`gradlew`:

```
#!/bin/sh

#
# Copyright © 2015-2021 the original authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
#

##############################################################################
#
#   Gradle start up script for POSIX generated by Gradle.
#
#   Important for running:
#
#   (1) You need a POSIX-compliant shell to run this script. If your /bin/sh is
#       noncompliant, but you have some other compliant shell such as ksh or
#       bash, then to run this script, type that shell name before the whole
#       command line, like:
#
#           ksh Gradle
#
#       Busybox and similar reduced shells will NOT work, because this script
#       requires all of these POSIX shell features:
#         * functions;
#         * expansions «$var», «${var}», «${var:-default}», «${var+SET}»,
#           «${var#prefix}», «${var%suffix}», and «$( cmd )»;
#         * compound commands having a testable exit status, especially «case»;
#         * various built-in commands including «command», «set», and «ulimit».
#
#   Important for patching:
#
#   (2) This script targets any POSIX shell, so it avoids extensions provided
#       by Bash, Ksh, etc; in particular arrays are avoided.
#
#       The "traditional" practice of packing multiple parameters into a
#       space-separated string is a well documented source of bugs and security
#       problems, so this is (mostly) avoided, by progressively accumulating
#       options in "$@", and eventually passing that to Java.
#
#       Where the inherited environment variables (DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS,
#       and GRADLE_OPTS) rely on word-splitting, this is performed explicitly;
#       see the in-line comments for details.
#
#       There are tweaks for specific operating systems such as AIX, CygWin,
#       Darwin, MinGW, and NonStop.
#
#   (3) This script is generated from the Groovy template
#       https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/HEAD/platforms/jvm/plugins-application/src/main/resources/org/gradle/api/internal/plugins/unixStartScript.txt
#       within the Gradle project.
#
#       You can find Gradle at https://github.com/gradle/gradle/.
#
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME

# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
app_path=$0

# Need this for daisy-chained symlinks.
while
    APP_HOME=${app_path%"${app_path##*/}"}  # leaves a trailing /; empty if no leading path
    [ -h "$app_path" ]
do
    ls=$( ls -ld "$app_path" )
    link=${ls#*' -> '}
    case $link in             #(
      /*)   app_path=$link ;; #(
      *)    app_path=$APP_HOME$link ;;
    esac
done

# This is normally unused
# shellcheck disable=SC2034
APP_BASE_NAME=${0##*/}
# Discard cd standard output in case $CDPATH is set (https://github.com/gradle/gradle/issues/25036)
APP_HOME=$( cd -P "${APP_HOME:-./}" > /dev/null && printf '%s\n' "$PWD" ) || exit

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD=maximum

warn () {
    echo "$*"
} >&2

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
} >&2

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "$( uname )" in                #(
  CYGWIN* )         cygwin=true  ;; #(
  Darwin* )         darwin=true  ;; #(
  MSYS* | MINGW* )  msys=true    ;; #(
  NONSTOP* )        nonstop=true ;;
esac

CLASSPATH="\\\"\\\""


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java
    else
        JAVACMD=$JAVA_HOME/bin/java
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD=java
    if ! command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1
    then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if ! "$cygwin" && ! "$darwin" && ! "$nonstop" ; then
    case $MAX_FD in #(
      max*)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -H is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        MAX_FD=$( ulimit -H -n ) ||
            warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit"
    esac
    case $MAX_FD in  #(
      '' | soft) :;; #(
      *)
        # In POSIX sh, ulimit -n is undefined. That's why the result is checked to see if it worked.
        # shellcheck disable=SC2039,SC3045
        ulimit -n "$MAX_FD" ||
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit to $MAX_FD"
    esac
fi

# Collect all arguments for the java command, stacking in reverse order:
#   * args from the command line
#   * the main class name
#   * -classpath
#   * -D...appname settings
#   * --module-path (only if needed)
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and GRADLE_OPTS environment variables.

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if "$cygwin" || "$msys" ; then
    APP_HOME=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME" )
    CLASSPATH=$( cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH" )

    JAVACMD=$( cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD" )

    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    for arg do
        if
            case $arg in                                #(
              -*)   false ;;                            # don't mess with options #(
              /?*)  t=${arg#/} t=/${t%%/*}              # looks like a POSIX filepath
                    [ -e "$t" ] ;;                      #(
              *)    false ;;
            esac
        then
            arg=$( cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg" )
        fi
        # Roll the args list around exactly as many times as the number of
        # args, so each arg winds up back in the position where it started, but
        # possibly modified.
        #
        # NB: a `for` loop captures its iteration list before it begins, so
        # changing the positional parameters here affects neither the number of
        # iterations, nor the values presented in `arg`.
        shift                   # remove old arg
        set -- "$@" "$arg"      # push replacement arg
    done
fi


# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Collect all arguments for the java command:
#   * DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS, JAVA_OPTS, and optsEnvironmentVar are not allowed to contain shell fragments,
#     and any embedded shellness will be escaped.
#   * For example: A user cannot expect ${Hostname} to be expanded, as it is an environment variable and will be
#     treated as '${Hostname}' itself on the command line.

set -- \
        "-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME" \
        -classpath "$CLASSPATH" \
        -jar "$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar" \
        "$@"

# Stop when "xargs" is not available.
if ! command -v xargs >/dev/null 2>&1
then
    die "xargs is not available"
fi

# Use "xargs" to parse quoted args.
#
# With -n1 it outputs one arg per line, with the quotes and backslashes removed.
#
# In Bash we could simply go:
#
#   readarray ARGS < <( xargs -n1 <<<"$var" ) &&
#   set -- "${ARGS[@]}" "$@"
#
# but POSIX shell has neither arrays nor command substitution, so instead we
# post-process each arg (as a line of input to sed) to backslash-escape any
# character that might be a shell metacharacter, then use eval to reverse
# that process (while maintaining the separation between arguments), and wrap
# the whole thing up as a single "set" statement.
#
# This will of course break if any of these variables contains a newline or
# an unmatched quote.
#

eval "set -- $(
        printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS" |
        xargs -n1 |
        sed ' s~[^-[:alnum:]+,./:=@_]~\\&~g; ' |
        tr '\n' ' '
    )" '"$@"'

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/BytecodeFallback.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.util.TraceClassVisitor;

public final class BytecodeFallback {
    public EngineResult dump(Path jar, Path output, Duration timeout) {
        var engine = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "bytecode"; }
            public String version() { return "ASM-9.7.1"; }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path destination) {
                try {
                    var paths = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                    for (var type : List.of(BytecodeWorker.class, ClassReader.class, TraceClassVisitor.class))
                        paths.add(Path.of(type.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()).toString());
                    return List.of(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(),
                        "-Xmx256m", "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8", "-cp", String.join(java.io.File.pathSeparator, paths),
                        BytecodeWorker.class.getName(), input.toString(), destination.toString());
                } catch (Exception error) { throw new IllegalStateException(error); }
            }
        };
        return new ProcessRunner().runDisassembler(engine, jar, output, timeout);
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/BytecodeWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import java.io.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.util.TraceClassVisitor;

/** Disassembles a previously validated class-only JAR; no target class loading. */
public final class BytecodeWorker {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        try (var jar = new ZipFile(args[0])) {
            var entries = jar.entries(); int count = 0;
            while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                if (!entry.getName().endsWith(".class")) continue;
                if (++count > 20_000) throw new IOException("Entry limit");
                try (var input = jar.getInputStream(entry)) {
                    byte[] bytes = input.readNBytes(16 * 1024 * 1024 + 1);
                    if (bytes.length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Class size limit");
                    Path destination = Path.of(args[1]).resolve(String.format("%05d.txt", count));
                    try (var writer = new PrintWriter(Files.newBufferedWriter(destination, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
                        writer.println("Original entry: " + entry.getName());
                        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(new TraceClassVisitor(writer), 0);
                        if (writer.checkError()) throw new IOException("Cannot write bytecode");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/CallHierarchy.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase G6: who calls a method, then who calls those, up to a depth, from a {@link ReferenceIndex}. A caller is a member
 * holding a call, a lambda body or method reference, or a method handle to the method. A method already on the path is
 * shown once more, marked as a cycle, and not expanded again. A node budget bounds the whole tree.
 */
public final class CallHierarchy {
    private CallHierarchy() {}

    /**
     * One method in the tree. {@code sites}: its references to the parent (empty for the root). {@code cycle}: it is
     * already on the path above. {@code cut}: callers exist but were not expanded (depth or budget reached).
     */
    public record Node(ReferenceIndex.Ref method, List<ReferenceIndex.Usage> sites, boolean cycle, boolean cut, List<Node> callers) {}

    /** The tree of callers of {@code method}; {@code depth} 1 lists direct callers only. */
    public static Node callers(ReferenceIndex index, ReferenceIndex.Ref method, int depth, int maxNodes) {
        int[] budget = {Math.max(1, maxNodes) - 1};
        return expand(index, method, List.of(), new ArrayDeque<>(List.of(method)), depth, budget);
    }

    private static Node expand(ReferenceIndex index, ReferenceIndex.Ref method, List<ReferenceIndex.Usage> sites, Deque<ReferenceIndex.Ref> path,
                               int depth, int[] budget) {
        var grouped = direct(index, method);
        if (depth <= 0 || grouped.isEmpty()) return new Node(method, sites, false, !grouped.isEmpty(), List.of());
        var children = new ArrayList<Node>();
        boolean cut = false;
        for (var entry : grouped.entrySet()) {
            if (budget[0] <= 0) { cut = true; break; }
            budget[0]--;
            var caller = entry.getKey();
            if (path.contains(caller)) { children.add(new Node(caller, entry.getValue(), true, false, List.of())); continue; }
            path.push(caller);
            children.add(expand(index, caller, entry.getValue(), path, depth - 1, budget));
            path.pop();
        }
        return new Node(method, sites, false, cut, List.copyOf(children));
    }

    /** The direct callers of {@code method}, each with its sites, in the index's order. */
    public static Map<ReferenceIndex.Ref,List<ReferenceIndex.Usage>> direct(ReferenceIndex index, ReferenceIndex.Ref method) {
        var grouped = new LinkedHashMap<ReferenceIndex.Ref,List<ReferenceIndex.Usage>>();
        for (var usage : index.usages(method))
            if (ReferenceIndex.calls(usage.site().kind()) && !usage.site().from().isClass())
                grouped.computeIfAbsent(usage.site().from(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(usage);
        return grouped;
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/ClassInspector.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import dev.classrevive.model.MemberInfo;
import java.util.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;

public final class ClassInspector {
    public static final int MIN_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION = 45;
    // Tied to the newest class-file constant of the pinned ASM parser (9.11.x: Java 28).
    public static final int MAX_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION = Opcodes.V28 & 0xFFFF;

    public ClassInfo inspect(byte[] bytes) {
        if (bytes.length < 10 || bytes[0] != (byte) 0xca || bytes[1] != (byte) 0xfe
                || bytes[2] != (byte) 0xba || bytes[3] != (byte) 0xbe)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid class header");
        int major = ((bytes[6] & 255) << 8) | (bytes[7] & 255);
        int minor = ((bytes[4] & 255) << 8) | (bytes[5] & 255);
        if (major < MIN_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION || major > MAX_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION)
            throw new UnsupportedClassVersion(major, minor);
        try {
            var reader = new ClassReader(bytes);
            var fields = new ArrayList<MemberInfo>();
            var methods = new ArrayList<MemberInfo>();
            reader.accept(new ClassVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                @Override public FieldVisitor visitField(int access, String name, String descriptor, String signature, Object value) {
                    fields.add(new MemberInfo(name, descriptor, access));
                    return new FieldVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {};
                }
                @Override public MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access, String name, String descriptor, String signature, String[] exceptions) {
                    methods.add(new MemberInfo(name, descriptor, access));
                    return new MethodVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {};
                }
            }, 0);
            return new ClassInfo(reader.getClassName(), reader.getSuperName(), major, minor,
                reader.getAccess(), Arrays.asList(reader.getInterfaces()), fields, methods);
        } catch (StackOverflowError excessiveNesting) {
            // ASM traverses nested annotation values recursively. Contain this
            // specific parser failure; never attempt to recover from arbitrary VM errors.
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class metadata exceeds parser nesting capacity");
        } catch (RuntimeException error) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed or truncated class file", error);
        }
    }
    public static final class UnsupportedClassVersion extends IllegalArgumentException {
        private final int majorVersion;
        private final int minorVersion;

        public UnsupportedClassVersion(int majorVersion, int minorVersion) {
            super(message(majorVersion, minorVersion));
            this.majorVersion = majorVersion;
            this.minorVersion = minorVersion;
        }

        public int majorVersion() { return majorVersion; }
        public int minorVersion() { return minorVersion; }

        private static String message(int major, int minor) {
            String javaVersion = javaVersion(major);
            String detected = "major " + major + ", minor " + minor
                + (javaVersion == null ? "" : " (Java " + javaVersion + ")");
            return "Unsupported class-file version: " + detected + "; this build supports major versions "
                + MIN_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION + ".." + MAX_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION
                + " (Java 1.1.." + javaVersion(MAX_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION) + ")";
        }

        private static String javaVersion(int major) {
            if (major < MIN_SUPPORTED_MAJOR_VERSION) return null;
            int release = major - 44;
            return release <= 4 ? "1." + release : Integer.toString(release);
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/ClassReducer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.util.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;

/**
 * Bytecode reductions for failure minimization (Phase 2AT delta debugging). Every operation parses and writes bytes
 * with ASM only; nothing is loaded, linked or executed here. A result is only a candidate: the caller keeps it when the
 * JVM verifier accepts it ({@link LinkCheck}) and the failure still reproduces.
 *
 * <p>Instruction edits only touch the focus method. Its frames and limits are recomputed in a throwaway class that
 * holds that method alone, so the other methods keep their original bytes and frames. Common superclasses come from
 * the case classes and from JDK classes looked up without initialization through the platform loader, which cannot
 * see target classes; an unknown type counts as {@code java/lang/Object}.
 */
public final class ClassReducer {
    private ClassReducer() {}

    /** A field or method; {@link #key()} is {@code name(desc)ret} for methods and {@code name:desc} for fields. */
    public record Member(boolean method, String name, String descriptor, boolean hasBody) {
        public String key() { return method ? name + descriptor : name + ":" + descriptor; }
    }

    public static List<Member> members(byte[] bytes) {
        var node = read(bytes, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
        var result = new ArrayList<Member>();
        for (var field : node.fields) result.add(new Member(false, field.name, field.desc, false));
        for (var method : node.methods) result.add(new Member(true, method.name, method.desc, method.instructions.size() > 0));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    /** Real instructions over all methods (labels, line numbers and frames excluded); a size measure for reports. */
    public static int instructions(byte[] bytes) {
        int total = 0;
        for (var method : read(bytes, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES | ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG).methods)
            for (var insn : method.instructions) if (real(insn)) total++;
        return total;
    }

    /** Removes every field and method whose key is not in {@code keep}; the remaining bytes are unchanged. */
    public static byte[] keepMembers(byte[] bytes, Set<String> keep) {
        var node = read(bytes, 0);
        node.fields.removeIf(field -> !keep.contains(field.name + ":" + field.desc));
        node.methods.removeIf(method -> !keep.contains(method.name + method.desc));
        return write(node);
    }

    /**
     * Replaces the bodies of the given methods: constructors call the superclass no-argument constructor and return,
     * every other method becomes {@code throw null}. Neither needs a stack map frame.
     */
    public static byte[] stubMethods(byte[] bytes, Set<String> methods) {
        var node = read(bytes, 0);
        for (var method : node.methods) {
            if (!methods.contains(method.name + method.desc) || method.instructions.size() == 0) continue;
            var body = new InsnList();
            if (method.name.equals("<init>")) {
                body.add(new VarInsnNode(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0));
                body.add(new MethodInsnNode(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, node.superName, "<init>", "()V", false));
                body.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.RETURN));
            } else {
                body.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.ACONST_NULL));
                body.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.ATHROW));
            }
            method.instructions = body; method.tryCatchBlocks = new ArrayList<>(); method.localVariables = new ArrayList<>();
            method.visibleLocalVariableAnnotations = null; method.invisibleLocalVariableAnnotations = null;
            method.visibleTypeAnnotations = null; method.invisibleTypeAnnotations = null;
            method.maxStack = 2; method.maxLocals = Math.max(1, Type.getArgumentsAndReturnSizes(method.desc) >> 2);
        }
        return write(node);
    }

    /** Drops LineNumberTable, LocalVariableTable, SourceFile and other debug attributes. */
    public static byte[] stripDebug(byte[] bytes) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(writer, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** Removes InnerClasses, NestMembers and PermittedSubclasses entries that name a removed class. */
    public static byte[] dropReferences(byte[] bytes, Set<String> removed) {
        var node = read(bytes, 0);
        node.innerClasses.removeIf(inner -> removed.contains(inner.name));
        if (node.nestMembers != null) node.nestMembers.removeIf(removed::contains);
        if (node.permittedSubclasses != null) node.permittedSubclasses.removeIf(removed::contains);
        return write(node);
    }

    /** Human-readable list of the instruction edits {@link #applyEdit} accepts for the method, in index order. */
    public static List<String> edits(byte[] bytes, String methodKey) {
        var method = method(read(bytes, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES), methodKey);
        if (method == null) return List.of();
        var result = new ArrayList<String>();
        var starts = blockStarts(method);
        for (int i = 1; i < starts.size(); i++) result.add("cut block " + i + " of " + starts.size() + " to a default return");
        for (int i = 0; i < method.tryCatchBlocks.size(); i++) result.add("drop exception handler " + (i + 1));
        var jumps = branches(method);
        for (int i = 0; i < jumps.size(); i++) result.add("branch " + (i + 1) + " never taken");
        for (int i = 0; i < jumps.size(); i++) result.add("branch " + (i + 1) + " always taken");
        var switches = switches(method);
        for (int i = 0; i < switches.size(); i++) result.add("switch " + (i + 1) + " to its default target");
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    /**
     * Applies edit {@code index} of {@link #edits} to the focus method, removes the code it made unreachable and
     * recomputes that method's frames. Returns null when the edit is not applicable or the result cannot be written.
     */
    public static byte[] applyEdit(byte[] bytes, String methodKey, int index, Map<String,byte[]> caseClasses) {
        var node = read(bytes, 0);
        var method = method(node, methodKey);
        if (method == null || index < 0) return null;
        var starts = blockStarts(method);
        var jumps = branches(method);
        var switches = switches(method);
        int cuts = starts.size() - 1, handlers = method.tryCatchBlocks.size();
        try {
            if (index < cuts) cut(method, starts, index + 1);
            else if ((index -= cuts) < handlers) method.tryCatchBlocks.remove(index);
            else if ((index -= handlers) < jumps.size()) never(method, jumps.get(index));
            else if ((index -= jumps.size()) < jumps.size()) always(method, jumps.get(index));
            else if ((index -= jumps.size()) < switches.size()) toDefault(method, switches.get(index));
            else return null;
            removeUnreachable(node.name, method);
            var rebuilt = recompute(node, method, caseClasses);
            node.methods.set(node.methods.indexOf(method), rebuilt);
            return write(node);
        } catch (AnalyzerException | RuntimeException invalid) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static ClassNode read(byte[] bytes, int flags) {
        var node = new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, flags);
        return node;
    }

    private static byte[] write(ClassNode node) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        node.accept(writer);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static MethodNode method(ClassNode node, String key) {
        for (var method : node.methods) if ((method.name + method.desc).equals(key) && method.instructions.size() > 0) return method;
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean real(AbstractInsnNode insn) { return insn.getOpcode() >= 0; }

    /** First real instruction of each basic block, in code order. */
    static List<AbstractInsnNode> blockStarts(MethodNode method) {
        var targets = new HashSet<LabelNode>();
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) { targets.add(block.start); targets.add(block.end); targets.add(block.handler); }
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) targets.add(jump.label);
            else if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { targets.add(table.dflt); targets.addAll(table.labels); }
            else if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { targets.add(lookup.dflt); targets.addAll(lookup.labels); }
        }
        var result = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        boolean starts = true;
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof LabelNode label && targets.contains(label)) starts = true;
            if (!real(insn)) continue;
            if (starts) result.add(insn);
            starts = transfers(insn);
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean transfers(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int opcode = insn.getOpcode();
        return insn instanceof JumpInsnNode || insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode
            || opcode >= Opcodes.IRETURN && opcode <= Opcodes.RETURN || opcode == Opcodes.ATHROW || opcode == Opcodes.RET;
    }

    private static List<JumpInsnNode> branches(MethodNode method) {
        var result = new ArrayList<JumpInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions)
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && jump.getOpcode() != Opcodes.GOTO && jump.getOpcode() != Opcodes.JSR) result.add(jump);
        return result;
    }

    private static List<AbstractInsnNode> switches(MethodNode method) {
        var result = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions)
            if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) result.add(insn);
        return result;
    }

    /** Replaces block {@code block} (up to the next block start) with a return of the method's default value. */
    private static void cut(MethodNode method, List<AbstractInsnNode> starts, int block) {
        AbstractInsnNode from = starts.get(block), until = block + 1 < starts.size() ? starts.get(block + 1) : null;
        var doomed = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var insn = from; insn != null && insn != until; insn = insn.getNext()) if (real(insn)) doomed.add(insn);
        var ret = defaultReturn(Type.getReturnType(method.desc));
        method.instructions.insertBefore(from, ret);
        doomed.forEach(method.instructions::remove);
    }

    private static InsnList defaultReturn(Type type) {
        var list = new InsnList();
        switch (type.getSort()) {
            case Type.VOID -> list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.RETURN));
            case Type.BOOLEAN, Type.BYTE, Type.CHAR, Type.SHORT, Type.INT -> { list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.ICONST_0)); list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.IRETURN)); }
            case Type.LONG -> { list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.LCONST_0)); list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.LRETURN)); }
            case Type.FLOAT -> { list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.FCONST_0)); list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.FRETURN)); }
            case Type.DOUBLE -> { list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.DCONST_0)); list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.DRETURN)); }
            default -> { list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.ACONST_NULL)); list.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.ARETURN)); }
        }
        return list;
    }

    private static InsnNode popOperands(int opcode) {
        boolean two = opcode >= Opcodes.IF_ICMPEQ && opcode <= Opcodes.IF_ACMPNE;
        return new InsnNode(two ? Opcodes.POP2 : Opcodes.POP);
    }

    private static void never(MethodNode method, JumpInsnNode jump) {
        method.instructions.set(jump, popOperands(jump.getOpcode()));
    }

    private static void always(MethodNode method, JumpInsnNode jump) {
        var replacement = new InsnList();
        replacement.add(popOperands(jump.getOpcode()));
        replacement.add(new JumpInsnNode(Opcodes.GOTO, jump.label));
        method.instructions.insertBefore(jump, replacement);
        method.instructions.remove(jump);
    }

    private static void toDefault(MethodNode method, AbstractInsnNode table) {
        LabelNode target = table instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode t ? t.dflt : ((LookupSwitchInsnNode) table).dflt;
        var replacement = new InsnList();
        replacement.add(new InsnNode(Opcodes.POP));
        replacement.add(new JumpInsnNode(Opcodes.GOTO, target));
        method.instructions.insertBefore(table, replacement);
        method.instructions.remove(table);
    }

    /**
     * Removes instructions no path reaches and handlers whose protected range no longer holds code, until nothing
     * changes. Frames are dropped here; the caller recomputes them.
     */
    static void removeUnreachable(String owner, MethodNode method) throws AnalyzerException {
        for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) if (insn instanceof FrameNode) method.instructions.remove(insn);
        method.maxStack += 4; // headroom for inserted constants; recomputed when written
        for (int round = 0; round < 16; round++) {
            var frames = new Analyzer<>(new BasicInterpreter()).analyze(owner, method);
            var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
            boolean changed = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++)
                if (frames[i] == null && real(insns[i])) { method.instructions.remove(insns[i]); changed = true; }
            changed |= method.tryCatchBlocks.removeIf(block -> !covers(block));
            if (!changed) return;
        }
        throw new AnalyzerException(null, "dead code removal did not converge");
    }

    private static boolean covers(TryCatchBlockNode block) {
        for (AbstractInsnNode insn = block.start; insn != null && insn != block.end; insn = insn.getNext()) if (real(insn)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** Writes the class with only this method and frame computation, then reads the method back with its new frames. */
    private static MethodNode recompute(ClassNode node, MethodNode method, Map<String,byte[]> caseClasses) {
        var shell = new ClassNode();
        shell.version = node.version; shell.access = node.access; shell.name = node.name; shell.signature = node.signature;
        shell.superName = node.superName; shell.interfaces = node.interfaces;
        shell.methods.add(method);
        int flags = (node.version & 0xFFFF) >= Opcodes.V1_6 ? ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES : ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS;
        var writer = new ClassWriter(flags) {
            @Override protected String getCommonSuperClass(String first, String second) { return commonSuperClass(first, second, caseClasses); }
        };
        shell.accept(writer);
        var reread = read(writer.toByteArray(), 0);
        return reread.methods.getFirst();
    }

    private record Header(String superName, List<String> interfaces, boolean isInterface) {}

    static String commonSuperClass(String first, String second, Map<String,byte[]> caseClasses) {
        if (assignable(first, second, caseClasses)) return first;
        if (assignable(second, first, caseClasses)) return second;
        Header a = header(first, caseClasses), b = header(second, caseClasses);
        if (a == null || b == null || a.isInterface || b.isInterface) return "java/lang/Object";
        for (String type = a.superName; type != null; ) {
            if (assignable(type, second, caseClasses)) return type;
            Header next = header(type, caseClasses);
            type = next == null ? null : next.superName;
        }
        return "java/lang/Object";
    }

    /** True when {@code target} is {@code type} or one of its supertypes, following known headers only. */
    private static boolean assignable(String target, String type, Map<String,byte[]> caseClasses) {
        var pending = new ArrayDeque<String>(List.of(type)); var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            String current = pending.pop();
            if (current.equals(target)) return true;
            if (!seen.add(current) || seen.size() > 1000) continue;
            Header header = header(current, caseClasses);
            if (header == null) continue;
            if (header.superName != null) pending.push(header.superName);
            header.interfaces.forEach(pending::push);
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static Header header(String name, Map<String,byte[]> caseClasses) {
        byte[] bytes = caseClasses.get(name);
        if (bytes != null) {
            try {
                var reader = new ClassReader(bytes);
                return new Header(reader.getSuperName(), List.of(reader.getInterfaces()), (reader.getAccess() & Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE) != 0);
            } catch (RuntimeException malformed) { return null; }
        }
        try {
            // Platform loader: JDK classes only, loaded without initialization; it cannot see target or ClassRevive classes.
            Class<?> type = Class.forName(name.replace('/', '.'), false, ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader());
            var interfaces = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (var item : type.getInterfaces()) interfaces.add(Type.getInternalName(item));
            return new Header(type.getSuperclass() == null ? null : Type.getInternalName(type.getSuperclass()), interfaces, type.isInterface());
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | LinkageError unknown) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/ClassText.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.io.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.util.TraceClassVisitor;

/**
 * Phase G3: readable bytecode of one class for the desktop GUI, before or without decompilation. ASM only parses the
 * bytes (nothing is defined, loaded or run). The text is cut at {@code maxChars}; a class ASM cannot parse gives an
 * {@link IOException} with ASM's reason.
 */
public final class ClassText {
    private ClassText() {}

    public static String disassemble(byte[] classBytes, int maxChars) throws IOException {
        var text = new StringWriter();
        try (var writer = new PrintWriter(new BoundedWriter(text, maxChars))) {
            new ClassReader(classBytes).accept(new TraceClassVisitor(writer), 0);
        } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
            throw new IOException("ASM cannot read this class: " + malformed, malformed);
        }
        return text.toString();
    }

    /** Stops copying at the limit and appends one truncation note; writing past it is ignored. */
    private static final class BoundedWriter extends Writer {
        private final StringWriter out;
        private final int max;
        private boolean truncated;
        BoundedWriter(StringWriter out, int max) { this.out = out; this.max = max; }
        @Override public void write(char[] buffer, int offset, int length) {
            if (truncated) return;
            int room = max - out.getBuffer().length();
            if (length <= room) { out.write(buffer, offset, length); return; }
            out.write(buffer, offset, Math.max(0, room));
            out.write("\n// ... truncated at " + max + " characters\n");
            truncated = true;
        }
        @Override public void flush() {}
        @Override public void close() {}
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/CompilerFingerprint.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CJ: which compiler produced the classes, from traces each compiler leaves in the bytecode. ASM reads the
 * class bytes; nothing is defined, loaded or run. Every finding is a count of classes with a documented signal, so a
 * verdict can be checked.
 * <ul>
 * <li><b>Kotlin</b>: the {@code @kotlin.Metadata} annotation kotlinc puts on every class.</li>
 * <li><b>Scala</b>: the {@code ScalaSig}, {@code Scala} or {@code TASTY} attribute, or {@code @ScalaSignature}.</li>
 * <li><b>Groovy</b>: {@code groovy.lang.GroovyObject} implemented, or the {@code $staticClassInfo} field.</li>
 * <li><b>javac versus ecj</b> (Eclipse), for Java classes: javac names lambda bodies {@code lambda$method$N}, keeps
 * enum switch maps in {@code $SwitchMap$...} fields and builds {@code values()} with {@code $VALUES.clone()}; ecj
 * names them {@code lambda$N}, uses {@code $SWITCH_TABLE$...} methods and copies with {@code System.arraycopy}.</li>
 * <li><b>javac version</b>, a lower bound: string concatenation through {@code StringConcatFactory} (javac 9+) and
 * the synthetic enum {@code $values()} method (javac 15+).</li>
 * <li><b>Debug information</b>: {@code SourceFile}, line numbers and local variable tables. Without local variable
 * tables every decompiler invents local names.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class CompilerFingerprint {
    private CompilerFingerprint() {}

    private static final Pattern JAVAC_LAMBDA = Pattern.compile("lambda\\$[^$]+\\$\\d+"), ECJ_LAMBDA = Pattern.compile("lambda\\$\\d+");

    /** Class counts per finding; {@code classVersions}: Java version of the class files to class count. */
    public record Result(int classes, int kotlin, int scala, int groovy, int java, int javacSignals, int ecjSignals,
                         int javacAtLeast, int withSourceFile, int withLineNumbers, int withLocalVariables, int withCode,
                         SortedMap<Integer,Integer> classVersions) {
        /** {@code javac}, {@code ecj}, {@code mixed} or {@code undetermined}, for the Java classes. */
        public String javaCompiler() {
            if (javacSignals > 0 && ecjSignals == 0) return "javac";
            if (ecjSignals > 0 && javacSignals == 0) return "ecj";
            return javacSignals > 0 ? "mixed" : "undetermined";
        }
        /** The main language by class count. */
        public String language() {
            int best = Math.max(Math.max(kotlin, scala), Math.max(groovy, java));
            if (classes == 0) return "none";
            return best == kotlin && kotlin > 0 ? "Kotlin" : best == scala && scala > 0 ? "Scala" : best == groovy && groovy > 0 ? "Groovy" : "Java";
        }
    }

    public static Result analyze(Collection<byte[]> classFiles) {
        int classes = 0, kotlin = 0, scala = 0, groovy = 0, java = 0, javac = 0, ecj = 0, atLeast = 0;
        int sourceFile = 0, lines = 0, locals = 0, code = 0;
        var versions = new TreeMap<Integer,Integer>();
        for (byte[] bytes : classFiles) {
            var visitor = new Probe();
            try { new ClassReader(bytes).accept(visitor, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES); }
            catch (RuntimeException unreadable) { continue; } // A class ASM cannot parse gives no evidence.
            classes++;
            versions.merge(visitor.javaVersion, 1, Integer::sum);
            if (visitor.kotlin) kotlin++;
            else if (visitor.scala) scala++;
            else if (visitor.groovy) groovy++;
            else {
                java++;
                if (visitor.javac) javac++;
                if (visitor.ecj) ecj++;
                if (!visitor.ecj) atLeast = Math.max(atLeast, visitor.javacAtLeast);
            }
            if (visitor.sourceFile) sourceFile++;
            if (visitor.methodsWithCode > 0) {
                code++;
                if (visitor.methodsWithLines > 0) lines++;
                if (visitor.methodsWithLocals > 0) locals++;
            }
        }
        return new Result(classes, kotlin, scala, groovy, java, javac, ecj, atLeast, sourceFile, lines, locals, code,
            Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(versions));
    }

    /** Readable lines for reports. */
    public static String text(Result result) {
        if (result.classes() == 0) return "";
        var out = new StringBuilder("Compiler fingerprint: ").append(result.language());
        if (result.java() > 0 && result.javaCompiler().equals("undetermined")) {
            out.append("; Java compiler undetermined (no javac or ecj signal in ").append(result.java()).append(" Java classes)");
        } else if (result.java() > 0) {
            out.append("; Java classes by ").append(result.javaCompiler());
            if (result.javaCompiler().equals("javac") && result.javacAtLeast() > 0) out.append(' ').append(result.javacAtLeast()).append('+');
            out.append(" (javac signals in ").append(result.javacSignals()).append(", ecj signals in ").append(result.ecjSignals()).append(" classes)");
        }
        if (result.kotlin() + result.scala() + result.groovy() > 0)
            out.append("; Kotlin ").append(result.kotlin()).append(", Scala ").append(result.scala()).append(", Groovy ").append(result.groovy()).append(" classes");
        out.append("\n  Class files: ");
        var versions = new StringJoiner(", ");
        result.classVersions().forEach((version, count) -> versions.add("Java " + version + " (" + count + ")"));
        out.append(versions).append("\n  Debug information: source file in ").append(result.withSourceFile()).append('/').append(result.classes())
            .append(" classes, line numbers in ").append(result.withLineNumbers()).append('/').append(result.withCode())
            .append(", local variable names in ").append(result.withLocalVariables()).append('/').append(result.withCode());
        if (result.withCode() > 0 && result.withLocalVariables() * 2 < result.withCode())
            out.append(" (most local variable names were not compiled in: decompilers invent them)");
        if (result.kotlin() > 0) out.append("\n  Kotlin classes decompile to Java: expect Intrinsics null checks, companion objects and synthetic accessors.");
        return out.append('\n').toString();
    }

    public static Map<String,Object> json(Result result) {
        var data = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        data.put("classes", result.classes()); data.put("language", result.language());
        data.put("kotlin_classes", result.kotlin()); data.put("scala_classes", result.scala()); data.put("groovy_classes", result.groovy());
        data.put("java_classes", result.java()); data.put("java_compiler", result.javaCompiler());
        data.put("javac_signal_classes", result.javacSignals()); data.put("ecj_signal_classes", result.ecjSignals());
        data.put("javac_at_least", result.javacAtLeast() == 0 ? null : result.javacAtLeast());
        var versions = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        result.classVersions().forEach((version, count) -> versions.put(Integer.toString(version), count));
        data.put("class_file_versions", versions);
        data.put("debug", Map.of("source_file", result.withSourceFile(), "line_numbers", result.withLineNumbers(),
            "local_variables", result.withLocalVariables(), "classes_with_code", result.withCode()));
        data.put("method", "documented bytecode traces: kotlin.Metadata, Scala signature attributes, GroovyObject, javac/ecj naming of "
            + "lambdas, enum switch maps and values(), StringConcatFactory (javac 9+), enum $values() (javac 15+); a hypothesis, not proof");
        return data;
    }

    /** Phase 2DC: a class kotlinc compiled (it carries {@code kotlin.Metadata}). */
    public static boolean kotlin(org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode node) {
        for (var list : Arrays.asList(node.visibleAnnotations, node.invisibleAnnotations))
            if (list != null) for (var annotation : list) if (annotation.desc.equals("Lkotlin/Metadata;")) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static final class Probe extends ClassVisitor {
        boolean kotlin, scala, groovy, javac, ecj, sourceFile, isEnum;
        int javaVersion, javacAtLeast, methodsWithCode, methodsWithLines, methodsWithLocals;
        Probe() { super(Opcodes.ASM9); }

        @Override public void visit(int version, int access, String name, String signature, String superName, String[] interfaces) {
            javaVersion = Math.max(1, (version & 0xFFFF) - 44);
            isEnum = (access & Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0;
            if (interfaces != null) for (String type : interfaces) if (type.equals("groovy/lang/GroovyObject")) groovy = true;
        }
        @Override public void visitSource(String source, String debug) { if (source != null) sourceFile = true; }
        @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String descriptor, boolean visible) {
            if (descriptor.equals("Lkotlin/Metadata;")) kotlin = true;
            if (descriptor.equals("Lscala/reflect/ScalaSignature;") || descriptor.equals("Lscala/reflect/ScalaLongSignature;")) scala = true;
            return null;
        }
        @Override public void visitAttribute(Attribute attribute) {
            if (attribute.type.equals("ScalaSig") || attribute.type.equals("Scala") || attribute.type.equals("TASTY")) scala = true;
        }
        @Override public FieldVisitor visitField(int access, String name, String descriptor, String signature, Object value) {
            if (name.equals("$staticClassInfo")) groovy = true;
            if (name.startsWith("$SwitchMap$") && (access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC) != 0) javac = true;
            return null;
        }
        @Override public MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access, String name, String descriptor, String signature, String[] exceptions) {
            boolean synthetic = (access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC) != 0;
            if (synthetic && JAVAC_LAMBDA.matcher(name).matches()) javac = true;
            if (synthetic && ECJ_LAMBDA.matcher(name).matches()) ecj = true;
            if (name.startsWith("$SWITCH_TABLE$") && synthetic) ecj = true;
            if (isEnum && name.equals("$values") && synthetic) { javac = true; javacAtLeast = Math.max(javacAtLeast, 15); }
            boolean enumValues = isEnum && name.equals("values") && descriptor.startsWith("()[");
            return new MethodVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                boolean hasCode, hasLines, hasLocals;
                @Override public void visitCode() { hasCode = true; }
                @Override public void visitLineNumber(int line, Label start) { hasLines = true; }
                @Override public void visitLocalVariable(String local, String type, String generic, Label start, Label end, int index) { hasLocals = true; }
                @Override public void visitMethodInsn(int opcode, String owner, String method, String desc, boolean isInterface) {
                    if (!enumValues) return;
                    if (owner.equals("java/lang/System") && method.equals("arraycopy")) ecj = true;
                    if (method.equals("clone") && owner.startsWith("[")) javac = true;
                }
                @Override public void visitInvokeDynamicInsn(String method, String desc, Handle bootstrap, Object... arguments) {
                    if (bootstrap.getOwner().equals("java/lang/invoke/StringConcatFactory")) javacAtLeast = Math.max(javacAtLeast, 9);
                }
                @Override public void visitEnd() {
                    if (hasCode) { methodsWithCode++; if (hasLines) methodsWithLines++; if (hasLocals) methodsWithLocals++; }
                }
            };
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/DynamicScanner.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import java.util.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Metadata-only linkage findings; no bootstrap or reflective invocation is performed. */
public final class DynamicScanner {
    public record Finding(String className,String method,String descriptor,int instruction,String kind,
                          String owner,String name,String targetDescriptor,int bootstrapArguments) {}
    public record Result(List<Finding> findings,boolean limitReached) { public Result { findings=List.copyOf(findings); } }
    public Result scan(byte[] bytes,int limit) {
        if(bytes.length>16*1024*1024 || limit<1 || limit>10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid class or finding budget");
        var findings=new ArrayList<Finding>(); boolean[] limited={false};
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(new ClassVisitor(ASM9) {
            String className, superName;
            @Override public void visit(int v,int a,String n,String s,String p,String[] i) { className=n; superName=p; }
            @Override public MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access,String method,String descriptor,String signature,String[] exceptions) {
                return new MethodVisitor(ASM9) {
                    int instruction;
                    void add(String kind,Handle handle,int arguments) {
                        if(findings.size()==limit) { limited[0]=true; return; }
                        findings.add(new Finding(className,method,descriptor,instruction,kind,handle.getOwner(),handle.getName(),handle.getDesc(),arguments));
                    }
                    void constant(Object value,int depth) {
                        if(!(value instanceof ConstantDynamic dynamic)) return;
                        if(depth>8 || findings.size()==limit) { limited[0]=true; return; }
                        add("CONSTANT_DYNAMIC",dynamic.getBootstrapMethod(),dynamic.getBootstrapMethodArgumentCount());
                        for(int i=0;i<dynamic.getBootstrapMethodArgumentCount();i++) constant(dynamic.getBootstrapMethodArgument(i),depth+1);
                    }
                    @Override public void visitInvokeDynamicInsn(String name,String desc,Handle bootstrap,Object... arguments) {
                        add("INVOKEDYNAMIC",bootstrap,arguments.length);
                        for(Object argument:arguments) constant(argument,0);
                        instruction++;
                    }
                    @Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object value) { constant(value,0); instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitMethodInsn(int op,String owner,String name,String desc,boolean itf) {
                        String signal = staticApiSignal(owner,name,desc,className,superName);
                        if(signal != null)
                            add(signal,new Handle(H_INVOKESTATIC,owner,name,desc,itf),0);
                        else if(owner.startsWith("java/lang/reflect/") || owner.equals("java/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup") ||
                            (owner.equals("java/lang/Class") && (name.equals("forName") || name.startsWith("getDeclared") || name.equals("getMethod") || name.equals("getField") || name.equals("getConstructor") || name.equals("newInstance"))))
                            add("REFLECTION_API",new Handle(H_INVOKESTATIC,owner,name,desc,itf),0);
                        instruction++;
                    }
                    @Override public void visitInsn(int op) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitIntInsn(int op,int operand) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitVarInsn(int op,int variable) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitTypeInsn(int op,String type) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitFieldInsn(int op,String owner,String name,String desc) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitJumpInsn(int op,Label label) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitIincInsn(int variable,int increment) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitTableSwitchInsn(int min,int max,Label d,Label... labels) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitLookupSwitchInsn(Label d,int[] keys,Label[] labels) { instruction++; }
                    @Override public void visitMultiANewArrayInsn(String desc,int dimensions) { instruction++; }
                };
            }
        },ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG|ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
        return new Result(findings,limited[0] || findings.size()==limit);
    }

    /** JDK loaders whose loadClass/defineClass a subclass inherits. Deeper custom hierarchies need cross-class analysis. */
    private static final Set<String> JDK_CLASS_LOADERS=Set.of("java/lang/ClassLoader","java/security/SecureClassLoader","java/net/URLClassLoader");
    private static final Set<String> DEFINE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS=Set.of("([BII)Ljava/lang/Class;","([BIILjava/security/ProtectionDomain;)Ljava/lang/Class;",
        "(Ljava/lang/String;[BII)Ljava/lang/Class;","(Ljava/lang/String;[BIILjava/security/ProtectionDomain;)Ljava/lang/Class;",
        "(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/nio/ByteBuffer;Ljava/security/ProtectionDomain;)Ljava/lang/Class;",
        "(Ljava/lang/String;[BIILjava/security/CodeSource;)Ljava/lang/Class;",
        "(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/nio/ByteBuffer;Ljava/security/CodeSource;)Ljava/lang/Class;");

    private static String staticApiSignal(String owner,String name,String descriptor,String className,String superName) {
        boolean classLoaderOwner=JDK_CLASS_LOADERS.contains(owner)
            || owner.equals(className) && JDK_CLASS_LOADERS.contains(superName);
        boolean classLoadingMethod=name.equals("loadClass")
                && (descriptor.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;")
                    || descriptor.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;Z)Ljava/lang/Class;"))
            || name.equals("defineClass") && DEFINE_CLASS_DESCRIPTORS.contains(descriptor);
        if(classLoaderOwner && classLoadingMethod
            || owner.equals("java/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup")
                && (name.equals("defineClass") || name.equals("defineHiddenClass") || name.equals("defineHiddenClassWithClassData"))
            || (owner.equals("sun/misc/Unsafe") || owner.equals("jdk/internal/misc/Unsafe"))
                && (name.equals("defineClass") || name.equals("defineAnonymousClass")))
            return "CLASS_LOADING_API";
        if(owner.equals("javax/crypto/Cipher") && Set.of("getInstance","init","update","updateAAD","doFinal","wrap","unwrap").contains(name)
            || owner.equals("javax/crypto/SecretKeyFactory") && Set.of("getInstance","generateSecret").contains(name)
            || owner.equals("javax/crypto/KeyGenerator") && Set.of("getInstance","generateKey","init").contains(name)
            || owner.equals("javax/crypto/spec/SecretKeySpec") && name.equals("<init>")
            || owner.equals("java/security/MessageDigest") && Set.of("getInstance","digest","update").contains(name)
            || owner.equals("java/security/KeyFactory") && Set.of("getInstance","generatePublic","generatePrivate").contains(name)
            || owner.equals("java/security/Signature") && Set.of("getInstance","initSign","initVerify","update","sign","verify").contains(name))
            return "CRYPTO_API";
        return null;
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/DynamicWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Reads a parent-validated snapshot; emits bounded data without extracting or loading target classes. */
public final class DynamicWorker {
    record Row(String entry,DynamicScanner.Finding finding) {}
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if(args.length!=2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and output");
        var rows=new ArrayList<Row>(); int classes=0; boolean limited=false; long expanded=0;
        Path input=Path.of(args[0]);
        // Phase 2BZ: the same pass builds the static obfuscation profile (resources by name and size only, never read).
        var profile=new ObfuscationProfile.Builder();
        if(input.toString().endsWith(".class")) {
            byte[] bytes=read(Files.newInputStream(input));
            var result=new DynamicScanner().scan(bytes,10000);
            for(var finding:result.findings()) rows.add(new Row("input.class",finding));
            classes=1; limited=result.limitReached(); profile.addClass(bytes);
        } else try(var zip=new ZipFile(input.toFile())) {
            var entries=zip.entries(); int visited=0;
            while(entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                var entry=entries.nextElement(); if(++visited>20000) throw new IOException("Entry limit");
                if(!entry.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class")) { if(!entry.isDirectory()) profile.addResource(entry.getName(),entry.getSize()); continue; }
                byte[] bytes=read(zip.getInputStream(entry)); expanded+=bytes.length;
                if(expanded>512L*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Expanded byte limit");
                profile.addClass(bytes);
                if(rows.size()==10000) { limited=true; continue; }
                var result=new DynamicScanner().scan(bytes,10000-rows.size());
                for(var finding:result.findings()) rows.add(new Row(entry.getName(),finding));
                classes++; limited|=result.limitReached();
            }
        }
        writeAudit(Path.of(args[1]).resolve("dynamic.bin"),classes,limited,rows,16*1024*1024);
        try(var out=new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(Path.of(args[1]).resolve("obfuscation.bin"),StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)))) {
            profile.build().write(out);
        }
    }
    static void writeAudit(Path path,int classes,boolean limited,List<Row> rows,int budget) throws IOException {
        if(budget<13) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Audit budget too small");
        var encoded=new ArrayList<byte[]>(); int size=13;
        for(var row:rows) {
            var buffer=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try(var out=new DataOutputStream(buffer)) {
                var f=row.finding(); out.writeUTF(row.entry()); out.writeUTF(f.className()); out.writeUTF(f.method()); out.writeUTF(f.descriptor());
                out.writeInt(f.instruction()); out.writeUTF(f.kind()); out.writeUTF(f.owner()); out.writeUTF(f.name()); out.writeUTF(f.targetDescriptor()); out.writeInt(f.bootstrapArguments());
            }
            if(buffer.size()>budget-size) { limited=true; break; }
            size+=buffer.size(); encoded.add(buffer.toByteArray());
        }
        try(var out=new DataOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(path,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            out.writeInt(1); out.writeInt(classes); out.writeBoolean(limited); out.writeInt(encoded.size());
            for(byte[] row:encoded) out.write(row);
        }
    }
    private static byte[] read(InputStream stream) throws IOException {
        try(stream) { byte[] bytes=stream.readNBytes(16*1024*1024+1); if(bytes.length>16*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Class byte limit"); return bytes; }
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/LinkCheck.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Asks {@link LinkWorker}, in a fresh JVM with bytecode verification on, whether every class of a JAR links. It is the
 * validity gate of failure minimization (Phase 2AT): a reduced class is kept only when the real JVM verifier accepts
 * it. No target code is initialized or executed.
 */
public final class LinkCheck {
    /** {@code errorType} is the JVM error class (or {@code WORKER_<status>}); {@code message} may name target classes. */
    public record Result(boolean linked, int classes, String failedClass, String errorType, String message) {}

    public Result check(Path classesJar, Path work, List<Path> dependencies, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        Path workerLocation;
        try { workerLocation = Path.of(LinkWorker.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()); }
        catch (Exception error) { throw new IOException("Cannot locate link worker", error); }
        var jars = List.copyOf(dependencies);
        var engine = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "jvm-link"; }
            public String version() { return System.getProperty("java.version"); }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
                var command = new ArrayList<>(List.of(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(),
                    "-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2",
                    "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8", "-cp", workerLocation.toString(), LinkWorker.class.getName(), input.toString(), output.toString()));
                jars.forEach(jar -> command.add(jar.toAbsolutePath().toString()));
                return command;
            }
        };
        var result = new ProcessRunner().runLinkCheck(engine, classesJar.toAbsolutePath(), work, timeout);
        Path properties = work.resolve("linked").resolve("link.properties");
        if (result.exitCode() != 0 || !Files.isRegularFile(properties, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.size(properties) > 64 * 1024)
            return new Result(false, 0, null, "WORKER_" + result.status(), result.message());
        var values = new Properties();
        try (var input = Files.newInputStream(properties)) { values.load(input); }
        int classes;
        try { classes = Integer.parseInt(values.getProperty("classes", "-1")); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { classes = -1; }
        if (classes < 0) throw new IOException("Invalid link check result");
        return new Result(Boolean.parseBoolean(values.getProperty("linked")), classes, values.getProperty("failed-class"),
            values.getProperty("error-type"), values.getProperty("message"));
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/LinkWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

/**
 * Defines the classes of a case JAR in an isolated class loader and links each one, which runs the JVM bytecode
 * verifier. Nothing is initialized or invoked: {@code Class.forName(name, false, loader)} only loads, and
 * {@code getDeclaredMethods()} links (verifies) and reflects; no static initializer, constructor or method of the target
 * runs. The loader's parent is the platform loader, so the classes see the JDK, the case and its dependency JARs, never
 * this worker or ClassRevive.
 *
 * <p>Arguments: classes JAR, output folder, then dependency JARs (loaded on demand, not linked). Writes
 * {@code link.properties} into the output folder.
 */
public final class LinkWorker {
    static final int MAX_CLASSES = 20_000, MAX_MESSAGE = 300;
    static final long MAX_ENTRY = 16L * 1024 * 1024, MAX_TOTAL = 512L * 1024 * 1024;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var classes = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>(); var dependencies = new HashMap<String,byte[]>();
        long[] total = {0};
        read(Path.of(args[0]), classes, total);
        for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i++) read(Path.of(args[i]), dependencies, total);
        var loader = new IsolatedLoader(classes, dependencies);
        int linked = 0; String failedClass = null; Throwable failure = null;
        boolean verifier = verifierActive();
        if (!verifier) { failedClass = ""; failure = new IllegalStateException("bytecode verification is disabled in this JVM"); }
        for (String name : verifier ? classes.keySet() : Set.<String>of()) {
            if (name.endsWith("module-info")) continue;
            try {
                Class<?> type = Class.forName(name.replace('/', '.'), false, loader);
                type.getDeclaredMethods();
                linked++;
            } catch (LinkageError | ClassNotFoundException | SecurityException | IllegalArgumentException error) {
                failedClass = name; failure = error; break;
            }
        }
        var result = new Properties();
        result.setProperty("linked", Boolean.toString(failure == null));
        result.setProperty("verifier-active", Boolean.toString(verifier));
        result.setProperty("classes", Integer.toString(classes.size()));
        result.setProperty("linked-classes", Integer.toString(linked));
        if (failure != null) {
            result.setProperty("failed-class", failedClass);
            result.setProperty("error-type", failure.getClass().getName());
            String message = String.valueOf(failure.getMessage()).replace('\r', ' ').replace('\n', ' ');
            result.setProperty("message", message.length() <= MAX_MESSAGE ? message : message.substring(0, MAX_MESSAGE) + "...");
        }
        try (var stream = Files.newOutputStream(Path.of(args[1]).resolve("link.properties"), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
            result.store(stream, "JVM link check; nothing initialized or executed");
        }
    }

    /**
     * Self-test: a hand-written class whose static method returns {@code null} as an {@code int} must be rejected when
     * linked. If it links, verification is off in this JVM and no result of this worker would mean anything.
     */
    static boolean verifierActive() throws IOException {
        var bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var out = new DataOutputStream(bytes)) {
            out.writeInt(0xCAFEBABE); out.writeShort(0); out.writeShort(52);
            out.writeShort(8);
            out.writeByte(1); out.writeUTF("ClassReviveVerifierProbe");
            out.writeByte(7); out.writeShort(1);
            out.writeByte(1); out.writeUTF("java/lang/Object");
            out.writeByte(7); out.writeShort(3);
            out.writeByte(1); out.writeUTF("m");
            out.writeByte(1); out.writeUTF("()I");
            out.writeByte(1); out.writeUTF("Code");
            out.writeShort(0x21); out.writeShort(2); out.writeShort(4); out.writeShort(0); out.writeShort(0);
            out.writeShort(1);
            out.writeShort(0x09); out.writeShort(5); out.writeShort(6); out.writeShort(1);
            out.writeShort(7); out.writeInt(14); out.writeShort(1); out.writeShort(0);
            out.writeInt(2); out.writeByte(0x01); out.writeByte(0xAC); // aconst_null; ireturn
            out.writeShort(0); out.writeShort(0);
            out.writeShort(0);
        }
        byte[] probe = bytes.toByteArray();
        var loader = new ClassLoader("classrevive-verifier-probe", ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader()) {
            Class<?> define() { return defineClass("ClassReviveVerifierProbe", probe, 0, probe.length); }
        };
        try { loader.define().getDeclaredMethods(); return false; }
        catch (VerifyError expected) { return true; }
    }

    private static void read(Path jar, Map<String,byte[]> into, long[] total) throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            var entries = zip.entries();
            while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                if (entry.isDirectory() || !entry.getName().endsWith(".class")) continue;
                if (into.size() >= MAX_CLASSES) throw new IOException("Too many classes");
                try (var input = zip.getInputStream(entry)) {
                    byte[] bytes = input.readNBytes((int) MAX_ENTRY + 1);
                    total[0] += bytes.length;
                    if (bytes.length > MAX_ENTRY || total[0] > MAX_TOTAL) throw new IOException("Class byte budget exceeded");
                    into.putIfAbsent(entry.getName().substring(0, entry.getName().length() - ".class".length()), bytes);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Case classes first, then dependency classes; everything else comes from the platform loader (the JDK). */
    private static final class IsolatedLoader extends ClassLoader {
        private final Map<String,byte[]> classes, dependencies;
        IsolatedLoader(Map<String,byte[]> classes, Map<String,byte[]> dependencies) {
            super("classrevive-link-check", ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader());
            this.classes = classes; this.dependencies = dependencies;
        }
        @Override protected Class<?> findClass(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException {
            String internal = name.replace('.', '/');
            byte[] bytes = classes.containsKey(internal) ? classes.get(internal) : dependencies.get(internal);
            if (bytes == null) throw new ClassNotFoundException(name);
            return defineClass(name, bytes, 0, bytes.length);
        }
    }
}
```
