`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/ObfuscatorClassifier.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscationProfile.Technique;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2BZ: documented rules that turn an {@link ObfuscationProfile} into obfuscator hypotheses. Every hypothesis is a
 * suggestion from static patterns, never proof: obfuscators share techniques, versions differ, and a jar can be processed
 * twice. Each rule adds points for its evidence (score 0..100); a hypothesis is reported from {@value #REPORTED} points,
 * as {@code LOW} below 45, {@code MEDIUM} below 70 and {@code HIGH} from 70. The rules are listed in docs/obfuscation-detection.md.
 */
public final class ObfuscatorClassifier {
    public static final int REPORTED = 30;
    public record Hypothesis(String obfuscator, int score, String confidence, List<String> reasons) {
        public Hypothesis { reasons = List.copyOf(reasons); }
    }
    /** {@code verdict}: SUGGESTED (at least one hypothesis), NONE (no technique and no marker) or UNKNOWN (techniques, no rule matched). */
    public record Result(String verdict, List<Hypothesis> hypotheses) {
        public Result { hypotheses = List.copyOf(hypotheses); }
        public String summary() {
            if (verdict.equals("NONE")) return "none (no obfuscation technique detected)";
            if (hypotheses.isEmpty()) return "unknown (techniques detected, but no rule matches a known obfuscator)";
            return String.join("; ", hypotheses.stream().map(h -> h.obfuscator() + " (" + h.confidence().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)
                + ", " + h.score() + "/100)").toList());
        }
    }

    private ObfuscatorClassifier() {}

    public static Result classify(ObfuscationProfile profile) {
        var hypotheses = new ArrayList<Hypothesis>();
        zkm(profile, hypotheses);
        allatori(profile, hypotheses);
        stringer(profile, hypotheses);
        dasho(profile, hypotheses);
        proguard(profile, hypotheses);
        nativeLayer(profile, hypotheses);
        skidfuscator(profile, hypotheses);
        aidsfuscator(profile, hypotheses);
        hypotheses.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Hypothesis::score).reversed().thenComparing(Hypothesis::obfuscator));
        String verdict = !hypotheses.isEmpty() ? "SUGGESTED" : profile.techniques().isEmpty() ? "NONE" : "UNKNOWN";
        return new Result(verdict, hypotheses);
    }

    private static final class Rule {
        final String name; int score; final List<String> reasons = new ArrayList<>();
        Rule(String name) { this.name = name; }
        void add(boolean condition, int points, String reason) { if (condition) { score += points; reasons.add(reason + " (+" + points + ")"); } }
        void subtract(boolean condition, int points, String reason) { if (condition) { score -= points; reasons.add(reason + " (-" + points + ")"); } }
        void into(List<Hypothesis> out) {
            int bounded = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
            if (bounded < REPORTED) return;
            out.add(new Hypothesis(name, bounded, bounded >= 70 ? "HIGH" : bounded >= 45 ? "MEDIUM" : "LOW", reasons));
        }
    }

    /** Zelix KlassMaster: indy reference obfuscation with a (Lookup,String,MethodType) bootstrap, (IJ)/(II) string decryptors, DES keys. */
    private static void zkm(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("Zelix KlassMaster");
        int lookup = p.metric("indy.bootstrap_lookup_string_methodtype") + p.metric("indy.bootstrap_lookup_string_methodtype_extra");
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.HIDDEN_CALLS) && lookup > 0, 25, "invokedynamic with a jar-owned (Lookup, String, MethodType) bootstrap: " + lookup + " sites");
        rule.add(p.metric("strings.decryptor(IJ)") + p.metric("strings.decryptor(JI)") > 0, 25,
            "string decryptors taking an int and a long key, (IJ)Ljava/lang/String;: " + (p.metric("strings.decryptor(IJ)") + p.metric("strings.decryptor(JI)")));
        rule.add(p.metric("strings.decryptor(II)") > 0, 10, "string decryptors (II)Ljava/lang/String;: " + p.metric("strings.decryptor(II)"));
        int des = p.metric("cipher.DES") + p.metric("cipher.DESEDE");
        rule.add(des > 0 && p.metric("strings.clinit_crypto") > 0, 20, "DES used to decrypt strings in <clinit>: " + p.metric("strings.clinit_crypto") + " classes");
        rule.add(des == 0 && p.metric("strings.clinit_crypto") > 0, 10, "JCE decryption into static strings in <clinit>: " + p.metric("strings.clinit_crypto") + " classes");
        rule.add(p.metric("zkm.long_key_methods") >= 3, 10, "methods XOR-ing a long parameter with a long constant (method keys): " + p.metric("zkm.long_key_methods"));
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.CONTROL_FLOW) && p.metric("cf.flag_at_entry_classes") > 0, 5, "static flag loaded at method entry in " + p.metric("cf.flag_at_entry_classes") + " classes");
        // Phase 2CA: ZKM's flow obfuscation reads its static flag through an accessor and tests a local copy of it.
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.CONTROL_FLOW) && p.metric("cf.flag_accessor_methods") >= 10, 10, "opaque predicates on a static flag read through an accessor: "
            + p.metric("cf.flag_accessor_methods") + " methods in " + p.metric("cf.flag_accessor_classes") + " classes, " + p.metric("cf.flag_accessor_tests") + " tests");
        // Phase 2CB: int/long constants decoded through the same (int, long)-keyed invokedynamic sites as the strings.
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.CONSTANT_ENCRYPTION) && lookup > 0, 10, "int/long constants decoded through invokedynamic: "
            + p.metric("constants.indy_int_sites") + " int and " + p.metric("constants.indy_long_sites") + " long sites");
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.EXCEPTION_OBFUSCATION), 15, "exception obfuscation, handlers rethrowing through an identity helper: "
            + p.metric("exceptions.rethrow_handlers") + " handlers in " + p.metric("exceptions.rethrow_classes") + " classes");
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && (p.has(Technique.SHORT_NAMES) || p.has(Technique.CASE_COLLISIONS)), 10, "short or case-colliding names");
        rule.subtract(p.metric("marker.allatori") > 0 || p.metric("marker.stringer_stacktrace") > 0, 30, "another obfuscator's marker present");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /** Allatori: its ALLATORI demo marker, or (String)String XOR decryptors called with literals. */
    private static void allatori(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("Allatori");
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.allatori") > 0, 80, "ALLATORI marker in names or literals: " + p.metric("marker.allatori"));
        rule.add(p.metric("strings.decryptor(Ljava/lang/String;)") > 0 && p.metric("strings.decryptor_calls") > 0, 25,
            "static (String)String decryptors called with literals: " + p.metric("strings.decryptor(Ljava/lang/String;)"));
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.allatori") > 0 && p.has(Technique.SHORT_NAMES), 5, "short names");
        rule.subtract(p.metric("marker.allatori") == 0 && (p.metric("strings.decryptor(IJ)") + p.metric("strings.decryptor(JI)") > 0
            || p.metric("indy.bootstrap_lookup_string_methodtype") > 0), 20, "no marker, and the other string and call evidence matches another tool");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /** Stringer: decryptors that read the caller from the stack trace; (Object)String decryptors. */
    private static void stringer(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("Stringer");
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.stringer_stacktrace") > 0, 50, "string decryptors that read the stack trace: " + p.metric("marker.stringer_stacktrace"));
        rule.add(p.metric("strings.decryptor(Ljava/lang/Object;)") > 0, 20, "static (Object)String decryptors: " + p.metric("strings.decryptor(Ljava/lang/Object;)"));
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.has(Technique.HIDDEN_CALLS), 15, "invokedynamic with a non-JDK bootstrap");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /** DashO: references to its com.preemptive runtime or annotations. */
    private static void dasho(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("DashO (PreEmptive)");
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.dasho") > 0, 70, "references to com.preemptive: " + p.metric("marker.dasho") + " classes");
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.has(Technique.STRING_ENCRYPTION), 10, "string encryption");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /** ProGuard / R8: renaming only (a/a/a), SourceFile renamed or removed; no string encryption or hidden calls (they have neither). */
    private static void proguard(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("ProGuard / R8 (renaming only)");
        rule.add(p.has(Technique.SHORT_NAMES), 35, "short names: " + (p.has(Technique.SHORT_NAMES) ? p.techniques().get(Technique.SHORT_NAMES).classes() : 0) + " classes");
        rule.add(p.metric("names.short_packages") >= 5, 15, "classes in packages whose every segment has at most 2 characters: " + p.metric("names.short_packages"));
        rule.add(p.metric("debug.sourcefile_renamed") > 0, 25, "SourceFile set to \"SourceFile\" or an r8-map-id: " + p.metric("debug.sourcefile_renamed") + " classes");
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.metric("debug.no_local_variables") * 2 >= Math.max(1, p.classes()), 5, "no LocalVariableTable");
        rule.subtract(p.has(Technique.STRING_ENCRYPTION), 30, "string encryption is not a ProGuard/R8 feature");
        rule.subtract(p.has(Technique.HIDDEN_CALLS), 30, "invokedynamic call hiding is not a ProGuard/R8 feature");
        rule.subtract(p.has(Technique.NON_IDENTIFIER_NAMES), 15, "names that are no Java identifiers (ProGuard/R8 emit identifiers by default)");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /** A native protection layer: obfuscated native method names, a bundled native library, a native-obfuscator loader. */
    private static void nativeLayer(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        boolean known = p.metric("marker.native_obfuscator") > 0;
        var rule = new Rule(known ? "native protection layer (JNIC / native-obfuscator style)" : "custom native protection layer");
        rule.add(p.metric("native.obfuscated_names") > 0, 40, "native methods with hexadecimal or non-identifier names: " + p.metric("native.obfuscated_names"));
        rule.add(known, 40, "known native-obfuscator loader class");
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.metric("native.libraries") > 0, 25, "native libraries bundled in the jar: " + p.metric("native.libraries"));
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.metric("native.load_calls") > 0, 10, "System/Runtime load calls: " + p.metric("native.load_calls"));
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.metric("strings.native_key_classes") > 0, 10, "decryption keys supplied by the native layer (<clinit> only registers natives): "
            + p.metric("strings.native_key_classes") + " classes");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2CD: Skidfuscator (community edition): per-block seed locals updated as {@code seed = C ^ seed}, switches on a
     * hash of the seed that loop back to themselves, gotos disguised as a caught {@code throw new X()}, seed-keyed string
     * decryptors, a static int seeded by {@code new Random(long).nextInt()}, and its {@code sdk/SDK} runtime and
     * {@code nothing_to_see_here} marker.
     */
    private static void skidfuscator(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("Skidfuscator");
        rule.add(p.metric("skid.self_loop_hash_switches") >= 2, 35, "switches on a hash of the block seed that jump back to themselves: "
            + p.metric("skid.self_loop_hash_switches"));
        rule.add(p.metric("skid.seed_methods") >= 3, 20, "methods updating a seed local as seed = C ^ seed: " + p.metric("skid.seed_methods"));
        rule.add(p.metric("strings.skid_sites") >= 3, 15, "string decryptors keyed by Integer.toString(seed).getBytes(): "
            + p.metric("skid.seed_string_decryptors") + " decryptors, " + p.metric("strings.skid_sites") + " call sites");
        rule.add(p.metric("skid.random_seed_fields") > 0, 10, "static int fields seeded by new Random(long).nextInt() in <clinit>: " + p.metric("skid.random_seed_fields"));
        rule.add(p.metric("skid.parseint_seeds") > 0, 5, "Integer.parseInt(\"digits\") folded into a seed: " + p.metric("skid.parseint_seeds"));
        rule.add(rule.score > 0 && p.metric("skid.exception_gotos") > 0, 10, "gotos disguised as throw new X() caught by a handler that pops it: " + p.metric("skid.exception_gotos"));
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.skidfuscator_sdk") > 0, 25, "Skidfuscator runtime class sdk/SDK (" + p.metric("skid.sdk_calls") + " calls)");
        rule.add(p.metric("marker.ahegao") > 0, 25, "nothing_to_see_here String[] marker field: " + p.metric("marker.ahegao") + " classes");
        rule.into(out);
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2CZ: Aidsfuscator: its salt dispatcher (FNV-1a class-name hash), reference bootstrap ({@code MutableCallSite}),
     * hash integrity class (SHA-256 of the class files in a {@code .bin} resource), string decryptors keyed by their caller's
     * stack trace, and {@code <clinit>} salts read through {@code MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass()}.
     */
    private static void aidsfuscator(ObfuscationProfile p, List<Hypothesis> out) {
        var rule = new Rule("Aidsfuscator");
        rule.add(p.metric("aids.salt_dispatcher") > 0, 30, "salt dispatcher class with an FNV-1a class-name hash: " + p.metric("aids.salt_dispatcher"));
        rule.add(p.metric("aids.reference_bootstrap") > 0, 25, "invokedynamic bootstrap returning a MutableCallSite with an (int, int) reference decoder");
        rule.add(p.metric("aids.hash_integrity") > 0, 20, "hash integrity class reading SHA-256 hashes of the class files from a .bin resource");
        rule.add(p.metric("aids.stacktrace_string_decryptors") >= 2, 15, "string decryptors keyed by their caller's stack trace: "
            + p.metric("aids.stacktrace_string_decryptors"));
        rule.add(p.metric("aids.lookup_class_retrievers") >= 2, 10, "static initializers reading a salt through MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass(): "
            + p.metric("aids.lookup_class_retrievers"));
        rule.into(out);
    }
}
```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/ReferenceIndex.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.signature.SignatureReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.signature.SignatureVisitor;

/**
 * Phase G6: who uses each class, method and field of a set of class files, for "find usages" and the call hierarchy of
 * the desktop application. ASM reads the bytes; nothing is defined, loaded or run.
 * <p>
 * A site is one reference in one class: a call, a field read or write, {@code new}, a cast, {@code instanceof}, a class
 * literal, a catch type, a type in a member's descriptor or generic signature, a superclass or interface, an annotation,
 * or a method handle (lambda bodies and method references behind {@code invokedynamic}, {@code ldc} handles, custom
 * bootstrap methods). Each site keeps the member it sits in, its line from the {@code LineNumberTable} when there is one,
 * and its ordinal among the references of that member to the same target, which is how an editor finds it in text.
 * <p>
 * A member reference names the class written in the instruction. Queries resolve it the way the JVM does (superclass
 * chain, then interfaces) over the indexed classes, so a call {@code Sub.m()} counts for {@code Base.m()} when only
 * {@code Base} declares it, and a call through an overridden supertype method is reported as such.
 */
public final class ReferenceIndex {
    public enum Kind { EXTENDS, IMPLEMENTS, SIGNATURE, THROWS, ANNOTATION, NEW, NEW_ARRAY, CAST, INSTANCEOF, CLASS_LITERAL, CATCH,
        CALL, FIELD_READ, FIELD_WRITE, LAMBDA, METHOD_REFERENCE, METHOD_HANDLE }

    /** A class ({@code name} null), a field (descriptor without {@code (}) or a method. */
    public record Ref(String owner, String name, String descriptor) {
        public static Ref ofClass(String owner) { return new Ref(owner, null, null); }
        public boolean isClass() { return name == null; }
        public boolean isMethod() { return name != null && descriptor.startsWith("("); }
        public boolean isField() { return name != null && !descriptor.startsWith("("); }
        /** {@code name + descriptor} for a method, {@code name:descriptor} for a field. */
        public String key() { return isClass() ? owner : isMethod() ? name + descriptor : name + ":" + descriptor; }
        @Override public String toString() { return isClass() ? owner : owner + "." + key(); }
    }

    /**
     * One reference. {@code from} is the member that holds it (a class ref for the class header). {@code line} is the
     * source line from the {@code LineNumberTable}, or -1. {@code ordinal} counts from 0 among the references of
     * {@code from} to the same target with the same kind, in bytecode order.
     */
    public record Site(Ref from, Kind kind, Ref target, int line, int ordinal) {
        public String className() { return from.owner(); }
    }

    /** A site found by a query; {@code via} is the supertype member it names when the call reaches an override, else null. */
    public record Usage(Site site, Ref via) {}

    public record Member(String owner, String name, String descriptor, int access) {
        public Ref ref() { return new Ref(owner, name, descriptor); }
        public boolean isStatic() { return (access & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) != 0; }
        public boolean isPrivate() { return (access & Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE) != 0; }
    }

    public record ClassDecl(String name, String superName, List<String> interfaces, int access, List<Member> fields, List<Member> methods) {}

    /** Bounds: classes read, sites kept, and bytes per class file. */
    public record Limits(int maxClasses, int maxSites, int maxClassBytes) {
        public static Limits defaults() { return new Limits(200_000, 5_000_000, 16 * 1024 * 1024); }
    }

    /** What the build saw; {@code truncated} when a limit stopped it. */
    public record Stats(int classes, int unreadable, int sites, boolean truncated) {}

    private final Map<String,ClassDecl> classes;
    private final Map<Ref,List<Site>> byTarget;
    private final Map<String,List<Ref>> refsByOwner, refsByKey;
    private final Map<String,List<String>> subtypes;
    private final Stats stats;

    private ReferenceIndex(Map<String,ClassDecl> classes, Map<Ref,List<Site>> byTarget, Stats stats) {
        this.classes = classes;
        this.byTarget = byTarget;
        this.stats = stats;
        var byOwner = new HashMap<String,List<Ref>>();
        var byKey = new HashMap<String,List<Ref>>();
        for (Ref target : byTarget.keySet()) {
            if (target.isClass()) continue;
            byOwner.computeIfAbsent(target.owner(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(target);
            byKey.computeIfAbsent(target.key(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(target);
        }
        this.refsByOwner = byOwner;
        this.refsByKey = byKey;
        var subs = new HashMap<String,List<String>>();
        for (var decl : classes.values()) {
            if (decl.superName() != null) subs.computeIfAbsent(decl.superName(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(decl.name());
            for (String face : decl.interfaces()) subs.computeIfAbsent(face, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(decl.name());
        }
        this.subtypes = subs;
    }

    /** Reads every {@code .class} entry of a jar (outside {@code META-INF/}); {@code cancelled} is polled between classes. */
    public static ReferenceIndex ofJar(Path jar, Limits limits, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var builder = new Builder(limits);
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            for (var entries = zip.entries(); entries.hasMoreElements(); ) {
                if (cancelled.getAsBoolean() || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException("index cancelled");
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                if (entry.isDirectory() || !entry.getName().endsWith(".class") || entry.getName().startsWith("META-INF/")) continue;
                if (entry.getSize() > limits.maxClassBytes()) { builder.unreadable++; continue; }
                byte[] bytes;
                try (var in = zip.getInputStream(entry)) { bytes = in.readNBytes(limits.maxClassBytes() + 1); }
                if (bytes.length > limits.maxClassBytes()) { builder.unreadable++; continue; }
                if (!builder.add(bytes)) break;
            }
        }
        return builder.build();
    }

    /** Adds classes one at a time; {@link #add} answers false once the class limit is reached. */
    public static final class Builder {
        private final Limits limits;
        private final Map<String,ClassDecl> classes = new HashMap<>();
        private final Map<Ref,List<Site>> byTarget = new HashMap<>();
        private final Map<Object,Object> pool = new HashMap<>();
        private int sites, unreadable;
        private boolean truncated;

        public Builder(Limits limits) { this.limits = limits; }

        public boolean add(byte[] classBytes) {
            if (classes.size() >= limits.maxClasses()) { truncated = true; return false; }
            if (classBytes.length > limits.maxClassBytes()) { unreadable++; return true; }
            try {
                var reader = new ClassReader(classBytes);
                if (classes.containsKey(reader.getClassName())) return true;
                reader.accept(new Indexer(), ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
            } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
                unreadable++;
            }
            return true;
        }

        public ReferenceIndex build() {
            byTarget.replaceAll((target, list) -> List.copyOf(list));
            return new ReferenceIndex(Map.copyOf(classes), Map.copyOf(byTarget), new Stats(classes.size(), unreadable, sites, truncated));
        }

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        private <T> T intern(T value) {
            if (value == null) return null;
            Object known = pool.putIfAbsent(value, value);
            return known == null ? value : (T) known;
        }

        private Ref ref(String owner, String name, String descriptor) { return intern(new Ref(intern(owner), intern(name), intern(descriptor))); }

        private final class Indexer extends ClassVisitor {
            private String name, superName;
            private List<String> interfaces;
            private int access;
            private final List<Member> fields = new ArrayList<>(), methods = new ArrayList<>();
            private Ref header;
            private final Map<String,Integer> ordinals = new HashMap<>();

            Indexer() { super(Opcodes.ASM9); }

            @Override public void visit(int version, int access, String name, String signature, String superName, String[] interfaces) {
                this.name = intern(name);
                this.access = access;
                this.superName = intern(superName);
                this.interfaces = interfaces == null ? List.of() : Arrays.stream(interfaces).map(Builder.this::intern).toList();
                header = ref(name, null, null);
                if (superName != null) site(header, Kind.EXTENDS, ref(superName, null, null), -1, ordinals);
                boolean isInterface = (access & Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE) != 0;
                for (String face : this.interfaces) site(header, isInterface ? Kind.EXTENDS : Kind.IMPLEMENTS, ref(face, null, null), -1, ordinals);
                var named = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                if (superName != null) named.add(superName);
                named.addAll(this.interfaces);
                signatureTypes(signature, header, named, ordinals);
            }

            @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String descriptor, boolean visible) {
                typeOf(descriptor, header, Kind.ANNOTATION, -1, ordinals);
                return null;
            }

            @Override public FieldVisitor visitField(int access, String fieldName, String descriptor, String signature, Object value) {
                var field = new Member(name, intern(fieldName), intern(descriptor), access);
                fields.add(field);
                Ref from = field.ref();
                var local = new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                var named = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                descriptorTypes(Type.getType(descriptor), named);
                for (String type : named) site(from, Kind.SIGNATURE, ref(type, null, null), -1, local);
                signatureTypes(signature, from, named, local);
                return new FieldVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                    @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String annotation, boolean visible) {
                        typeOf(annotation, from, Kind.ANNOTATION, -1, local);
                        return null;
                    }
                };
            }

            @Override public MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access, String methodName, String descriptor, String signature, String[] exceptions) {
                var method = new Member(name, intern(methodName), intern(descriptor), access);
                methods.add(method);
                Ref from = intern(method.ref());
                var local = new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                var named = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                var type = Type.getMethodType(descriptor);
                for (Type argument : type.getArgumentTypes()) descriptorTypes(argument, named);
                descriptorTypes(type.getReturnType(), named);
                for (String typeName : named) site(from, Kind.SIGNATURE, ref(typeName, null, null), -1, local);
                if (exceptions != null) for (String exception : exceptions) if (named.add(exception)) site(from, Kind.THROWS, ref(exception, null, null), -1, local);
                signatureTypes(signature, from, named, local);
                return new Code(from, local);
            }

            @Override public void visitEnd() {
                classes.put(name, new ClassDecl(name, superName, interfaces, access, List.copyOf(fields), List.copyOf(methods)));
            }

            private void signatureTypes(String signature, Ref from, Set<String> named, Map<String,Integer> local) {
                if (signature == null) return;
                var found = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                try {
                    new SignatureReader(signature).accept(new SignatureVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                        @Override public void visitClassType(String type) { found.add(type); }
                    });
                } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
                    return;
                }
                for (String type : found) if (named.add(type)) site(from, Kind.SIGNATURE, ref(type, null, null), -1, local);
            }

            private void typeOf(String descriptor, Ref from, Kind kind, int line, Map<String,Integer> local) {
                try {
                    var named = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
                    descriptorTypes(Type.getType(descriptor), named);
                    for (String type : named) site(from, kind, ref(type, null, null), line, local);
                } catch (RuntimeException malformed) { /* not a type: nothing to index */ }
            }

            /** References of one method body, with the current line. */
            private final class Code extends MethodVisitor {
                private final Ref from;
                private final Map<String,Integer> local;
                private int line = -1;

                Code(Ref from, Map<String,Integer> local) { super(Opcodes.ASM9); this.from = from; this.local = local; }

                @Override public void visitLineNumber(int number, Label start) { line = number; }
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String descriptor, boolean visible) { typeOf(descriptor, from, Kind.ANNOTATION, -1, local); return null; }
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitParameterAnnotation(int parameter, String descriptor, boolean visible) { typeOf(descriptor, from, Kind.ANNOTATION, -1, local); return null; }

                @Override public void visitTryCatchBlock(Label start, Label end, Label handler, String type) {
                    if (type != null) site(from, Kind.CATCH, ref(type, null, null), -1, local);
                }

                @Override public void visitTypeInsn(int opcode, String type) {
                    Kind kind = switch (opcode) {
                        case Opcodes.NEW -> Kind.NEW;
                        case Opcodes.ANEWARRAY -> Kind.NEW_ARRAY;
                        case Opcodes.CHECKCAST -> Kind.CAST;
                        default -> Kind.INSTANCEOF;
                    };
                    String element = elementClass(type);
                    if (element != null) site(from, kind, ref(element, null, null), line, local);
                }

                @Override public void visitMultiANewArrayInsn(String descriptor, int dimensions) { typeOf(descriptor, from, Kind.NEW_ARRAY, line, local); }

                @Override public void visitFieldInsn(int opcode, String owner, String fieldName, String descriptor) {
                    boolean write = opcode == Opcodes.PUTFIELD || opcode == Opcodes.PUTSTATIC;
                    site(from, write ? Kind.FIELD_WRITE : Kind.FIELD_READ, ref(owner, fieldName, descriptor), line, local);
                }

                @Override public void visitMethodInsn(int opcode, String owner, String methodName, String descriptor, boolean isInterface) {
                    site(from, Kind.CALL, ref(owner, methodName, descriptor), line, local);
                }

                @Override public void visitInvokeDynamicInsn(String indyName, String descriptor, Handle bootstrap, Object... arguments) {
                    boolean lambdaFactory = "java/lang/invoke/LambdaMetafactory".equals(bootstrap.getOwner());
                    if (!lambdaFactory) handle(bootstrap, Kind.METHOD_HANDLE);
                    for (Object argument : arguments) constant(argument, lambdaFactory);
                }

                @Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object value) { constant(value, false); }

                private void constant(Object value, boolean lambdaFactory) {
                    switch (value) {
                        case Type type when type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT || type.getSort() == Type.ARRAY -> {
                            String element = elementClass(type.getInternalName());
                            if (element != null) site(from, Kind.CLASS_LITERAL, ref(element, null, null), line, local);
                        }
                        case Handle handle -> handle(handle, !lambdaFactory ? Kind.METHOD_HANDLE
                            : handle.getName().startsWith("lambda$") ? Kind.LAMBDA : Kind.METHOD_REFERENCE);
                        case ConstantDynamic dynamic -> {
                            handle(dynamic.getBootstrapMethod(), Kind.METHOD_HANDLE);
                            for (int i = 0; i < dynamic.getBootstrapMethodArgumentCount(); i++) constant(dynamic.getBootstrapMethodArgument(i), false);
                        }
                        default -> { }
                    }
                }

                private void handle(Handle handle, Kind kind) {
                    site(from, kind, ref(handle.getOwner(), handle.getName(), handle.getDesc()), line, local);
                }
            }
        }

        private void site(Ref from, Kind kind, Ref target, int line, Map<String,Integer> ordinals) {
            if (sites >= limits.maxSites()) { truncated = true; return; }
            String counter = kind.ordinal() + " " + target;
            int ordinal = ordinals.merge(counter, 1, Integer::sum) - 1;
            byTarget.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>(2)).add(new Site(from, kind, target, line, ordinal));
            sites++;
        }
    }

    /** The class an array or object type names, or null for primitive arrays. */
    private static String elementClass(String internalName) {
        if (!internalName.startsWith("[")) return internalName;
        try {
            var element = Type.getType(internalName).getElementType();
            return element.getSort() == Type.OBJECT ? element.getInternalName() : null;
        } catch (RuntimeException malformed) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static void descriptorTypes(Type type, Set<String> into) {
        if (type.getSort() == Type.ARRAY) type = type.getElementType();
        if (type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT) into.add(type.getInternalName());
    }

    // ----- queries -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    public Stats stats() { return stats; }
    public Map<String,ClassDecl> classes() { return classes; }
    public Optional<ClassDecl> declaration(String className) { return Optional.ofNullable(classes.get(className)); }

    /** The members a class declares under {@code name} (methods when {@code methods}, else fields), in declaration order. */
    public List<Member> declared(String className, String name, boolean methods) {
        var decl = classes.get(className);
        if (decl == null) return List.of();
        return (methods ? decl.methods() : decl.fields()).stream().filter(member -> member.name().equals(name)).toList();
    }

    /** Superclass first, then interfaces, breadth first; only indexed classes are walked, each once. */
    public List<String> supertypes(String className) {
        var order = new ArrayList<String>();
        var seen = new HashSet<String>(Set.of(className));
        var queue = new ArrayDeque<String>(List.of(className));
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            var decl = classes.get(queue.poll());
            if (decl == null) continue;
            var next = new ArrayList<String>();
            if (decl.superName() != null) next.add(decl.superName());
            next.addAll(decl.interfaces());
            for (String type : next) if (seen.add(type)) { order.add(type); queue.add(type); }
        }
        return order;
    }

    /** Every indexed class that extends or implements {@code className}, directly or not. */
    public Set<String> subtypes(String className) {
        var found = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
        var queue = new ArrayDeque<String>(List.of(className));
        while (!queue.isEmpty()) for (String sub : subtypes.getOrDefault(queue.poll(), List.of())) if (found.add(sub)) queue.add(sub);
        return found;
    }

    /**
     * The declaration a member reference reaches, by JVM resolution: the named class, its superclasses, then its
     * interfaces. Empty when the chain leaves the indexed classes before a declaration is found.
     */
    public Optional<Member> resolve(Ref ref) {
        if (ref.isClass()) return Optional.empty();
        boolean method = ref.isMethod();
        // Constructors and class initializers belong to the named class only.
        if (method && ref.name().startsWith("<")) return own(ref.owner(), ref, true);
        for (String type = ref.owner(); type != null; ) {
            var found = own(type, ref, method);
            if (found.isPresent()) return found;
            var decl = classes.get(type);
            if (decl == null) return Optional.empty();
            type = decl.superName();
        }
        for (String type : supertypes(ref.owner())) {
            var found = own(type, ref, method);
            if (found.isPresent()) return found;
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    private Optional<Member> own(String className, Ref ref, boolean method) {
        var decl = classes.get(className);
        if (decl == null) return Optional.empty();
        for (var member : method ? decl.methods() : decl.fields())
            if (member.name().equals(ref.name()) && member.descriptor().equals(ref.descriptor())) return Optional.of(member);
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    /**
     * The usages of a class, field or method, sorted by class, member and bytecode order. For a class: every type
     * reference to it and every member reference that names it. For a member: every reference that resolves to it, and,
     * for an instance method, every call that resolves to a supertype method it overrides ({@link Usage#via}).
     */
    public List<Usage> usages(Ref target) {
        var found = new ArrayList<Usage>();
        if (target.isClass()) {
            for (Site site : byTarget.getOrDefault(target, List.of())) found.add(new Usage(site, null));
            for (Ref member : refsByOwner.getOrDefault(target.owner(), List.of()))
                for (Site site : byTarget.get(member)) found.add(new Usage(site, null));
        } else {
            var declared = resolve(target);
            Ref declaration = declared.map(Member::ref).orElse(target);
            boolean virtual = target.isMethod() && declared.isPresent() && !declared.get().isStatic() && !declared.get().isPrivate()
                && !target.name().startsWith("<");
            var overridden = new HashSet<Ref>();
            if (virtual) for (String type : supertypes(declaration.owner()))
                own(type, target, true).filter(member -> !member.isStatic() && !member.isPrivate()).ifPresent(member -> overridden.add(member.ref()));
            for (Ref candidate : refsByKey.getOrDefault(declaration.key(), List.of())) {
                Ref reached = resolve(candidate).map(Member::ref).orElse(candidate);
                Ref via = reached.equals(declaration) ? null : overridden.contains(reached) ? reached : NOT_A_USAGE;
                if (via == NOT_A_USAGE) continue;
                for (Site site : byTarget.get(candidate)) found.add(new Usage(site, via));
            }
        }
        found.sort(ORDER);
        return found;
    }

    private static final Ref NOT_A_USAGE = new Ref("", "", "");
    private static final Comparator<Usage> ORDER = Comparator.<Usage,String>comparing(usage -> usage.site().className())
        .thenComparing(usage -> usage.site().from().isClass() ? "" : usage.site().from().key())
        .thenComparingInt(usage -> usage.site().line())
        .thenComparing(usage -> usage.site().kind())
        .thenComparingInt(usage -> usage.site().ordinal());

    /** The kinds that make {@code from} a caller of the target method: calls, lambda bodies, method references, handles. */
    public static boolean calls(Kind kind) {
        return kind == Kind.CALL || kind == Kind.LAMBDA || kind == Kind.METHOD_REFERENCE || kind == Kind.METHOD_HANDLE;
    }
}

```

`modules/bytecode/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/StubSynthesizer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipEntry;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.signature.SignatureReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.signature.SignatureVisitor;

/**
 * Phase 2CT: stand-in classes for types the input uses but nobody supplied (not in the input, the dependencies or
 * the JDK), inferred from how the input's own bytecode uses them, so the decompiled sources can be compiled and
 * measured instead of failing on hundreds of {@code cannot find symbol} errors. The stubs exist only on the compiler's
 * class path: they are never loaded, run or exported as code, and every report says the result compiled against
 * inferred stubs, not the real library.
 *
 * <p>What is inferred, per missing type:
 * <ul>
 * <li>its kind: an annotation (used as one), an interface ({@code invokeinterface}, an interface method reference, or
 * implemented by an input class), a throwable (caught, or in a {@code throws} clause), or a class;</li>
 * <li>constructors, methods and fields with their exact descriptors and static-ness, from every instruction that names
 * the type as owner, and from instructions that name an input subclass for a member the subclass does not declare
 * (an inherited member, added to the nearest missing superclass);</li>
 * <li>for a missing superclass, the input subclasses' instance methods (possible overrides, unless they would clash);</li>
 * <li>the number of type parameters, from generic signatures that mention the type with arguments (local variable
 * signatures included); with one parameter, a method or field of type {@code Object} whose result the input casts at
 * once is declared with that parameter, as javac's cast shows;</li>
 * <li>checked JDK exceptions caught around a range whose only call is a stub method's;</li>
 * <li>annotation elements (with defaults) and enum constants, from annotation values and enum-shaped uses.</li>
 * </ul>
 * Stub methods are concrete (interface methods are {@code default}) and their bodies only throw, so no subclass is
 * forced to implement anything. Unknown supertypes are {@code Object} ({@code RuntimeException} for throwables).
 */
public final class StubSynthesizer {
    private StubSynthesizer() {}
    public static final int MAX_STUBS = 20_000;

    /** {@code classes}: internal names of the stubs written; {@code packages}: package to stub count. */
    public record Result(SortedSet<String> classes, SortedMap<String,Integer> packages, int methods, int fields, boolean truncated) {
        public boolean isEmpty() { return classes.isEmpty(); }
    }

    private static final class Stub {
        final String name;
        boolean isInterface, annotation, throwable, extended;
        int typeParameters;
        final Map<String,Integer> methods = new TreeMap<>();   // name+desc -> access (ACC_STATIC, ACC_PROTECTED or 0 for public)
        final Map<String,Set<String>> throwsBy = new TreeMap<>();
        final Map<String,String> fields = new TreeMap<>();      // name -> desc (first seen)
        final Set<String> staticFields = new HashSet<>();
        final Set<String> constructors = new TreeSet<>();
        boolean enumType;
        final Set<String> genericReturns = new HashSet<>(), genericFields = new HashSet<>();
        final Map<String,String> elements = new TreeMap<>();      // annotation element -> descriptor
        final Set<String> constants = new TreeSet<>();            // enum constants
        Stub(String name) { this.name = name; }
    }

    public static Result synthesize(Map<String,byte[]> originals, List<Path> dependencyJars, Path outputJar) throws IOException {
        return synthesize(originals, dependencyJars, outputJar, MAX_STUBS);
    }
    /** @param maxStubs the stub budget; {@code truncated} is set only when a missing type was refused because of it */
    static Result synthesize(Map<String,byte[]> originals, List<Path> dependencyJars, Path outputJar, int maxStubs) throws IOException {
        var nodes = new TreeMap<String,ClassModel>();
        for (var entry : originals.entrySet()) {
            try { nodes.put(entry.getKey(), ClassModel.read(entry.getValue())); } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) { /* no evidence */ }
        }
        var supplied = new HashSet<String>(originals.keySet());
        for (var jar : dependencyJars) {
            try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
                var entries = zip.entries();
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    String name = entries.nextElement().getName();
                    if (name.endsWith(".class")) supplied.add(name.substring(0, name.length() - 6));
                }
            }
        }
        var jdk = new JdkTypes();
        var stubs = new TreeMap<String,Stub>();
        boolean[] truncated = {false};
        java.util.function.Function<String,Stub> missing = name -> {
            if (name == null || name.startsWith("[") || supplied.contains(name) || name.equals("module-info") || name.endsWith("/package-info")) return null;
            if (!stubs.containsKey(name)) {
                if (jdk.has(name)) return null;
                // Phase 2DF: truncated means a missing type was refused, not merely that the count reached the limit.
                if (stubs.size() >= maxStubs) { truncated[0] = true; return null; }
            }
            return stubs.computeIfAbsent(name, Stub::new);
        };
        // Pass 1: kinds, owners of members, supertypes and generic arity.
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            var superStub = missing.apply(node.superName);
            if (superStub != null) superStub.extended = true;
            for (String type : node.interfaces) { var stub = missing.apply(type); if (stub != null) stub.isInterface = true; }
            for (String type : node.annotations) { var stub = missing.apply(type); if (stub != null) { stub.annotation = true; stub.isInterface = true; } }
            for (String type : node.throwables) { var stub = missing.apply(type); if (stub != null) stub.throwable = true; }
            for (var arity : node.genericArity.entrySet()) {
                var stub = missing.apply(arity.getKey());
                if (stub != null) stub.typeParameters = Math.max(stub.typeParameters, arity.getValue());
            }
            for (String type : node.mentioned) missing.apply(type);
            for (var used : node.annotationElements.entrySet()) {
                var stub = stubs.get(used.getKey());
                if (stub != null) used.getValue().forEach(stub.elements::putIfAbsent);
            }
            for (var used : node.enumConstants.entrySet()) {
                var stub = missing.apply(used.getKey());
                if (stub != null) { stub.enumType = true; stub.constants.addAll(used.getValue()); }
            }
        }
        // Pass 2: members, through the owner named by each instruction (or the nearest missing superclass of an input owner).
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            for (var use : node.uses) {
                Stub target = ownerStub(use.owner(), use.name(), use.descriptor(), use.field(), nodes, missing);
                if (target == null) continue;
                if (use.interfaceOwner() && stubs.get(use.owner()) == target) target.isInterface = true;
                if (stubs.get(use.owner()) == target && !use.field() && (use.name().equals("values") && use.isStatic()
                    && use.descriptor().equals("()[L" + target.name + ";") || use.name().equals("ordinal") && use.descriptor().equals("()I"))) target.enumType = true;
                if (use.castResult() && stubs.get(use.owner()) == target) {
                    if (use.field()) target.genericFields.add(use.name()); else target.genericReturns.add(use.name() + use.descriptor());
                }
                if (use.field()) {
                    target.fields.putIfAbsent(use.name(), use.descriptor());
                    if (use.isStatic()) target.staticFields.add(use.name());
                } else if (use.name().equals("<init>")) {
                    if (stubs.get(use.owner()) == target) target.constructors.add(use.descriptor());
                } else {
                    target.methods.merge(use.name() + use.descriptor(), use.isStatic() ? Opcodes.ACC_STATIC : 0, (a, b) -> a);
                    for (String caught : use.caught()) target.throwsBy.computeIfAbsent(use.name() + use.descriptor(), key -> new TreeSet<>()).add(caught);
                }
            }
            // Possible overrides of a missing superclass's methods, so decompiled @Override annotations still compile.
            var superStub = node.superName == null ? null : stubs.get(node.superName);
            if (superStub != null && !superStub.isInterface)
                for (var method : node.instanceMethods) {
                    superStub.methods.putIfAbsent(method, 0);
                    // Phase 2CW: an override declared protected (Activity.onCreate) needs a protected stub: a public one
                    // would make the override "attempting to assign weaker access privileges".
                    if (node.protectedMethods.contains(method) && superStub.methods.get(method) == 0) superStub.methods.put(method, Opcodes.ACC_PROTECTED);
                }
        }
        // Constructors that input subclasses call through super(...).
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var call : node.superConstructorCalls) { var stub = stubs.get(call.owner()); if (stub != null) stub.constructors.add(call.descriptor()); }
        // A nested stub needs every enclosing class to be a stub too (or supplied), so javac resolves Outer.Middle.Inner;
        // Phase 2DF walks each name up to its top-level class instead of stopping at the immediate outer one.
        for (String name : new ArrayList<>(stubs.keySet())) {
            int start = name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1;
            for (int dollar = name.lastIndexOf('$'); dollar > start; dollar = name.lastIndexOf('$', dollar - 1))
                missing.apply(name.substring(0, dollar));
        }
        int methods = 0, fields = 0;
        var packages = new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
        Files.createDirectories(outputJar.getParent());
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(outputJar, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            for (var stub : stubs.values()) {
                byte[] bytes = write(stub, stubs);
                var entry = new ZipEntry(stub.name + ".class"); entry.setTime(0);
                zip.putNextEntry(entry); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry();
                methods += stub.methods.size(); fields += stub.fields.size();
                int slash = stub.name.lastIndexOf('/');
                packages.merge(slash < 0 ? "" : stub.name.substring(0, slash).replace('/', '.'), 1, Integer::sum);
            }
        }
        return new Result(Collections.unmodifiableSortedSet(new TreeSet<>(stubs.keySet())), Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(packages),
            methods, fields, truncated[0]);
    }

    /** The stub that should declare a member: the owner itself when missing, else the nearest missing superclass of an input owner. */
    private static Stub ownerStub(String owner, String name, String descriptor, boolean field, Map<String,ClassModel> nodes,
                                  java.util.function.Function<String,Stub> missing) {
        var direct = missing.apply(owner);
        if (direct != null) return direct;
        var node = nodes.get(owner);
        for (int depth = 0; node != null && depth < 64; depth++) {
            if (field ? node.fieldNames.contains(name) : node.methodKeys.contains(name + descriptor)) return null;
            if (name.equals("<init>")) return null;
            var parent = missing.apply(node.superName);
            if (parent != null) return parent;
            node = nodes.get(node.superName);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static byte[] write(Stub stub, Map<String,Stub> stubs) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        int access = Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC;
        String superName = "java/lang/Object";
        if (stub.annotation) access |= Opcodes.ACC_ANNOTATION | Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE | Opcodes.ACC_ABSTRACT;
        else if (stub.enumType && !stub.extended) { access |= Opcodes.ACC_ENUM | Opcodes.ACC_FINAL; superName = "java/lang/Enum"; }
        else if (stub.isInterface && !stub.extended && !stub.throwable) access |= Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE | Opcodes.ACC_ABSTRACT;
        else if (stub.throwable) superName = "java/lang/RuntimeException";
        boolean isEnum = (access & Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0;
        boolean isInterface = (access & Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE) != 0;
        String signature = isEnum ? "Ljava/lang/Enum<L" + stub.name + ";>;" : null;
        if (stub.typeParameters > 0 && !isEnum && !stub.annotation) {
            var params = new StringBuilder("<");
            for (int i = 1; i <= stub.typeParameters; i++) params.append('T').append(i).append(":Ljava/lang/Object;");
            signature = params.append(">L").append(superName).append(";").toString();
        }
        int dollar = stub.name.lastIndexOf('$');
        boolean nested = dollar > stub.name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1 && stubs.containsKey(stub.name.substring(0, dollar));
        if (nested) access |= Opcodes.ACC_STATIC;
        // Every annotation type implements java.lang.annotation.Annotation, or javac refuses it in an annotation use.
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_8, access & ~Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, stub.name, signature, superName,
            stub.annotation ? new String[]{"java/lang/annotation/Annotation"} : null);
        writer.visitSource("ClassRevive inferred stub", null);
        if (nested) writer.visitInnerClass(stub.name, stub.name.substring(0, dollar), stub.name.substring(dollar + 1),
            Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | (access & (Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE | Opcodes.ACC_ABSTRACT | Opcodes.ACC_ANNOTATION)));
        for (var inner : stubs.values()) {
            int innerDollar = inner.name.lastIndexOf('$');
            if (innerDollar > inner.name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1 && inner.name.substring(0, innerDollar).equals(stub.name))
                writer.visitInnerClass(inner.name, stub.name, inner.name.substring(innerDollar + 1), Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC);
        }
        if (isEnum) {
            String self = "L" + stub.name + ";";
            for (String constant : stub.constants)
                writer.visitField(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | Opcodes.ACC_FINAL | Opcodes.ACC_ENUM, constant, self, null, null).visitEnd();
            for (var field : stub.fields.entrySet())
                if (field.getValue().equals(self) && stub.staticFields.contains(field.getKey()) && !stub.constants.contains(field.getKey()))
                    writer.visitField(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | Opcodes.ACC_FINAL | Opcodes.ACC_ENUM, field.getKey(), self, null, null).visitEnd();
            stub.fields.entrySet().removeIf(field -> field.getValue().equals(self) && stub.staticFields.contains(field.getKey()));
            stub.constants.forEach(stub.fields::remove);
            var constructor = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE, "<init>", "(Ljava/lang/String;I)V", null, null);
            constructor.visitCode(); constructor.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0); constructor.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 1); constructor.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, 2);
            constructor.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/Enum", "<init>", "(Ljava/lang/String;I)V", false);
            constructor.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN); constructor.visitMaxs(0, 0); constructor.visitEnd();
            stub.methods.putIfAbsent("values()[" + self, Opcodes.ACC_STATIC);
            stub.methods.putIfAbsent("valueOf(Ljava/lang/String;)" + self, Opcodes.ACC_STATIC);
            stub.methods.remove("ordinal()I"); stub.methods.remove("name()Ljava/lang/String;");
        }
        if (stub.annotation) {
            for (var element : stub.elements.entrySet()) {
                var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_ABSTRACT, element.getKey(), "()" + element.getValue(), null, null);
                if (hasDefault(element.getValue(), stubs)) {
                    var defaults = method.visitAnnotationDefault();
                    writeDefault(defaults, element.getValue(), stubs);
                    defaults.visitEnd();
                }
                method.visitEnd();
            }
            stub.methods.clear(); stub.fields.clear();
        }
        for (var field : stub.fields.entrySet()) {
            int fieldAccess = Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | (stub.staticFields.contains(field.getKey()) || isInterface ? Opcodes.ACC_STATIC : 0);
            if (isInterface) fieldAccess |= Opcodes.ACC_FINAL;
            String fieldSignature = stub.typeParameters == 1 && !isInterface && (fieldAccess & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) == 0 && field.getValue().equals("Ljava/lang/Object;")
                && stub.genericFields.contains(field.getKey()) ? "TT1;" : null;
            writer.visitField(fieldAccess, field.getKey(), field.getValue(), fieldSignature, null).visitEnd();
        }
        if (!isInterface && !isEnum) {
            var constructors = new TreeSet<>(stub.constructors); constructors.add("()V");
            for (String descriptor : constructors) {
                var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "<init>", descriptor, null, null);
                method.visitCode();
                method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0);
                method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, superName, "<init>", "()V", false);
                method.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN);
                method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
            }
        }
        // Methods that differ only by return type would make overload resolution ambiguous: the first one (by descriptor) is kept.
        var seenParameters = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var entry : stub.methods.entrySet()) {
            String key = entry.getKey();
            int paren = key.indexOf('(');
            String name = key.substring(0, paren), descriptor = key.substring(paren);
            if (!seenParameters.add(name + descriptor.substring(0, descriptor.indexOf(')') + 1))) continue;
            boolean isStatic = entry.getValue() == Opcodes.ACC_STATIC;
            int methodAccess = (entry.getValue() == Opcodes.ACC_PROTECTED ? Opcodes.ACC_PROTECTED : Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC) | (isStatic ? Opcodes.ACC_STATIC : 0);
            if (stub.annotation && !isStatic) {
                writer.visitMethod(methodAccess | Opcodes.ACC_ABSTRACT, name, descriptor, null, null).visitEnd();
                continue;
            }
            var exceptions = stub.throwsBy.getOrDefault(key, Set.of()).toArray(String[]::new);
            String methodSignature = stub.typeParameters == 1 && !isStatic && descriptor.endsWith(")Ljava/lang/Object;") && stub.genericReturns.contains(key)
                ? descriptor.substring(0, descriptor.length() - "Ljava/lang/Object;".length()) + "TT1;" : null;
            var method = writer.visitMethod(methodAccess, name, descriptor, methodSignature, exceptions.length == 0 ? null : exceptions);
            method.visitCode();
            method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ACONST_NULL);
            method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ATHROW);
            method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
        }
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** Whether a neutral default exists: primitives, String, Class, arrays, and stub enums with a known constant. */
    private static boolean hasDefault(String descriptor, Map<String,Stub> stubs) {
        if (descriptor.startsWith("[") || descriptor.length() == 1 || descriptor.equals("Ljava/lang/String;") || descriptor.equals("Ljava/lang/Class;")) return true;
        var stub = descriptor.startsWith("L") ? stubs.get(descriptor.substring(1, descriptor.length() - 1)) : null;
        return stub != null && stub.enumType && !stub.constants.isEmpty();
    }
    /** A neutral default so an annotation use that omits the element still compiles (the first constant for an enum). */
    private static void writeDefault(AnnotationVisitor defaults, String descriptor, Map<String,Stub> stubs) {
        if (descriptor.startsWith("L") && !descriptor.equals("Ljava/lang/String;") && !descriptor.equals("Ljava/lang/Class;")) {
            defaults.visitEnum(null, descriptor, stubs.get(descriptor.substring(1, descriptor.length() - 1)).constants.iterator().next());
            return;
        }
        switch (descriptor) {
            case "Ljava/lang/String;" -> defaults.visit(null, "");
            case "Ljava/lang/Class;" -> defaults.visit(null, Type.getType("Ljava/lang/Object;"));
            case "I" -> defaults.visit(null, 0); case "J" -> defaults.visit(null, 0L); case "Z" -> defaults.visit(null, false);
            case "B" -> defaults.visit(null, (byte) 0); case "C" -> defaults.visit(null, (char) 0); case "S" -> defaults.visit(null, (short) 0);
            case "F" -> defaults.visit(null, 0f); case "D" -> defaults.visit(null, 0d);
            default -> { if (descriptor.startsWith("[")) defaults.visitArray(null).visitEnd(); }
        }
    }

    /** JDK class lookup through the runtime image, cached per package. */
    private static final class JdkTypes {
        private final List<Path> modules = new ArrayList<>();
        private final Map<String,List<Path>> byPackage = new HashMap<>();
        JdkTypes() {
            try (var stream = Files.list(FileSystems.getFileSystem(URI.create("jrt:/")).getPath("/modules"))) { stream.sorted().forEach(modules::add); }
            catch (IOException | RuntimeException unavailable) { /* no runtime image: nothing counts as a JDK type */ }
        }
        boolean has(String internalName) {
            int slash = internalName.lastIndexOf('/');
            String pkg = slash < 0 ? "" : internalName.substring(0, slash);
            var candidates = byPackage.computeIfAbsent(pkg, key -> modules.stream().filter(module -> Files.isDirectory(module.resolve(key))).toList());
            for (var module : candidates) if (Files.isRegularFile(module.resolve(internalName + ".class"))) return true;
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** What one input class tells about the types it uses. */
    private static final class ClassModel extends ClassVisitor {
        record Use(String owner, String name, String descriptor, boolean field, boolean isStatic, boolean interfaceOwner, Set<String> caught,
                   boolean castResult) {
            Use(String owner, String name, String descriptor, boolean field, boolean isStatic, boolean interfaceOwner, Set<String> caught) {
                this(owner, name, descriptor, field, isStatic, interfaceOwner, caught, false);
            }
        }
        record Call(String owner, String descriptor) {}
        String name, superName;
        final List<String> interfaces = new ArrayList<>();
        final Set<String> annotations = new HashSet<>(), throwables = new HashSet<>(), mentioned = new HashSet<>();
        final Map<String,Integer> genericArity = new HashMap<>();
        final List<Use> uses = new ArrayList<>();
        final List<Call> superConstructorCalls = new ArrayList<>();
        final Set<String> methodKeys = new HashSet<>(), fieldNames = new HashSet<>(), instanceMethods = new TreeSet<>(), protectedMethods = new HashSet<>();
        final Map<String,Map<String,String>> annotationElements = new HashMap<>();
        final Map<String,Set<String>> enumConstants = new HashMap<>();
        ClassModel() { super(Opcodes.ASM9); }

        /** Records the elements of one annotation use; nested annotations and enum values are followed. */
        private AnnotationVisitor elements(String annotationType) {
            var found = annotationElements.computeIfAbsent(annotationType, key -> new TreeMap<>());
            return new AnnotationVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                @Override public void visit(String element, Object value) {
                    if (element != null) found.putIfAbsent(element, valueDescriptor(value));
                    if (value instanceof Type type) type(type); // @Mixin(Target.class): the class named in the value is used too
                }
                @Override public void visitEnum(String element, String descriptor, String value) {
                    if (element != null) found.putIfAbsent(element, descriptor);
                    enumValue(descriptor, value);
                }
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String element, String descriptor) {
                    if (element != null) found.putIfAbsent(element, descriptor);
                    annotation(descriptor);
                    return elements(Type.getType(descriptor).getInternalName());
                }
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitArray(String element) {
                    String[] inner = {null};
                    return new AnnotationVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                        @Override public void visit(String unused, Object value) {
                            inner[0] = inner[0] == null ? valueDescriptor(value) : inner[0];
                            if (value instanceof Type type) type(type);
                        }
                        @Override public void visitEnum(String unused, String descriptor, String value) { inner[0] = descriptor; enumValue(descriptor, value); }
                        @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String unused, String descriptor) {
                            inner[0] = descriptor; annotation(descriptor); return elements(Type.getType(descriptor).getInternalName());
                        }
                        @Override public void visitEnd() { if (element != null) found.putIfAbsent(element, "[" + (inner[0] == null ? "Ljava/lang/String;" : inner[0])); }
                    };
                }
            };
        }
        private void enumValue(String descriptor, String value) {
            Type type = Type.getType(descriptor);
            if (type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT) { mentioned.add(type.getInternalName()); enumConstants.computeIfAbsent(type.getInternalName(), key -> new TreeSet<>()).add(value); }
        }
        private static String valueDescriptor(Object value) {
            if (value instanceof Type type) return "Ljava/lang/Class;";
            if (value instanceof String) return "Ljava/lang/String;";
            if (value instanceof Integer) return "I"; if (value instanceof Long) return "J"; if (value instanceof Boolean) return "Z";
            if (value instanceof Byte) return "B"; if (value instanceof Character) return "C"; if (value instanceof Short) return "S";
            if (value instanceof Float) return "F"; if (value instanceof Double) return "D";
            if (value instanceof int[]) return "[I"; if (value instanceof long[]) return "[J"; if (value instanceof boolean[]) return "[Z";
            if (value instanceof byte[]) return "[B"; if (value instanceof char[]) return "[C"; if (value instanceof short[]) return "[S";
            if (value instanceof float[]) return "[F"; if (value instanceof double[]) return "[D";
            return "Ljava/lang/String;";
        }

        static ClassModel read(byte[] bytes) {
            var model = new ClassModel();
            // Debug attributes are read on purpose: local variable signatures are often the only trace of a type's generic arity.
            new ClassReader(bytes).accept(model, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
            return model;
        }
        private void type(Type type) {
            while (type.getSort() == Type.ARRAY) type = type.getElementType();
            if (type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT) mentioned.add(type.getInternalName());
        }
        private void descriptor(String descriptor) {
            Type type = Type.getType(descriptor);
            if (type.getSort() == Type.METHOD) { type(type.getReturnType()); for (var argument : type.getArgumentTypes()) type(argument); }
            else type(type);
        }
        private void signature(String signature) {
            if (signature == null) return;
            try {
                new SignatureReader(signature).accept(new SignatureVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                    final Deque<String> classes = new ArrayDeque<>(); final Deque<Integer> counts = new ArrayDeque<>();
                    @Override public void visitClassType(String type) { classes.push(type); counts.push(0); }
                    String last;
                    @Override public void visitInnerClassType(String inner) { finish(); classes.push((last == null ? "" : last + "$") + inner); counts.push(0); }
                    @Override public SignatureVisitor visitTypeArgument(char wildcard) { if (!counts.isEmpty()) counts.push(counts.pop() + 1); return this; }
                    @Override public void visitTypeArgument() { if (!counts.isEmpty()) counts.push(counts.pop() + 1); }
                    @Override public void visitEnd() { finish(); }
                    private void finish() {
                        if (classes.isEmpty()) return;
                        String type = classes.pop(); int count = counts.pop();
                        last = type;
                        mentioned.add(type);
                        if (count > 0) genericArity.merge(type, count, Math::max);
                    }
                });
            } catch (RuntimeException malformed) { /* a broken signature adds nothing */ }
        }
        @Override public void visit(int version, int access, String name, String signature, String superName, String[] interfaces) {
            this.name = name; this.superName = superName;
            if (interfaces != null) this.interfaces.addAll(Arrays.asList(interfaces));
            if (superName != null) mentioned.add(superName);
            signature(signature);
        }
        @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String descriptor, boolean visible) { annotation(descriptor); return elements(Type.getType(descriptor).getInternalName()); }
        private void annotation(String descriptor) { Type type = Type.getType(descriptor); if (type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT) annotations.add(type.getInternalName()); }
        @Override public FieldVisitor visitField(int access, String field, String descriptor, String signature, Object value) {
            fieldNames.add(field); descriptor(descriptor); signature(signature);
            return new FieldVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String annotation, boolean visible) { annotation(annotation); return elements(Type.getType(annotation).getInternalName()); }
            };
        }
        @Override public MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access, String method, String descriptor, String signature, String[] exceptions) {
            methodKeys.add(method + descriptor); descriptor(descriptor); signature(signature);
            if ((access & (Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE | Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC)) == 0 && !method.startsWith("<")) {
                instanceMethods.add(method + descriptor);
                if ((access & Opcodes.ACC_PROTECTED) != 0) protectedMethods.add(method + descriptor);
            }
            if (exceptions != null) for (String type : exceptions) { throwables.add(type); mentioned.add(type); }
            boolean constructor = method.equals("<init>");
            return new MethodVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                final List<Label[]> tries = new ArrayList<>(); final List<String> handlers = new ArrayList<>();
                final Map<Label,Integer> positions = new HashMap<>(); int position;
                final List<int[]> pendingUses = new ArrayList<>(); final List<Use> raw = new ArrayList<>();
                // An Object-typed result cast right away: a member whose declared type is a type variable (javac casts it).
                final Set<Integer> castResults = new HashSet<>(); int pendingCast = -1;
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitAnnotation(String annotation, boolean visible) { annotation(annotation); return elements(Type.getType(annotation).getInternalName()); }
                @Override public AnnotationVisitor visitParameterAnnotation(int parameter, String annotation, boolean visible) { annotation(annotation); return elements(Type.getType(annotation).getInternalName()); }
                @Override public void visitLabel(Label label) { positions.put(label, position); }
                @Override public void visitLocalVariable(String local, String desc, String generic, Label start, Label end, int index) { descriptor(desc); signature(generic); }
                @Override public void visitTryCatchBlock(Label start, Label end, Label handler, String type) {
                    if (type != null) { tries.add(new Label[]{start, end}); handlers.add(type); throwables.add(type); mentioned.add(type); }
                }
                @Override public void visitTypeInsn(int opcode, String type) {
                    position++;
                    if (opcode == Opcodes.CHECKCAST && pendingCast >= 0) castResults.add(pendingCast);
                    pendingCast = -1;
                    if (!type.startsWith("[")) mentioned.add(type); else descriptor(type);
                }
                @Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object value) { position++; if (value instanceof Type type && type.getSort() != Type.METHOD) type(type); }
                @Override public void visitFieldInsn(int opcode, String owner, String field, String desc) {
                    position++; mentioned.add(owner); descriptor(desc);
                    raw.add(new Use(owner, field, desc, true, opcode == Opcodes.GETSTATIC || opcode == Opcodes.PUTSTATIC, false, Set.of()));
                    pendingUses.add(new int[]{position, raw.size() - 1});
                    pendingCast = opcode == Opcodes.GETFIELD && desc.equals("Ljava/lang/Object;") ? raw.size() - 1 : -1;
                }
                @Override public void visitMethodInsn(int opcode, String owner, String called, String desc, boolean isInterface) {
                    position++;
                    if (owner.startsWith("[")) return;
                    mentioned.add(owner); descriptor(desc);
                    if (constructor && opcode == Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL && called.equals("<init>") && owner.equals(superName))
                        superConstructorCalls.add(new Call(owner, desc));
                    raw.add(new Use(owner, called, desc, false, opcode == Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, isInterface || opcode == Opcodes.INVOKEINTERFACE, Set.of()));
                    pendingUses.add(new int[]{position, raw.size() - 1});
                    pendingCast = opcode != Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC && desc.endsWith(")Ljava/lang/Object;") ? raw.size() - 1 : -1;
                }
                @Override public void visitInvokeDynamicInsn(String called, String desc, Handle bootstrap, Object... arguments) {
                    position++; descriptor(desc);
                    for (var argument : arguments) if (argument instanceof Handle handle && !handle.getOwner().startsWith("[")) {
                        mentioned.add(handle.getOwner());
                        boolean field = handle.getTag() <= Opcodes.H_PUTSTATIC;
                        boolean isStatic = handle.getTag() == Opcodes.H_INVOKESTATIC || handle.getTag() == Opcodes.H_GETSTATIC || handle.getTag() == Opcodes.H_PUTSTATIC;
                        raw.add(new Use(handle.getOwner(), handle.getName(), handle.getDesc(), field, isStatic, handle.isInterface(), Set.of()));
                    }
                }
                @Override public void visitMultiANewArrayInsn(String desc, int dimensions) { position++; descriptor(desc); }
                @Override public void visitInsn(int opcode) { position++; pendingCast = -1; }
                @Override public void visitIntInsn(int opcode, int operand) { position++; pendingCast = -1; }
                @Override public void visitVarInsn(int opcode, int var) { position++; pendingCast = -1; }
                @Override public void visitJumpInsn(int opcode, Label label) { position++; pendingCast = -1; }
                @Override public void visitIincInsn(int var, int increment) { position++; pendingCast = -1; }
                @Override public void visitTableSwitchInsn(int min, int max, Label dflt, Label... labels) { position++; }
                @Override public void visitLookupSwitchInsn(Label dflt, int[] keys, Label[] labels) { position++; }
                @Override public void visitEnd() {
                    // A checked exception caught around a range whose only calls are these: those calls may throw it.
                    var caughtBy = new HashMap<Integer,Set<String>>();
                    for (int t = 0; t < tries.size(); t++) {
                        Integer start = positions.get(tries.get(t)[0]), end = positions.get(tries.get(t)[1]);
                        if (start == null || end == null || !checked(handlers.get(t))) continue;
                        var inRange = new ArrayList<Integer>();
                        for (int[] pending : pendingUses) if (pending[0] > start && pending[0] <= end && !raw.get(pending[1]).field()) inRange.add(pending[1]);
                        if (inRange.size() == 1) caughtBy.computeIfAbsent(inRange.getFirst(), key -> new TreeSet<>()).add(handlers.get(t));
                    }
                    for (int i = 0; i < raw.size(); i++) {
                        var use = raw.get(i);
                        var caught = new TreeSet<String>();
                        caught.addAll(caughtBy.getOrDefault(i, Set.of()));
                        uses.add(new Use(use.owner(), use.name(), use.descriptor(), use.field(), use.isStatic(), use.interfaceOwner(), caught, castResults.contains(i)));
                    }
                }
            };
        }
        /** A JDK checked exception type (Exception, not RuntimeException); stub and unknown types are not counted. */
        private static boolean checked(String type) {
            try {
                Class<?> found = Class.forName(type.replace('/', '.'), false, ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader());
                return Exception.class.isAssignableFrom(found) && !RuntimeException.class.isAssignableFrom(found);
            } catch (ClassNotFoundException | LinkageError notJdk) { return false; }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class BytecodeFallbackTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    @Test void exportsActualInstructionsWithoutExecutingClass() throws Exception {
        var src = directory.resolve("Code.java");
        Files.writeString(src, "public class Code { public int add(int a,int b) { return a+b; } }");
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",src.toString()));
        var jar = directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try(var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Code.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("Code.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = new BytecodeFallback().dump(jar, directory.resolve("fallback"), Duration.ofSeconds(20));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED,result.status());
        String text = Files.readString(directory.resolve("fallback/bytecode/00001.txt"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("IADD")); assertTrue(text.contains("add(II)I"));
    }
}
```
