`modules/bytecode/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/bytecode/StubSynthesizerTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.bytecode;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class StubSynthesizerTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    static final Map<String,String> LIBRARY = Map.of(
        "lib/Base.java", "package lib; public abstract class Base { protected Base(String name) {} public int size() { return 0; } public abstract void tick();"
            // Phase 2CW: overridden as protected (Activity.onCreate), so the stub must not be public.
            + " protected void onShow(String screen) {} }",
        "lib/Service.java", "package lib; public interface Service { String call(int times); }",
        "lib/Mode.java", "package lib; public enum Mode { FAST, SAFE }",
        "lib/Marker.java", "package lib; public @interface Marker { String name(); Mode mode() default Mode.SAFE; Class<?>[] targets() default {}; }",
        "lib/LibException.java", "package lib; public class LibException extends Exception { public LibException(String message) { super(message); } }",
        "lib/Box.java", "package lib; public class Box<T> { public T value; public static <T> Box<T> of(T value) { return null; } public T get() { return value; } }",
        "lib/Io.java", "package lib; public class Io { public static String read(String path) throws java.io.IOException { return path; } }",
        "lib/Outer.java", "package lib; public class Outer { public static class Inner { public static int seven() { return 7; } } }",
        "lib/Target.java", "package lib; public class Target {}");

    static final String APP = "package app; import lib.*;"
        + " @Marker(name = \"app\", mode = Mode.FAST, targets = {String.class, Target.class})"
        + " public class App extends Base implements Service {"
        + "   public App() { super(\"app\"); }"
        + "   @Override public void tick() { System.out.println(size()); }"
        + "   @Override protected void onShow(String screen) { super.onShow(screen); }"
        + "   public String call(int times) { return String.valueOf(times); }"
        + "   static int code(Mode mode) { switch (mode) { case FAST: return 1; default: return 2; } }"
        + "   static String box() { Box<String> box = Box.of(\"x\"); return box.get() + box.value; }"
        + "   static String io() { try { return Io.read(\"p\"); } catch (java.io.IOException e) { return \"\"; } }"
        + "   static void fail() throws LibException { try { throw new LibException(\"no\"); } catch (LibException e) { throw e; } }"
        + "   static int nested() { return Outer.Inner.seven(); } }";

    @Test void synthesizesStubsTheOriginalSourceCompilesAgainst() throws Exception {
        var library = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("library"));
        var sources = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var file : LIBRARY.entrySet()) {
            var path = library.resolve(file.getKey()); Files.createDirectories(path.getParent()); Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
            sources.add(path.toString());
        }
        var appSource = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("app/app")).resolve("App.java");
        Files.writeString(appSource, APP);
        var classes = dir.resolve("classes");
        // -g, as Maven and Gradle compile by default: local variable signatures are the only trace of Box's type parameter here.
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-g", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        args.addAll(sources); args.add(appSource.toString());
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        // Only the application's classes are known: the library is "missing".
        var originals = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(classes.resolve("app"))) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".class")).toList()) {
                String name = classes.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                originals.put(name.substring(0, name.length() - 6), Files.readAllBytes(path));
            }
        }
        var jar = dir.resolve("stubs/stubs.jar");
        var result = StubSynthesizer.synthesize(originals, List.of(), jar);
        assertTrue(result.classes().containsAll(List.of("lib/Base", "lib/Service", "lib/Mode", "lib/Marker", "lib/LibException", "lib/Box",
            "lib/Io", "lib/Outer", "lib/Outer$Inner", "lib/Target")), result.classes().toString());
        // lib/Target appears only as a class value of an annotation, as Mixin targets do.
        assertFalse(result.classes().stream().anyMatch(name -> name.startsWith("java/") || name.startsWith("app/")), result.classes().toString());
        assertEquals(Map.of("lib", result.classes().size()), result.packages());
        // The kinds were inferred from the uses.
        assertTrue(access(jar, "lib/Mode") == null || (access(jar, "lib/Mode") & Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0);
        assertNotEquals(0, access(jar, "lib/Marker") & Opcodes.ACC_ANNOTATION);
        assertNotEquals(0, access(jar, "lib/Service") & Opcodes.ACC_INTERFACE);
        assertEquals("java/lang/RuntimeException", superName(jar, "lib/LibException"));
        // The original application source compiles against the stubs alone.
        var rebuilt = dir.resolve("rebuilt");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-cp", jar.toString(), "-d", rebuilt.toString(), appSource.toString()));
    }

    @Test void suppliedAndJdkTypesNeedNoStub() throws Exception {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_8, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "app/Uses", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "run", "()V", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "java/util/Collections", "emptyList", "()Ljava/util/List;", false);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.POP);
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "dep/Helper", "go", "()V", false);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN); method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        var dependency = dir.resolve("dep.jar");
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(dependency))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry("dep/Helper.class")); zip.write(new byte[]{0}); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = StubSynthesizer.synthesize(Map.of("app/Uses", writer.toByteArray()), List.of(dependency), dir.resolve("out/stubs.jar"));
        assertTrue(result.isEmpty(), result.classes().toString());
    }

    /** Phase 2DF: a class that calls a static {@code ()I} method on each owner, with no InnerClasses attribute (as obfuscators leave it). */
    private static byte[] caller(String... owners) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_8, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "app/Calls", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "run", "()V", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        for (String owner : owners) { method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, owner, "seven", "()I", false); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.POP); }
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN); method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void nestedStubsGetEveryEnclosingClassUpToTheTop() throws Exception {
        var jar = dir.resolve("deep/stubs.jar");
        var result = StubSynthesizer.synthesize(Map.of("app/Calls", caller("lib/Deep$Mid$Leaf")), List.of(), jar);
        assertEquals(new TreeSet<>(List.of("lib/Deep", "lib/Deep$Mid", "lib/Deep$Mid$Leaf")), result.classes());
        // javac resolves the three-level name against the stubs alone.
        var source = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("deep-src/app")).resolve("Use.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "package app; public class Use { static int run() { return lib.Deep.Mid.Leaf.seven(); } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-cp", jar.toString(), "-d", dir.resolve("deep-classes").toString(), source.toString()));
    }

    @Test void truncatedOnlyWhenAMissingTypeWasRefused() throws Exception {
        var exact = StubSynthesizer.synthesize(Map.of("app/Calls", caller("lib/A", "lib/B")), List.of(), dir.resolve("exact/stubs.jar"), 2);
        assertEquals(2, exact.classes().size());
        assertFalse(exact.truncated(), "reaching the limit without refusing anything is not truncation");
        var over = StubSynthesizer.synthesize(Map.of("app/Calls", caller("lib/A", "lib/B", "lib/C")), List.of(), dir.resolve("over/stubs.jar"), 2);
        assertEquals(2, over.classes().size());
        assertTrue(over.truncated());
    }

    private static Integer access(Path jar, String name) throws Exception {
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            var entry = zip.getEntry(name + ".class");
            if (entry == null) return null;
            return new ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(entry).readAllBytes()).getAccess();
        }
    }
    private static String superName(Path jar, String name) throws Exception {
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) { return new ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry(name + ".class")).readAllBytes()).getSuperName(); }
    }
}
```

```kts
// Phase 2BK: the official scoreboard. Real libraries from Maven Central, hash-checked by gradle/verification-metadata.xml,

// One non-transitive configuration per sample (phase 2BT): a single shared one resolved version conflicts between samples
// (commons-lang3 3.16.0 for commons-compress, 3.17.0 in holdout2) to the newest and laid out only that.
fun jarName(coordinate: String) = coordinate.split(':').let { "${it[1]}-${it[2]}.jar" }
val scoreboardCorpusTasks = scoreboardCorpora.mapValues { (set, samples) ->
    val libraries = samples.mapValues { (sample, deps) ->
        configurations.create("scoreboard_${set}_" + sample.replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9]"), "_")) {
            isCanBeConsumed = false; isTransitive = false
        }.also { configuration -> (listOf(sample) + deps).forEach { dependencies.add(configuration.name, it) } }
    }
    tasks.register<Sync>("scoreboardCorpus${set.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() }}") {
        description = "Lays out the '$set' scoreboard corpus (real libraries plus <sample>.deps/ folders) under build/scoreboard-corpus/$set."
        group = "verification"
        into(rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.dir("scoreboard-corpus/$set"))
        for ((sample, deps) in samples) {
            from(libraries.getValue(sample)) { include(jarName(sample)) }
            for (dep in deps) from(libraries.getValue(sample)) { include(jarName(dep)); into(jarName(sample) + ".deps") }
        }
    }
}
tasks.register<JavaExec>("scoreboard") {
    description = "Runs 'classrevive benchmark' on a scoreboard corpus (-PscoreboardSet=dev|holdout|holdout2, default dev) into a new build/scoreboard/ folder."
    group = "verification"
    val set = providers.gradleProperty("scoreboardSet").getOrElse("dev")
    val corpus = scoreboardCorpusTasks[set] ?: throw GradleException("scoreboardSet must be one of ${scoreboardCorpora.keys}")
    dependsOn(corpus)
    classpath = sourceSets["main"].runtimeClasspath
    mainClass.set(application.mainClass)
    // -PscoreboardResume=<folder under build/scoreboard> continues that interrupted run instead of starting a new one.
    val resumeFrom = providers.gradleProperty("scoreboardResume").orNull
    val output = if (resumeFrom != null) rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.dir("scoreboard/$resumeFrom")
        else rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.dir("scoreboard/$set-" + LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss")))
    argumentProviders.add(CommandLineArgumentProvider {
        // Phase 2CH: engine outputs are cached across runs under build/engine-cache (keyed by input and engine bytes).
        listOf("benchmark", corpus.get().destinationDir.path, "--output", output.get().asFile.path, "--timeout-seconds", "600",
            "--engine-cache", rootProject.layout.buildDirectory.dir("engine-cache").get().asFile.path) +
            (if (resumeFrom != null) listOf("--resume", "true") else listOf())
    })
    doFirst { output.get().asFile.parentFile.mkdirs() }
    // Exit 1 also means some attempt was not structurally complete, which is a measurement, not a build failure;
    // only benchmark.json proves the run finished.
    isIgnoreExitValue = true
    doLast {
        val code = executionResult.get().exitValue
        if (code !in 0..1 || !output.get().file("benchmark.json").asFile.isFile) throw GradleException("benchmark did not finish (exit $code)")
        logger.lifecycle("Scoreboard: " + output.get().file("benchmark.md").asFile.path)
    }
}
// The distribution carries only these user documents, never the whole docs/ folder. The desktop application opens
// docs/guia-iniciante.md from it, and obfuscation reports cite docs/obfuscation-detection.md.
val publicDocs = listOf("README.md", "getting-started.md", "guia-iniciante.md", "cli-reference.md", "benchmarks.md", "status.md",
    "reports.md", "obfuscation-detection.md", "dynamic-diagnostics.md", "pass-sdk.md", "sandbox.md", "behavior-protocol.md",
    "images/desktop-class-dark.png", "images/desktop-class-dark-pt-BR.png", "images/desktop-overview-dark.png",
    "images/desktop-compare-light.png")
publicDocs.forEach { check(rootProject.file("docs/$it").isFile) { "Public document docs/$it is missing" } }
distributions {
    main {
        contents {
            from(guiStartScripts) { into("bin") }
            // Phase 2CW: dex2jar is the conversion worker's own class path, next to the dex module's jar, never the application's.
            from(dexTools) { into("lib/dex2jar") }
            from(rootProject.file("LICENSE"))
            from(rootProject.file("NOTICE"))
            from(rootProject.file("THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md"))
            from(rootProject.file("README.md"))
            from(rootProject.file("README.pt-BR.md"))

            from(rootProject.file("CONTRIBUTING.md"))
            from(rootProject.file("docs")) { include(publicDocs); into("docs") }
            from(rootProject.file("third-party-licenses")) { into("third-party-licenses") }
        }
    }
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.BenchmarkRunner;
import java.io.*;

final class BenchmarkCommand {
    private BenchmarkCommand() {}
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            var options = JobOptions.parse(args, "all");
            out.println("Benchmarking selected engines and combined selection; target behavior is not executed.");
            var result = new BenchmarkRunner().withEngineCache(options.engineCache()).withStubs(options.stubs())
                .run(options.input(), options.output(), options.engines(), options.timeout(), options.resume());
            out.printf("Structurally complete: %d/%d attempts. Behavior not verified.%n", result.complete(), result.attempted());
            out.println("Report: " + Main.safe(options.output().toAbsolutePath().normalize().resolve("benchmark.json").toString()));
            return result.complete() == result.attempted() ? 0 : 1;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Benchmark failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1;
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Benchmark interrupted; completed rows remain in progress.jsonl."); return 130;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/CompareReferenceCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.ReferenceCompareJob;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/** Phase 2CD: {@code compare-reference <reference.jar> <decompile-output> --output <new-directory>}. */
final class CompareReferenceCommand {
    private CompareReferenceCommand() {}
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            if (args.length < 5 || args.length % 2 == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected reference JAR, decompile output and --output <new-directory>.");
            Path reference = Path.of(args[1]), decompiled = Path.of(args[2]), output = null;
            int seconds = 600; var dependencies = new ArrayList<Path>(); var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            for (int i = 3; i < args.length; i += 2) {
                if (!seen.add(args[i])) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate option: " + args[i]);
                switch (args[i]) {
                    case "--output" -> output = Path.of(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--timeout-seconds" -> seconds = Integer.parseInt(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--classpath" -> {
                        for (String path : args[i + 1].split(java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(File.pathSeparator), -1)) {
                            if (path.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty classpath entry");
                            dependencies.add(Path.of(path));
                        }
                    }
                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + args[i]);
                }
            }
            if (output == null || seconds < 1 || seconds > 3600 || dependencies.size() > 16)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require --output, timeout-seconds 1..3600 and at most 16 classpath JARs.");
            var result = new ReferenceCompareJob().run(reference, decompiled, output, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds), dependencies);
            out.print(ReferenceCompareJob.text(result));
            out.println("Evidence: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().resolve("reference.json").toString()));
            return 0;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid command arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2;
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten."); return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Comparison failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/DecompileCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.DecompileService;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

final class DecompileCommand {
    /** Phase 2CV: a folder given as input contributes its .jar and .class files, at most this many. */
    static final int MAX_FOLDER_INPUTS = 100;

    private DecompileCommand() {}

    /**
     * Phase 2CV: {@code decompile <file|folder>... [--output <folder>] [options]}. One input works as before, and without
     * {@code --output} it writes a new {@code <name>-classrevive} folder in the current folder. Several inputs, or a folder,
     * each get a new folder inside the output folder (default: the current folder), decompiled one after another.
     */
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        int first = 1, end = first;
        while (end < args.length && !args[end].startsWith("-")) end++;
        if (end == first) { err.println("Invalid command arguments: expected an input file. Run 'classrevive help decompile'."); return 2; }
        var options = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(args).subList(end, args.length));
        List<Path> inputs;
        try { inputs = inputs(Arrays.asList(args).subList(first, end)); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException | IOException invalid) { err.println("Invalid command arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(invalid.getMessage()))); return 2; }
        int outputAt = options.indexOf("--output");
        boolean batch = inputs.size() > 1 || Files.isDirectory(Path.of(args[first]));
        if (!batch) {
            var single = new ArrayList<String>(List.of("decompile", inputs.getFirst().toString()));
            single.addAll(options);
            if (outputAt < 0) {
                Path output = Outputs.next(Path.of("").toAbsolutePath(), inputs.getFirst(), "classrevive");
                single.addAll(List.of("--output", output.toString()));
                out.println("Output: " + Main.safe(output.toString()));
            }
            return single(single.toArray(String[]::new), out, err);
        }
        if (outputAt == options.size() - 1) { err.println("Invalid command arguments: --output needs a folder."); return 2; }
        Path folder = outputAt < 0 ? Path.of("").toAbsolutePath() : Path.of(options.get(outputAt + 1)).toAbsolutePath();
        if (outputAt >= 0) { options.remove(outputAt + 1); options.remove(outputAt); }
        try { Files.createDirectories(folder); }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) { err.println("Cannot create the output folder: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(failure.getMessage()))); return 1; }
        int complete = 0, failed = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < inputs.size(); i++) {
            Path input = inputs.get(i);
            Path output = Outputs.next(folder, input, "classrevive");
            out.println("== [" + (i + 1) + "/" + inputs.size() + "] " + Main.safe(input.toString()));
            var single = new ArrayList<String>(List.of("decompile", input.toString()));
            single.addAll(options);
            single.addAll(List.of("--output", output.toString()));
            int code = single(single.toArray(String[]::new), out, err);
            if (code == 2 || code == 130) return code;
            if (code == 0) complete++; else failed++;
        }
        out.println("Decompiled " + inputs.size() + " inputs into " + Main.safe(folder.toString()) + ": " + complete
            + " compiled with every signature, " + failed + " partial or failed.");
        return failed == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }

    /** The positional inputs, with each folder replaced by its .jar and .class files (sorted, not recursive). */
    static List<Path> inputs(List<String> names) throws IOException {
        var inputs = new ArrayList<Path>();
        for (String name : names) {
            Path path = Path.of(name);
            if (!Files.isDirectory(path)) { inputs.add(path); continue; }
            try (var files = Files.list(path)) {
                var found = files.filter(file -> Files.isRegularFile(file, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
                    .filter(file -> file.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).matches(".*\\.(jar|class)")).sorted().toList();
                if (found.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("no .jar or .class file in " + name);
                inputs.addAll(found);
            }
        }
        if (inputs.size() > MAX_FOLDER_INPUTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("at most " + MAX_FOLDER_INPUTS + " inputs per run");
        return inputs;
    }

    private static int single(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            var nativeOptions = new NativeOptions[1];
            var options = JobOptions.parse(NativeOptions.strip(args, nativeOptions), "cfr,vineflower");
            Path output = options.output();
            if (IdentifyCommand.needsIdentification(options.input()))
                out.println("Input is not named .class or .jar: identifying it from its bytes (nothing is run).");
            out.println("Preparing input; selected engines run in separate JVMs (2 to 4 concurrently, by processor count).");
            var decompiled = new DecompileService().decompile(options.request(), progress(err));
            var job = decompiled.job();
            if (job.deobfuscation() != null)
                out.println("Deobfuscation: " + Main.safe(dev.classrevive.pipeline.AutoDeobfuscation.headline(job.deobfuscation())));
            for (var result : job.engines()) {
                out.printf("%s %s: %s (%d source files, %d ms)%n", result.engine(), result.version(),
                    result.status(), result.sourceFiles(), result.elapsedMillis());
            }
            out.println("Result: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString()));
            var verified = job.selection().verification();
            out.printf("Selected: %s | compilation=%s | signatures=%d/%d | placeholder-signals=%d%n",
                job.selection().candidate(), verified.status(), verified.matchedSymbols(), verified.expectedSymbols(), verified.placeholderSignals());
            int missing = verified.detail().indexOf("missing packages (supply with --classpath): ");
            if (missing >= 0) {
                String list = verified.detail().substring(missing + "missing packages (supply with --classpath): ".length());
                int end = list.indexOf(';');
                out.println("Likely missing dependencies (pass their JARs with --classpath): " + Main.safe(end < 0 ? list : list.substring(0, end)));
            }
            out.println("Sources: selection/sources. Behavior not verified; see selection/selection.txt for evidence.");
            if (job.fallback() != null) out.println("Bytecode fallback: " + job.fallback().status() + " (fallback/bytecode)");
            Path absolute = decompiled.output();
            if (decompiled.origin() != null) out.println(Main.safe(decompiled.origin()));
            nativeOptions[0].run(absolute, absolute.resolve("report.txt"), absolute.resolve("report.json"), out);
            return verified.complete() ? 0 : 1;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid command arguments: " + Main.safe(error.getMessage()));
            return 2;
        } catch (dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.NoJavaException error) {
            return IdentifyCommand.noJava(error, out, err);
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten.");
            return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Decompilation failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage())));
            return 1;
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            err.println("Decompilation interrupted.");
            return 130;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2CV: each stage on standard error, only when it is the interactive terminal, so scripts that read standard
     * output (or capture both streams) see exactly what they saw before.
     */
    static JobListener progress(PrintStream err) {
        if (System.console() == null || err != System.err) return JobListener.NONE;
        var names = Map.of(JobListener.Stage.INTAKE, "reading and checking the input", JobListener.Stage.ENGINES, "running the decompilers",
            JobListener.Stage.STUBS, "inferring missing libraries", JobListener.Stage.SELECTION, "recompiling and choosing the best source",
            JobListener.Stage.PER_FILE, "measuring file by file", JobListener.Stage.FALLBACK, "writing readable bytecode",
            JobListener.Stage.REPORTS, "writing the reports");
        return new JobListener() {
            @Override public void stage(Stage stage) { err.println("  [" + (stage.ordinal() + 1) + "/" + Stage.values().length + "] " + names.get(stage)); }
        };
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/DiagnoseCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.DiagnosticJob;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

final class DiagnoseCommand {
    static int run(String[] args,PrintStream out,PrintStream err) {
        try {
            var nativeOptions=new NativeOptions[1];
            args=NativeOptions.strip(args,nativeOptions);
            // Phase 2CV: without --output, a new <name>-diagnosis folder in the current folder.
            if(args.length>=2 && !Arrays.asList(args).contains("--output")) args=Outputs.withDefault(args,"diagnosis");
            if(args.length<4 || args.length%2!=0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and --output <new-directory>");
            var options=new HashMap<String,String>();
            for(int i=2;i<args.length;i+=2) {
                if(!Set.of("--output","--timeout-seconds","--entry").contains(args[i]) || options.putIfAbsent(args[i],args[i+1])!=null)
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown or duplicate option: "+args[i]);
            }
            if(!options.containsKey("--output")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing --output");
            Duration timeout=dev.classrevive.workbench.RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(Integer.parseInt(options.getOrDefault("--timeout-seconds","60")));
            Path output=Path.of(options.get("--output"));
            if(IdentifyCommand.needsIdentification(Path.of(args[1]))) out.println("Input is not named .class or .jar: identifying it from its bytes (nothing is run).");
            // Phase 2DB: --entry picks the nested jar of a bundle of jars.
            var result=new DiagnosticJob().run(Path.of(args[1]),output,timeout,options.get("--entry"));
            out.printf("Classes scanned: %d; findings: %d; limit reached: %s%n",result.classes(),result.findings(),result.limited());
            out.printf("Static signals: class-loading=%d; crypto=%d%n",result.signalCounts().getOrDefault("CLASS_LOADING_API",0),
                result.signalCounts().getOrDefault("CRYPTO_API",0));
            if(!result.obfuscation().isEmpty()) for(String line:result.obfuscation().split("\n")) out.println(Main.safe(line));
            Path absolute=output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            String origin=dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.attach(absolute,absolute.resolve("obfuscation.txt"),absolute.resolve("diagnostics.json"));
            if(origin!=null) out.println(Main.safe(origin));
            nativeOptions[0].run(absolute,absolute.resolve("obfuscation.txt"),absolute.resolve("diagnostics.json"),out);
            out.println("Evidence: "+Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().resolve("diagnostics.json").toString()));
            out.println("Static API references are clues only; they do not prove runtime reachability, packing, encryption or malicious behavior.");
            return result.successful()&&!result.limited()?0:1;
        } catch(IllegalArgumentException error) { err.println("Invalid arguments: "+Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2; }
        catch(dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.NoJavaException error) { return IdentifyCommand.noJava(error,out,err); }
        catch(IOException error) { err.println("Diagnostics failed: "+Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1; }
        catch(InterruptedException error) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Diagnostics interrupted."); return 130; }
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/GuiCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.file.*;

/** Phase G3: {@code classrevive gui [file-or-result-folder]} opens the desktop application. */
final class GuiCommand {
    private GuiCommand() {}

    /** 0 when the window is starting (the process then lives on); 1 without a display, 2 for bad arguments. */
    static int start(String[] args, PrintStream err) {
        if (args.length > 2) { err.println("Usage: classrevive gui [file.jar|file.class|result-folder]"); return 2; }
        Path file = null;
        if (args.length == 2) {
            try { file = Path.of(args[1]); }
            catch (InvalidPathException invalid) { err.println("Invalid path."); return 2; }
            if (!Files.exists(file)) { err.println("No such file or folder: " + Main.safe(args[1])); return 2; }
        }
        if (java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless()) {
            err.println("The desktop application needs a graphical display. Use the other commands here (classrevive --help).");
            return 1;
        }
        dev.classrevive.gui.ClassReviveApp.launch(file);
        return 0;
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.util.*;

/** Phase 2CV: a short overview, and per-command help with options, defaults, examples and exit codes. */
final class Help {
    static final String VERSION = "0.1.0";

    /** {@code summary}: one line for the overview; {@code text}: the full help of the command. */
    record Entry(String group, String summary, String text) {}

    static final String EXIT_CODES = """
        Exit codes: 0 done (for decompile: compiles with every signature) | 1 failure or partial result | 2 invalid arguments | 130 interrupted.""";

    static final Map<String,Entry> COMMANDS = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    static {
        COMMANDS.put("gui", new Entry("main", "Open the desktop application (also bin/classrevive-gui)", """
            Usage: classrevive gui [file.jar|file.class|result-folder]

            Opens the desktop application, optionally with a file or a result folder. Everything decompile does, with
            an explorer, code tabs, live progress, the confidence of every class, search, export and settings.
            Exit codes: 0 the window is opening | 1 no graphical display | 2 invalid arguments."""));
        COMMANDS.put("decompile", new Entry("main", "Recover Java sources with several engines and verify them by recompiling", """
            Usage: classrevive decompile <file|folder>... [-o <output>] [options]

            Decompiles .jar and .class files (any other file, such as an .exe, is identified from its bytes first;
            an Android .apk or .dex is converted to class files by dex2jar), recompiles the result and writes sources,
            evidence and an IDE project into a new folder.

              -o, --output <folder>       New result folder (one input), or the folder that receives one result folder per
                                          input (several inputs or a folder). Default: <name>-classrevive in the current folder.
              -e, --engines <list>        cfr,vineflower,procyon,jadx or all. Default: cfr,vineflower.
              -t, --timeout-seconds <n>   Limit per worker or compile attempt, 1..3600. Default: 120.
              -cp, --classpath <jars>     Library JARs used only to verify the result (separator: %s), at most 16.
              --stubs true|false          Infer stand-ins for missing libraries (reported as such). Default: true.
              --entry <name>              For a bundle of jars (a zip of jars, alone or inside an .exe): the nested jar
                                          to decompile. Default: the one with the most classes that is not a library;
                                          the bundle's other jars are added to --classpath automatically.
              --engine-cache <folder>     Reuse engine outputs keyed by input and engine bytes.
              --deobfuscate auto|off      Undo a recognized obfuscator (Skidfuscator, Aidsfuscator) before decompiling,
                                          when the diagnosis is HIGH confidence. Default: auto.
              %s
                                          Static triage of bundled native libraries with an installed Ghidra.

            Examples:
              classrevive decompile app.jar
              classrevive decompile app.jar -o recovered -e all -cp "libs/a.jar%slibs/b.jar"
              classrevive decompile plugins/ -o results

            Existing folders are never overwritten. The program is never executed; behavior is not verified.
            %s"""));
        COMMANDS.put("inspect", new Entry("main", "List the classes of a .jar or .class: versions, fields and methods", """
            Usage: classrevive inspect <file.class|file.jar>

            Prints the input and entry SHA-256, sizes, every class with its Java version and member counts, and notices.
            Nothing is loaded or run. Any other file is identified instead (exit 1).
            Exit codes: 0 complete inventory | 1 input or inspection failure | 2 invalid arguments."""));
        COMMANDS.put("identify", new Entry("main", "Say what a file is (PE, ELF, .NET, jar, APK, installer...) and whether it holds Java", """
            Usage: classrevive identify <file> [-o <new-folder>]

            Reads the bytes only: format, sections and entropy, overlay, signature, protector names, and any jar found
            inside (Launch4j, exe4j, a jar appended to a stub), bundles of nested jars, Android APK, dex and app
            bundles. With -o, a bundle's nested jars are also written to bundle/ as data. Nothing is run,
            unpacked or decrypted.
            Exit codes: 0 the file was read | 1 unreadable, or the output exists | 2 invalid arguments."""));
        COMMANDS.put("diagnose", new Entry("main", "Static triage: obfuscation techniques, reflection, class loading, crypto", """
            Usage: classrevive diagnose <input> [-o <new-folder>] [-t <seconds>] [--entry <nested.jar>] [native options]

            Counts obfuscation techniques and suggests the obfuscator (never proof), and lists bootstrap sites, reflection,
            class-loading and crypto references as clues. Default output: <name>-diagnosis in the current folder.
            %s"""));
        COMMANDS.put("engines", new Entry("tools", "List the bundled decompiler engines and their pinned versions", """
            Usage: classrevive engines"""));
        COMMANDS.put("transform", new Entry("tools", "Opt-in static simplification passes (constant folding, string decoding)", """
            Usage: classrevive transform <input> -o <new-folder> [--passes <list>] [--max-changes <1..10000>] [-t <seconds>]

            Passes, in the order given: integer-constants (default), integer-unary, integer-branches, string-length,
            string-char-at, string-decryptor; skidfuscator (first in the list) reverses Skidfuscator 2.1.0,
            aidsfuscator (first in the list) reverses Aidsfuscator 2.10.0.
            The output is checked by the JVM verifier; nothing is executed.
            %s"""));
        COMMANDS.put("rename", new Entry("tools", "Rename classes and private members (readable aliases or a mapping file)", """
            Usage: classrevive rename <input> -o <new-folder> [--mapping <file> | --proguard-mapping <mapping.txt>] [-t <seconds>]

            Without a mapping, short class names get deterministic readable aliases. --mapping takes rules
            "class a=b", "method owner#name[(desc)]=new", "field owner#name[:desc]=new"; --proguard-mapping restores the
            names a ProGuard or R8 mapping records where that is safe, and reports what it skipped.
            %s"""));
        COMMANDS.put("benchmark", new Entry("tools", "Measure each engine and the combined selection on a corpus", """
            Usage: classrevive benchmark <corpus-folder> -o <new-folder> [-e <list>] [-t <seconds>] [--engine-cache <folder>] [--resume true]

            Each .jar/.class sample compiles against the jars in a sibling <sample>.deps/ folder. Writes benchmark.json,
            benchmark.md and the failure lab cases. Default engines: all.
            %s"""));
        COMMANDS.put("compare-reference", new Entry("tools", "Score a decompile against a reference jar (answer key)", """
            Usage: classrevive compare-reference <reference.jar> <decompile-output> -o <new-folder> [-cp <jars>]"""));
        COMMANDS.put("sandbox-check", new Entry("tools", "Check local Docker readiness (read only; nothing is executed)", """
            Usage: classrevive sandbox-check"""));
        COMMANDS.put("lab", new Entry("lab", "Capture failure cases, grouped by stable signature", """
            Usage: classrevive lab <input|corpus-folder> -o <new-folder> [--minimize none|first|all|failure-NNNN] [--max-steps <n>] [--max-seconds <n>]"""));
        COMMANDS.put("lab-minimize", new Entry("lab", "Reduce a failure case while it still fails the same way", """
            Usage: classrevive lab-minimize <failure-case-folder> -o <new-folder> [--max-steps <n>] [--max-seconds <n>] [--keep-recoverable true|false]

            A reduction is kept only if the JVM verifier accepts it (nothing executed) and the failure repeats twice."""));
        COMMANDS.put("lab-promote", new Entry("lab", "Turn a minimized case into a regression case", """
            Usage: classrevive lab-promote <minimized-case-folder> -o <new-regression-folder> [--provenance <text>]"""));
        COMMANDS.put("lab-check", new Entry("lab", "Fail when a committed regression case got worse", """
            Usage: classrevive lab-check <regressions-folder> -o <new-folder>"""));
    }

    private Help() {}

    static void overview(PrintStream out) {
        out.println("ClassRevive " + VERSION + " - recover readable Java and measure how far to trust it");
        out.println();
        out.println("Usage: classrevive <command> [arguments]");
        for (var group : List.of(new String[] {"main", "Main commands"}, new String[] {"tools", "Tools"}, new String[] {"lab", "Failure lab"})) {
            out.println();
            out.println(group[1] + ":");
            COMMANDS.forEach((name, entry) -> { if (entry.group().equals(group[0])) out.printf("  %-18s %s%n", name, entry.summary()); });
        }
        out.println();
        out.println("Run 'classrevive help <command>' (or '<command> --help') for options and examples. 'classrevive --version' prints the version.");
        out.println(EXIT_CODES);
        out.println("Target code is never executed: ClassRevive only reads bytes. Compilation and signatures are checked; behavior is not verified.");
    }

    /** Prints a command's help; 2 for an unknown command. */
    static int command(String name, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        var entry = COMMANDS.get(name);
        if (entry == null) return unknown(name, err);
        out.println("classrevive " + name + " - " + entry.summary());
        out.println();
        out.println(text(name, entry));
        return 0;
    }

    static int unknown(String name, PrintStream err) {
        String suggestion = closest(name);
        err.println("Unknown command: " + Main.safe(name) + "." + (suggestion == null ? "" : " Did you mean '" + suggestion + "'?")
            + " Run 'classrevive --help' for the list of commands.");
        return 2;
    }

    /** The full help text of a command, with the platform path separator and exit codes filled in. */
    static String text(String name, Entry entry) {
        String separator = java.io.File.pathSeparator;
        return switch (name) {
            case "decompile" -> entry.text().formatted(separator, NativeOptions.USAGE, separator, EXIT_CODES);
            case "diagnose", "transform", "rename", "benchmark" -> entry.text().formatted(EXIT_CODES);
            default -> entry.text();
        };
    }

    /** The known command nearest to {@code name} (edit distance at most 3), or null. */
    static String closest(String name) {
        String best = null;
        int bestDistance = 4;
        for (String command : COMMANDS.keySet()) {
            int distance = distance(name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), command);
            if (distance < bestDistance) { best = command; bestDistance = distance; }
        }
        return best;
    }

    private static int distance(String a, String b) {
        int[] previous = new int[b.length() + 1], current = new int[b.length() + 1];
        for (int j = 0; j <= b.length(); j++) previous[j] = j;
        for (int i = 1; i <= a.length(); i++) {
            current[0] = i;
            for (int j = 1; j <= b.length(); j++)
                current[j] = Math.min(Math.min(current[j - 1] + 1, previous[j] + 1), previous[j - 1] + (a.charAt(i - 1) == b.charAt(j - 1) ? 0 : 1));
            var swap = previous; previous = current; current = swap;
        }
        return previous[b.length()];
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/IdentifyCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.Locale;

/**
 * Phase 2CE: {@code identify <file> [--output <new-directory>]}: what the file is and whether it holds Java, from its bytes.
 * Phase 2DB: for a bundle of jars, {@code --output} also writes the nested jars to {@code bundle/}.
 */
final class IdentifyCommand {
    private IdentifyCommand() {}
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            if (args.length != 2 && !(args.length == 4 && args[2].equals("--output")))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Usage: classrevive identify <file> [--output <new-directory>]");
            var identification = InputIdentifier.identify(Path.of(args[1]));
            print(identification, out);
            if (args.length == 4) {
                Path output = InputIdentifier.write(Path.of(args[3]), identification);
                out.println("Evidence: " + Main.safe(output.resolve("identification.json").toString()));
                // Phase 2DB: a bundle's nested jars are written next to the evidence, as data.
                var jars = InputIdentifier.extractBundle(Path.of(args[1]), identification, output);
                if (!jars.isEmpty()) out.println("Nested jars written (data, not run): " + jars.size() + " in " + Main.safe(output.resolve("bundle").toString()));
            }
            return 0;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage())));
            return 2;
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten.");
            return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Identification failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage())));
            return 1;
        }
    }

    static boolean needsIdentification(Path input) {
        Path name = input.getFileName();
        String lower = name == null ? "" : name.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        return !lower.endsWith(".class") && !lower.endsWith(".jar");
    }

    static void print(InputIdentifier.Identification identification, PrintStream out) {
        for (String line : identification.text().split("\n")) out.println(Main.safe(line));
    }

    /** For decompile and diagnose: an input without Java the pipeline can take is explained, not just rejected (exit 1). */
    static int noJava(InputIdentifier.NoJavaException error, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        print(error.identification(), out);
        err.println("No Java to process: " + Main.safe(error.getMessage()) + " No output directory was created.");
        return 1;
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/JobOptions.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.*;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/** {@code engineCache}: Phase 2BX opt-in engine output cache, or null; {@code resume}: continue an interrupted benchmark. */
/** Phase 2DB: {@code entry}: the nested jar to take from a bundle of jars (decompile only), or null. */
/** Phase 2DD: {@code deobfuscate}: automatic reversal ({@code --deobfuscate auto|off}, decompile only). */
record JobOptions(Path input, Path output, Duration timeout, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, List<Path> dependencies, Path engineCache, boolean resume,
                  boolean stubs, String entry, boolean deobfuscate) {
    static JobOptions parse(String[] args, String defaultEngines) {
        if (args.length < 4 || args.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and option/value pairs");
        var options = new HashMap<String,String>();
        for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i += 2) {
            if (!Set.of("--output", "--timeout-seconds", "--engines", "--classpath", "--engine-cache", "--resume", "--stubs", "--entry", "--deobfuscate").contains(args[i]))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + args[i]);
            if (options.putIfAbsent(args[i], args[i+1]) != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Repeated option: " + args[i]);
        }
        if (!options.containsKey("--output")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing --output <new-directory>");
        Duration timeout = RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(Integer.parseInt(options.getOrDefault("--timeout-seconds", "120")));
        var dependencies=new ArrayList<Path>();
        if(options.containsKey("--classpath")) {
            if(!args[0].equals("decompile")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--classpath is supported only by decompile");
            for(String path:options.get("--classpath").split(java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(java.io.File.pathSeparator),-1)) {
                if(path.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty classpath entry");
                dependencies.add(Path.of(path));
            }
            RequestLimits.dependencies(dependencies);
        }
        String resume = options.getOrDefault("--resume", "false");
        if (!resume.equals("true") && !resume.equals("false")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--resume takes true or false");
        if (resume.equals("true") && !args[0].equals("benchmark")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--resume is supported only by benchmark");
        // Phase 2CT: inferred stubs for missing types (decompile and benchmark), on by default.
        String stubs = options.getOrDefault("--stubs", "true");
        if (!stubs.equals("true") && !stubs.equals("false")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--stubs takes true or false");
        String entry = options.get("--entry");
        if (entry != null && !args[0].equals("decompile")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--entry is supported only by decompile and diagnose");
        if (entry != null && entry.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty --entry name");
        // Phase 2DD: reversal of an obfuscator the diagnosis recognizes with HIGH confidence, on by default.
        String deobfuscate = options.getOrDefault("--deobfuscate", "auto");
        if (!deobfuscate.equals("auto") && !deobfuscate.equals("off")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--deobfuscate takes auto or off");
        if (options.containsKey("--deobfuscate") && !args[0].equals("decompile")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--deobfuscate is supported only by decompile");
        String cache = options.get("--engine-cache");
        if (cache != null && cache.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty --engine-cache directory");
        return new JobOptions(Path.of(args[1]), Path.of(options.get("--output")), timeout,
            EngineRegistry.parse(options.getOrDefault("--engines", defaultEngines)),List.copyOf(dependencies), cache == null ? null : Path.of(cache),
            resume.equals("true"), stubs.equals("true"), entry, deobfuscate.equals("auto"));
    }

    /** Phase G1: the same job as a front-end-neutral request. */
    DecompileRequest request() { return new DecompileRequest(input, output, engines, timeout, dependencies, engineCache, stubs, entry, deobfuscate); }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/LabCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.EngineRegistry;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/** Failure lab commands (Phase 2AT): capture and group, minimize, promote to a regression case, check regressions. */
final class LabCommand {
    private LabCommand() {}

    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            return switch (args[0]) {
                case "lab" -> lab(args, out);
                case "lab-minimize" -> minimize(args, out);
                case "lab-promote" -> promote(args, out);
                default -> check(args, out);
            };
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2;
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten."); return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Failure lab failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1;
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Failure lab interrupted; finished steps remain in the output."); return 130;
        }
    }

    private static int lab(String[] args, PrintStream out) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var options = options(args, Set.of("--output", "--engines", "--timeout-seconds", "--classpath", "--minimize", "--max-steps", "--max-seconds",
            "--keep-recoverable"));
        Path input = Path.of(args[1]), output = Path.of(required(options, "--output")).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        var engines = EngineRegistry.parse(options.getOrDefault("--engines", "all"));
        Duration timeout = seconds(options, "--timeout-seconds", 120, 3600);
        String minimize = options.getOrDefault("--minimize", "none");
        if (!minimize.matches("none|first|all|failure-[0-9]{4}")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--minimize must be none, first, all or failure-NNNN");
        var dependencies = new ArrayList<Path>();
        if (options.containsKey("--classpath")) {
            if (Files.isDirectory(input)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--classpath is supported only for a single input");
            for (String path : options.get("--classpath").split(java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(File.pathSeparator), -1)) {
                if (path.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty classpath entry");
                dependencies.add(Path.of(path));
            }
        }
        var budget = budget(options);
        boolean keepRecoverable = keepRecoverable(options);
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        Path failures;
        if (Files.isDirectory(input, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            out.println("Corpus: running the benchmark with failure capture; target behavior is not executed.");
            var result = new BenchmarkRunner().run(input, output.resolve("benchmark"), engines, timeout);
            out.printf("Benchmark: %d/%d attempts structurally complete.%n", result.complete(), result.attempted());
            failures = output.resolve("benchmark").resolve("failures");
        } else {
            out.println("Decompiling with every selected engine; each engine candidate and the selected sources are captured.");
            var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, output.resolve("job"), engines, timeout, dependencies, true);
            var collector = new FailureCollector(output.resolve("failures"));
            collector.capture(job, output.resolve("job"), engines.size() > 1 ? "combined" : engines.getFirst().id(), null, true);
            collector.finish();
            failures = collector.directory();
        }
        var summary = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(failures.resolve("failures.json")));
        var groups = (List<?>) summary.get("groups");
        out.printf("Failure cases: %s; signatures: %s (%s)%n", summary.get("cases"), summary.get("signatures"),
            Main.safe(failures.resolve("failures.md").toString()));
        int shown = 0;
        for (var value : groups) {
            if (shown++ == 10) { out.println("  ... " + (groups.size() - 10) + " more in failures.json"); break; }
            var group = (Map<?,?>) value;
            out.printf("  %4s  %s (selected %s, recoverable by another engine %s)%n", group.get("cases"), Main.safe(String.valueOf(group.get("signature"))),
                group.get("selected"), group.get("recoverable_by_other_candidate"));
        }
        var chosen = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var value : groups) {
            var ids = (List<?>) ((Map<?,?>) value).get("case_ids");
            if (minimize.equals("first")) chosen.add(String.valueOf(ids.getFirst()));
            else if (minimize.equals("all")) ids.forEach(id -> chosen.add(String.valueOf(id)));
            else if (ids.contains(minimize)) chosen.add(minimize);
        }
        if (minimize.startsWith("failure-") && chosen.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("No captured case " + minimize);
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + budget.maxTime().toNanos();
        for (String id : chosen) {
            long left = deadline - System.nanoTime();
            if (left < 1_000_000_000L) { out.println("Time budget used up; remaining cases were not minimized."); break; }
            var result = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(failures.resolve(id), output.resolve("minimized").resolve(id), EngineRegistry.all(),
                new FailureMinimizer.Budget(budget.maxSteps(), Duration.ofNanos(left), budget.timeout()), keepRecoverable);
            report(out, id, result);
        }
        out.println("Behavior not verified. Promote a reduced authored or license-compatible case with lab-promote.");
        return 0;
    }

    private static int minimize(String[] args, PrintStream out) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var options = options(args, Set.of("--output", "--max-steps", "--max-seconds", "--timeout-seconds", "--keep-recoverable"));
        Path output = Path.of(required(options, "--output"));
        out.println("Minimizing: each reduction must pass the JVM verifier (nothing is executed) and reproduce twice.");
        var result = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(Path.of(args[1]), output, EngineRegistry.all(), budget(options), keepRecoverable(options));
        report(out, Path.of(args[1]).toAbsolutePath().normalize().getFileName().toString(), result);
        return result.directory() == null ? 1 : 0;
    }

    private static int promote(String[] args, PrintStream out) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var options = options(args, Set.of("--output", "--engines", "--timeout-seconds", "--provenance"));
        Path output = Path.of(required(options, "--output"));
        String provenance = options.getOrDefault("--provenance", "unspecified: commit only cases derived from authored or license-compatible inputs");
        var expected = new RegressionSuite().promote(Path.of(args[1]), output, EngineRegistry.parse(options.getOrDefault("--engines", "all")),
            seconds(options, "--timeout-seconds", 120, 3600), provenance);
        out.println("Regression case: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString()));
        var variants = (Map<?,?>) expected.get("variants");
        variants.forEach((variant, data) -> out.printf("  %s: %s%n", variant, Main.safe(String.valueOf(((Map<?,?>) data).get("minimum_levels")))));
        if (!((List<?>) expected.get("unstable_at_promotion")).isEmpty())
            out.println("Unstable between the two measurements (the lower level was kept): " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(expected.get("unstable_at_promotion"))));
        return 0;
    }

    private static int check(String[] args, PrintStream out) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var options = options(args, Set.of("--output", "--timeout-seconds"));
        Path output = Path.of(required(options, "--output"));
        var report = new RegressionSuite().check(Path.of(args[1]), output, EngineRegistry.all(), seconds(options, "--timeout-seconds", 120, 3600));
        out.printf("%s: %d case(s), %d method check(s), %d regressed, %d improved, %d error(s).%n", report.passed() ? "PASSED" : "FAILED",
            report.cases(), report.checks().size(), report.regressions().size(), report.improvements().size(), report.errors().size());
        for (var check : report.regressions())
            out.printf("  REGRESSED %s %s %s: expected at least %s, got %s%n", Main.safe(check.caseName()), check.variant(),
                Main.safe(check.method()), check.expected(), check.actual());
        for (var check : report.improvements())
            out.printf("  IMPROVED %s %s %s: %s -> %s (raise expected.json)%n", Main.safe(check.caseName()), check.variant(),
                Main.safe(check.method()), check.expected(), check.actual());
        report.errors().forEach(error -> out.println("  ERROR " + Main.safe(error)));
        out.println("Report: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize().resolve("regressions.md").toString()));
        return report.passed() ? 0 : 1;
    }

    private static void report(PrintStream out, String id, FailureMinimizer.Result result) {
        out.printf("%s %s: %s after %d evaluation(s), %d accepted", id, Main.safe(result.signature()), result.status(),
            result.evaluations(), result.accepted());
        if (result.original() != null && result.minimized() != null)
            out.printf("; %d -> %d bytes, %d -> %d members, %d -> %d instructions", result.original().bytes(), result.minimized().bytes(),
                result.original().members(), result.minimized().members(), result.original().instructions(), result.minimized().instructions());
        out.println();
        if (result.directory() != null) out.println("  Reduced case: " + Main.safe(result.directory().toString()));
    }

    private static Map<String,String> options(String[] args, Set<String> allowed) {
        if (args.length < 4 || args.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and option/value pairs");
        var options = new HashMap<String,String>();
        for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i += 2) {
            if (!allowed.contains(args[i])) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + args[i]);
            if (options.putIfAbsent(args[i], args[i + 1]) != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Repeated option: " + args[i]);
        }
        return options;
    }

    private static String required(Map<String,String> options, String name) {
        if (!options.containsKey(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing " + name + " <new-directory>");
        return options.get(name);
    }

    private static Duration seconds(Map<String,String> options, String name, int fallback, int max) {
        int value = Integer.parseInt(options.getOrDefault(name, Integer.toString(fallback)));
        if (value < 1 || value > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException(name + " must be 1.." + max);
        return Duration.ofSeconds(value);
    }

    private static boolean keepRecoverable(Map<String,String> options) {
        String value = options.getOrDefault("--keep-recoverable", "true");
        if (!value.equals("true") && !value.equals("false")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--keep-recoverable must be true or false");
        return value.equals("true");
    }

    private static FailureMinimizer.Budget budget(Map<String,String> options) {
        int steps = Integer.parseInt(options.getOrDefault("--max-steps", "80"));
        if (steps < 1 || steps > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--max-steps must be 1..10000");
        return new FailureMinimizer.Budget(steps, seconds(options, "--max-seconds", 1800, 86_400), seconds(options, "--timeout-seconds", 60, 3600));
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/Main.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.EngineRegistry;
import java.io.PrintStream;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.Map;
import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.intake.MultiRelease;
import dev.classrevive.model.Limits;

public final class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        // Phase G3: the desktop application keeps running on its own threads; only a refusal ends the process here.
        if (args.length > 0 && args[0].equals("gui") && !(args.length == 2 && help(args[1]))) {
            int refused = GuiCommand.start(args, System.err);
            if (refused != 0) System.exit(refused);
            return;
        }
        System.exit(run(args, System.out, System.err));
    }
    public static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        // Phase 2CV: overview, version and per-command help.
        if (args.length == 0 || (args.length == 1 && (help(args[0]) || args[0].equals("help")))) { Help.overview(out); return 0; }
        if (args.length == 1 && (args[0].equals("--version") || args[0].equals("-V") || args[0].equals("version"))) {
            out.println("ClassRevive " + Help.VERSION);
            return 0;
        }
        if (args[0].equals("help")) return args.length == 2 ? Help.command(args[1], out, err) : 2;
        if (args.length >= 2 && help(args[1])) return Help.command(args[0], out, err);
        if (!Help.COMMANDS.containsKey(args[0])) return Help.unknown(args[0], err);
        args = shortOptions(args);
        if (args[0].equals("gui")) return GuiCommand.start(args, err);
        if (args[0].equals("decompile")) return DecompileCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args[0].equals("diagnose")) return DiagnoseCommand.run(args,out,err);
        if (args[0].equals("identify")) return IdentifyCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args.length==1 && args[0].equals("sandbox-check")) {
            try {
                var result=new dev.classrevive.sandbox.SandboxProbe().check("docker",java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(5));
                out.println(result.status()+": "+result.detail());
                return result.available()?0:1;
            } catch(InterruptedException interrupted) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Sandbox check interrupted."); return 130;
            }
        }
        if (args[0].equals("compare-reference")) return CompareReferenceCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args[0].equals("transform")) return TransformCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args[0].equals("rename")) return RenameCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args[0].equals("benchmark")) return BenchmarkCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (java.util.Set.of("lab", "lab-minimize", "lab-promote", "lab-check").contains(args[0])) return LabCommand.run(args, out, err);
        if (args.length == 1 && args[0].equals("engines")) {
            for (var engine : EngineRegistry.all()) out.printf("%s %s%n", engine.id(), engine.version());
            return 0;
        }
        if (args.length != 2 || !args[0].equals("inspect")) {
            // A known command with the wrong arguments: its own usage line (inspect, engines and sandbox-check end here).
            err.println(Help.text(args[0], Help.COMMANDS.get(args[0])).lines().findFirst().orElse(""));
            err.println("Run 'classrevive help " + args[0] + "' for details.");
            return 2;
        }
        try {
            if (IdentifyCommand.needsIdentification(Path.of(args[1])) && Files.isRegularFile(Path.of(args[1]), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                // Phase 2CE: inspect inventories .class and .jar files; anything else is identified instead (exit 1: no inventory).
                try {
                    var identification = dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.identify(Path.of(args[1]));
                    IdentifyCommand.print(identification, out);
                    err.println("No class inventory: inspect reads .class and .jar files" + (identification.javaAvailable()
                        ? "; decompile and diagnose take the Java found in this file." : "."));
                } catch (java.io.IOException error) {
                    err.println("Identification failed: " + safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage())));
                }
                return 1;
            }
            var result = new InventoryReader().inspect(Path.of(args[1]), Limits.defaults());
            out.println("Input: " + safe(result.input()));
            if (!result.sha256().isEmpty()) out.println("SHA-256: " + result.sha256());
            out.printf("Bytes: %d input, %d expanded%n", result.inputBytes(), result.expandedBytes());
            long classes = result.entries().stream().filter(e -> e.classInfo() != null).count();
            out.printf("Entries: %d; parsed classes: %d; diagnostics: %d%n", result.entries().size(), classes, result.diagnostics().size());
            var variants = new java.util.HashMap<String, MultiRelease.Variant>();
            MultiRelease.variants(result).forEach(variant -> variants.put(variant.entry(), variant));
            for (var entry : result.entries()) {
                var info = entry.classInfo();
                if (info == null) {
                    out.printf("ENTRY %s (%d bytes)%n", safe(entry.name()), entry.size());
                } else {
                    var variant = variants.get(entry.name());
                    out.printf("CLASS %s | %s | Java %d (%d.%d) | fields=%d methods=%d%s%n",
                        safe(entry.name()), safe(info.name()), info.javaVersion(), info.majorVersion(),
                        info.minorVersion(), info.fields().size(), info.methods().size(),
                        variant == null ? "" : " | multi-release variant for Java " + variant.release() + "+ (decompile uses the base version)");
                }
            }
            for (var diagnostic : result.diagnostics()) {
                err.printf("%s [%s]: %s%n", diagnostic.code(), safe(diagnostic.entry()), safe(diagnostic.message()));
            }
            for (var notice : result.notices()) {
                out.printf("NOTICE %s [%s]: %s%n", notice.code(), safe(notice.entry()), safe(notice.message()));
            }
            out.println("Static inventory only; successful parsing does not establish JVM validity or safety.");
            return result.successful() ? 0 : 1;
        } catch (InvalidPathException error) {
            err.println("Invalid input path.");
            return 2;
        }
    }

    private static boolean help(String arg) { return arg.equals("--help") || arg.equals("-h"); }

    /** Phase 2CV: -o, -e, -t and -cp stand for --output, --engines, --timeout-seconds and --classpath after the command. */
    static String[] shortOptions(String[] args) {
        var aliases = Map.of("-o", "--output", "-e", "--engines", "-t", "--timeout-seconds", "-cp", "--classpath");
        var expanded = args.clone();
        for (int i = 1; i < expanded.length; i++) expanded[i] = aliases.getOrDefault(expanded[i], expanded[i]);
        return expanded;
    }

    static String safe(String value) {
        var result = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < value.length(); i++) {
            char c = value.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isISOControl(c) || Character.getType(c) == Character.FORMAT)
                result.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
            else result.append(c);
        }
        return result.toString();
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/NativeOptions.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.NativeAnalysis;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.NativeTriage;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CC: the optional native triage options of {@code decompile} and {@code diagnose}. {@code --native} is a flag; any
 * other native option turns it on too. They are removed from the arguments before the command's own option pairs are read.
 */
record NativeOptions(boolean enabled, NativeAnalysis.Options options) {
    static final Set<String> VALUED = Set.of("--ghidra-home", "--native-max-mib", "--native-max-libraries", "--native-timeout-seconds");
    static final String USAGE = "[--native] [--ghidra-home <dir>] [--native-max-mib <1..512>] [--native-max-libraries <1..32>] [--native-timeout-seconds <30..7200>]";

    /** Returns the arguments without the native options; {@code parsed[0]} receives the options. */
    static String[] strip(String[] args, NativeOptions[] parsed) {
        var kept = new ArrayList<String>();
        var values = new HashMap<String,String>();
        boolean enabled = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
            if (i >= 2 && args[i].equals("--native")) { enabled = true; continue; }
            if (i >= 2 && VALUED.contains(args[i])) {
                if (i + 1 >= args.length) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing value for " + args[i]);
                if (values.putIfAbsent(args[i], args[++i]) != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Repeated option: " + args[i - 1]);
                enabled = true;
                continue;
            }
            kept.add(args[i]);
        }
        var options = NativeAnalysis.Options.defaults(values.get("--ghidra-home"), System.getenv());
        long mib = integer(values, "--native-max-mib", 64, 1, 512);
        int libraries = (int) integer(values, "--native-max-libraries", 4, 1, 32);
        long seconds = integer(values, "--native-timeout-seconds", 900, 30, 7200);
        parsed[0] = new NativeOptions(enabled, options.withLimits(mib * 1024 * 1024, libraries, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds)));
        return kept.toArray(String[]::new);
    }

    private static long integer(Map<String,String> values, String key, long fallback, long min, long max) {
        if (!values.containsKey(key)) return fallback;
        long value;
        try { value = Long.parseLong(values.get(key)); }
        catch (NumberFormatException bad) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(key + " must be an integer"); }
        if (value < min || value > max) throw new IllegalArgumentException(key + " must be " + min + ".." + max);
        return value;
    }

    /** Runs the triage on {@code output/input.jar} into {@code output/native} and attaches it to the given evidence pair. */
    void run(Path output, Path text, Path json, PrintStream out) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (!enabled) return;
        if (!NativeTriage.applicable(output)) { out.println("Native analysis: not applicable (input is not a jar)"); return; }
        out.println("Native analysis: extracting bundled libraries as data; Ghidra, when configured, runs in its own process (static only).");
        var result = NativeTriage.run(output, text, json, options);
        for (String line : result.text().split("\n")) out.println(Main.safe(line));
        out.println("Native evidence: " + Main.safe(output.resolve("native").toAbsolutePath().toString()));
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/Outputs.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Phase 2CV: default result folders, so a command can run without --output. They are new folders: nothing is overwritten. */
final class Outputs {
    private Outputs() {}

    /** {@code <folder>/<input name without .jar/.class>-<suffix>}, with -2, -3... when taken; not created here. */
    static Path next(Path folder, Path input, String suffix) {
        String name = input.getFileName() == null ? "input" : input.getFileName().toString().replaceAll("(?i)\\.(jar|class)$", "");
        if (name.isBlank()) name = "input";
        Path candidate = folder.resolve(name + "-" + suffix);
        for (int n = 2; Files.exists(candidate, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS); n++) candidate = folder.resolve(name + "-" + suffix + "-" + n);
        return candidate;
    }

    /** {@code args} (command, input, options...) with {@code --output} set to a new folder in the current folder. */
    static String[] withDefault(String[] args, String suffix) {
        var list = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(args));
        list.add("--output");
        list.add(next(Path.of("").toAbsolutePath(), Path.of(args[1]), suffix).toString());
        return list.toArray(String[]::new);
    }
}
```
