`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/RenameCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.RenameJob;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.HashSet;

final class RenameCommand {
    private RenameCommand() {}
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            if (args.length < 4 || args.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and --output <new-directory>.");
            Path input = Path.of(args[1]), output = null, mapping = null, proguard = null;
            int seconds = 60;
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i += 2) {
                if (!seen.add(args[i])) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate option: " + args[i]);
                switch (args[i]) {
                    case "--output" -> output = Path.of(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--mapping" -> mapping = Path.of(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--proguard-mapping" -> proguard = Path.of(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--timeout-seconds" -> seconds = Integer.parseInt(args[i + 1]);
                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + args[i]);
                }
            }
            if (mapping != null && proguard != null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Use either --mapping or --proguard-mapping, not both.");
            if (output == null || seconds < 1 || seconds > 3600)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require --output and timeout-seconds 1..3600.");
            out.println(proguard != null
                ? "Restoring names from a ProGuard/R8 mapping (same-package classes and private members only) in a separate worker JVM. Original retained; target code is not executed."
                : mapping == null
                ? "Renaming classes with generated readable aliases in a separate worker JVM. Original retained; target code is not executed."
                : "Renaming classes and private members with explicit mappings in a separate worker JVM. Original retained; target code is not executed.");
            var result = proguard != null
                ? new RenameJob().run(input, output, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds), proguard, true)
                : mapping == null
                ? new RenameJob().run(input, output, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds))
                : new RenameJob().run(input, output, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds), mapping);
            if (proguard != null) out.println("Skipped ProGuard rules and their reasons are listed in rename.json under \"proguard\".");
            out.printf("Worker: %s; classes: %d; renamed: %d; members: %d; reflected literals: %d%n", result.worker().status(), result.classes(), result.renamed(), result.members(), result.reflectionRewrites());
            out.println("Evidence: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().resolve("rename.json").toString()));
            out.println("Aliases and explicit mappings are not recovered originals; standard manifest attributes, services, literal reflection calls and private members are rewritten. Variables, serialization, other resources and external callers are not. Behavior not verified.");
            return result.successful() ? 0 : 1;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid command arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2;
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten."); return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Renaming failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1;
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Renaming interrupted."); return 130;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/cli/TransformCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.TransformJob;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.HashSet;

final class TransformCommand {
    private TransformCommand() {}
    static int run(String[] args, PrintStream out, PrintStream err) {
        try {
            if (args.length < 4 || args.length % 2 != 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected input and --output <new-directory>.");
            Path input = Path.of(args[1]), output = null;
            int budget = 1000, seconds = 60;
            String passes = "integer-constants";
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            for (int i = 2; i < args.length; i += 2) {
                if (!seen.add(args[i])) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate option: " + args[i]);
                switch (args[i]) {
                    case "--output" -> output = Path.of(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--max-changes" -> budget = Integer.parseInt(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--timeout-seconds" -> seconds = Integer.parseInt(args[i + 1]);
                    case "--passes" -> passes = args[i + 1];
                    default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + args[i]);
                }
            }
            if (output == null || budget < 1 || budget > 10000 || seconds < 1 || seconds > 3600)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require --output, max-changes 1..10000 and timeout-seconds 1..3600.");
            out.println("Applying selected static bytecode passes in a separate worker JVM. Original retained; target code is not executed.");
            var result = new TransformJob().run(input, output, budget, Duration.ofSeconds(seconds), passes);
            out.printf("Worker: %s; changes: %d; change limit reached: %s%n", result.worker().status(), result.changes(), result.limitReached());
            if (result.link() != null)
                out.println("JVM verifier (classes linked, none initialized): " + (result.link().linked() ? "all " + result.link().classes() + " classes link"
                    : "FAILED at " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(result.link().failedClass())) + " (" + Main.safe(String.valueOf(result.link().errorType())) + ")"));
            out.println("Evidence: " + Main.safe(output.toAbsolutePath().resolve("transform.json").toString()));
            out.println("Behavior not verified. This is a static simplification pass, not general deobfuscation.");
            return result.successful() ? 0 : 1;
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
            err.println("Invalid command arguments: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 2;
        } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException error) {
            err.println("Output already exists. Choose a new directory; existing results were not overwritten."); return 1;
        } catch (IOException error) {
            err.println("Transformation failed: " + Main.safe(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()))); return 1;
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); err.println("Transformation interrupted."); return 130;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/cli/CliUsabilityTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2CV: help, version, short options, default output folders, several inputs, clear errors. */
class CliUsabilityTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    ByteArrayOutputStream errors = new ByteArrayOutputStream();

    int run(String... args) {
        output.reset(); errors.reset();
        return Main.run(args, new PrintStream(output), new PrintStream(errors));
    }

    @Test void overviewListsEveryCommandGroupedWithExitCodes() {
        assertEquals(0, run());
        String text = output.toString();
        for (String command : Help.COMMANDS.keySet()) assertTrue(text.contains(command), command);
        assertTrue(text.contains("Main commands:") && text.contains("Tools:") && text.contains("Failure lab:"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("Exit codes: 0"));
        assertEquals(0, run("--help"));
        assertEquals(0, run("-h"));
        assertEquals(0, run("help"));
    }

    @Test void printsTheVersion() {
        for (String flag : List.of("--version", "-V", "version")) {
            assertEquals(0, run(flag));
            assertEquals("ClassRevive " + Help.VERSION, output.toString().strip());
        }
    }

    @Test void everyCommandHasHelpThroughBothForms() {
        for (String command : Help.COMMANDS.keySet()) {
            assertEquals(0, run("help", command), command);
            String viaHelp = output.toString();
            assertTrue(viaHelp.contains("Usage: classrevive " + command), viaHelp);
            assertFalse(viaHelp.contains("%s"), "unformatted placeholder in " + command);
            assertEquals(0, run(command, "--help"), command);
            assertEquals(viaHelp, output.toString());
        }
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", "-h"));
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("-o, --output") && output.toString().contains("Examples:"));
        assertEquals(2, run("help", "decomplie"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("Did you mean 'decompile'?"), errors.toString());
    }

    @Test void unknownCommandsAndWrongArgumentsSayWhatToDo() {
        assertEquals(2, run("decomple", "app.jar"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("Unknown command: decomple. Did you mean 'decompile'?"), errors.toString());
        assertEquals(2, run("frobnicate"));
        assertFalse(errors.toString().contains("Did you mean"), errors.toString());
        assertEquals(2, run("inspect"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("Usage: classrevive inspect") && errors.toString().contains("classrevive help inspect"));
        assertEquals(2, run("engines", "extra"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("Usage: classrevive engines"));
        assertEquals(2, run("decompile"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("expected an input file"));
    }

    @Test void shortOptionsMeanTheLongOnes() throws Exception {
        Path input = compile("Single", "public class Single { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; } }");
        Path out = directory.resolve("short");
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", input.toString(), "-o", out.toString(), "-e", "cfr", "-t", "60"), errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve("report.json")));
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("cfr 0.152"));
        assertFalse(output.toString().contains("vineflower"), "-e cfr picked one engine");
        assertArrayEquals(new String[] {"decompile", "a.jar", "--output", "x", "--engines", "all", "--timeout-seconds", "5", "--classpath", "l.jar"},
            Main.shortOptions(new String[] {"decompile", "a.jar", "-o", "x", "-e", "all", "-t", "5", "-cp", "l.jar"}));
    }

    @Test void defaultOutputFoldersAreNewAndNamedAfterTheInput() throws Exception {
        Path first = Outputs.next(directory, Path.of("libs/My-App.JAR"), "classrevive");
        assertEquals(directory.resolve("My-App-classrevive"), first);
        Files.createDirectories(first);
        assertEquals(directory.resolve("My-App-classrevive-2"), Outputs.next(directory, Path.of("My-App.jar"), "classrevive"));
        assertEquals(directory.resolve("tool.exe-diagnosis"), Outputs.next(directory, Path.of("tool.exe"), "diagnosis"));
        var withDefault = Outputs.withDefault(new String[] {"diagnose", "x/app.jar", "--timeout-seconds", "5"}, "diagnosis");
        assertEquals(List.of("diagnose", "x/app.jar", "--timeout-seconds", "5", "--output"), Arrays.asList(withDefault).subList(0, 5));
        assertEquals(Path.of("").toAbsolutePath().resolve("app-diagnosis").getFileName(), Path.of(withDefault[5]).getFileName());
    }

    @Test void decompilesEveryFileOfAFolderIntoItsOwnNewFolder() throws Exception {
        Path folder = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("inputs"));
        Files.copy(compile("Alpha", "public class Alpha { public int one() { return 1; } }"), folder.resolve("Alpha.class"));
        Files.copy(compile("Beta", "public class Beta { public String two() { return \"two\"; } }"), folder.resolve("Beta.class"));
        Files.writeString(folder.resolve("notes.txt"), "not an input");
        Path out = directory.resolve("results");
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", folder.toString(), "-o", out.toString(), "-e", "cfr"), errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve("Alpha-classrevive/report.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve("Beta-classrevive/report.json")));
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("== [1/2]") && output.toString().contains("== [2/2]"));
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Decompiled 2 inputs") && output.toString().contains("2 compiled with every signature, 0 partial or failed"));
        // A second run reuses the output folder and never touches the first results.
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", folder.resolve("Alpha.class").toString(), folder.resolve("Beta.class").toString(), "-o", out.toString(), "-e", "cfr"));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve("Alpha-classrevive-2/report.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(out.resolve("Beta-classrevive-2/report.json")));

        Path empty = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("empty"));
        assertEquals(2, run("decompile", empty.toString(), "-o", out.toString()));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("no .jar or .class file"));
        assertEquals(2, run("decompile", folder.toString(), "-o", out.toString(), "-e", "nope"), "invalid options stop the whole run");
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("Alpha-classrevive-3")));
    }

    private Path compile(String name, String source) throws Exception {
        Path sources = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src-" + name));
        Path file = sources.resolve(name + ".java");
        Files.writeString(file, source);
        Path classes = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("classes-" + name));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString(), file.toString()));
        return classes.resolve(name + ".class");
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

    }
    @Test void diagnosesDynamicReferencesThroughBoundedWorker() throws Exception {

        assertEquals(2,run("diagnose",input.toString(),"--engines","all"));
    }
    @Test void diagnosesClassLoadingAndCryptoReferencesWithoutClaimingPackingOrMalware() throws Exception {
        Path source=directory.resolve("ApiSignalFixture.java");
        Files.writeString(source,"import javax.crypto.Cipher;"
            + "class ApiSignalLoader extends ClassLoader { Class<?> define(byte[] b){return defineClass(b,0,b.length);} }"
            + "public class ApiSignalFixture { static byte[] decrypt(byte[] b) throws Exception {"
            + "Cipher c=Cipher.getInstance(\"AES\"); return c.doFinal(b); }"
            + "static Class<?> load(byte[] b){return new ApiSignalLoader().define(b);} }");
        assertEquals(0,javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-Xlint:-options","-proc:none",
            "-d",directory.toString(),source.toString()));
        Path input=directory.resolve("api-signals.jar");
        try(var archive=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            for(String name:List.of("ApiSignalFixture.class","ApiSignalLoader.class")) {
                archive.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name)); archive.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(name))); archive.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        Path outputPath=directory.resolve("api-signals");
        assertEquals(0,run("diagnose",input.toString(),"--output",outputPath.toString()),errors.toString());
        String report=Files.readString(outputPath.resolve("diagnostics.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("CLASS_LOADING_API"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("CRYPTO_API"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"signal_counts\""),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"CLASS_LOADING_API\":1"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"CRYPTO_API\":2"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("do not prove runtime reachability, packing, encryption or malicious behavior"),report);
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Static API references are clues only"));
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("class-loading=1; crypto=2"));
        // Phase 2BZ: crypto API references alone are not string encryption; javac output is not obfuscated.
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"obfuscation\":{"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"verdict\":\"NONE\""),report);
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Suggested obfuscator: none"),output.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(outputPath.resolve("obfuscation.txt")).contains("not proof"));
    }
    /** Phase 2CC: --native extracts bundled libraries as data; without Ghidra the command still works and says it skipped. */
    @Test void diagnoseWithNativeTriageWorksWithoutGhidra() throws Exception {
        Path input=directory.resolve("with-native.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input)); var stream=MainTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/dev/classrevive/cli/MainTest.class")) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("dev/classrevive/cli/MainTest.class")); stream.transferTo(zip); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("natives/win-x64/junk.dll")); zip.write("MZ not really a library".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        Path result=directory.resolve("with-native");

        assertTrue(console.contains("natives/win-x64/junk.dll: NOT_NATIVE"),console);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(result.resolve("obfuscation.txt")).contains("\nNative analysis: "));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(result.resolve("diagnostics.json")).contains("\"native_analysis\":{"));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(result.resolve("native/summary.txt")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(result.resolve("native/report.json")).contains("\"status\":\"NOT_NATIVE\""));
        // Without --native nothing changes; invalid native options are argument errors.

        assertFalse(Files.exists(plain.resolve("native")));
        assertFalse(Files.readString(plain.resolve("diagnostics.json")).contains("native_analysis"));
        assertEquals(2,run("diagnose",input.toString(),"--output",directory.resolve("bad1").toString(),"--native-max-mib","0"));
        assertEquals(2,run("diagnose",input.toString(),"--output",directory.resolve("bad2").toString(),"--ghidra-home",directory.resolve("nowhere").toString()));

    @Test void identifiesExecutablesAndDecompilesTheJarInside() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("Hello.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Hello { public int value() { return 42; } }");
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-proc:none", source.toString()));

        errors.reset();

        output.reset(); errors.reset();

        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", app.toString(), "--output", result.toString(), "--engines", "cfr"), errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Input origin: PE32+ x86-64 console executable (Windows) (EMBEDDED_JAR); jar extracted from offset 1024"),
            output.toString());

        assertTrue(Files.readString(result.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"input_origin\":{"));

        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("No Java to process: Input is PE32+ x86-64 console executable (Windows) (NATIVE_PROTECTED_NO_JAVA)"),
            errors.toString());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(refused));
        assertEquals(1, run("diagnose", loader.toString(), "--output", refused.toString()));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(refused));
    }

    @Test void decompilesABundleOfJarsInsideAnExecutableWithItsOtherJarsOnTheClasspath() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2DB: app.jar calls lib.Util from libs/util.jar; with stubs off, verification needs the bundle's other jar.
        Path sources = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src"));
        Files.createDirectories(sources.resolve("app")); Files.createDirectories(sources.resolve("lib"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("lib/Util.java"), "package lib; public class Util { public static int value() { return 7; } }");
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("app/Main.java"), "package app; public class Main { public int run() { return lib.Util.value() + 1; } }");
        Path classes = directory.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString(),
            sources.resolve("lib/Util.java").toString(), sources.resolve("app/Main.java").toString()));
        var payload = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(payload)) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("app.jar")); zip.write(jarOf(classes, "app/Main.class")); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("libs/util.jar")); zip.write(jarOf(classes, "lib/Util.class")); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("helper.dll")); zip.write(new byte[] {'M', 'Z'}); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        Path exe = Files.write(directory.resolve("Bundle.exe"), minimalPe(".rdata2", payload.toByteArray()));

        assertEquals(0, run("identify", exe.toString(), "--output", directory.resolve("identified").toString()), errors.toString());
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Verdict: JAVA_BUNDLE"), output.toString());
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("Nested jars written (data, not run): 2"), output.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(directory.resolve("identified/bundle/libs_util.jar")));

        output.reset(); errors.reset();
        Path result = directory.resolve("bundle-result");
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", exe.toString(), "--output", result.toString(), "--engines", "cfr", "--stubs", "false"), errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("(JAVA_BUNDLE); nested jar app.jar taken from the bundle at offset 1024"), output.toString());
        assertTrue(output.toString().contains("1 other nested jar(s) on the classpath"), output.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.exists(result.resolve("selection/sources/app/Main.java")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(result.resolve("project/lib/util.jar")));
        String origin = Files.readString(result.resolve("input-origin/identification.txt"));
        assertTrue(origin.contains("Extracted: nested jar app.jar of the bundle at 0x400") && origin.contains("Classpath for verification: libs/util.jar"), origin);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(result.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"entry\":\"app.jar\""));

        output.reset(); errors.reset();
        Path chosen = directory.resolve("bundle-util");
        assertEquals(0, run("decompile", exe.toString(), "--output", chosen.toString(), "--engines", "cfr", "--entry", "util.jar"), errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(Files.exists(chosen.resolve("selection/sources/lib/Util.java")));
        assertEquals(0, run("diagnose", exe.toString(), "--output", directory.resolve("bundle-diagnosis").toString(), "--entry", "libs/util.jar"),
            errors + "\n" + output);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(directory.resolve("bundle-diagnosis/input-origin/identification.txt")).contains("nested jar libs/util.jar"));
        errors.reset();
        assertEquals(2, run("decompile", exe.toString(), "--output", directory.resolve("bad").toString(), "--engines", "cfr", "--entry", "nope.jar"));
        assertTrue(errors.toString().contains("No nested jar named nope.jar"), errors.toString());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(directory.resolve("bad")));
    }

    private static byte[] jarOf(Path classes, String entry) throws IOException {
        var jar = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(jar)) { zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(entry))); zip.closeEntry(); }
        return jar.toByteArray();
    }

    /** A PE32+ x64 console image with one .text section and an optional executable section filled with {@code data}. */
    private static byte[] minimalPe(String extraName, byte[] data) {
        int extra = data == null ? 0 : (data.length + 0x1ff) / 0x200 * 0x200;
        var b = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(0x400 + extra).order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(0, (byte) 'M').put(1, (byte) 'Z').putInt(0x3c, 0x40).put(0x40, (byte) 'P').put(0x41, (byte) 'E');
        b.putShort(0x44, (short) 0x8664).putShort(0x46, (short) (data == null ? 1 : 2)).putShort(0x54, (short) 240).putShort(0x56, (short) 0x22);
        b.putShort(0x58, (short) 0x20b).putInt(0x58 + 16, 0x1000).putShort(0x58 + 68, (short) 3).putInt(0x58 + 108, 16);
        int table = 0x58 + 240;
        b.put(table, ".text".getBytes()).putInt(table + 8, 0x10).putInt(table + 12, 0x1000).putInt(table + 16, 0x200)
            .putInt(table + 20, 0x200).putInt(table + 36, 0x60000020);
        b.put(0x200, (byte) 0xc3);
        if (data != null) {
            b.put(table + 40, extraName.getBytes()).putInt(table + 48, data.length).putInt(table + 52, 0x2000).putInt(table + 56, extra)
                .putInt(table + 60, 0x400).putInt(table + 76, 0xe0000060);
            b.put(0x400, data);
        }
        return b.array();
    }
}
```

`modules/cli/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/cli/ProguardFixtureTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.cli;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.io.*;
import java.lang.reflect.Member;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * Runs the CLI over jars produced by a real ProGuard 7.10.0 run (benchmarks/obfuscated/proguard8, regenerated by
 * {@code gradlew regenerateObfuscatedFixtures}). Renamed classes are only defined and linked, never initialized or run.
 */
class ProguardFixtureTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of(System.getProperty("classrevive.obfuscatedFixtures", "missing"));
    @TempDir Path directory;
    ByteArrayOutputStream output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    ByteArrayOutputStream errors = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    int run(String... args) { return Main.run(args, new PrintStream(output), new PrintStream(errors)); }

    static Map<String,byte[]> classes(Path jar) throws IOException {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            for (var entries = zip.entries(); entries.hasMoreElements(); ) {
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                if (entry.getName().endsWith(".class"))
                    result.put(entry.getName().substring(0, entry.getName().length() - 6).replace('/', '.'), zip.getInputStream(entry).readAllBytes());
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** Defines every class of the jar in an isolated loader and links it, which runs the JVM verifier; nothing is initialized. */
    static Map<String,Class<?>> link(Map<String,byte[]> bytes) throws Exception {
        var loader = new ClassLoader(null) {
            @Override protected Class<?> findClass(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException {
                byte[] value = bytes.get(name); if (value == null) throw new ClassNotFoundException(name);
                return defineClass(name, value, 0, value.length);
            }
        };
        var result = new TreeMap<String,Class<?>>();
        for (String name : bytes.keySet()) {
            var type = Class.forName(name, false, loader);
            type.getDeclaredMethods(); type.getDeclaredFields(); type.getDeclaredConstructors();
            result.put(name, type);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static Set<String> names(Member[] members) {
        var result = new TreeSet<String>(); for (var member : members) result.add(member.getName()); return result;
    }

    static String sha256(Path file) throws Exception {
        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(Files.readAllBytes(file)));
    }

    Path rename(String variant) throws Exception {
        Path jar = FIXTURES.resolve(variant + ".jar"), mapping = FIXTURES.resolve(variant + ".mapping.txt");
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(jar) && Files.isRegularFile(mapping), "fixture missing under " + FIXTURES);
        String before = sha256(jar);
        Path result = directory.resolve(variant + "-renamed");
        assertEquals(0, run("rename", jar.toString(), "--proguard-mapping", mapping.toString(), "--output", result.toString()), errors.toString());
        assertEquals(before, sha256(jar));
        return result;
    }

    @Test void obfuscatedInputUsesProguardNamesAndPassesVerification() throws Exception {
        for (String variant : List.of("obf8", "obf8-opt")) {
            var bytes = classes(FIXTURES.resolve(variant + ".jar"));
            assertEquals(Set.of("fixtures.obf.Main", "fixtures.obf.a", "fixtures.obf.b", "fixtures.obf.c"), bytes.keySet());
            assertDoesNotThrow(() -> link(bytes), variant);
        }
    }

    @Test void restoresSamePackageClassesAndPrivateMembersFromUnoptimizedProguardOutput() throws Exception {
        Path result = rename("obf8");
        String report = Files.readString(result.resolve("rename.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"mapping\":\"proguard\""), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"forward\":{\"fixtures/obf/a\":\"fixtures/obf/Ledger\",\"fixtures/obf/b\":\"fixtures/obf/Ledger$Entry\",\"fixtures/obf/c\":\"fixtures/obf/Vault\"}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"applicable_classes\":3,\"applicable_members\":9,\"inline_frames_ignored\":0"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"skipped\":{\"NOT_PRIVATE\":5,\"SERIALIZATION_MEMBER\":2}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("{\"reason\":\"SERIALIZATION_MEMBER\",\"rule\":\"field fixtures/obf/a#a -> serialVersionUID\"}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("{\"reason\":\"SERIALIZATION_MEMBER\",\"rule\":\"method fixtures/obf/a#a -> writeObject\"}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"members_renamed\":9"), report);

        var renamed = classes(result.resolve("renamed.jar"));
        assertEquals(Set.of("fixtures.obf.Main", "fixtures.obf.Ledger", "fixtures.obf.Ledger$Entry", "fixtures.obf.Vault"), renamed.keySet());
        var types = link(renamed);
        var ledger = types.get("fixtures.obf.Ledger");
        // serialVersionUID keeps its obfuscated name "a": a serialization member is never renamed.
        assertEquals(Set.of("a", "owner", "balance", "audits"), names(ledger.getDeclaredFields()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a", "clamp"), names(ledger.getDeclaredMethods()));
        var entry = types.get("fixtures.obf.Ledger$Entry");
        assertEquals(Set.of("amount"), names(entry.getDeclaredFields()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a", "doubled"), names(entry.getDeclaredMethods()));
        var vault = types.get("fixtures.obf.Vault");
        assertEquals(Set.of("reads"), names(vault.getDeclaredFields()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a", "b", "bump", "unmask"), names(vault.getDeclaredMethods()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("describe"), names(types.get("fixtures.obf.Main").getDeclaredMethods()));
    }

    @Test void optimizedProguardInlineFramesAreSkippedNotApplied() throws Exception {
        Path result = rename("obf8-opt");
        String report = Files.readString(result.resolve("rename.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"applicable_classes\":3,\"applicable_members\":6,\"inline_frames_ignored\":0"), report);
        // ProGuard writes inline frames without a class qualifier; clamp/bump frames match no method and are skipped.
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"skipped\":{\"MEMBER_NOT_FOUND\":3,\"NOT_PRIVATE\":10}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("{\"reason\":\"MEMBER_NOT_FOUND\",\"rule\":\"method fixtures/obf/a#a -> clamp\"}"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("{\"reason\":\"NOT_PRIVATE\",\"rule\":\"method fixtures/obf/b#a -> doubled\"}"), report);

        var types = link(classes(result.resolve("renamed.jar")));
        assertEquals(Set.of("owner", "balance", "audits"), names(types.get("fixtures.obf.Ledger").getDeclaredFields()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a"), names(types.get("fixtures.obf.Ledger").getDeclaredMethods()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a"), names(types.get("fixtures.obf.Ledger$Entry").getDeclaredMethods()));
        assertEquals(Set.of("a", "b", "unmask"), names(types.get("fixtures.obf.Vault").getDeclaredMethods()));
    }

    @Test void stringDecryptorFoldsMaskedLiteralsAfterNamesAreRestored() throws Exception {
        for (String variant : List.of("obf8", "obf8-opt")) {
            Path renamed = rename(variant).resolve("renamed.jar");
            Path result = directory.resolve(variant + "-transformed");
            assertEquals(0, run("transform", renamed.toString(), "--passes", "string-decryptor,integer-branches", "--output", result.toString()), errors.toString());
            String report = Files.readString(result.resolve("transform.json"));
            assertTrue(report.contains("\"status\":\"OUTPUT_VALIDATED\""), report);
            assertEquals(2, report.split("\"pass\":\"string-decryptor-v1\"", -1).length - 1, report);
            assertFalse(report.contains("\"pass\":\"integer-branches-v2\""), "javac already folds constant branches; ProGuard adds none");
            assertTrue(report.contains("\"class\":\"fixtures/obf/Vault\""), report);
            assertFalse(report.contains("ledger-ready"), "plaintext must not be logged");
            var transformed = classes(result.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar"));
            assertDoesNotThrow(() -> link(transformed), variant);
            String constants = new String(transformed.get("fixtures.obf.Vault"), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
            assertTrue(constants.contains("ledger-ready") && constants.contains("audit trail"), variant);
        }
    }
}
```

```kts
// Phase 2CW: dex2jar (Apache-2.0, the maintained ThexXTURBOXx fork) turns Dalvik bytecode into class files. It runs only in
// DexWorker, a separate JVM with the usual worker limits, and reads the dex statically; target code is never loaded.
// d2j-external bundles its own copy of ASM's core classes (plus AsmBridge, which reaches into them), so dex2jar never joins
// the application's class path, where that copy could shadow ASM 9.11.1: the worker gets these jars as its own class path,
// from a folder next to this module's jar in the distribution (lib/dex2jar) or from a system property in tests.
val dexTools: Configuration by configurations.creating {
    isCanBeConsumed = true
    isCanBeResolved = true
    // The core classes come from d2j-external, where AsmBridge expects them.
    exclude(group = "org.ow2.asm", module = "asm")
}

    dexTools("de.femtopedia.dex2jar:dex-translator:2.4.38")

    testImplementation("org.ow2.asm:asm:9.11.1")

    testImplementation("org.ow2.asm:asm-analysis:9.11.1")
```

`modules/dex/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/dex/DexConversion.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.dex;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Stream;

/**
 * Phase 2CW: Dalvik bytecode (an APK's {@code classes*.dex}, or a dex file) to a jar of class files, through dex2jar in
 * {@link DexWorker}, a separate JVM under the usual worker limits. The rest of the pipeline then treats that jar as its
 * input: engines decompile it and javac's round trip is measured against it, so "identical" means identical to the
 * conversion, which is as faithful as dex2jar is. Methods it could not translate and dropped duplicate classes are listed.
 */
public final class DexConversion {
    private DexConversion() {}

    public static final String TOOL = "dex2jar";
    public static final String VERSION = "2.4.38";
    /** The worker's own class path in tests and development: dex2jar's jars, joined with the path separator. */
    static final String CLASSPATH_PROPERTY = "classrevive.dex2jar.classpath";

    /** A method dex2jar could not translate: its class keeps it, with a body that throws. */
    public record FailedMethod(String className, String method, String error) {}
    /** A class defined again in a later dex: the first one is kept, as the runtime does. */
    public record Duplicate(String className, String keptFrom, String droppedFrom) {}
    /** One dex file of the input, in load order, and how many of its classes were kept. */
    public record DexFile(String name, long bytes, int classes) {}

    /**
     * {@code jar} is null when nothing was converted; {@code worker} says why. {@code dalvik}: the input's dex files alone,
     * in load order (Phase 2CX), or null. {@code movedParameters}: methods whose
     * reused parameter registers were moved to locals; {@code syntheticFields}: outer-instance and captured-variable fields
     * given ACC_SYNTHETIC back; {@code topLevelClasses}: anonymous or local classes created outside their method, now
     * top-level; {@code shownSyntheticMethods}: synthetic methods called from other classes, no longer synthetic
     * ({@link DexNormalizer}).
     */
    public record Result(Path jar, Path dalvik, List<DexFile> dexFiles, List<FailedMethod> failedMethods, List<Duplicate> duplicates,
                         List<String> errors, long failedMethodCount, long duplicateCount, int movedParameters, int syntheticFields,
                         int topLevelClasses, int shownSyntheticMethods, EngineResult worker) {
        public Result {
            dexFiles = List.copyOf(dexFiles); failedMethods = List.copyOf(failedMethods); duplicates = List.copyOf(duplicates);
            errors = List.copyOf(errors);
        }
        public int classes() { return dexFiles.stream().mapToInt(DexFile::classes).sum(); }
    }

    /** Converts {@code input} into {@code directory} (which must not exist): {@code directory/transformed/converted.jar}. */
    public static Result convert(Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        var worker = new ProcessRunner().runTransform(engine(), input, directory, timeout);
        Path out = directory.resolve("transformed");
        var dexFiles = new ArrayList<DexFile>();
        var failed = new ArrayList<FailedMethod>();
        var duplicates = new ArrayList<Duplicate>();
        var errors = new ArrayList<String>();
        long failedCount = 0, duplicateCount = 0;
        int movedParameters = 0, syntheticFields = 0, topLevelClasses = 0, shownSyntheticMethods = 0;
        Path log = out.resolve("conversion.tsv");
        if (Files.isRegularFile(log, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            if (Files.size(log) > 16L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Conversion log exceeds limit");
            for (String line : Files.readAllLines(log, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
                String[] field = line.split("\t", -1);
                switch (field[0]) {
                    case "dex" -> { if (field.length == 4) dexFiles.add(new DexFile(field[1], Long.parseLong(field[2]), Integer.parseInt(field[3]))); }
                    case "method-failed" -> { if (field.length == 4) { failed.add(new FailedMethod(field[1], field[2], field[3])); failedCount++; } }
                    case "duplicate" -> { if (field.length == 4) { duplicates.add(new Duplicate(field[1], field[2], field[3])); duplicateCount++; } }
                    case "error" -> { if (field.length == 3) errors.add(field[1] + ": " + field[2]); }
                    case "normalized" -> {
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("parameters")) movedParameters = Integer.parseInt(field[2]);
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("synthetic-fields")) syntheticFields = Integer.parseInt(field[2]);
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("top-level-classes")) topLevelClasses = Integer.parseInt(field[2]);
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("synthetic-methods-shown")) shownSyntheticMethods = Integer.parseInt(field[2]);
                    }
                    case "truncated" -> {
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("method-failed")) failedCount = Long.parseLong(field[2]);
                        if (field.length == 3 && field[1].equals("duplicate")) duplicateCount = Long.parseLong(field[2]);
                    }
                    default -> { }
                }
            }
        }
        Path jar = out.resolve("converted.jar");
        boolean produced = worker.status() == EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED && Files.isRegularFile(jar, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        Path dalvik = out.resolve("dalvik.zip");
        return new Result(produced ? jar : null, produced && Files.isRegularFile(dalvik, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) ? dalvik : null, dexFiles, failed, duplicates, errors, failedCount, duplicateCount, movedParameters,
            syntheticFields, topLevelClasses, shownSyntheticMethods, worker);
    }

    private static DecompilerEngine engine() {
        return new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return TOOL; }
            public String version() { return VERSION; }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
                var command = new ArrayList<String>();
                command.add(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString());
                command.addAll(List.of("-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2", "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
                    "-cp", classPath(), DexWorker.class.getName(), input.toString(), output.toString()));
                return EngineCommand.sizedHeap(input, command);
            }
        };
    }

    /**
     * This module's own classes plus dex2jar's jars: from {@value #CLASSPATH_PROPERTY}, or from the {@code dex2jar} folder
     * next to this module's jar (the distribution's {@code lib/dex2jar}).
     */
    static String classPath() {
        try {
            Path self = Path.of(DexConversion.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI());
            var paths = new ArrayList<String>();
            paths.add(self.toString());
            String configured = System.getProperty(CLASSPATH_PROPERTY);
            if (configured != null && !configured.isBlank()) {
                for (String path : configured.split(File.pathSeparator)) if (!path.isBlank()) paths.add(path);
            } else {
                Path folder = self.resolveSibling("dex2jar");
                if (!Files.isDirectory(folder)) throw new IllegalStateException("dex2jar is not installed next to " + self.getFileName() + " (expected " + folder + ")");
                try (Stream<Path> jars = Files.list(folder)) {
                    jars.filter(path -> path.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".jar")).sorted().forEach(path -> paths.add(path.toString()));
                }
            }
            return String.join(File.pathSeparator, paths);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot locate the dex2jar worker class path", error);
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/dex/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/dex/DexNormalizer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.dex;

import java.util.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CW: two traits of Dalvik bytecode that javac never produces, undone in the converted class files so Java
 * decompilers read them as they read javac's output. Runs in {@link DexWorker}; semantics are unchanged.
 * <ul>
 * <li><b>Registers reused for unrelated values.</b> dx and d8 put new values, often of another type, in a register whose
 * value is dead, parameters included ({@code object = new Note(...)} over a {@code String} parameter). dex2jar keeps one
 * local slot per register, so a decompiler sees one variable with two types and writes code that does not compile. Each
 * slot is split into its webs (the stores linked by the loads they reach, found with ASM's source analysis), and every web
 * but one moves to a slot of its own. A parameter keeps the web of its incoming value.</li>
 * <li><b>Fields lose ACC_SYNTHETIC</b> (synthetic methods keep it). javac's own synthetic fields are recognized by name
 * and type and get it back: {@code this$N} and {@code val$name} in inner, local and anonymous classes (otherwise decompilers
 * print them and the constructor that sets them), an enum's {@code $VALUES}, {@code $assertionsDisabled} and
 * {@code $SwitchMap$...} tables.</li>
 * <li><b>Anonymous and local classes created outside their method</b> (Phase 2DA). R8 inlines a method together with its
 * {@code new Outer$m$1(...)}, so the class is created in other methods, or other classes, than the one its
 * EnclosingMethod names. A decompiler can declare such a class in one place only and writes the others as
 * {@code new /* invalid duplicate definition of identical inner class * /} or {@code new 1(...)}. These classes lose their
 * anonymous/local marking (their own InnerClasses entry, EnclosingMethod, and the entries naming them elsewhere), so
 * decompilers write them as top-level classes named {@code Outer$m$1} and every creation as a plain {@code new}.</li>
 * <li><b>Synthetic methods called from other classes</b> (Phase 2DA). R8 turns a lambda into a class of its own
 * ({@code Outer$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0}) that calls a synthetic static method {@code Outer.$r8$lambda$...}. Decompilers
 * hide synthetic methods, so the call has nothing to call. A synthetic method called from a class outside its owner's nest
 * (a different outermost class) is no longer marked synthetic.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
final class DexNormalizer {
    private DexNormalizer() {}

    static final int MAX_INSTRUCTIONS = 50_000;

    static byte[] normalize(byte[] bytes, int[] counts) { return normalize(bytes, counts, Set.of(), Set.of()); }

    static byte[] normalize(byte[] bytes, int[] counts, Set<String> demoted) { return normalize(bytes, counts, demoted, Set.of()); }

    /**
     * {@code counts[0]} gains the methods whose locals were split, {@code counts[1]} the fields given ACC_SYNTHETIC,
     * {@code counts[2]} (when present) the classes that stop being anonymous or local, from {@link #createdElsewhere}.
     */
    /** {@code calledAcross}: {@code owner.name(desc)} of synthetic methods to unmark, from {@link #calledAcrossNests}; counted in counts[3]. */
    static byte[] normalize(byte[] bytes, int[] counts, Set<String> demoted, Set<String> calledAcross) {
        var node = new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, 0);
        int methods = 0, fields = 0;
        boolean unmarked = false;
        for (var method : node.methods)
            if ((method.access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC) != 0 && calledAcross.contains(node.name + "." + method.name + method.desc)) {
                method.access &= ~Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC;
                unmarked = true;
                if (counts.length > 3) counts[3]++;
            }
        if (!demoted.isEmpty()) {
            if (demoted.contains(node.name)) {
                node.outerClass = null; node.outerMethod = null; node.outerMethodDesc = null;
                unmarked = true;
            }
            unmarked |= node.innerClasses.removeIf(inner -> demoted.contains(inner.name));
        }
        for (var method : node.methods) if (splitWebs(node.name, method)) methods++;
        boolean inner = inner(node), isEnum = (node.access & Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0;
        for (var field : node.fields) {
            if ((field.access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC) != 0 || (field.access & Opcodes.ACC_FINAL) == 0) continue;
            boolean isStatic = (field.access & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) != 0;
            boolean javacSynthetic = !isStatic && inner && (field.name.matches("this\\$\\d+") || field.name.startsWith("val$"))
                || isStatic && isEnum && field.name.equals("$VALUES") && field.desc.equals("[L" + node.name + ";")
                || isStatic && field.name.equals("$assertionsDisabled") && field.desc.equals("Z")
                || isStatic && field.name.startsWith("$SwitchMap$") && field.desc.equals("[I");
            if (javacSynthetic) { field.access |= Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC; fields++; }
        }
        if (methods == 0 && fields == 0 && !unmarked) return bytes;
        counts[0] += methods;
        counts[1] += fields;
        if (demoted.contains(node.name) && counts.length > 2) counts[2]++;
        // No frames: the class files dex2jar writes are version 50, which the JVM verifies without a StackMapTable.
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        node.accept(writer);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /**
     * The anonymous and local classes Java source could not have written where they are used: created anywhere but in the
     * method their EnclosingMethod names (or, without a method, in their outer class's constructors and initializer), or
     * created in more than one method, or named by any other code. R8 does all three: it inlines a method together with its
     * {@code new Outer$m$1(...)}, its lambda classes ({@code $$ExternalSyntheticLambda0}) take an anonymous class as a field
     * and constructor parameter, and it strengthens field and parameter types to anonymous classes. A decompiler then writes
     * {@code Outer.1}, which is no Java. Classes nested in the anonymous class itself may name it, as javac's do.
     */
    static Set<String> createdElsewhere(Map<String, byte[]> classes) {
        var nodes = new ArrayList<ClassNode>();
        var enclosing = new HashMap<String, String>();   // anonymous or local class -> "Owner.method(desc)" or "Owner."
        var outer = new HashMap<String, String>();       // any nested class -> its outer class
        for (byte[] bytes : classes.values()) {
            var node = new ClassNode();
            try { new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES); } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) { continue; }
            nodes.add(node);
            if (node.outerClass != null) outer.put(node.name, node.outerClass);
            for (var inner : node.innerClasses) {
                if (!inner.name.equals(node.name)) continue;
                if (inner.outerName != null) outer.put(node.name, inner.outerName);
                else if (node.outerClass != null)
                    enclosing.put(node.name, node.outerClass + "." + (node.outerMethod == null ? "" : node.outerMethod + node.outerMethodDesc));
            }
        }
        var demoted = new TreeSet<String>();
        var sites = new HashMap<String, Set<String>>();
        for (var node : nodes) {
            // The classes this one may name freely: itself and the classes it is nested in.
            var chain = new HashSet<String>();
            for (String at = node.name; at != null && chain.add(at); ) at = outer.get(at);
            java.util.function.Consumer<String> named = type -> {
                if (type != null && enclosing.containsKey(type) && !chain.contains(type)) demoted.add(type);
            };
            for (var field : node.fields) descriptor(field.desc, named);
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                descriptor(method.desc, named);
                String site = node.name + "." + method.name + method.desc;
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    String type = null, desc = null;
                    if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode t) {
                        type = t.desc.startsWith("[") ? null : t.desc;
                        if (t.desc.startsWith("[")) desc = t.desc;
                        if (t.getOpcode() == Opcodes.NEW) sites.computeIfAbsent(t.desc, key -> new HashSet<>()).add(site);
                    } else if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode m) { type = m.owner; desc = m.desc; }
                    else if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f) { type = f.owner; desc = f.desc; }
                    else if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode l && l.cst instanceof Type t) desc = t.getDescriptor();
                    else if (insn instanceof MultiANewArrayInsnNode a) desc = a.desc;
                    else if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode d) desc = d.desc;
                    // The method an anonymous class belongs to creates it and may call it: that is javac's own code.
                    String home = type == null ? null : enclosing.get(type);
                    boolean ownMethod = home != null && (home.endsWith(".") ? site.startsWith(home + "<init>(") || site.startsWith(home + "<clinit>(")
                        : site.equals(home));
                    if (!ownMethod) named.accept(type);
                    if (desc != null) descriptor(desc, named);
                }
            }
        }
        for (var entry : enclosing.entrySet()) {
            var created = sites.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), Set.of());
            String home = entry.getValue();
            boolean inPlace = home.endsWith(".")
                ? created.stream().allMatch(site -> site.startsWith(home + "<init>(") || site.startsWith(home + "<clinit>("))
                : created.size() <= 1 && (created.isEmpty() || created.contains(home));
            if (!inPlace) demoted.add(entry.getKey());
        }
        return demoted;
    }

    /** The synthetic methods called from a class outside their owner's nest: {@code owner.name(desc)}. */
    static Set<String> calledAcrossNests(Map<String, byte[]> classes) {
        var outer = new HashMap<String, String>();
        var synthetic = new HashSet<String>();
        var nodes = new ArrayList<ClassNode>();
        for (byte[] bytes : classes.values()) {
            var node = new ClassNode();
            try { new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES); } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) { continue; }
            nodes.add(node);
            if (node.outerClass != null) outer.put(node.name, node.outerClass);
            for (var inner : node.innerClasses) if (inner.name.equals(node.name) && inner.outerName != null) outer.put(node.name, inner.outerName);
            for (var method : node.methods) if ((method.access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC) != 0) synthetic.add(node.name + "." + method.name + method.desc);
        }
        java.util.function.Function<String, String> root = name -> {
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            String at = name;
            while (outer.containsKey(at) && seen.add(at)) at = outer.get(at);
            return at;
        };
        var across = new TreeSet<String>();
        for (var node : nodes) {
            String nest = root.apply(node.name);
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && !call.owner.equals(node.name) && synthetic.contains(call.owner + "." + call.name + call.desc)
                            && !root.apply(call.owner).equals(nest)) across.add(call.owner + "." + call.name + call.desc);
        }
        return across;
    }

    /** Every class name in a field or method descriptor. */
    private static void descriptor(String desc, java.util.function.Consumer<String> named) {
        for (int at = desc.indexOf('L'); at >= 0; at = desc.indexOf('L', at + 1)) {
            if (at > 0 && "([)VZBCSIJFDL;".indexOf(desc.charAt(at - 1)) < 0) continue;
            int end = desc.indexOf(';', at);
            if (end < 0) return;
            named.accept(desc.substring(at + 1, end));
            at = end;
        }
    }

    /** A class listed in its own InnerClasses entry as a member that is not static, or as local or anonymous. */
    private static boolean inner(ClassNode node) {
        for (var inner : node.innerClasses)
            if (inner.name.equals(node.name)) return inner.outerName == null || (inner.access & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) == 0;
        return false;
    }

    static boolean splitWebs(String owner, MethodNode method) {
        if (method.instructions.size() == 0 || method.instructions.size() > MAX_INSTRUCTIONS) return false;
        // Each parameter's incoming value becomes an explicit store, so it is a definition like the others.
        var entry = new InsnList();
        var entryStores = new HashMap<Integer, VarInsnNode>();
        int slot = 0;
        var parameters = new ArrayList<Type>();
        if ((method.access & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) == 0) parameters.add(Type.getObjectType(owner));
        parameters.addAll(Arrays.asList(Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc)));
        for (Type type : parameters) {
            var store = new VarInsnNode(type.getOpcode(Opcodes.ISTORE), slot);
            entry.add(new VarInsnNode(type.getOpcode(Opcodes.ILOAD), slot));
            entry.add(store);
            entryStores.put(slot, store);
            slot += type.getSize();
        }
        method.instructions.insert(entry);
        try {
            return split(owner, method, entryStores);
        } finally {
            // The identity copies (load p, store p) are only analysis aids: drop the ones still writing their own slot.
            for (var store : entryStores.values()) {
                var load = (VarInsnNode) store.getPrevious();
                if (load.var == store.var) { method.instructions.remove(load); method.instructions.remove(store); }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean split(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer, VarInsnNode> entryStores) {
        Frame<SourceValue>[] frames;
        try {
            frames = new Analyzer<>(new SourceInterpreter()).analyze(owner, method);
        } catch (AnalyzerException | RuntimeException unanalyzable) {
            return false;
        }
        var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode, Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        int[] parent = new int[insns.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parent.length; i++) parent[i] = i;
        var unsafe = new HashSet<Integer>();           // slots read with no store reaching them: left alone
        var useSlot = new HashMap<Integer, Integer>(); // load or iinc -> its slot
        var entryLoads = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode, Boolean>());
        for (var store : entryStores.values()) entryLoads.add(store.getPrevious());
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            int var = load(insns[i]);
            if (var < 0 || frames[i] == null || entryLoads.contains(insns[i])) continue;
            if (var >= frames[i].getLocals()) { unsafe.add(var); continue; }
            var sources = frames[i].getLocal(var).insns;
            if (sources.isEmpty()) { unsafe.add(var); continue; }
            useSlot.put(i, var);
            for (var source : sources) {
                Integer at = index.get(source);
                if (at == null || store(source) != var) { unsafe.add(var); continue; }
                union(parent, i, at);
            }
        }
        // Webs per slot: the stores (and increments) grouped by their root, in instruction order.
        var webs = new TreeMap<Integer, LinkedHashMap<Integer, List<Integer>>>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            int var = store(insns[i]);
            if (var < 0 || frames[i] == null && !(insns[i] == entryStores.get(var))) continue;
            webs.computeIfAbsent(var, key -> new LinkedHashMap<>()).computeIfAbsent(find(parent, i), key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(i);
        }
        int next = method.maxLocals;
        var moved = new HashMap<Integer, Integer>(); // web root -> new slot
        for (var bySlot : webs.entrySet()) {
            int var = bySlot.getKey();
            if (unsafe.contains(var) || bySlot.getValue().size() < 2) continue;
            var entryStore = entryStores.get(var);
            int keep = entryStore != null ? find(parent, index.get(entryStore)) : bySlot.getValue().keySet().iterator().next();
            for (var web : bySlot.getValue().entrySet()) {
                if (web.getKey() == keep) continue;
                boolean wide = web.getValue().stream().anyMatch(i -> insns[i].getOpcode() == Opcodes.LSTORE || insns[i].getOpcode() == Opcodes.DSTORE);
                moved.put(web.getKey(), next);
                next += wide ? 2 : 1;
            }
        }
        if (moved.isEmpty()) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            boolean definition = store(insns[i]) >= 0, use = useSlot.containsKey(i);
            if (!definition && !use) continue;
            Integer target = moved.get(find(parent, i));
            if (target == null) continue;
            if (insns[i] instanceof VarInsnNode variable) variable.var = target;
            else if (insns[i] instanceof IincInsnNode increment) increment.var = target;
        }
        if (method.localVariables != null) method.localVariables.clear();
        method.maxLocals = next;
        return true;
    }

    /** The slot a load or increment reads, or -1. */
    private static int load(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode variable && variable.getOpcode() >= Opcodes.ILOAD && variable.getOpcode() <= Opcodes.ALOAD) return variable.var;
        if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode increment) return increment.var;
        return -1;
    }

    /** The slot a store or increment writes, or -1. */
    private static int store(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode variable && variable.getOpcode() >= Opcodes.ISTORE && variable.getOpcode() <= Opcodes.ASTORE) return variable.var;
        if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode increment) return increment.var;
        return -1;
    }

    private static int find(int[] parent, int i) {
        while (parent[i] != i) { parent[i] = parent[parent[i]]; i = parent[i]; }
        return i;
    }

    private static void union(int[] parent, int a, int b) { parent[find(parent, a)] = find(parent, b); }
}
```

`modules/dex/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/dex/DexWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.dex;

import com.googlecode.d2j.Method;
import com.googlecode.d2j.dex.Dex2jar;
import com.googlecode.d2j.dex.DexExceptionHandler;
import com.googlecode.d2j.node.DexMethodNode;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.MethodVisitor;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;

/**
 * Phase 2CW worker, run in its own JVM by {@link DexConversion}: reads the Dalvik bytecode of an APK ({@code classes.dex},
 * {@code classes2.dex}, ... at the archive root) or of a single dex file and writes the class files dex2jar makes of it to
 * {@code converted.jar}, with what happened in {@code conversion.tsv}, and the dex files alone to {@code dalvik.zip}. The dex is only parsed; nothing is loaded or run.
 * A method dex2jar cannot translate keeps its signature and gets a body that throws, and is listed; a class with the same
 * name in a later dex is dropped (the runtime loads the first), and is listed too.
 */
public final class DexWorker {
    private DexWorker() {}

    static final Pattern ROOT_DEX = Pattern.compile("classes(\\d*)\\.dex");
    static final long MAX_DEX_BYTES = 256L * 1024 * 1024, MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 512L * 1024 * 1024;
    static final int MAX_DEX_FILES = 200, MAX_CLASSES = 200_000, MAX_RECORDS = 10_000;

    public static void main(String[] arguments) throws Exception {
        if (arguments.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected an APK or dex file and an output directory");
        Path input = Path.of(arguments[0]);
        Path output = Path.of(arguments[1]);
        var log = new ArrayList<String>();
        var classes = new TreeMap<String, byte[]>();
        var origin = new HashMap<String, String>();
        int failedMethods = 0, duplicates = 0;
        var dexes = dexFiles(input);
        // Phase 2CX: the dex files themselves, in load order, for engines that read Dalvik bytecode (JADX).
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(output.resolve("dalvik.zip"), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            int index = 1;
            for (var dex : dexes) {
                var entry = new ZipEntry(index == 1 ? "classes.dex" : "classes" + index + ".dex");
                entry.setTime(0);
                zip.putNextEntry(entry);
                zip.write(dex.bytes());
                zip.closeEntry();
                index++;
            }
        }
        for (var dex : dexes) {
            var failures = new ArrayList<String>();
            var errors = new ArrayList<String>();
            var buffer = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
            try {
                Dex2jar.from(dex.bytes()).skipDebug(false).resetRandom().withExceptionHandler(new Handler(failures, errors)).doTranslate(buffer);
            } catch (Exception | LinkageError error) {
                errors.add(describe(error));
            }
            int converted = 0;
            var data = ByteBuffer.wrap(buffer.toByteArray());
            while (data.remaining() >= 8) {
                byte[] name = new byte[data.getInt()];
                data.get(name);
                byte[] bytes = new byte[data.getInt()];
                data.get(bytes);
                String className = new String(name, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                String kept = origin.putIfAbsent(className, dex.name());
                if (kept != null) {
                    if (duplicates++ < MAX_RECORDS) log.add(row("duplicate", className, kept, dex.name()));
                    continue;
                }
                if (classes.size() >= MAX_CLASSES) throw new IOException("More than " + MAX_CLASSES + " classes");
                classes.put(className, bytes);
                converted++;
            }
            log.add(row("dex", dex.name(), Long.toString(dex.bytes().length), Integer.toString(converted)));
            for (String failure : failures) if (failedMethods++ < MAX_RECORDS) log.add(failure);
            for (String error : errors.stream().limit(100).toList()) log.add(row("error", dex.name(), error));
        }
        int[] normalized = new int[4];
        var demoted = DexNormalizer.createdElsewhere(classes);
        var calledAcross = DexNormalizer.calledAcrossNests(classes);
        for (var entry : classes.entrySet()) {
            try {
                entry.setValue(DexNormalizer.normalize(entry.getValue(), normalized, demoted, calledAcross));
            } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) {
                log.add(row("error", entry.getKey(), "not normalized: " + describe(unreadable)));
            }
        }
        log.add(row("normalized", "parameters", Integer.toString(normalized[0])));
        log.add(row("normalized", "synthetic-fields", Integer.toString(normalized[1])));
        log.add(row("normalized", "top-level-classes", Integer.toString(normalized[2])));
        log.add(row("normalized", "synthetic-methods-shown", Integer.toString(normalized[3])));
        if (failedMethods > MAX_RECORDS) log.add(row("truncated", "method-failed", Integer.toString(failedMethods)));
        if (duplicates > MAX_RECORDS) log.add(row("truncated", "duplicate", Integer.toString(duplicates)));
        Files.write(output.resolve("conversion.tsv"), log, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (classes.isEmpty()) {
            System.err.println("dex2jar produced no class file");
            System.exit(3);
        }
        try (var jar = new JarOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(output.resolve("converted.jar"), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            for (var entry : classes.entrySet()) {
                var zipEntry = new JarEntry(entry.getKey() + ".class");
                zipEntry.setTime(0);
                jar.putNextEntry(zipEntry);
                jar.write(entry.getValue());
                jar.closeEntry();
            }
        }
    }

    record Dex(String name, byte[] bytes) {}

    /** The dex files of the input in load order: a dex file itself, or an archive's root classes.dex, classes2.dex, ... */
    static List<Dex> dexFiles(Path input) throws IOException {
        byte[] head = new byte[4];
        try (var in = Files.newInputStream(input)) { if (in.readNBytes(head, 0, 4) < 4) throw new IOException("Input too small"); }
        if (head[0] == 'd' && head[1] == 'e' && head[2] == 'x' && head[3] == '\n') {
            if (Files.size(input) > MAX_DEX_BYTES) throw new IOException("Dex file over " + MAX_DEX_BYTES + " bytes");
            return List.of(new Dex(String.valueOf(input.getFileName()), Files.readAllBytes(input)));
        }
        var found = new TreeMap<Integer, Dex>();
        long total = 0;
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(input.toFile())) {
            for (var entries = zip.entries(); entries.hasMoreElements(); ) {
                ZipEntry entry = entries.nextElement();
                var matcher = ROOT_DEX.matcher(entry.getName());
                if (entry.isDirectory() || !matcher.matches()) continue;
                // classes.dex is the first; classes2.dex, classes3.dex, ... follow it in number order.
                int index = matcher.group(1).isEmpty() ? 1 : Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));
                if (index < 1 || found.size() >= MAX_DEX_FILES) continue;
                var dex = new Dex(entry.getName(), read(zip, entry));
                total += dex.bytes().length;
                if (total > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) throw new IOException("Dex files over " + MAX_TOTAL_BYTES + " bytes in total");
                found.put(index, dex);
            }
        }
        if (found.isEmpty()) throw new IOException("No classes.dex at the archive root");
        return List.copyOf(found.values());
    }

    private static byte[] read(ZipFile zip, ZipEntry entry) throws IOException {
        if (entry.getSize() > MAX_DEX_BYTES) throw new IOException(entry.getName() + " is over " + MAX_DEX_BYTES + " bytes");
        try (var in = zip.getInputStream(entry)) {
            byte[] bytes = in.readNBytes((int) MAX_DEX_BYTES + 1);
            if (bytes.length > MAX_DEX_BYTES) throw new IOException(entry.getName() + " is over " + MAX_DEX_BYTES + " bytes");
            return bytes;
        }
    }

    /** Lists each method dex2jar could not translate; its body becomes a throw, so the class stays valid and says so. */
    private static final class Handler implements DexExceptionHandler {
        private final List<String> failures, errors;
        Handler(List<String> failures, List<String> errors) { this.failures = failures; this.errors = errors; }

        @Override public void handleFileException(Exception error) { errors.add(describe(error)); }

        @Override public void handleMethodTranslateException(Method method, DexMethodNode node, MethodVisitor visitor, Exception error) {
            String owner = method.getOwner();
            if (owner.startsWith("L") && owner.endsWith(";")) owner = owner.substring(1, owner.length() - 1);
            failures.add(row("method-failed", owner, method.getName() + method.getDesc(), error.getClass().getSimpleName()));
            visitor.visitTypeInsn(Opcodes.NEW, "java/lang/RuntimeException");
            visitor.visitInsn(Opcodes.DUP);
            visitor.visitLdcInsn("ClassRevive: dex2jar could not translate this method from Dalvik bytecode");
            visitor.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/RuntimeException", "<init>", "(Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
            visitor.visitInsn(Opcodes.ATHROW);
        }
    }

    static String describe(Throwable error) {
        return error.getClass().getSimpleName() + (error.getMessage() == null ? "" : ": " + error.getMessage());
    }

    /** One tab-separated line; tabs, line breaks and control characters in a field become spaces, and long fields are cut. */
    static String row(String... fields) {
        var out = new StringJoiner("\t");
        for (String field : fields) {
            String clean = field.replaceAll("\\p{Cntrl}", " ");
            out.add(clean.length() > 300 ? clean.substring(0, 300) + "..." : clean);
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
}
```
