`modules/dex/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/dex/DexConversionTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.dex;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2CW: dex2jar in its worker on the committed fixtures (benchmarks/android); nothing converted is loaded or run. */
class DexConversionTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of("../../benchmarks/android");
    static final Duration TIMEOUT = Duration.ofMinutes(3);
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void convertsBothDexFilesOfTheApkWithTheirDebugInformation() throws Exception {
        var result = DexConversion.convert(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"), directory.resolve("run"), TIMEOUT);
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.worker().status(), result.worker().message());
        assertEquals(List.of("classes.dex", "classes2.dex"), result.dexFiles().stream().map(DexConversion.DexFile::name).toList());
        var classes = classes(result.jar());
        assertEquals(Set.of("demo/notes/MainActivity", "demo/notes/Note", "demo/notes/NoteStore", "demo/notes/NoteStore$1",
            "demo/notes/NoteStore$Stats", "demo/notes/Priority", "demo/util/Strings"), classes.keySet());
        assertEquals(7, result.classes());
        assertTrue(result.failedMethods().isEmpty(), result.failedMethods().toString());
        assertTrue(result.duplicates().isEmpty());
        // The framework types stay references: android.* is not in the dex, so it is not in the jar.
        assertEquals("android/app/Activity", classes.get("demo/notes/MainActivity").superName);
        // Line numbers come through (skipDebug off). Local variable names do not: dex2jar reallocates registers and writes
        // no LocalVariableTable, so engines name locals themselves.
        var words = classes.get("demo/notes/Note").methods.stream().filter(m -> m.name.equals("words")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(java.util.stream.StreamSupport.stream(words.instructions.spliterator(), false)
            .anyMatch(insn -> insn instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.LineNumberNode line && line.line == 33), "line numbers survive");
        // Normalized for Java decompilers: Note.edit reuses its String parameter's register for the new Note, so its
        // locals were split; NoteStore$1.this$0 and Priority.$VALUES are synthetic again, as javac made them.
        assertTrue(result.movedParameters() > 0, "methods with locals split: " + result.movedParameters());
        assertTrue(result.syntheticFields() >= 2, "fields marked synthetic: " + result.syntheticFields());
        assertNotEquals(0, field(classes.get("demo/notes/NoteStore$1"), "this$0").access & org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC);
        assertNotEquals(0, field(classes.get("demo/notes/Priority"), "$VALUES").access & org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC);
        var edit = classes.get("demo/notes/Note").methods.stream().filter(m -> m.name.equals("edit")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(java.util.stream.StreamSupport.stream(edit.instructions.spliterator(), false).noneMatch(insn ->
            insn instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.VarInsnNode store && store.getOpcode() == org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ASTORE && store.var == 1),
            "the String parameter's slot is no longer written");
        // Entries are sorted and carry no time, so the same dex always gives the same jar.
        var again = DexConversion.convert(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"), directory.resolve("again"), TIMEOUT);
        assertArrayEquals(Files.readAllBytes(result.jar()), Files.readAllBytes(again.jar()));
    }

    @Test void convertsASingleDexFile() throws Exception {
        var result = DexConversion.convert(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"), directory.resolve("run"), TIMEOUT);
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.worker().status(), result.worker().message());
        assertEquals(6, result.classes());
        assertFalse(classes(result.jar()).containsKey("demo/util/Strings"), "Strings lives in classes2.dex only");
    }

    @Test void keepsTheFirstOfTwoClassesWithTheSameNameAndListsTheOther() throws Exception {
        byte[] dex = Files.readAllBytes(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"));
        Path apk = directory.resolve("twice.apk");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(apk))) {
            for (String name : List.of("classes.dex", "classes2.dex", "assets/payload.dex")) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name));
                zip.write(dex);
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var result = DexConversion.convert(apk, directory.resolve("run"), TIMEOUT);
        assertEquals(6, result.classes());
        assertEquals(6, result.duplicateCount());
        assertTrue(result.duplicates().stream().allMatch(d -> d.keptFrom().equals("classes.dex") && d.droppedFrom().equals("classes2.dex")));
        // Only root classes*.dex are what the runtime loads; a dex under assets/ is data and is not converted.
        assertEquals(List.of("classes.dex", "classes2.dex"), result.dexFiles().stream().map(DexConversion.DexFile::name).toList());
    }

    @Test void anArchiveWithoutDexProducesNoJarAndSaysWhy() throws Exception {
        Path zip = directory.resolve("empty.apk");
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(zip))) {
            out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("AndroidManifest.xml"));
            out.write(new byte[] {3, 0, 8, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0});
            out.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = DexConversion.convert(zip, directory.resolve("run"), TIMEOUT);
        assertNull(result.jar());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.FAILED, result.worker().status());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(directory.resolve("run/engine.log")).contains("No classes.dex at the archive root"));
    }

    private static org.objectweb.asm.tree.FieldNode field(ClassNode node, String name) {
        return node.fields.stream().filter(f -> f.name.equals(name)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
    }

    private static Map<String, ClassNode> classes(Path jar) throws IOException {
        var classes = new TreeMap<String, ClassNode>();
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            for (var entries = zip.entries(); entries.hasMoreElements(); ) {
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                var node = new ClassNode();
                try (var in = zip.getInputStream(entry)) { new ClassReader(in.readAllBytes()).accept(node, 0); }
                classes.put(node.name, node);
            }
        }
        return classes;
    }
}
```

`modules/dex/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/dex/DexNormalizerTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.dex;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode;

/** Phase 2DA: anonymous classes R8 creates outside their method stop being anonymous; the others stay as they are. */
class DexNormalizerTest {
    @Test void anonymousClassesCreatedInAnotherMethodBecomeTopLevel() {
        var classes = new TreeMap<String, byte[]>();
        // Outer$1 belongs to a(), but R8 inlined a() into b() and c.Other.d(): three creation sites.
        classes.put("p/Outer", outer("p/Outer", List.of("p/Outer$1", "p/Outer$2", "p/Outer$3"),
            Map.of("a", "p/Outer$1", "b", "p/Outer$1", "e", "p/Outer$2", "f", "p/Outer$3")));
        classes.put("p/Outer$1", anonymous("p/Outer$1", "p/Outer", "a"));
        classes.put("p/Outer$2", anonymous("p/Outer$2", "p/Outer", "e"));
        classes.put("c/Other", outer("c/Other", List.of("p/Outer$1"), Map.of("d", "p/Outer$1")));
        // Outer$2$1 lives inside Outer$2: its this$0 names Outer$2, as javac's nested anonymous classes do.
        classes.put("p/Outer$2$1", anonymous("p/Outer$2$1", "p/Outer$2", "run"));
        // Outer$3 is created only in f(), but an R8 lambda class keeps it in a field: Java cannot name it there.
        classes.put("p/Outer$3", anonymous("p/Outer$3", "p/Outer", "f"));
        classes.put("p/Outer$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0", holder("p/Outer$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0", "p/Outer$3"));

        var demoted = DexNormalizer.createdElsewhere(classes);
        assertEquals(Set.of("p/Outer$1", "p/Outer$3"), demoted, "Outer$2 is created only in e() and named only by its own nested class");

        int[] counts = new int[3];
        var one = read(DexNormalizer.normalize(classes.get("p/Outer$1"), counts, demoted));
        assertNull(one.outerClass);
        assertNull(one.outerMethod);
        assertTrue(one.innerClasses.isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, counts[2]);
        // Not inner any more: this$0 stays a plain field, so the constructor that sets it still compiles.
        assertEquals(0, one.fields.getFirst().access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC);
        var outer = read(DexNormalizer.normalize(classes.get("p/Outer"), counts, demoted));
        assertEquals(List.of("p/Outer$2"), outer.innerClasses.stream().map(inner -> inner.name).toList());
        var other = read(DexNormalizer.normalize(classes.get("c/Other"), counts, demoted));
        assertTrue(other.innerClasses.isEmpty());

        var two = read(DexNormalizer.normalize(classes.get("p/Outer$2"), new int[3], demoted));
        assertEquals("e", two.outerMethod);
        assertNotEquals(0, two.fields.getFirst().access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC, "still anonymous: this$0 is synthetic again");
    }

    /** R8's lambda class calls Outer's synthetic $r8$lambda$ method: it is shown; an access$ method used by Outer$Inner stays hidden. */
    @Test void syntheticMethodsCalledFromAnotherNestAreShown() {
        var classes = new TreeMap<String, byte[]>();
        classes.put("p/Outer", withSynthetic("p/Outer", List.of("$r8$lambda$abc", "access$000"), "p/Outer$Inner"));
        classes.put("p/Outer$Inner", caller("p/Outer$Inner", "p/Outer", "access$000", true));
        classes.put("p/Outer$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0", caller("p/Outer$$ExternalSyntheticLambda0", "p/Outer", "$r8$lambda$abc", false));
        var across = DexNormalizer.calledAcrossNests(classes);
        assertEquals(Set.of("p/Outer.$r8$lambda$abc()V"), across);
        int[] counts = new int[4];
        var outer = read(DexNormalizer.normalize(classes.get("p/Outer"), counts, Set.of(), across));
        var access = new TreeMap<String, Integer>();
        outer.methods.forEach(m -> access.put(m.name, m.access & Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC));
        assertEquals(0, access.get("$r8$lambda$abc"));
        assertNotEquals(0, access.get("access$000"));
        assertEquals(1, counts[3]);
    }

    private static byte[] withSynthetic(String name, List<String> methods, String inner) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_6, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitInnerClass(inner, name, inner.substring(inner.lastIndexOf('$') + 1), Opcodes.ACC_STATIC);
        for (String method : methods) {
            var m = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC, method, "()V", null, null);
            m.visitCode(); m.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN); m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd();
        }
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] caller(String name, String owner, String method, boolean nested) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_6, Opcodes.ACC_FINAL | Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        if (nested) writer.visitInnerClass(name, owner, name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('$') + 1), Opcodes.ACC_STATIC);
        var m = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "run", "()V", null, null);
        m.visitCode();
        m.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, owner, method, "()V", false);
        m.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN); m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** A top-level class with a field of the given type, as R8's lambda classes have. */
    private static byte[] holder(String name, String type) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_6, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_FINAL | Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC | Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_FINAL, "f$0", "L" + type + ";", null, null).visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static ClassNode read(byte[] bytes) {
        var node = new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, 0);
        return node;
    }

    /** A class whose methods each create one anonymous class, listing them in InnerClasses as javac does. */
    private static byte[] outer(String name, List<String> inners, Map<String, String> creates) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_6, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        for (String inner : inners) writer.visitInnerClass(inner, null, null, 0);
        for (var entry : new TreeMap<>(creates).entrySet()) {
            var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, entry.getKey(), "()Ljava/lang/Object;", null, null);
            method.visitCode();
            method.visitTypeInsn(Opcodes.NEW, entry.getValue());
            method.visitInsn(Opcodes.DUP);
            method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ACONST_NULL);
            method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, entry.getValue(), "<init>", "(Lp/Outer;)V", false);
            method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ARETURN);
            method.visitMaxs(0, 0);
            method.visitEnd();
        }
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] anonymous(String name, String owner, String method) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V1_6, Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitOuterClass(owner, method, "()Ljava/lang/Object;");
        writer.visitInnerClass(name, null, null, 0);
        writer.visitField(Opcodes.ACC_FINAL, "this$0", "L" + owner + ";", null, null).visitEnd();
        var init = writer.visitMethod(0, "<init>", "(L" + owner + ";)V", null, null);
        init.visitCode();
        init.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0);
        init.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 1);
        init.visitFieldInsn(Opcodes.PUTFIELD, name, "this$0", "L" + owner + ";");
        init.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0);
        init.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/Object", "<init>", "()V", false);
        init.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN);
        init.visitMaxs(0, 0);
        init.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-jadx/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/jadx/JadxWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.jadx;

import jadx.api.*;
import jadx.api.plugins.JadxPlugin;
import jadx.api.plugins.loader.JadxPluginLoader;
import jadx.core.plugins.files.IJadxFilesGetter;
import jadx.plugins.input.dex.DexInputPlugin;
import jadx.plugins.input.java.JavaInputPlugin;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Explicit plugin set: Java class input and (Phase 2CX) JADX's own dex input; no user plugins, scripts, network
 * installation or target execution. An archive of dex files is read by the dex plugin, a jar by the Java one.
 */
public final class JadxWorker {
    public static void main(String[] arguments) throws Exception {
        if (arguments.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected a normalized JAR (or dex archive) and output directory");
        Path output = Path.of(arguments[1]).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path state = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve(".jadx-state"));
        Path config = Files.createDirectory(state.resolve("config"));
        Path cache = Files.createDirectory(state.resolve("cache"));
        Path temp = Files.createDirectory(state.resolve("tmp"));
        var args = new JadxArgs();
        args.setInputFile(Path.of(arguments[0]).toFile());
        args.setOutDir(output.toFile()); args.setOutDirSrc(output.toFile());
        args.setSkipResources(true); args.setThreadsCount(1);
        args.setDeobfuscationOn(false); args.setRenameFlags(Set.of());
        args.setRespectBytecodeAccModifiers(true);
        args.setFilesGetter(new IJadxFilesGetter() {
            public Path getConfigDir() { return config; }
            public Path getCacheDir() { return cache; }
            public Path getTempDir() { return temp; }
        });
        args.setPluginLoader(new JadxPluginLoader() {
            public List<JadxPlugin> load() { return List.of(new JavaInputPlugin(), new DexInputPlugin()); }
            public void close() {}
        });
        int errors;
        try (var decompiler = new JadxDecompiler(args)) {
            decompiler.load(); decompiler.saveSources();
            errors = decompiler.getErrorsCount(); decompiler.printErrorsReport();
        }
        if (errors > 0) System.exit(1);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.jadx;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class JadxEngineTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    @Test void emitsJavaWithoutExecutingInitializer() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("Example.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Example { static { if (System.nanoTime() != 0) throw new Error(); } public int value() { return 42; } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        Path jar = directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Example.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("Example.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(new JadxEngine(), jar, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status(), Files.readString(directory.resolve("out/engine.log")));
        var generated = directory.resolve("out/sources/Example.java");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(generated).contains("int value("));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"-proc:none",generated.toString()));
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-procyon/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/procyon/ProcyonWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.procyon;

import com.strobel.assembler.metadata.*;
import com.strobel.decompiler.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.jar.JarFile;
import java.util.*;

/** Reads only the normalized JAR supplied by the parent; never defines target classes. */
public final class ProcyonWorker {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        if (args.length != 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected normalized JAR and output directory");
        Path output = Path.of(args[1]).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        int failures = 0;
        try (var jar = new JarFile(args[0])) {
            var loader = new JarTypeLoader(jar);
            var metadata = new MetadataSystem(loader);
            var settings = DecompilerSettings.javaDefaults();
            settings.setTypeLoader(loader);
            var options = new DecompilationOptions(); options.setSettings(settings); options.setFullDecompilation(true);
            var entries = jar.stream().filter(e -> e.getName().endsWith(".class")).limit(20001)
                .sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(entry -> entry.getName().length())).toList();
            if (entries.size() > 20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many classes");
            var emitted = new HashSet<String>();
            for (var entry : entries) {
                String name = entry.getName().substring(0, entry.getName().length() - 6);
                Path destination = output.resolve(name + ".java").normalize();
                if (!destination.startsWith(output)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsafe class path");
                try {
                    var reference = metadata.lookupType(name);
                    var type = reference == null ? null : reference.resolve();
                    if (type == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Class metadata unavailable");
                    if (coveredByEnclosingType(type, emitted)) continue;
                    Files.createDirectories(destination.getParent());
                    try (var writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(destination, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
                        settings.getLanguage().decompileType(type, new PlainTextOutput(writer), options);
                    }
                    emitted.add(name);
                } catch (RuntimeException error) {
                    failures++; System.err.println("Failed class " + name + ": " + error.getClass().getSimpleName());
                }
            }
        }
        if (failures > 0) System.exit(1);
    }
    private static boolean coveredByEnclosingType(TypeDefinition type, Set<String> emitted) {
        var parent = type.getDeclaringType();
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        while (parent != null && seen.size() < 1000 && seen.add(parent.getInternalName())) {
            if (emitted.contains(parent.getInternalName())) return true;
            parent = parent.getDeclaringType();
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.procyon;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProcyonEngineTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    @Test void retainsOrphanNestedClassAsPartialSource() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("Outer.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Outer { public static class Inner { public int value() { return 7; } } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        Path jar = directory.resolve("orphan.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Outer$Inner.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("Outer$Inner.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(new ProcyonEngine(), jar, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertTrue(result.sourceFiles() > 0, result.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(directory.resolve("out/sources/Outer$Inner.java")).contains("value("));
    }
    @Test void decompilesNestedClassFamilyWithoutExecutingInitializer() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("Example.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Example { static { if (System.nanoTime() != 0) throw new Error(); } public static class Nested { public int value() { return 42; } } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        Path jar = directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (String name : new String[]{"Example", "Example$Nested"}) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name + ".class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(name + ".class"))); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(new ProcyonEngine(), jar, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status(), result.toString());
        Path generated = directory.resolve("out/sources/Example.java");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(generated).contains("class Nested"));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(directory.resolve("out/sources/Example$Nested.java")));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"-proc:none",generated.toString()));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public interface DecompilerEngine {
    String id();
    String version();
    List<String> command(Path input, Path output);
    /** Environment variables set for the worker in addition to the inherited ones (phase 2CC: JAVA_HOME for Ghidra). */
    default Map<String,String> environment() { return Map.of(); }
    /**
     * Phase 2CX: whether {@link #command} also takes an archive of Dalvik dex files. For an Android input whose converted
     * classes were not renamed or rewritten, such an engine gets the original dex instead of the converted jar.
     */
    default boolean readsDalvik() { return false; }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/EngineCommand.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.net.JarURLConnection;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;

public final class EngineCommand {
    private EngineCommand() {}
    public static List<String> javaWorker(Class<?> adapter, String worker, List<String> resources, String... arguments) {
        try {
            var paths = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
            paths.add(Path.of(adapter.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()).toString());
            for (String resource : resources) {
                var location = adapter.getClassLoader().getResource(resource);
                if (location == null || !(location.openConnection() instanceof JarURLConnection connection))
                    throw new IllegalStateException("Worker dependency missing: " + resource);
                paths.add(Path.of(connection.getJarFileURL().toURI()).toString());
            }
            var command = new ArrayList<String>();
            command.add(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString());
            command.addAll(List.of("-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2",
                "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8", "-cp", String.join(java.io.File.pathSeparator, paths), worker));
            command.addAll(Arrays.asList(arguments));
            return List.copyOf(command);
        } catch (Exception error) { throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot locate packaged worker dependencies", error); }
    }
    /** Worker heap cap by size of the class JAR given to a decompiler (Phase 2BB); the cap stays bounded at 1 GiB. */
    static final long SMALL_INPUT = 1L << 20, MEDIUM_INPUT = 4L << 20;

    /**
     * Replaces the default {@code -Xmx256m} of a decompiler command with a heap sized for its input: 256 MiB up to 1 MiB,
     * 512 MiB up to 4 MiB, and 1 GiB above. Vineflower ran out of 256 MiB on CFR 0.152 (2 MiB jar, 1302 classes) and
     * wrote stubs for different classes on each run, so results depended on chance. An unreadable size keeps 256 MiB.
     */
    public static List<String> sizedHeap(Path input, List<String> command) {
        long size;
        try { size = java.nio.file.Files.size(input); } catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException error) { size = 0; }
        String heap = size <= SMALL_INPUT ? "-Xmx256m" : size <= MEDIUM_INPUT ? "-Xmx512m" : "-Xmx1g";
        return command.stream().map(argument -> argument.equals("-Xmx256m") ? heap : argument).toList();
    }

    public static List<String> javaJar(Class<?> adapter, String resource, String... arguments) {
        try {
            var location = adapter.getClassLoader().getResource(resource);
            if (location == null || !(location.openConnection() instanceof JarURLConnection connection))
                throw new IllegalStateException("Engine JAR missing: " + resource);
            Path jar = Path.of(connection.getJarFileURL().toURI());
            var command = new ArrayList<String>();
            command.add(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString());
            command.addAll(List.of("-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2",
                "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8", "-jar", jar.toString()));
            command.addAll(Arrays.asList(arguments));
            return List.copyOf(command);
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot locate packaged engine", error);
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/EngineResult.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

public record EngineResult(String engine, String version, Status status, int exitCode,
                           long sourceFiles, long elapsedMillis, String message, DiagnosticCode diagnosticCode) {
    public enum Status { OUTPUT_PRODUCED, NO_SOURCES, FAILED, TIMED_OUT, OUTPUT_LIMIT, CANCELLED }
    public enum DiagnosticCode {
        NONE, NO_SOURCE_FILES, ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
        CANCELLED, WORKER_SETUP_FAILED, WORKER_START_FAILED, WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE
    }
    public EngineResult(String engine, String version, Status status, int exitCode,
                        long sourceFiles, long elapsedMillis, String message) {
        this(engine, version, status, exitCode, sourceFiles, elapsedMillis, message, defaultCode(status));
    }
    private static DiagnosticCode defaultCode(Status status) {
        return switch (status) {
            case OUTPUT_PRODUCED -> DiagnosticCode.NONE;
            case NO_SOURCES -> DiagnosticCode.NO_SOURCE_FILES;
            case FAILED -> DiagnosticCode.WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE;
            case TIMED_OUT -> DiagnosticCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED;
            case OUTPUT_LIMIT -> DiagnosticCode.OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED;
            case CANCELLED -> DiagnosticCode.CANCELLED;
        };
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/FailureCause.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Describes a host-side worker failure and its chained causes for engine.log: exception types, the first frames
 * that locate them, the OS reason of file-system errors and a redacted location. Absolute paths are replaced and
 * target-derived path segments (package and class names) are never written.
 */
final class FailureCause {
    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 8, MAX_MESSAGE = 200;
    private static final Pattern ENGINE_SEGMENT = Pattern.compile("[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*(-?[0-9]+)?");
    private FailureCause() {}

    static String describe(Throwable error, Path directory, Path input) {
        var lines = new ArrayList<String>();
        var seen = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<Throwable, Boolean>());
        for (Throwable current = error; current != null && seen.add(current) && lines.size() < MAX_DEPTH;
             current = current.getCause()) {
            var line = new StringBuilder(lines.isEmpty() ? "[classrevive] host-side worker failure: " : "[classrevive]   caused by: ");
            line.append(current.getClass().getName());
            if (current instanceof FileSystemException file) {
                line.append(" (reason=").append(file.getReason() == null ? "none" : clean(file.getReason(), directory, input))
                    .append(", location=").append(location(file.getFile(), directory));
                if (file.getOtherFile() != null) line.append(", other=").append(location(file.getOtherFile(), directory));
                line.append(')');
            } else {
                String message = current.getMessage();
                if (message != null && !(current.getCause() != null && message.equals(String.valueOf(current.getCause()))))
                    line.append(": ").append(clean(message, directory, input));
            }
            line.append(frames(current));
            lines.add(line.toString());
        }
        return String.join(System.lineSeparator(), lines) + System.lineSeparator();
    }

    /** Origin frame plus the first ClassRevive frame; frames name JDK/engine/ClassRevive code, never the target. */
    private static String frames(Throwable error) {
        var trace = error.getStackTrace();
        if (trace.length == 0) return "";
        var text = new StringBuilder(" at ").append(frame(trace[0]));
        for (var element : trace)
            if (element != trace[0] && element.getClassName().startsWith("dev.classrevive.")) {
                text.append(" via ").append(frame(element)); break;
            }
        return text.toString();
    }
    private static String frame(StackTraceElement element) {
        return element.getClassName() + "." + element.getMethodName() + (element.getLineNumber() > 0 ? ":" + element.getLineNumber() : "");
    }

    /**
     * Keeps the runner-owned folder and an engine-state subtree (a dot-prefixed directory such as {@code .jadx-state}
     * and up to two lowercase engine-named levels below it); every other segment is counted, not written.
     */
    static String location(String file, Path directory) {
        if (file == null) return "unknown";
        Path path;
        try { path = Path.of(file).toAbsolutePath().normalize(); }
        catch (InvalidPathException error) { return "unparsable"; }
        Path base = directory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (!path.startsWith(base)) return "<outside run directory>";
        Path relative = base.relativize(path);
        if (relative.getNameCount() == 0 || relative.toString().isEmpty()) return "<run>";
        var kept = new ArrayList<String>(List.of("<run>", relative.getName(0).toString()));
        int index = 1, engineLevels = -1;
        for (; index < relative.getNameCount(); index++) {
            String segment = relative.getName(index).toString();
            if (engineLevels < 0 && segment.startsWith(".") && segment.length() > 1 && ENGINE_SEGMENT.matcher(segment.substring(1)).matches())
                engineLevels = 0;
            else if (engineLevels >= 0 && engineLevels < 2 && ENGINE_SEGMENT.matcher(segment).matches()) engineLevels++;
            else break;
            kept.add(segment);
        }
        int redacted = relative.getNameCount() - index;
        return String.join("/", kept) + (redacted > 0 ? "/<" + redacted + " redacted segment" + (redacted == 1 ? "" : "s") + ">" : "");
    }

    private static String clean(String message, Path directory, Path input) {
        String text = message.replace('\r', ' ').replace('\n', ' ');
        text = redact(text, input, "<input>");
        text = redact(text, directory, "<run>");
        text = redact(text, Path.of(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir")), "<tmp>");
        text = redact(text, Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home")), "<home>");
        return text.length() > MAX_MESSAGE ? text.substring(0, MAX_MESSAGE) + "…" : text;
    }
    /** Replaces a known absolute path and everything that follows it up to whitespace (the target-derived tail). */
    private static String redact(String text, Path path, String placeholder) {
        if (path == null) return text;
        String absolute = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
        if (absolute.length() < 3) return text;
        return Pattern.compile(Pattern.quote(absolute) + "\\S*", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(text)
            .replaceAll(java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement(placeholder + "/…"));
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/ProcessRunner.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import static dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult.Status.*;

public final class ProcessRunner {
    public EngineResult run(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "sources", ".java");
    }
    public EngineResult runCompiler(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "classes", ".class");
    }
    public EngineResult runDisassembler(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "bytecode", ".txt");
    }
    public EngineResult runTransform(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "transformed", ".jar");
    }
    public EngineResult runDiagnostics(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine,input,directory,timeout,"diagnostics",".bin");
    }
    /** Source repair proposals: changed .java files under {@code repaired}. */
    public EngineResult runSourceRepair(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "repaired", ".java");
    }
    /** Method composition proposals (Phase 2BD): spliced .java files under {@code spliced/sources}. */
    public EngineResult runMethodSplice(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "spliced", ".java");
    }
    public EngineResult runRename(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "renamed", ".jar");
    }
    /** Native library triage (Phase 2CC): the external tool writes one JSON export under {@code native}. */
    public EngineResult runNativeAnalysis(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "native", ".json");
    }
    /** JVM link checks (define and verify, never initialize): one result file under {@code linked}. */
    public EngineResult runLinkCheck(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout) {
        return run(engine, input, directory, timeout, "linked", ".properties");
    }
    private EngineResult run(DecompilerEngine engine, Path input, Path directory, Duration timeout, String folder, String suffix) {
        if (timeout.isNegative() || timeout.isZero()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Timeout must be positive");
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        Process process = null;
        Thread drain = null;
        var status = FAILED;
        var diagnosticCode = EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_SETUP_FAILED;
        String message = "Worker did not complete";
        int exit = -1;
        long sources = 0;
        boolean restoreInterrupt = false;
        boolean startAttempted = false, directoryCreated = false;
        Throwable failure = null;
        long deadline = start + timeout.toNanos();
        try {
            Files.createDirectory(directory);
            directoryCreated = true;
            Path output = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve(folder));
            var builder = new ProcessBuilder(engine.command(input.toAbsolutePath(), output.toAbsolutePath()));
            builder.directory(directory.toFile()).redirectErrorStream(true);
            // Do not inherit JVM injection options or target-related class paths.
            builder.environment().keySet().removeIf(key -> key.equalsIgnoreCase("JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS")
                || key.equalsIgnoreCase("_JAVA_OPTIONS") || key.equalsIgnoreCase("JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS")
                || key.equalsIgnoreCase("CLASSPATH"));
            builder.environment().putAll(engine.environment());
            startAttempted = true;
            process = builder.start();
            diagnosticCode = EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE;
            process.getOutputStream().close();
            Process worker = process;
            drain = Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> drainLog(worker.getInputStream(), directory.resolve("engine.log")));
            while (true) {
                boolean finished = process.waitFor(100, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
                checkDeadline(deadline);
                // While the worker runs it may delete its own state (JADX removes .jadx-state/tmp on close), so only
                // the walk after exit treats a vanished entry as a failure.
                long[] usage = usage(output, deadline, suffix, !finished);
                if (usage[0] > 128L * 1024 * 1024 || usage[1] > 20_000) {
                    status = OUTPUT_LIMIT; diagnosticCode = EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED;
                    message = "Worker exceeded output budget"; break;
                }
                if (finished) {
                    exit = process.exitValue(); sources = usage[2];
                    status = exit != 0 ? FAILED : sources == 0 ? NO_SOURCES : OUTPUT_PRODUCED;
                    diagnosticCode = exit != 0 ? EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO
                        : sources == 0 ? EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NO_SOURCE_FILES : EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NONE;
                    message = status == OUTPUT_PRODUCED ? "Sources emitted; correctness not verified" : "See engine.log";
                    break;
                }
            }
        } catch (TimeoutException error) {
            status = TIMED_OUT; diagnosticCode = EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED; message = "Worker exceeded deadline";
        } catch (InterruptedException error) {
            status = CANCELLED; diagnosticCode = EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.CANCELLED; message = "Worker interrupted";
            restoreInterrupt = true;
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException error) {
            diagnosticCode = process != null ? EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE
                : startAttempted ? EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_START_FAILED : EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_SETUP_FAILED;
            failure = error;
            Throwable root = error;
            while (root.getCause() != null && root.getCause() != root) root = root.getCause();
            message = "Worker failure: " + error.getClass().getSimpleName()
                + (root != error ? " (caused by " + root.getClass().getSimpleName() + ")" : "")
                + (directoryCreated ? "; see engine.log" : "");
        } finally {
            restoreInterrupt |= Thread.interrupted();
            if (process != null) {
                if (process.isAlive()) {
                    process.descendants().forEach(child -> child.destroyForcibly());
                    process.destroyForcibly();
                }
                try { process.waitFor(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS); }
                catch (InterruptedException error) { restoreInterrupt = true; }
                try { if (drain != null) drain.join(5000); }
                catch (InterruptedException error) { restoreInterrupt = true; }
                try { process.getInputStream().close(); } catch (IOException ignored) { }
            }
            // The exception names only its type in the result; its chained causes go to the run's own log.
            if (failure != null && directoryCreated) appendCause(failure, directory, input);
            if (restoreInterrupt) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        }
        return new EngineResult(engine.id(), engine.version(), status, exit, sources,
            Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - start).toMillis(), message, diagnosticCode);
    }

    private static void drainLog(InputStream input, Path log) {
        try (input; var output = Files.newOutputStream(log, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192]; int read; long retained = 0;
            while ((read = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                int keep = (int) Math.min(read, 1024 * 1024 - retained);
                if (keep > 0) { output.write(buffer, 0, keep); retained += keep; }
            }
        } catch (IOException ignored) {
            // A killed worker closes its pipe; no unbounded buffering is retained.
        }
    }

    private static void appendCause(Throwable failure, Path directory, Path input) {
        try {
            Files.writeString(directory.resolve("engine.log"), FailureCause.describe(failure, directory, input),
                StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException ignored) {
            // The result still carries the failure type when the log cannot be written.
        }
    }

    private static long[] usage(Path output, long deadline, String suffix, boolean workerRunning)
        throws IOException, InterruptedException, TimeoutException {
        var meter = new OutputMeter(output, deadline, suffix, workerRunning);
        Files.walkFileTree(output, meter);
        if (meter.stop instanceof InterruptedException error) throw error;
        if (meter.stop instanceof TimeoutException error) throw error;
        return new long[] {meter.bytes, meter.files, meter.sources};
    }
    private static final class OutputMeter extends SimpleFileVisitor<Path> {
        private final Path output; private final long deadline; private final String suffix; private final boolean workerRunning;
        long bytes, files, sources; Exception stop;
        OutputMeter(Path output, long deadline, String suffix, boolean workerRunning) {
            this.output = output; this.deadline = deadline; this.suffix = suffix; this.workerRunning = workerRunning;
        }
        @Override public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path directory, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
            return visit(directory, attributes);
        }
        @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
            return visit(file, attributes);
        }
        @Override public FileVisitResult visitFileFailed(Path file, IOException error) throws IOException {
            return vanished(error);
        }
        @Override public FileVisitResult postVisitDirectory(Path directory, IOException error) throws IOException {
            return error == null ? FileVisitResult.CONTINUE : vanished(error);
        }
        private FileVisitResult visit(Path path, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
            try { checkDeadline(deadline); }
            catch (InterruptedException | TimeoutException error) { stop = error; return FileVisitResult.TERMINATE; }
            if (!path.equals(output)) files++;
            if (attributes.isSymbolicLink()) throw new IOException("Worker emitted symbolic link");
            if (attributes.isRegularFile()) {
                long size = attributes.size(); bytes += size;
                if (size > 0 && path.toString().endsWith(suffix)) sources++;
            }
            return bytes > 128L * 1024 * 1024 || files > 20_000 ? FileVisitResult.TERMINATE : FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
        }
        /** An entry deleted between listing and visiting holds no budget; any other I/O error still fails the run. */
        private FileVisitResult vanished(IOException error) throws IOException {
            if (workerRunning && error instanceof NoSuchFileException) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            throw error;
        }
    }
    private static void checkDeadline(long deadline) throws InterruptedException, TimeoutException {
        if (Thread.interrupted()) throw new InterruptedException();
        if (System.nanoTime() >= deadline) throw new TimeoutException();
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/SafePaths.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;

/**
 * Phase 2DI: the link rule for paths the user names (an input, a corpus, an output folder). The folders above the named
 * item are the user's or the system's, not the target's: links there are followed once, by resolving the deepest
 * existing one with {@link Path#toRealPath}, so macOS's {@code /var -> /private/var} (where {@code java.io.tmpdir} lives)
 * or a user's own link to another disk are accepted, and every later check and write uses the resolved path. The named
 * item itself must not be a symbolic link or another special file (a Windows junction is a reparse point that NIO reports
 * as {@code isOther}). Links met inside a corpus, a dependency folder or a folder ClassRevive created are still refused
 * by the walks that read or write them; this class does not relax those.
 */
public final class SafePaths {
    private SafePaths() {}

    /**
     * Returns {@code path} absolute and normalized, with its parent folders resolved to their real location, and refuses
     * it when the item itself is a link or a special file. A missing item or missing parent folders are allowed (an output
     * folder about to be created); the caller still checks what must exist.
     */
    public static Path resolveParents(Path path) throws IOException {
        Path absolute = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path name = absolute.getFileName();
        if (name == null) return absolute;
        var missing = new ArrayDeque<Path>();
        Path existing = absolute.getParent();
        while (existing != null && !Files.exists(existing)) { missing.push(existing.getFileName()); existing = existing.getParent(); }
        Path resolved = existing == null ? absolute.getParent() : existing.toRealPath();
        while (!missing.isEmpty()) resolved = resolved.resolve(missing.pop());
        resolved = resolved.resolve(name);
        try {
            var attributes = Files.readAttributes(resolved, BasicFileAttributes.class, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
            if (attributes.isSymbolicLink() || attributes.isOther())
                throw new IOException("Linked or special paths are not supported: " + name);
        } catch (NoSuchFileException absent) { /* A new output does not exist yet. */ }
        return resolved;
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/engine/WorkerConcurrency.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

/**
 * How many worker JVMs one job runs at once. Each worker is capped at two processors and a 256 MiB heap, so half the
 * host processors, between 2 and 4, keeps the previous minimum of two while bounding memory to four workers.
 */
public final class WorkerConcurrency {
    public static final int MIN = 2, MAX = 4;
    private WorkerConcurrency() {}
    public static int limit() { return limit(Runtime.getRuntime().availableProcessors()); }
    static int limit(int processors) { return Math.max(MIN, Math.min(MAX, processors / 2)); }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.List;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class EngineCommandTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    @Test void heapGrowsWithTheInputButStaysCapped() throws Exception {
        var command = List.of("java", "-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-jar", "engine.jar");
        assertEquals("-Xmx256m", EngineCommand.sizedHeap(file("small.jar", 1024), command).get(1));
        assertEquals("-Xmx256m", EngineCommand.sizedHeap(file("edge.jar", EngineCommand.SMALL_INPUT), command).get(1));
        assertEquals("-Xmx512m", EngineCommand.sizedHeap(file("medium.jar", EngineCommand.SMALL_INPUT + 1), command).get(1));
        assertEquals("-Xmx1g", EngineCommand.sizedHeap(file("large.jar", EngineCommand.MEDIUM_INPUT + 1), command).get(1));
        assertEquals("-Xmx256m", EngineCommand.sizedHeap(dir.resolve("missing.jar"), command).get(1));
        // Every other argument is kept as is.
        assertEquals(List.of("java", "-Xmx1g", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-jar", "engine.jar"),
            EngineCommand.sizedHeap(file("huge.jar", 64L << 20), command));
    }

    private Path file(String name, long size) throws Exception {
        Path path = dir.resolve(name);
        try (var channel = java.nio.channels.FileChannel.open(path, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW, StandardOpenOption.WRITE)) {
            if (size > 0) channel.write(java.nio.ByteBuffer.wrap(new byte[] {0}), size - 1);
        }
        return path;
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class FailureCauseTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    @Test void recordsChainedCauseWithoutAbsoluteOrTargetDerivedPaths() {
        Path vanished = directory.resolve("run/sources/.jadx-state/tmp/jadx-instance-42/com/secret/Target.java");
        var error = new UncheckedIOException(new NoSuchFileException(vanished.toString()));
        String text = FailureCause.describe(error, directory.resolve("run"), directory.resolve("input.jar"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("host-side worker failure: java.io.UncheckedIOException"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("caused by: java.nio.file.NoSuchFileException"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("location=<run>/sources/.jadx-state/tmp/jadx-instance-42/<3 redacted segments>"), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains(directory.toString()), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains("secret") || text.contains("Target.java"), text);
    }
    @Test void keepsNoSegmentOfTargetOutputOutsideEngineState() {
        assertEquals("<run>/sources/<2 redacted segments>",
            FailureCause.location(directory.resolve("sources/demo/Sample.java").toString(), directory));
        assertEquals("<outside run directory>", FailureCause.location(directory.getParent().resolve("x").toString(), directory));
    }
    @Test void redactsPathsInsideMessages() {
        var error = new IllegalStateException("Cannot open " + directory.resolve("input.jar") + " for reading");
        String text = FailureCause.describe(error, directory.resolve("run"), directory.resolve("input.jar"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("Cannot open <input>/… for reading"), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains(directory.toString()), text);
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/engine/ProcessRunnerTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProcessRunnerTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    DecompilerEngine engine(String mode) {
        return new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "fixture"; }
            public String version() { return "1"; }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
                String cp;
                try { cp = Path.of(Worker.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()).toString(); }
                catch (Exception error) { throw new IllegalStateException(error); }
                return List.of(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(),
                    "-Xmx64m", "-cp", cp, Worker.class.getName(), mode, output.toString());
            }
        };
    }
    @Test void distinguishesNonzeroExit() {
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("fail"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.FAILED, result.status());
        assertEquals(7, result.exitCode());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void zeroExitWithoutSourcesIsNotRecovery() {
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("empty"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.NO_SOURCES, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NO_SOURCE_FILES, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void timesOutWorker() {
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("sleep"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofMillis(500));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.TIMED_OUT, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, result.diagnosticCode());
        assertTrue(Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - start).toSeconds() < 10);
    }
    @Test void drainsLargeLogsWithoutDeadlockingOrRetainingEverything() throws Exception {
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("noisy"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NONE, result.diagnosticCode());
        assertEquals(1, result.sourceFiles());
        assertTrue(Files.size(directory.resolve("out/engine.log")) <= 1024 * 1024);
    }
    @Test void handlesMissingExecutable() {
        var bad = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "bad"; }
            public String version() { return "1"; }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) { return List.of(directory.resolve("missing-executable").toString()); }
        };
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(bad, directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(1));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.FAILED, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_START_FAILED, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void classifiesWorkerDirectorySetupFailure() throws Exception {
        Path output = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("out"));
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("empty"), directory, output, Duration.ofSeconds(1));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.FAILED, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_SETUP_FAILED, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void stopsWorkerOverOutputBudget() {
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("oversize"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_LIMIT, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void emptyJavaFileIsNotSourceRecovery() {
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("blank"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.NO_SOURCES, result.status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NO_SOURCE_FILES, result.diagnosticCode());
    }
    @Test void entriesDeletedWhileTheWorkerRunsAreNotAFailure() throws Exception {
        // Engines delete their own state while running and at exit (JADX 1.5.3 removes .jadx-state/tmp in close());
        // the in-flight budget walk must not turn a vanished entry into WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE.
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(engine("churn"), directory, directory.resolve("out"), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status(), result + Files.readString(directory.resolve("out/engine.log")));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.NONE, result.diagnosticCode());
        assertEquals(1, result.sourceFiles());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(directory.resolve("out/sources/.state")));
    }
    @Test void cancellationWaitsForWorkerTermination() throws Exception {
        var result = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<EngineResult>();
        Path out = directory.resolve("out");
        Thread thread = new Thread(() -> result.set(new ProcessRunner().run(engine("pid"), directory, out, Duration.ofSeconds(30))));
        thread.start();
        try {
            Path pidFile = out.resolve("sources/pid.txt");
            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + Duration.ofSeconds(10).toNanos();
            while ((!Files.exists(pidFile) || Files.size(pidFile) == 0) && System.nanoTime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(20);
            assertTrue(Files.exists(pidFile));
            long pid = Long.parseLong(Files.readString(pidFile));
            thread.interrupt(); thread.join(7000);
            assertFalse(thread.isAlive());
            assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.CANCELLED, result.get().status());
            assertEquals(EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.CANCELLED, result.get().diagnosticCode());
            assertFalse(ProcessHandle.of(pid).map(ProcessHandle::isAlive).orElse(false));
        } finally { thread.interrupt(); thread.join(7000); }
    }
    public static class Worker {
        public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
            switch (args[0]) {
                case "fail" -> System.exit(7);
                case "sleep" -> Thread.sleep(60_000);
                case "oversize" -> {
                    try (var file = new java.io.RandomAccessFile(Path.of(args[1], "huge.txt").toFile(), "rw")) {
                        file.setLength(129L * 1024 * 1024);
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(60_000);
                }
                case "blank" -> Files.createFile(Path.of(args[1], "Blank.java"));
                case "pid" -> {
                    Files.writeString(Path.of(args[1], "pid.txt"), Long.toString(ProcessHandle.current().pid()));
                    Thread.sleep(60_000);
                }
                case "churn" -> {
                    Path state = Path.of(args[1], ".state");
                    long end = System.nanoTime() + Duration.ofSeconds(3).toNanos();
                    for (int round = 0; System.nanoTime() < end; round++) {
                        Path tmp = Files.createDirectories(state.resolve("tmp").resolve("instance-" + round));
                        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) Files.writeString(tmp.resolve("f" + i + ".java"), "x");
                        deleteTree(state);
                    }
                    Files.writeString(Path.of(args[1], "Sample.java"), "class Sample {}");
                }
                case "noisy" -> {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 5000; i++) System.out.println("x".repeat(1000));
                    Files.writeString(Path.of(args[1], "Sample.java"), "class Sample {}");
                }
                default -> { }
            }
        }
        static void deleteTree(Path root) throws java.io.IOException {
            try (var paths = Files.walk(root)) {
                for (Path path : paths.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList()) Files.delete(path);
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/engine-spi/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/engine/SafePathsTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.engine;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SafePathsTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    /** A link standing for a parent folder, as {@code /var -> /private/var} on macOS; skipped where links cannot be made. */
    static Path linkOrSkip(Path link, Path target) {
        try { return Files.createSymbolicLink(link, target); }
        catch (IOException | UnsupportedOperationException | SecurityException unavailable) {
            Assumptions.abort("Symbolic links unavailable here (Windows needs Developer Mode or the privilege): " + unavailable);
            return null;
        }
    }

    @Test void followsLinkedParentFoldersOnceAndKeepsMissingOnes() throws Exception {
        Path real = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("real"));
        Path alias = linkOrSkip(directory.resolve("alias"), real);
        assertEquals(real.toRealPath().resolve("result"), SafePaths.resolveParents(alias.resolve("result")));
        assertEquals(real.toRealPath().resolve("a/b/result"), SafePaths.resolveParents(alias.resolve("a/b/result")));
        assertEquals(real.toRealPath().resolve("result"), SafePaths.resolveParents(alias.resolve("x/../result")));
    }

    @Test void refusesTheNamedItemWhenItIsALink() throws Exception {
        Path real = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("real"));
        Path alias = linkOrSkip(directory.resolve("alias"), real);
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> SafePaths.resolveParents(alias));
        Path file = Files.writeString(real.resolve("input.jar"), "x");
        Path fileLink = linkOrSkip(directory.resolve("link.jar"), file);
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> SafePaths.resolveParents(fileLink));
        // Through a linked parent, the regular file itself is accepted.
        assertEquals(file.toRealPath(), SafePaths.resolveParents(alias.resolve("input.jar")));
    }

    /** Windows junctions need no privilege: one above the item is followed, the item itself being one is refused. */
    @Test void followsAParentJunctionAndRefusesAJunctionItem() throws Exception {
        Assumptions.assumeTrue(System.getProperty("os.name").startsWith("Windows"));
        Path real = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("real"));
        Path junction = directory.resolve("junction");
        var process = new ProcessBuilder("cmd.exe", "/c", "mklink", "/J", junction.toString(), real.toString()).redirectErrorStream(true).start();
        String message = new String(process.getInputStream().readAllBytes(), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        assertEquals(0, process.waitFor(), message);
        try {
            assertEquals(real.toRealPath().resolve("result"), SafePaths.resolveParents(junction.resolve("result")));
            assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> SafePaths.resolveParents(junction));
        } finally { Files.delete(junction); }
    }

    @Test void plainPathsAreOnlyNormalized() throws Exception {
        Path plain = directory.resolve("new/output");
        assertEquals(directory.toRealPath().resolve("new/output"), SafePaths.resolveParents(plain));
        Path root = directory.getRoot();
        assertEquals(root, SafePaths.resolveParents(root));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.vineflower;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.List;

public final class VineflowerEngine implements DecompilerEngine {
    public String id() { return "vineflower"; }
    public String version() { return "1.11.1"; }
    public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
        // Phase 2DG: Vineflower's bundled Kotlin plugin writes every class carrying @kotlin.Metadata as a .kt file, which
        // selection and javac never read; kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 gave 0 of 671 Kotlin files. Off, those classes come out as
        // Java like the other engines'. Classes without the annotation are not affected.
        return EngineCommand.sizedHeap(input, EngineCommand.javaJar(VineflowerEngine.class, "org/jetbrains/java/decompiler/main/decompiler/ConsoleDecompiler.class",
            "--kt-enable=0", "--folder", input.toString(), output.toString()));
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/ActivityPanel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import java.awt.*;
import java.time.*;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: a running decompile's stages and engines, live, with its log; the last run stays visible afterwards. */
final class ActivityPanel extends JPanel {
    private enum State { PENDING, RUNNING, DONE, SKIPPED }

    private final Map<JobListener.Stage,JLabel> stages = new EnumMap<>(JobListener.Stage.class);
    private final Map<JobListener.Stage,State> states = new EnumMap<>(JobListener.Stage.class);
    private final JPanel engines = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 6, 0));
    private final Map<String,Ui.Chip> engineChips = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final JProgressBar progress = new JProgressBar();
    private final JLabel headline = new JLabel(Text.t("activity.idle"));
    private final JLabel elapsed = Ui.muted("");
    private final JButton cancel;
    private final JTextArea log = new JTextArea();
    private final javax.swing.Timer clock;
    private Instant started;

    ActivityPanel(Action cancelAction) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        var top = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(Ui.GAP, 0));
        top.setBorder(Ui.padding(8, 12, 6, 12));
        headline.setFont(headline.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD));
        var left = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, Ui.GAP, 0));
        left.setOpaque(false);
        left.add(headline);
        left.add(elapsed);
        engines.setOpaque(false);
        left.add(engines);
        top.add(left, BorderLayout.WEST);
        progress.setIndeterminate(false);
        progress.setVisible(false);
        progress.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(180, 6));
        var right = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, Ui.GAP, 0));
        right.setOpaque(false);
        right.add(progress);
        cancel = new JButton(cancelAction);
        cancel.setVisible(false);
        right.add(cancel);
        top.add(right, BorderLayout.EAST);
        add(top, BorderLayout.NORTH);

        var steps = new JPanel(new GridLayout(0, 1, 0, 2));
        steps.setBorder(Ui.padding(4, 14, 8, 12));
        for (var stage : JobListener.Stage.values()) {
            var label = new JLabel(Text.t("stage." + stage.name()));
            stages.put(stage, label);
            states.put(stage, State.PENDING);
            steps.add(label);
        }
        var stepsBox = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        stepsBox.add(steps, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        stepsBox.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(300, 150));
        log.setEditable(false);
        log.setFont(Theme.codeFont(12));
        log.setBorder(Ui.padding(6, 8, 6, 8));
        var logScroll = new JScrollPane(log);
        logScroll.setBorder(Ui.line(0, 1, 0, 0));
        add(stepsBox, BorderLayout.WEST);
        add(logScroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        paintStages();
        clock = new javax.swing.Timer(500, event -> tick());
    }

    void start(String input, List<String> engineIds) {
        started = Instant.now();
        for (var stage : JobListener.Stage.values()) states.put(stage, State.PENDING);
        engines.removeAll();
        engineChips.clear();
        for (String id : engineIds) {
            var chip = Ui.chip(id + " · " + Text.t("activity.engine.waiting"), Theme.muted());
            engineChips.put(id, chip);
            engines.add(chip);
        }
        engines.revalidate();
        headline.setText(Text.t("activity.running", Ui.visible(input)));
        progress.setIndeterminate(true);
        progress.setVisible(true);
        cancel.setVisible(true);
        cancel.setEnabled(true);
        paintStages();
        append(Text.t("activity.log.start", Ui.visible(input), String.join(", ", engineIds)));
        clock.start();
        tick();
    }

    /** Back to "no decompile yet" for a newly opened input; the log keeps its history. */
    void reset() {
        if (clock.isRunning()) return;
        started = null;
        elapsed.setText("");
        for (var stage : JobListener.Stage.values()) states.put(stage, State.PENDING);
        engines.removeAll();
        engineChips.clear();
        engines.revalidate();
        headline.setText(Text.t("activity.idle"));
        paintStages();
    }

    void stage(JobListener.Stage stage) {
        for (var entry : states.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getValue() == State.RUNNING) entry.setValue(State.DONE);
            if (entry.getKey().ordinal() < stage.ordinal() && entry.getValue() == State.PENDING) entry.setValue(State.SKIPPED);
        }
        states.put(stage, State.RUNNING);
        paintStages();
        append(Text.t("stage." + stage.name()));
    }

    void engineStarted(String engine) {
        var chip = engineChips.get(engine);
        if (chip != null) chip.set(engine + " · " + Text.t("activity.engine.running"), Theme.ACCENT);
    }

    void engineFinished(EngineResult result) {
        var chip = engineChips.get(result.engine());
        boolean ok = result.status() == EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED;
        if (chip != null) chip.set(result.engine() + " · " + Text.t("engine." + result.status().name()),
            ok ? Theme.level(dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex.Level.CLOSE) : Theme.level(dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex.Level.PARTIAL));
        append(Text.t("activity.log.engine", result.engine(), Text.t("engine." + result.status().name()), result.sourceFiles(), result.elapsedMillis()));
    }

    /** Phase G5: a step outside the pipeline stages (the Skidfuscator reversal), as headline and log line. */
    void note(String text) {
        headline.setText(text);
        append(text);
    }

    void cancelling() {
        cancel.setEnabled(false);
        headline.setText(Text.t("activity.cancelling"));
        append(Text.t("activity.cancelling"));
    }

    /** {@code outcome} is the headline; {@code success} marks every remaining stage done or skipped. */
    void finish(String outcome, boolean success) {
        clock.stop();
        tick();
        for (var entry : states.entrySet()) {
            if (entry.getValue() == State.RUNNING) entry.setValue(success ? State.DONE : State.SKIPPED);
            else if (entry.getValue() == State.PENDING) entry.setValue(State.SKIPPED);
        }
        paintStages();
        headline.setText(outcome);
        progress.setIndeterminate(false);
        progress.setVisible(false);
        cancel.setVisible(false);
        append(outcome);
    }

    void append(String line) {
        log.append(LocalTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HH:mm:ss")) + "  " + line + "\n");
        log.setCaretPosition(log.getDocument().getLength());
    }

    private void tick() {
        if (started == null) return;
        long seconds = Duration.between(started, Instant.now()).toSeconds();
        elapsed.setText(String.format("%d:%02d", seconds / 60, seconds % 60));
    }

    private void paintStages() {
        for (var stage : JobListener.Stage.values()) {
            var label = stages.get(stage);
            switch (states.get(stage)) {
                case PENDING -> { label.setIcon(ring(Theme.muted(), false)); label.setForeground(Theme.muted()); }
                case RUNNING -> { label.setIcon(ring(Theme.ACCENT, true)); label.setForeground(Theme.foreground()); }
                case DONE -> { label.setIcon(check()); label.setForeground(Theme.foreground()); }
                case SKIPPED -> { label.setIcon(ring(Theme.line(), false)); label.setForeground(Theme.muted()); }
            }
        }
    }

    private static Icon ring(Color color, boolean filled) {
        return new Icon() {
            @Override public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
                var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
                g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
                g2.setColor(color);
                g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.5f));
                if (filled) g2.fillOval(x + 3, y + 3, 8, 8); else g2.drawOval(x + 3, y + 3, 8, 8);
                g2.dispose();
            }
            @Override public int getIconWidth() { return 14; }
            @Override public int getIconHeight() { return 14; }
        };
    }

    private static Icon check() {
        return new Icon() {
            @Override public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
                var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
                g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
                g2.setColor(Theme.ACCENT);
                g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(2f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
                g2.drawPolyline(new int[] {x + 3, x + 6, x + 11}, new int[] {y + 7, y + 10, y + 4}, 3);
                g2.dispose();
            }
            @Override public int getIconWidth() { return 14; }
            @Override public int getIconHeight() { return 14; }
        };
    }
}
```
