```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.geom.*;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.nio.file.*;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: starts the desktop application ({@code classrevive gui [file]} or the {@code classrevive-gui} launcher). */
public final class ClassReviveApp {
    public static final String VERSION = "0.1.0";

    private ClassReviveApp() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        if (GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless()) {
            System.err.println("ClassRevive desktop needs a graphical display. Use the command line instead: classrevive --help");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        launch(args.length > 0 ? Path.of(args[0]) : null);
    }

    /** Opens the main window on the event thread, then {@code file} when given; returns at once. */
    public static void launch(Path file) {
        var settings = GuiSettings.load();
        Text.use(settings.language());
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
            Theme.install(settings.theme());
            var window = new MainWindow(settings);
            window.setVisible(true);
            if (file != null) window.openPath(file.toAbsolutePath().normalize());
        });
    }

    /** The application logo at {@code size} pixels: a near-black rounded square with orange braces. */
    static Image logo(int size) {
        var image = new BufferedImage(size, size, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
        var g = image.createGraphics();
        g.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
        g.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, RenderingHints.VALUE_STROKE_PURE);
        g.scale(size / 64.0, size / 64.0);
        g.setPaint(new GradientPaint(0, 0, new Color(0x26262B), 64, 64, new Color(0x0E0E10)));
        g.fill(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(2, 2, 60, 60, 18, 18));
        g.setColor(new Color(0x3A3A40));
        g.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.5f));
        g.draw(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(2.75, 2.75, 58.5, 58.5, 17, 17));
        g.setPaint(new GradientPaint(0, 12, new Color(0xFFA54A), 0, 52, new Color(0xFF7A0F)));
        g.setStroke(new BasicStroke(5.2f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
        var left = new Path2D.Double();
        left.moveTo(24, 15); left.curveTo(17, 15, 18, 22, 18, 26); left.curveTo(18, 30, 16, 32, 13, 32);
        left.curveTo(16, 32, 18, 34, 18, 38); left.curveTo(18, 42, 17, 49, 24, 49);
        g.draw(left);
        var right = new Path2D.Double();
        right.moveTo(40, 15); right.curveTo(47, 15, 46, 22, 46, 26); right.curveTo(46, 30, 48, 32, 51, 32);
        right.curveTo(48, 32, 46, 34, 46, 38); right.curveTo(46, 42, 47, 49, 40, 49);
        g.draw(right);
        g.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(28.5, 28.5, 7, 7));
        g.dispose();
        return image;
    }

    /** A file of the installed distribution's {@code docs/} folder, or null when running from a build tree without it. */
    static Path installedDoc(String name) {
        try {
            Path jar = Path.of(ClassReviveApp.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI());
            Path doc = jar.getParent() == null || jar.getParent().getParent() == null ? null : jar.getParent().getParent().resolve("docs").resolve(name);
            return doc != null && Files.isRegularFile(doc) ? doc : null;
        } catch (Exception unknown) {
            return null;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/CodeTab.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import javax.swing.*;
import org.fife.ui.rsyntaxtextarea.*;
import org.fife.ui.rsyntaxtextarea.parser.*;
import org.fife.ui.rtextarea.*;

/**
 * Phase G3: one editor tab. A class shows the selected source, any engine's version or its bytecode; a resource shows its
 * text. Content is read off the event thread; the editor is read-only.
 */
final class CodeTab extends JPanel {
    /** One way to look at the tab's subject; {@code id} is a result candidate, {@link #BYTECODE} or {@link #RESOURCE}. */
    record View(String id, String label) { @Override public String toString() { return label; } }
    static final String BYTECODE = "bytecode", RESOURCE = "resource";
    static final long MAX_SOURCE_BYTES = 8L * 1024 * 1024;

    final String key;
    private final Workspace workspace;
    private final Workspace.ClassItem item;
    private final Workspace.ResourceItem resource;
    private final GuiSettings settings;
    private final Consumer<String> status;
    private final RSyntaxTextArea area = new RSyntaxTextArea();
    private final RTextScrollPane scroll = new RTextScrollPane(area, true);
    private final JComboBox<View> views = new JComboBox<>();
    private final Ui.Chip level = Ui.chip("", Color.GRAY);
    private final FindBar find = new FindBar(area);
    private final JLabel hint = Ui.muted("");
    private final JLabel viewLabel = Ui.muted(Text.t("code.view"));
    private SwingWorker<String,Void> loading;
    private int pendingLine = -1;
    private final EvidenceParser parser = new EvidenceParser();
    private Navigator navigator = name -> { };
    private Map<String,String> imports = Map.of();
    private int pendingCaret = -1;
    private Locator pendingLocator;
    private int evidenceIcons, firstEvidenceLine;

    /** Phase G6: finds a 1-based line in the text of a view (-1 when not found). */
    interface Locator { int line(String viewId, String text); }

    /** Phase G4: what a Ctrl+click on a class name asks the window to do. */
    interface Navigator { void openClass(String className); }

    static CodeTab forClass(Workspace workspace, Workspace.ClassItem item, GuiSettings settings, Consumer<String> status) {
        return new CodeTab("class:" + item.name(), workspace, item, null, settings, status);
    }

    static CodeTab forResource(Workspace workspace, Workspace.ResourceItem resource, GuiSettings settings, Consumer<String> status) {
        return new CodeTab("resource:" + resource.entry(), workspace, null, resource, settings, status);
    }

    private CodeTab(String key, Workspace workspace, Workspace.ClassItem item, Workspace.ResourceItem resource, GuiSettings settings, Consumer<String> status) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        this.key = key; this.workspace = workspace; this.item = item; this.resource = resource; this.settings = settings; this.status = status;
        area.setEditable(false);
        area.setCodeFoldingEnabled(true);
        area.setMarkOccurrences(true);
        area.setHighlightCurrentLine(true);
        area.setAntiAliasingEnabled(true);
        area.setAnimateBracketMatching(false);
        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        scroll.setFoldIndicatorEnabled(true);
        // Phase G4: evidence icons per method, javac errors as underlines with an overview strip, Ctrl+click on class names.
        scroll.setIconRowHeaderEnabled(true);
        area.addParser(parser);
        area.setHyperlinksEnabled(true);
        area.setLinkGenerator(this::link);
        area.addCaretListener(event -> status.accept(caretText()));
        // Phase G6: a right click puts the caret on the word under the mouse, so the context menu acts on it.
        area.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mousePressed(MouseEvent event) {
                if (!SwingUtilities.isRightMouseButton(event) && !event.isPopupTrigger()) return;
                int offset = area.viewToModel2D(event.getPoint());
                if (offset >= 0 && (area.getSelectionStart() == area.getSelectionEnd() || offset < area.getSelectionStart() || offset > area.getSelectionEnd()))
                    area.setCaretPosition(offset);
            }
        });

        var header = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(Ui.GAP, 0));
        header.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(Ui.bottomLine(), Ui.padding(6, 12, 6, 8)));
        var name = new JLabel();
        if (item != null) {
            char kind = ExplorerPanel.kind(item);
            name.setIcon(Icons.kind(kind, ExplorerPanel.kindColor(kind), null));
            String pkg = item.packageName();
            name.setText("<html>" + (pkg.isEmpty() ? "" : "<span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(pkg) + ".</span>")
                + "<b>" + Ui.escape(item.simpleName()) + "</b></html>");
        } else {
            name.setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.RESOURCE, 14));
            name.setText(Ui.visible(resource.entry()));
        }
        var left = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, Ui.GAP, 0));
        left.setOpaque(false);
        left.add(name);
        left.add(level);
        left.add(hint);
        header.add(left, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        var right = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 6, 0));
        right.setOpaque(false);
        right.add(viewLabel);
        views.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.MINIMUM_WIDTH, 170);
        right.add(views);
        header.add(right, BorderLayout.EAST);
        add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        var editor = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        editor.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        editor.add(new ErrorStrip(area), BorderLayout.EAST);
        add(editor, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        add(find, BorderLayout.SOUTH);

        bind("ctrl F", "find", find::open);
        bind("F3", "next", () -> find.step(true));
        bind("shift F3", "previous", () -> find.step(false));
        bind("ctrl G", "line", this::askLine);
        bind("ESCAPE", "closeFind", find::close);
        views.addActionListener(event -> { if (!adjusting && views.getSelectedItem() instanceof View view) load(view); });
        applyLook();
        refreshViews();
    }

    private void bind(String key, String name, Runnable run) {
        getInputMap(WHEN_ANCESTOR_OF_FOCUSED_COMPONENT).put(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(key), name);
        getActionMap().put(name, new AbstractAction() { @Override public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) { run.run(); } });
    }

    String title() { return item != null ? Ui.visible(item.simpleName()) : Ui.visible(resource.entry().substring(resource.entry().lastIndexOf('/') + 1)); }
    String tooltip() { return item != null ? Ui.visible(item.name().replace('/', '.')) : Ui.visible(resource.entry()); }
    Workspace.ClassItem classItem() { return item; }
    void navigator(Navigator navigator) { this.navigator = navigator; }
    /** The caret offset, for the back/forward history. */
    int caret() { return area.getCaretPosition(); }
    /** Puts the caret at {@code offset} once the content is there. */
    void caret(int offset) {
        pendingCaret = offset;
        if (loading == null || loading.isDone()) applyPendingCaret();
    }
    /** For tests: how many methods got an evidence icon, and the link a Ctrl+click at {@code offset} would follow. */
    int evidenceIcons() { return evidenceIcons; }
    int firstEvidenceLine() { return firstEvidenceLine; }
    LinkGeneratorResult linkAt(int offset) { return link(area, offset); }

    String viewId() { return views.getSelectedItem() instanceof View view ? view.id() : null; }

    /** Re-lists the views (a decompile just finished) keeping the current choice when it still exists. */
    void refreshViews() {
        var current = (View) views.getSelectedItem();
        var list = new ArrayList<View>();
        if (resource != null) list.add(new View(RESOURCE, Text.t("code.view.resource")));
        else {
            var result = workspace.result();
            if (result != null) for (String candidate : result.candidates())
                list.add(new View(candidate, candidate.equals(ResultIndex.SELECTION) ? Text.t("code.view.selected") : engineLabel(result, candidate)));
            list.add(new View(BYTECODE, Text.t("code.view.bytecode")));
        }
        var evidence = item == null ? Optional.<ResultIndex.ClassEntry>empty() : workspace.evidence(item.name());
        level.setVisible(evidence.isPresent() && evidence.get().level() != null);
        evidence.ifPresent(entry -> { if (entry.level() != null) level.set(Text.t("level." + entry.level().name()), Theme.level(entry.level())); });
        hint.setText(item != null && workspace.result() == null ? Text.t("code.notDecompiled") : "");
        hint.setVisible(!hint.getText().isEmpty());
        View keep = current == null || views.getItemCount() <= 1 ? null : list.stream().filter(view -> view.id().equals(current.id())).findFirst().orElse(null);
        adjusting = true;
        views.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(list.toArray(View[]::new)));
        views.setSelectedItem(keep != null ? keep : list.getFirst());
        adjusting = false;
        views.setVisible(list.size() > 1);
        viewLabel.setVisible(list.size() > 1);
        // A new view list after a decompile switches a bytecode-only tab to the selected source.
        load((View) views.getSelectedItem());
    }
    private boolean adjusting;

    private static String engineLabel(ResultIndex result, String id) {
        return result.engines().stream().filter(engine -> engine.id().equals(id)).findFirst()
            .map(engine -> Character.toUpperCase(id.charAt(0)) + id.substring(1) + " " + engine.version()).orElse(id);
    }

    void select(String viewId) {
        for (int i = 0; i < views.getItemCount(); i++) if (views.getItemAt(i).id().equals(viewId)) { views.setSelectedIndex(i); return; }
    }

    /** Phase G6: moves to the line {@code locator} finds once the content is there; not found, the class's declaration. */
    void reveal(Locator locator) {
        pendingLocator = locator;
        if (loading == null || loading.isDone()) applyPendingLocator();
    }

    private void applyPendingLocator() {
        var locator = pendingLocator;
        pendingLocator = null;
        if (locator == null) return;
        int line = locator.line(viewId(), area.getText());
        if (line > 0) { pendingLine = line; applyPendingLine(); } else revealDeclaration();
    }

    /** Phase G6: the find usages and call hierarchy actions, first in the editor's context menu. */
    void contextActions(List<Action> actions) {
        var menu = area.getPopupMenu();
        if (menu == null) return;
        int at = 0;
        for (var action : actions) menu.insert(action, at++);
        menu.insert(new JPopupMenu.Separator(), at);
    }

    /** Phase G6: the input's class a simple name written in this tab means, by the Phase G4 rules, or null. */
    String resolveClass(String simple) { return item == null ? null : resolve(simple); }

    /** Phase G6: the text of the caret's line. */
    String caretLine() {
        try {
            int line = area.getCaretLineNumber();
            int start = area.getLineStartOffset(line), end = area.getLineEndOffset(line);
            return area.getText(start, end - start).stripTrailing();
        } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException outside) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    /** Moves to a 1-based line once the content is there. */
    void goToLine(int line) {
        pendingLine = line;
        if (loading == null || loading.isDone()) applyPendingLine();
    }

    private void load(View view) {
        if (view == null) return;
        if (loading != null) loading.cancel(true);
        area.setText(Text.t("code.loading"));
        area.setSyntaxEditingStyle(SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE);
        loading = new SwingWorker<>() {
            String style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_JAVA;
            @Override protected String doInBackground() throws Exception {
                if (view.id().equals(RESOURCE)) {
                    byte[] bytes = workspace.entryBytes(resource.entry());
                    if (binary(bytes)) { style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE; return Text.t("code.binary", bytes.length); }
                    style = styleFor(resource.entry());
                    return new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                }
                if (view.id().equals(BYTECODE)) { style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE; return workspace.bytecode(item); }
                Path source = workspace.source(item.name(), view.id()).orElse(null);
                if (source == null) { style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE; return Text.t("code.noSource", view.label()); }
                if (Files.size(source) > MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) { style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE; return Text.t("code.tooLarge", source.getFileName()); }
                return Files.readString(source, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            }
            @Override protected void done() {
                // A newer load may have started after this one finished but before its result arrived: only the latest applies.
                if (isCancelled() || loading != this) return;
                String text;
                try { text = get(); }
                catch (Exception failure) {
                    Throwable cause = failure.getCause() == null ? failure : failure.getCause();
                    style = SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE;
                    text = Text.t("code.failed", String.valueOf(cause.getMessage()));
                }
                area.setSyntaxEditingStyle(style);
                area.setText(text);
                area.discardAllEdits();
                decorate(view, text);
                if (pendingCaret >= 0) applyPendingCaret();
                else if (pendingLocator != null) applyPendingLocator();
                else if (pendingLine > 0) applyPendingLine();
                else revealDeclaration();
            }
        };
        loading.execute();
    }

    private void applyPendingCaret() {
        int offset = pendingCaret;
        pendingCaret = -1;
        if (offset < 0) return;
        area.setCaretPosition(Math.min(offset, area.getDocument().getLength()));
        centerCaret();
    }

    /**
     * Phase G4: in the selected source, a gutter icon on each measured method of every class this file declares (its
     * round trip outcome) and the file's javac errors as underlines. Other views get neither: the evidence is about the
     * selected source only.
     */
    private void decorate(View view, String text) {
        scroll.getGutter().removeAllTrackingIcons();
        evidenceIcons = 0;
        firstEvidenceLine = 0;
        parser.diagnostics = List.of();
        imports = imports(text);
        var result = workspace.result();
        if (item != null && result != null && view.id().equals(ResultIndex.SELECTION)) {
            var source = workspace.source(item.name(), ResultIndex.SELECTION).orElse(null);
            if (source != null) {
                String file = result.output().resolve(ResultIndex.SELECTION).resolve("sources").relativize(source).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                var methods = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<String>>();
                for (var entry : result.classes().values()) if (entry.file().equals(file) && !entry.methods().isEmpty()) methods.put(entry.className(), List.copyOf(entry.methods().keySet()));
                var lines = MethodLocator.locate(text, methods);
                lines.forEach((className, found) -> found.forEach((method, line) -> {
                    var outcome = result.classes().get(className).methods().get(method);
                    try {
                        scroll.getGutter().addLineTrackingIcon(line - 1, Icons.dot(outcomeColor(outcome), 10),
                            Text.t("evidence.method", Descriptors.pretty(className, method), Text.t("outcome." + outcome.name())));
                        evidenceIcons++;
                        if (firstEvidenceLine == 0 || line < firstEvidenceLine) firstEvidenceLine = line;
                    } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException ignored) { }
                }));
                parser.diagnostics = result.diagnostics(file);
            }
        }
        area.forceReparsing(parser);
    }

    static Color outcomeColor(ResultIndex.Outcome outcome) {
        return switch (outcome) {
            case IDENTICAL -> Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT);
            case EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION -> Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.CLOSE);
            case DIFFERENT -> Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.UNVERIFIED);
        };
    }

    /** {@code import a.b.C;} lines: simple name to internal name. */
    private static Map<String,String> imports(String text) {
        var found = new HashMap<String,String>();
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*import\\s+([\\w.]+)\\.(\\w+)\\s*;").matcher(text);
        while (matcher.find()) found.put(matcher.group(2), matcher.group(1).replace('.', '/') + "/" + matcher.group(2));
        return found;
    }

    /** Phase G4: Ctrl+click on a class name of this input opens it; JDK and library names are not links. */
    private LinkGeneratorResult link(RSyntaxTextArea text, int offset) {
        if (item == null) return null;
        Token token = text.modelToToken(offset);
        if (token == null || !token.isIdentifier()) return null;
        String word = token.getLexeme();
        if (word.isEmpty() || !Character.isUpperCase(word.charAt(0))) return null;
        String target = resolve(word);
        if (target == null || target.equals(item.name())) return null;
        int start = token.getOffset();
        return new LinkGeneratorResult() {
            @Override public javax.swing.event.HyperlinkEvent execute() {
                navigator.openClass(target);
                return new javax.swing.event.HyperlinkEvent(area, javax.swing.event.HyperlinkEvent.EventType.ACTIVATED, null, target);
            }
            @Override public int getSourceOffset() { return start; }
        };
    }

    /** The input's class a simple name means here: an explicit import, then this package, then a unique name. */
    private String resolve(String simple) {
        var candidates = workspace.classesNamed(simple);
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return null;
        String imported = imports.get(simple);
        // Imports name the classes as the engines saw them (portable names); the tree uses the input's own names.
        if (imported != null) { String original = workspace.originalOf(imported); return candidates.contains(original) ? original : null; }
        String pkg = item.name().contains("/") ? item.name().substring(0, item.name().lastIndexOf('/') + 1) : "";
        String outer = item.name().contains("$") ? item.name().substring(0, item.name().indexOf('$')) : item.name();
        for (String name : candidates) if (name.startsWith(outer + "$")) return name;
        for (String name : candidates) if (name.startsWith(pkg) && name.indexOf('/', pkg.length()) < 0 && !name.substring(pkg.length()).contains("$")) return name;
        return candidates.size() == 1 ? candidates.getFirst() : null;
    }

    private final class EvidenceParser extends AbstractParser {
        List<ResultIndex.Diagnostic> diagnostics = List.of();
        @Override public ParseResult parse(RSyntaxDocument document, String style) {
            var result = new DefaultParseResult(this);
            var root = document.getDefaultRootElement();
            for (var diagnostic : diagnostics) {
                int line = (int) diagnostic.line() - 1;
                if (line < 0 || line >= root.getElementCount()) continue;
                var element = root.getElement(line);
                int start = element.getStartOffset(), end = Math.max(start, element.getEndOffset() - 1);
                int offset = diagnostic.column() > 0 ? Math.min(end, start + (int) diagnostic.column() - 1) : start;
                int length = 0;
                try {
                    String rest = document.getText(offset, end - offset);
                    while (length < rest.length() && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(rest.charAt(length))) length++;
                    if (length == 0) length = Math.max(1, rest.stripTrailing().length());
                } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException ignored) { length = 1; }
                var notice = new DefaultParserNotice(this, Text.t("diagnostic.tooltip", diagnostic.message()), line, offset, length);
                notice.setLevel(ParserNotice.Level.ERROR);
                result.addNotice(notice);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    private void applyPendingLine() {
        int line = pendingLine;
        pendingLine = -1;
        if (line <= 0) return;
        try {
            int index = Math.min(line, area.getLineCount()) - 1;
            // Caret at the line's first character, no selection: a selection would hide a javac error's underline.
            int start = area.getLineStartOffset(index), end = area.getLineEndOffset(index);
            String text = area.getText(start, end - start);
            area.setCaretPosition(start + (text.length() - text.stripLeading().length()));
            centerCaret();
        } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException ignored) { }
    }

    /** Nested classes share their outer class's file: put the caret on this one's declaration. */
    private void revealDeclaration() {
        area.setCaretPosition(0);
        if (item == null || !item.name().contains("$")) return;
        String simple = item.simpleName().substring(item.simpleName().lastIndexOf('$') + 1);
        if (simple.isEmpty() || Character.isDigit(simple.charAt(0))) return;
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\b(class|interface|enum|record)\\s+" + Pattern.quote(simple) + "\\b").matcher(area.getText());
        if (matcher.find()) { area.setCaretPosition(matcher.start()); centerCaret(); }
    }

    private void centerCaret() {
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> {
            try {
                var rect = area.modelToView2D(area.getCaretPosition()).getBounds();
                var viewport = scroll.getViewport();
                int y = Math.max(0, rect.y - viewport.getExtentSize().height / 3);
                viewport.setViewPosition(new Point(0, Math.min(y, Math.max(0, area.getHeight() - viewport.getExtentSize().height))));
            } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException ignored) { }
        });
    }

    private void askLine() {
        String answer = JOptionPane.showInputDialog(this, Text.t("code.goToLine", area.getLineCount()), Text.t("code.goToLine.title"), JOptionPane.PLAIN_MESSAGE);
        if (answer == null) return;
        try { goToLine(Integer.parseInt(answer.strip())); } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
    }

    String caretText() {
        int line = area.getCaretLineNumber() + 1, column = area.getCaretOffsetFromLineStart() + 1;
        return Text.t("code.caret", line, column);
    }

    /** Colors and font for the current theme and font size. */
    void applyLook() {
        String file = Theme.dark() ? "dark.xml" : "idea.xml";
        try (var in = RSyntaxTextArea.class.getResourceAsStream("/org/fife/ui/rsyntaxtextarea/themes/" + file)) {
            org.fife.ui.rsyntaxtextarea.Theme.load(in).apply(area);
        } catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException ignored) { }
        area.setFont(Theme.codeFont(settings.fontSize()));
        scroll.getGutter().setLineNumberFont(Theme.codeFont(Math.max(GuiSettings.MIN_FONT, settings.fontSize() - 1)));
        if (Theme.dark()) darkScheme(area);
        if (Theme.dark()) {
            Color background = Theme.editor();
            area.setBackground(background);
            area.setCurrentLineHighlightColor(new Color(0x18181B));
            area.setSelectionColor(new Color(0x5A2C08));
            area.setCaretColor(Theme.ACCENT);
            area.setMarkOccurrencesColor(new Color(0x3A2410));
            area.setMatchedBracketBGColor(new Color(0x3A2410));
            area.setMatchedBracketBorderColor(Theme.ACCENT);
            scroll.getGutter().setBackground(background);
            scroll.getGutter().setLineNumberColor(new Color(0x55555C));
            scroll.getGutter().setCurrentLineNumberColor(Theme.ACCENT);
        }
        scroll.getGutter().setBorderColor(Theme.line());
        find.updateUI();
    }

    /** Near-black editor colors with keywords in the orange accent; shared with the comparison view. */
    static void darkScheme(RSyntaxTextArea area) {
        var scheme = area.getSyntaxScheme();
        color(scheme, Token.RESERVED_WORD, 0xFF8A1F);
        color(scheme, Token.RESERVED_WORD_2, 0xFF8A1F);
        color(scheme, Token.DATA_TYPE, 0xFFB366);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_STRING_DOUBLE_QUOTE, 0xA6D189);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_CHAR, 0xA6D189);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_NUMBER_DECIMAL_INT, 0xE5C07B);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_NUMBER_FLOAT, 0xE5C07B);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_NUMBER_HEXADECIMAL, 0xE5C07B);
        color(scheme, Token.LITERAL_BOOLEAN, 0xFF8A1F);
        color(scheme, Token.ANNOTATION, 0xC0A0F0);
        color(scheme, Token.COMMENT_EOL, 0x6B6B73);
        color(scheme, Token.COMMENT_MULTILINE, 0x6B6B73);
        color(scheme, Token.COMMENT_DOCUMENTATION, 0x7A7A82);
        color(scheme, Token.IDENTIFIER, 0xE4E4E7);
        color(scheme, Token.FUNCTION, 0xE4E4E7);
        color(scheme, Token.OPERATOR, 0xC8C8CE);
        color(scheme, Token.SEPARATOR, 0xC8C8CE);
        area.setSyntaxScheme(scheme);
    }

    private static void color(SyntaxScheme scheme, int type, int rgb) {
        var style = scheme.getStyle(type);
        if (style != null) style.foreground = new Color(rgb);
    }

    void focusEditor() { area.requestFocusInWindow(); }
    void openFind() { find.open(); }
    String content() { return area.getText(); }

    private static boolean binary(byte[] bytes) {
        int limit = Math.min(bytes.length, 8192);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) if (bytes[i] == 0) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static String styleFor(String entry) {
        String name = entry.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (name.endsWith(".java")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_JAVA;
        if (name.endsWith(".xml") || name.endsWith(".xsd") || name.endsWith(".pom")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_XML;
        if (name.endsWith(".properties")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_PROPERTIES_FILE;
        if (name.endsWith(".json")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_JSON;
        if (name.endsWith(".html") || name.endsWith(".htm")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_HTML;
        if (name.endsWith(".yml") || name.endsWith(".yaml")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_YAML;
        if (name.endsWith(".js")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_JAVASCRIPT;
        if (name.endsWith(".kt") || name.endsWith(".kts")) return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_KOTLIN;
        return SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_NONE;
    }

    /** Find in this tab: Enter for next, Shift+Enter for previous, all matches marked. */
    static final class FindBar extends JPanel {
        private final RSyntaxTextArea area;
        private final JTextField field = new JTextField(24);
        private final JToggleButton matchCase = new JToggleButton("Aa");
        private final JLabel count = Ui.muted("");

        FindBar(RSyntaxTextArea area) {
            super(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 6, 4));
            this.area = area;
            setBorder(Ui.topLine());
            setVisible(false);
            field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, Text.t("find.placeholder"));
            field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_LEADING_ICON, Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.SEARCH, 14));
            matchCase.setToolTipText(Text.t("find.matchCase"));
            matchCase.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
            var previous = new JButton("↑"); var next = new JButton("↓"); var close = new JButton("✕");
            for (var button : List.of(previous, next, close)) button.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
            previous.setToolTipText(Text.t("find.previous")); next.setToolTipText(Text.t("find.next")); close.setToolTipText(Text.t("find.close"));
            add(field); add(matchCase); add(previous); add(next); add(count); add(close);
            previous.addActionListener(e -> step(false));
            next.addActionListener(e -> step(true));
            close.addActionListener(e -> close());
            matchCase.addActionListener(e -> mark());
            field.getDocument().addDocumentListener(new javax.swing.event.DocumentListener() {
                @Override public void insertUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { mark(); }
                @Override public void removeUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { mark(); }
                @Override public void changedUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { mark(); }
            });
            field.addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() {
                @Override public void keyPressed(KeyEvent event) {
                    if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_ENTER) step(!event.isShiftDown());
                    if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE) close();
                }
            });
        }

        void open() {
            setVisible(true);
            String selected = area.getSelectedText();
            if (selected != null && !selected.contains("\n")) field.setText(selected);
            field.requestFocusInWindow();
            field.selectAll();
            revalidate();
        }

        void close() {
            if (!isVisible()) return;
            setVisible(false);
            SearchEngine.markAll(area, new SearchContext());
            area.requestFocusInWindow();
        }

        private SearchContext context(boolean forward) {
            var context = new SearchContext(field.getText(), matchCase.isSelected());
            context.setSearchForward(forward);
            context.setMarkAll(true);
            context.setSearchWrap(true);
            return context;
        }

        private void mark() {
            if (field.getText().isEmpty()) { SearchEngine.markAll(area, new SearchContext()); count.setText(""); field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.OUTLINE, null); return; }
            var result = SearchEngine.markAll(area, context(true));
            show(result.getMarkedCount());
        }

        void step(boolean forward) {
            if (!isVisible()) { open(); return; }
            if (field.getText().isEmpty()) return;
            var result = SearchEngine.find(area, context(forward));
            show(result.getMarkedCount());
        }

        private void show(int matches) {
            count.setText(matches == 0 ? Text.t("find.none") : Text.t("find.count", matches));
            field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.OUTLINE, matches == 0 ? FlatClientProperties.OUTLINE_ERROR : null);
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/CompareTab.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.*;
import org.fife.ui.rsyntaxtextarea.*;
import org.fife.ui.rtextarea.RTextScrollPane;

/**
 * Phase G4: one class's source in two candidates (the selected source and any engine), aligned line by line with the
 * differences colored, both sides scrolling together. Read-only; the diff runs off the event thread.
 */
final class CompareTab extends JPanel {
    final String key;
    private final Workspace workspace;
    private final Workspace.ClassItem item;
    private final JComboBox<CodeTab.View> left = new JComboBox<>(), right = new JComboBox<>();
    private final RSyntaxTextArea leftArea = area(), rightArea = area();
    private final RTextScrollPane leftScroll = new RTextScrollPane(leftArea), rightScroll = new RTextScrollPane(rightArea);
    private final JLabel summary = Ui.muted("");
    private final GuiSettings settings;
    private SwingWorker<LineDiff.Aligned,Void> running;

    CompareTab(Workspace workspace, Workspace.ClassItem item, GuiSettings settings) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        this.key = "compare:" + item.name();
        this.workspace = workspace;
        this.item = item;
        this.settings = settings;
        var result = workspace.result();
        var views = new ArrayList<CodeTab.View>();
        for (String candidate : result.candidates())
            views.add(new CodeTab.View(candidate, candidate.equals(ResultIndex.SELECTION) ? Text.t("code.view.selected") : candidate));
        left.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(views.toArray(CodeTab.View[]::new)));
        right.setModel(new DefaultComboBoxModel<>(views.toArray(CodeTab.View[]::new)));
        left.setSelectedIndex(0);
        right.setSelectedIndex(Math.min(1, views.size() - 1));

        var header = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(Ui.GAP, 0));
        header.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(Ui.bottomLine(), Ui.padding(6, 12, 6, 12)));
        var title = new JLabel("<html>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("compare.title")) + " &nbsp;<b>" + Ui.escape(item.simpleName()) + "</b></html>");
        title.setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.COMPARE, 14));
        header.add(title, BorderLayout.WEST);
        var pickers = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 6, 0));
        pickers.setOpaque(false);
        pickers.add(summary);
        pickers.add(Box.createHorizontalStrut(12));
        pickers.add(left);
        pickers.add(Ui.muted("↔"));
        pickers.add(right);
        header.add(pickers, BorderLayout.EAST);
        add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH);

        // Rows are aligned with filler lines, so source line numbers would mislead: none are shown.
        for (var scroll : List.of(leftScroll, rightScroll)) { scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder()); scroll.setLineNumbersEnabled(false); }
        // One vertical model for both sides: the aligned rows stay side by side.
        rightScroll.getVerticalScrollBar().setModel(leftScroll.getVerticalScrollBar().getModel());
        var split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, leftScroll, rightScroll);
        split.setResizeWeight(0.5);
        split.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        add(split, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        left.addActionListener(e -> compare());
        right.addActionListener(e -> compare());
        applyLook();
        compare();
    }

    String title() { return Text.t("compare.tab", Ui.visible(item.simpleName())); }

    private static RSyntaxTextArea area() {
        var area = new RSyntaxTextArea();
        area.setEditable(false);
        area.setSyntaxEditingStyle(SyntaxConstants.SYNTAX_STYLE_JAVA);
        area.setCodeFoldingEnabled(false);
        area.setHighlightCurrentLine(false);
        area.setAntiAliasingEnabled(true);
        return area;
    }

    private void compare() {
        if (!(left.getSelectedItem() instanceof CodeTab.View a) || !(right.getSelectedItem() instanceof CodeTab.View b)) return;
        if (running != null) running.cancel(true);
        summary.setText(Text.t("compare.running"));
        running = new SwingWorker<>() {
            @Override protected LineDiff.Aligned doInBackground() throws Exception { return LineDiff.align(read(a), read(b)); }
            @Override protected void done() {
                if (isCancelled()) return;
                try { show(get()); }
                catch (Exception failure) { summary.setText(Text.t("compare.failed", String.valueOf(failure.getMessage()))); }
            }
        };
        running.execute();
    }

    private String read(CodeTab.View view) throws java.io.IOException {
        Path source = workspace.source(item.name(), view.id()).orElse(null);
        if (source == null) return Text.t("code.noSource", view.label()) + "\n";
        if (Files.size(source) > CodeTab.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES) return Text.t("code.tooLarge", source.getFileName()) + "\n";
        return Files.readString(source, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }

    private void show(LineDiff.Aligned aligned) {
        leftArea.setText(aligned.leftText());
        rightArea.setText(aligned.rightText());
        leftArea.removeAllLineHighlights();
        rightArea.removeAllLineHighlights();
        Color changed = tint(Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.PER_FILE)), removed = tint(Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.UNVERIFIED)),
            added = tint(Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT)), filler = tint(Theme.muted());
        for (int row = 0; row < aligned.kinds().size(); row++) {
            try {
                switch (aligned.kinds().get(row)) {
                    case CHANGED -> { leftArea.addLineHighlight(row, changed); rightArea.addLineHighlight(row, changed); }
                    case REMOVED -> { leftArea.addLineHighlight(row, removed); rightArea.addLineHighlight(row, filler); }
                    case ADDED -> { leftArea.addLineHighlight(row, filler); rightArea.addLineHighlight(row, added); }
                    case SAME -> { }
                }
            } catch (javax.swing.text.BadLocationException ignored) { }
        }
        leftArea.setCaretPosition(0);
        rightArea.setCaretPosition(0);
        long differences = aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.CHANGED) + aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.REMOVED) + aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.ADDED);
        summary.setText(differences == 0 ? Text.t("compare.same") : Text.t("compare.summary", aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.CHANGED),
            aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.REMOVED), aligned.count(LineDiff.Kind.ADDED)));
    }

    private static Color tint(Color color) { return new Color(color.getRed(), color.getGreen(), color.getBlue(), Theme.dark() ? 46 : 52); }

    void applyLook() {
        for (var area : List.of(leftArea, rightArea)) {
            String file = Theme.dark() ? "dark.xml" : "idea.xml";
            try (var in = RSyntaxTextArea.class.getResourceAsStream("/org/fife/ui/rsyntaxtextarea/themes/" + file)) {
                org.fife.ui.rsyntaxtextarea.Theme.load(in).apply(area);
            } catch (java.io.IOException | RuntimeException ignored) { }
            area.setFont(Theme.codeFont(settings.fontSize()));
            if (Theme.dark()) { CodeTab.darkScheme(area); area.setBackground(Theme.editor()); }
        }
        for (var scroll : List.of(leftScroll, rightScroll)) {
            scroll.getGutter().setLineNumberFont(Theme.codeFont(Math.max(GuiSettings.MIN_FONT, settings.fontSize() - 1)));
            if (Theme.dark()) scroll.getGutter().setBackground(Theme.editor());
        }
        left.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.MINIMUM_WIDTH, 150);
        right.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.MINIMUM_WIDTH, 150);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.EngineRegistry;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.RequestLimits;
import java.awt.*;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: the options of one decompile (engines, dependency JARs, stubs, time limit), optionally kept as the defaults. */
final class DecompileDialog extends JDialog {
    /** What the user chose; {@code engines} is the CLI syntax ({@code cfr,vineflower}). */
    record Choice(String engines, int timeoutSeconds, boolean stubs, List<Path> dependencies) {}

    private final JRadioButton fast = new JRadioButton(Text.t("profile.FAST"));
    private final JRadioButton complete = new JRadioButton(Text.t("profile.COMPLETE"));
    private final JRadioButton custom = new JRadioButton(Text.t("profile.CUSTOM"));
    private final Map<String,JCheckBox> engineBoxes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final JSpinner timeout;
    private final JCheckBox stubs = new JCheckBox(Text.t("decompile.stubs"));
    private final DefaultListModel<Path> dependencies = new DefaultListModel<>();
    private final JCheckBox remember = new JCheckBox(Text.t("decompile.remember"), true);
    private Choice choice;

    DecompileDialog(Window owner, GuiSettings settings, List<Path> current) {
        super(owner, Text.t("decompile.title"), ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
        timeout = new JSpinner(new SpinnerNumberModel(settings.timeoutSeconds(), RequestLimits.MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, RequestLimits.MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, 30));
        var content = new JPanel();
        content.setLayout(new BoxLayout(content, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
        content.setBorder(Ui.padding(16, 18, 12, 18));

        content.add(section(Text.t("decompile.engines")));
        var group = new ButtonGroup();
        for (var button : List.of(fast, complete, custom)) { group.add(button); content.add(left(button)); }
        content.add(left(Ui.muted("   " + Text.t("profile.FAST.note"))));
        var boxes = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 10, 2));
        boxes.setBorder(Ui.padding(0, 22, 0, 0));
        for (var engine : EngineRegistry.all()) {
            var box = new JCheckBox(engine.id() + " " + engine.version());
            engineBoxes.put(engine.id(), box);
            boxes.add(box);
        }
        content.add(left(boxes));
        var selected = Set.of(settings.customEngines().split(","));
        engineBoxes.forEach((id, box) -> box.setSelected(selected.contains(id)));
        switch (settings.profile()) { case FAST -> fast.setSelected(true); case COMPLETE -> complete.setSelected(true); case CUSTOM -> custom.setSelected(true); }
        for (var button : List.of(fast, complete, custom)) button.addActionListener(e -> syncBoxes());
        syncBoxes();

        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        content.add(section(Text.t("decompile.dependencies")));
        content.add(left(Ui.muted("<html><body style='width:420px'>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("decompile.dependencies.note")) + "</body></html>")));
        current.forEach(dependencies::addElement);
        var list = new JList<>(dependencies);
        list.setVisibleRowCount(4);
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(list);
        scroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(440, 86));
        content.add(left(scroll));
        var listButtons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 6, 4));
        var add = new JButton(Text.t("decompile.dependencies.add"));
        var remove = new JButton(Text.t("decompile.dependencies.remove"));
        listButtons.add(add); listButtons.add(remove);
        content.add(left(listButtons));
        add.addActionListener(e -> addJars(settings));
        remove.addActionListener(e -> list.getSelectedValuesList().forEach(dependencies::removeElement));

        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        content.add(section(Text.t("decompile.verification")));
        stubs.setSelected(settings.stubs());
        content.add(left(stubs));
        content.add(left(Ui.muted("<html><body style='width:420px'>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("decompile.stubs.note")) + "</body></html>")));
        var time = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 6, 6));
        time.add(new JLabel(Text.t("decompile.timeout")));
        time.add(timeout);
        time.add(Ui.muted(Text.t("decompile.timeout.note")));
        content.add(left(time));

        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
        content.add(left(remember));
        var buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 8, 0));
        var cancel = new JButton(Text.t("dialog.cancel"));
        var run = Ui.primary(Ui.action(Text.t("action.decompile"), Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.PLAY, 14, Theme.ON_ACCENT), null, this::accept));
        buttons.add(cancel); buttons.add(run);
        cancel.addActionListener(e -> dispose());
        var root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        root.add(content, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        buttons.setBorder(Ui.padding(0, 18, 14, 18));
        root.add(buttons, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(root);
        getRootPane().setDefaultButton(run);
        getRootPane().registerKeyboardAction(e -> dispose(), KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ESCAPE"), JComponent.WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW);
        pack();
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
    }

    /** Shows the dialog; empty when cancelled. Applies the choice to {@code settings} when "remember" is checked. */
    static Optional<Choice> ask(Window owner, GuiSettings settings, List<Path> dependencies) {
        var dialog = new DecompileDialog(owner, settings, dependencies);
        dialog.setVisible(true);
        var choice = dialog.choice;
        if (choice != null && dialog.remember.isSelected()) {
            settings.profile(dialog.fast.isSelected() ? GuiSettings.Profile.FAST : dialog.complete.isSelected() ? GuiSettings.Profile.COMPLETE : GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
            if (dialog.custom.isSelected()) settings.customEngines(choice.engines());
            settings.timeoutSeconds(choice.timeoutSeconds());
            settings.stubs(choice.stubs());
        }
        return Optional.ofNullable(choice);
    }

    private void accept() {
        String engines = fast.isSelected() ? "cfr,vineflower" : complete.isSelected() ? "all"
            : String.join(",", engineBoxes.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> e.getValue().isSelected()).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList());
        if (engines.isEmpty()) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("decompile.title"), Text.t("decompile.noEngine"), null); return; }
        if (dependencies.size() > RequestLimits.MAX_DEPENDENCIES) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("decompile.title"), Text.t("decompile.tooManyJars", RequestLimits.MAX_DEPENDENCIES), null); return; }
        var jars = new ArrayList<Path>();
        for (int i = 0; i < dependencies.size(); i++) jars.add(dependencies.get(i));
        choice = new Choice(engines.equals("all") ? "cfr,vineflower,procyon,jadx" : engines, (Integer) timeout.getValue(), stubs.isSelected(), List.copyOf(jars));
        dispose();
    }

    private void addJars(GuiSettings settings) {
        var chooser = new JFileChooser(settings.lastDirectory() == null ? null : settings.lastDirectory().toFile());
        chooser.setMultiSelectionEnabled(true);
        chooser.setFileFilter(new javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter(Text.t("files.jar"), "jar"));
        if (chooser.showOpenDialog(this) != JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) return;
        for (var file : chooser.getSelectedFiles()) if (!dependencies.contains(file.toPath())) dependencies.addElement(file.toPath());
    }

    private void syncBoxes() {
        boolean editable = custom.isSelected();
        engineBoxes.forEach((id, box) -> {
            box.setEnabled(editable);
            if (fast.isSelected()) box.setSelected(id.equals("cfr") || id.equals("vineflower"));
            if (complete.isSelected()) box.setSelected(true);
        });
    }

    private static JComponent section(String title) {
        var label = Ui.heading(title, 13f);
        label.setBorder(Ui.padding(0, 0, 4, 0));
        return left(label);
    }

    private static JComponent left(JComponent component) { component.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT); return component; }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Descriptors.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.util.*;

/** Phase G4: method keys ({@code name + descriptor}) as people read them: {@code twice(int)}, {@code Circle(double)}. */
final class Descriptors {
    private Descriptors() {}

    static String pretty(String className, String method) {
        int paren = method.indexOf('(');
        if (paren < 0) return Ui.visible(method);
        String name = method.substring(0, paren);
        if (name.equals("<init>")) name = MethodLocator.simpleName(className).isEmpty() ? "<init>" : MethodLocator.simpleName(className);
        if (name.equals("<clinit>")) return "static { }";
        var types = new ArrayList<String>();
        String descriptor = method.substring(paren);
        for (int i = 1; i < descriptor.length() && descriptor.charAt(i) != ')'; ) {
            int dimensions = 0;
            while (descriptor.charAt(i) == '[') { dimensions++; i++; }
            String type;
            char c = descriptor.charAt(i);
            if (c == 'L') {
                int end = descriptor.indexOf(';', i);
                String full = descriptor.substring(i + 1, end);
                type = full.substring(Math.max(full.lastIndexOf('/'), full.lastIndexOf('$')) + 1);
                i = end + 1;
            } else {
                type = switch (c) { case 'Z' -> "boolean"; case 'B' -> "byte"; case 'C' -> "char"; case 'S' -> "short"; case 'I' -> "int";
                    case 'J' -> "long"; case 'F' -> "float"; case 'D' -> "double"; default -> String.valueOf(c); };
                i++;
            }
            types.add(type + "[]".repeat(dimensions));
        }
        return Ui.visible(name) + "(" + Ui.visible(String.join(", ", types)) + ")";
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/ExplorerPanel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.*;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
import javax.swing.event.DocumentListener;
import javax.swing.tree.*;

/** Phase G3: the input as a tree (packages, classes with their nested classes, resources) with an instant filter. */
final class ExplorerPanel extends JPanel {
    /** What a tree node stands for. */
    sealed interface Node permits Group, Package, ClassNode, Resource {}
    record Group(String label, Icons.Glyph glyph, int count) implements Node {}
    record Package(String name, int count) implements Node {}
    record ClassNode(Workspace.ClassItem item) implements Node {}
    record Resource(Workspace.ResourceItem item) implements Node {}

    private final JTree tree = new JTree(new DefaultTreeModel(new DefaultMutableTreeNode()));
    private final JTextField filter = new JTextField();
    private final JLabel title = Ui.heading("", 13f);
    private final javax.swing.Timer debounce;
    private Workspace workspace;

    ExplorerPanel(Consumer<Workspace.ClassItem> open, Consumer<Workspace.ResourceItem> openResource, Consumer<Node> select) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        setBorder(Ui.line(0, 0, 0, 1));
        var header = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 6));
        header.setBorder(Ui.padding(10, 10, 8, 10));
        title.setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.PACKAGE, 14));
        header.add(title, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        filter.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, Text.t("explorer.filter"));
        filter.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_LEADING_ICON, Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.SEARCH, 14));
        filter.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_SHOW_CLEAR_BUTTON, true);
        header.add(filter, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        add(header, BorderLayout.NORTH);

        tree.setRootVisible(false);
        tree.setShowsRootHandles(true);
        tree.setLargeModel(true);
        tree.setToggleClickCount(0);
        tree.setCellRenderer(new Renderer());
        ToolTipManager.sharedInstance().registerComponent(tree);
        tree.getSelectionModel().setSelectionMode(TreeSelectionModel.SINGLE_TREE_SELECTION);
        tree.addTreeSelectionListener(event -> { var node = selected(); if (node != null) select.accept(node); });
        tree.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) {
                if (event.getClickCount() != 2 || !SwingUtilities.isLeftMouseButton(event)) return;
                var path = tree.getPathForLocation(event.getX(), event.getY());
                if (path == null) return;
                if (node(path) instanceof ClassNode cls) open.accept(cls.item());
                else if (node(path) instanceof Resource res) openResource.accept(res.item());
                else if (tree.isExpanded(path)) tree.collapsePath(path); else tree.expandPath(path);
            }
        });
        tree.getInputMap().put(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ENTER"), "open");
        tree.getActionMap().put("open", new AbstractAction() {
            @Override public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
                if (selected() instanceof ClassNode cls) open.accept(cls.item());
                else if (selected() instanceof Resource res) openResource.accept(res.item());
            }
        });
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(tree);
        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);

        debounce = new javax.swing.Timer(150, event -> rebuild());
        debounce.setRepeats(false);
        filter.getDocument().addDocumentListener(new DocumentListener() {
            @Override public void insertUpdate(DocumentEvent e) { debounce.restart(); }
            @Override public void removeUpdate(DocumentEvent e) { debounce.restart(); }
            @Override public void changedUpdate(DocumentEvent e) { debounce.restart(); }
        });
        filter.addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() {
            @Override public void keyPressed(KeyEvent event) {
                if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_DOWN) { tree.requestFocusInWindow(); if (tree.getSelectionCount() == 0) tree.setSelectionRow(0); }
                if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_ESCAPE) filter.setText("");
            }
        });
    }

    /** Phase G6: a context menu with {@code actions} on class nodes; a right click selects the node first. */
    void popup(List<Action> actions) {
        var menu = new JPopupMenu();
        actions.forEach(menu::add);
        tree.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mousePressed(MouseEvent event) { maybeShow(event); }
            @Override public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent event) { maybeShow(event); }
            private void maybeShow(MouseEvent event) {
                if (!event.isPopupTrigger()) return;
                var path = tree.getPathForLocation(event.getX(), event.getY());
                if (path == null || !(node(path) instanceof ClassNode)) return;
                tree.setSelectionPath(path);
                menu.show(tree, event.getX(), event.getY());
            }
        });
    }

    void show(Workspace workspace) {
        this.workspace = workspace;
        title.setText(Ui.visible(workspace.displayName()));
        filter.setText("");
        rebuild();
    }

    /** Repaints after the evidence changed (a decompile finished). */
    void refresh() { tree.repaint(); }

    void focusFilter() { filter.requestFocusInWindow(); filter.selectAll(); }

    /** Selects and reveals a class (used by "go to class" and search results). */
    void reveal(String className) {
        var root = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) tree.getModel().getRoot();
        for (var nodes = root.depthFirstEnumeration(); nodes.hasMoreElements(); ) {
            var node = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) nodes.nextElement();
            if (node.getUserObject() instanceof ClassNode cls && cls.item().name().equals(className)) {
                var path = new TreePath(node.getPath());
                tree.setSelectionPath(path);
                tree.scrollPathToVisible(path);
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    Node selected() {
        var path = tree.getSelectionPath();
        return path == null ? null : node(path);
    }

    private static Node node(TreePath path) {
        return ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) path.getLastPathComponent()).getUserObject() instanceof Node node ? node : null;
    }

    private void rebuild() {
        if (workspace == null) return;
        var root = build(workspace, filter.getText().strip());
        tree.setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(root));
        boolean filtering = !filter.getText().isBlank();
        // Expand the groups, and every package while filtering or when the input is small.
        for (int i = 0; i < tree.getRowCount(); i++) {
            var node = node(tree.getPathForRow(i));
            if (node instanceof Group || (node instanceof Package && (filtering || workspace.classes().size() <= 60))) tree.expandRow(i);
            if (filtering && i > 4000) break;
        }
    }

    /** The tree for a workspace and a filter (case-insensitive, on simple or full class names and resource paths). */
    static DefaultMutableTreeNode build(Workspace workspace, String filter) {
        String needle = filter.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        var names = workspace.classNames();
        var matched = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
        for (var item : workspace.classes())
            if (needle.isEmpty() || item.simpleName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(needle) || item.name().replace('/', '.').toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(needle))
                matched.add(item.name());
        var nodes = new HashMap<String,DefaultMutableTreeNode>();
        var packages = new TreeMap<String,DefaultMutableTreeNode>();
        for (var item : workspace.classes()) {
            if (!matched.contains(item.name())) continue;
            nodes.put(item.name(), new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new ClassNode(item)));
        }
        for (var item : workspace.classes()) {
            var node = nodes.get(item.name());
            if (node == null) continue;
            String outer = item.outer(names);
            if (outer != null && nodes.containsKey(outer)) nodes.get(outer).add(node);
            else packages.computeIfAbsent(item.packageName(), k -> new DefaultMutableTreeNode()).add(node);
        }
        var root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode();
        var classes = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new Group(Text.t("explorer.classes"), Icons.Glyph.PACKAGE, matched.size()));
        packages.forEach((name, node) -> {
            node.setUserObject(new Package(name, node.getChildCount()));
            classes.add(node);
        });
        root.add(classes);
        var resources = workspace.resources().stream()
            .filter(item -> needle.isEmpty() || item.entry().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(needle)).toList();
        if (!resources.isEmpty()) {
            var group = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new Group(Text.t("explorer.resources"), Icons.Glyph.FOLDER, resources.size()));
            for (var item : resources) group.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new Resource(item)));
            root.add(group);
        }
        return root;
    }

    /** The kind badge of a class: C, I (interface), E (enum), R (record) or @ (annotation). */
    static char kind(Workspace.ClassItem item) {
        int access = item.info().access();
        if ((access & 0x2000) != 0) return '@';
        if ((access & 0x0200) != 0) return 'I';
        if ((access & 0x4000) != 0) return 'E';
        if ("java/lang/Record".equals(item.info().superName())) return 'R';
        return 'C';
    }

    static Color kindColor(char kind) {
        return switch (kind) {
            case 'I' -> new Color(0x7C6CB0); case 'E' -> new Color(0xB07C3C); case 'R' -> new Color(0x3C8CA0); case '@' -> new Color(0x9C5C8C);
            default -> new Color(0x5F7396);
        };
    }

    private final class Renderer extends DefaultTreeCellRenderer {
        @Override public Component getTreeCellRendererComponent(JTree tree, Object value, boolean selected, boolean expanded, boolean leaf, int row, boolean focus) {
            super.getTreeCellRendererComponent(tree, value, selected, expanded, leaf, row, focus);
            Object object = ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) value).getUserObject();
            switch (object) {
                case Group group -> { setText(group.label() + "  " + group.count()); setIcon(Icons.of(group.glyph())); setFont(tree.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD)); }
                case Package pkg -> {
                    setText(pkg.name().isEmpty() ? Text.t("explorer.defaultPackage") : Ui.visible(pkg.name()));
                    setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.PACKAGE, 14)); setFont(tree.getFont());
                }
                case ClassNode cls -> {
                    var evidence = workspace == null ? Optional.<dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex.ClassEntry>empty() : workspace.evidence(cls.item().name());
                    char kind = kind(cls.item());
                    setIcon(Icons.kind(kind, kindColor(kind), evidence.map(entry -> Theme.level(entry.level())).orElse(null)));
                    setText(Ui.visible(cls.item().simpleName()));
                    setFont(tree.getFont());
                    setToolTipText(Ui.visible(cls.item().name().replace('/', '.')));
                }
                case Resource res -> { setText(Ui.visible(res.item().entry())); setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.RESOURCE, 14)); setFont(tree.getFont()); }
                default -> { }
            }
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Exporter.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Phase G3: copies of a result for the user; never overwrites anything and never follows links. */
public final class Exporter {
    private Exporter() {}

    /** Copies the tree under {@code source} into {@code target}, which must not exist or be an empty folder. Returns the file count. */
    public static int copyTree(Path source, Path target) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isDirectory(source, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new NoSuchFileException(source.toString());
        if (Files.exists(target)) {
            if (!Files.isDirectory(target, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new FileAlreadyExistsException(target.toString());
            try (var children = Files.list(target)) { if (children.findAny().isPresent()) throw new DirectoryNotEmptyException(target.toString()); }
        }
        if (target.toAbsolutePath().normalize().startsWith(source.toAbsolutePath().normalize())) throw new IOException("Target is inside the source");
        int[] files = {0};
        Files.walkFileTree(source, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
            @Override public FileVisitResult preVisitDirectory(Path directory, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
                Files.createDirectories(target.resolve(source.relativize(directory).toString()));
                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
                if (attributes.isRegularFile()) { Files.copy(file, target.resolve(source.relativize(file).toString()), StandardCopyOption.COPY_ATTRIBUTES); files[0]++; }
                return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
        return files[0];
    }

    /** Writes every regular file under {@code source} into a new zip {@code target}, with {@code /} separated paths. Returns the file count. */
    public static int zip(Path source, Path target) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isDirectory(source, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new NoSuchFileException(source.toString());
        int[] files = {0};
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(target, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            Files.walkFileTree(source, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
                @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attributes) throws IOException {
                    if (!attributes.isRegularFile()) return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                    zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(source.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/')));
                    Files.copy(file, zip);
                    zip.closeEntry();
                    files[0]++;
                    return FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
                }
            });
        }
        return files[0];
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/GoToClassDialog.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: type part of a class name, pick it, open it (Ctrl+N). Prefix matches of the simple name come first. */
final class GoToClassDialog extends JDialog {
    static final int LIMIT = 300;

    private final JTextField field = new JTextField(36);
    private final DefaultListModel<Workspace.ClassItem> model = new DefaultListModel<>();
    private final JList<Workspace.ClassItem> list = new JList<>(model);

    GoToClassDialog(Window owner, Workspace workspace, Consumer<Workspace.ClassItem> open) {
        super(owner, Text.t("goto.title"), ModalityType.APPLICATION_MODAL);
        field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, Text.t("goto.placeholder"));
        field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_LEADING_ICON, Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.SEARCH, 14));
        list.setCellRenderer(new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> l, Object value, int index, boolean selected, boolean focus) {
                super.getListCellRendererComponent(l, value, index, selected, focus);
                var item = (Workspace.ClassItem) value;
                char kind = ExplorerPanel.kind(item);
                setIcon(Icons.kind(kind, ExplorerPanel.kindColor(kind), workspace.evidence(item.name()).map(e -> Theme.level(e.level())).orElse(null)));
                setText("<html><b>" + Ui.escape(item.simpleName()) + "</b> &nbsp;<span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(item.packageName()) + "</span></html>");
                return this;
            }
        });
        list.setFixedCellHeight(26);
        var panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, Ui.GAP));
        panel.setBorder(Ui.padding(Ui.PAD, Ui.PAD, Ui.PAD, Ui.PAD));
        panel.add(field, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(list);
        scroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(560, 360));
        panel.add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        panel.add(Ui.muted(Text.t("goto.hint")), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(panel);
        Runnable choose = () -> { var item = list.getSelectedValue(); if (item != null) { dispose(); open.accept(item); } };
        field.addActionListener(e -> choose.run());
        field.addKeyListener(new KeyAdapter() {
            @Override public void keyPressed(KeyEvent event) {
                int size = model.getSize();
                if (size == 0) return;
                if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_DOWN) { list.setSelectedIndex(Math.min(size - 1, list.getSelectedIndex() + 1)); list.ensureIndexIsVisible(list.getSelectedIndex()); event.consume(); }
                if (event.getKeyCode() == KeyEvent.VK_UP) { list.setSelectedIndex(Math.max(0, list.getSelectedIndex() - 1)); list.ensureIndexIsVisible(list.getSelectedIndex()); event.consume(); }
            }
        });
        list.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() { @Override public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) { if (event.getClickCount() == 2) choose.run(); } });
        getRootPane().registerKeyboardAction(e -> dispose(), KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ESCAPE"), JComponent.WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW);
        field.getDocument().addDocumentListener(new javax.swing.event.DocumentListener() {
            @Override public void insertUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { update(workspace); }
            @Override public void removeUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { update(workspace); }
            @Override public void changedUpdate(javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent e) { update(workspace); }
        });
        update(workspace);
        pack();
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
    }

    private void update(Workspace workspace) {
        model.clear();
        for (var item : rank(workspace.classes(), field.getText().strip())) model.addElement(item);
        if (!model.isEmpty()) list.setSelectedIndex(0);
    }

    /** Simple-name prefix, then simple-name substring, then qualified-name substring, alphabetically; nested and anonymous classes last. */
    static List<Workspace.ClassItem> rank(List<Workspace.ClassItem> classes, String query) {
        String needle = query.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        var scored = new ArrayList<Map.Entry<Integer,Workspace.ClassItem>>();
        for (var item : classes) {
            String simple = item.simpleName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT), full = item.name().replace('/', '.').toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            int score;
            if (needle.isEmpty()) score = 3;
            else if (simple.startsWith(needle)) score = 0;
            else if (simple.contains(needle)) score = 1;
            else if (full.contains(needle)) score = 2;
            else continue;
            if (item.simpleName().contains("$")) score += 4;
            scored.add(Map.entry(score, item));
        }
        scored.sort(Map.Entry.<Integer,Workspace.ClassItem>comparingByKey()
            .thenComparing(entry -> entry.getValue().simpleName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).thenComparing(entry -> entry.getValue().name()));
        return scored.stream().limit(LIMIT).map(Map.Entry::getValue).toList();
    }
}
```
