`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/GuiSettings.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.EngineRegistry;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.RequestLimits;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * The desktop application's preferences, kept in {@code settings.properties} under {@link #home()}. Unknown or invalid
 * values fall back to their defaults, so a damaged file never stops the application from starting.
 */
public final class GuiSettings {
    public enum ThemeChoice { SYSTEM, LIGHT, DARK }
    public enum Language { SYSTEM, PORTUGUESE, ENGLISH }
    /** FAST is the CLI default (CFR + Vineflower); COMPLETE runs all four engines; CUSTOM uses {@link #customEngines()}. */
    public enum Profile { FAST, COMPLETE, CUSTOM }

    static final int MAX_RECENT = 10, MIN_FONT = 10, MAX_FONT = 28;

    private final Path file;
    private ThemeChoice theme = ThemeChoice.DARK;
    private Language language = Language.SYSTEM;
    private int fontSize = 13;
    private Profile profile = Profile.FAST;
    private String customEngines = "cfr,vineflower";
    private int timeoutSeconds = 120;
    private boolean stubs = true;
    private boolean engineCache = true;
    private boolean showInspector = true;
    private boolean showActivity = true;
    private Path workspaceDirectory;
    private Path lastDirectory;
    private final List<Path> recent = new ArrayList<>();

    private GuiSettings(Path file) {
        this.file = file;
        this.workspaceDirectory = file.getParent().resolve("workspaces");
    }

    /** {@code classrevive.home} when set (tests), else {@code %APPDATA%\ClassRevive} on Windows, else {@code ~/.classrevive}. */
    public static Path home() {
        String override = System.getProperty("classrevive.home");
        if (override != null && !override.isBlank()) return Path.of(override);
        String appData = System.getenv("APPDATA");
        if (System.getProperty("os.name", "").startsWith("Windows") && appData != null && !appData.isBlank())
            return Path.of(appData, "ClassRevive");
        return Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home"), ".classrevive");
    }

    public static GuiSettings load() { return load(home().resolve("settings.properties")); }

    static GuiSettings load(Path file) {
        var settings = new GuiSettings(file);
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file)) return settings;
        var values = new Properties();
        try (var reader = Files.newBufferedReader(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) { values.load(reader); }
        catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException unreadable) { return settings; }
        settings.theme = choice(ThemeChoice.class, values.getProperty("theme"), settings.theme);
        settings.language = choice(Language.class, values.getProperty("language"), settings.language);
        settings.fontSize = number(values.getProperty("editor.fontSize"), settings.fontSize, MIN_FONT, MAX_FONT);
        settings.profile = choice(Profile.class, values.getProperty("decompile.profile"), settings.profile);
        String custom = values.getProperty("decompile.customEngines");
        if (custom != null && valid(custom)) settings.customEngines = custom;
        settings.timeoutSeconds = number(values.getProperty("decompile.timeoutSeconds"), settings.timeoutSeconds,
            RequestLimits.MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, RequestLimits.MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS);
        settings.stubs = flag(values.getProperty("decompile.stubs"), settings.stubs);
        settings.engineCache = flag(values.getProperty("decompile.engineCache"), settings.engineCache);
        settings.showInspector = flag(values.getProperty("view.inspector"), settings.showInspector);
        settings.showActivity = flag(values.getProperty("view.activity"), settings.showActivity);
        settings.workspaceDirectory = path(values.getProperty("workspace.directory"), settings.workspaceDirectory);
        settings.lastDirectory = path(values.getProperty("files.lastDirectory"), null);
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_RECENT; i++) {
            Path recent = path(values.getProperty("recent." + i), null);
            if (recent != null && !settings.recent.contains(recent)) settings.recent.add(recent);
        }
        return settings;
    }

    /** Writes the file through a temporary sibling, so a crash never leaves it half written. */
    public void save() throws IOException {
        var values = new Properties();
        values.setProperty("theme", theme.name());
        values.setProperty("language", language.name());
        values.setProperty("editor.fontSize", Integer.toString(fontSize));
        values.setProperty("decompile.profile", profile.name());
        values.setProperty("decompile.customEngines", customEngines);
        values.setProperty("decompile.timeoutSeconds", Integer.toString(timeoutSeconds));
        values.setProperty("decompile.stubs", Boolean.toString(stubs));
        values.setProperty("decompile.engineCache", Boolean.toString(engineCache));
        values.setProperty("view.inspector", Boolean.toString(showInspector));
        values.setProperty("view.activity", Boolean.toString(showActivity));
        values.setProperty("workspace.directory", workspaceDirectory.toString());
        if (lastDirectory != null) values.setProperty("files.lastDirectory", lastDirectory.toString());
        for (int i = 0; i < recent.size(); i++) values.setProperty("recent." + i, recent.get(i).toString());
        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
        Path temporary = file.resolveSibling(file.getFileName() + ".tmp");
        try (var writer = Files.newBufferedWriter(temporary, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) { values.store(writer, "ClassRevive desktop settings"); }
        Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
    }

    /** The engines a decompile runs with the current profile. */
    public List<DecompilerEngine> engines() {
        return switch (profile) {
            case FAST -> EngineRegistry.parse("cfr,vineflower");
            case COMPLETE -> EngineRegistry.all();
            case CUSTOM -> EngineRegistry.parse(customEngines);
        };
    }

    /** Puts {@code path} first in the recent list (inputs and result folders alike). */
    public void remember(Path path) {
        Path normalized = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        recent.remove(normalized);
        recent.addFirst(normalized);
        while (recent.size() > MAX_RECENT) recent.removeLast();
    }

    public void forget(Path path) { recent.remove(path.toAbsolutePath().normalize()); }

    public Path engineCacheDirectory() { return file.getParent().resolve("engine-cache"); }
    public Path cacheDirectory() { return file.getParent().resolve("cache"); }

    public ThemeChoice theme() { return theme; }
    public void theme(ThemeChoice value) { theme = Objects.requireNonNull(value); }
    public Language language() { return language; }
    public void language(Language value) { language = Objects.requireNonNull(value); }
    public int fontSize() { return fontSize; }
    public void fontSize(int value) { fontSize = Math.max(MIN_FONT, Math.min(MAX_FONT, value)); }
    public Profile profile() { return profile; }
    public void profile(Profile value) { profile = Objects.requireNonNull(value); }
    public String customEngines() { return customEngines; }
    public void customEngines(String value) { if (!valid(value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(value); customEngines = value; }
    public int timeoutSeconds() { return timeoutSeconds; }
    public void timeoutSeconds(int value) { RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(value); timeoutSeconds = value; }
    public boolean stubs() { return stubs; }
    public void stubs(boolean value) { stubs = value; }
    public boolean engineCache() { return engineCache; }
    public void engineCache(boolean value) { engineCache = value; }
    public boolean showInspector() { return showInspector; }
    public void showInspector(boolean value) { showInspector = value; }
    public boolean showActivity() { return showActivity; }
    public void showActivity(boolean value) { showActivity = value; }
    public Path workspaceDirectory() { return workspaceDirectory; }
    public void workspaceDirectory(Path value) { workspaceDirectory = value.toAbsolutePath().normalize(); }
    public Path lastDirectory() { return lastDirectory; }
    public void lastDirectory(Path value) { lastDirectory = value; }
    public List<Path> recent() { return List.copyOf(recent); }

    private static boolean valid(String engines) {
        try { EngineRegistry.parse(engines); return true; } catch (IllegalArgumentException invalid) { return false; }
    }
    private static <E extends Enum<E>> E choice(Class<E> type, String value, E fallback) {
        if (value == null) return fallback;
        try { return Enum.valueOf(type, value); } catch (IllegalArgumentException unknown) { return fallback; }
    }
    private static int number(String value, int fallback, int min, int max) {
        if (value == null) return fallback;
        try { int parsed = Integer.parseInt(value.trim()); return parsed < min || parsed > max ? fallback : parsed; }
        catch (NumberFormatException bad) { return fallback; }
    }
    private static boolean flag(String value, boolean fallback) {
        return value == null ? fallback : value.equals("true") ? true : value.equals("false") ? false : fallback;
    }
    private static Path path(String value, Path fallback) {
        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) return fallback;
        try { return Path.of(value); } catch (InvalidPathException bad) { return fallback; }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Icons.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.geom.*;
import javax.swing.Icon;

/**
 * Phase G3: the application's icons, drawn as vectors so they stay sharp at any display scale and follow the theme's text
 * color. No image files and no icon library.
 */
final class Icons {
    enum Glyph { OPEN, FOLDER_RESULT, PLAY, STOP, SEARCH, GOTO, EXPORT, SETTINGS, PACKAGE, RESOURCE, FOLDER, REPORT, BACK, FORWARD, COMPARE, SHIELD }

    private Icons() {}

    static Icon of(Glyph glyph) { return new GlyphIcon(glyph, 16, null); }
    static Icon of(Glyph glyph, int size) { return new GlyphIcon(glyph, size, null); }
    static Icon of(Glyph glyph, int size, Color color) { return new GlyphIcon(glyph, size, color); }

    /** A filled circle, for confidence levels. */
    static Icon dot(Color color, int size) {
        return new Icon() {
            @Override public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
                var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
                g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
                g2.setColor(color);
                g2.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(x + 1, y + 1, size - 2, size - 2));
                g2.dispose();
            }
            @Override public int getIconWidth() { return size; }
            @Override public int getIconHeight() { return size; }
        };
    }

    /** A class kind badge: a rounded square with C, I, E, R or @, and an optional confidence dot at its corner. */
    static Icon kind(char letter, Color color, Color levelDot) {
        return new Icon() {
            @Override public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
                var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
                g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
                g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_TEXT_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_ON);
                g2.setColor(color);
                g2.fill(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(x + 1, y + 1, 14, 14, 5, 5));
                g2.setColor(Color.WHITE);
                g2.setFont(new Font(Font.SANS_SERIF, Font.BOLD, 10));
                var metrics = g2.getFontMetrics();
                String text = String.valueOf(letter);
                g2.drawString(text, x + 8 - metrics.stringWidth(text) / 2f, y + 8 + (metrics.getAscent() - metrics.getDescent()) / 2f);
                if (levelDot != null) {
                    g2.setColor(Theme.panel());
                    g2.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(x + 10, y + 10, 8, 8));
                    g2.setColor(levelDot);
                    g2.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(x + 11, y + 11, 6, 6));
                }
                g2.dispose();
            }
            @Override public int getIconWidth() { return 18; }
            @Override public int getIconHeight() { return 18; }
        };
    }

    private record GlyphIcon(Glyph glyph, int size, Color fixed) implements Icon {
        @Override public int getIconWidth() { return size; }
        @Override public int getIconHeight() { return size; }

        @Override public void paintIcon(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y) {
            var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_STROKE_CONTROL, RenderingHints.VALUE_STROKE_PURE);
            g2.translate(x, y);
            g2.scale(size / 16.0, size / 16.0);
            Color color = fixed != null ? fixed : c != null && !c.isEnabled() ? Theme.muted() : Theme.foreground();
            g2.setColor(color);
            g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.4f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
            switch (glyph) {
                case OPEN -> {
                    var path = new Path2D.Double();
                    path.moveTo(1.5, 4); path.lineTo(6, 4); path.lineTo(7.5, 5.5); path.lineTo(13.5, 5.5); path.lineTo(13.5, 7.5);
                    g2.draw(path);
                    var front = new Path2D.Double();
                    front.moveTo(1.5, 4); front.lineTo(1.5, 13); front.lineTo(12.5, 13); front.lineTo(14.8, 7.5); front.lineTo(4, 7.5); front.lineTo(1.5, 13);
                    g2.draw(front);
                }
                case FOLDER_RESULT, FOLDER -> {
                    var path = new Path2D.Double();
                    path.moveTo(1.5, 3.5); path.lineTo(6, 3.5); path.lineTo(7.5, 5); path.lineTo(14.5, 5); path.lineTo(14.5, 13); path.lineTo(1.5, 13); path.closePath();
                    g2.draw(path);
                    if (glyph == Glyph.FOLDER_RESULT) { g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(5, 9.2, 7, 11)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(7, 11, 11, 7)); }
                }
                case PLAY -> {
                    var path = new Path2D.Double();
                    path.moveTo(4.5, 2.5); path.lineTo(13, 8); path.lineTo(4.5, 13.5); path.closePath();
                    g2.fill(path);
                }
                case STOP -> g2.fill(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(3.5, 3.5, 9, 9, 2.5, 2.5));
                case SEARCH -> {
                    g2.draw(new Ellipse2D.Double(2.5, 2.5, 8, 8));
                    g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.8f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(9.4, 9.4, 13.5, 13.5));
                }
                case GOTO -> {
                    g2.draw(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(2, 2, 12, 12, 3, 3));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(5, 8, 11, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8.5, 5.5, 11, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8.5, 10.5, 11, 8));
                }
                case EXPORT -> {
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8, 2, 8, 10));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(5, 5, 8, 2));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(11, 5, 8, 2));
                    var tray = new Path2D.Double();
                    tray.moveTo(2.5, 9); tray.lineTo(2.5, 13.5); tray.lineTo(13.5, 13.5); tray.lineTo(13.5, 9);
                    g2.draw(tray);
                }
                case SETTINGS -> {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
                        double angle = Math.PI / 4 * i;
                        g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8 + Math.cos(angle) * 4.6, 8 + Math.sin(angle) * 4.6, 8 + Math.cos(angle) * 6.6, 8 + Math.sin(angle) * 6.6));
                    }
                    g2.draw(new Ellipse2D.Double(3.6, 3.6, 8.8, 8.8));
                    g2.draw(new Ellipse2D.Double(6, 6, 4, 4));
                }
                case PACKAGE -> {
                    var box = new Path2D.Double();
                    box.moveTo(8, 1.8); box.lineTo(14, 4.8); box.lineTo(14, 11.2); box.lineTo(8, 14.2); box.lineTo(2, 11.2); box.lineTo(2, 4.8); box.closePath();
                    g2.draw(box);
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(2, 4.8, 8, 7.8)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(14, 4.8, 8, 7.8)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8, 7.8, 8, 14.2));
                }
                case RESOURCE, REPORT -> {
                    var page = new Path2D.Double();
                    page.moveTo(3.5, 1.5); page.lineTo(9.5, 1.5); page.lineTo(12.5, 4.5); page.lineTo(12.5, 14.5); page.lineTo(3.5, 14.5); page.closePath();
                    g2.draw(page);
                    if (glyph == Glyph.REPORT) {
                        g2.fill(new Rectangle2D.Double(5.5, 10, 1.6, 2.8)); g2.fill(new Rectangle2D.Double(7.7, 8, 1.6, 4.8)); g2.fill(new Rectangle2D.Double(9.9, 6, 1.6, 6.8));
                    } else {
                        g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(5.5, 8, 10.5, 8)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(5.5, 10.5, 10.5, 10.5));
                    }
                }
                case BACK -> {
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(13, 8, 3.5, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(7, 4.5, 3.5, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(7, 11.5, 3.5, 8));
                }
                case FORWARD -> {
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(3, 8, 12.5, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(9, 4.5, 12.5, 8));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(9, 11.5, 12.5, 8));
                }
                case SHIELD -> {
                    var shield = new Path2D.Double();
                    shield.moveTo(8, 1.5); shield.lineTo(13.5, 3.5); shield.lineTo(13.5, 8); shield.curveTo(13.5, 11.5, 11, 13.5, 8, 14.8);
                    shield.curveTo(5, 13.5, 2.5, 11.5, 2.5, 8); shield.lineTo(2.5, 3.5); shield.closePath();
                    g2.draw(shield);
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(8, 5, 8, 9)); g2.fill(new Ellipse2D.Double(7.2, 10.4, 1.6, 1.6));
                }
                case COMPARE -> {
                    g2.draw(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(1.5, 2.5, 5.5, 11, 2, 2));
                    g2.draw(new RoundRectangle2D.Double(9, 2.5, 5.5, 11, 2, 2));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(3, 6, 5.5, 6)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(10.5, 6, 13, 6));
                    g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(3, 9.5, 5.5, 9.5)); g2.draw(new Line2D.Double(10.5, 10, 13, 10));
                }
            }
            g2.dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: details of what the explorer has selected: a class's evidence, a package's levels, a resource, or the input. */
final class InspectorPanel extends JPanel {
    private final Ui.Column body = new Ui.Column();
    private final Runnable decompile;

    InspectorPanel(Runnable decompile) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        this.decompile = decompile;
        setBorder(Ui.line(0, 1, 0, 0));
        body.setBorder(Ui.padding(12, 14, 12, 14));
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(body, ScrollPaneConstants.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_AS_NEEDED, ScrollPaneConstants.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER);
        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        scroll.getVerticalScrollBar().setUnitIncrement(16);
        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        setPreferredSize(new Dimension(300, 400));
    }

    void show(Workspace workspace, ExplorerPanel.Node node) {
        body.removeAll();
        switch (node) {
            case ExplorerPanel.ClassNode cls -> showClass(workspace, cls.item());
            case ExplorerPanel.Package pkg -> showPackage(workspace, pkg.name());
            case ExplorerPanel.Resource res -> showResource(res.item());
            case null, default -> showInput(workspace);
        }
        body.add(Box.createVerticalGlue());
        body.revalidate();
        body.repaint();
    }

    private void showInput(Workspace workspace) {
        section(Text.t("inspector.input"));
        put(Ui.heading(Ui.visible(workspace.displayName()), 15f));
        row(Text.t("inspector.classes"), String.valueOf(workspace.classes().size()));
        row(Text.t("inspector.resources"), String.valueOf(workspace.resources().size()));
        row(Text.t("inspector.size"), bytes(workspace.inventory().inputBytes()));
        if (workspace.identification() != null) row(Text.t("inspector.format"), workspace.identification().format());
        if (workspace.reversedFrom() != null) row(Text.t("inspector.obfuscator"), Text.t("obfuscation.reversed"));
        else if (workspace.obfuscation() != null) row(Text.t("inspector.obfuscator"), ObfuscationBanner.headline(workspace.obfuscation()));
        var compiler = workspace.result() == null ? null : workspace.result().compiler();
        if (compiler != null && compiler.classes() > 0) {
            row(Text.t("inspector.language"), compiler.language());
            row(Text.t("inspector.compiler"), OverviewPanel.languageNote(compiler));
        }
        selectable("SHA-256", workspace.inventory().sha256());
        if (!workspace.decompiled()) decompileHint();
        else levels(workspace.classes().stream().map(item -> workspace.evidence(item.name()).map(ResultIndex.ClassEntry::level).orElse(null)).toList());
    }

    private void showClass(Workspace workspace, Workspace.ClassItem item) {
        section(Text.t("inspector.class"));
        var name = Ui.heading(Ui.visible(item.simpleName()), 15f);
        char kind = ExplorerPanel.kind(item);
        name.setIcon(Icons.kind(kind, ExplorerPanel.kindColor(kind), null));
        put(name);
        put(wrap(Ui.visible(item.name().replace('/', '.')), true));
        var evidence = workspace.evidence(item.name());
        if (evidence.isPresent() && evidence.get().level() != null) {
            var entry = evidence.get();
            put(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
            var chip = Ui.chip(Text.t("level." + entry.level().name()), Theme.level(entry.level()));
            chip.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            put(chip);
            put(Box.createVerticalStrut(4));
            put(wrap(Text.t("level." + entry.level().name() + ".meaning"), true));
            section(Text.t("inspector.evidence"));
            row(Text.t("inspector.origin"), originText(entry.origin()));
            row(Text.t("inspector.signatures"), entry.matchedSymbols() + " / " + entry.expectedSymbols());
            row(Text.t("inspector.identical"), String.valueOf(entry.identical()));
            row(Text.t("inspector.equivalent"), String.valueOf(entry.equivalent()));
            row(Text.t("inspector.different"), String.valueOf(entry.different()));
            if (!entry.differentMethods().isEmpty()) {
                section(Text.t("inspector.differentMethods"));
                var list = new JList<>(entry.differentMethods().stream().limit(200).map(Ui::visible).toArray(String[]::new));
                list.setFont(Theme.codeFont(11));
                list.setVisibleRowCount(Math.min(8, entry.differentMethods().size()));
                var scroll = new JScrollPane(list);
                scroll.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
                scroll.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, scroll.getPreferredSize().height));
                put(scroll);
            }
            // Phase 2BV renamed this class (case collision or invalid identifier) before the engines saw it.
            if (!entry.className().equals(item.name())) row(Text.t("inspector.portableName"), Ui.visible(entry.className().replace('/', '.')));
        } else if (!workspace.decompiled()) {
            decompileHint();
        } else {
            put(wrap(Text.t("inspector.noEvidence"), true));
        }
        section(Text.t("inspector.bytecode"));
        var info = item.info();
        row(Text.t("inspector.kind"), Text.t("kind." + kind));
        row(Text.t("inspector.java"), "Java " + info.javaVersion() + " (" + info.majorVersion() + "." + info.minorVersion() + ")");
        if (info.superName() != null) row(Text.t("inspector.super"), Ui.visible(info.superName().replace('/', '.')));
        row(Text.t("inspector.interfaces"), String.valueOf(info.interfaces().size()));
        row(Text.t("inspector.fields"), String.valueOf(info.fields().size()));
        row(Text.t("inspector.methods"), String.valueOf(info.methods().size()));
    }

    private void showPackage(Workspace workspace, String pkg) {
        section(Text.t("inspector.package"));
        put(Ui.heading(pkg.isEmpty() ? Text.t("explorer.defaultPackage") : Ui.visible(pkg), 15f));
        var items = workspace.classes().stream().filter(item -> item.packageName().equals(pkg)).toList();
        row(Text.t("inspector.classes"), String.valueOf(items.size()));
        if (workspace.decompiled())
            levels(items.stream().map(item -> workspace.evidence(item.name()).map(ResultIndex.ClassEntry::level).orElse(null)).toList());
    }

    private void showResource(Workspace.ResourceItem item) {
        section(Text.t("inspector.resource"));
        put(Ui.heading(Ui.visible(item.entry().substring(item.entry().lastIndexOf('/') + 1)), 15f));
        put(wrap(Ui.visible(item.entry()), true));
        row(Text.t("inspector.size"), bytes(item.size()));
        if (item.sha256() != null) selectable("SHA-256", item.sha256());
    }

    /** Count of classes per level, with the level's color. */
    private void levels(List<ResultIndex.Level> levels) {
        section(Text.t("inspector.confidence"));
        var counts = new EnumMap<ResultIndex.Level,Integer>(ResultIndex.Level.class);
        for (var level : levels) if (level != null) counts.merge(level, 1, Integer::sum);
        var bar = new OverviewPanel.LevelBar(counts);
        bar.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        bar.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 10));
        put(bar);
        put(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
        for (var level : ResultIndex.Level.values()) {
            var label = new JLabel(Text.t("level." + level.name()) + "  " + counts.getOrDefault(level, 0));
            label.setIcon(Icons.dot(Theme.level(level), 10));
            label.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            put(label);
        }
    }

    private void decompileHint() {
        put(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        put(wrap(Text.t("inspector.notDecompiled"), true));
        put(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
        var button = Ui.primary(Ui.action(Text.t("action.decompile"), Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.PLAY, 14, Theme.ON_ACCENT), null, decompile));
        button.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        put(button);
    }

    static String originText(String origin) {
        if (origin == null || origin.equals("none")) return Text.t("inspector.origin.none");
        String engine = origin.replace("+repair", "").replace("+methods", "");
        var extras = new ArrayList<String>();
        if (origin.contains("+repair")) extras.add(Text.t("inspector.origin.repair"));
        if (origin.contains("+methods")) extras.add(Text.t("inspector.origin.methods"));
        return engine + (extras.isEmpty() ? "" : " (" + String.join(", ", extras) + ")");
    }

    private void section(String title) {
        if (body.getComponentCount() > 0) body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(16));
        var label = Ui.muted(title.toUpperCase(Text.locale()));
        label.setFont(label.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, label.getFont().getSize2D() - 1.5f));
        label.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        body.add(label);
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
    }

    private void row(String name, String value) {
        var row = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(Ui.GAP, 0));
        row.setOpaque(false);
        row.add(Ui.muted(name), BorderLayout.WEST);
        var right = new JLabel(value);
        right.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.RIGHT);
        row.add(right, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        row.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        row.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, row.getPreferredSize().height + 4));
        row.setBorder(Ui.padding(2, 0, 2, 0));
        body.add(row);
    }

    private void selectable(String name, String value) {
        body.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(4));
        var label = Ui.muted(name);
        label.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        body.add(label);
        var field = new JTextField(value);
        field.setEditable(false);
        field.setFont(Theme.codeFont(11));
        field.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        field.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, field.getPreferredSize().height));
        body.add(field);
    }

    private JComponent wrap(String text, boolean muted) { return Ui.text(text, muted); }

    /** Everything shown goes into the scrolling column; a plain add() would replace the panel's own content. */
    private void put(Component component) { body.add(component); }

    static String bytes(long size) {
        if (size < 1024) return size + " B";
        if (size < 1024 * 1024) return String.format(Text.locale(), "%.1f KiB", size / 1024.0);
        return String.format(Text.locale(), "%.1f MiB", size / (1024.0 * 1024));
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/LineDiff.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase G4: a line diff (Myers, O((N+M)D)) aligned for side-by-side display: both sides get the same number of rows,
 * with blank filler rows where one side has nothing. Whitespace does not count (engines indent differently): lines are
 * compared trimmed, with runs of spaces collapsed.
 */
final class LineDiff {
    enum Kind { SAME, CHANGED, REMOVED, ADDED }

    /** {@code left}/{@code right}: the aligned rows (null for a filler row); {@code kinds}: one per row. */
    record Aligned(List<String> left, List<String> right, List<Kind> kinds) {
        String leftText() { return text(left); }
        String rightText() { return text(right); }
        long count(Kind kind) { return kinds.stream().filter(k -> k == kind).count(); }
        private static String text(List<String> rows) {
            var out = new StringBuilder();
            for (String row : rows) out.append(row == null ? "" : row).append('\n');
            return out.toString();
        }
    }

    /** Above this many lines in total, or this many differences, rows are paired by position instead. */
    static final int MAX_LINES = 60_000, MAX_EDITS = 6_000;

    private LineDiff() {}

    static Aligned align(String leftText, String rightText) {
        var left = lines(leftText);
        var right = lines(rightText);
        var script = left.size() + right.size() > MAX_LINES ? null : script(left, right);
        var rows = new Aligned(new ArrayList<>(), new ArrayList<>(), new ArrayList<>());
        if (script == null) {
            for (int i = 0; i < Math.max(left.size(), right.size()); i++) {
                String l = i < left.size() ? left.get(i) : null, r = i < right.size() ? right.get(i) : null;
                add(rows, l, r, l == null ? Kind.ADDED : r == null ? Kind.REMOVED : key(l).equals(key(r)) ? Kind.SAME : Kind.CHANGED);
            }
            return rows;
        }
        // Walk the edit script; a run of removals followed by additions is shown as changed rows side by side.
        int i = 0, j = 0;
        var removed = new ArrayList<String>();
        var added = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (char op : script) {
            if (op == '=') { flush(rows, removed, added); add(rows, left.get(i++), right.get(j++), Kind.SAME); }
            else if (op == '-') removed.add(left.get(i++));
            else added.add(right.get(j++));
        }
        flush(rows, removed, added);
        return rows;
    }

    private static void flush(Aligned rows, List<String> removed, List<String> added) {
        for (int k = 0; k < Math.max(removed.size(), added.size()); k++) {
            String l = k < removed.size() ? removed.get(k) : null, r = k < added.size() ? added.get(k) : null;
            add(rows, l, r, l == null ? Kind.ADDED : r == null ? Kind.REMOVED : Kind.CHANGED);
        }
        removed.clear();
        added.clear();
    }

    private static void add(Aligned rows, String left, String right, Kind kind) {
        rows.left().add(left);
        rows.right().add(right);
        rows.kinds().add(kind);
    }

    /** The shortest edit script ('=', '-', '+'), or null when it would need more than {@link #MAX_EDITS} edits. */
    static char[] script(List<String> a, List<String> b) {
        int n = a.size(), m = b.size(), max = Math.min(n + m, MAX_EDITS), offset = max + 1;
        var ka = a.stream().map(LineDiff::key).toList();
        var kb = b.stream().map(LineDiff::key).toList();
        int[] v = new int[2 * max + 3];
        var trace = new ArrayList<int[]>();
        for (int d = 0; d <= max; d++) {
            trace.add(v.clone());
            for (int k = -d; k <= d; k += 2) {
                int x = k == -d || (k != d && v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ? v[offset + k + 1] : v[offset + k - 1] + 1;
                int y = x - k;
                while (x < n && y < m && ka.get(x).equals(kb.get(y))) { x++; y++; }
                v[offset + k] = x;
                if (x >= n && y >= m) return backtrack(trace, n, m, offset);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static char[] backtrack(List<int[]> trace, int n, int m, int offset) {
        var ops = new StringBuilder();
        int x = n, y = m;
        for (int d = trace.size() - 1; d >= 0; d--) {
            int[] v = trace.get(d);
            int k = x - y;
            int previousK = k == -d || (k != d && v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ? k + 1 : k - 1;
            int previousX = d == 0 ? 0 : v[offset + previousK], previousY = previousX - previousK;
            while (x > previousX && y > previousY) { ops.append('='); x--; y--; }
            if (d > 0) { if (x == previousX) { ops.append('+'); y--; } else { ops.append('-'); x--; } }
        }
        return ops.reverse().toString().toCharArray();
    }

    private static String key(String line) { return line.strip().replaceAll("\\s+", " "); }

    static List<String> lines(String text) {
        var lines = new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n", -1)));
        if (!lines.isEmpty() && lines.getLast().isEmpty()) lines.removeLast();
        return lines;
    }
}
```

```java
        welcome = new WelcomePanel(settings, open, openResult, this::openPath);
        inspector = new InspectorPanel(() -> decompile(false));
        explorer = new ExplorerPanel(this::openClass, this::openResource, this::selected);
        activity = new ActivityPanel(cancel);
        search = new SearchPanel((name, line) -> workspace.classItem(name).ifPresent(item -> openClass(item, line)));
        usages = new UsagesPanel(this::openSite, () -> { if (usageIndex != null) usageIndex.cancel(); });
        explorer.popup(List.of(
            Ui.action(Text.t("action.findUsages"), null, Ui.key("alt F7"), () -> { if (explorer.selected() instanceof ExplorerPanel.ClassNode node) classUsages(node.item()); }),
            Ui.action(Text.t("action.memberUsages"), null, null, () -> { if (explorer.selected() instanceof ExplorerPanel.ClassNode node) memberOf(node.item(), false); }),
            Ui.action(Text.t("action.callHierarchy"), null, Ui.key("ctrl alt H"), () -> { if (explorer.selected() instanceof ExplorerPanel.ClassNode node) memberOf(node.item(), true); })));

        tabs.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_CLOSABLE, true);
        tabs.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_CLOSE_CALLBACK, (BiConsumer<JTabbedPane,Integer>) (pane, index) -> pane.removeTabAt(index));
        tabs.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_TYPE_UNDERLINED);
        tabs.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_SCROLL_BUTTONS_POLICY, FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_POLICY_AS_NEEDED);
        tabs.setTabLayoutPolicy(JTabbedPane.SCROLL_TAB_LAYOUT);
        tabs.addChangeListener(e -> caret.setText(tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab ? tab.caretText() : ""));
        var emptyTabs = new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());
        emptyTabs.add(Ui.muted(Text.t("tabs.empty")));
        var editorArea = new JPanel(new CardLayout());
        editorArea.add(emptyTabs, "empty");
        editorArea.add(tabs, "tabs");
        tabs.addContainerListener(new ContainerAdapter() {
            @Override public void componentAdded(ContainerEvent e) { ((CardLayout) editorArea.getLayout()).show(editorArea, "tabs"); }
            @Override public void componentRemoved(ContainerEvent e) { if (tabs.getTabCount() == 0) ((CardLayout) editorArea.getLayout()).show(editorArea, "empty"); }
        });

        bottom.addTab(Text.t("bottom.activity"), activity);
        bottom.addTab(Text.t("bottom.search"), search);
        bottom.addTab(Text.t("bottom.usages"), usages);
        bottom.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_HEIGHT, 28);
        bottom.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.TABBED_PANE_TAB_TYPE_UNDERLINED);
        bottom.setBorder(Ui.topLine());
        vertical = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.VERTICAL_SPLIT, editorArea, bottom);
        vertical.setResizeWeight(1);
        vertical.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        inner = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, vertical, inspector);
        inner.setResizeWeight(1);
        inner.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        explorer.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(300, 400));
        outer = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, explorer, inner);
        outer.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        center.add(welcome, "welcome");
        center.add(outer, "work");

        var root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        var north = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
        north.add(toolbar(), BorderLayout.NORTH);
        north.add(banner, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        root.add(north, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        root.add(center, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        root.add(statusBar(), BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(root);
        setJMenuBar(menus());
        setTransferHandler(new FileDrop());
        inspectorItem.setSelected(settings.showInspector());
        bottomItem.setSelected(settings.showActivity());
        refreshRecent();
        refreshActions();
        setSize(1380, 860);
        setMinimumSize(new Dimension(960, 600));
        setLocationRelativeTo(null);
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> { outer.setDividerLocation(300); inner.setDividerLocation(inner.getWidth() - 300); vertical.setDividerLocation(vertical.getHeight() - 210); });
        status(Text.t("status.ready"));
    }

    // ----- opening -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void chooseInput() {
        var chooser = chooser();
        chooser.setFileFilter(new javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter(Text.t("files.inputs"), "jar", "class", "exe", "zip", "war", "jmod"));
        chooser.setAcceptAllFileFilterUsed(true);
        if (chooser.showOpenDialog(this) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) openPath(chooser.getSelectedFile().toPath());
    }

    private void chooseResult() {
        var chooser = chooser();
        chooser.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
        chooser.setDialogTitle(Text.t("action.openResult"));
        if (Files.isDirectory(settings.workspaceDirectory())) chooser.setCurrentDirectory(settings.workspaceDirectory().toFile());
        if (chooser.showOpenDialog(this) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) openPath(chooser.getSelectedFile().toPath());
    }

    private JFileChooser chooser() {
        var chooser = new JFileChooser(settings.lastDirectory() == null ? null : settings.lastDirectory().toFile());
        chooser.addActionListener(e -> { if (chooser.getSelectedFile() != null) settings.lastDirectory(chooser.getSelectedFile().toPath().getParent()); });
        return chooser;
    }

    /** Opens an input file, or a result folder (one holding {@code report.json}). */
    void openPath(Path path) {
        if (running != null) { Ui.info(this, Text.t("app.name"), Text.t("busy.decompiling")); return; }
        if (opening) return;
        boolean folder = Files.isDirectory(path);
        if (!Files.exists(path)) {
            settings.forget(path);
            saveSettings();
            refreshRecent();
            Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("error.missing", path), null);
            return;
        }
        if (folder && !Files.isRegularFile(path.resolve("report.json"))) {
            Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("error.notResult", path.getFileName()), null);
            return;
        }
        opening = true;
        busy(true, Text.t("status.opening", Ui.visible(String.valueOf(path.getFileName()))));
        new SwingWorker<Workspace,Void>() {
            @Override protected Workspace doInBackground() throws Exception {
                return folder ? Workspace.openResult(path) : Workspace.openInput(path, settings.cacheDirectory());
            }
            @Override protected void done() {
                opening = false;
                busy(false, " ");
                try {
                    show(get());
                    settings.remember(path);
                    saveSettings();
                    refreshRecent();
                } catch (java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException failure) {
                    reportFailure(Text.t("error.openFailed", Ui.visible(String.valueOf(path.getFileName()))), failure.getCause());
                } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                }
            }
        }.execute();
    }

    private void show(Workspace opened) {
        workspace = opened;
        if (usageIndex != null) usageIndex.cancel();
        usageIndex = new UsageIndex(opened);
        shown = null;
        usages.message(Text.t("usages.empty"));
        usages.indexing("", false);
        backStack.clear();
        forwardStack.clear();
        dependencies = new ArrayList<>();
        tabs.removeAll();
        explorer.show(opened);
        inspector.show(opened, null);
        search.attach(opened);
        activity.reset();
        banner.show(opened);
        cards.show(center, "work");
        applyPanels();
        setTitle("ClassRevive — " + Ui.visible(opened.displayName()));
        refreshActions();
        if (opened.decompiled()) { showOverview(); status(summary(opened.result())); }
        else status(Text.t("status.opened", opened.classes().size(), Ui.visible(opened.displayName())));
        explorer.focusFilter();
    }

    private void closeWorkspace() {
        if (running != null) { Ui.info(this, Text.t("app.name"), Text.t("busy.decompiling")); return; }
        workspace = null;
        if (usageIndex != null) usageIndex.cancel();
        usageIndex = null;
        shown = null;
        usages.message(Text.t("usages.empty"));
        tabs.removeAll();
        search.attach(null);
        banner.show(null);
        welcome.refresh();
        cards.show(center, "welcome");
        setTitle("ClassRevive");
        refreshActions();
        status(Text.t("status.ready"));
    }

    // ----- decompiling -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void decompile(boolean ask) { decompile(ask, null); }

    /**
     * Phase G5: {@code reverse} true runs the Skidfuscator reversal first, false never does, null asks when the input
     * looks protected by Skidfuscator (and was not reversed already).
     */
    void decompile(boolean ask, Boolean reverse) {
        if (workspace == null || running != null) return;
        boolean declinedReversal = Boolean.FALSE.equals(reverse);
        if (reverse == null) {
            var detection = workspace.obfuscation();
            reverse = false;
            if (detection != null && detection.skidfuscator() && workspace.reversedFrom() == null) {
                var top = detection.top();
                Object[] options = {Text.t("skid.reverseAndDecompile"), Text.t("skid.decompileOriginal"), Text.t("dialog.cancel")};
                int answer = JOptionPane.showOptionDialog(this, "<html><body style='width:420px'>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("skid.question",
                    Text.t("confidence." + top.confidence()), top.score())) + "</body></html>", Text.t("skid.title"), JOptionPane.DEFAULT_OPTION,
                    JOptionPane.QUESTION_MESSAGE, null, options, options[0]);
                if (answer != 0 && answer != 1) return;
                reverse = answer == 0;
                declinedReversal = answer == 1;
            }
        }
        boolean reverseFirst = reverse, declined = declinedReversal;
        DecompileRequest request;
        try {
            if (ask) {
                var choice = DecompileDialog.ask(this, settings, dependencies);
                if (choice.isEmpty()) return;
                dependencies = new ArrayList<>(choice.get().dependencies());
                saveSettings();
                request = workspace.request(EngineRegistry.parse(choice.get().engines()), choice.get().timeoutSeconds(), choice.get().stubs(), dependencies, settings);
            } else request = workspace.request(settings, dependencies);
        } catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException invalid) {
            reportFailure(Text.t("error.decompileFailed"), invalid);
            return;
        }
        var target = workspace;
        settingsAction.setEnabled(false);
        showBottom(activity);
        activity.start(target.displayName(), request.engines().stream().map(engine -> engine.id()).toList());
        busy(true, Text.t("status.decompiling", Ui.visible(target.displayName())));
        var listener = new JobListener() {
            @Override public void stage(Stage stage) { SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.stage(stage)); }
            @Override public void engineStarted(String engine) { SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.engineStarted(engine)); }
            @Override public void engineFinished(EngineResult result) { SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.engineFinished(result)); }
        };
        running = Thread.ofPlatform().name("classrevive-decompile").start(() -> {
            try {
                if (reverseFirst) {
                    var reversed = reverseSkidfuscator(target, request);
                    if (reversed != null) {
                        // The result is the reversed program: reopen it, so the tree and bytecode show the reversed classes.
                        var output = new DecompileService().decompile(reversed, listener).output();
                        var reopened = Workspace.openResult(output);
                        reopened.reversedFrom(target.displayName());
                        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> reversedAndDecompiled(target, reopened));
                        return;
                    }
                }
                // Phase 2DD: the job reverses a recognized obfuscator by itself, unless the user chose the original or the
                // reversal above already ran (and fell back to the original).
                boolean original = reverseFirst || declined;
                var index = target.decompile(original ? request.withDeobfuscation(false) : request, listener);
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> decompiled(target, index));
            } catch (InterruptedException cancelled) {
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> stopped(Text.t("activity.cancelled", request.output()), null));
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> stopped(Text.t("activity.failed"), failure));
            }
        });
        refreshActions();
    }

    /**
     * Phase G5: runs the Skidfuscator reversal into its own new folder beside the result and returns the request for the
     * reversed jar, or null (the original is then decompiled) when the reversal fails or the JVM verifier refuses a class.
     */
    private DecompileRequest reverseSkidfuscator(Workspace target, DecompileRequest request) throws InterruptedException {
        SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.note(Text.t("skid.running")));
        try {
            String base = target.displayName().replaceAll("(?i)\\.(jar|class)$", "");
            Path folder = Workspace.newOutput(settings.workspaceDirectory(), base + "-skidfuscator-reversal");
            var result = SkidReversal.run(target.inspected(), folder, request.timeout());
            if (!result.usable()) {
                String reason = result.jar() == null ? Text.t("skid.noOutput") : Text.t("skid.notLinked", result.linkError());
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.note(Text.t("skid.fallback", reason)));
                return null;
            }
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.note(Text.t("skid.done", result.linkedClasses(), result.output())));
            return new DecompileRequest(result.jar(), request.output(), request.engines(), request.timeout(), request.dependencies(),
                request.engineCache(), request.stubs());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException failure) {
            String reason = String.valueOf(failure.getMessage());
            SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> activity.note(Text.t("skid.fallback", reason)));
            return null;
        }
    }

    private void reversedAndDecompiled(Workspace original, Workspace reversed) {
        running = null;
        busy(false, summary(reversed.result()));
        activity.finish(Text.t("activity.done", summary(reversed.result())), true);
        settingsAction.setEnabled(true);
        if (original != workspace) return;
        show(reversed);
        settings.remember(reversed.result().output());
        saveSettings();
        refreshRecent();
    }

    private void cancel() {
        if (running == null) return;
        running.interrupt();
        activity.cancelling();
        cancel.setEnabled(false);
    }

    private void decompiled(Workspace target, ResultIndex index) {
        running = null;
        busy(false, summary(index));
        activity.finish(Text.t("activity.done", summary(index)), true);
        settingsAction.setEnabled(true);
        if (target != workspace) return;
        explorer.refresh();
        inspector.show(target, explorer.selected());
        search.attach(target);
        for (int i = 0; i < tabs.getTabCount(); i++) if (tabs.getComponentAt(i) instanceof CodeTab tab) tab.refreshViews();
        refreshActions();
        showOverview();
        settings.remember(index.output());
        saveSettings();
        refreshRecent();
    }

    private void stopped(String outcome, Throwable failure) {
        running = null;
        busy(false, outcome);
        activity.finish(outcome, false);
        settingsAction.setEnabled(true);
        refreshActions();
        if (failure != null) reportFailure(Text.t("error.decompileFailed"), failure);
    }

    static String summary(ResultIndex index) {
        var summary = index.summary();
        var counts = index.levelCounts();
        String exact = counts.isEmpty() ? "" : " · " + Text.t("status.exact", counts.get(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT), index.classes().size());
        return Text.t("compilation." + summary.compilation()) + " · " + Text.t("status.signatures", summary.matchedSymbols(), summary.expectedSymbols()) + exact;
    }

    // ----- tabs ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    void openClass(Workspace.ClassItem item) { openClass(item, -1); }

    void openClass(Workspace.ClassItem item, int line) {
        remember();
        show(item);
        var tab = (CodeTab) find("class:" + item.name());
        if (line > 0) { tab.select(ResultIndex.SELECTION); tab.goToLine(line); }
        tab.focusEditor();
        explorer.reveal(item.name());
    }

    /** Selects the class's tab, opening it when needed; no history entry. */
    private CodeTab show(Workspace.ClassItem item) {
        var tab = (CodeTab) find("class:" + item.name());
        if (tab == null) {
            tab = CodeTab.forClass(workspace, item, settings, caret::setText);
            tab.navigator(name -> workspace.classItem(name).ifPresent(this::openClass));
            tab.contextActions(List.of(findUsages, callHierarchy));
            char kind = ExplorerPanel.kind(item);
            addTab(tab, Icons.kind(kind, ExplorerPanel.kindColor(kind), null));
        }
        tabs.setSelectedComponent(tab);
        return tab;
    }

    /** Phase G4: the current class tab and caret go on the back stack; a new move clears the forward stack. */
    private void remember() {
        if (!(tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab) || tab.classItem() == null) return;
        var place = new Place(tab.classItem().name(), tab.caret());
        if (place.equals(backStack.peek())) return;
        backStack.push(place);
        while (backStack.size() > MAX_HISTORY) backStack.removeLast();
        forwardStack.clear();
        refreshHistory();
    }

    private void travel(Deque<Place> from, Deque<Place> to) {
        if (workspace == null) return;
        while (!from.isEmpty()) {
            var place = from.pop();
            var item = workspace.classItem(place.className());
            if (item.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab current && current.classItem() != null)
                to.push(new Place(current.classItem().name(), current.caret()));
            var tab = show(item.get());
            tab.caret(place.caret());
            tab.focusEditor();
            explorer.reveal(place.className());
            break;
        }
        refreshHistory();
    }

    private void refreshHistory() {
        back.setEnabled(!backStack.isEmpty());
        forward.setEnabled(!forwardStack.isEmpty());
    }

    /** Phase G4: the class of the current tab (or the explorer's selection) in two candidates side by side. */
    private void compareCurrent() {
        if (result() == null) return;
        Workspace.ClassItem item = null;
        if (tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab) item = tab.classItem();
        else if (tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CompareTab) return;
        if (item == null && explorer.selected() instanceof ExplorerPanel.ClassNode node) item = node.item();
        if (item == null) { status(Text.t("compare.pick")); return; }
        if (result().candidates().size() < 2) { status(Text.t("compare.oneCandidate")); return; }
        for (int i = 0; i < tabs.getTabCount(); i++)
            if (tabs.getComponentAt(i) instanceof CompareTab open && open.key.equals("compare:" + item.name())) { tabs.setSelectedIndex(i); return; }
        var compareTab = new CompareTab(workspace, item, settings);
        tabs.addTab(compareTab.title(), Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.COMPARE, 14), compareTab, Ui.visible(item.name().replace('/', '.')));
        tabs.setSelectedComponent(compareTab);
    }

    private void openResource(Workspace.ResourceItem item) {
        var tab = (CodeTab) find("resource:" + item.entry());
        if (tab == null) { tab = CodeTab.forResource(workspace, item, settings, caret::setText); addTab(tab, Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.RESOURCE, 14)); }
        tabs.setSelectedComponent(tab);
    }

    private void addTab(CodeTab tab, Icon icon) {
        tabs.addTab(tab.title(), icon, tab, tab.tooltip());
        while (tabs.getTabCount() > MAX_TABS) {
            int oldest = tabs.getComponentAt(0) instanceof OverviewPanel ? 1 : 0;
            tabs.removeTabAt(oldest);
        }
    }

    private Component find(String key) {
        for (int i = 0; i < tabs.getTabCount(); i++) {
            var component = tabs.getComponentAt(i);
            if (component instanceof CodeTab tab && tab.key.equals(key)) return tab;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private void showOverview() {
        if (result() == null) return;
        for (int i = 0; i < tabs.getTabCount(); i++) if (tabs.getComponentAt(i) instanceof OverviewPanel) tabs.removeTabAt(i--);
        var panel = new OverviewPanel(workspace, List.of(exportProject, openReport, openFolder));
        tabs.insertTab(Text.t("tab.overview"), Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.REPORT, 14), panel, null, 0);
        tabs.setSelectedIndex(0);
    }

    private void selected(ExplorerPanel.Node node) { if (workspace != null) inspector.show(workspace, node); }

    // ----- navigation and search --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void goToClass() {
        if (workspace == null) return;
        new GoToClassDialog(this, workspace, this::openClass).setVisible(true);
    }

    private void searchCode() {
        if (result() == null) return;
        showBottom(search);
        String selected = null;
        if (tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab) selected = selectedText(tab);
        search.focus(selected);
    }

    private static String selectedText(CodeTab tab) {
        var focus = KeyboardFocusManager.getCurrentKeyboardFocusManager().getFocusOwner();
        return focus instanceof javax.swing.text.JTextComponent text && SwingUtilities.isDescendingFrom(text, tab) ? text.getSelectedText() : null;
    }

    private void copyName() {
        if (tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab && tab.classItem() != null) {
            var name = tab.classItem().name().replace('/', '.');
            Toolkit.getDefaultToolkit().getSystemClipboard().setContents(new StringSelection(name), null);
            status(Text.t("status.copied", Ui.visible(name)));
        }
    }

    // ----- usages (Phase G6) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** Alt+F7 / Ctrl+Alt+H: the word under the editor's caret, or the class selected in the explorer when it has focus. */
    private void usagesOf(boolean hierarchy) {
        if (workspace == null) return;
        var focus = KeyboardFocusManager.getCurrentKeyboardFocusManager().getFocusOwner();
        boolean fromTree = focus != null && SwingUtilities.isDescendingFrom(focus, explorer);
        if (!fromTree && tabs.getSelectedComponent() instanceof CodeTab tab && tab.classItem() != null) { atCaret(tab, hierarchy); return; }
        if (explorer.selected() instanceof ExplorerPanel.ClassNode node) {
            if (hierarchy) memberOf(node.item(), true); else classUsages(node.item());
            return;
        }
        status(Text.t("usages.pick"));
    }

    /** Runs {@code then} with the index for the current input, building it first (in the background) when needed. */
    private void withIndex(Consumer<UsageIndex.Built> then) {
        var target = usageIndex;
        if (target == null) return;
        showBottom(usages);
        usages.indexing(Text.t("usages.indexing"), true);
        target.whenReady(built -> {
            if (target != usageIndex) return;
            usages.indexing(note(built), false);
            then.accept(built);
        }, failure -> {
            if (target != usageIndex) return;
            String text = failure instanceof InterruptedException ? Text.t("usages.cancelled")
                : Text.t("usages.failed", Ui.visible(String.valueOf(failure.getMessage())));
            usages.indexing(text, false);
            status(text);
        });
    }

    private static String note(UsageIndex.Built built) {
        var stats = built.index().stats();
        String text = Text.t(built.basedOn() == null ? "usages.indexedInput" : "usages.indexedResult", stats.classes(), stats.sites(), built.millis());
        if (stats.unreadable() > 0) text += " · " + Text.t("usages.unreadable", stats.unreadable());
        if (stats.truncated()) text += " · " + Text.t("usages.truncated");
        return text;
    }

    private UnaryOperator<String> treeNames(UsageIndex.Built built) {
        var index = usageIndex;
        return name -> index == null ? name : index.treeName(built, name);
    }

    /** The member (or class) under the caret: exact in bytecode, by context in source, a choice when ambiguous. */
    private void atCaret(CodeTab tab, boolean hierarchy) {
        withIndex(built -> {
            var index = built.index();
            String current = usageIndex.indexName(built, tab.classItem().name());
            List<ReferenceIndex.Ref> candidates;
            String word;
            if (CodeTab.BYTECODE.equals(tab.viewId())) {
                var ref = MemberAtCaret.inBytecode(tab.caretLine(), tab.classItem().name(), name -> usageIndex.indexName(built, name));
                candidates = ref == null ? List.of() : List.of(ref);
                word = ref == null ? "" : ref.isClass() ? ref.owner() : ref.name();
            } else {
                var query = MemberAtCaret.at(tab.content(), tab.caret());
                UnaryOperator<String> classes = simple -> {
                    String tree = tab.resolveClass(simple);
                    return tree == null ? null : usageIndex.indexName(built, tree);
                };
                candidates = MemberAtCaret.candidates(query, index, current, fileClasses(index, current), classes);
                word = query == null ? "" : query.word();
            }
            if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
                String text = word.isEmpty() ? Text.t("usages.nothing") : Text.t("usages.notDeclared", Ui.visible(word));
                usages.message(text);
                status(text);
                return;
            }
            choose(Text.t("usages.choose.message", Ui.visible(word)), candidates, built, ref -> run(ref, hierarchy, built));
        });
    }

    /** The index classes declared in the same source file as {@code current} (its top-level class and nested ones), current first. */
    private static List<String> fileClasses(ReferenceIndex index, String current) {
        int slash = current.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = current.indexOf('$', slash + 1);
        String top = dollar < 0 ? current : current.substring(0, dollar);
        var found = new ArrayList<String>(List.of(current));
        for (String name : new TreeSet<>(index.classes().keySet()))
            if (!name.equals(current) && (name.equals(top) || name.startsWith(top + "$"))) found.add(name);
        return found;
    }

    private void choose(String message, List<ReferenceIndex.Ref> candidates, UsageIndex.Built built, Consumer<ReferenceIndex.Ref> then) {
        if (candidates.size() == 1) { then.accept(candidates.getFirst()); return; }
        chooser.choose(this, message, candidates, treeNames(built)).ifPresent(then);
    }

    private void classUsages(Workspace.ClassItem item) {
        withIndex(built -> run(ReferenceIndex.Ref.ofClass(usageIndex.indexName(built, item.name())), false, built));
    }

    /** Asks for a member of {@code item}: any member (and the class) for usages, a method for the call hierarchy. */
    private void memberOf(Workspace.ClassItem item, boolean hierarchy) {
        withIndex(built -> {
            String name = usageIndex.indexName(built, item.name());
            var decl = built.index().declaration(name).orElse(null);
            if (decl == null) { status(Text.t("usages.unreadableClass", Ui.visible(item.name().replace('/', '.')))); return; }
            var options = new ArrayList<ReferenceIndex.Ref>();
            if (!hierarchy) { options.add(ReferenceIndex.Ref.ofClass(name)); decl.fields().forEach(field -> options.add(field.ref())); }
            decl.methods().forEach(method -> options.add(method.ref()));
            if (options.isEmpty()) { status(Text.t("usages.noMethods")); return; }
            chooser.choose(this, Text.t(hierarchy ? "usages.choose.method" : "usages.choose.member", Ui.visible(item.simpleName())), options, treeNames(built))
                .ifPresent(ref -> run(ref, hierarchy, built));
        });
    }

    private void run(ReferenceIndex.Ref ref, boolean hierarchy, UsageIndex.Built built) {
        shown = built;
        var names = treeNames(built);
        showBottom(usages);
        if (hierarchy) {
            if (ref.isClass()) {
                workspace.classItem(names.apply(ref.owner())).ifPresentOrElse(item -> memberOf(item, true), () -> status(Text.t("usages.notAMethod")));
                return;
            }
            if (!ref.isMethod()) { status(Text.t("usages.notAMethod")); return; }
            hierarchy(ref, UsagesPanel.DEFAULT_DEPTH, built);
            return;
        }
        var found = built.index().usages(ref);
        usages.showUsages(ref, found, names, note(built));
        status(Text.t(found.isEmpty() ? "usages.titleNone" : "usages.title", found.size(), UsagesPanel.describe(ref, names)));
    }

    private void hierarchy(ReferenceIndex.Ref method, int depth, UsageIndex.Built built) {
        var root = CallHierarchy.callers(built.index(), method, depth, UsagesPanel.MAX_NODES);
        usages.showHierarchy(root, depth, treeNames(built), level -> hierarchy(method, level, built), note(built));
        status(Text.t("usages.hierarchyTitle", UsagesPanel.describe(method, treeNames(built))));
    }

    /** Opens a site's class: the selected source when there is one (else the bytecode), at the site's line. */
    void openSite(ReferenceIndex.Site site) {
        var built = shown;
        if (workspace == null || built == null) return;
        var names = treeNames(built);
        String tree = names.apply(site.className());
        var item = workspace.classItem(tree);
        if (item.isEmpty()) { status(Text.t("usages.notInTree", Ui.visible(tree.replace('/', '.')))); return; }
        remember();
        var tab = show(item.get());
        tab.select(workspace.source(tree, ResultIndex.SELECTION).isPresent() ? ResultIndex.SELECTION : CodeTab.BYTECODE);
        var index = built.index();
        tab.reveal((view, text) -> CodeTab.BYTECODE.equals(view) ? UsageLocator.bytecode(text, site, names) : UsageLocator.source(text, site, index));
        tab.focusEditor();
        explorer.reveal(tree);
    }

    // ----- export ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private void exportProject() {
        var index = result();
        if (index == null) return;
        Path project = index.output().resolve("project");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(project)) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("export.noProject"), null); return; }
        var chooser = chooser();
        chooser.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
        chooser.setDialogTitle(Text.t("export.chooseFolder"));
        if (chooser.showSaveDialog(this) != JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) return;
        Path parent = chooser.getSelectedFile().toPath();
        String base = workspace.displayName().replaceAll("\\.(jar|class)$", "") + "-project";
        Path target = parent.resolve(base);
        for (int n = 2; Files.exists(target); n++) target = parent.resolve(base + "-" + n);
        Path destination = target;
        background(Text.t("status.exporting"), () -> Exporter.copyTree(project, destination),
            count -> offerFolder(Text.t("export.done", count, destination), destination));
    }

    private void exportSources() {
        var index = result();
        if (index == null) return;
        Path sources = index.output().resolve(ResultIndex.SELECTION).resolve("sources");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(sources)) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("export.noSources"), null); return; }
        var chooser = chooser();
        chooser.setSelectedFile(new File(chooser.getCurrentDirectory(), workspace.displayName().replaceAll("\\.(jar|class)$", "") + "-sources.zip"));
        chooser.setFileFilter(new javax.swing.filechooser.FileNameExtensionFilter("ZIP", "zip"));
        if (chooser.showSaveDialog(this) != JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) return;
        Path chosen = chooser.getSelectedFile().toPath();
        Path target = chosen.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".zip") ? chosen : chosen.resolveSibling(chosen.getFileName() + ".zip");
        if (Files.exists(target)) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("export.exists", target.getFileName()), null); return; }
        background(Text.t("status.exporting"), () -> Exporter.zip(sources, target),
            count -> offerFolder(Text.t("export.zipDone", count, target), target.getParent()));
    }

    private void offerFolder(String text, Path folder) {
        status(text);
        Object[] options = {Text.t("export.openFolder"), Text.t("dialog.close")};
        int answer = JOptionPane.showOptionDialog(this, text, Text.t("export.title"), JOptionPane.DEFAULT_OPTION, JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE, null, options, options[0]);
        if (answer == 0) Ui.open(this, folder);
    }

    interface Work<T> { T run() throws Exception; }

    private <T> void background(String label, Work<T> work, java.util.function.Consumer<T> done) {
        busy(true, label);
        new SwingWorker<T,Void>() {
            @Override protected T doInBackground() throws Exception { return work.run(); }
            @Override protected void done() {
                busy(false, " ");
                try { done.accept(get()); }
                catch (java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException failure) { reportFailure(Text.t("error.exportFailed"), failure.getCause()); }
                catch (InterruptedException interrupted) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
            }
        }.execute();
    }

    }

    private void exit() {
        if (running != null) {
            int answer = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(this, Text.t("exit.running"), Text.t("app.name"), JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION, JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
            if (answer != JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) return;
            var job = running;
            job.interrupt();
            busy(true, Text.t("activity.cancelling"));
            Thread.ofVirtual().start(() -> {
                try { job.join(20_000); } catch (InterruptedException ignored) { }
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(this::shutdown);
            });
            return;
        }
        shutdown();
    }

        System.exit(0);

    private void reportFailure(String headline, Throwable failure) {
        if (failure instanceof Workspace.Unreadable unreadable) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), unreadable.getMessage(), unreadable.details()); return; }
        if (failure instanceof InputIdentifier.NoJavaException noJava) {
            Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("error.noJavaShort"), noJava.identification().text());
            return;
        }
        String reason = failure == null ? "" : failure.getMessage() == null ? failure.getClass().getSimpleName() : failure.getMessage();
        if (failure instanceof FileAlreadyExistsException) reason = Text.t("error.exists", failure.getMessage());
        Ui.error(this, Text.t("error.title"), headline + "\n" + Ui.visible(reason), stack(failure));
    }

    private static String stack(Throwable failure) {
        if (failure == null) return null;
        var text = new java.io.StringWriter();
        failure.printStackTrace(new java.io.PrintWriter(text));
        return text.toString();
    }

    /** Accepts a file or folder dropped anywhere on the window. */
    private final class FileDrop extends TransferHandler {
        @Override public boolean canImport(TransferSupport support) { return support.isDataFlavorSupported(DataFlavor.javaFileListFlavor); }
        @Override public boolean importData(TransferSupport support) {
            try {
                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
                var files = (List<File>) support.getTransferable().getTransferData(DataFlavor.javaFileListFlavor);
                if (files.isEmpty()) return false;
                openPath(files.getFirst().toPath());
                return true;
            } catch (UnsupportedFlavorException | IOException unreadable) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
```
