`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/MemberAtCaret.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex.Ref;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Phase G6: what the word under the caret names, as candidates from the reference index. Decompiled text has no types,
 * so a name is resolved by its context and never guessed: a class through the Phase G4 resolution (import, nested class,
 * same package, unique simple name); a member through its qualifier ({@code Type.m}, {@code this.m}, {@code super.m},
 * {@code Type::m}), else the classes of this file and their supertypes, else every class of the input; overloads are
 * narrowed by the number of arguments. More than one candidate is for the user to choose.
 */
final class MemberAtCaret {
    private MemberAtCaret() {}

    /** The identifier at an offset and its surroundings; {@code arguments} is -1 unless a call's list was counted. */
    record Query(String word, int start, boolean call, int arguments, String qualifier, boolean afterNew, boolean declaration) {}

    private static final Set<String> KEYWORDS = Set.of("abstract", "assert", "boolean", "break", "byte", "case", "catch", "char", "class",
        "const", "continue", "default", "do", "double", "else", "enum", "extends", "final", "finally", "float", "for", "goto", "if",
        "implements", "import", "instanceof", "int", "interface", "long", "native", "new", "package", "private", "protected", "public",
        "return", "short", "static", "strictfp", "super", "switch", "synchronized", "this", "throw", "throws", "transient", "try",
        "void", "volatile", "while", "var", "record", "true", "false", "null");

    /** The query at {@code offset} in Java text, or null on a keyword, literal, comment or nothing. */
    static Query at(String text, int offset) {
        String code = MethodLocator.blank(text);
        if (offset < 0 || offset > code.length()) return null;
        int start = offset, end = offset;
        while (start > 0 && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(start - 1))) start--;
        while (end < code.length() && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(end))) end++;
        if (start == end) return null;
        String word = code.substring(start, end);
        if (KEYWORDS.contains(word) || !Character.isJavaIdentifierStart(word.charAt(0))) return null;
        int after = skip(code, end);
        boolean call = after < code.length() && code.charAt(after) == '(';
        int arguments = -1;
        boolean declaration = false;
        if (call) {
            int close = matchParen(code, after);
            if (close > 0) {
                int next = skip(code, close + 1);
                declaration = next < code.length() && (code.charAt(next) == '{' || code.startsWith("throws", next)
                    || code.charAt(next) == ';' && !precededByOperator(code, start));
                // Parameter lists nest generic arguments (Map<K, V>); call arguments may hold comparisons instead.
                arguments = count(code, after + 1, close, declaration);
            }
        }
        String qualifier = null;
        boolean afterNew = false;
        int before = start - 1;
        while (before >= 0 && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(before))) before--;
        if (before >= 0 && (code.charAt(before) == '.' || before > 0 && code.charAt(before) == ':' && code.charAt(before - 1) == ':')) {
            int qualifierEnd = code.charAt(before) == '.' ? before : before - 1;
            while (qualifierEnd > 0 && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(qualifierEnd - 1))) qualifierEnd--;
            int qualifierStart = qualifierEnd;
            while (qualifierStart > 0 && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(qualifierStart - 1))) qualifierStart--;
            qualifier = qualifierStart < qualifierEnd ? code.substring(qualifierStart, qualifierEnd) : "?";
            if (code.charAt(before) == ':') call = true;
        } else if (before >= 2 && code.startsWith("new", before - 2) && (before < 3 || !Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(before - 3)))) {
            afterNew = true;
        }
        if (declaration && (qualifier != null || afterNew)) declaration = false;
        return new Query(word, start, call, arguments, qualifier, afterNew, declaration);
    }

    /** A {@code ;} after a call ends a statement (a call), unless the name follows a type (an abstract declaration). */
    private static boolean precededByOperator(String code, int start) {
        int i = start - 1;
        while (i >= 0 && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(i))) i--;
        if (i < 0) return true;
        char c = code.charAt(i);
        if (c == '>' || c == ']') return false;
        if (!Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(c)) return true;
        int end = i + 1;
        while (i >= 0 && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(i))) i--;
        return Set.of("return", "new", "throw", "else", "case", "yield").contains(code.substring(i + 1, end)) || i >= 0 && code.charAt(i) == '.';
    }

    /**
     * Candidates for {@code query} in the class {@code current} (index name). {@code classes} resolves a simple class
     * name written in this file to an index class name, or null; {@code fileClasses} are the index classes declared in
     * this file, the current one first.
     */
    static List<Ref> candidates(Query query, ReferenceIndex index, String current, List<String> fileClasses, UnaryOperator<String> classes) {
        if (query == null) return List.of();
        String asClass = Character.isUpperCase(query.word().charAt(0)) || query.afterNew() ? classes.apply(query.word()) : null;
        if (asClass != null && query.afterNew() && query.call()) {
            var constructors = arity(index.declared(asClass, "<init>", true).stream().map(ReferenceIndex.Member::ref).toList(), query.arguments());
            return constructors.isEmpty() ? List.of(Ref.ofClass(asClass)) : constructors;
        }
        if (asClass != null && !query.call()) return List.of(Ref.ofClass(asClass));
        // A constructor declaration, or this(...)/super(...): the class's constructors.
        if (query.call() && query.declaration() && fileClasses.stream().anyMatch(name -> MethodLocator.simpleName(name).equals(query.word()))) {
            var owner = fileClasses.stream().filter(name -> MethodLocator.simpleName(name).equals(query.word())).toList();
            var found = new ArrayList<Ref>();
            for (String name : owner) index.declared(name, "<init>", true).forEach(member -> found.add(member.ref()));
            return arity(found, query.arguments());
        }
        boolean methods = query.call();
        List<String> scope;
        boolean known = true;
        if (query.declaration()) scope = fileClasses;
        else if (query.qualifier() == null) scope = fileClasses;
        else if (query.qualifier().equals("this")) scope = List.of(current);
        else if (query.qualifier().equals("super")) scope = index.declaration(current).map(decl -> decl.superName() == null ? List.<String>of() : List.of(decl.superName())).orElse(List.of());
        else {
            String qualifierClass = Character.isUpperCase(query.qualifier().charAt(0)) ? classes.apply(query.qualifier()) : null;
            scope = qualifierClass == null ? List.of() : List.of(qualifierClass);
            known = qualifierClass != null;
        }
        var found = new ArrayList<Ref>();
        if (known) {
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            for (String type : scope) {
                var walk = new ArrayList<String>();
                walk.add(type);
                if (!query.declaration()) walk.addAll(index.supertypes(type));
                for (String owner : walk)
                    for (var member : index.declared(owner, query.word(), methods))
                        // The most derived declaration of a signature hides the ones it overrides.
                        if (seen.add(member.isPrivate() ? owner + "#" + member.descriptor() : member.descriptor())) found.add(member.ref());
            }
        }
        if (found.isEmpty() && !query.declaration()) {
            for (var decl : new TreeMap<>(index.classes()).values())
                for (var member : index.declared(decl.name(), query.word(), methods)) found.add(member.ref());
        }
        return methods ? arity(found, query.arguments()) : found;
    }

    /** Keeps the overloads with {@code arguments} parameters, when that is known and at least one has them. */
    private static List<Ref> arity(List<Ref> refs, int arguments) {
        if (arguments < 0) return refs;
        var matching = refs.stream().filter(ref -> MethodLocator.parameters(ref.descriptor()) == arguments).toList();
        return matching.isEmpty() ? refs : matching;
    }

    private static final Pattern INSTRUCTION = Pattern.compile("^\\s+(?:INVOKE\\w+|GETFIELD|PUTFIELD|GETSTATIC|PUTSTATIC)\\s+([^\\s.]+)\\.(\\S+)\\s+(?::\\s+)?(\\S+)");
    private static final Pattern TYPE = Pattern.compile("^\\s+(?:NEW|ANEWARRAY|CHECKCAST|INSTANCEOF)\\s+(\\S+)\\s*$");
    private static final Pattern METHOD_HEADER = Pattern.compile("^  (?:[a-z]+ )*([^\\s(]+)(\\([^\\s]*)$");
    private static final Pattern FIELD_HEADER = Pattern.compile("^  (?:[a-z]+ )*(\\S+) (\\S+)(?: = .*)?$");

    /**
     * In ASM's bytecode text the line says exactly what it references: an instruction names its owner, name and
     * descriptor; a member header is a member of {@code current} (the text's own class name). {@code toIndex} maps the
     * text's class names to the index's. Null when the line names nothing.
     */
    static Ref inBytecode(String line, String current, UnaryOperator<String> toIndex) {
        var instruction = INSTRUCTION.matcher(line);
        if (instruction.find()) return new Ref(toIndex.apply(instruction.group(1)), instruction.group(2), mapDescriptor(instruction.group(3), toIndex));
        var type = TYPE.matcher(line);
        if (type.find()) {
            String name = type.group(1);
            if (name.startsWith("[")) { int l = name.indexOf('L'); if (l < 0) return null; name = name.substring(l + 1, name.length() - 1); }
            return Ref.ofClass(toIndex.apply(name));
        }
        if (line.startsWith("  //") || line.startsWith("  @") || line.startsWith("   ")) return null;
        var method = METHOD_HEADER.matcher(line);
        if (method.find()) return new Ref(toIndex.apply(current), method.group(1), mapDescriptor(method.group(2), toIndex));
        var field = FIELD_HEADER.matcher(line);
        if (field.find() && field.group(1).matches("\\[*([BCDFIJSZ]|L[^;]+;)")) return new Ref(toIndex.apply(current), field.group(2), mapDescriptor(field.group(1), toIndex));
        return null;
    }

    private static String mapDescriptor(String descriptor, UnaryOperator<String> names) {
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("L([^;]+);").matcher(descriptor);
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        while (matcher.find()) matcher.appendReplacement(out, java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement("L" + names.apply(matcher.group(1)) + ";"));
        matcher.appendTail(out);
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int skip(String code, int i) {
        while (i < code.length() && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(i))) i++;
        return i;
    }

    private static int matchParen(String code, int open) {
        int depth = 0;
        for (int i = open; i < code.length(); i++) {
            char c = code.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(') depth++;
            else if (c == ')' && --depth == 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /** Top-level commas plus one; {@code <} nests only in a declaration's parameters (in a call it may be a comparison). */
    private static int count(String code, int from, int close, boolean generics) {
        if (code.substring(from, close).isBlank()) return 0;
        int depth = 0, commas = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < close; i++) {
            char c = code.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(' || c == '[' || c == '{' || generics && c == '<') depth++;
            else if (c == ')' || c == ']' || c == '}' || generics && c == '>') depth--;
            else if (c == ',' && depth == 0) commas++;
        }
        return commas + 1;
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex.Ref;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
import javax.swing.*;

/**
 * Phase G6: asks which member is meant when a name has several candidates (overloads, or the same name in several
 * classes). The user picks; nothing is chosen for them.
 */
final class MemberChooser {
    private MemberChooser() {}

    /** What the window asks; tests replace it. */
    interface Ask { Optional<Ref> choose(Component parent, String message, List<Ref> options, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames); }

    static Optional<Ref> choose(Component parent, String message, List<Ref> options, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames) {
        var list = new JList<>(options.toArray(Ref[]::new));
        list.setCellRenderer(new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> view, Object value, int index, boolean selected, boolean focus) {
                super.getListCellRendererComponent(view, value, index, selected, focus);
                if (value instanceof Ref ref) {
                    String owner = treeNames.apply(ref.owner()).replace('/', '.');
                    setText("<html>" + Ui.escape(UsagesPanel.member(ref, treeNames)) + " <span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(Ui.visible(owner)) + "</span></html>");
                }
                return this;
            }
        });
        list.setSelectedIndex(0);
        list.setVisibleRowCount(Math.min(12, options.size()));
        var pane = new JOptionPane(new Object[] {message, new JScrollPane(list)}, JOptionPane.QUESTION_MESSAGE, JOptionPane.OK_CANCEL_OPTION);
        var dialog = pane.createDialog(parent, Text.t("usages.choose.title"));
        list.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) {
                if (event.getClickCount() == 2) pane.setValue(JOptionPane.OK_OPTION);
            }
        });
        dialog.setResizable(true);
        dialog.setVisible(true);
        Object answer = pane.getValue();
        dialog.dispose();
        return Integer.valueOf(JOptionPane.OK_OPTION).equals(answer) ? Optional.ofNullable(list.getSelectedValue()) : Optional.empty();
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/MethodLocator.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

/**
 * Phase G4: where a method is declared in decompiled source, so the editor can mark it. Text only and best effort: a
 * class's body is found from its declaration by brace matching (strings, chars and comments skipped), and a method by
 * its name and parameter count inside that body but outside nested classes. Constructors are found by the class's
 * simple name, the class initializer by {@code static {}. Synthetic methods ({@code lambda$}, {@code access$}) have no
 * declaration and are not found. Overloads with the same parameter count are taken in order of appearance.
 */
final class MethodLocator {
    private MethodLocator() {}

    /** A located class body: offsets of its {@code {} and matching {@code }}. */
    record Body(int open, int close) {
        boolean contains(int offset) { return offset > open && offset < close; }
    }

    /**
     * 1-based declaration lines for the methods of each class in {@code text}. {@code methods} maps a class's internal
     * name ({@code a/B$C}) to its method keys ({@code name + descriptor}). Methods not found are absent from the result.
     */
    static Map<String,Map<String,Integer>> locate(String text, Map<String,? extends Collection<String>> methods) {
        String code = blank(text);
        var bodies = new LinkedHashMap<String,Body>();
        // Outer classes first: a nested class's body is recognized by being inside one already found.
        var outerFirst = methods.keySet().stream().sorted(Comparator.comparingInt(MethodLocator::nestingDepth)).toList();
        for (String className : outerFirst) {
            Body body = body(code, simpleName(className), nestingDepth(className), bodies.values());
            if (body != null) bodies.put(className, body);
        }
        var lines = lineStarts(text);
        var result = new LinkedHashMap<String,Map<String,Integer>>();
        for (var entry : methods.entrySet()) {
            Body body = bodies.get(entry.getKey());
            if (body == null) continue;
            var nested = bodies.values().stream().filter(other -> other != body && body.contains(other.open)).toList();
            var used = new HashSet<Integer>();
            var found = new LinkedHashMap<String,Integer>();
            for (String method : entry.getValue()) {
                int paren = method.indexOf('(');
                if (paren <= 0) continue;
                String name = method.substring(0, paren);
                if (name.startsWith("lambda$") || name.startsWith("access$") || name.contains("$")) continue;
                int offset = name.equals("<clinit>") ? staticBlock(code, body, nested, used)
                    : declaration(code, name.equals("<init>") ? simpleName(entry.getKey()) : name, parameters(method.substring(paren)), body, nested, used);
                if (offset < 0) continue;
                used.add(offset);
                found.put(method, line(lines, offset));
            }
            result.put(entry.getKey(), found);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** The class's own name: after the last {@code /} and {@code $}; empty for anonymous classes ({@code A$1}). */
    static String simpleName(String internalName) {
        String simple = internalName.substring(Math.max(internalName.lastIndexOf('/'), internalName.lastIndexOf('$')) + 1);
        return simple.isEmpty() || Character.isDigit(simple.charAt(0)) ? "" : simple;
    }

    private static int nestingDepth(String internalName) {
        String simple = internalName.substring(internalName.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        return (int) simple.chars().filter(c -> c == '$').count();
    }

    /** Parameter count of a method descriptor's {@code (...)} part. */
    static int parameters(String descriptor) {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < descriptor.length() && descriptor.charAt(i) != ')'; i++) {
            char c = descriptor.charAt(i);
            if (c == '[') continue;
            if (c == 'L') i = descriptor.indexOf(';', i);
            count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    private static Body body(String code, String simple, int depth, Collection<Body> known) {
        if (simple.isEmpty()) return null;
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\b(?:class|interface|enum|record|@interface)\\s+" + Pattern.quote(simple) + "\\b").matcher(code);
        while (matcher.find()) {
            int open = code.indexOf('{', matcher.end());
            if (open < 0) return null;
            int close = match(code, open);
            if (close < 0) continue;
            // A nested class sits inside another body; a top-level one does not.
            boolean inside = known.stream().anyMatch(body -> body.contains(open));
            if ((depth == 0) == !inside) return new Body(open, close);
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static int declaration(String code, String name, int parameters, Body body, List<Body> nested, Set<Integer> used) {
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\b" + Pattern.quote(name) + "\\s*\\(").matcher(code);
        matcher.region(body.open + 1, body.close);
        while (matcher.find()) {
            int start = matcher.start();
            if (used.contains(start) || nested.stream().anyMatch(other -> other.contains(start)) || !declarationContext(code, start)) continue;
            int close = match(code, matcher.end() - 1, '(', ')');
            if (close < 0 || count(code, matcher.end(), close) != parameters) continue;
            // A declaration's parameter list is followed by a body, "throws", or ";" (abstract and interface methods).
            int after = skipSpace(code, close + 1);
            if (after < code.length() && (code.charAt(after) == '{' || code.charAt(after) == ';' || code.startsWith("throws", after))) return start;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    /** The name follows a type, a modifier or a generic list, not an operator, a dot or a keyword such as {@code new}/{@code return}. */
    private static boolean declarationContext(String code, int start) {
        int i = start - 1;
        while (i >= 0 && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(i))) i--;
        if (i < 0) return false;
        char c = code.charAt(i);
        if (c == '>' || c == ']') return true;
        if (!Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(c)) return c == '}' || c == ';' || c == '{';
        int end = i + 1;
        while (i >= 0 && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(code.charAt(i))) i--;
        String word = code.substring(i + 1, end);
        if (Set.of("new", "return", "throw", "else", "case", "assert", "yield").contains(word)) return false;
        return i < 0 || code.charAt(i) != '.';
    }

    private static int staticBlock(String code, Body body, List<Body> nested, Set<Integer> used) {
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\bstatic\\s*\\{").matcher(code);
        matcher.region(body.open + 1, body.close);
        while (matcher.find()) if (!used.contains(matcher.start()) && nested.stream().noneMatch(other -> other.contains(matcher.start()))) return matcher.start();
        return -1;
    }

    /** Top-level commas plus one, or 0 for an empty list, between {@code from} and the closing parenthesis. */
    private static int count(String code, int from, int close) {
        if (code.substring(from, close).isBlank()) return 0;
        int depth = 0, commas = 0;
        for (int i = from; i < close; i++) {
            char c = code.charAt(i);
            if (c == '<' || c == '(' || c == '[') depth++;
            else if (c == '>' || c == ')' || c == ']') depth--;
            else if (c == ',' && depth == 0) commas++;
        }
        return commas + 1;
    }

    private static int match(String code, int open) { return match(code, open, '{', '}'); }

    private static int match(String code, int open, char left, char right) {
        int depth = 0;
        for (int i = open; i < code.length(); i++) {
            char c = code.charAt(i);
            if (c == left) depth++;
            else if (c == right && --depth == 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static int skipSpace(String code, int i) {
        while (i < code.length() && Character.isWhitespace(code.charAt(i))) i++;
        return i;
    }

    /** The text with comments, string and char literals replaced by spaces (same length, newlines kept). */
    static String blank(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder(text);
        int i = 0, n = text.length();
        while (i < n) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (c == '/' && i + 1 < n && text.charAt(i + 1) == '/') { while (i < n && text.charAt(i) != '\n') out.setCharAt(i++, ' '); }
            else if (c == '/' && i + 1 < n && text.charAt(i + 1) == '*') {
                int end = text.indexOf("*/", i + 2);
                end = end < 0 ? n : end + 2;
                for (; i < end; i++) if (text.charAt(i) != '\n') out.setCharAt(i, ' ');
            } else if (c == '"' || c == '\'') {
                boolean block = c == '"' && text.startsWith("\"\"\"", i);
                int j = i + (block ? 3 : 1);
                while (j < n) {
                    if (text.charAt(j) == '\\') { j += 2; continue; }
                    if (block ? text.startsWith("\"\"\"", j) : text.charAt(j) == c || text.charAt(j) == '\n') break;
                    j++;
                }
                int end = Math.min(n, j + (block ? 3 : 1));
                for (int k = i; k < end; k++) if (text.charAt(k) != '\n') out.setCharAt(k, ' ');
                i = end;
            } else i++;
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int[] lineStarts(String text) {
        var starts = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        starts.add(0);
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) if (text.charAt(i) == '\n') starts.add(i + 1);
        return starts.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
    }

    private static int line(int[] starts, int offset) {
        int index = Arrays.binarySearch(starts, offset);
        return (index >= 0 ? index : -index - 2) + 1;
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/ObfuscationBanner.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.ObfuscationCheck;
import java.awt.*;
import javax.swing.*;

/**
 * Phase G5: a thin bar under the toolbar when the input looks obfuscated: the likely obfuscator with its confidence, the
 * evidence on demand, and for Skidfuscator the reversal before decompiling. Hidden for inputs with no technique found.
 */
final class ObfuscationBanner extends JPanel {
    private final MainWindow window;
    private final JLabel text = new JLabel();
    private final JButton details = new JButton(Text.t("obfuscation.details"));
    private final JButton reverse;
    private ObfuscationCheck.Detection detection;

    ObfuscationBanner(MainWindow window) {
        super(new BorderLayout(Ui.GAP, 0));
        this.window = window;
        setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(Ui.bottomLine(), Ui.padding(5, 12, 5, 10)));
        text.setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.SHIELD, 16, Theme.ACCENT));
        add(text, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        var buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 6, 0));
        buttons.setOpaque(false);
        reverse = Ui.primary(Ui.action(Text.t("skid.reverseAndDecompile"), Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.PLAY, 14, Theme.ON_ACCENT), null,
            () -> window.decompile(false, true)));
        details.putClientProperty(com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
        buttons.add(details);
        buttons.add(reverse);
        add(buttons, BorderLayout.EAST);
        details.addActionListener(e -> showDetails());
        setVisible(false);
    }

    /** Shows what the workspace's classes point to; hidden when nothing was found or no workspace is open. */
    void show(Workspace workspace) {
        detection = workspace == null ? null : workspace.obfuscation();
        if (workspace != null && workspace.reversedFrom() != null) {
            text.setText("<html>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("obfuscation.bannerReversed", workspace.reversedFrom())) + "</html>");
            reverse.setVisible(false);
            details.setVisible(detection != null);
            setVisible(true);
            return;
        }
        if (detection == null || detection.verdict().equals("NONE")) { setVisible(false); return; }
        text.setText("<html><b>" + Ui.escape(headline(detection)) + "</b> &nbsp;" + Ui.escape(note(detection)) + "</html>");
        reverse.setVisible(detection.skidfuscator());
        details.setVisible(true);
        setVisible(true);
    }

    /** For tests: the bar is shown and offers the Skidfuscator reversal. */
    boolean offersReversal() { return isVisible() && reverse.isVisible(); }

    @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
        g.setColor(Theme.dark() ? new Color(0x1E1408) : new Color(0xFFF1E3));
        g.fillRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight());
        g.setColor(Theme.ACCENT);
        g.fillRect(0, 0, 3, getHeight());
    }

    /** "Skidfuscator (high confidence)", "Unknown obfuscator" or "No obfuscation found". */
    static String headline(ObfuscationCheck.Detection detection) {
        return switch (detection.verdict()) {
            case "NONE" -> Text.t("obfuscation.none");
            case "UNKNOWN" -> Text.t("obfuscation.unknown");
            default -> Text.t("obfuscation.likely", detection.top().obfuscator(), Text.t("confidence." + detection.top().confidence()));
        };
    }

    /** The score and the number of techniques, or what an unknown verdict means. */
    static String note(ObfuscationCheck.Detection detection) {
        return switch (detection.verdict()) {
            case "NONE" -> Text.t("obfuscation.noneNote", detection.classes());
            case "UNKNOWN" -> Text.t("obfuscation.unknownNote", detection.techniques().size());
            default -> Text.t("obfuscation.likelyNote", detection.top().score(), detection.techniques().size());
        };
    }

    private void showDetails() {
        if (detection == null) return;
        var html = new StringBuilder("<html><body style='width:520px'>");
        html.append("<p>").append(Ui.escape(Text.t("obfuscation.disclaimer"))).append("</p>");
        if (!detection.hypotheses().isEmpty()) {
            html.append("<h3>").append(Ui.escape(Text.t("obfuscation.hypotheses"))).append("</h3>");
            for (var hypothesis : detection.hypotheses()) {
                html.append("<p><b>").append(Ui.escape(hypothesis.obfuscator())).append("</b> &nbsp;").append(hypothesis.score()).append("/100, ")
                    .append(Ui.escape(Text.t("confidence." + hypothesis.confidence()))).append("</p><ul>");
                hypothesis.reasons().stream().limit(12).forEach(reason -> html.append("<li>").append(Ui.escape(reason)).append("</li>"));
                html.append("</ul>");
            }
        }
        if (!detection.techniques().isEmpty()) {
            html.append("<h3>").append(Ui.escape(Text.t("obfuscation.techniques"))).append("</h3><ul>");
            detection.techniques().forEach(technique -> html.append("<li>").append(Ui.escape(technique.label())).append(" &nbsp;<span style='color:gray'>")
                .append(Ui.escape(Text.t("obfuscation.classes", technique.classes()))).append("</span></li>"));
            html.append("</ul>");
        }
        html.append("</body></html>");
        var label = new JLabel(html.toString());
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(label);
        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        scroll.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(580, Math.min(460, label.getPreferredSize().height + 12)));
        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(window, scroll, Text.t("obfuscation.title"), JOptionPane.PLAIN_MESSAGE);
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/OverviewPanel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: the result of a decompile at a glance, with what to do next. Shown as the first editor tab. */
final class OverviewPanel extends JPanel {
    static final String KEY = "overview";

    OverviewPanel(Workspace workspace, List<Action> actions) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        var index = workspace.result();
        var summary = index.summary();
        var content = new Ui.Column();
        content.setBorder(Ui.padding(24, 28, 24, 28));

        var title = Ui.heading(Ui.visible(workspace.displayName()), 22f);
        content.add(left(title));
        var subtitle = Ui.muted(Text.t("overview.subtitle", index.output()));
        subtitle.setToolTipText(index.output().toString());
        content.add(left(subtitle));
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(18));

        var grid = new GridLayout(1, 4, 12, 12);
        var tiles = new JPanel(grid);
        tiles.setOpaque(false);
        boolean compiled = summary.compilation().equals("COMPILED");
        tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.compilation"), Text.t("compilation." + summary.compilation()),
            compiled ? Text.t("overview.compilation.ok") : Text.t("overview.compilation.errors", summary.errors()),
            compiled ? Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT) : Theme.level(ResultIndex.Level.UNVERIFIED)));
        tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.signatures"), summary.matchedSymbols() + " / " + summary.expectedSymbols(),
            Text.t("overview.signatures.note"), null));
        int identical = 0, equivalent = 0, different = 0;
        for (var entry : index.classes().values()) { identical += entry.identical(); equivalent += entry.equivalent(); different += entry.different(); }
        int measured = identical + equivalent + different;
        tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.bodies"), measured == 0 ? "—" : (identical + equivalent) + " / " + measured,
            measured == 0 ? Text.t("overview.bodies.none") : Text.t("overview.bodies.note", percent(identical + equivalent, measured)), null));
        tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.selected"), summary.selectedCandidate(), Text.t("overview.selected.note"), null));
        // Phase G4: the language and compiler the bytecode points to (Phase 2CJ), when the report has them.
        var compiler = index.compiler();
        if (compiler != null && compiler.classes() > 0) tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.language"), compiler.language(), languageNote(compiler), null));
        // Phase G5: the obfuscator the classes point to, and whether the Skidfuscator reversal ran first.
        if (workspace.reversedFrom() != null)
            tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.obfuscation"), Text.t("obfuscation.reversed"), Text.t("obfuscation.reversedFrom", Ui.visible(workspace.reversedFrom())), Theme.ACCENT));
        else if (workspace.obfuscation() != null) {
            var detection = workspace.obfuscation();
            tiles.add(new Tile(Text.t("overview.obfuscation"), ObfuscationBanner.headline(detection), ObfuscationBanner.note(detection),
                detection.verdict().equals("NONE") ? null : Theme.ACCENT));
        }
        tiles.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        // Four tiles in a row on wide windows, two by two on narrow ones.
        tiles.addComponentListener(new java.awt.event.ComponentAdapter() {
            @Override public void componentResized(java.awt.event.ComponentEvent event) {
                int count = tiles.getComponentCount();
                int columns = tiles.getWidth() >= 1100 ? count : tiles.getWidth() >= 700 ? Math.min(count, 3) : 2;
                if (grid.getColumns() != columns) { grid.setColumns(columns); grid.setRows(0); tiles.revalidate(); }
            }
        });
        content.add(tiles);
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(22));

        content.add(left(Ui.heading(Text.t("overview.confidence"), 14f)));
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
        var counts = index.levelCounts();
        if (counts.isEmpty()) content.add(left(Ui.muted(Text.t("overview.noLevels"))));
        else {
            var bar = new LevelBar(new EnumMap<>(counts));
            bar.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            bar.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, 14));
            content.add(bar);
            content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(10));
            var legend = new JPanel(new GridLayout(0, 1, 0, 4));
            legend.setOpaque(false);
            for (var level : ResultIndex.Level.values()) {
                var label = new JLabel("<html><b>" + Text.t("level." + level.name()) + "</b> &nbsp;" + counts.get(level)
                    + " &nbsp;<span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("level." + level.name() + ".meaning")) + "</span></html>");
                label.setIcon(Icons.dot(Theme.level(level), 12));
                legend.add(label);
            }
            legend.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            content.add(legend);
        }
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(22));

        content.add(left(Ui.heading(Text.t("overview.engines"), 14f)));
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(8));
        var engines = new JPanel(new GridLayout(0, 3, 16, 4));
        engines.setOpaque(false);
        for (var engine : index.engines()) {
            engines.add(new JLabel("<html><b>" + Ui.escape(engine.id()) + "</b> " + Ui.escape(engine.version()) + "</html>"));
            engines.add(new JLabel(Text.t("engine." + engine.status(), engine.status())));
            engines.add(Ui.muted(Text.t("overview.engines.files", engine.sourceFiles())));
        }
        engines.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        engines.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(640, engines.getPreferredSize().height));
        content.add(engines);
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(22));

        var buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, 0, 0));
        buttons.setOpaque(false);
        boolean first = true;
        for (var action : actions) {
            var button = first ? Ui.primary(action) : new JButton(action);
            if (!first) buttons.add(Box.createHorizontalStrut(8));
            buttons.add(button);
            first = false;
        }
        buttons.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        content.add(buttons);
        content.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(18));
        content.add(Ui.text(Text.t("overview.behavior"), true));

        var scroll = new JScrollPane(content);
        scroll.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        scroll.getVerticalScrollBar().setUnitIncrement(16);
        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
    }

    private static JComponent left(JComponent component) { component.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT); return component; }

    /** "javac 9 or later", "Eclipse compiler (ecj)", or how many classes another language produced. */
    static String languageNote(ResultIndex.Compiler compiler) {
        if (!compiler.language().equals("Java")) return Text.t("overview.language.other", compiler.classes());
        return switch (compiler.javaCompiler()) {
            case "javac" -> compiler.javacAtLeast() > 0 ? Text.t("overview.language.javacAtLeast", compiler.javacAtLeast()) : Text.t("overview.language.javac");
            case "ecj" -> Text.t("overview.language.ecj");
            case "mixed" -> Text.t("overview.language.mixed");
            default -> Text.t("overview.language.unknown");
        };
    }

    static String percent(long part, long whole) { return String.format(Text.locale(), "%.1f%%", part * 100.0 / whole); }

    /** A rounded card with a label, a big value, a note and an optional accent stripe. */
    static final class Tile extends JPanel {
        private final Color accent;
        Tile(String label, String value, String note, Color accent) {
            super(new BorderLayout(0, 2));
            this.accent = accent;
            setOpaque(false);
            setBorder(Ui.padding(12, 14, 12, 14));
            var top = Ui.muted(label.toUpperCase(Text.locale()));
            top.setFont(top.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, top.getFont().getSize2D() - 1.5f));
            add(top, BorderLayout.NORTH);
            var big = new JLabel(Ui.visible(value));
            big.setFont(big.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, 20f));
            add(big, BorderLayout.CENTER);
            var small = Ui.muted(note);
            add(small, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        }
        @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
            var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            g2.setColor(Theme.card());
            g2.fillRoundRect(0, 0, getWidth() - 1, getHeight() - 1, 14, 14);
            g2.setColor(Theme.line());
            g2.drawRoundRect(0, 0, getWidth() - 1, getHeight() - 1, 14, 14);
            if (accent != null) { g2.setColor(accent); g2.fillRoundRect(0, 10, 4, getHeight() - 20, 4, 4); }
            g2.dispose();
            super.paintComponent(g);
        }
    }

    /** Classes per level as one proportional bar. */
    static final class LevelBar extends JComponent {
        private final Map<ResultIndex.Level,Integer> counts;
        LevelBar(Map<ResultIndex.Level,Integer> counts) {
            this.counts = counts;
            setPreferredSize(new Dimension(240, 12));
            setMinimumSize(new Dimension(60, 12));
            var tip = new StringJoiner(", ");
            counts.forEach((level, count) -> tip.add(Text.t("level." + level.name()) + " " + count));
            setToolTipText(tip.toString());
        }
        @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
            var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            int total = counts.values().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sum();
            var clip = new java.awt.geom.RoundRectangle2D.Double(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), getHeight(), getHeight());
            g2.setColor(Theme.line());
            g2.fill(clip);
            if (total > 0) {
                g2.clip(clip);
                double x = 0;
                for (var level : ResultIndex.Level.values()) {
                    int count = counts.getOrDefault(level, 0);
                    if (count == 0) continue;
                    double width = getWidth() * (double) count / total;
                    g2.setColor(Theme.level(level));
                    g2.fill(new java.awt.geom.Rectangle2D.Double(x, 0, Math.max(2, width), getHeight()));
                    x += width;
                }
            }
            g2.dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/SearchPanel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean;
import java.util.function.BiConsumer;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: search the selected sources of the current result; results open the class at the line. */
final class SearchPanel extends JPanel {
    static final int LIMIT = 2000;

    private final JTextField field = new JTextField(28);
    private final JCheckBox matchCase = new JCheckBox(Text.t("search.matchCase"));
    private final JButton run = new JButton(Text.t("search.run"));
    private final JLabel status = Ui.muted("");
    private final DefaultListModel<SourceSearch.Hit> model = new DefaultListModel<>();
    private final JList<SourceSearch.Hit> results = new JList<>(model);
    private final BiConsumer<String,Integer> open;
    private Workspace workspace;
    private AtomicBoolean cancelled = new AtomicBoolean();

    /** {@code open} receives the input's class name and the 1-based line. */
    SearchPanel(BiConsumer<String,Integer> open) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        this.open = open;
        var top = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, Ui.GAP, 6));
        top.setBorder(Ui.padding(2, 6, 0, 6));
        field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.PLACEHOLDER_TEXT, Text.t("search.placeholder"));
        field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_LEADING_ICON, Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.SEARCH, 14));
        field.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.TEXT_FIELD_SHOW_CLEAR_BUTTON, true);
        top.add(field); top.add(matchCase); top.add(run); top.add(status);
        add(top, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        results.setCellRenderer(new Renderer());
        results.setFixedCellHeight(24);
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(results);
        scroll.setBorder(Ui.topLine());
        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        run.addActionListener(e -> search());
        field.addActionListener(e -> search());
        results.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) { if (event.getClickCount() == 2) openSelected(); }
        });
        results.getInputMap().put(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ENTER"), "open");
        results.getActionMap().put("open", new AbstractAction() { @Override public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) { openSelected(); } });
        attach(null);
    }

    void attach(Workspace workspace) {
        this.workspace = workspace;
        cancelled.set(true);
        model.clear();
        boolean ready = workspace != null && workspace.decompiled();
        field.setEnabled(ready); run.setEnabled(ready); matchCase.setEnabled(ready);
        status.setText(ready ? "" : Text.t("search.needsResult"));
    }

    void focus(String text) {
        if (text != null && !text.isBlank() && !text.contains("\n")) field.setText(text);
        field.requestFocusInWindow();
        field.selectAll();
    }

    private void search() {
        if (workspace == null || !workspace.decompiled() || field.getText().isEmpty()) return;
        cancelled.set(true);
        var flag = new AtomicBoolean();
        cancelled = flag;
        String query = field.getText();
        boolean caseSensitive = matchCase.isSelected();
        var root = workspace.result().output().resolve(ResultIndex.SELECTION).resolve("sources");
        model.clear();
        status.setText(Text.t("search.running"));
        new SwingWorker<List<SourceSearch.Hit>,Void>() {
            @Override protected List<SourceSearch.Hit> doInBackground() throws Exception {
                return SourceSearch.search(root, query, caseSensitive, LIMIT, flag::get);
            }
            @Override protected void done() {
                if (flag.get()) return;
                try {
                    var hits = get();
                    hits.forEach(model::addElement);
                    status.setText(hits.isEmpty() ? Text.t("search.none") : hits.size() >= LIMIT ? Text.t("search.limit", LIMIT) : Text.t("search.count", hits.size()));
                } catch (Exception failure) {
                    status.setText(Text.t("search.failed", String.valueOf(failure.getMessage())));
                }
            }
        }.execute();
    }

    private void openSelected() {
        var hit = results.getSelectedValue();
        if (hit != null && workspace != null) open.accept(workspace.originalOf(hit.className()), hit.line());
    }

    private static final class Renderer extends DefaultListCellRenderer {
        @Override public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value, int index, boolean selected, boolean focus) {
            super.getListCellRendererComponent(list, value, index, selected, focus);
            if (value instanceof SourceSearch.Hit hit) {
                String simple = hit.className().substring(hit.className().lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
                setText("<html><b>" + Ui.escape(simple) + "</b>:" + hit.line() + " &nbsp;<code>" + Ui.escape(hit.text()) + "</code></html>");
                setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.RESOURCE, 14));
            }
            return this;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
import dev.classrevive.workbench.RequestLimits;

/** Phase G3: appearance, decompile defaults and folders. Theme and font size apply at once; the language on restart. */
final class SettingsDialog extends JDialog {

        line.accept(Text.t("settings.language"), language);

        line.accept("", stubs);
        line.accept("", cache);

        var folderRow = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(6, 0));
        folderRow.add(folder, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        folderRow.add(choose, BorderLayout.EAST);
        line.accept(Text.t("settings.workspace"), folderRow);
        gap.run();
        at.gridy = row[0]; at.gridx = 0; at.gridwidth = 2;
        form.add(Ui.muted("<html><body style='width:420px'>" + Ui.escape(Text.t("settings.workspace.note")) + "</body></html>"), at);
        choose.addActionListener(e -> {
            var chooser = new JFileChooser(folder.getText());
            chooser.setFileSelectionMode(JFileChooser.DIRECTORIES_ONLY);
            if (chooser.showOpenDialog(this) == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) folder.setText(chooser.getSelectedFile().getPath());
        });

        buttons.setBorder(Ui.padding(8, 18, 14, 18));

        buttons.add(cancel); buttons.add(ok);

        var root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());

        root.add(buttons, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
        setContentPane(root);
        getRootPane().setDefaultButton(ok);
        getRootPane().registerKeyboardAction(e -> dispose(), KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ESCAPE"), JComponent.WHEN_IN_FOCUSED_WINDOW);
        pack();
        setLocationRelativeTo(owner);
    }

    /** True when the user saved; the settings object then holds the new values. */
    static boolean edit(Window owner, GuiSettings settings) {
        var dialog = new SettingsDialog(owner, settings);
        dialog.setVisible(true);
        return dialog.saved;
    }

    private void save(GuiSettings settings) {
        Path workspace;
        try { workspace = Path.of(folder.getText().strip()); }
        catch (RuntimeException invalid) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("settings.title"), Text.t("settings.badFolder"), null); return; }
        if (folder.getText().isBlank() || !workspace.isAbsolute()) { Ui.error(this, Text.t("settings.title"), Text.t("settings.badFolder"), null); return; }
        settings.theme((GuiSettings.ThemeChoice) theme.getSelectedItem());
        settings.language((GuiSettings.Language) language.getSelectedItem());
        settings.fontSize((Integer) fontSize.getValue());
        settings.profile((GuiSettings.Profile) profile.getSelectedItem());
        settings.timeoutSeconds((Integer) timeout.getValue());
        settings.stubs(stubs.isSelected());
        settings.engineCache(cache.isSelected());
        settings.workspaceDirectory(workspace);
        saved = true;
        dispose();
    }

    private static ListCellRenderer<Object> renderer(String prefix) {
        return new DefaultListCellRenderer() {
            @Override public Component getListCellRendererComponent(JList<?> list, Object value, int index, boolean selected, boolean focus) {
                super.getListCellRendererComponent(list, value, index, selected, focus);
                if (value instanceof Enum<?> e) setText(Text.t(prefix + e.name()));
                return this;
            }
        };
    }
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/SourceSearch.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.BooleanSupplier;

/** Phase G3: plain-text search through a folder of decompiled sources, bounded and cancellable. */
public final class SourceSearch {
    /** {@code className}: internal name of the file's top-level class; {@code line} is 1-based. */
    public record Hit(String className, Path file, int line, String text) {}

    static final long MAX_FILE_BYTES = 8L * 1024 * 1024;
    static final int MAX_LINE_CHARS = 240;

    private SourceSearch() {}

    /** At most {@code limit} hits in {@code .java} files under {@code root}, in path order; stops early when {@code cancelled}. */
    public static List<Hit> search(Path root, String query, boolean matchCase, int limit, BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException {
        if (query.isEmpty() || !Files.isDirectory(root, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return List.of();
        String needle = matchCase ? query : query.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        var files = new ArrayList<Path>();
        Files.walkFileTree(root, new SimpleFileVisitor<>() {
            @Override public FileVisitResult visitFile(Path file, BasicFileAttributes attributes) {
                if (attributes.isRegularFile() && file.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".java") && attributes.size() <= MAX_FILE_BYTES) files.add(file);
                return cancelled.getAsBoolean() ? FileVisitResult.TERMINATE : FileVisitResult.CONTINUE;
            }
        });
        files.sort(Comparator.naturalOrder());
        var hits = new ArrayList<Hit>();
        for (Path file : files) {
            if (cancelled.getAsBoolean() || hits.size() >= limit) break;
            String relative = root.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/');
            String className = relative.substring(0, relative.length() - ".java".length());
            List<String> lines;
            try { lines = Files.readAllLines(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }
            catch (IOException | java.io.UncheckedIOException unreadable) { continue; }
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.size() && hits.size() < limit; i++) {
                String line = lines.get(i);
                if ((matchCase ? line : line.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).contains(needle)) {
                    String trimmed = line.strip();
                    hits.add(new Hit(className, file, i + 1, trimmed.length() > MAX_LINE_CHARS ? trimmed.substring(0, MAX_LINE_CHARS) + "…" : trimmed));
                }
            }
        }
        return hits;
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Text.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.text.MessageFormat;
import java.util.*;

/** User-visible strings, in Brazilian Portuguese or English ({@code messages*.properties}, UTF-8). */
public final class Text {
    private static ResourceBundle bundle = load(Locale.getDefault());

    private Text() {}

    /** Chooses the language for every string created afterwards. */
    public static void use(GuiSettings.Language language) {
        bundle = load(switch (language) {
            case PORTUGUESE -> Locale.of("pt", "BR");
            case ENGLISH -> Locale.ENGLISH;
            case SYSTEM -> Locale.getDefault();
        });
    }

    public static Locale locale() { return bundle.getLocale(); }

    /** The string for {@code key}, formatted with {@code args} ({@link MessageFormat}); the key itself when missing. */
    public static String t(String key, Object... args) {
        String pattern;
        try { pattern = bundle.getString(key); } catch (MissingResourceException missing) { return key; }
        // Always through MessageFormat, so every string follows the same quoting rule ('' for an apostrophe).
        return new MessageFormat(pattern, bundle.getLocale()).format(args);
    }

    private static ResourceBundle load(Locale locale) {
        // English is the base bundle; any other language falls back to it rather than to the JVM default.
        return ResourceBundle.getBundle("dev.classrevive.gui.messages", locale,
            ResourceBundle.Control.getNoFallbackControl(ResourceBundle.Control.FORMAT_PROPERTIES));
    }
}
```

```java
    private static final Map<String,String> LIGHT = Map.ofEntries(
        Map.entry("@selectionBackground", "#FFD7B0"), Map.entry("@selectionForeground", "#141416"), Map.entry("TabbedPane.underlineColor", "#E8720C"),
        Map.entry("ProgressBar.foreground", "#E8720C"));

    private Theme() {}

    /** Installs the look and feel; call before any window exists. */
    static void install(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice choice) {
        boolean dark = dark(choice);
        var defaults = new java.util.HashMap<>(SHARED);
        defaults.putAll(dark ? DARK : LIGHT);
        FlatLaf.setGlobalExtraDefaults(defaults);
        if (dark) FlatDarkLaf.setup(); else FlatLightLaf.setup();
    }

    /** Switches every open window to {@code choice}. */
    static void switchTo(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice choice) {
        install(choice);
        FlatLaf.updateUI();
    }

    static boolean dark() { return FlatLaf.isLafDark(); }

    static boolean dark(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice choice) {
        return switch (choice) { case DARK -> true; case LIGHT -> false; case SYSTEM -> windowsAppsUseDarkTheme(); };
    }

    /** Windows' "app mode" setting, read with {@code reg query}; false elsewhere or when it cannot be read. */
    static boolean windowsAppsUseDarkTheme() {
        if (!System.getProperty("os.name", "").startsWith("Windows")) return false;
        try {
            var process = new ProcessBuilder("reg", "query", "HKCU\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Themes\\Personalize",
                "/v", "AppsUseLightTheme").redirectErrorStream(true).start();
            process.getOutputStream().close();
            String text = new String(process.getInputStream().readNBytes(4096), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            if (!process.waitFor(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { process.destroyForcibly(); return false; }
            return text.matches("(?s).*AppsUseLightTheme\\s+REG_DWORD\\s+0x0\\b.*");
        } catch (Exception unavailable) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /** One color per confidence level, readable on both themes; null (not decompiled yet) is neutral. */
    static Color level(ResultIndex.Level level) {
        if (level == null) return new Color(0x8A8A93);
        return switch (level) {
            case EXACT -> new Color(0x3FB950);
            case CLOSE -> new Color(0x58A6FF);
            case PER_FILE -> new Color(0xD7B53C);
            case PARTIAL -> new Color(0xB980F0);
            case UNVERIFIED -> new Color(0xF0605A);
        };
    }

    /** Black or white, whichever reads better on {@code background}. */
    static Color textOn(Color background) {
        double luminance = (0.299 * background.getRed() + 0.587 * background.getGreen() + 0.114 * background.getBlue()) / 255;
        return luminance > 0.6 ? ON_ACCENT : Color.WHITE;
    }

    static Color muted() { return color("Label.disabledForeground", Color.GRAY); }
    static Color foreground() { return color("Label.foreground", Color.DARK_GRAY); }
    static Color panel() { return color("Panel.background", Color.WHITE); }
    static Color card() { return dark() ? new Color(0x1A1A1D) : Color.WHITE; }
    /** The code editor's background: darker than the panels in the dark theme. */
    static Color editor() { return dark() ? new Color(0x0C0C0E) : Color.WHITE; }
    static Color line() { return color("Component.borderColor", Color.LIGHT_GRAY); }

    static Color color(String key, Color fallback) {
        Color color = javax.swing.UIManager.getColor(key);
        return color == null ? fallback : color;
    }

    static Color blend(Color a, Color b, double amount) {
        return new Color((int) Math.round(a.getRed() + (b.getRed() - a.getRed()) * amount), (int) Math.round(a.getGreen() + (b.getGreen() - a.getGreen()) * amount),
            (int) Math.round(a.getBlue() + (b.getBlue() - a.getBlue()) * amount));
    }

    /** The first installed of the preferred monospaced families. */
    static Font codeFont(int size) {
        var families = java.util.Set.of(GraphicsEnvironment.getLocalGraphicsEnvironment().getAvailableFontFamilyNames());
        for (String family : new String[] {"JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "Consolas", "Menlo", "DejaVu Sans Mono"})
            if (families.contains(family)) return new Font(family, Font.PLAIN, size);
        return new Font(Font.MONOSPACED, Font.PLAIN, size);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
import java.nio.file.*;
import javax.swing.*;
import javax.swing.border.Border;

/** Phase G3: small shared pieces so every panel spaces, labels and reports errors the same way. */
final class Ui {
    static final int GAP = 8, PAD = 12;
    /** Every state spelled out: FlatLaf would otherwise paint its own focused, hover or toolbar colors over the accent. */
    static final String PRIMARY_STYLE = "background: #FF8A1F; focusedBackground: #FF8A1F; hoverBackground: #FF9D45; pressedBackground: #E5751A; "
        + "selectedBackground: #E5751A; disabledBackground: #FF8A1F4D; foreground: #141416; disabledText: #14141699; font: bold; "
        + "default.background: #FF8A1F; default.focusedBackground: #FF8A1F; default.hoverBackground: #FF9D45; "
        + "default.pressedBackground: #E5751A; default.foreground: #141416; default.borderWidth: 0; "
        + "borderWidth: 0; focusWidth: 0; innerFocusWidth: 0; arc: 10";

    private Ui() {}

    static Action action(String name, Icon icon, KeyStroke key, Runnable run) {
        var action = new AbstractAction(name, icon) { @Override public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) { run.run(); } };
        if (key != null) action.putValue(Action.ACCELERATOR_KEY, key);
        action.putValue(Action.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, key == null ? name : name + "  (" + keyText(key) + ")");
        return action;
    }

    static String keyText(KeyStroke key) {
        String modifiers = java.awt.event.InputEvent.getModifiersExText(key.getModifiers());
        String text = java.awt.event.KeyEvent.getKeyText(key.getKeyCode());
        return modifiers.isEmpty() ? text : modifiers + "+" + text;
    }

    static KeyStroke key(String spec) { return KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(spec); }

    static JLabel heading(String text, float size) {
        var label = new JLabel(text);
        label.setFont(label.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, size));
        return label;
    }

    static JLabel muted(String text) {
        var label = new JLabel(text);
        label.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.STYLE, "foreground: $Label.disabledForeground");
        return label;
    }

    /** A rounded label in {@code color}, for levels and statuses. */
    static Chip chip(String text, Color color) { return new Chip(text, color); }

    /** A pill-shaped label; painted by the component itself so a theme switch keeps it. */
    static final class Chip extends JLabel {
        private Color color;
        Chip(String text, Color color) {
            super(text);
            this.color = color;
            setForeground(Theme.textOn(color));
            setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(2, 9, 2, 9));
        }
        void set(String text, Color color) { setText(text); this.color = color; setForeground(Theme.textOn(color)); repaint(); }
        @Override public void updateUI() {
            super.updateUI();
            setFont(UIManager.getFont("Label.font").deriveFont(Font.BOLD, UIManager.getFont("Label.font").getSize2D() - 1));
            if (color != null) setForeground(Theme.textOn(color));
        }
        @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
            var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            g2.setColor(color);
            g2.fillRoundRect(0, 0, getWidth(), getHeight(), getHeight(), getHeight());
            g2.dispose();
            super.paintComponent(g);
        }
    }

    /** A vertical stack for scroll panes: as wide as the viewport, so text wraps instead of running off the right edge. */
    static final class Column extends JPanel implements Scrollable {
        Column() { setLayout(new BoxLayout(this, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS)); }
        /** BoxLayout squeezes left-aligned children when any child (a strut or glue, by default) is centered. */
        @Override protected void addImpl(Component component, Object constraints, int index) {
            if (component instanceof JComponent child) child.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            super.addImpl(component, constraints, index);
        }
        @Override public Dimension getPreferredScrollableViewportSize() { return getPreferredSize(); }
        @Override public int getScrollableUnitIncrement(Rectangle visible, int orientation, int direction) { return 16; }
        @Override public int getScrollableBlockIncrement(Rectangle visible, int orientation, int direction) { return visible.height - 32; }
        @Override public boolean getScrollableTracksViewportWidth() { return true; }
        @Override public boolean getScrollableTracksViewportHeight() { return false; }
    }

    /** Read-only text that wraps at the available width and takes only the height it needs. */
    static JTextArea text(String text, boolean muted) {
        var area = new JTextArea(text) {
            @Override public Dimension getMaximumSize() { return new Dimension(Integer.MAX_VALUE, getPreferredSize().height); }
            @Override public void updateUI() { super.updateUI(); setFont(UIManager.getFont("Label.font")); setOpaque(false); setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder()); }
        };
        area.setLineWrap(true);
        area.setWrapStyleWord(true);
        area.setEditable(false);
        area.setFocusable(false);
        area.setOpaque(false);
        area.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder());
        area.setFont(UIManager.getFont("Label.font"));
        if (muted) area.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.STYLE, "foreground: $Label.disabledForeground");
        area.setAlignmentX(Component.LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
        return area;
    }

    static Border padding(int top, int left, int bottom, int right) { return BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(top, left, bottom, right); }

    static Border bottomLine() { return line(0, 0, 1, 0); }
    static Border topLine() { return line(1, 0, 0, 0); }

    /** A separator line in the current theme's border color, read when painted so a theme switch recolors it. */
    static Border line(int top, int left, int bottom, int right) {
        return new javax.swing.border.AbstractBorder() {
            @Override public void paintBorder(Component c, Graphics g, int x, int y, int width, int height) {
                g.setColor(Theme.line());
                if (top > 0) g.fillRect(x, y, width, top);
                if (bottom > 0) g.fillRect(x, y + height - bottom, width, bottom);
                if (left > 0) g.fillRect(x, y, left, height);
                if (right > 0) g.fillRect(x + width - right, y, right, height);
            }
            @Override public Insets getBorderInsets(Component c) { return new Insets(top, left, bottom, right); }
        };
    }

    static JButton toolButton(Action action) {
        var button = new JButton(action);
        button.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
        button.setFocusable(false);
        return button;
    }

    /** An accent-colored button for the one main action of a screen. */
    static JButton primary(Action action) {
        var button = new JButton(action);
        button.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.STYLE, PRIMARY_STYLE);
        return button;
    }

    /** A message dialog with an optional "details" area for the evidence behind it. */
    static void error(Component parent, String title, String message, String details) {
        var panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, GAP));
        var text = new JLabel("<html><body style='width:360px'>" + escape(message) + "</body></html>");
        panel.add(text, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        if (details != null && !details.isBlank()) {
            var area = new JTextArea(details, Math.min(14, details.split("\n").length + 1), 60);
            area.setEditable(false);
            area.setFont(Theme.codeFont(12));
            area.setCaretPosition(0);
            panel.add(new JScrollPane(area), BorderLayout.CENTER);
        }
        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(parent, panel, title, JOptionPane.ERROR_MESSAGE);
    }

    static void info(Component parent, String title, String message) {
        JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(parent, "<html><body style='width:360px'>" + escape(message) + "</body></html>", title, JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE);
    }

    /** Opens a file or folder with the system's default application. */
    static void open(Component parent, Path path) {
        try {
            if (!Desktop.isDesktopSupported()) throw new UnsupportedOperationException();
            Desktop.getDesktop().open(path.toFile());
        } catch (Exception failure) {
            error(parent, Text.t("error.title"), Text.t("error.cannotOpen", path), String.valueOf(failure.getMessage()));
        }
    }

    /** Text from the input can hold markup or control characters: shown as plain, visible text. */
    static String escape(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder(text.length());
        for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
            switch (c) {
                case '<' -> out.append("&lt;"); case '>' -> out.append("&gt;"); case '&' -> out.append("&amp;");
                case '\n' -> out.append("<br>");
                default -> {
                    if (Character.isISOControl(c) || Character.getType(c) == Character.FORMAT) out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
                    else out.append(c);
                }
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    /** Like {@link #escape} without markup: makes control and bidi characters of names visible (Trojan Source). */
    static String visible(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder(text.length());
        for (char c : text.toCharArray())
            if (Character.isISOControl(c) || Character.getType(c) == Character.FORMAT) out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
            else out.append(c);
        return out.toString();
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/UsageIndex.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;

/**
 * Phase G6: the reference index of one workspace, built in the background on first use. After a decompile it reads the
 * classes the engines saw ({@code classes.jar}: portable names, and the reversed classes when Phase 2DD applied a
 * reversal), so its names match the decompiled sources; before, it reads the input's own classes. Either way the bytes
 * are only parsed. A newer result makes the next request rebuild; {@link #cancel} stops a build.
 */
final class UsageIndex {
    static final ReferenceIndex.Limits LIMITS = ReferenceIndex.Limits.defaults();

    /**
     * A finished index and what it cost. {@code requestedFor}: the result current when it was built (null before a
     * decompile); {@code basedOn}: that result when its {@code classes.jar} was read, null when the input's classes were.
     */
    record Built(ReferenceIndex index, ResultIndex requestedFor, ResultIndex basedOn, long millis) {}

    private final Workspace workspace;
    private Built built;
    private Thread building;
    private java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean cancelled = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean();
    private ResultIndex buildingFor;
    private final List<Consumer<Built>> waiting = new ArrayList<>();
    private final List<Consumer<Throwable>> failing = new ArrayList<>();

    UsageIndex(Workspace workspace) { this.workspace = workspace; }

    /** On the event thread: {@code ready} gets the index for the current result, now or once built; {@code failed} otherwise. */
    void whenReady(Consumer<Built> ready, Consumer<Throwable> failed) {
        var result = workspace.result();
        if (built != null && built.requestedFor() == result) { ready.accept(built); return; }
        waiting.add(ready);
        failing.add(failed);
        if (building != null && buildingFor == result) return;
        if (building != null) { cancelled.set(true); building.interrupt(); }
        var flag = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean();
        cancelled = flag;
        buildingFor = result;
        building = Thread.ofPlatform().daemon().name("classrevive-usages").start(() -> {
            try {
                var made = build(workspace, result, flag::get);
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> finish(result, made, null));
            } catch (Throwable failure) {
                SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> finish(result, null, failure));
            }
        });
    }

    boolean building() { return building != null; }

    /** Stops a build; whoever waits is told it was cancelled. */
    void cancel() {
        if (building == null) return;
        cancelled.set(true);
        building.interrupt();
    }

    private void finish(ResultIndex result, Built made, Throwable failure) {
        if (result != buildingFor) return;
        building = null;
        var ready = List.copyOf(waiting);
        var failed = List.copyOf(failing);
        waiting.clear();
        failing.clear();
        if (made != null) { built = made; ready.forEach(consumer -> consumer.accept(made)); }
        else failed.forEach(consumer -> consumer.accept(failure));
    }

    /** The input's name for a class of the index (they differ when the index reads a result's renamed classes). */
    String treeName(Built built, String indexName) { return built.basedOn() == null ? indexName : workspace.originalOf(indexName); }

    /** The index's name for a class of the input. */
    String indexName(Built built, String treeName) { return built.basedOn() == null ? treeName : workspace.portableOf(treeName); }

    static Built build(Workspace workspace, ResultIndex result, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        ReferenceIndex index;
        Path normalized = result == null ? null : result.output().resolve("classes.jar");
        if (normalized != null && Files.isRegularFile(normalized, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) index = ReferenceIndex.ofJar(normalized, LIMITS, cancelled);
        else index = ofInput(workspace, cancelled);
        long millis = (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1_000_000;
        return new Built(index, result, normalized != null && Files.isRegularFile(normalized) ? result : null, millis);
    }

    /** The input's own classes, by the entries the tree lists (multi-release variants stay aside, as in the tree). */
    private static ReferenceIndex ofInput(Workspace workspace, java.util.function.BooleanSupplier cancelled) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var builder = new ReferenceIndex.Builder(LIMITS);
        if (!workspace.jar()) {
            if (Files.size(workspace.inspected()) <= LIMITS.maxClassBytes()) builder.add(Files.readAllBytes(workspace.inspected()));
            return builder.build();
        }
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(workspace.inspected().toFile())) {
            for (var item : workspace.classes()) {
                if (cancelled.getAsBoolean() || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException("index cancelled");
                var entry = zip.getEntry(item.entry());
                if (entry == null || entry.getSize() > LIMITS.maxClassBytes()) continue;
                byte[] bytes;
                try (var in = zip.getInputStream(entry)) { bytes = in.readNBytes(LIMITS.maxClassBytes() + 1); }
                if (bytes.length > LIMITS.maxClassBytes()) continue;
                if (!builder.add(bytes)) break;
            }
        }
        return builder.build();
    }
}
```
