`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/UsageLocator.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Phase G6: the line of a usage site in the text the editor shows. Decompiled sources do not keep the original line
 * numbers, so the {@code LineNumberTable} line is shown in the results and the text is searched instead: the member that
 * holds the site is found by {@link MethodLocator} (a lambda body by the method it was written in), then the site's
 * ordinal occurrence of the target's name inside that member. Not found: the member's declaration; no member: the class.
 * In ASM's bytecode text the member's header is found and then the instruction naming the target. Best effort, never a
 * guess presented as exact: when nothing matches the result is -1 and the editor shows the class from its declaration.
 */
final class UsageLocator {
    private UsageLocator() {}

    private static final Pattern LAMBDA = Pattern.compile("lambda\\$(.+)\\$\\d+");

    /** 1-based line in decompiled {@code text} for {@code site}; {@code index} names the class's methods for lambdas. */
    static int source(String text, ReferenceIndex.Site site, ReferenceIndex index) {
        String code = MethodLocator.blank(text);
        String className = site.className();
        var from = site.from();
        int start = -1, end = -1;
        if (from.isMethod()) {
            var keys = new ArrayList<String>();
            var lambda = LAMBDA.matcher(from.name());
            if (lambda.matches()) {
                String written = lambda.group(1).equals("new") ? "<init>" : lambda.group(1).equals("static") ? "<clinit>" : lambda.group(1);
                index.declared(className, written, true).forEach(member -> keys.add(member.name() + member.descriptor()));
            } else keys.add(from.key());
            var found = MethodLocator.locate(text, Map.of(className, keys)).getOrDefault(className, Map.of());
            int line = found.values().stream().min(Integer::compare).orElse(-1);
            if (line > 0) {
                start = lineStart(text, line);
                int brace = code.indexOf('{', start), semicolon = code.indexOf(';', start);
                end = brace >= 0 && (semicolon < 0 || brace < semicolon) ? match(code, brace) : lineEnd(text, start);
                if (end < 0) end = lineEnd(text, start);
                // Skip the declaration's own name, which a recursive call or an overload would otherwise match.
                String written = lambda.matches() ? lambda.group(1) : from.name();
                String declared = written.equals("<init>") || written.equals("new") ? MethodLocator.simpleName(className)
                    : written.equals("<clinit>") || written.equals("static") ? null : written;
                if (declared != null && !declared.isEmpty()) {
                    var name = Pattern.compile("\\b" + Pattern.quote(declared) + "\\s*\\(").matcher(code).region(start, end);
                    if (name.find()) start = name.end();
                }
            }
        }
        int declaration = start < 0 ? -1 : lineOf(text, start);
        if (start < 0) {
            // A field, the class header or a member the text does not show: the class's own body.
            String simple = MethodLocator.simpleName(className);
            var header = simple.isEmpty() ? null : Pattern.compile("\\b(class|interface|enum|record)\\s+" + Pattern.quote(simple) + "\\b").matcher(code);
            if (header == null || !header.find()) return -1;
            start = header.start();
            int brace = code.indexOf('{', header.end());
            end = brace < 0 ? code.length() : Math.max(brace, match(code, brace));
            declaration = lineOf(text, start);
            if (from.isField()) {
                var field = Pattern.compile("\\b" + Pattern.quote(from.name()) + "\\b\\s*[;=,]").matcher(code).region(start, end);
                if (field.find()) return lineOf(text, field.start());
            }
        }
        String word = word(site.target());
        if (word == null) return declaration;
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("\\b" + Pattern.quote(word) + "\\b").matcher(code).region(start, Math.max(start, end));
        int line = -1;
        for (int seen = 0; matcher.find(); seen++) {
            line = lineOf(text, matcher.start());
            if (seen == site.ordinal()) break;
        }
        return line > 0 ? line : declaration;
    }

    /** The name a target is written with in Java: a member's name, a constructor's class, a class's own simple name. */
    static String word(ReferenceIndex.Ref target) {
        String word = target.isClass() || "<init>".equals(target.name()) ? MethodLocator.simpleName(target.owner())
            : target.name().startsWith("<") ? null : target.name();
        return word == null || word.isEmpty() ? null : word;
    }

    /**
     * 1-based line in ASM's text ({@link dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassText}) for {@code site}. {@code names} maps the
     * index's class names to those the text uses (the input's own, when the index read a result's renamed classes).
     */
    static int bytecode(String text, ReferenceIndex.Site site, UnaryOperator<String> names) {
        var lines = text.split("\n", -1);
        var from = site.from();
        int first = 0, last = lines.length;
        if (!from.isClass()) {
            int header = header(lines, from, names);
            if (header < 0) return -1;
            first = header;
            last = header + 1;
            while (last < lines.length && !lines[last].isBlank()) last++;
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) if (lines[i].startsWith("  // access flags")) { last = i; break; }
        }
        var target = site.target();
        String owner = names.apply(target.owner());
        Pattern needle = target.isClass()
            ? Pattern.compile("(^|[\\s\\[L(])" + Pattern.quote(owner) + "([;.\\s]|$)")
            : Pattern.compile(Pattern.quote(owner + "." + target.name()) + "[\\s(]");
        int seen = 0, found = -1;
        for (int i = first + (from.isClass() ? 0 : 1); i < last; i++) {
            if (!needle.matcher(lines[i]).find()) continue;
            found = i + 1;
            if (seen++ == site.ordinal()) break;
        }
        return found > 0 ? found : from.isClass() ? -1 : first + 1;
    }

    /** The line index of a member's header: {@code "  [modifiers] name(desc)"} or {@code "  [modifiers] desc name"}. */
    private static int header(String[] lines, ReferenceIndex.Ref member, UnaryOperator<String> names) {
        String key = member.isMethod() ? member.name() + mapDescriptor(member.descriptor(), names) : mapDescriptor(member.descriptor(), names) + " " + member.name();
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            String line = lines[i];
            if (!line.startsWith("  ") || line.length() < 3 || line.charAt(2) == ' ' || line.startsWith("  //") || line.startsWith("  @")) continue;
            String trimmed = member.isField() ? line.replaceFirst("\\s+=.*$", "") : line;
            if (trimmed.equals("  " + key) || trimmed.endsWith(" " + key)) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static String mapDescriptor(String descriptor, UnaryOperator<String> names) {
        var matcher = Pattern.compile("L([^;]+);").matcher(descriptor);
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        while (matcher.find()) matcher.appendReplacement(out, java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement("L" + names.apply(matcher.group(1)) + ";"));
        matcher.appendTail(out);
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static int match(String code, int open) {
        int depth = 0;
        for (int i = open; i < code.length(); i++) {
            char c = code.charAt(i);
            if (c == '{') depth++;
            else if (c == '}' && --depth == 0) return i;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static int lineStart(String text, int line) {
        int offset = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < line && offset >= 0; i++) { offset = text.indexOf('\n', offset); if (offset >= 0) offset++; }
        return Math.max(0, offset);
    }

    private static int lineEnd(String text, int offset) {
        int end = text.indexOf('\n', offset);
        return end < 0 ? text.length() : end;
    }

    private static int lineOf(String text, int offset) {
        int line = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < offset && i < text.length(); i++) if (text.charAt(i) == '\n') line++;
        return line;
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/UsagesPanel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.CallHierarchy;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex.Ref;
import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.function.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import javax.swing.*;
import javax.swing.tree.*;

/**
 * Phase G6: the results of "find usages" (grouped by class, then by the member holding the site) and of the call
 * hierarchy (callers of callers, with cycles marked). Opening a site goes to its class at the site's line.
 */
final class UsagesPanel extends JPanel {
    static final int DEFAULT_DEPTH = 5, MAX_DEPTH = 12, MAX_NODES = 3000;

    /** Tree nodes: a class, a member holding sites, one site, or one method of the call hierarchy. */
    record ClassGroup(String treeName, int count) {}
    record MemberGroup(Ref from, int count) {}
    record SiteNode(ReferenceIndex.Usage usage) {}
    record CallerNode(CallHierarchy.Node node) {}

    private final JLabel title = new JLabel(Text.t("usages.empty"));
    private final JLabel status = Ui.muted("");
    private final JButton cancel = new JButton(Text.t("usages.cancel"));
    private final JLabel depthLabel = Ui.muted(Text.t("usages.depth"));
    private final JSpinner depth = new JSpinner(new SpinnerNumberModel(DEFAULT_DEPTH, 1, MAX_DEPTH, 1));
    private final JTree tree = new JTree(new DefaultTreeModel(new DefaultMutableTreeNode()));
    private final Consumer<ReferenceIndex.Site> open;
    private UnaryOperator<String> treeNames = UnaryOperator.identity();
    private IntConsumer redo = level -> { };
    private boolean adjusting;

    UsagesPanel(Consumer<ReferenceIndex.Site> open, Runnable cancelIndex) {
        super(new BorderLayout());
        this.open = open;
        var top = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.LEFT, Ui.GAP, 6));
        top.setBorder(Ui.padding(2, 6, 0, 6));
        title.setFont(title.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD));
        cancel.putClientProperty(FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
        cancel.addActionListener(e -> cancelIndex.run());
        cancel.setVisible(false);
        depth.addChangeListener(e -> { if (!adjusting) redo.accept((Integer) depth.getValue()); });
        top.add(title); top.add(depthLabel); top.add(depth); top.add(status); top.add(cancel);
        add(top, BorderLayout.NORTH);
        tree.setRootVisible(false);
        tree.setShowsRootHandles(true);
        tree.setCellRenderer(new Renderer());
        tree.getSelectionModel().setSelectionMode(TreeSelectionModel.SINGLE_TREE_SELECTION);
        tree.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() {
            @Override public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) {
                if (event.getClickCount() != 2 || !SwingUtilities.isLeftMouseButton(event)) return;
                var path = tree.getPathForLocation(event.getX(), event.getY());
                if (path != null && openable(path)) openPath(path);
            }
        });
        tree.getInputMap().put(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke("ENTER"), "open");
        tree.getActionMap().put("open", new AbstractAction() {
            @Override public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent e) { if (tree.getSelectionPath() != null) openPath(tree.getSelectionPath()); }
        });
        var scroll = new JScrollPane(tree);
        scroll.setBorder(Ui.topLine());
        add(scroll, BorderLayout.CENTER);
        showDepth(false);
    }

    /** The index is being built (or failed: {@code text} says so, {@code busy} false). */
    void indexing(String text, boolean busy) {
        status.setText(text);
        cancel.setVisible(busy);
    }

    void message(String text) {
        title.setText(text);
        showDepth(false);
        tree.setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(new DefaultMutableTreeNode()));
    }

    /** Usages of {@code target}, grouped by class and member. */
    void showUsages(Ref target, List<ReferenceIndex.Usage> usages, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames, String note) {
        this.treeNames = treeNames;
        showDepth(false);
        title.setText(Text.t(usages.isEmpty() ? "usages.titleNone" : "usages.title", usages.size(), describe(target, treeNames)));
        status.setText(note);
        cancel.setVisible(false);
        var root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode();
        var byClass = new LinkedHashMap<String,LinkedHashMap<Ref,List<ReferenceIndex.Usage>>>();
        for (var usage : usages)
            byClass.computeIfAbsent(usage.site().className(), k -> new LinkedHashMap<>()).computeIfAbsent(usage.site().from(), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(usage);
        byClass.forEach((className, members) -> {
            var classNode = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new ClassGroup(treeNames.apply(className), members.values().stream().mapToInt(List::size).sum()));
            members.forEach((from, sites) -> {
                var memberNode = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new MemberGroup(from, sites.size()));
                for (var usage : sites) memberNode.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new SiteNode(usage)));
                classNode.add(memberNode);
            });
            root.add(classNode);
        });
        tree.setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(root));
        // Expand everything for small results, the classes only for large ones.
        int limit = usages.size() <= 400 ? Integer.MAX_VALUE : root.getChildCount();
        for (int i = 0; i < tree.getRowCount() && i < limit + 2000; i++) {
            var node = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) tree.getPathForRow(i).getLastPathComponent();
            if (usages.size() <= 400 || node.getUserObject() instanceof ClassGroup) tree.expandRow(i);
        }
        if (tree.getRowCount() > 0) tree.setSelectionRow(0);
    }

    /** The callers of a method; {@code redo} recomputes for another depth. */
    void showHierarchy(CallHierarchy.Node root, int level, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames, IntConsumer redo, String note) {
        this.treeNames = treeNames;
        this.redo = redo;
        adjusting = true;
        depth.setValue(level);
        adjusting = false;
        showDepth(true);
        title.setText(Text.t("usages.hierarchyTitle", describe(root.method(), treeNames)));
        status.setText(note);
        cancel.setVisible(false);
        var top = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new CallerNode(root));
        add(top, root);
        var model = new DefaultMutableTreeNode();
        model.add(top);
        tree.setModel(new DefaultTreeModel(model));
        for (int i = 0; i < tree.getRowCount() && i < 500; i++) tree.expandRow(i);
        tree.setSelectionRow(0);
    }

    private static void add(DefaultMutableTreeNode parent, CallHierarchy.Node node) {
        for (var caller : node.callers()) {
            var child = new DefaultMutableTreeNode(new CallerNode(caller));
            add(child, caller);
            parent.add(child);
        }
    }

    private void showDepth(boolean visible) { depthLabel.setVisible(visible); depth.setVisible(visible); }

    private static boolean openable(TreePath path) {
        Object value = ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) path.getLastPathComponent()).getUserObject();
        return value instanceof SiteNode || value instanceof CallerNode caller && !caller.node().sites().isEmpty();
    }

    private void openPath(TreePath path) {
        var node = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) path.getLastPathComponent();
        switch (node.getUserObject()) {
            case SiteNode site -> open.accept(site.usage().site());
            case CallerNode caller when !caller.node().sites().isEmpty() -> open.accept(caller.node().sites().getFirst().site());
            case MemberGroup group when node.getChildCount() > 0 -> openPath(path.pathByAddingChild(node.getChildAt(0)));
            case null, default -> { if (tree.isExpanded(path)) tree.collapsePath(path); else tree.expandPath(path); }
        }
    }

    // ----- labels ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    private static final Pattern LAMBDA = Pattern.compile("lambda\\$(.+)\\$\\d+");

    /** {@code Circle}, {@code Circle.area()}, {@code Circle.radius}, with the input's class names. */
    static String describe(Ref ref, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames) {
        String owner = simple(treeNames.apply(ref.owner()));
        if (ref.isClass()) return Ui.visible(treeNames.apply(ref.owner()).replace('/', '.'));
        return owner + "." + member(ref, treeNames);
    }

    /** A member as people read it; a lambda body is "lambda in m". */
    static String member(Ref ref, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames) {
        if (ref.isClass()) return Text.t("usages.classLevel");
        if (ref.isField()) return Ui.visible(ref.name());
        var lambda = LAMBDA.matcher(ref.name());
        if (lambda.matches()) {
            String written = lambda.group(1).equals("new") ? MethodLocator.simpleName(treeNames.apply(ref.owner()))
                : lambda.group(1).equals("static") ? "static { }" : lambda.group(1);
            return Text.t("usages.lambdaIn", Ui.visible(written));
        }
        return Descriptors.pretty(treeNames.apply(ref.owner()), ref.name() + ref.descriptor());
    }

    private static String simple(String internalName) {
        String simple = internalName.substring(internalName.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        return Ui.visible(simple);
    }

    /** One site: what it does, to what, where. */
    static String site(ReferenceIndex.Usage usage, UnaryOperator<String> treeNames) {
        var site = usage.site();
        String text = Text.t("usages.kind." + site.kind().name()) + " · " + describe(site.target(), treeNames);
        if (usage.via() != null) text += " " + Text.t("usages.via", describe(usage.via(), treeNames));
        if (site.line() > 0) text += " · " + Text.t("usages.line", site.line());
        return text;
    }

    private final class Renderer extends DefaultTreeCellRenderer {
        @Override public Component getTreeCellRendererComponent(JTree tree, Object value, boolean selected, boolean expanded, boolean leaf, int row, boolean focus) {
            super.getTreeCellRendererComponent(tree, value, selected, expanded, leaf, row, focus);
            setFont(tree.getFont());
            switch (((DefaultMutableTreeNode) value).getUserObject()) {
                case ClassGroup group -> {
                    setText("<html><b>" + Ui.escape(simple(group.treeName())) + "</b> <span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(packageOf(group.treeName()))
                        + " · " + group.count() + "</span></html>");
                    setIcon(Icons.kind('C', ExplorerPanel.kindColor('C'), null));
                }
                case MemberGroup group -> { setText(member(group.from(), treeNames) + "  (" + group.count() + ")"); setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.GOTO, 14)); }
                case SiteNode site -> { setText(site(site.usage(), treeNames)); setIcon(Icons.of(Icons.Glyph.FORWARD, 12)); }
                case CallerNode caller -> {
                    var node = caller.node();
                    String text = describe(node.method(), treeNames);
                    if (!node.sites().isEmpty()) text += "  · " + Text.t("usages.sites", node.sites().size());
                    if (node.cycle()) text += "  " + Text.t("usages.cycle");
                    else if (node.cut()) text += "  " + Text.t("usages.cut");
                    setText(text);
                    setIcon(Icons.of(node.sites().isEmpty() ? Icons.Glyph.GOTO : Icons.Glyph.BACK, 14));
                }
                case null, default -> { }
            }
            return this;
        }

        private String packageOf(String treeName) {
            int slash = treeName.lastIndexOf('/');
            return slash < 0 ? "" : Ui.visible(treeName.substring(0, slash).replace('/', '.'));
        }
    }

    // For tests.
    JTree tree() { return tree; }
    String titleText() { return title.getText(); }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.event.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import javax.swing.*;

/** Phase G3: the first screen: open a file or a result, reopen a recent one, or drop a file anywhere on the window. */
final class WelcomePanel extends JPanel {
    private final JPanel recent = new JPanel();
    private final GuiSettings settings;
    private final Consumer<Path> open;

    WelcomePanel(GuiSettings settings, Action openFile, Action openResult, Consumer<Path> open) {
        super(new GridBagLayout());
        this.settings = settings;
        this.open = open;
        var column = new JPanel();
        column.setOpaque(false);
        column.setLayout(new BoxLayout(column, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));

        var logo = new JLabel(new ImageIcon(ClassReviveApp.logo(56)));
        column.add(center(logo));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(12));
        column.add(center(Ui.heading("ClassRevive", 28f)));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(4));
        column.add(center(Ui.muted(Text.t("welcome.tagline"))));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(24));

        var buttons = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.CENTER, 10, 0));
        buttons.setOpaque(false);
        var primary = Ui.primary(openFile);
        primary.setMargin(new Insets(8, 16, 8, 16));
        var secondary = new JButton(openResult);
        secondary.setMargin(new Insets(8, 16, 8, 16));
        buttons.add(primary);
        buttons.add(secondary);
        column.add(center(buttons));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(18));
        column.add(center(new DropHint()));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(26));

        recent.setOpaque(false);
        recent.setLayout(new BoxLayout(recent, BoxLayout.Y_AXIS));
        column.add(center(recent));
        column.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(24));
        column.add(center(Ui.muted(Text.t("welcome.safety"))));
        add(column);
        refresh();
    }

    /** Rebuilds the recent list from the settings. */
    void refresh() {
        recent.removeAll();
        var items = settings.recent();
        if (!items.isEmpty()) {
            var title = Ui.muted(Text.t("welcome.recent").toUpperCase(Text.locale()));
            title.setFont(title.getFont().deriveFont(Font.BOLD, title.getFont().getSize2D() - 1.5f));
            title.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            recent.add(title);
            recent.add(Box.createVerticalStrut(6));
        }
        for (Path path : items.stream().limit(8).toList()) {
            boolean folder = Files.isDirectory(path);
            var link = new JButton("<html><nobr><b>" + Ui.escape(path.getFileName() == null ? path.toString() : path.getFileName().toString())
                + "</b> &nbsp;<span style='color:gray'>" + Ui.escape(shorten(path.getParent() == null ? "" : path.getParent().toString(), 64))
                + "</span></nobr></html>");
            link.setIcon(Icons.of(folder ? Icons.Glyph.FOLDER_RESULT : Icons.Glyph.RESOURCE, 14));
            link.putClientProperty(com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE, com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatClientProperties.BUTTON_TYPE_TOOLBAR_BUTTON);
            link.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.LEFT);
            link.setAlignmentX(LEFT_ALIGNMENT);
            link.setMaximumSize(new Dimension(560, link.getPreferredSize().height));
            link.setToolTipText(path.toString());
            link.addActionListener(e -> open.accept(path));
            recent.add(link);
        }
        recent.revalidate();
        recent.repaint();
    }

    /** Keeps both ends of a long path, with an ellipsis in the middle. */
    static String shorten(String path, int max) {
        if (path.length() <= max) return path;
        int keep = (max - 1) / 2;
        return path.substring(0, keep) + "…" + path.substring(path.length() - (max - 1 - keep));
    }

    private static JComponent center(JComponent component) {
        component.setAlignmentX(CENTER_ALIGNMENT);
        return component;
    }

    /** A dashed drop zone hint. */
    private static final class DropHint extends JComponent {
        DropHint() { setPreferredSize(new Dimension(520, 64)); setMaximumSize(new Dimension(520, 64)); }
        @Override protected void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
            var g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            g2.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_TEXT_ANTIALIASING, RenderingHints.VALUE_TEXT_ANTIALIAS_ON);
            g2.setColor(Theme.line());
            g2.setStroke(new BasicStroke(1.4f, BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND, BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND, 1f, new float[] {6f, 5f}, 0f));
            g2.drawRoundRect(1, 1, getWidth() - 3, getHeight() - 3, 14, 14);
            g2.setColor(Theme.muted());
            g2.setFont(UIManager.getFont("Label.font"));
            String text = Text.t("welcome.drop");
            var metrics = g2.getFontMetrics();
            g2.drawString(text, (getWidth() - metrics.stringWidth(text)) / 2, getHeight() / 2 + metrics.getAscent() / 2 - 2);
            g2.dispose();
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Workspace.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.intake.MultiRelease;
import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

/**
 * Phase G3: one opened input and, once decompiled, its result. Opening only inventories the bytes (as {@code classrevive
 * inspect}); classes are never loaded or run. Not thread-confined: the GUI builds it on a background thread and then reads it
 * on the event thread, and {@link #attach} is called once a decompile finishes.
 */
public final class Workspace {
    /** A class of the input, by its own internal name ({@code a/b/C$D}) and archive entry. */
    public record ClassItem(String name, String entry, ClassInfo info) {
        public String simpleName() { return name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1); }
        public String packageName() { int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/'); return slash < 0 ? "" : name.substring(0, slash).replace('/', '.'); }
        /** The enclosing class for {@code A$B} when {@code A} is in the input, else null. */
        public String outer(Set<String> names) {
            int slash = name.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = name.lastIndexOf('$');
            if (dollar <= slash + 1 || dollar == name.length() - 1) return null;
            String outer = name.substring(0, dollar);
            return names.contains(outer) ? outer : null;
        }
    }

    /** A non-class entry, or a multi-release class variant kept aside like the pipeline does. */
    public record ResourceItem(String entry, long size, String sha256) {}

    static final int MAX_ENTRY_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_BYTECODE_CHARS = 2_000_000;

    private final Path input;
    private final Path inspected;
    private final boolean jar;
    private final InputIdentifier.Identification identification;
    private final Inventory inventory;
    private final List<ClassItem> classes;
    private final Map<String,ClassItem> byName;
    private final List<ResourceItem> resources;
    private volatile ResultIndex result;
    private volatile Map<String,String> portableByOriginal = Map.of();
    private String label;
    private ObfuscationCheck.Detection obfuscation;
    private volatile String reversedFrom;

    private Workspace(Path input, Path inspected, InputIdentifier.Identification identification, Inventory inventory) {
        this.input = input;
        this.inspected = inspected;
        this.jar = !inspected.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class");
        this.identification = identification;
        this.inventory = inventory;
        var variants = new HashSet<String>();
        if (jar) MultiRelease.variants(inventory).forEach(variant -> variants.add(variant.entry()));
        var classes = new ArrayList<ClassItem>();
        var resources = new ArrayList<ResourceItem>();
        for (var entry : inventory.entries()) {
            if (entry.classInfo() != null && !variants.contains(entry.name())) classes.add(new ClassItem(entry.classInfo().name(), entry.name(), entry.classInfo()));
            else resources.add(new ResourceItem(entry.name(), entry.size(), entry.sha256()));
        }
        classes.sort(Comparator.comparing(ClassItem::name));
        resources.sort(Comparator.comparing(ResourceItem::entry));
        this.classes = List.copyOf(classes);
        var byName = new LinkedHashMap<String,ClassItem>();
        for (var item : classes) byName.put(item.name(), item);
        this.byName = Collections.unmodifiableMap(byName);
        this.resources = List.copyOf(resources);
    }

    /** Thrown when the input holds nothing ClassRevive can read; the message is for people. */
    public static final class Unreadable extends IOException {
        private final String details;
        Unreadable(String message, String details) { super(message); this.details = details; }
        public String details() { return details; }
    }

    /**
     * Inventories a {@code .jar} or {@code .class}. Any other file is identified from its bytes first (Phase 2CE); a jar
     * found inside it is copied, as data, into {@code cache} and inventoried from there.
     */
    public static Workspace openInput(Path file, Path cache) throws IOException {
        file = file.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(file)) throw new Unreadable(Text.t("error.notAFile", file.getFileName()), file.toString());
        String name = file.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        InputIdentifier.Identification identification = null;
        Path inspected = file;
        if (!name.endsWith(".jar") && !name.endsWith(".class")) {
            identification = InputIdentifier.identify(file);
            if (!identification.javaAvailable())
                throw new Unreadable(Text.t("error.noJava", file.getFileName(), identification.format()), identification.text());
            var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(file);
            Files.createDirectories(cache);
            inspected = cache.resolve(resolved.identification().sha256() + (resolved.jar() ? ".jar" : ".class"));
            if (!Files.exists(inspected)) Files.write(inspected, resolved.bytes());
        }
        var workspace = new Workspace(file, inspected, identification, inventory(inspected));
        workspace.obfuscation = detect(inspected);
        return workspace;
    }

    /** Opens a folder a decompile wrote (by this application or by {@code classrevive decompile}). */
    public static Workspace openResult(Path folder) throws IOException {
        var index = ResultIndex.open(folder);
        Path snapshot = Files.isRegularFile(index.output().resolve("input.jar")) ? index.output().resolve("input.jar") : index.output().resolve("input.class");
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(snapshot)) throw new Unreadable(Text.t("error.noSnapshot", folder.getFileName()), snapshot.toString());
        var workspace = new Workspace(snapshot, snapshot, null, inventory(snapshot));
        workspace.label = index.output().getFileName().toString();
        workspace.obfuscation = detect(snapshot);
        workspace.attach(index);
        return workspace;
    }

    /** Phase G5: the obfuscator the input points to, or null when the bytes could not be classified. */
    private static ObfuscationCheck.Detection detect(Path file) {
        try { return ObfuscationCheck.analyze(file); }
        catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) { return null; }
    }

    private static Inventory inventory(Path file) throws IOException {
        var inventory = new InventoryReader().inspect(file, Limits.defaults());
        if (!inventory.successful()) {
            var details = new StringBuilder();
            for (var diagnostic : inventory.diagnostics())
                details.append(diagnostic.code()).append(" [").append(diagnostic.entry()).append("]: ").append(diagnostic.message()).append('\n');
            throw new Unreadable(Text.t("error.rejected", file.getFileName()), details.toString());
        }
        return inventory;
    }

    /**
     * Decompiles the input into a new folder under {@code root} and attaches the result. Interrupting the calling thread
     * cancels the job (its folder keeps what was written so far).
     */
    public ResultIndex decompile(DecompileRequest request, JobListener listener) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var decompiled = new DecompileService().decompile(request, listener);
        var index = ResultIndex.open(decompiled.output());
        attach(index);
        return index;
    }

    /** A request for this input with the settings' engines, timeout and stubs, into a new folder under the workspace directory. */
    public DecompileRequest request(GuiSettings settings, List<Path> dependencies) throws IOException {
        return request(settings.engines(), settings.timeoutSeconds(), settings.stubs(), dependencies, settings);
    }

    /** A request with explicit engines, time limit and stubs; the folder and engine cache still follow the settings. */
    public DecompileRequest request(List<dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine> engines, int timeoutSeconds, boolean stubs, List<Path> dependencies,
                                    GuiSettings settings) throws IOException {
        return new DecompileRequest(input, newOutput(settings.workspaceDirectory(), displayName()), engines,
            RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(timeoutSeconds), dependencies, settings.engineCache() ? settings.engineCacheDirectory() : null, stubs);
    }

    /** {@code root/<name>-<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>}, with {@code -2}, {@code -3}... when taken; the folder itself is not created. */
    static Path newOutput(Path root, String inputName) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(root);
        String base = inputName.replaceAll("\\.(jar|class)$", "").replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_");
        if (base.isEmpty() || base.startsWith(".")) base = "input" + base;
        String stamp = LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss"));
        Path candidate = root.resolve(base + "-" + stamp);
        for (int n = 2; Files.exists(candidate); n++) candidate = root.resolve(base + "-" + stamp + "-" + n);
        return candidate;
    }

    void attach(ResultIndex index) {
        var map = new HashMap<String,String>();
        for (String portable : index.classes().keySet()) map.put(index.originalName(portable), portable);
        portableByOriginal = Map.copyOf(map);
        result = index;
    }

    /** The decompile evidence for a class of the input, or empty before a decompile (or for a class it did not cover). */
    public Optional<ResultIndex.ClassEntry> evidence(String name) {
        var index = result;
        if (index == null) return Optional.empty();
        return Optional.ofNullable(index.classes().get(portableByOriginal.getOrDefault(name, name)));
    }

    /** The source of a class of the input in one candidate of the result. */
    public Optional<Path> source(String name, String candidate) {
        var index = result;
        if (index == null) return Optional.empty();
        return index.source(portableByOriginal.getOrDefault(name, name), candidate);
    }

    /** The input's name for a class of the result (the inverse of the portable renaming). */
    public String originalOf(String portable) {
        var index = result;
        return index == null ? portable : index.originalName(portable);
    }

    /** Phase G6: the result's name for a class of the input (portable when Phase 2BV renamed it), or the name itself. */
    public String portableOf(String original) { return portableByOriginal.getOrDefault(original, original); }

    /** Bytes of one archive entry (or of the class file), at most 16 MiB. */
    public byte[] entryBytes(String entry) throws IOException {
        if (!jar) return readBounded(Files.readAllBytes(inspected));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(inspected.toFile())) {
            var item = zip.getEntry(entry);
            if (item == null) throw new IOException("No entry " + entry);
            try (var in = zip.getInputStream(item)) { return readBounded(in.readNBytes(MAX_ENTRY_BYTES + 1)); }
        }
    }

    private static byte[] readBounded(byte[] bytes) throws IOException {
        if (bytes.length > MAX_ENTRY_BYTES) throw new IOException("Entry larger than 16 MiB");
        return bytes;
    }

    /** ASM's text of the class, parsed in this process and never loaded. */
    public String bytecode(ClassItem item) throws IOException {
        return dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassText.disassemble(entryBytes(item.entry()), MAX_BYTECODE_CHARS);
    }

    public Path input() { return input; }
    /** The file actually inventoried: the input, or the jar extracted from it (an .exe, a renamed zip). */
    public Path inspected() { return inspected; }
    public boolean jar() { return jar; }
    /** The input's file name, or the folder name of a result opened directly. */
    public String displayName() { return label != null ? label : input.getFileName().toString(); }
    public InputIdentifier.Identification identification() { return identification; }
    public Inventory inventory() { return inventory; }
    public List<ClassItem> classes() { return classes; }
    public Optional<ClassItem> classItem(String name) { return Optional.ofNullable(byName.get(name)); }

    private volatile Map<String,List<String>> bySimpleName;

    /** Phase G4: the input's classes whose own name (after the last {@code /} or {@code $}) is {@code simple}. */
    public List<String> classesNamed(String simple) {
        var index = bySimpleName;
        if (index == null) {
            var built = new HashMap<String,List<String>>();
            for (var item : classes) {
                String own = item.name().substring(Math.max(item.name().lastIndexOf('/'), item.name().lastIndexOf('$')) + 1);
                built.computeIfAbsent(own, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item.name());
            }
            built.replaceAll((k, v) -> List.copyOf(v));
            bySimpleName = index = Map.copyOf(built);
        }
        return index.getOrDefault(simple, List.of());
    }
    public Set<String> classNames() { return byName.keySet(); }
    public List<ResourceItem> resources() { return resources; }
    public ResultIndex result() { return result; }
    /** Phase G5: the obfuscator classification of this workspace's classes, or null. */
    public ObfuscationCheck.Detection obfuscation() { return obfuscation; }
    /** Phase G5: the original input's name when these classes are the Skidfuscator reversal of it, else null. */
    public String reversedFrom() { return reversedFrom; }
    void reversedFrom(String original) { reversedFrom = original; }
    public boolean decompiled() { return result != null; }
}

```

`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/EditorLogicTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase G4: finding method declarations in decompiled text, and aligning two versions line by line. */
class EditorLogicTest {
    static final String SOURCE = """
        package demo;

        /* class Fake { void ghost() {} } in a comment */
        public class Outer {
            private final String text = "area(1) { not a method";
            static {
                System.out.println("init");
            }
            public Outer() { this(1); }
            public Outer(int x) { }
            public int area() { return area(2); }
            public int area(int scale) {
                return scale;
            }
            public <T> java.util.List<T> list(T a, java.util.Map<String, T> b) throws Exception { return null; }
            abstract static class Shape { abstract double area(); }
            public static class Inner {
                public int area() { return 3; }
            }
        }
        """;

    @Test void locatesDeclarationsByNameAndParameterCountInTheRightClass() {
        var methods = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<String>>();
        methods.put("demo/Outer$Inner", List.of("area()I"));
        methods.put("demo/Outer$Shape", List.of("area()D"));
        methods.put("demo/Outer", List.of("<clinit>()V", "<init>()V", "<init>(I)V", "area()I", "area(I)I", "list(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/util/Map;)Ljava/util/List;",
            "lambda$area$0()V", "ghost()V"));
        var lines = MethodLocator.locate(SOURCE, methods);
        var outer = lines.get("demo/Outer");
        assertEquals(6, outer.get("<clinit>()V"));
        assertEquals(9, outer.get("<init>()V"));
        assertEquals(10, outer.get("<init>(I)V"));
        assertEquals(11, outer.get("area()I"), "the call area(2) on the same line is not a declaration");
        assertEquals(12, outer.get("area(I)I"));
        assertEquals(15, outer.get("list(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/util/Map;)Ljava/util/List;"), "generic and nested commas");
        assertFalse(outer.containsKey("lambda$area$0()V"), "synthetic methods have no declaration");
        assertFalse(outer.containsKey("ghost()V"), "comments are ignored");
        assertEquals(16, lines.get("demo/Outer$Shape").get("area()D"), "abstract methods end with ;");
        assertEquals(18, lines.get("demo/Outer$Inner").get("area()I"), "a nested class's method is not the outer one");
        assertEquals(1, MethodLocator.parameters("(I)V"));
        assertEquals(3, MethodLocator.parameters("([[ILjava/lang/String;J)V"));
        assertEquals("Inner", MethodLocator.simpleName("demo/Outer$Inner"));
        assertEquals("", MethodLocator.simpleName("demo/Outer$1"));
        assertEquals("list(Object, Map)", Descriptors.pretty("demo/Outer", "list(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/util/Map;)Ljava/util/List;"));
        assertEquals("Outer(int[][])", Descriptors.pretty("demo/Outer", "<init>([[I)V"));
    }

    @Test void blankingKeepsOffsetsAndNewlines() {
        String text = "a /* x\ny */ \"s\\\"t\" 'c' // end\nb";
        String blank = MethodLocator.blank(text);
        assertEquals(text.length(), blank.length());
        assertEquals(text.indexOf('\n'), blank.indexOf('\n'));
        assertEquals('b', blank.charAt(blank.length() - 1));
        assertFalse(blank.contains("s") || blank.contains("end") || blank.contains("x"));
    }

    @Test void alignsTwoVersionsSideBySide() {
        var aligned = LineDiff.align("a\nb\nc\nd\n", "a\nB\nc\nd\ne\n");
        assertEquals(List.of(LineDiff.Kind.SAME, LineDiff.Kind.CHANGED, LineDiff.Kind.SAME, LineDiff.Kind.SAME, LineDiff.Kind.ADDED), aligned.kinds());
        assertEquals(Arrays.asList("a", "b", "c", "d", null), aligned.left());
        assertEquals(aligned.left().size(), aligned.right().size());
        var removed = LineDiff.align("x\ny\nz", "x\nz");
        assertEquals(List.of(LineDiff.Kind.SAME, LineDiff.Kind.REMOVED, LineDiff.Kind.SAME), removed.kinds());
        assertEquals(0, LineDiff.align("same  \n", "same\n").count(LineDiff.Kind.CHANGED), "trailing spaces do not count");
        assertEquals(List.of(), LineDiff.align("", "").kinds());
        assertEquals(3, LineDiff.align("", "a\nb\nc").count(LineDiff.Kind.ADDED));
    }

    @Test void theScriptIsMinimalOnAShiftedBlock() {
        var a = new ArrayList<String>();
        var b = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 200; i++) a.add("line " + i);
        b.add("new first");
        b.addAll(a.subList(0, 150));
        b.addAll(a.subList(160, 200));
        char[] script = LineDiff.script(a, b);
        long edits = new String(script).chars().filter(c -> c != '=').count();
        assertEquals(11, edits, "one insertion and ten deletions");
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/Fixtures.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;

/** Compiles small authored sources into a jar for the GUI tests (nothing from the jar is ever run). */
final class Fixtures {
    private Fixtures() {}

    static final Map<String,String> SOURCES = Map.of(
        "demo/shapes/Shape.java", "package demo.shapes; public interface Shape { double area(); }",
        "demo/shapes/Circle.java", """
            package demo.shapes;
            public class Circle implements Shape {
                private final double radius;
                public Circle(double radius) { this.radius = radius; }
                public double area() { return Math.PI * radius * radius; }
                public static class Builder { private double r; public Builder radius(double r) { this.r = r; return this; } public Circle build() { return new Circle(r); } }
            }
            """,
        "demo/shapes/Color.java", "package demo.shapes; public enum Color { RED, GREEN; public Color next() { return values()[(ordinal() + 1) % 2]; } }",
        "demo/Main.java", """
            package demo;
            import demo.shapes.*;
            public class Main {
                public static String describe(Shape shape) { return "area=" + shape.area(); }
                public int sum(int[] values) { int total = 0; for (int value : values) total += value; return total; }
            }
            """);

    /** A jar with the classes above plus a text resource and a binary one. */
    static Path jar(Path directory) throws Exception {
        var sources = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("fixture-src"));
        var classes = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("fixture-classes"));
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        for (var source : SOURCES.entrySet()) {
            Path file = sources.resolve(source.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
            Files.writeString(file, source.getValue());
            args.add(file.toString());
        }
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        var archive = directory.resolve("demo-app.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(archive)); var walk = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (Path file : walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile).sorted().toList()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/')));
                zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(file));
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("config/app.properties"));
            zip.write("name=demo\nversion=1\n".getBytes());
            zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("assets/logo.bin"));
            zip.write(new byte[] {0, 1, 2, 3, 0});
            zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return archive;
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/MainWindowSmokeTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeFalse;

/** The real window, driven through its actions: open, open a class, decompile, overview. Skipped without a display. */
class MainWindowSmokeTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void opensDecompilesAndShowsTheResult() throws Exception {
        assumeFalse(GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless(), "needs a display");
        System.setProperty("classrevive.home", directory.resolve("home").toString());
        try {
            var settings = GuiSettings.load();
            settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
            settings.customEngines("cfr");
            settings.engineCache(false);
            Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
            Path jar = Fixtures.jar(directory);
            var window = onEdt(() -> { Theme.install(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.LIGHT); return new MainWindow(settings); });
            try {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(jar));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null));
                assertFalse(onEdt(() -> window.decompile.isEnabled() && window.searchCode.isEnabled()), "search needs a result");
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/Main").orElseThrow()));
                assertEquals(1, (int) onEdt(() -> window.tabs().getTabCount()));

                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.decompile.actionPerformed(null));
                assertTrue(onEdt(window::running));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !window.running()));
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.workspace().decompiled()), "decompile finished with a result");
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.tabs().getComponentAt(0) instanceof OverviewPanel), "overview first");
                assertEquals(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT, window.workspace().evidence("demo/Main").orElseThrow().level());
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.searchCode.isEnabled() && window.exportProject.isEnabled()));
                // The class tab switched from bytecode to the selected source.
                var tab = onEdt(() -> (CodeTab) window.tabs().getComponentAt(1));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> tab.content().contains("public class Main")));
                assertTrue(settings.recent().stream().anyMatch(path -> path.equals(window.workspace().result().output())));

                // Phase G4: evidence icons on the measured methods of the selected source.
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> tab.evidenceIcons() >= 2));
                // Ctrl+click on "Shape" (a class of the input) opens it; back and forward return.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.tabs().setSelectedComponent(tab));
                int offset = onEdt(() -> tab.content().indexOf("Shape shape") + 1);
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> tab.linkAt(offset).execute());
                assertEquals("demo/shapes/Shape", onEdt(() -> ((CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent()).classItem().name()));
                assertNull(onEdt(() -> tab.linkAt(tab.content().indexOf("String") + 1)), "JDK classes are not links");
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.back.actionPerformed(null));
                assertEquals("demo/Main", onEdt(() -> ((CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent()).classItem().name()));
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.forward.isEnabled()));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.forward.actionPerformed(null));
                assertEquals("demo/shapes/Shape", onEdt(() -> ((CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent()).classItem().name()));
                // Opening a class at a line (search results, javac errors) puts the caret on that line.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/shapes/Circle").orElseThrow(), 4));
                var circle = onEdt(() -> (CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent());
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> circle.content().contains("class Circle") && circle.caretText().startsWith("Ln 4,")));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/shapes/Shape").orElseThrow()));
                // Compare engines opens a side-by-side tab for the current class.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.compare.actionPerformed(null));
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.tabs().getSelectedComponent() instanceof CompareTab));
            } finally {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(window::dispose);
            }
        } finally {
            System.clearProperty("classrevive.home");
        }
    }

    private static <T> T onEdt(Callable<T> call) throws Exception {
        var result = new CompletableFuture<T>();
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { try { result.complete(call.call()); } catch (Exception e) { result.completeExceptionally(e); } });
        return result.get();
    }

    private interface Check { boolean ok() throws Exception; }

    private static void waitFor(Check check) throws Exception {
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(120);
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) { if (check.ok()) return; Thread.sleep(100); }
        fail("condition not reached in time");
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/ScreenshotTour.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.awt.*;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
import javax.swing.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeTrue;

/**
 * Design review aid, off by default: with {@code -Dclassrevive.screenshots=<folder>} (and optionally
 * {@code -Dclassrevive.screenshots.result=<a result folder>}), walks the main screens in both themes and writes PNGs there.
 * {@code -Dclassrevive.screenshots.language=en} (default) or {@code pt} picks the interface language. Gradle passes
 * {@code -Pclassrevive.screenshots...} properties through (see the module's build script).
 */
class ScreenshotTour {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void tour() throws Exception {
        String target = System.getProperty("classrevive.screenshots");
        assumeTrue(target != null && !GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless(), "screenshots not requested");
        Path out = Files.createDirectories(Path.of(target));
        System.setProperty("classrevive.home", directory.resolve("home").toString());
        var settings = GuiSettings.load();
        settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
        settings.customEngines("cfr,vineflower");
        settings.engineCache(false);
        var language = System.getProperty("classrevive.screenshots.language", "en").equals("pt")
            ? GuiSettings.Language.PORTUGUESE : GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH;
        settings.language(language);
        Text.use(language);
        Path jar = Fixtures.jar(directory);
        String result = System.getProperty("classrevive.screenshots.result");
        if (result != null) settings.remember(Path.of(result));
        settings.remember(jar);
        for (var theme : new GuiSettings.ThemeChoice[] {GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.LIGHT, GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK}) {
            String suffix = theme.name().toLowerCase();
            var window = onEdt(() -> { Theme.install(theme); var w = new MainWindow(settings); w.setSize(1440, 900); w.setVisible(true); return w; });
            try {
                settle();
                shot(window, out.resolve("01-welcome-" + suffix + ".png"));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(jar));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/shapes/Circle").orElseThrow()));
                settle();
                shot(window, out.resolve("02-opened-" + suffix + ".png"));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.decompile.actionPerformed(null));
                Thread.sleep(700);
                shot(window, out.resolve("03-decompiling-" + suffix + ".png"));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !window.running()));
                settle();
                shot(window, out.resolve("04-overview-" + suffix + ".png"));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/shapes/Circle").orElseThrow()));
                settle();
                shot(window, out.resolve("05-class-" + suffix + ".png"));
                // A result folder opens in a window of its own, so its activity panel does not show the demo's decompile.
                if (result != null) resultTour(settings, Path.of(result), out, suffix);
                // Optional: a result that does not compile, opened at its first javac error.
                String errors = System.getProperty("classrevive.screenshots.errors");
                if (errors != null) {
                    SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(Path.of(errors)));
                    waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null && window.workspace().input().startsWith(Path.of(errors))));
                    var diagnostic = window.workspace().result().diagnostics().getFirst();
                    String className = window.workspace().originalOf(diagnostic.file().replaceAll("\\.java$", ""));
                    SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem(className).orElseThrow(), (int) diagnostic.line()));
                    settle();
                    Thread.sleep(2500);
                    shot(window, out.resolve("12-errors-" + suffix + ".png"));
                }
                // Optional: a Skidfuscator jar, its banner, then the overview of its reversal.
                String skid = System.getProperty("classrevive.screenshots.skid");
                if (skid != null) {
                    SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(Path.of(skid)));
                    waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null && window.workspace().input().equals(Path.of(skid))));
                    settle();
                    shot(window, out.resolve("13-skidfuscator-" + suffix + ".png"));
                    SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.decompile(false, true));
                    waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !window.running() && window.workspace().reversedFrom() != null));
                    settle();
                    shot(window, out.resolve("14-skidfuscator-reversed-" + suffix + ".png"));
                }
                if (theme == GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.LIGHT) {
                    dialog(new GoToClassDialog(window, window.workspace(), x -> { }), out.resolve("09-goto.png"));
                    dialog(onEdt(() -> new SettingsDialog(window, settings)), out.resolve("10-settings.png"));
                    dialog(onEdt(() -> new DecompileDialog(window, settings, java.util.List.of())), out.resolve("11-decompile-options.png"));
                }
            } finally {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(window::dispose);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void resultTour(GuiSettings settings, Path result, Path out, String suffix) throws Exception {
        var window = onEdt(() -> { var w = new MainWindow(settings); w.setSize(1440, 900); w.setVisible(true); return w; });
        try {
            SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(result));
            waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null && window.workspace().decompiled() && window.workspace().input().startsWith(result)));
            settle();
            shot(window, out.resolve("06-result-overview-" + suffix + ".png"));
            var item = onEdt(() -> window.workspace().classes().stream().filter(c -> c.simpleName().equals("JsonReader")).findFirst()
                .orElse(window.workspace().classes().get(window.workspace().classes().size() / 2)));
            SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(item));
            settle();
            // Scroll to the first method with an evidence icon, a few lines below the top.
            SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> {
                var tab = (CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent();
                if (tab.firstEvidenceLine() > 0) tab.goToLine(tab.firstEvidenceLine() + 12);
            });
            settle();
            shot(window, out.resolve("07-result-class-" + suffix + ".png"));
            SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.compare.actionPerformed(null));
            settle();
            Thread.sleep(800);
            shot(window, out.resolve("08-compare-" + suffix + ".png"));
        } finally {
            SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(window::dispose);
        }
    }

    private static void dialog(JDialog dialog, Path file) throws Exception {
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { dialog.pack(); dialog.setLocation(-5000, -5000); dialog.setVisible(false); });
        var image = onEdt(() -> {
            var root = dialog.getRootPane();
            root.setSize(root.getPreferredSize());
            root.doLayout();
            layout(root);
            var picture = new BufferedImage(root.getWidth(), root.getHeight(), BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
            var g = picture.createGraphics();
            root.paint(g);
            g.dispose();
            return picture;
        });
        ImageIO.write(image, "png", file.toFile());
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(dialog::dispose);
    }

    private static void layout(Container container) {
        container.doLayout();
        for (var child : container.getComponents()) if (child instanceof Container c) layout(c);
    }

    private static void shot(JFrame window, Path file) throws Exception {
        var image = onEdt(() -> {
            var root = window.getRootPane();
            window.validate();
            var picture = new BufferedImage(root.getWidth(), root.getHeight(), BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
            var g = picture.createGraphics();
            root.paint(g);
            g.dispose();
            return picture;
        });
        ImageIO.write(image, "png", file.toFile());
    }

    private static void settle() throws Exception {
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { Thread.sleep(150); SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { }); }
    }

    private static <T> T onEdt(Callable<T> call) throws Exception {
        var result = new CompletableFuture<T>();
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { try { result.complete(call.call()); } catch (Exception e) { result.completeExceptionally(e); } });
        return result.get();
    }

    private interface Check { boolean ok() throws Exception; }

    private static void waitFor(Check check) throws Exception {
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(180);
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) { if (check.ok()) return; Thread.sleep(100); }
        throw new AssertionError("condition not reached in time");
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class SettingsAndToolsTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void settingsRoundTripAndFallBackOnBadValues() throws Exception {
        Path file = directory.resolve("settings.properties");
        var settings = GuiSettings.load(file);
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK, settings.theme(), "black and orange by default (Phase G4)");
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower"), settings.engines().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        settings.theme(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK);
        settings.language(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
        settings.fontSize(99);
        settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
        settings.customEngines("procyon,jadx");
        settings.timeoutSeconds(300);
        settings.stubs(false);
        for (int i = 0; i < 14; i++) settings.remember(directory.resolve("input-" + i + ".jar"));
        settings.remember(directory.resolve("input-3.jar"));
        settings.save();

        var loaded = GuiSettings.load(file);
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK, loaded.theme());
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH, loaded.language());
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.MAX_FONT, loaded.fontSize());
        assertEquals(List.of("procyon", "jadx"), loaded.engines().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        assertEquals(300, loaded.timeoutSeconds());
        assertFalse(loaded.stubs());
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.MAX_RECENT, loaded.recent().size());
        assertEquals(directory.resolve("input-3.jar").toAbsolutePath().normalize(), loaded.recent().getFirst(), "reopened goes first, once");

        Files.writeString(file, "theme=PURPLE\neditor.fontSize=abc\ndecompile.timeoutSeconds=0\ndecompile.customEngines=fernflower\ndecompile.profile=CUSTOM\n");
        var damaged = GuiSettings.load(file);
        assertEquals(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK, damaged.theme());
        assertEquals(13, damaged.fontSize());
        assertEquals(120, damaged.timeoutSeconds());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower"), damaged.engines().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> damaged.timeoutSeconds(0));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> damaged.customEngines("cfr,cfr"));
    }

    @Test void searchFindsLinesInSourcesAndStopsAtTheLimit() throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("sources/a"));
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("B.java"), "package a;\nclass B {\n  int Value = 1;\n  int value() { return Value; }\n}\n");
        Files.writeString(root.resolve("notes.txt"), "value");
        var hits = SourceSearch.search(directory.resolve("sources"), "value", false, 100, () -> false);
        assertEquals(List.of(3, 4), hits.stream().map(SourceSearch.Hit::line).toList());
        assertEquals("a/B", hits.getFirst().className());
        assertEquals(List.of(4), SourceSearch.search(directory.resolve("sources"), "value()", true, 100, () -> false).stream().map(SourceSearch.Hit::line).toList());
        assertEquals(1, SourceSearch.search(directory.resolve("sources"), "value", false, 1, () -> false).size());
        assertTrue(SourceSearch.search(directory.resolve("sources"), "value", false, 100, () -> true).isEmpty());
        assertTrue(SourceSearch.search(directory.resolve("missing"), "value", false, 100, () -> false).isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void exportCopiesIntoANewFolderAndZipsWithoutOverwriting() throws Exception {
        Path source = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("project/src/main/java/a"));
        Files.writeString(source.resolve("B.java"), "class B {}");
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("project/README.md"), "readme");
        Path target = directory.resolve("out/project-copy");
        assertEquals(2, Exporter.copyTree(directory.resolve("project"), target));
        assertEquals("class B {}", Files.readString(target.resolve("src/main/java/a/B.java")));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> Exporter.copyTree(directory.resolve("project"), target), "target not empty");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> Exporter.copyTree(directory.resolve("project"), directory.resolve("project/inside")));
        Path zip = directory.resolve("sources.zip");
        assertEquals(2, Exporter.zip(directory.resolve("project"), zip));
        try (var archive = new ZipFile(zip.toFile())) { assertNotNull(archive.getEntry("src/main/java/a/B.java")); }
        assertThrows(FileAlreadyExistsException.class, () -> Exporter.zip(directory.resolve("project"), zip));
    }

    /** Every key the code asks for exists in both languages, both have the same keys, and every pattern formats. */
    @Test void bothLanguagesHaveEveryStringTheCodeUses() throws Exception {
        var english = load("messages.properties");
        var portuguese = load("messages_pt_BR.properties");
        assertEquals(english.keySet(), portuguese.keySet(), "same keys in both languages");
        var used = new TreeSet<String>();
        var literal = Pattern.compile("Text\\.t\\(\"([A-Za-z0-9_.@]+)\"\\s*[,)]");
        try (var files = Files.walk(Path.of("src/main/java"))) {
            for (Path file : files.filter(f -> f.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                var matcher = literal.matcher(Files.readString(file));
                while (matcher.find()) used.add(matcher.group(1));
            }
        }
        for (String confidence : List.of("HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW")) used.add("confidence." + confidence);
        var families = Map.of("outcome.", Arrays.stream(dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex.Outcome.values()).map(Enum::name).toList(), "level.", List.of("EXACT", "CLOSE", "PER_FILE", "PARTIAL", "UNVERIFIED", "EXACT.meaning", "CLOSE.meaning",
                "PER_FILE.meaning", "PARTIAL.meaning", "UNVERIFIED.meaning"),
            "kind.", List.of("C", "I", "E", "R", "@"), "compilation.", List.of("COMPILED", "COMPILE_FAILED", "UNSUPPORTED_RELEASE", "WORKER_FAILED"),
            "engine.", Arrays.stream(dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult.Status.values()).map(Enum::name).toList(),
            "stage.", Arrays.stream(dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener.Stage.values()).map(Enum::name).toList(),
            "theme.", Arrays.stream(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.values()).map(Enum::name).toList(),
            "language.", Arrays.stream(GuiSettings.Language.values()).map(Enum::name).toList(),
            "profile.", Arrays.stream(GuiSettings.Profile.values()).map(Enum::name).toList());
        families.forEach((prefix, names) -> names.forEach(name -> used.add(prefix + name)));
        for (String key : used) assertTrue(english.containsKey(key), "missing key " + key);
        for (var bundle : List.of(english, portuguese))
            for (String key : bundle.stringPropertyNames())
                assertDoesNotThrow(() -> new java.text.MessageFormat(bundle.getProperty(key)).format(new Object[] {1, 2, 3, 4}), key);
        assertTrue(new java.text.MessageFormat(english.getProperty("level.PER_FILE.meaning")).format(new Object[0]).contains("class's"));
    }

    private static Properties load(String name) throws IOException {
        var properties = new Properties();
        try (var in = SettingsAndToolsTest.class.getResourceAsStream("/dev/classrevive/gui/" + name);
             var reader = new java.io.InputStreamReader(in, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) { properties.load(reader); }
        return properties;
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeFalse;

/** Phase G5, in the real window: a Skidfuscator jar is detected, reversed, decompiled and reopened as its reversal. */
class SkidfuscatorFlowTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void detectsReversesAndDecompiles() throws Exception {
        assumeFalse(GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless(), "needs a display");
        System.setProperty("classrevive.home", directory.resolve("home").toString());
        try {
            var settings = GuiSettings.load();
            settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
            settings.customEngines("cfr");
            settings.engineCache(false);
            Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
            Path jar = Files.copy(Path.of("../../benchmarks/obfuscated/skidfuscator/skid-fixture-obf.jar"), directory.resolve("skid-app.jar"));
            var window = onEdt(() -> { Theme.install(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.DARK); return new MainWindow(settings); });
            try {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(jar));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null));
                assertTrue(window.workspace().obfuscation().skidfuscator());
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.banner().offersReversal()), "the banner offers the reversal");

                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.decompile(false, true));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !window.running()));
                var reversed = onEdt(window::workspace);
                assertEquals("skid-app.jar", reversed.reversedFrom(), "the window now shows the reversal");
                assertTrue(reversed.decompiled());
                assertFalse(reversed.obfuscation().skidfuscator(), reversed.obfuscation().summary());
                assertFalse(onEdt(() -> window.banner().offersReversal()));
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.banner().isVisible()), "the banner says the classes were reversed");
                assertTrue(onEdt(() -> window.tabs().getComponentAt(0) instanceof OverviewPanel));
                // The reversal folder sits beside the result in the workspace directory.
                try (var folders = Files.list(settings.workspaceDirectory())) {
                    assertTrue(folders.anyMatch(folder -> folder.getFileName().toString().startsWith("skid-app-skidfuscator-reversal")));
                }
            } finally {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(window::dispose);
            }
        } finally {
            System.clearProperty("classrevive.home");
        }
    }

    private static <T> T onEdt(Callable<T> call) throws Exception {
        var result = new CompletableFuture<T>();
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { try { result.complete(call.call()); } catch (Exception e) { result.completeExceptionally(e); } });
        return result.get();
    }

    private interface Check { boolean ok() throws Exception; }

    private static void waitFor(Check check) throws Exception {
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(300);
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) { if (check.ok()) return; Thread.sleep(100); }
        fail("condition not reached in time");
    }
}
```
