`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/UsagesLogicTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassText;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex.Ref;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.UnaryOperator;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.BeforeAll;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * Phase G6: resolving the name under the caret and finding a usage site in text, without a window. The authored source
 * stands in for decompiled text; the bytecode text is ASM's, as the editor shows it.
 */
class UsagesLogicTest {
    @TempDir static Path directory;
    static ReferenceIndex index;
    static Map<String,byte[]> classes = new HashMap<>();

    static final String SHOP = """
        package demo;
        import java.util.function.Supplier;
        public class Shop {
            private int stock;
            public Shop(int stock) { this.stock = stock; }
            public int stock() { return stock; }
            public void add(int n) { stock += n; }
            public void add(int n, int times) { for (int i = 0; i < times; i++) add(n); }
            public Supplier<Shop> copy() {
                return () -> new Shop(stock());
            }
            public static Shop open() {
                // add(9) in a comment is no call
                Shop shop = new Shop(1);
                shop.add(2);
                shop.add(3, 4);
                return shop;
            }
        }
        """;
    static final String OTHER = "package demo; public class Other { int add(int x) { return x; } }";

    @BeforeAll static void compile() throws Exception {
        var sources = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src/demo"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("Shop.java"), SHOP);
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("Other.java"), OTHER);
        var out = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("classes"));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "17", "-proc:none", "-d", out.toString(),
            sources.resolve("Shop.java").toString(), sources.resolve("Other.java").toString()));
        var jar = directory.resolve("shop.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var walk = Files.walk(out)) {
            for (Path file : walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList()) {
                String name = out.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                classes.put(name, Files.readAllBytes(file));
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name));
                zip.write(classes.get(name));
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        index = ReferenceIndex.ofJar(jar, ReferenceIndex.Limits.defaults(), () -> false);
    }

    private static final UnaryOperator<String> CLASSES = simple -> switch (simple) { case "Shop" -> "demo/Shop"; case "Other" -> "demo/Other"; default -> null; };

    private static List<Ref> at(String marker, int delta) {
        int offset = SHOP.indexOf(marker);
        assertTrue(offset >= 0, marker);
        var query = MemberAtCaret.at(SHOP, offset + delta);
        return MemberAtCaret.candidates(query, index, "demo/Shop", List.of("demo/Shop"), CLASSES);
    }

    @Test void resolvesTheNameUnderTheCaretWithoutGuessing() {
        // shop.add(2): the receiver is a variable, so every add with one argument in the input is a candidate.
        assertEquals(Set.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(I)V"), new Ref("demo/Other", "add", "(I)I")), Set.copyOf(at("shop.add(2)", 6)));
        // add(n) without a qualifier: this file's class, narrowed to the one-argument overload.
        assertEquals(List.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(I)V")), at("add(n); }", 1));
        // The declaration of the two-argument overload.
        assertEquals(List.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(II)V")), at("add(int n, int times)", 1));
        // new Shop(1): the constructor with one argument; Shop alone: the class.
        assertEquals(List.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "<init>", "(I)V")), at("new Shop(1)", 5));
        assertEquals(List.of(Ref.ofClass("demo/Shop")), at("Shop shop", 1));
        // this.stock: the field; stock(): the method.
        assertEquals(List.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "stock", "I")), at("this.stock", 6));
        assertEquals(List.of(new Ref("demo/Shop", "stock", "()I")), at("stock());", 1));
        // A JDK class, a keyword, a comment: nothing.
        assertEquals(List.of(), at("Supplier<Shop> copy", 2));
        assertNull(MemberAtCaret.at(SHOP, SHOP.indexOf("return shop") + 2));
        assertNull(MemberAtCaret.at(SHOP, SHOP.indexOf("add(9)") + 1));
    }

    @Test void bytecodeLinesNameTheirTargetExactly() {
        UnaryOperator<String> same = UnaryOperator.identity();
        assertEquals(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(I)V"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("    INVOKEVIRTUAL demo/Shop.add (I)V", "demo/Shop", same));
        assertEquals(new Ref("demo/Shop", "stock", "I"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("    GETFIELD demo/Shop.stock : I", "demo/Shop", same));
        assertEquals(Ref.ofClass("demo/Shop"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("    NEW demo/Shop", "demo/Shop", same));
        assertEquals(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(II)V"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("  public add(II)V", "demo/Shop", same));
        assertEquals(new Ref("demo/Shop", "stock", "I"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("  private I stock", "demo/Shop", same));
        assertEquals(new Ref("p/New", "m", "(Lp/New;)V"), MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("    INVOKESTATIC p/Old.m (Lp/Old;)V", "p/Old", name -> name.replace("Old", "New")));
        assertNull(MemberAtCaret.inBytecode("    ILOAD 1", "demo/Shop", same));
    }

    private static int lineOf(String text, String marker) {
        int offset = text.indexOf(marker);
        assertTrue(offset >= 0, marker);
        return (int) text.substring(0, offset).chars().filter(c -> c == '\n').count() + 1;
    }

    @Test void findsSitesInSourceAndBytecode() throws Exception {
        var calls = index.usages(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(I)V"));
        assertEquals(2, calls.size());
        var inOpen = calls.stream().filter(usage -> usage.site().from().name().equals("open")).findFirst().orElseThrow().site();
        var inOverload = calls.stream().filter(usage -> usage.site().from().name().equals("add")).findFirst().orElseThrow().site();
        assertEquals(lineOf(SHOP, "shop.add(2)"), UsageLocator.source(SHOP, inOpen, index), "the comment's add(9) is skipped");
        assertEquals(lineOf(SHOP, "add(int n, int times)"), UsageLocator.source(SHOP, inOverload, index));
        assertEquals(inOpen.line(), lineOf(SHOP, "shop.add(2)"), "javac's LineNumberTable matches the authored source");

        // The constructor called inside a lambda: found inside the method that wrote the lambda.
        var created = index.usages(new Ref("demo/Shop", "<init>", "(I)V"));
        var inLambda = created.stream().filter(usage -> usage.site().from().name().startsWith("lambda$copy$")).findFirst().orElseThrow().site();
        assertEquals(ReferenceIndex.Kind.CALL, inLambda.kind());
        assertEquals(lineOf(SHOP, "() -> new Shop(stock())"), UsageLocator.source(SHOP, inLambda, index));
        Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
        assertEquals("lambda in copy", UsagesPanel.member(inLambda.from(), UnaryOperator.identity()));

        // ASM's text: the instruction inside the right method.
        String text = ClassText.disassemble(classes.get("demo/Shop.class"), 1_000_000);
        int line = UsageLocator.bytecode(text, inOpen, UnaryOperator.identity());
        assertTrue(text.split("\n")[line - 1].contains("INVOKEVIRTUAL demo/Shop.add (I)V"), text.split("\n")[line - 1]);
        int header = UsageLocator.bytecode(text, new ReferenceIndex.Site(new Ref("demo/Shop", "open", "()Ldemo/Shop;"), ReferenceIndex.Kind.CALL,
            new Ref("x/Missing", "m", "()V"), -1, 0), UnaryOperator.identity());
        assertTrue(text.split("\n")[header - 1].endsWith("open()Ldemo/Shop;"), "not found: the method's header");
    }

    @Test void labelsReadLikeJava() {
        Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
        UnaryOperator<String> same = UnaryOperator.identity();
        assertEquals("Shop.add(int, int)", UsagesPanel.describe(new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(II)V"), same));
        assertEquals("Shop.Shop(int)", UsagesPanel.describe(new Ref("demo/Shop", "<init>", "(I)V"), same));
        assertEquals("demo.Shop", UsagesPanel.describe(Ref.ofClass("demo/Shop"), same));
        var usage = new ReferenceIndex.Usage(new ReferenceIndex.Site(new Ref("demo/Shop", "open", "()Ldemo/Shop;"), ReferenceIndex.Kind.CALL,
            new Ref("demo/Shop", "add", "(I)V"), 14, 0), new Ref("demo/Base", "add", "(I)V"));
        assertEquals("call · Shop.add(int) (through Base.add(int)) · line 14", UsagesPanel.site(usage, same));
        for (var kind : ReferenceIndex.Kind.values()) {
            Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.PORTUGUESE);
            assertNotEquals("usages.kind." + kind.name(), Text.t("usages.kind." + kind.name()));
            Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
            assertNotEquals("usages.kind." + kind.name(), Text.t("usages.kind." + kind.name()));
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/gui/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/gui/UsagesWindowTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ReferenceIndex.Ref;
import java.awt.GraphicsEnvironment;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import javax.swing.SwingUtilities;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.assumeFalse;

/** Phase G6: find usages and the call hierarchy in the real window, before and after a decompile. Skipped without a display. */
class UsagesWindowTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void findsUsagesInBytecodeAndSourceAndShowsCallers() throws Exception {
        assumeFalse(GraphicsEnvironment.isHeadless(), "needs a display");
        System.setProperty("classrevive.home", directory.resolve("home").toString());
        try {
            var settings = GuiSettings.load();
            settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
            settings.customEngines("cfr");
            settings.engineCache(false);
            Text.use(GuiSettings.Language.ENGLISH);
            Path jar = Fixtures.jar(directory);
            var window = onEdt(() -> { Theme.install(GuiSettings.ThemeChoice.LIGHT); return new MainWindow(settings); });
            var offered = new ArrayList<List<Ref>>();
            window.chooser = (parent, message, options, names) -> {
                offered.add(options);
                return options.stream().filter(ref -> ref.owner().equals("demo/shapes/Shape") || ref.name().equals("<init>")).findFirst();
            };
            try {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openPath(jar));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.workspace() != null));

                // Before any decompile: the bytecode view, where the instruction names its target exactly.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/Main").orElseThrow()));
                var main = onEdt(() -> (CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent());
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> main.content().contains("INVOKEINTERFACE demo/shapes/Shape.area")));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> main.caret(main.content().indexOf("INVOKEINTERFACE demo/shapes/Shape.area")));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.findUsages.actionPerformed(null));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.usages().titleText().equals("1 usages of Shape.area()")));
                assertTrue(offered.isEmpty(), "an instruction is never ambiguous");
                var site = onEdt(() -> firstSite(window));
                assertEquals("demo/Main", site.className());
                assertEquals("describe", site.from().name());
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openSite(site));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> main.caretLine().contains("INVOKEINTERFACE demo/shapes/Shape.area")));

                // After a decompile: the selected source, where the receiver's type is unknown, so the user chooses.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.decompile.actionPerformed(null));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !window.running()));
                assertTrue(window.workspace().decompiled());
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/Main").orElseThrow()));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> main.content().contains("public class Main")));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> main.caret(main.content().indexOf("area()") + 1));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.findUsages.actionPerformed(null));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> !offered.isEmpty() && window.usages().titleText().equals("1 usages of Shape.area()")));
                assertEquals(Set.of(new Ref("demo/shapes/Shape", "area", "()D"), new Ref("demo/shapes/Circle", "area", "()D")), Set.copyOf(offered.getFirst()));
                var inSource = onEdt(() -> firstSite(window));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openSite(inSource));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> main.caretLine().contains("area()")));

                // Call hierarchy of Circle's constructor, from its declaration: Builder.build calls it.
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.openClass(window.workspace().classItem("demo/shapes/Circle").orElseThrow()));
                var circle = onEdt(() -> (CodeTab) window.tabs().getSelectedComponent());
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> circle.content().contains("public Circle(double")));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> circle.caret(circle.content().indexOf("public Circle(double") + 8));
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> window.callHierarchy.actionPerformed(null));
                waitFor(() -> onEdt(() -> window.usages().titleText().equals("Callers of Circle.Circle(double)")));
                var callers = onEdt(() -> {
                    var root = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) window.usages().tree().getModel().getRoot();
                    var top = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) root.getChildAt(0);
                    var names = new ArrayList<String>();
                    for (int i = 0; i < top.getChildCount(); i++)
                        names.add(((UsagesPanel.CallerNode) ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) top.getChildAt(i)).getUserObject()).node().method().toString());
                    return names;
                });
                assertEquals(List.of("demo/shapes/Circle$Builder.build()Ldemo/shapes/Circle;"), callers);
            } finally {
                SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(window::dispose);
            }
        } finally {
            System.clearProperty("classrevive.home");
        }
    }

    private static ReferenceIndex.Site firstSite(MainWindow window) {
        var root = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) window.usages().tree().getModel().getRoot();
        for (var nodes = root.depthFirstEnumeration(); nodes.hasMoreElements(); )
            if (((DefaultMutableTreeNode) nodes.nextElement()).getUserObject() instanceof UsagesPanel.SiteNode site) return site.usage().site();
        throw new AssertionError("no site");
    }

    private static <T> T onEdt(Callable<T> call) throws Exception {
        var result = new CompletableFuture<T>();
        SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(() -> { try { result.complete(call.call()); } catch (Exception e) { result.completeExceptionally(e); } });
        return result.get();
    }

    private interface Check { boolean ok() throws Exception; }

    private static void waitFor(Check check) throws Exception {
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(120);
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) { if (check.ok()) return; Thread.sleep(100); }
        fail("condition not reached in time");
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.gui;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import dev.classrevive.workbench.ResultIndex;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import javax.swing.tree.DefaultMutableTreeNode;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class WorkspaceTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void opensAJarIntoClassesAndResourcesWithoutDecompiling() throws Exception {
        var workspace = Workspace.openInput(Fixtures.jar(directory), directory.resolve("cache"));
        assertFalse(workspace.decompiled());
        assertEquals(List.of("demo/Main", "demo/shapes/Circle", "demo/shapes/Circle$Builder", "demo/shapes/Color", "demo/shapes/Shape"),
            workspace.classes().stream().map(Workspace.ClassItem::name).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("assets/logo.bin", "config/app.properties"), workspace.resources().stream().map(Workspace.ResourceItem::entry).toList());
        assertEquals('I', ExplorerPanel.kind(workspace.classItem("demo/shapes/Shape").orElseThrow()));
        assertEquals('E', ExplorerPanel.kind(workspace.classItem("demo/shapes/Color").orElseThrow()));
        assertEquals('C', ExplorerPanel.kind(workspace.classItem("demo/Main").orElseThrow()));

        assertTrue(bytecode.contains("describe"), bytecode);
        assertEquals("name=demo\nversion=1\n", new String(workspace.entryBytes("config/app.properties")));
    }

    @Test void buildsATreeWithNestedClassesUnderTheirOuterClassAndFilters() throws Exception {
        var workspace = Workspace.openInput(Fixtures.jar(directory), directory.resolve("cache"));
        var root = ExplorerPanel.build(workspace, "");
        assertEquals(2, root.getChildCount(), "classes and resources groups");
        var classes = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) root.getChildAt(0);
        assertEquals(List.of("demo", "demo.shapes"), children(classes).stream().map(n -> ((ExplorerPanel.Package) n.getUserObject()).name()).toList());
        var shapes = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) classes.getChildAt(1);
        var circle = children(shapes).stream().filter(n -> ((ExplorerPanel.ClassNode) n.getUserObject()).item().simpleName().equals("Circle")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals("demo/shapes/Circle$Builder", ((ExplorerPanel.ClassNode) ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) circle.getChildAt(0)).getUserObject()).item().name());
        assertEquals(3, shapes.getChildCount(), "Builder is under Circle, not beside it");

        var filtered = ExplorerPanel.build(workspace, "build");
        assertEquals(1, filtered.getChildCount(), "no resource matches");
        var only = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) filtered.getChildAt(0)).getChildAt(0);
        assertEquals("demo/shapes/Circle$Builder", ((ExplorerPanel.ClassNode) ((DefaultMutableTreeNode) only.getChildAt(0)).getUserObject()).item().name());
        var resourceOnly = ExplorerPanel.build(workspace, "app.prop");
        assertEquals(0, resourceOnly.getChildAt(0).getChildCount(), "no class matches");
        assertEquals(1, resourceOnly.getChildAt(1).getChildCount(), "one resource matches");
    }

    @Test void ranksGoToClassMatchesByPrefixFirst() throws Exception {
        var workspace = Workspace.openInput(Fixtures.jar(directory), directory.resolve("cache"));
        assertEquals(List.of("demo/shapes/Circle", "demo/shapes/Color", "demo/shapes/Circle$Builder"),
            GoToClassDialog.rank(workspace.classes(), "c").stream().map(Workspace.ClassItem::name).toList());
        assertEquals("demo/shapes/Shape", GoToClassDialog.rank(workspace.classes(), "shapes.sh").getFirst().name());
        assertTrue(GoToClassDialog.rank(workspace.classes(), "zzz").isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void decompilesAndReopensTheResultWithEvidenceByTheInputsNames() throws Exception {
        Path home = directory.resolve("home");
        System.setProperty("classrevive.home", home.toString());
        try {
            var settings = GuiSettings.load();
            settings.profile(GuiSettings.Profile.CUSTOM);
            settings.customEngines("cfr");
            settings.engineCache(false);
            var workspace = Workspace.openInput(Fixtures.jar(directory), settings.cacheDirectory());
            var request = workspace.request(settings, List.of());
            assertTrue(request.output().startsWith(home.resolve("workspaces")));
            assertEquals(List.of("cfr"), request.engines().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
            var stages = new ArrayList<JobListener.Stage>();
            var index = workspace.decompile(request, new JobListener() { @Override public void stage(Stage stage) { stages.add(stage); } });
            assertTrue(workspace.decompiled());
            assertEquals(JobListener.Stage.INTAKE, stages.getFirst());
            assertEquals("COMPILED", index.summary().compilation());
            var builder = workspace.evidence("demo/shapes/Circle$Builder").orElseThrow();
            assertEquals(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT, builder.level());

            var reopened = Workspace.openResult(index.output());
            assertTrue(reopened.decompiled());
            assertEquals(workspace.classes().size(), reopened.classes().size());
            assertEquals(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT, reopened.evidence("demo/Main").orElseThrow().level());
            assertNotEquals(request.output(), workspace.request(settings, List.of()).output(), "every decompile gets a new folder");
        } finally {
            System.clearProperty("classrevive.home");
        }
    }

    @Test void explainsAFileWithoutJava() throws Exception {
        Path text = directory.resolve("notes.txt");
        Files.writeString(text, "just some text, no Java here");
        var refused = assertThrows(Workspace.Unreadable.class, () -> Workspace.openInput(text, directory.resolve("cache")));
        assertTrue(refused.getMessage().contains("notes.txt"), refused.getMessage());
        assertFalse(refused.details().isBlank());
        Path broken = directory.resolve("broken.jar");
        Files.write(broken, new byte[] {'P', 'K', 3, 4, 1, 2});
        assertThrows(Workspace.Unreadable.class, () -> Workspace.openInput(broken, directory.resolve("cache")));
        assertThrows(Workspace.Unreadable.class, () -> Workspace.openInput(directory, directory.resolve("cache")));
    }

    @Test void namesNewOutputFoldersWithoutCollisions() throws Exception {
        Path root = directory.resolve("workspaces");
        Path first = Workspace.newOutput(root, "my app.jar");
        assertTrue(first.getFileName().toString().startsWith("my_app-"), first.toString());
        Files.createDirectories(first);
        Path second = Workspace.newOutput(root, "my app.jar");
        assertNotEquals(first, second);
        assertTrue(Workspace.newOutput(root, ".jar").getFileName().toString().startsWith("input"));
    }

    private static List<DefaultMutableTreeNode> children(DefaultMutableTreeNode node) {
        var list = new ArrayList<DefaultMutableTreeNode>();
        for (int i = 0; i < node.getChildCount(); i++) list.add((DefaultMutableTreeNode) node.getChildAt(i));
        return list;
    }
}
```

`modules/intake/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/intake/InventoryReader.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.intake;

import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.security.*;
import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import static dev.classrevive.model.Diagnostic.Code.*;

public final class InventoryReader {
    public Inventory inspect(Path path, Limits limits) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(path);
        Objects.requireNonNull(limits);
        var entries = new ArrayList<Inventory.Entry>();
        var diagnostics = new ArrayList<Diagnostic>();
        var notices = new ArrayList<Diagnostic>();
        String hash = "";
        long size = 0;
        long[] expanded = {0};
        String input = path.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
        try {
            String name = path.getFileName() == null ? "" : path.getFileName().toString();
            String lower = name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || !(lower.endsWith(".jar") || lower.endsWith(".class"))) {
                diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(INVALID_INPUT, "", "Expected an existing regular .class or .jar file (not a symbolic link)"));
                return new Inventory(input, hash, size, 0, entries, diagnostics);
            }
            size = Files.size(path);
            if (size > limits.maxInputBytes()) throw new LimitExceeded("Input exceeds byte limit");
            hash = hashFile(path, limits.maxInputBytes());
            if (lower.endsWith(".class")) {
                try (var stream = Files.newInputStream(path)) {
                    byte[] bytes = readEntry(stream, limits, expanded);
                    entries.add(entry(name, bytes, diagnostics));
                }
            } else {
                readJar(path, limits, expanded, entries, diagnostics, notices);
            }
            if (!hash.equals(hashFile(path, limits.maxInputBytes()))) {
                entries.clear();
                notices.clear();
                diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(IO_ERROR, "", "Input changed during inspection; results discarded"));
            }
        } catch (LimitExceeded error) {
            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(RESOURCE_LIMIT, "", error.getMessage()));
        } catch (ZipException error) {
            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(INVALID_ARCHIVE, "", "Invalid, truncated or inconsistent ZIP archive"));
        } catch (IOException | SecurityException error) {
            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(IO_ERROR, "", "Cannot read input: " + error.getClass().getSimpleName()));
        }
        entries.sort(Comparator.comparing(Inventory.Entry::name));
        return new Inventory(input, hash, size, expanded[0], entries, diagnostics, notices);
    }

    /**
     * Exact duplicates (after NFC) are rejected. Paths that differ only in letter case are legal in a JAR and a common
     * obfuscator trick against case-insensitive file systems (Phase 2BV): class entries are all kept and reported as a
     * {@code CASE_COLLISION} notice; a resource that collides by case with a kept entry is left out with a
     * {@code CASE_COLLISION_SKIPPED} notice (the first in archive order is kept, but a class always wins over a resource).
     * Directory entries that differ only in case are harmless and are not reported. A resource that declares more than the
     * entry byte limit is left out unread with an {@code OVERSIZED_RESOURCE_SKIPPED} notice; an oversized class still fails.
     */
    private void readJar(Path path, Limits limits, long[] expanded, List<Inventory.Entry> entries,
                         List<Diagnostic> diagnostics, List<Diagnostic> notices) throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(path.toFile())) {
            if (zip.size() > limits.maxEntries()) throw new LimitExceeded("Archive exceeds entry count limit");
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            var caseClasses = new TreeMap<String, List<String>>();
            var caseOther = new HashMap<String, String>();
            var enumeration = zip.entries();
            while (enumeration.hasMoreElements()) {
                var item = enumeration.nextElement();
                String name = item.getName();
                if (!isSafeEntryName(name)) {
                    diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(UNSAFE_ENTRY, name, "Unsafe or non-portable archive path"));
                    continue;
                }
                String exact = Normalizer.normalize(name, Normalizer.Form.NFC);
                if (!seen.add(exact)) {
                    diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(DUPLICATE_ENTRY, name, "Duplicate archive path"));
                    continue;
                }
                if (item.getSize() > limits.maxEntryBytes() && !name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class")) {
                    // Phase 2BV: an oversized resource (a bundled native library, say) is never read or extracted.
                    notices.add(new Diagnostic(OVERSIZED_RESOURCE_SKIPPED, name, "Left out unread: resource declares "
                        + item.getSize() + " bytes, over the " + limits.maxEntryBytes() + "-byte entry limit"));
                    continue;
                }
                String key = exact.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
                boolean isClass = !item.isDirectory() && name.endsWith(".class");
                var classes = caseClasses.get(key);
                String other = caseOther.get(key);
                if (isClass) {
                    if (other != null) {
                        // A class always wins over a resource that only collides with it by case.
                        caseOther.remove(key);
                        entries.removeIf(kept -> kept.name().equals(other));
                        diagnostics.removeIf(found -> found.entry().equals(other));
                        notices.add(new Diagnostic(CASE_COLLISION_SKIPPED, other, "Left out: path collides by case with class entry " + name));
                    }
                    caseClasses.computeIfAbsent(key, ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(name);
                } else if (classes != null || other != null) {
                    if (!(item.isDirectory() && other != null && other.endsWith("/")))
                        notices.add(new Diagnostic(CASE_COLLISION_SKIPPED, name, "Left out: path collides by case with "
                            + (classes != null ? classes.getFirst() : other)));
                    continue;
                } else {
                    caseOther.put(key, name);
                }
                if (item.getSize() > limits.maxEntryBytes()) throw new LimitExceeded("Expanded entry exceeds byte limit: " + name);
                try (var stream = zip.getInputStream(item)) {
                    byte[] bytes = readEntry(stream, limits, expanded);
                    var crc = new CRC32(); crc.update(bytes);
                    if (bytes.length != item.getSize() || crc.getValue() != item.getCrc())
                        throw new ZipException("Entry size or CRC mismatch");
                    if (!item.isDirectory()) entries.add(entry(name, bytes, diagnostics));
                }
            }
            for (var group : caseClasses.values()) {
                if (group.size() < 2) continue;
                var sorted = new ArrayList<>(group); Collections.sort(sorted);
                notices.add(new Diagnostic(CASE_COLLISION, sorted.getFirst(),
                    "Class entries differ only in letter case: " + String.join(", ", sorted)));
            }
        }
    }

    private Inventory.Entry entry(String name, byte[] bytes, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics) {
        ClassInfo info = null;
        if (name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class")) {
            try {
                info = new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes);
            } catch (ClassInspector.UnsupportedClassVersion error) {
                diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(UNSUPPORTED_CLASS_VERSION, name, error.getMessage()));
            } catch (IllegalArgumentException error) {
                diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(INVALID_CLASS, name, error.getMessage()));
            }
        }
        return new Inventory.Entry(name, bytes.length, HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest().digest(bytes)), info);
    }

    private static byte[] readEntry(InputStream input, Limits limits, long[] expanded) throws IOException {
        var output = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int count;
        while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
            if ((long) output.size() + count > limits.maxEntryBytes()
                    || expanded[0] + count > limits.maxExpandedBytes())
                throw new LimitExceeded("Expanded data exceeds configured byte limit");
            expanded[0] += count;
            output.write(buffer, 0, count);
        }
        return output.toByteArray();
    }

    public static boolean isSafeEntryName(String name) {
        if (name.isEmpty() || name.length() > 4096 || name.startsWith("/") || name.contains("\\")) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < name.length(); i++) {
            char c = name.charAt(i);
            if (Character.isISOControl(c) || Character.getType(c) == Character.FORMAT || ":*?\"<>|".indexOf(c) >= 0) return false;
        }
        String clean = name.endsWith("/") ? name.substring(0, name.length() - 1) : name;
        for (String part : clean.split("/", -1)) {
            if (part.isEmpty() || part.equals(".") || part.equals("..") || part.endsWith(".") || part.endsWith(" ")) return false;
            String base = part.split("\\.", 2)[0].toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
            if (base.matches("CON|PRN|AUX|NUL|COM[1-9]|LPT[1-9]")) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static String hashFile(Path path, long limit) throws IOException {
        var digest = digest();
        try (var input = Files.newInputStream(path)) {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8192]; long total = 0; int count;
            while ((count = input.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                total += count;
                if (total > limit) throw new LimitExceeded("Input exceeds byte limit");
                digest.update(buffer, 0, count);
            }
        }
        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest());
    }

    private static MessageDigest digest() {
        try { return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); }
        catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new AssertionError(impossible); }
    }

    private static final class LimitExceeded extends IOException {
        LimitExceeded(String message) { super(message); }
    }
}
```

`modules/intake/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/intake/MultiRelease.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.intake;

import dev.classrevive.model.Inventory;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Policy for class entries under {@code META-INF/versions/N/} (multi-release JARs, JAR File Specification).
 * A variant is accepted only when N is a decimal release of at least 9 without leading zeros and the rest of the
 * path is exactly the class's internal name plus {@code .class}. Every other path/identity mismatch stays an error.
 * Accepted variants are not decompiled or put on a compiler classpath; callers report them instead.
 */
public final class MultiRelease {
    private static final String PREFIX = "META-INF/versions/";
    private static final Pattern VERSIONED = Pattern.compile("META-INF/versions/([1-9][0-9]{0,3})/(.+)");
    private MultiRelease() {}

    /** A class entry that is a valid versioned variant; {@code hasBase} says whether the base JAR has the same class. */
    public record Variant(String entry, int release, String className, boolean hasBase) {}

    public static boolean versioned(String entryName) { return entryName.startsWith(PREFIX); }

    /** The variant for this class entry, or {@code null} when it is not a valid versioned variant. */
    public static Variant variant(Inventory.Entry entry, Set<String> baseClasses) {
        if (entry.classInfo() == null) return null;
        var matcher = VERSIONED.matcher(entry.name());
        if (!matcher.matches()) return null;
        int release = Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1));
        String className = entry.classInfo().name();
        if (release < 9 || !matcher.group(2).equals(className + ".class")) return null;
        return new Variant(entry.name(), release, className, baseClasses.contains(className));
    }

    /** All valid variants among the inventory's class entries, in entry order. Invalid ones are not listed. */
    public static List<Variant> variants(Inventory inventory) {
        var base = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var entry : inventory.entries())
            if (entry.classInfo() != null && entry.name().equals(entry.classInfo().name() + ".class")) base.add(entry.classInfo().name());
        var result = new ArrayList<Variant>();
        for (var entry : inventory.entries()) {
            var variant = variant(entry, base);
            if (variant != null) result.add(variant);
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.intake;

import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class MultiReleaseTest {
    static Inventory.Entry entry(String path, String className) {
        var info = className == null ? null : new ClassInfo(className, "java/lang/Object", 53, 0, 1, List.of(), List.of(), List.of());
        return new Inventory.Entry(path, 1, "00", info);
    }
    static Inventory inventory(Inventory.Entry... entries) { return new Inventory("in.jar", "00", 1, 1, List.of(entries), List.of()); }

    @Test void acceptsOnlyVariantsWhosePathMatchesTheirIdentity() {
        var base = Set.of("p/A");
        var variant = MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class", "p/A"), base);
        assertEquals(new MultiRelease.Variant("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class", 9, "p/A", true), variant);
        var module = MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/11/module-info.class", "module-info"), base);
        assertEquals(11, module.release()); assertFalse(module.hasBase());
        // A path that does not name the class it holds is not a variant; decompile keeps rejecting it.
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/9/p/B.class", "p/A"), base));
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/9/q/p/A.class", "p/A"), base));
        // The JAR specification starts versioned directories at 9; leading zeros and non-numbers are not versions.
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/8/p/A.class", "p/A"), base));
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/09/p/A.class", "p/A"), base));
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/x/p/A.class", "p/A"), base));
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.txt", null), base));
        assertNull(MultiRelease.variant(entry("p/A.class", "p/A"), base));
    }
    @Test void listsVariantsAndWhetherTheBaseHasTheClass() {
        var result = MultiRelease.variants(inventory(entry("META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class", "module-info"),
            entry("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class", "p/A"), entry("META-INF/versions/9/p/C.class", "p/Wrong"),
            entry("p/A.class", "p/A"), entry("readme.txt", null)));
        assertEquals(List.of(new MultiRelease.Variant("META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class", 9, "module-info", false),
            new MultiRelease.Variant("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class", 9, "p/A", true)), result);
        assertTrue(MultiRelease.versioned("META-INF/versions/9/p/C.class"));
        assertFalse(MultiRelease.versioned("p/A.class"));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.model;

public record Diagnostic(Code code, String entry, String message) {
    public enum Code {
        INVALID_INPUT, IO_ERROR, INVALID_ARCHIVE, UNSAFE_ENTRY, DUPLICATE_ENTRY,
        RESOURCE_LIMIT, INVALID_CLASS, UNSUPPORTED_CLASS_VERSION,
        /** Informational (Phase 2BV): class entries whose paths differ only in letter case; all are kept. */
        CASE_COLLISION,
        /** Informational (Phase 2BV): a resource or directory whose path collides by case with a kept entry; it is left out. */
        CASE_COLLISION_SKIPPED,
        /** Informational (Phase 2BV): a resource that declares more than the entry byte limit; it is left out unread. */
        OVERSIZED_RESOURCE_SKIPPED
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.model;

import java.util.List;

/**
 * {@code diagnostics} reject the input; {@code notices} are informational (Phase 2BV: class entries that differ only in
 * letter case, resources dropped because their path collides by case with an entry already kept, and resources left
 * out unread because they declare more than the entry byte limit).
 */
public record Inventory(String input, String sha256, long inputBytes, long expandedBytes,
                        List<Entry> entries, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics, List<Diagnostic> notices) {
    public Inventory {
        entries = List.copyOf(entries);
        diagnostics = List.copyOf(diagnostics);
        notices = List.copyOf(notices);
    }
    public Inventory(String input, String sha256, long inputBytes, long expandedBytes, List<Entry> entries, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics) {
        this(input, sha256, inputBytes, expandedBytes, entries, diagnostics, List.of());
    }
    public boolean successful() { return diagnostics.isEmpty(); }
    public record Entry(String name, long size, String sha256, ClassInfo classInfo) {}
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.model;

public record Limits(long maxInputBytes, int maxEntryBytes, long maxExpandedBytes, int maxEntries) {
    public Limits {
        if (maxInputBytes <= 0 || maxEntryBytes <= 0 || maxExpandedBytes <= 0 || maxEntries <= 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All limits must be positive");
    }
    public static Limits defaults() {
        return new Limits(256L * 1024 * 1024, 16 * 1024 * 1024, 512L * 1024 * 1024, 20_000);
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/AndroidPackage.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CY: what an APK says about itself, read statically. Its binary {@code AndroidManifest.xml} (Android's compiled XML:
 * a string pool, a resource-id map and element chunks) is decoded to text and summarized: package, versions, SDK levels,
 * permissions, components and the launcher activity. Native libraries ({@code lib/<abi>/*.so}) are listed and triaged with
 * 2CC's header reader: format, JNI exports, {@code JNI_OnLoad}, packing hints. Nothing is run, loaded or written back; every
 * read is bounded, and a malformed chunk ends decoding with a problem noted instead of an exception.
 */
final class AndroidPackage {
    private AndroidPackage() {}

    static final int MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024, MAX_TRIAGED = 32, MAX_LISTED = 1000;
    static final long MAX_LIBRARY_TOTAL = 256L * 1024 * 1024;

    record Manifest(String packageName, String versionCode, String versionName, Integer minSdk, Integer targetSdk,
                    List<String> permissions, SortedMap<String, List<String>> components, String launcher, boolean debuggable,
                    String xml, List<String> problems) {}

    /** {@code format} is null for a library that was listed but not read (over the size or count limits). */
    record NativeLibrary(String entry, String abi, long size, String format, int jniExports, boolean jniOnLoad, List<String> packingHints) {}

    record Contents(Manifest manifest, List<NativeLibrary> libraries) {}

    /** Reads the APK archive's manifest and native libraries. */
    static Contents read(byte[] archive) {
        Manifest manifest = null;
        var libraries = new ArrayList<NativeLibrary>();
        long read = 0;
        try (var zip = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(archive))) {
            for (ZipEntry entry; (entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null; ) {
                String name = entry.getName();
                if (name.equals("AndroidManifest.xml") && manifest == null) {
                    byte[] bytes = zip.readNBytes(MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES + 1);
                    manifest = bytes.length > MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES ? empty("manifest over " + MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES + " bytes: not decoded")
                        : decode(bytes);
                } else if (name.startsWith("lib/") && name.endsWith(".so") && name.chars().filter(c -> c == '/').count() == 2
                        && libraries.size() < MAX_LISTED) {
                    String abi = name.substring(4, name.indexOf('/', 4));
                    if (libraries.size() < MAX_TRIAGED && read < MAX_LIBRARY_TOTAL) {
                        byte[] bytes = zip.readNBytes(MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES + 1);
                        if (bytes.length <= MAX_LIBRARY_BYTES) {
                            read += bytes.length;
                            libraries.add(triage(name, abi, bytes));
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                    long size = entry.getSize() >= 0 ? entry.getSize() : zip.transferTo(OutputStream.nullOutputStream());
                    libraries.add(new NativeLibrary(name, abi, size, null, 0, false, List.of()));
                }
            }
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) {
            if (manifest == null) manifest = empty("archive not fully readable: " + unreadable.getClass().getSimpleName());
        }
        return new Contents(manifest, libraries);
    }

    private static NativeLibrary triage(String name, String abi, byte[] bytes) {
        var headers = NativeBinary.parse(bytes);
        if (!headers.known()) return new NativeLibrary(name, abi, bytes.length, "unknown", 0, false, List.of());
        int jni = (int) headers.exports().stream().filter(symbol -> symbol.startsWith("Java_")).count();
        boolean onLoad = headers.exports().contains("JNI_OnLoad");
        var packing = NativeBinary.packing(headers);
        return new NativeLibrary(name, abi, bytes.length, headers.format() + " " + headers.machine(), jni, onLoad,
            packing.packed() ? packing.hints() : List.of());
    }

    private static Manifest empty(String problem) {
        return new Manifest(null, null, null, null, null, List.of(), new TreeMap<>(), null, false, "", List.of(problem));
    }

    // ---- binary XML ----

    static final int XML = 0x0003, STRING_POOL = 0x0001, RESOURCE_MAP = 0x0180;
    static final int START_NAMESPACE = 0x0100, END_NAMESPACE = 0x0101, START_ELEMENT = 0x0102, END_ELEMENT = 0x0103, CDATA = 0x0104;
    static final String ANDROID = "http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android";
    /** Attribute resource ids, for manifests whose attribute names were stripped (R8, obfuscators). */
    static final Map<Integer, String> ATTRIBUTES = Map.ofEntries(
        Map.entry(0x01010003, "name"), Map.entry(0x0101021b, "versionCode"), Map.entry(0x0101021c, "versionName"),
        Map.entry(0x0101020c, "minSdkVersion"), Map.entry(0x01010270, "targetSdkVersion"), Map.entry(0x0101000f, "debuggable"),
        Map.entry(0x01010010, "exported"), Map.entry(0x01010001, "label"), Map.entry(0x01010002, "icon"));
    static final int MAX_ELEMENTS = 100_000, MAX_DEPTH = 64;

    /** Decodes compiled XML; whatever was decoded before a malformed chunk is kept, with the problem noted. */
    static Manifest decode(byte[] b) {
        var problems = new ArrayList<String>();
        var xml = new StringBuilder();
        String packageName = null, versionCode = null, versionName = null;
        Integer minSdk = null, targetSdk = null;
        boolean debuggable = false;
        var permissions = new TreeSet<String>();
        var components = new TreeMap<String, List<String>>();
        String launcher = null;
        try {
            if (b.length < 8 || u16(b, 0) != XML) return empty("not Android binary XML (first chunk type " + (b.length < 2 ? "none" : u16(b, 0)) + ")");
            int end = (int) Math.min(b.length, u32(b, 4));
            int at = u16(b, 2);
            List<String> strings = List.of();
            int[] resourceIds = new int[0];
            var path = new ArrayDeque<String>();
            var namespaces = new LinkedHashMap<String, String>();
            String component = null, componentTag = null;
            boolean main = false, launcherCategory = false;
            int elements = 0;
            while (at + 8 <= end) {
                int type = u16(b, at), headerSize = u16(b, at + 2);
                long size = u32(b, at + 4);
                if (size < 8 || at + size > end || headerSize > size) { problems.add("chunk at " + at + " has a bad size"); break; }
                int chunkEnd = (int) (at + size);
                switch (type) {
                    case STRING_POOL -> strings = strings(b, at, chunkEnd);
                    case RESOURCE_MAP -> {
                        resourceIds = new int[(chunkEnd - at - headerSize) / 4];
                        for (int i = 0; i < resourceIds.length; i++) resourceIds[i] = (int) u32(b, at + headerSize + 4 * i);
                    }
                    case START_NAMESPACE -> namespaces.put(string(strings, (int) u32(b, at + 20)), string(strings, (int) u32(b, at + 16)));
                    case START_ELEMENT -> {
                        if (++elements > MAX_ELEMENTS || path.size() >= MAX_DEPTH) { problems.add("element limit reached"); at = end; continue; }
                        int ext = at + headerSize;
                        String tag = string(strings, (int) u32(b, ext + 4));
                        int attrStart = u16(b, ext + 8), attrSize = u16(b, ext + 10), count = u16(b, ext + 12);
                        xml.append("  ".repeat(path.size())).append('<').append(tag);
                        if (path.isEmpty()) namespaces.forEach((uri, prefix) -> xml.append(" xmlns:").append(prefix).append("=\"").append(escape(uri)).append('"'));
                        var attributes = new LinkedHashMap<String, String>();
                        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                            int a = ext + attrStart + i * attrSize;
                            if (attrSize < 20 || a + 20 > chunkEnd) { problems.add("attribute outside its element"); break; }
                            String ns = string(strings, (int) u32(b, a)), name = string(strings, (int) u32(b, a + 4));
                            int nameIndex = (int) u32(b, a + 4);
                            if ((name == null || name.isEmpty()) && nameIndex >= 0 && nameIndex < resourceIds.length)
                                name = ATTRIBUTES.getOrDefault(resourceIds[nameIndex], String.format("attr_0x%08x", resourceIds[nameIndex]));
                            String value = value(strings, (int) u32(b, a + 8), b[a + 15] & 0xff, (int) u32(b, a + 16));
                            String prefix = ns == null ? null : namespaces.get(ns);
                            xml.append(' ').append(prefix == null ? "" : prefix + ":").append(name).append("=\"").append(escape(value)).append('"');
                            attributes.put(name, value);
                        }
                        xml.append(">\n");
                        String name = attributes.get("name");
                        switch (tag == null ? "" : tag) {
                            case "manifest" -> { packageName = attributes.get("package"); versionCode = attributes.get("versionCode"); versionName = attributes.get("versionName"); }
                            case "uses-sdk" -> { minSdk = integer(attributes.get("minSdkVersion")); targetSdk = integer(attributes.get("targetSdkVersion")); }
                            case "uses-permission", "uses-permission-sdk-23" -> { if (name != null) permissions.add(name); }
                            case "application" -> debuggable = "true".equals(attributes.get("debuggable"));
                            case "activity", "activity-alias", "service", "receiver", "provider" -> {
                                component = qualified(packageName, name);
                                componentTag = tag;
                                if (component != null) components.computeIfAbsent(tag, key -> new ArrayList<>()).add(component);
                            }
                            case "intent-filter" -> { main = false; launcherCategory = false; }
                            case "action" -> { if ("android.intent.action.MAIN".equals(name)) main = true; }
                            case "category" -> { if ("android.intent.category.LAUNCHER".equals(name)) launcherCategory = true; }
                            default -> { }
                        }
                        path.push(tag == null ? "" : tag);
                    }
                    case END_ELEMENT -> {
                        String tag = path.isEmpty() ? null : path.pop();
                        xml.append("  ".repeat(path.size())).append("</").append(tag).append(">\n");
                        // The launcher: an activity (or alias) with an intent filter for MAIN and LAUNCHER.
                        if ("intent-filter".equals(tag) && main && launcherCategory && launcher == null && component != null
                                && ("activity".equals(componentTag) || "activity-alias".equals(componentTag))) launcher = component;
                        if (tag != null && tag.equals(componentTag)) { component = null; componentTag = null; }
                    }
                    case END_NAMESPACE, CDATA -> { }
                    default -> { }
                }
                at = chunkEnd;
            }
        } catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException truncated) {
            problems.add("truncated binary XML");
        }
        return new Manifest(packageName, versionCode, versionName, minSdk, targetSdk, List.copyOf(permissions), components, launcher,
            debuggable, xml.toString(), problems);
    }

    private static String qualified(String packageName, String name) {
        if (name == null) return null;
        return name.startsWith(".") && packageName != null ? packageName + name : name.contains(".") || packageName == null ? name : packageName + "." + name;
    }

    private static Integer integer(String value) {
        try { return value == null ? null : Integer.valueOf(value); } catch (NumberFormatException notANumber) { return null; }
    }

    /** A typed attribute value as text: strings, decimal and hex integers, booleans, references, or the raw type. */
    private static String value(List<String> strings, int raw, int type, int data) {
        return switch (type) {
            case 0x03 -> Objects.requireNonNullElse(string(strings, data), "");
            case 0x10 -> Integer.toString(data);
            case 0x11 -> "0x" + Integer.toHexString(data);
            case 0x12 -> data != 0 ? "true" : "false";
            case 0x01 -> String.format("@0x%08x", data);
            case 0x02 -> String.format("?0x%08x", data);
            default -> raw >= 0 && raw < strings.size() ? strings.get(raw) : String.format("(type 0x%02x) 0x%08x", type, data);
        };
    }

    private static List<String> strings(byte[] b, int at, int end) {
        int count = (int) u32(b, at + 8);
        boolean utf8 = (u32(b, at + 16) & 0x100) != 0;
        int start = at + (int) u32(b, at + 20), offsets = at + u16(b, at + 2);
        if (count < 0 || count > 1_000_000 || offsets + 4L * count > end) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("string pool");
        var out = new ArrayList<String>(count);
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int p = start + (int) u32(b, offsets + 4 * i);
            if (p < at || p >= end) { out.add(""); continue; }
            if (utf8) {
                int skip = (b[p] & 0x80) != 0 ? 2 : 1;
                p += skip;
                int length = b[p] & 0xff;
                if ((length & 0x80) != 0) { length = (length & 0x7f) << 8 | b[p + 1] & 0xff; p += 2; } else p += 1;
                if (p + length > end) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("string");
                out.add(new String(b, p, length, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            } else {
                int length = u16(b, p);
                if ((length & 0x8000) != 0) { length = (length & 0x7fff) << 16 | u16(b, p + 2); p += 4; } else p += 2;
                if (p + 2L * length > end) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException("string");
                out.add(new String(b, p, 2 * length, StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE));
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static String string(List<String> strings, int index) { return index >= 0 && index < strings.size() ? strings.get(index) : null; }

    private static String escape(String text) {
        return NativeBinary.clean(text == null ? "" : text).replace("&", "&amp;").replace("\"", "&quot;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;");
    }

    private static int u16(byte[] b, int at) { return (b[at] & 0xff) | (b[at + 1] & 0xff) << 8; }
    private static long u32(byte[] b, int at) { return (b[at] & 0xffL) | (b[at + 1] & 0xffL) << 8 | (b[at + 2] & 0xffL) << 16 | (b[at + 3] & 0xffL) << 24; }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/AndroidSdk.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

/**
 * Phase 2CX: the Android framework classes of a local Android SDK, for javac only. An APK does not contain
 * {@code android.*}; with the SDK's {@code platforms/android-N/android.jar} on the class path the decompiled sources compile
 * against the real API instead of stubs inferred from their uses. The SDK is never downloaded and its jar never run or
 * redistributed: it is looked up in {@code -Dclassrevive.android.sdk}, {@code ANDROID_HOME}, {@code ANDROID_SDK_ROOT} and the
 * default install folders. The platform matching the app's {@code targetSdkVersion} (Phase 2CY, from the decoded manifest)
 * is preferred, then the oldest newer one, then the newest one.
 */
final class AndroidSdk {
    private AndroidSdk() {}

    static final String PROPERTY = "classrevive.android.sdk";
    private static final Pattern PLATFORM = Pattern.compile("android-(\\d+)(?:[.-].*)?");

    /** A platform jar of the SDK, its API level and where the SDK was found, e.g. {@code ANDROID_HOME}. */
    record Platform(Path jar, int apiLevel, String foundBy) {}

    static Optional<Platform> find() { return find(null); }

    /** {@code target}: the app's targetSdkVersion, or null. */
    static Optional<Platform> find(Integer target) {
        var roots = new LinkedHashMap<String, String>();
        put(roots, System.getProperty(PROPERTY), "-D" + PROPERTY);
        put(roots, System.getenv("ANDROID_HOME"), "ANDROID_HOME");
        put(roots, System.getenv("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"), "ANDROID_SDK_ROOT");
        String local = System.getenv("LOCALAPPDATA"), home = System.getProperty("user.home");
        if (local != null) put(roots, Path.of(local, "Android", "Sdk").toString(), "the default SDK folder");
        if (home != null) {
            put(roots, Path.of(home, "Library", "Android", "sdk").toString(), "the default SDK folder");
            put(roots, Path.of(home, "Android", "Sdk").toString(), "the default SDK folder");
        }
        for (var root : roots.entrySet()) {
            var platform = choose(platforms(Path.of(root.getKey()), root.getValue()), target);
            if (platform.isPresent()) return platform;
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    /** The target level if installed, else the oldest newer one, else the newest. */
    static Optional<Platform> choose(List<Platform> installed, Integer target) {
        if (installed.isEmpty()) return Optional.empty();
        if (target != null) {
            var atLeast = installed.stream().filter(p -> p.apiLevel() >= target).min(Comparator.comparingInt(Platform::apiLevel));
            if (atLeast.isPresent()) return atLeast;
        }
        return installed.stream().max(Comparator.comparingInt(Platform::apiLevel));
    }

    static Optional<Platform> newest(Path sdk, String foundBy) { return choose(platforms(sdk, foundBy), null); }

    private static void put(Map<String, String> roots, String path, String by) {
        if (path != null && !path.isBlank()) roots.putIfAbsent(path, by);
    }

    /** Every {@code platforms/android-N} folder of the SDK that holds an android.jar. */
    static List<Platform> platforms(Path sdk, String foundBy) {
        Path platforms = sdk.resolve("platforms");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(platforms)) return List.of();
        var found = new ArrayList<Platform>();
        try (Stream<Path> folders = Files.list(platforms)) {
            for (Path folder : folders.toList()) {
                var matcher = PLATFORM.matcher(folder.getFileName().toString());
                Path jar = folder.resolve("android.jar");
                if (matcher.matches() && Files.isRegularFile(jar, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
                    found.add(new Platform(jar, Integer.parseInt(matcher.group(1)), foundBy));
            }
        } catch (IOException | NumberFormatException unreadable) {
            return List.of();
        }
        return found;
    }

    /** Whether one of the jars already holds the framework (the user passed android.jar with -cp). */
    static boolean supplied(List<Path> dependencies) {
        for (Path jar : dependencies) {
            try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
                if (zip.getEntry("android/app/Activity.class") != null) return true;
            } catch (IOException unreadable) {
                // Not a jar the framework could be in.
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ArchiveGuards.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.Manifest;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

final class ArchiveGuards {
    private ArchiveGuards() {}
    static void rejectSignedOrDigested(Path input) throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(input.toFile())) {
            for (var entry : zip.stream().toList()) {
                String name = entry.getName().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
                if (name.startsWith("META-INF/") && (name.endsWith(".SF") || name.endsWith(".RSA") || name.endsWith(".DSA") || name.endsWith(".EC") || name.startsWith("META-INF/SIG-")))
                    throw new IOException("Signed JAR rewriting is unsupported; original retained");
                if (name.equals("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")) {
                    Manifest manifest;
                    try (var stream = zip.getInputStream(entry)) { manifest = new Manifest(stream); }
                    var attributes = new ArrayList<java.util.jar.Attributes>(manifest.getEntries().values());
                    attributes.add(manifest.getMainAttributes());
                    if (attributes.stream().flatMap(a -> a.keySet().stream()).anyMatch(k -> k.toString().toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("-DIGEST")))
                        throw new IOException("Digest-bearing JAR rewriting is unsupported; original retained");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
