`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/FailureCollector.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import dev.classrevive.selection.SelectionResult;
import dev.classrevive.verification.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import java.util.zip.*;

/**
 * Failure lab capture and grouping (Phase 2AT). Reads what a verified job already measured (per-attempt verification,
 * per-method round trip, javac diagnostics, placeholder markers, worker outcomes) and writes one directory per failure
 * with its classes, plus {@code failures.json} and {@code failures.md} that count cases per stable signature. It runs no
 * engine, compiler or target code itself.
 *
 * <p>Case directories hold target-derived evidence (the failing classes, the candidate source file, javac messages).
 * The two summary files hold only signatures, counts and case ids. Absolute paths are redacted from every excerpt.
 */
public final class FailureCollector {
    static final int MAX_EXCERPT = 2000, MAX_CASES = 10_000;
    private static final Pattern EXCEPTION = Pattern.compile(
        "\\b(?:java|javax|jdk|sun|org\\.benf|org\\.jetbrains|com\\.strobel|jadx|dev\\.classrevive)(?:\\.[A-Za-z_$][\\w$]*)+(?:Exception|Error)\\b");
    private static final Pattern WINDOWS_PATH = Pattern.compile("(?i)\\b[a-z]:[\\\\/][^\\s\"'<>|]*");
    private static final Pattern UNIX_PATH = Pattern.compile("(?<![\\w.$/])/(?:home|Users|tmp|var|private|opt|mnt|root)/[^\\s\"'<>|]*");

    /** A failure found in a job; {@code group} names the classes written to the case (the focus class's source file). */
    record Found(FailureCase data, SortedSet<String> group, Path candidateSource, byte[] recompiled) {}

    private final Path directory;
    private final List<FailureCase> cases = new ArrayList<>();

    /** @param directory new directory for the cases and the two summary files */
    public FailureCollector(Path directory) throws IOException {
        this.directory = Files.createDirectory(directory.toAbsolutePath().normalize());
    }

    private FailureCollector(Path directory, boolean existing) { this.directory = directory; }

    /**
     * Phase 2CH: the collector of an interrupted benchmark, with the cases of its complete rows ({@code keep}) loaded back
     * from their {@code case.json}; every other case directory (from the row that was cut) is moved aside.
     */
    static FailureCollector resume(Path directory, Set<String> keep) throws IOException {
        directory = directory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (!Files.isDirectory(directory, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return new FailureCollector(directory);
        var collector = new FailureCollector(directory, true);
        // Summaries of a run cut between the failure lab and benchmark.json are rewritten at the end.
        for (String summary : List.of("failures.json", "failures.md")) {
            Path written = directory.resolve(summary);
            if (Files.exists(written, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) Files.move(written, directory.resolve("interrupted-" + summary), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        }
        List<Path> children;
        try (var stream = Files.list(directory)) { children = stream.sorted().toList(); }
        for (var child : children) {
            String name = child.getFileName().toString();
            if (!name.matches("failure-\\d{4}") || !Files.isDirectory(child, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) continue;
            if (keep.contains(name) && Files.isRegularFile(child.resolve("case.json"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
                collector.cases.add(FailureCase.fromJson(Json.decode(Files.readString(child.resolve("case.json"), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8))));
            } else {
                for (int n = 1; ; n++) {
                    Path target = directory.resolve("interrupted-" + name + "-" + n);
                    if (!Files.exists(target, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) { Files.move(child, target); break; }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < collector.cases.size(); i++)
            if (!collector.cases.get(i).id().equals(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "failure-%04d", i + 1)))
                throw new IOException("Cannot resume: failure cases of complete rows are not numbered in sequence");
        return collector;
    }

    public Path directory() { return directory; }
    public List<FailureCase> cases() { return List.copyOf(cases); }

    /**
     * Captures the failures of one job and writes their case directories.
     *
     * @param allCandidates also capture the engine candidates that were not selected (a lab run); the benchmark captures
     *                      only the selected candidate of each row, since its single-engine rows already cover each engine
     */
    public List<FailureCase> capture(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, Path jobDirectory, String variant, String sample,
                                     boolean allCandidates) throws IOException {
        jobDirectory = jobDirectory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        var originals = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(jobDirectory.resolve("classes.jar"));
        var written = new ArrayList<FailureCase>();
        for (var found : find(job, jobDirectory, variant, sample, allCandidates)) {
            if (cases.size() >= MAX_CASES) break;
            String id = String.format(Locale.ROOT, "failure-%04d", cases.size() + 1);
            Path caseDirectory = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve(id));
            var data = found.data().withId(id);
            if (!found.group().isEmpty()) {
                var group = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
                found.group().forEach(name -> group.put(name, originals.get(name)));
                writeJar(caseDirectory.resolve("classes.jar"), group);
                if (originals.size() > group.size())
                    data = data.withContext(caseDirectory.relativize(jobDirectory.resolve("classes.jar")).toString().replace('\\', '/'));
            }
            if (found.candidateSource() != null && Files.isRegularFile(found.candidateSource(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)
                && Files.size(found.candidateSource()) <= 1024 * 1024)
                Files.copy(found.candidateSource(), caseDirectory.resolve("candidate.java"));
            if (found.recompiled() != null) Files.write(caseDirectory.resolve("recompiled.class"), found.recompiled(), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            EvidenceReport.write(caseDirectory.resolve("case.json"), data.toJson());
            cases.add(data); written.add(data);
        }
        return List.copyOf(written);
    }

    /** Writes {@code failures.json} and {@code failures.md} and returns the summary (signatures and counts only). */
    public Map<String,Object> finish() throws IOException {
        var summary = summary(cases);
        EvidenceReport.write(directory.resolve("failures.json"), summary);
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("failures.md"), "# ClassRevive failure lab\n\n" + markdown(summary, 50)
            + "\nEach `failure-NNNN/case.json` holds the target-specific evidence; reduce one with `classrevive lab-minimize`.\n",
            StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
        return summary;
    }

    /** Groups cases by signature, most frequent first; ties by signature. */
    static Map<String,Object> summary(List<FailureCase> cases) {
        var bySignature = new TreeMap<String,List<FailureCase>>();
        for (var item : cases) bySignature.computeIfAbsent(item.signature(), ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(item);
        var groups = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        bySignature.entrySet().stream()
            .sorted(Comparator.<Map.Entry<String,List<FailureCase>>>comparingInt(entry -> -entry.getValue().size()).thenComparing(Map.Entry::getKey))
            .forEach(entry -> {
                var first = entry.getValue().getFirst();
                var variants = new TreeMap<String,Long>();
                entry.getValue().forEach(item -> variants.merge(item.variant(), 1L, Long::sum));
                var group = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
                group.put("signature", entry.getKey()); group.put("category", first.category()); group.put("engine", first.engine());
                group.put("detail", first.detail()); group.put("cases", (long) entry.getValue().size());
                group.put("selected", entry.getValue().stream().filter(FailureCase::selected).count());
                group.put("recoverable_by_other_candidate", entry.getValue().stream().filter(item -> !item.recoverableBy().isEmpty()).count());
                group.put("variants", variants);
                group.put("case_ids", entry.getValue().stream().map(FailureCase::id).toList());
                groups.add(group);
            });
        var categories = new TreeMap<String,Long>();
        cases.forEach(item -> categories.merge(item.category(), 1L, Long::sum));
        var summary = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        summary.put("schema_version", 1); summary.put("kind", "failure-lab"); summary.put("tool_version", "0.1.0");
        summary.put("cases", (long) cases.size()); summary.put("signatures", (long) groups.size());
        summary.put("categories", categories); summary.put("groups", groups);
        summary.put("behavior", "NOT_VERIFIED");
        summary.put("note", "Signatures name no target class, member, constant or path; case directories hold the target-derived "
            + "evidence. METHOD_DIFFERENT includes legitimate compiler variation; PLACEHOLDER markers are text heuristics.");
        return summary;
    }

    static String markdown(Map<String,Object> summary, int limit) {
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        out.append("Cases: ").append(summary.get("cases")).append("; signatures: ").append(summary.get("signatures"))
            .append(". \"Selected\" counts cases in the candidate a job chose; \"recoverable\" counts METHOD_DIFFERENT cases where ")
            .append("another engine candidate of the same job got that method identical or equivalent.\n\n")
            .append("| Signature | Cases | Selected | Recoverable | Variants |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---|\n");
        int shown = 0;
        var groups = (List<?>) summary.get("groups");
        for (var value : groups) {
            if (shown++ == limit) { out.append("| ... ").append(groups.size() - limit).append(" more in failures.json | | | | |\n"); break; }
            var group = (Map<?,?>) value;
            var variants = new StringJoiner(", ");
            ((Map<?,?>) group.get("variants")).forEach((variant, count) -> variants.add(variant + " " + count));
            out.append("| `").append(group.get("signature")).append("` | ").append(group.get("cases")).append(" | ")
                .append(group.get("selected")).append(" | ").append(group.get("recoverable_by_other_candidate")).append(" | ")
                .append(variants).append(" |\n");
        }
        return out.toString();
    }

    /** Finds the failures of one job without writing anything; used by capture and by the minimizer's reproduction check. */
    static List<Found> find(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, Path jobDirectory, String variant, String sample, boolean allCandidates) throws IOException {
        jobDirectory = jobDirectory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        var originals = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(jobDirectory.resolve("classes.jar"));
        var versions = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        job.engines().forEach(engine -> versions.put(engine.engine(), engine.version()));
        String input = inputHash(jobDirectory);
        var selection = job.selection();
        var tried = selection.tried();
        var result = new ArrayList<Found>();
        for (int index = 0; index < tried.size(); index++) {
            var attempt = tried.get(index);
            boolean selected = attempt.id().equals(selection.candidate()), engineCandidate = versions.containsKey(attempt.id());
            // An attempt without source files (an engine that wrote nothing) is a worker failure, captured below.
            if (attempt.origins().isEmpty() || !selected && !(allCandidates && engineCandidate)) continue;
            var context = new Context(jobDirectory, originals, versions, variant, sample, input, selected, attempt,
                jobDirectory.resolve("selection/checks/attempt-" + index + "/classes"), sources(jobDirectory, attempt.id(), versions, selected), tried);
            result.addAll(fromAttempt(context));
        }
        if (allCandidates || job.engines().size() == 1)
            for (var engine : job.engines()) if (engine.status() != EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED) result.add(workerFailure(engine, jobDirectory, variant, sample, input));
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    private record Context(Path job, Map<String,byte[]> originals, Map<String,String> versions, String variant, String sample,
                           String input, boolean selected, SelectionResult.Attempt attempt, Path compiled, Path sources,
                           List<SelectionResult.Attempt> tried) {
        String producer(String file) {
            String origin = file == null ? null : attempt.origins().get(file);
            return origin != null ? origin : attempt.id();
        }
        String version(String producer) {
            String engine = producer.endsWith("+repair") ? producer.substring(0, producer.length() - "+repair".length()) : producer;
            return versions.getOrDefault(engine, "");
        }
    }

    private static List<Found> fromAttempt(Context context) throws IOException {
        var result = new ArrayList<Found>();
        var verification = context.attempt().verification();
        switch (verification.status()) {
            case WORKER_FAILED -> result.add(found(context, FailureCase.WORKER_FAILED, "javac", "verification-" + slug(verification.detail()),
                null, null, null, "compiler worker did not complete", "", null, null));
            case COMPILE_FAILED -> {
                for (var file : verification.fileErrors().keySet()) {
                    var diagnostics = verification.diagnostics().stream().filter(item -> item.file().equals(file)).toList();
                    String code = diagnostics.isEmpty() ? "unlocated" : diagnostics.getFirst().code();
                    var excerpt = new StringBuilder();
                    for (var item : diagnostics.subList(0, Math.min(5, diagnostics.size())))
                        excerpt.append(item.line()).append(':').append(item.column()).append(' ').append(item.code()).append(": ").append(item.message()).append('\n');
                    String focus = focusClass(file, context.originals());
                    result.add(found(context, FailureCase.COMPILE_FAILED, context.producer(file), code, focus, null, file,
                        verification.fileErrors().get(file) + " javac error(s) in this file", excerpt.toString(), null, null));
                }
                if (verification.fileErrors().isEmpty())
                    result.add(found(context, FailureCase.COMPILE_FAILED, context.attempt().id(), "unlocated", null, null, null,
                        verification.errors() + " javac error(s) without a source file", "", null, null));
            }
            case COMPILED -> {
                for (var item : verification.roundTrip()) {
                    String file = topLevel(item.className()) + ".java";
                    for (var method : item.methods()) {
                        if (method.outcome() != MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.DIFFERENT) continue;
                        String detail = reasonCode(method.reason()) + (method.difference().isEmpty() ? "" : ":" + method.difference());
                        byte[] recompiled = readCompiled(context.compiled(), item.className());
                        String excerpt = recompiled == null ? "" : MethodRoundTrip.differenceContext(context.originals().get(item.className()),
                            recompiled, method.name(), method.descriptor(), 4);
                        result.add(found(context, FailureCase.METHOD_DIFFERENT, context.producer(file), detail, item.className(),
                            method.name() + method.descriptor(), file, method.reason(), excerpt, alternatives(context, item.className(), method), recompiled));
                    }
                }
            }
            case UNSUPPORTED_RELEASE -> { /* a JDK limit, not an engine failure */ }
        }
        if (context.sources() != null && Files.isDirectory(context.sources(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            for (var path : javaFiles(context.sources())) {
                String file = context.sources().relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                String text = Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                for (var marker : CompilerVerifier.PLACEHOLDER_SIGNALS) {
                    int at = text.indexOf(marker);
                    if (at < 0) continue;
                    int start = Math.max(0, text.lastIndexOf('\n', Math.max(0, at - 200)) + 1), end = text.indexOf('\n', at);
                    String excerpt = text.substring(start, end < 0 ? text.length() : Math.min(end, at + 400));
                    result.add(found(context, FailureCase.PLACEHOLDER, context.producer(file), slug(marker), focusClass(file, context.originals()),
                        null, file, "engine stub or failure marker in the source (text heuristic)", excerpt, null, null));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    private static Found found(Context context, String category, String engine, String detail, String className, String method,
                               String file, String reason, String excerpt, Map<String,String> alternatives, byte[] recompiled) {
        var group = new TreeSet<String>();
        if (className != null) {
            String top = topLevel(className);
            for (var name : context.originals().keySet()) if (topLevel(name).equals(top)) group.add(name);
        }
        String hash = className == null || !context.originals().containsKey(className) ? null : sha256(context.originals().get(className));
        boolean repaired = engine.endsWith("+repair");
        var data = new FailureCase(null, category, engine, detail, context.version(engine), context.variant(), context.sample(),
            context.attempt().id(), context.selected(), repaired, className, hash, method, file, reason,
            redact(excerpt, context.job()), alternatives == null ? Map.of() : alternatives, context.input(), null);
        Path source = file == null || context.sources() == null ? null : context.sources().resolve(file).normalize();
        if (source != null && !source.startsWith(context.sources())) source = null;
        return new Found(data, group, source, recompiled);
    }

    private static Found workerFailure(EngineResult engine, Path job, String variant, String sample, String input) throws IOException {
        Path log = job.resolve(engine.engine()).resolve("engine.log");
        String text = Files.isRegularFile(log, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && Files.size(log) <= 2L * 1024 * 1024
            ? new String(Files.readAllBytes(log), StandardCharsets.UTF_8) : "";
        var matcher = EXCEPTION.matcher(text);
        String detail = engine.diagnosticCode().name() + (matcher.find() ? ":" + matcher.group() : "");
        var lines = text.lines().limit(20).toList();
        var data = new FailureCase(null, FailureCase.WORKER_FAILED, engine.engine(), detail, engine.version(), variant, sample,
            engine.engine(), true, false, null, null, null, null, engine.status() + ": " + engine.message(),
            redact(String.join("\n", lines), job), Map.of(), input, null);
        return new Found(data, new TreeSet<>(), null, null);
    }

    /** Level of the same method in every other engine candidate of the job; candidates that did not compile are NOT_RECOMPILED. */
    private static Map<String,String> alternatives(Context context, String className, MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult method) {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for (var other : context.tried()) {
            if (other == context.attempt() || !context.versions().containsKey(other.id())) continue;
            String level = "NOT_RECOMPILED";
            for (var item : other.verification().roundTrip())
                if (item.className().equals(className))
                    for (var candidate : item.methods())
                        if (candidate.name().equals(method.name()) && candidate.descriptor().equals(method.descriptor())) level = candidate.outcome().name();
            result.put(other.id(), level);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** Engine candidates keep their sources under {@code <engine>/sources}; the selected copy is {@code selection/sources}. */
    private static Path sources(Path job, String id, Map<String,String> versions, boolean selected) {
        if (versions.containsKey(id)) return job.resolve(id).resolve("sources");
        return selected ? job.resolve("selection/sources") : job.resolve("selection").resolve(id);
    }

    private static List<Path> javaFiles(Path root) throws IOException {
        var result = new ArrayList<Path>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(root)) {
            var iterator = paths.iterator(); int visited = 0;
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                Path path = iterator.next();
                if (++visited > 20_001 || Files.isSymbolicLink(path)) throw new IOException("Unsafe source tree");
                if (Files.isRegularFile(path) && path.toString().endsWith(".java") && Files.size(path) <= 16L * 1024 * 1024) result.add(path);
            }
        }
        result.sort(Comparator.comparing(Path::toString));
        return result;
    }

    private static byte[] readCompiled(Path classes, String name) throws IOException {
        Path path = classes.resolve(name + ".class").normalize();
        if (!path.startsWith(classes) || !Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || Files.size(path) > 16L * 1024 * 1024) return null;
        return Files.readAllBytes(path);
    }

    /** The class whose source file this is: its top-level class when present, else the first nested class of that file. */
    static String focusClass(String file, Map<String,byte[]> originals) {
        if (!file.endsWith(".java")) return null;
        String top = file.substring(0, file.length() - ".java".length());
        if (originals.containsKey(top)) return top;
        for (var name : originals.keySet()) if (topLevel(name).equals(top)) return name;
        return null;
    }

    static String topLevel(String className) {
        int slash = className.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = className.indexOf('$', slash + 1);
        return dollar > slash + 1 ? className.substring(0, dollar) : className;
    }

    static String reasonCode(String reason) {
        return switch (reason) {
            case "body differs after normalization" -> "body-differs";
            case "method missing from recompiled class" -> "method-missing";
            case "recompiled method has no body" -> "no-body";
            case "class missing from recompiled output" -> "class-missing";
            case "recompiled class unreadable" -> "class-unreadable";
            default -> slug(reason);
        };
    }

    static String slug(String text) {
        String value = text.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[^a-z0-9]+", "-").replaceAll("^-+|-+$", "");
        return value.isEmpty() ? "unknown" : value.length() <= 60 ? value : value.substring(0, 60);
    }

    /** Removes the job directory, temp and home folders and other absolute paths; bounds the excerpt. */
    static String redact(String text, Path job) {
        if (text == null) return "";
        String value = text;
        for (Path root : List.of(job, Path.of(System.getProperty("java.io.tmpdir")), Path.of(System.getProperty("user.home")))) {
            String absolute = root.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
            if (absolute.length() < 3) continue;
            value = Pattern.compile(Pattern.quote(absolute), Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(value).replaceAll("<path>");
            value = Pattern.compile(Pattern.quote(absolute.replace('\\', '/')), Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE).matcher(value).replaceAll("<path>");
        }
        value = WINDOWS_PATH.matcher(value).replaceAll("<path>");
        value = UNIX_PATH.matcher(value).replaceAll("<path>");
        return value.length() <= MAX_EXCERPT ? value : value.substring(0, MAX_EXCERPT) + "...";
    }

    private static String inputHash(Path job) throws IOException {
        for (String name : List.of("input.jar", "input.class")) {
            Path path = job.resolve(name);
            if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) continue;
            try (var in = Files.newInputStream(path)) {
                var digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
                byte[] buffer = new byte[8192]; int read;
                while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) digest.update(buffer, 0, read);
                return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest());
            } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new IllegalStateException(impossible); }
        }
        return null;
    }

    static String sha256(byte[] bytes) {
        try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)); }
        catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new IllegalStateException(impossible); }
    }

    /** Deterministic class JAR: sorted entries, fixed timestamps, nothing but {@code name.class} entries. */
    static void writeJar(Path path, Map<String,byte[]> classes) throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(path, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
            for (var entry : new TreeMap<>(classes).entrySet()) {
                var item = new ZipEntry(entry.getKey() + ".class"); item.setTime(0);
                zip.putNextEntry(item); zip.write(entry.getValue()); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
    }
}

```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/FailureMinimizer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassReducer;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.LinkCheck;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Delta debugging for one captured failure (Phase 2AT). The case's classes are reduced with ASM in four phases: other
 * classes of the source file, then other members of the focus class (ddmin), then stub bodies of the methods that
 * must stay, then instruction edits inside the focus method (greedy, one edit at a time), and finally debug attributes.
 *
 * <p>A reduction is kept only when (1) every class passes the real JVM verifier in an isolated loader ({@link LinkCheck};
 * nothing is initialized or executed) and (2) a fresh single-engine job reproduces the failure with the same signature,
 * on the same class and method, in two consecutive runs, so an intermittent engine cannot shrink the case by accident.
 * When the case records engines that recovered the focus method in the original job ({@link FailureCase#recoverableBy()}),
 * each of them must still recover it (identical or equivalent) in the reduced case, so the case keeps proving that a
 * better choice existed. Budgets cap the evaluations and the wall time; on exhaustion the last accepted state is kept.
 */
public final class FailureMinimizer {
    /** @param maxSteps evaluations (link check plus runs) allowed; @param maxTime wall time; @param timeout per worker */
    public record Budget(int maxSteps, Duration maxTime, Duration timeout) {
        public Budget {
            if (maxSteps < 1 || maxSteps > 10_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Steps must be 1..10000");
            if (maxTime.isNegative() || maxTime.isZero() || maxTime.compareTo(Duration.ofHours(24)) > 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Time budget must be 1 s..24 h");
            if (timeout.isNegative() || timeout.isZero() || timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofHours(1)) > 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Timeout must be 1 s..1 h");
        }
    }
    public record Size(int classes, int bytes, int members, int instructions) {}
    public record Result(String status, String signature, int evaluations, int accepted, Size original, Size minimized, Path directory) {}

    public static final String MINIMIZED = "MINIMIZED", BUDGET_EXHAUSTED = "BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", NOT_REPRODUCIBLE = "NOT_REPRODUCIBLE",
        ORIGINAL_DOES_NOT_LINK = "ORIGINAL_DOES_NOT_LINK", UNSUPPORTED = "UNSUPPORTED";

    private static final class Exhausted extends Exception { Exhausted() { super(null, null, false, false); } }

    private Path output, steps; private FailureCase failure; private DecompilerEngine engine; private List<Path> context;
    private Budget budget; private long deadline; private int evaluations, accepted;
    private Map<String,byte[]> state;
    private final Set<String> evaluated = new HashSet<>();
    private final List<Map<String,Object>> log = new ArrayList<>();
    private String lastRejection = "";
    private FailureCase lastMatch;
    private List<DecompilerEngine> contrast = List.of();
    private Map<String,String> lastContrast = Map.of();

    public Result minimize(Path caseDirectory, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> available, Budget budget) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        return minimize(caseDirectory, output, available, budget, true);
    }

    /** @param keepRecoverable require the engines that recovered the focus method to keep recovering it */
    public Result minimize(Path caseDirectory, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> available, Budget budget, boolean keepRecoverable)
        throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        caseDirectory = caseDirectory.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        this.output = Files.createDirectory(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize());
        this.budget = budget; this.deadline = System.nanoTime() + budget.maxTime().toNanos();
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        failure = FailureCase.fromJson(Json.decode(Files.readString(caseDirectory.resolve("case.json"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        Path jar = caseDirectory.resolve("classes.jar");
        String base = failure.engine().endsWith("+repair") ? failure.engine().substring(0, failure.engine().length() - "+repair".length()) : failure.engine();
        engine = available.stream().filter(item -> item.id().equals(base)).findFirst().orElse(null);
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(jar, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) || engine == null)
            return finish(UNSUPPORTED, engine == null ? "producer " + failure.engine() + " is not an available engine" : "case has no classes.jar", null, start);
        if (keepRecoverable && failure.method() != null)
            contrast = available.stream().filter(item -> failure.recoverableBy().contains(item.id()) && item != engine).toList();
        var original = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(jar);
        state = original;
        if (failure.className() != null && !original.containsKey(failure.className()))
            return finish(UNSUPPORTED, "focus class missing from classes.jar", original, start);
        context = context(caseDirectory, original.keySet());
        steps = Files.createDirectory(this.output.resolve("steps"));
        try {
            if (!evaluate(original, "original", "unreduced case")) {
                boolean linkFailed = String.valueOf(log.getLast().get("outcome")).equals("REJECTED_LINK");
                return finish(linkFailed ? ORIGINAL_DOES_NOT_LINK : NOT_REPRODUCIBLE, lastRejection, original, start);
            }
            reduceClasses();
            reduceMembers();
            stubBodies();
            reduceInstructions();
            accept(stripDebug(state), "debug", "drop debug attributes");
        } catch (Exhausted exhausted) {
            return finish(BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, "budget exhausted after " + evaluations + " evaluation(s)", original, start);
        }
        return finish(MINIMIZED, "", original, start);
    }

    /** Phase 1: other classes of the focus class's source file (nested and sibling classes). */
    private void reduceClasses() throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        var others = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var name : state.keySet()) if (!name.equals(failure.className())) others.add(name);
        if (others.isEmpty() || failure.className() == null) return;
        var all = new TreeMap<>(state);
        ddmin(others, kept -> {
            var removed = new TreeSet<>(all.keySet()); removed.remove(failure.className()); removed.removeAll(kept);
            var candidate = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
            for (var entry : all.entrySet())
                if (!removed.contains(entry.getKey())) candidate.put(entry.getKey(), ClassReducer.dropReferences(entry.getValue(), removed));
            return accept(candidate, "classes", "keep " + kept.size() + " of " + others.size() + " other class(es)");
        });
    }

    /** Phase 2: fields and methods of the focus class other than the focus method. */
    private void reduceMembers() throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (failure.className() == null) return;
        byte[] focus = state.get(failure.className());
        var members = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var member : ClassReducer.members(focus)) if (!member.key().equals(failure.method())) members.add(member.key());
        ddmin(members, kept -> {
            var keep = new HashSet<>(kept); if (failure.method() != null) keep.add(failure.method());
            return accept(with(failure.className(), ClassReducer.keepMembers(focus, keep)), "members",
                "keep " + kept.size() + " of " + members.size() + " other member(s)");
        });
    }

    /** Phase 3: replace the bodies of the methods that had to stay with {@code throw null} or a bare super constructor call. */
    private void stubBodies() throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (failure.className() == null) return;
        byte[] focus = state.get(failure.className());
        var bodies = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var member : ClassReducer.members(focus))
            if (member.method() && member.hasBody() && !member.key().equals(failure.method())) bodies.add(member.key());
        ddmin(bodies, kept -> {
            var stubbed = new HashSet<>(bodies); kept.forEach(stubbed::remove);
            return accept(with(failure.className(), ClassReducer.stubMethods(focus, stubbed)), "stubs",
                "stub " + stubbed.size() + " of " + bodies.size() + " other method bod(ies)");
        });
    }

    /** Phase 4: one instruction edit at a time in the focus method, restarting after each accepted edit. */
    private void reduceInstructions() throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (failure.className() == null || failure.method() == null) return;
        boolean progressed = true;
        while (progressed) {
            progressed = false;
            byte[] focus = state.get(failure.className());
            var edits = ClassReducer.edits(focus, failure.method());
            for (int index = 0; index < edits.size() && !progressed; index++) {
                byte[] candidate = ClassReducer.applyEdit(focus, failure.method(), index, state);
                if (candidate == null || Arrays.equals(candidate, focus)) continue;
                progressed = accept(with(failure.className(), candidate), "instructions", edits.get(index));
            }
        }
    }

    private Map<String,byte[]> stripDebug(Map<String,byte[]> classes) {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        classes.forEach((name, bytes) -> result.put(name, ClassReducer.stripDebug(bytes)));
        return result;
    }

    private Map<String,byte[]> with(String name, byte[] bytes) {
        var result = new TreeMap<>(state); result.put(name, bytes); return result;
    }

    @FunctionalInterface private interface Test { boolean keep(List<String> kept) throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException; }

    /** Zeller's ddmin over the removable items: returns a 1-minimal list of items that must stay for the failure to persist. */
    private static List<String> ddmin(List<String> items, Test test) throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (items.isEmpty() || test.keep(List.of())) return List.of();
        var current = new ArrayList<>(items); int n = 2;
        while (current.size() >= 2) {
            var chunks = split(current, n); boolean reduced = false;
            for (var chunk : chunks) if (test.keep(chunk)) { current = new ArrayList<>(chunk); n = 2; reduced = true; break; }
            if (!reduced && n > 2)
                for (var chunk : chunks) {
                    var complement = new ArrayList<>(current); complement.removeAll(chunk);
                    if (test.keep(complement)) { current = complement; n = Math.max(n - 1, 2); reduced = true; break; }
                }
            if (!reduced) { if (n >= current.size()) break; n = Math.min(current.size(), n * 2); }
        }
        return current;
    }

    private static List<List<String>> split(List<String> items, int parts) {
        var result = new ArrayList<List<String>>();
        int size = items.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
            var chunk = items.subList(i * size / parts, (i + 1) * size / parts);
            if (!chunk.isEmpty()) result.add(List.copyOf(chunk));
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** Evaluates a candidate state and makes it current when the failure persists. */
    private boolean accept(Map<String,byte[]> candidate, String phase, String description) throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        if (!evaluate(candidate, phase, description)) return false;
        state = candidate; accepted++;
        return true;
    }

    private boolean evaluate(Map<String,byte[]> candidate, String phase, String description) throws Exhausted, IOException, InterruptedException {
        String hash = digest(candidate);
        if (!evaluated.add(hash)) return false;
        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException();
        if (evaluations >= budget.maxSteps() || System.nanoTime() > deadline) throw new Exhausted();
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        Path step = Files.createDirectory(steps.resolve(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%04d", ++evaluations)));
        Path jar = step.resolve("classes.jar");
        FailureCollector.writeJar(jar, candidate);
        var entry = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        entry.put("step", (long) evaluations); entry.put("phase", phase); entry.put("description", description);
        entry.put("classes_sha256", hash);
        Map<String,String> pendingContrast = Map.of();
        try {
            var link = new LinkCheck().check(jar, step.resolve("link"), context, budget.timeout());
            if (!link.linked()) return reject(entry, "REJECTED_LINK", link.errorType() + ": " + link.message(), start);
            for (String run : List.of("a", "b")) {
                if (System.nanoTime() > deadline) throw new Exhausted();
                Path directory = step.resolve("run-" + run);
                DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job;
                try { job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, directory, List.of(engine), budget.timeout(), context, failure.sourceRepair()); }
                catch (IOException error) { return reject(entry, "REJECTED_ERROR", String.valueOf(error.getMessage()), start); }
                var seen = new TreeSet<String>();
                FailureCase same = null;
                for (var found : FailureCollector.find(job, directory, "lab", null, true)) {
                    var data = found.data();
                    if (!Objects.equals(data.className(), failure.className())) continue;
                    if (data.signature().equals(failure.signature()) && Objects.equals(data.method(), failure.method())) same = data;
                    seen.add(data.signature());
                }
                if (same == null) return reject(entry, run.equals("a") ? "REJECTED_SIGNATURE" : "REJECTED_NOT_REPEATED",
                    "observed on the focus class: " + (seen.isEmpty() ? "no failure" : String.join(", ", seen)), start);
                if (run.equals("b")) lastMatch = same;
                if (run.equals("a") && !contrast.isEmpty()) {
                    var levels = new TreeMap<String,String>();
                    for (var other : contrast) {
                        Path contrastRun = step.resolve("contrast-" + other.id());
                        String level;
                        try {
                            var check = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, contrastRun, List.of(other), budget.timeout(), context, false);
                            level = RegressionSuite.levels(check, candidate).getOrDefault(failure.className() + "." + failure.method(), "NOT_RECOMPILED");
                        } catch (IOException error) { level = "NOT_RECOMPILED"; }
                        levels.put(other.id(), level);
                        if (FailureCase.level(level) < FailureCase.level("EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION"))
                            return reject(entry, "REJECTED_CONTRAST", other.id() + " no longer recovers the focus method (" + level + ")", start);
                    }
                    pendingContrast = levels;
                }
            }
            lastContrast = pendingContrast;
            entry.put("outcome", "ACCEPTED");
        } catch (Exhausted stop) {
            entry.put("outcome", "STOPPED_BY_BUDGET");
            throw stop;
        } finally {
            entry.putIfAbsent("outcome", "ABORTED");
            entry.put("elapsed_ms", (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1_000_000);
            log.add(entry);
        }
        return true;
    }

    private boolean reject(Map<String,Object> entry, String outcome, String detail, long start) {
        entry.put("outcome", outcome); entry.put("detail", FailureCollector.redact(detail, output));
        lastRejection = outcome + ": " + entry.get("detail");
        return false;
    }

    /** Context classes of the case's job, minus the case's own classes, as a compile-only (and link-only) dependency. */
    private List<Path> context(Path caseDirectory, Set<String> own) throws IOException {
        if (failure.context() == null) return List.of();
        Path source = caseDirectory.resolve(failure.context()).normalize();
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(source, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return List.of();
        var classes = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(source);
        classes.keySet().removeAll(own);
        if (classes.isEmpty()) return List.of();
        Path jar = output.resolve("context.jar");
        FailureCollector.writeJar(jar, classes);
        return List.of(jar);
    }

    private Result finish(String status, String reason, Map<String,byte[]> original, long start) throws IOException {
        Size before = original == null ? null : size(original), after = original == null ? null : size(state);
        Path minimized = null;
        if (original != null && (status.equals(MINIMIZED) || status.equals(BUDGET_EXHAUSTED))) {
            minimized = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve("minimized"));
            FailureCollector.writeJar(minimized.resolve("classes.jar"), state);
            var data = (lastMatch == null ? failure : failure.withEvidence(lastMatch.excerpt(), lastMatch.engineVersion(), lastContrast))
                .withClassHash(failure.className() == null ? null : FailureCollector.sha256(state.get(failure.className())))
                .withContext(context.isEmpty() ? null : "../context.jar");
            EvidenceReport.write(minimized.resolve("case.json"), data.toJson());
        }
        var report = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        report.put("schema_version", 1); report.put("kind", "failure-minimization"); report.put("case", failure.id());
        report.put("signature", failure.signature()); report.put("status", status); report.put("reason", reason);
        report.put("engine", engine == null ? failure.engine() : engine.id() + " " + engine.version());
        report.put("source_repair", failure.sourceRepair());
        report.put("contrast_engines", contrast.stream().map(DecompilerEngine::id).toList());
        report.put("contrast_levels", lastContrast);
        report.put("budget", Map.of("max_steps", (long) budget.maxSteps(), "max_seconds", budget.maxTime().toSeconds(),
            "timeout_seconds", budget.timeout().toSeconds()));
        report.put("evaluations", (long) evaluations); report.put("accepted", (long) accepted);
        report.put("elapsed_ms", (System.nanoTime() - start) / 1_000_000);
        report.put("acceptance", "every class links under the JVM verifier (isolated loader, nothing initialized or executed), "
            + "two fresh single-engine runs reproduce the same signature on the same class and method, and every contrast engine "
            + "still recovers the focus method (identical or equivalent)");
        report.put("original", before == null ? null : size(before)); report.put("minimized", after == null ? null : size(after));
        report.put("steps", log);
        report.put("behavior", "NOT_VERIFIED");
        EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("minimization.json"), report);
        return new Result(status, failure.signature(), evaluations, accepted, before, after, minimized);
    }

    private static Map<String,Object> size(Size size) {
        return Map.of("classes", (long) size.classes(), "bytes", (long) size.bytes(), "members", (long) size.members(),
            "instructions", (long) size.instructions());
    }

    private static Size size(Map<String,byte[]> classes) {
        int bytes = 0, members = 0, instructions = 0;
        for (var value : classes.values()) {
            bytes += value.length; members += ClassReducer.members(value).size(); instructions += ClassReducer.instructions(value);
        }
        return new Size(classes.size(), bytes, members, instructions);
    }

    private static String digest(Map<String,byte[]> classes) {
        var text = new StringBuilder();
        new TreeMap<>(classes).forEach((name, bytes) -> text.append(name).append('=').append(FailureCollector.sha256(bytes)).append(';'));
        return FailureCollector.sha256(text.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/GhidraEngine.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CC: Ghidra's headless analyzer as an optional native engine. Ghidra is never bundled or downloaded; it is found
 * through {@code --ghidra-home} or {@code GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR}. It runs as its own process (analyzeHeadless) with a
 * throwaway project in the run directory, imports one library, analyzes it statically and runs the versioned post script.
 */
public final class GhidraEngine implements DecompilerEngine {
    public static final String SCRIPT = "ClassReviveNativeExport.java";
    public static final String EXPORT = "ghidra.json";

    private final Path home, scripts, project;
    private final String version;
    private final boolean analysis;
    private final int analysisSeconds, maxStrings, maxDecompiled, maxCBytes;

    GhidraEngine(Path home, String version, Path scripts, Path project, boolean analysis, int analysisSeconds, int maxStrings, int maxDecompiled,
                 int maxCBytes) {
        this.home = home; this.version = version; this.scripts = scripts; this.project = project; this.analysis = analysis; this.analysisSeconds = analysisSeconds;
        this.maxStrings = maxStrings; this.maxDecompiled = maxDecompiled; this.maxCBytes = maxCBytes;
    }

    /** A located installation: its folder, the launcher and the version from {@code Ghidra/application.properties}. */
    public record Installation(Path home, Path launcher, String version) {}

    /**
     * The installation named by {@code option} (which must be valid) or else by {@code GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR}; empty when
     * neither is set. {@code problem} receives why a set GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR was not usable.
     */
    public static Optional<Installation> locate(String option, Map<String,String> environment, List<String> problem) {
        if (option != null) {
            var found = installation(Path.of(option));
            if (found.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("--ghidra-home is not a Ghidra installation (support/" + launcherName() + " missing)");
            return found;
        }
        String variable = environment.get("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR");
        if (variable == null || variable.isBlank()) return Optional.empty();
        Optional<Installation> found;
        try { found = installation(Path.of(variable)); }
        catch (InvalidPathException invalid) { found = Optional.empty(); }
        if (found.isEmpty()) problem.add("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR does not point to a Ghidra installation");
        return found;
    }

    static Optional<Installation> installation(Path home) {
        home = home.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path launcher = home.resolve("support").resolve(launcherName());
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(launcher)) return Optional.empty();
        String version = "unknown";
        Path properties = home.resolve("Ghidra").resolve("application.properties");
        if (Files.isRegularFile(properties)) {
            var values = new Properties();
            try (var in = Files.newInputStream(properties)) { values.load(in); version = values.getProperty("application.version", "unknown"); }
            catch (IOException | IllegalArgumentException unreadable) { version = "unknown"; }
        }
        return Optional.of(new Installation(home, launcher, version.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_")));
    }

    static String launcherName() { return windows() ? "analyzeHeadless.bat" : "analyzeHeadless"; }
    static boolean windows() { return System.getProperty("os.name", "").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).startsWith("windows"); }

    /**
     * Ghidra refuses a project location with a path element that starts with {@code .} (GhidraURL.checkValidProjectPath),
     * so an output folder such as {@code .analysis/out} cannot hold the project; a new temporary folder is used then.
     */
    static boolean projectLocationAccepted(Path location) {
        for (Path element : location.toAbsolutePath().normalize()) if (element.toString().startsWith(".")) return false;
        return true;
    }

    /** Writes the versioned post script into {@code directory} (it is compiled by Ghidra, never by this JVM). */
    static Path installScript(Path directory) throws IOException {
        Files.createDirectories(directory);
        try (var in = GhidraEngine.class.getResourceAsStream("ghidra/" + SCRIPT)) {
            if (in == null) throw new IOException("Ghidra post script missing from the ClassRevive build");
            Files.copy(in, directory.resolve(SCRIPT));
        }
        return directory;
    }

    @Override public String id() { return analysis ? "ghidra" : "ghidra-noanalysis"; }
    @Override public String version() { return version; }

    /** Ghidra needs a JDK; without JAVA_HOME the launcher would ask on the console, so this JVM's own JDK is offered. */
    @Override public Map<String,String> environment() {
        if (System.getenv("JAVA_HOME") != null) return Map.of();
        Path javaHome = Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"));
        return Files.isRegularFile(javaHome.resolve("bin").resolve(windows() ? "javac.exe" : "javac")) ? Map.of("JAVA_HOME", javaHome.toString()) : Map.of();
    }

    /**
     * {@code input} is the extracted library; {@code output} the folder the export goes to. The throwaway project is
     * deleted by Ghidra ({@code -deleteProject}); {@code -readOnly} keeps the import from being saved at all.
     */
    @Override public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
        var command = new ArrayList<String>(List.of(home.resolve("support").resolve(launcherName()).toString(),
            project.toString(), "classrevive", "-import", input.toString(), "-readOnly", "-deleteProject",
            "-scriptPath", scripts.toString(), "-postScript", SCRIPT, output.resolve(EXPORT).toString(),
            String.valueOf(maxStrings), String.valueOf(maxDecompiled), String.valueOf(maxCBytes), "-max-cpu", "2"));
        if (analysis) { command.add("-analysisTimeoutPerFile"); command.add(String.valueOf(analysisSeconds)); }
        else command.add("-noanalysis");
        if (windows()) for (String argument : command) {
            // analyzeHeadless.bat re-expands every argument through cmd.exe; these characters would change its meaning.
            if (argument.isEmpty() || argument.chars().anyMatch(c -> "\"%^&|<>!".indexOf(c) >= 0))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Path not supported by analyzeHeadless.bat: " + argument);
        }
        return command;
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/GhidraExport.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CC: the JSON that {@code ClassReviveNativeExport.java} writes after Ghidra's static analysis, read strictly. A
 * missing or mistyped field fails the whole export; lists are bounded and strings are kept as untrusted data.
 */
public record GhidraExport(String ghidraVersion, String format, String language, String compiler, int pointerSize, String imageBase,
                           boolean analyzed, boolean analysisTimedOut, long functionCount, List<Block> blocks, List<Symbol> imports,
                           List<Export> exports, List<Function> jniFunctions, List<Site> registerNativesSites, List<TableEntry> nativeMethodTables,
                           List<Text> strings, List<Decompiled> decompiled) {
    public record Block(String name, String start, long size, String permissions, boolean initialized, long entropyMillibits) {}
    public record Symbol(String library, String name) {}
    public record Export(String name, String address, boolean function) {}
    public record Function(String name, String address, long size, String signature, List<String> calls, boolean createdByScript) {}
    public record Site(String function, String address, String instruction, long depth) {}
    public record TableEntry(String entry, String name, String descriptor, String functionAddress, String function) {}
    public record Text(String address, String type, long length, String value) {}
    public record Decompiled(String name, String address, boolean completed, boolean truncated, String code, String error) {}

    static final int MAX_ROWS = 20_000;

    public static GhidraExport parse(String json) {
        if (!(Json.decode(json) instanceof Map<?,?> root)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ghidra export is not a JSON object");
        if (number(root, "schema_version") != 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown Ghidra export schema");
        if (!"ghidra".equals(text(root, "tool"))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a Ghidra export");
        return new GhidraExport(text(root, "ghidra_version"), text(root, "format"), text(root, "language"), text(root, "compiler"),
            (int) number(root, "pointer_size"), text(root, "image_base"), flag(root, "analyzed", false), flag(root, "analysis_timed_out", false),
            number(root, "function_count"),
            rows(root, "blocks", m -> new Block(text(m, "name"), text(m, "start"), number(m, "size"), text(m, "permissions"),
                flag(m, "initialized", false), number(m, "entropy_millibits"))),
            rows(root, "imports", m -> new Symbol(text(m, "library"), text(m, "name"))),
            rows(root, "exports", m -> new Export(text(m, "name"), text(m, "address"), flag(m, "function", false))),
            rows(root, "jni_functions", m -> new Function(text(m, "name"), text(m, "address"), number(m, "size"), text(m, "signature"),
                strings(m, "calls"), flag(m, "created_by_script", false))),
            rows(root, "register_natives_sites", m -> new Site(text(m, "function"), text(m, "address"), text(m, "instruction"), number(m, "depth"))),
            rows(root, "native_method_tables", m -> new TableEntry(text(m, "entry"), text(m, "name"), text(m, "descriptor"),
                text(m, "function_address"), text(m, "function"))),
            rows(root, "strings", m -> new Text(text(m, "address"), text(m, "type"), number(m, "length"), text(m, "value"))),
            rows(root, "decompiled", m -> {
                boolean completed = flag(m, "completed", false);
                return new Decompiled(text(m, "name"), text(m, "address"), completed, completed && flag(m, "truncated", false),
                    completed ? text(m, "c") : "", completed ? "" : text(m, "error"));
            }));
    }

    public boolean exports(String name) { return exports.stream().anyMatch(e -> e.name().equals(name)); }

    private interface Row<T> { T read(Map<?,?> map); }
    private static <T> List<T> rows(Map<?,?> map, String key, Row<T> reader) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof List<?> list)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing list: " + key);
        if (list.size() > MAX_ROWS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many rows: " + key);
        var rows = new ArrayList<T>();
        for (Object item : list) {
            if (!(item instanceof Map<?,?> row)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Row is not an object: " + key);
            rows.add(reader.read(row));
        }
        return List.copyOf(rows);
    }
    private static List<String> strings(Map<?,?> map, String key) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof List<?> list)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing list: " + key);
        var values = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (Object item : list) {
            if (!(item instanceof String text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a string in " + key);
            values.add(text);
        }
        return List.copyOf(values);
    }
    private static String text(Map<?,?> map, String key) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof String value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing string: " + key);
        return value;
    }
    private static long number(Map<?,?> map, String key) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof Long value)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing integer: " + key);
        return value;
    }
    private static boolean flag(Map<?,?> map, String key, boolean fallback) {
        Object value = map.get(key);
        if (value == null && !map.containsKey(key)) return fallback;
        if (!(value instanceof Boolean flag)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Not a boolean: " + key);
        return flag;
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/HtmlReport.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.verification.ClassCoverage;
import dev.classrevive.verification.ClassRoundTrip;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CF: a self-contained {@code report.html} beside {@code report.json}, a confidence map of the selected sources.
 * Each class gets a level from the evidence already measured: its structural signatures, and the per-method round
 * trip of the whole candidate or, when that did not compile, of the per-file measurement (Phase 2BP). No script, no
 * network, no external resource; every name from the input is HTML-escaped. Behavior is never claimed.
 */
final class HtmlReport {
    private HtmlReport() {}

    /** Confidence of one class, from strongest to weakest evidence. */
    enum Level {
        EXACT("exact", "every method body recompiles identical or equivalent, all signatures match"),
        CLOSE("close", "signatures match; some bodies differ after recompilation (may be legitimate compiler variation)"),
        PER_FILE("per-file", "the whole candidate does not compile; this class's file compiles against the original classes"),
        PARTIAL("partial", "signatures missing or bodies not recompiled"),
        UNVERIFIED("unverified", "not recompiled: its file has compiler errors or no source");
        final String css, meaning;
        Level(String css, String meaning) { this.css = css; this.meaning = meaning; }
    }

    /** {@code methods}: every measured method's round trip (Phase G4), empty when the class was not recompiled. */
    record Row(String className, String file, String origin, int matched, int expected, int identical, int equivalent, int different,
               List<String> differentMethods, Level level, List<MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult> methods) {}

    /** {@code originalBodies}: every original method body, so bodies never recompiled count against the rate. */
    static void write(Path output, String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies) throws IOException {
        write(output, inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, null);
    }
    /** Phase 2CI: with {@code libraries}, bundled library packages are labeled and folded, and the application's own share is shown. */
    static void write(Path output, String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies,
                      EmbeddedLibraries.Result libraries) throws IOException {
        write(output, inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, libraries, null);
    }
    /** Phase 2CJ: with {@code compiler}, a tile names the language and compiler, and the debug information present. */
    static void write(Path output, String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies,
                      EmbeddedLibraries.Result libraries, dev.classrevive.bytecode.CompilerFingerprint.Result compiler) throws IOException {
        write(output, inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, libraries, compiler, 0);
    }
    /** Phase 2CT: {@code stubs} inferred stand-in classes were on the compiler's class path; the page says so. */
    static void write(Path output, String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies,
                      EmbeddedLibraries.Result libraries, dev.classrevive.bytecode.CompilerFingerprint.Result compiler, int stubs) throws IOException {
        String page = render(inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, libraries, compiler);
        // Phase 2DD: what the automatic reversal did, and that the numbers below measure the reversed classes.
        var reversal = job.deobfuscation();
        if (reversal != null) page = page.replaceFirst("<section class=\"tiles\">", java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement(
            "<p class=\"" + (reversal.applied() ? "reversal" : "warning") + "\">" + escape(AutoDeobfuscation.headline(reversal)) + "."
            + (reversal.applied() ? " Signatures, round trip and confidence below are measured against the reversed classes (deobfuscation/), "
                + "not the original; the reversal kept " + reversal.comparison().keptMethods() + "/" + reversal.comparison().originalMethods()
                + " of the original's method signatures." : "") + "</p>\n<section class=\"tiles\">"));
        if (stubs > 0) page = page.replaceFirst("<section class=\"tiles\">", java.util.regex.Matcher.quoteReplacement(
            "<p class=\"warning\">" + (job.selection().stubBacked() ? "Stub-backed: c" : "C") + "ompiled against " + stubs + " inferred stub class"
            + (stubs == 1 ? "" : "es") + " for missing libraries (stubs/stubs.txt), not the real libraries."
            // Phase 2DF: a stub-backed result still counts as complete, so the page says what that completeness rests on.
            + (job.selection().stubBacked() ? " The result counts as complete only against these stand-ins; the bytecode fallback is kept (fallback/)." : "")
            + " Pass the real JARs with --classpath for a faithful check.</p>\n<section class=\"tiles\">"));
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("report.html"), page, StandardCharsets.UTF_8, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
    }

    static List<Row> rows(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job) {
        VerificationResult verification = job.selection().verification();
        boolean compiled = verification.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED;
        var whole = new HashMap<String,ClassRoundTrip>();
        for (var trip : verification.roundTrip()) whole.put(trip.className(), trip);
        var partial = new HashMap<String,ClassRoundTrip>();
        if (job.perFile() != null) for (var trip : job.perFile().classes()) partial.put(trip.className(), trip);
        var rows = new ArrayList<Row>();
        for (ClassCoverage coverage : verification.classCoverage()) {
            String name = coverage.className();
            String file = topLevel(name) + ".java";
            String origin = job.selection().provenance().getOrDefault(file, "none");
            ClassRoundTrip trip = compiled ? whole.get(name) : partial.get(name);
            int identical = trip == null ? 0 : trip.identical(), equivalent = trip == null ? 0 : trip.equivalent(), different = trip == null ? 0 : trip.different();
            var differing = new ArrayList<String>();
            if (trip != null) for (var method : trip.methods()) if (method.outcome() == MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.DIFFERENT) differing.add(method.name() + method.descriptor());
            boolean signatures = coverage.matchedSymbols() == coverage.expectedSymbols();
            Level level;
            if (trip == null) level = compiled && signatures && coverage.expectedSymbols() > 0 ? Level.PARTIAL : Level.UNVERIFIED;
            else if (!compiled) level = Level.PER_FILE;
            else if (!signatures) level = Level.PARTIAL;
            else level = different == 0 ? Level.EXACT : Level.CLOSE;
            rows.add(new Row(name, file, origin, coverage.matchedSymbols(), coverage.expectedSymbols(), identical, equivalent, different, differing, level,
                trip == null ? List.of() : trip.methods()));
        }
        rows.sort(Comparator.comparing(Row::className));
        return rows;
    }

    /**
     * Phase G2: the same rows as the page, for {@code class_confidence} in {@code report.json}, so a reader of the JSON (the
     * desktop GUI's result index) shows exactly the levels of {@code report.html}. Level names are the enum constants.
     */
    static List<Object> confidence(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job) {
        var entries = new ArrayList<Object>();
        for (var row : rows(job)) {
            var entry = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
            entry.put("class_name", row.className()); entry.put("file", row.file()); entry.put("origin", row.origin());
            entry.put("matched_symbols", row.matched()); entry.put("expected_symbols", row.expected());
            entry.put("identical", row.identical()); entry.put("equivalent_after_normalization", row.equivalent());
            entry.put("different", row.different()); entry.put("different_methods", row.differentMethods());
            entry.put("level", row.level().name());
            // Phase G4 (additive): each measured method's outcome, so the editor can mark it at its declaration.
            entry.put("methods", row.methods().stream().map(method -> (Object) Map.of("method", method.name() + method.descriptor(),
                "outcome", method.outcome().name())).toList());
            entries.add(entry);
        }
        return entries;
    }

    static String render(String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies) {
        return render(inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, null);
    }
    static String render(String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies, EmbeddedLibraries.Result libraries) {
        return render(inputName, inputSha256, job, originalBodies, libraries, null);
    }
    static String render(String inputName, String inputSha256, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, int originalBodies, EmbeddedLibraries.Result libraries,
                         dev.classrevive.bytecode.CompilerFingerprint.Result compiler) {
        VerificationResult verification = job.selection().verification();
        var rows = rows(job);
        var counts = new EnumMap<Level,Integer>(Level.class);
        for (var level : Level.values()) counts.put(level, 0);
        long recovered = 0;
        for (var row : rows) {
            counts.merge(row.level(), 1, Integer::sum);
            recovered += row.identical() + row.equivalent();
        }
        long bodies = originalBodies;
        var out = new StringBuilder(64 * 1024 + rows.size() * 256);
        out.append("<!doctype html>\n<html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\">\n")
            .append("<title>ClassRevive report</title>\n<style>").append(STYLE).append("</style></head><body>\n<main>\n")
            .append("<h1>ClassRevive confidence map</h1>\n<p class=\"meta\">").append(escape(inputName)).append(" &middot; SHA-256 <code>")
            .append(escape(inputSha256)).append("</code></p>\n");
        out.append("<section class=\"tiles\">")
            .append(tile("Compilation", escape(verification.status().name()), verification.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED
                ? "the selected sources recompile" : verification.errors() + " javac error(s)"))
            .append(tile("Signatures", verification.matchedSymbols() + "/" + verification.expectedSymbols(), "classes, fields and methods with the original shape"))
            .append(tile("Method bodies", bodies == 0 ? "n/a" : recovered + "/" + bodies, bodies == 0 ? "no original method body"
                : percent(recovered, bodies) + " of all original bodies identical or equivalent"
                + (verification.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED ? "" : " (per-file credit)")))
            .append(tile("Selected", escape(job.selection().candidate()), job.selection().repairs().size() + " source repair(s), "
                + job.selection().methods().size() + " composed method(s)"));
        if (libraries != null && !libraries.libraries().isEmpty()) {
            long ownExact = rows.stream().filter(row -> libraries.libraryOf(row.className()) == null && row.level() == Level.EXACT).count();
            long own = rows.stream().filter(row -> libraries.libraryOf(row.className()) == null).count();
            out.append(tile("Application code", own + " classes", ownExact + " exact; " + libraries.libraryClasses() + " classes belong to "
                + libraries.libraries().size() + " bundled librar" + (libraries.libraries().size() == 1 ? "y" : "ies")));
        }
        if (compiler != null && compiler.classes() > 0) {
            String producer = compiler.language().equals("Java")
                ? (compiler.javaCompiler().equals("javac") && compiler.javacAtLeast() > 0 ? "javac " + compiler.javacAtLeast() + "+" : compiler.javaCompiler())
                : compiler.language();
            out.append(tile("Compiler", escape(producer), "local variable names in " + compiler.withLocalVariables() + "/" + compiler.withCode()
                + " classes, line numbers in " + compiler.withLineNumbers() + "/" + compiler.withCode()));
        }
        out.append("</section>\n");
        if (libraries != null && !libraries.libraries().isEmpty()) {
            out.append("<p class=\"meta\">Bundled libraries (folded below): ");
            var names = new StringJoiner(", ");
            for (var library : libraries.libraries())
                names.add(escape(library.name() + (library.version() == null ? "" : " " + library.version())) + " (" + library.classes() + ")");
            out.append(names).append("</p>\n");
        }
        out.append("<section class=\"bar\" aria-label=\"classes by confidence\">");
        for (var level : Level.values()) {
            int count = counts.get(level);
            if (count > 0) out.append("<span class=\"").append(level.css).append("\" style=\"flex:").append(count).append("\" title=\"")
                .append(level.css).append(": ").append(count).append("\"></span>");
        }
        out.append("</section>\n<ul class=\"legend\">");
        for (var level : Level.values())
            out.append("<li><i class=\"").append(level.css).append("\"></i><b>").append(level.css).append("</b> ").append(counts.get(level))
                .append(" &middot; ").append(escape(level.meaning)).append("</li>");
        out.append("</ul>\n");
        String currentPackage = null;
        for (var row : rows) {
            String pkg = packageOf(row.className());
            if (!pkg.equals(currentPackage)) {
                if (currentPackage != null) out.append("</tbody></table></details>\n");
                currentPackage = pkg;
                var inPackage = rows.stream().filter(r -> packageOf(r.className()).equals(pkg)).toList();
                long exact = inPackage.stream().filter(r -> r.level() == Level.EXACT).count();
                String library = libraries == null ? null : libraries.libraryOf(inPackage.getFirst().className());
                out.append(library == null ? "<details open><summary><code>" : "<details class=\"library\"><summary><code>")
                    .append(escape(pkg.isEmpty() ? "(default package)" : pkg.replace('/', '.')))
                    .append("</code> <span class=\"meta\">").append(inPackage.size()).append(" classes, ").append(exact).append(" exact")
                    .append(library == null ? "" : " &middot; library: " + escape(library)).append("</span></summary>\n")
                    .append("<table><thead><tr><th>Class</th><th>Source</th><th>Signatures</th><th>Identical</th><th>Equivalent</th><th>Different</th><th>Level</th></tr></thead><tbody>\n");
            }
            out.append("<tr><td><code>").append(escape(simpleName(row.className()))).append("</code>");
            if (!row.differentMethods().isEmpty()) {
                out.append("<details class=\"methods\"><summary>").append(row.differentMethods().size()).append(" different</summary><ul>");
                row.differentMethods().stream().limit(50).forEach(method -> out.append("<li><code>").append(escape(method)).append("</code></li>"));
                out.append("</ul></details>");
            }
            out.append("</td><td>").append(escape(row.origin())).append("</td><td>").append(row.matched()).append('/').append(row.expected())
                .append("</td><td>").append(row.identical()).append("</td><td>").append(row.equivalent()).append("</td><td>").append(row.different())
                .append("</td><td><span class=\"pill ").append(row.level().css).append("\">").append(row.level().css).append("</span></td></tr>\n");
        }
        if (currentPackage != null) out.append("</tbody></table></details>\n");
        out.append("<p class=\"meta\">Levels come from recompilation evidence only: structural signatures and per-method round trip against ")
            .append("the decompiled bytes. They are not proof of behavior, which ClassRevive never executes. Details: <code>report.json</code>, ")
            .append("<code>selection/selection.txt</code>.</p>\n</main></body></html>\n");
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static String tile(String label, String value, String note) {
        return "<div class=\"tile\"><span class=\"label\">" + escape(label) + "</span><span class=\"value\">" + value + "</span><span class=\"note\">"
            + escape(note) + "</span></div>";
    }
    private static String percent(long part, long whole) { return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f%%", part * 100.0 / whole); }
    private static String topLevel(String internalName) {
        int slash = internalName.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = internalName.indexOf('$', slash + 1);
        return dollar > slash + 1 ? internalName.substring(0, dollar) : internalName;
    }
    private static String packageOf(String internalName) { int slash = internalName.lastIndexOf('/'); return slash < 0 ? "" : internalName.substring(0, slash); }
    private static String simpleName(String internalName) { return internalName.substring(internalName.lastIndexOf('/') + 1); }

    /** HTML-escapes text taken from the input (class, method and file names can hold any character). */
    static String escape(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder(text.length() + 16);
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            switch (c) {
                case '&' -> out.append("&amp;"); case '<' -> out.append("&lt;"); case '>' -> out.append("&gt;");
                case '"' -> out.append("&quot;"); case '\'' -> out.append("&#39;");
                default -> { if (c < 0x20 && c != '\t') out.append("&#").append((int) c).append(';'); else out.append(c); }
            }
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
```
