`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/NativeBinary.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CC: ClassRevive's own static reader for the headers of a bundled native library (PE, ELF, Mach-O format only).
 * The bytes are data: every offset is bounds-checked, nothing is mapped, loaded or run. It gives the sections with their
 * entropy, the exported and imported names and packing hints even when Ghidra is not configured.
 */
public final class NativeBinary {
    private NativeBinary() {}

    /** {@code permissions} is {@code rwx} style; {@code entropyMillibits} is Shannon entropy of the file data times 1000, -1 without data. */
    public record Section(String name, long virtualAddress, long virtualSize, long rawSize, String permissions, int entropyMillibits) {
        public boolean executable() { return permissions.indexOf('x') >= 0; }
        public boolean unnamed() { return name.isBlank(); }
    }
    public record Import(String library, String name) {}
    /** Header facts; {@code entryPoint} is an RVA (PE) or virtual address (ELF), -1 when unknown. */
    public record Headers(String format, String machine, int bits, long entryPoint, List<Section> sections, List<String> exports,
                          List<Import> imports, List<String> neededLibraries, boolean tls, List<String> problems) {
        public Headers {
            sections = List.copyOf(sections); exports = List.copyOf(exports); imports = List.copyOf(imports);
            neededLibraries = List.copyOf(neededLibraries); problems = List.copyOf(problems);
        }
        public boolean known() { return !format.equals("unknown"); }
        public Optional<Section> entrySection() {
            if (entryPoint < 0) return Optional.empty();
            return sections.stream().filter(s -> entryPoint >= s.virtualAddress()
                && entryPoint < s.virtualAddress() + Math.max(s.virtualSize(), s.rawSize())).findFirst();
        }
    }
    /** {@code verdict}: {@code LIKELY_PACKED} or {@code NOT_DETECTED}; hints are readable reasons, packers are hypotheses. */
    public record Packing(String verdict, List<String> hints, List<String> suspectedPackers) {
        public Packing { hints = List.copyOf(hints); suspectedPackers = List.copyOf(suspectedPackers); }
        public boolean packed() { return verdict.equals("LIKELY_PACKED"); }
    }

    static final int MAX_SECTIONS = 96, MAX_NAMES = 5000, MAX_LIBRARIES = 256;
    /** Executable sections at or above this entropy (bits per byte, times 1000) look compressed or encrypted. */
    static final int HIGH_ENTROPY = 7200;

    public static Headers parse(byte[] bytes) {
        try {
            if (bytes.length >= 64 && bytes[0] == 'M' && bytes[1] == 'Z') return pe(bytes);
            if (bytes.length >= 52 && (bytes[0] & 0xff) == 0x7f && bytes[1] == 'E' && bytes[2] == 'L' && bytes[3] == 'F') return elf(bytes);
            if (bytes.length >= 8) {
                long magic = u32(bytes, 0, false);
                if (magic == 0xfeedfaceL || magic == 0xfeedfacfL || magic == 0xcefaedfeL || magic == 0xcffaedfeL)
                    return machO(bytes, magic == 0xcefaedfeL || magic == 0xcffaedfeL);
                if (magic == 0xcafebabeL && u32(bytes, 4, true) < 64) return simple("Mach-O universal", "multiple", 0, "fat binary; slices not parsed");
            }
        } catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException truncated) {
            return simple("unknown", "unknown", 0, "truncated or malformed headers");
        }
        return simple("unknown", "unknown", 0, "not a PE, ELF or Mach-O file");
    }

    private static Headers simple(String format, String machine, int bits, String problem) {
        return new Headers(format, machine, bits, -1, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), false, List.of(problem));
    }

    private static Headers pe(byte[] b) {
        var problems = new ArrayList<String>();
        int pe = (int) u32(b, 0x3c, true);
        if (pe < 0 || pe > b.length - 24 || b[pe] != 'P' || b[pe + 1] != 'E' || b[pe + 2] != 0 || b[pe + 3] != 0)
            return simple("unknown", "unknown", 0, "MZ header without a PE signature");
        int machine = u16(b, pe + 4, true), count = u16(b, pe + 6, true), optionalSize = u16(b, pe + 20, true);
        int optional = pe + 24, magic = u16(b, optional, true);
        boolean plus = magic == 0x20b;
        if (!plus && magic != 0x10b) return simple("unknown", "unknown", 0, "unknown PE optional header magic");
        long entry = u32(b, optional + 16, true);
        int directories = optional + (plus ? 112 : 96);
        long directoryCount = u32(b, optional + (plus ? 108 : 92), true);
        if (count > MAX_SECTIONS) { problems.add(count + " sections; only " + MAX_SECTIONS + " read"); count = MAX_SECTIONS; }
        var sections = new ArrayList<Section>();
        int table = optional + optionalSize;
        var raw = new ArrayList<long[]>();
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            int at = table + 40 * i;
            if (at + 40 > b.length) { problems.add("section table truncated"); break; }
            String name = ascii(b, at, 8);
            long virtualSize = u32(b, at + 8, true), address = u32(b, at + 12, true), rawSize = u32(b, at + 16, true), pointer = u32(b, at + 20, true);
            long flags = u32(b, at + 36, true);
            String permissions = ((flags & 0x40000000L) != 0 ? "r" : "-") + ((flags & 0x80000000L) != 0 ? "w" : "-") + ((flags & 0x20000000L) != 0 ? "x" : "-");
            sections.add(new Section(name, address, virtualSize, rawSize, permissions, entropy(b, pointer, rawSize)));
            raw.add(new long[] {address, Math.max(virtualSize, rawSize), pointer, rawSize});
        }
        var exports = new ArrayList<String>();
        var imports = new ArrayList<Import>();
        var libraries = new ArrayList<String>();
        boolean tls = false;
        try {
            if (directoryCount > 0) {
                long rva = u32(b, directories, true), size = u32(b, directories + 4, true);
                int at = offset(raw, rva);
                if (size > 0 && at >= 0) {
                    long names = Math.min(u32(b, at + 24, true), MAX_NAMES);
                    int nameTable = offset(raw, u32(b, at + 32, true));
                    for (int i = 0; i < names && nameTable >= 0; i++) {
                        int name = offset(raw, u32(b, nameTable + 4 * i, true));
                        if (name >= 0) exports.add(cString(b, name, 512));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (directoryCount > 1) {
                int at = offset(raw, u32(b, directories + 8, true));
                for (int d = 0; at >= 0 && d < MAX_LIBRARIES; d++, at += 20) {
                    long lookup = u32(b, at, true), nameRva = u32(b, at + 12, true), first = u32(b, at + 16, true);
                    if (lookup == 0 && nameRva == 0 && first == 0) break;
                    int nameAt = offset(raw, nameRva);
                    String library = nameAt < 0 ? "?" : cString(b, nameAt, 256);
                    libraries.add(library);
                    int thunk = offset(raw, lookup != 0 ? lookup : first);
                    for (int t = 0; thunk >= 0 && imports.size() < MAX_NAMES; t++) {
                        long value = plus ? u64(b, thunk + 8L * t) : u32(b, thunk + 4 * t, true);
                        if (value == 0) break;
                        boolean ordinal = plus ? value < 0 : (value & 0x80000000L) != 0;
                        if (ordinal) { imports.add(new Import(library, "#" + (value & 0xffff))); continue; }
                        int hint = offset(raw, value & 0x7fffffffL);
                        imports.add(new Import(library, hint < 0 ? "?" : cString(b, hint + 2, 256)));
                    }
                }
            }
            if (directoryCount > 9) tls = u32(b, directories + 72, true) != 0 && u32(b, directories + 76, true) != 0;
        } catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException truncated) {
            problems.add("export or import directory truncated");
        }
        String arch = switch (machine) {
            case 0x14c -> "x86"; case 0x8664 -> "x86-64"; case 0xaa64 -> "AArch64"; case 0x1c4 -> "ARM (Thumb-2)";
            default -> String.format(Locale.ROOT, "machine 0x%04x", machine);
        };
        return new Headers(plus ? "PE32+" : "PE32", arch, plus ? 64 : 32, entry, sections, exports, imports, libraries, tls, problems);
    }

    private static int offset(List<long[]> sections, long rva) {
        if (rva <= 0) return -1;
        for (long[] s : sections) {
            if (rva >= s[0] && rva < s[0] + s[1]) {
                long delta = rva - s[0];
                if (delta >= s[3]) return -1;
                long at = s[2] + delta;
                return at > Integer.MAX_VALUE ? -1 : (int) at;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }

    private static Headers elf(byte[] b) {
        var problems = new ArrayList<String>();
        boolean wide = b[4] == 2, little = b[5] != 2;
        int machine = u16(b, 18, little);
        long entry = wide ? u64le(b, 24, little) : u32(b, 24, little);
        long sectionOffset = wide ? u64le(b, 40, little) : u32(b, 32, little);
        int entrySize = u16(b, wide ? 58 : 46, little), count = u16(b, wide ? 60 : 48, little), names = u16(b, wide ? 62 : 50, little);
        if (count > MAX_SECTIONS * 2) { problems.add(count + " sections; only " + MAX_SECTIONS * 2 + " read"); count = MAX_SECTIONS * 2; }
        var raw = new ArrayList<long[]>(); // name, type, flags, address, offset, size, link, entsize
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
            long at = sectionOffset + (long) entrySize * i;
            if (sectionOffset <= 0 || at + (wide ? 64 : 40) > b.length) { if (sectionOffset > 0) problems.add("section table truncated"); break; }
            int s = (int) at;
            raw.add(wide
                ? new long[] {u32(b, s, little), u32(b, s + 4, little), u64le(b, s + 8, little), u64le(b, s + 16, little), u64le(b, s + 24, little),
                    u64le(b, s + 32, little), u32(b, s + 40, little), u64le(b, s + 56, little)}
                : new long[] {u32(b, s, little), u32(b, s + 4, little), u32(b, s + 8, little), u32(b, s + 12, little), u32(b, s + 16, little),
                    u32(b, s + 20, little), u32(b, s + 24, little), u32(b, s + 36, little)});
        }
        long[] nameTable = names < raw.size() ? raw.get(names) : null;
        var sections = new ArrayList<Section>();
        var exports = new ArrayList<String>();
        var imports = new ArrayList<Import>();
        var needed = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (long[] s : raw) {
            if (s[1] == 0) continue; // SHT_NULL
            String name = nameTable == null ? "" : stringAt(b, nameTable, s[0]);
            boolean nobits = s[1] == 8;
            String permissions = ((s[2] & 2) != 0 ? "r" : "-") + ((s[2] & 1) != 0 ? "w" : "-") + ((s[2] & 4) != 0 ? "x" : "-");
            if (sections.size() < MAX_SECTIONS)
                sections.add(new Section(name, s[3], s[5], nobits ? 0 : s[5], permissions, nobits ? -1 : entropy(b, s[4], s[5])));
            if (s[1] == 11 && s[6] < raw.size()) { // SHT_DYNSYM, linked string table
                long[] strings = raw.get((int) s[6]);
                long size = wide ? 24 : 16;
                for (long at = s[4] + size; at + size <= s[4] + s[5] && at + size <= b.length; at += size) {
                    int e = (int) at;
                    long nameOffset = u32(b, e, little);
                    int info = b[e + (wide ? 4 : 12)] & 0xff, index = u16(b, e + (wide ? 6 : 14), little);
                    int bind = info >> 4, type = info & 0xf;
                    if (nameOffset == 0 || (bind != 1 && bind != 2)) continue;
                    String symbol = stringAt(b, strings, nameOffset);
                    if (index != 0 && type == 2 && exports.size() < MAX_NAMES) exports.add(symbol);
                    else if (index == 0 && (type == 2 || type == 0) && imports.size() < MAX_NAMES) imports.add(new Import("", symbol));
                }
            }
            if (s[1] == 6 && s[6] < raw.size()) { // SHT_DYNAMIC: DT_NEEDED names
                long[] strings = raw.get((int) s[6]);
                long size = wide ? 16 : 8;
                for (long at = s[4]; at + size <= s[4] + s[5] && at + size <= b.length && needed.size() < MAX_LIBRARIES; at += size) {
                    long tag = wide ? u64le(b, (int) at, little) : u32(b, (int) at, little);
                    if (tag == 0) break;
                    if (tag == 1) needed.add(stringAt(b, strings, wide ? u64le(b, (int) at + 8, little) : u32(b, (int) at + 4, little)));
                }
            }
        }
        String arch = switch (machine) {
            case 3 -> "x86"; case 62 -> "x86-64"; case 183 -> "AArch64"; case 40 -> "ARM"; case 8 -> "MIPS"; case 20 -> "PowerPC";
            case 21 -> "PowerPC64"; case 22 -> "S390"; case 243 -> "RISC-V"; case 258 -> "LoongArch"; case 2 -> "SPARC";
            default -> "machine " + machine;
        };
        return new Headers(wide ? "ELF64" : "ELF32", arch, wide ? 64 : 32, entry, sections, exports, imports, needed, false, problems);
    }

    /** {@code little}: the magic read big-endian was cefaedfe/cffaedfe, so the file is little-endian. */
    private static Headers machO(byte[] b, boolean little) {
        long cpu = u32(b, 4, little);
        boolean wide = (cpu & 0x01000000L) != 0;
        String arch = switch ((int) (cpu & 0xffffff)) {
            case 7 -> wide ? "x86-64" : "x86"; case 12 -> wide ? "AArch64" : "ARM"; case 18 -> wide ? "PowerPC64" : "PowerPC";
            default -> "cpu " + cpu;
        };
        return new Headers(wide ? "Mach-O 64" : "Mach-O", arch, wide ? 64 : 32, -1, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), List.of(), false,
            List.of("Mach-O load commands are not parsed by ClassRevive; Ghidra reads them"));
    }

    /** Packing hints from header facts only (names, sizes, entropy, imports). A hypothesis, never proof. */
    public static Packing packing(Headers headers) {
        var hints = new ArrayList<String>();
        var packers = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
        boolean strong = false;
        long unnamed = headers.sections().stream().filter(Section::unnamed).count();
        if (unnamed >= 2) { hints.add(unnamed + " sections without a name"); strong = true; }
        for (var section : headers.sections()) {
            String name = section.name().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
            String packer = packerSection(name);
            if (packer != null) { hints.add("section " + section.name().trim() + " (" + packer + " name)"); packers.add(packer); strong = true; }
            if (section.executable() && section.rawSize() == 0 && section.virtualSize() > 0) {
                hints.add("executable section " + label(section) + " has no file data (" + section.virtualSize() + " bytes filled at run time)");
                strong = true;
            }
            if (section.executable() && section.rawSize() >= 4096 && section.entropyMillibits() >= HIGH_ENTROPY) {
                hints.add("executable section " + label(section) + " has entropy " + bits(section.entropyMillibits()) + " bits/byte (compressed or encrypted)");
                strong = true;
            }
        }
        headers.entrySection().ifPresent(section -> {
            var executable = headers.sections().stream().filter(Section::executable).findFirst();
            if (executable.isPresent() && executable.get() != section) hints.add("entry point in section " + label(section) + ", not the first code section");
        });
        if (headers.format().startsWith("PE") && headers.neededLibraries().size() >= 5
            && headers.imports().size() <= headers.neededLibraries().size() * 3 / 2) {
            hints.add(headers.imports().size() + " imports from " + headers.neededLibraries().size()
                + " libraries (one or two each: the rest resolved at run time)");
            strong = true;
        }
        if (headers.tls() && strong) hints.add("TLS callback directory present (code that runs before the entry point)");
        boolean boot = headers.sections().stream().anyMatch(s -> s.name().trim().equalsIgnoreCase(".boot"));
        var suspected = new ArrayList<String>(packers);
        if (unnamed >= 2 && boot) { suspected.remove("Themida/WinLicense"); suspected.addFirst("Themida/WinLicense 3.x"); }
        return new Packing(strong ? "LIKELY_PACKED" : "NOT_DETECTED", hints, suspected);
    }

    private static String packerSection(String name) {
        if (name.equals(".boot") || name.equals(".themida") || name.equals(".winlice")) return "Themida/WinLicense";
        if (name.matches("\\.vmp[0-9]")) return "VMProtect";
        if (name.equals(".vlizer")) return "Oreans Code Virtualizer"; // Phase 2CE
        if (name.matches("\\.?upx[0-9!]?")) return "UPX";
        if (name.equals(".aspack") || name.equals(".adata")) return "ASPack";
        if (name.matches("\\.mpress[12]")) return "MPRESS";
        if (name.matches("\\.enigma[12]")) return "Enigma Protector";
        if (name.equals(".petite")) return "Petite";
        if (name.matches("\\.nsp[012]")) return "NsPack";
        if (name.equals("pec1") || name.equals("pec2") || name.equals(".pec")) return "PECompact";
        return null;
    }

    static String label(Section section) { return section.unnamed() ? "(unnamed @0x" + Long.toHexString(section.virtualAddress()) + ")" : section.name().trim(); }
    static String bits(int millibits) { return String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%d.%02d", millibits / 1000, (millibits % 1000) / 10); }

    /** Shannon entropy of {@code bytes[offset, offset + length)} clipped to the file, times 1000; -1 when empty. */
    static int entropy(byte[] bytes, long offset, long length) {
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= bytes.length || length <= 0) return -1;
        int end = (int) Math.min(bytes.length, offset + length);
        long[] counts = new long[256];
        for (int i = (int) offset; i < end; i++) counts[bytes[i] & 0xff]++;
        double total = end - offset, bits = 0;
        for (long count : counts) if (count > 0) { double p = count / total; bits -= p * (Math.log(p) / Math.log(2)); }
        return (int) Math.round(bits * 1000);
    }

    private static String stringAt(byte[] b, long[] table, long offset) {
        long at = table[4] + offset;
        if (offset < 0 || offset >= table[5] || at >= b.length) return "?";
        return cString(b, (int) at, 512);
    }
    private static String cString(byte[] b, int at, int max) {
        int end = at;
        while (end < b.length && end - at < max && b[end] != 0) end++;
        return clean(new String(b, at, end - at, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1));
    }
    private static String ascii(byte[] b, int at, int length) {
        int end = at;
        while (end < at + length && b[end] != 0) end++;
        return clean(new String(b, at, end - at, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1));
    }
    /** Names are untrusted: anything outside printable ASCII becomes \\xNN so every report line stays one line. */
    static String clean(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : text.toCharArray()) {
            if (c >= 0x20 && c < 0x7f) out.append(c); else out.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "\\x%02x", (int) c));
        }
        return out.toString();
    }
    private static int u16(byte[] b, int at, boolean little) {
        return little ? (b[at] & 0xff) | (b[at + 1] & 0xff) << 8 : (b[at] & 0xff) << 8 | (b[at + 1] & 0xff);
    }
    private static long u32(byte[] b, int at, boolean little) {
        long v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) v |= (long) (b[at + i] & 0xff) << (little ? 8 * i : 8 * (3 - i));
        return v;
    }
    private static long u64(byte[] b, long at) { return u64le(b, Math.toIntExact(at), true); }
    private static long u64le(byte[] b, int at, boolean little) {
        long v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) v |= (long) (b[at + i] & 0xff) << (little ? 8 * i : 8 * (7 - i));
        return v;
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ObfuscationSummary.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscationProfile;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscatorClassifier;
import java.util.*;

/** Phase 2BZ: readable and JSON forms of a static obfuscation profile and its obfuscator hypotheses. */
public final class ObfuscationSummary {
    public static final String INTERPRETATION = "Static patterns only; nothing was executed or decrypted. The suggested obfuscator is a hypothesis "
        + "from documented rules (docs/obfuscation-detection.md), never proof: obfuscators share techniques and a jar can be processed by several tools.";

    private ObfuscationSummary() {}

    /** One line, e.g. {@code string encryption: 107 classes; hidden calls ...: 1514 sites in 103 classes; suggested obfuscator: ...}. */
    public static String line(ObfuscationProfile profile, ObfuscatorClassifier.Result result) {
        var parts = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var entry : profile.techniques().entrySet()) parts.add(entry.getKey().label() + ": " + count(profile, entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()));
        if (parts.isEmpty()) parts.add("no obfuscation technique detected");
        parts.add("suggested obfuscator: " + result.summary());
        return String.join("; ", parts);
    }

    /** Several lines with the counts, the hypotheses and their reasons. */
    public static String text(ObfuscationProfile profile, ObfuscatorClassifier.Result result) {
        var out = new StringBuilder("Obfuscation (static, " + profile.classes() + " classes"
            + (profile.unparsable() > 0 ? ", " + profile.unparsable() + " unparsable" : "") + "):\n");
        if (profile.techniques().isEmpty()) out.append("  no obfuscation technique detected\n");
        for (var entry : profile.techniques().entrySet())
            out.append("  ").append(entry.getKey().label()).append(": ").append(count(profile, entry.getKey(), entry.getValue())).append('\n');
        out.append("Suggested obfuscator: ").append(result.summary()).append('\n');
        for (var hypothesis : result.hypotheses()) {
            out.append("  ").append(hypothesis.obfuscator()).append(" (").append(hypothesis.confidence()).append(", ")
                .append(hypothesis.score()).append("/100):\n");
            for (String reason : hypothesis.reasons()) out.append("    - ").append(reason).append('\n');
        }
        out.append("  (suggestion from static patterns, not proof)\n");
        return out.toString();
    }

    private static String count(ObfuscationProfile profile, ObfuscationProfile.Technique technique, ObfuscationProfile.Count count) {
        return switch (technique) {
            case HIDDEN_CALLS -> count.occurrences() + " sites in " + count.classes() + " classes";
            case STRING_ENCRYPTION -> count.classes() + " classes, " + count.occurrences() + " decryption sites (" + profile.metric("strings.indy_sites")
                + " invokedynamic, " + profile.metric("strings.decryptor_calls") + " direct calls, " + (profile.metric("strings.clinit_crypto")
                + profile.metric("strings.clinit_xor")) + " <clinit>)" + (profile.metric("strings.native_key_classes") > 0
                ? "; keys supplied by the native layer in " + profile.metric("strings.native_key_classes") + " classes" : "");
            case CONSTANT_ENCRYPTION -> count.occurrences() + " sites in " + count.classes() + " classes (" + profile.metric("constants.indy_int_sites")
                + " int, " + profile.metric("constants.indy_long_sites") + " long)";
            case CASE_COLLISIONS -> count.occurrences() + " groups, " + count.classes() + " classes";
            case NATIVE_LAYER -> count.occurrences() + " native methods/libraries in " + count.classes() + " classes";
            case EXCEPTION_OBFUSCATION -> count.occurrences() + " handlers in " + count.classes() + " classes";
            default -> count.classes() + " classes, " + count.occurrences() + " occurrences";
        };
    }

    public static Map<String,Object> json(ObfuscationProfile profile, ObfuscatorClassifier.Result result) {
        var data = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        data.put("classes", profile.classes()); data.put("unparsable_classes", profile.unparsable());
        var techniques = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        profile.techniques().forEach((technique, count) -> {
            var row = new TreeMap<String,Object>(); row.put("label", technique.label()); row.put("classes", count.classes());
            row.put("occurrences", count.occurrences()); row.put("samples", count.samples());
            techniques.put(technique.name(), row);
        });
        data.put("techniques", techniques);
        data.put("indicators", new TreeMap<String,Object>(profile.metrics()));
        data.put("verdict", result.verdict());
        data.put("suggested_obfuscator", result.summary());
        data.put("hypotheses", result.hypotheses().stream().map(h -> {
            var row = new TreeMap<String,Object>(); row.put("obfuscator", h.obfuscator()); row.put("score", h.score());
            row.put("confidence", h.confidence()); row.put("reasons", h.reasons()); return (Object) row; }).toList());
        data.put("summary", line(profile, result));
        data.put("interpretation", INTERPRETATION);
        return data;
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ProjectExport.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

/**
 * Phase 2CG: the selected sources as a project an IDE opens directly, under {@code project/}: sources in
 * {@code src/main/java}, the input JAR's resources in {@code src/main/resources}, the {@code --classpath} JARs in
 * {@code lib/}, a {@code build.gradle} and {@code settings.gradle} for the originals' Java release, and a README that
 * says where the code came from. Resources are copied from the job's own snapshot of the input, entry by entry: names
 * that could leave the folder are refused, and counts and bytes are bounded. Nothing is executed.
 */
final class ProjectExport {
    private ProjectExport() {}
    static final int MAX_RESOURCES = 20_000;
    static final long MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES = 256L * 1024 * 1024;

    record Result(int sources, int resources, int skippedResources, int libraries, int release) {}

    static Result write(Path output, Path selected, Path snapshot, List<Path> dependencies, List<ClassInfo> originals,
                        VerificationResult verification, String inputName) throws IOException {
        Path project = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve("project"));
        Path java = Files.createDirectories(project.resolve("src/main/java"));
        int sources = 0;
        if (Files.isDirectory(selected, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) {
            try (var paths = Files.walk(selected)) {
                for (var path : paths.filter(Files::isRegularFile).sorted().toList()) {
                    if (Files.isSymbolicLink(path)) throw new IOException("Unsafe selected sources");
                    Path target = java.resolve(selected.relativize(path).toString()).normalize();
                    if (!target.startsWith(java)) throw new IOException("Unsafe selected sources");
                    Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
                    Files.copy(path, target);
                    if (path.toString().endsWith(".java")) sources++;
                }
            }
        }
        int resources = 0, skipped = 0;
        if (snapshot.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".jar")) {
            Path folder = Files.createDirectories(project.resolve("src/main/resources"));
            long bytes = 0;
            try (var zip = new ZipFile(snapshot.toFile())) {
                var entries = zip.entries();
                while (entries.hasMoreElements()) {
                    var entry = entries.nextElement();
                    String name = entry.getName();
                    if (entry.isDirectory() || name.endsWith(".class") || !resource(name)) continue;
                    if (!safe(name) || resources >= MAX_RESOURCES) { skipped++; continue; }
                    Path target = folder.resolve(name).normalize();
                    if (!target.startsWith(folder) || entry.getSize() > MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES - bytes) { skipped++; continue; }
                    Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
                    // A resource that would pass the byte budget is left out (and its partial copy removed); the job goes on.
                    long before = bytes; boolean fits = true;
                    try (InputStream in = zip.getInputStream(entry); var out = Files.newOutputStream(target, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
                        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192]; int read;
                        while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) {
                            bytes += read;
                            if (bytes > MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES) { fits = false; break; }
                            out.write(buffer, 0, read);
                        }
                    } catch (FileAlreadyExistsException duplicate) { skipped++; continue; } // e.g. names differing only by case
                    if (!fits) { Files.deleteIfExists(target); bytes = before; skipped++; continue; }
                    resources++;
                }
            }
        }
        var libraries = new ArrayList<String>();
        if (!dependencies.isEmpty()) {
            Path lib = Files.createDirectory(project.resolve("lib"));
            var used = new HashSet<String>();
            for (var dependency : dependencies) {
                String name = dependency.getFileName().toString();
                if (!safe(name) || name.contains("/") || !used.add(name)) name = "dependency-" + (libraries.size() + 1) + ".jar";
                Files.copy(dependency, lib.resolve(name), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
                libraries.add(name);
            }
        }
        int release = Math.max(8, originals.stream().filter(info -> !info.name().equals("module-info"))
            .mapToInt(ClassInfo::javaVersion).max().orElse(8));
        Files.writeString(project.resolve("settings.gradle"), "rootProject.name = '" + projectName(inputName) + "'\n", StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        // No toolchain block: options.release works with any installed JDK at or above the release, without downloads.
        var build = new StringBuilder("// Generated by ClassRevive from decompiled sources; see README.md.\nplugins {\n    id 'java'\n}\n\n")
            .append("tasks.withType(JavaCompile).configureEach {\n    options.release = ").append(release).append("\n    options.encoding = 'UTF-8'\n}\n");
        if (!libraries.isEmpty()) {
            build.append("\ndependencies {\n");
            for (var library : libraries) build.append("    implementation files('lib/").append(library).append("')\n");
            build.append("}\n");
        }
        Files.writeString(project.resolve("build.gradle"), build, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Files.writeString(project.resolve("README.md"), readme(inputName, verification, sources, resources, skipped, libraries, release), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        return new Result(sources, resources, skipped, libraries.size(), release);
    }

    /** Resource entries worth keeping: not JAR signatures, the manifest, or multi-release class variants. */
    private static boolean resource(String name) {
        String upper = name.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
        if (upper.equals("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF") || upper.startsWith("META-INF/VERSIONS/")) return false;
        return !(upper.startsWith("META-INF/") && (upper.endsWith(".SF") || upper.endsWith(".RSA") || upper.endsWith(".DSA") || upper.endsWith(".EC")));
    }
    /** A relative name with "/" separators and no empty, "." or ".." part, no drive, backslash or control character. */
    static boolean safe(String name) {
        if (name.isEmpty() || name.startsWith("/") || name.contains("\\") || name.contains(":") || name.length() > 1024) return false;
        for (int i = 0; i < name.length(); i++) if (name.charAt(i) < 0x20) return false;
        for (String part : name.split("/", -1)) if (part.isEmpty() || part.equals(".") || part.equals("..")) return false;
        return true;
    }
    private static String projectName(String inputName) {
        String base = inputName.replaceAll("(?i)\\.(jar|class)$", "");
        String cleaned = base.replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "-");
        return cleaned.isEmpty() ? "decompiled" : cleaned + "-decompiled";
    }
    private static String readme(String inputName, VerificationResult verification, int sources, int resources, int skipped,
                                 List<String> libraries, int release) {
        var out = new StringBuilder("# ").append(projectName(inputName)).append("\n\n")
            .append("Decompiled by ClassRevive from `").append(inputName.replace("`", "'")).append("`. This is **not the original source**: ")
            .append("comments, formatting and some names were lost in compilation. Behavior was not verified.\n\n")
            .append("- Compilation check: ").append(verification.status()).append(verification.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED
                ? " (the sources recompiled with javac)" : " (" + verification.errors() + " javac error(s); see `../report.html`)").append('\n')
            .append("- Structural signatures: ").append(verification.matchedSymbols()).append('/').append(verification.expectedSymbols()).append('\n')
            .append("- Java sources: ").append(sources).append(" in `src/main/java`\n")
            .append("- Resources from the JAR: ").append(resources).append(" in `src/main/resources`")
            .append(skipped == 0 ? "" : " (" + skipped + " skipped: unsafe names, duplicates or over the limit)").append('\n')
            .append("- Libraries: ").append(libraries.isEmpty() ? "none given (pass `--classpath` to `decompile`)" : String.join(", ", libraries) + " in `lib/`").append('\n')
            .append(libraries.contains(DecompilationJob.STUB_JAR) ? "- `lib/" + DecompilationJob.STUB_JAR + "` holds **inferred stand-ins** for libraries that were "
                + "missing: they only let the code compile and do nothing at run time. Replace them with the real libraries.\n" : "")
            .append('\n')
            .append("## Open it\n\nOpen this folder in IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse or VS Code (with the Java extension) and import it as a Gradle project. ")
            .append("It compiles with `options.release = ").append(release).append("`. Build it from a terminal with an installed Gradle:\n\n")
            .append("```\ngradle build\n```\n\nThe confidence of each class is in `../report.html`.\n");
        return out.toString();
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ReferenceCompareJob.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import dev.classrevive.verification.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CD: measures a decompile result against a reference ("answer key") JAR, the unobfuscated original of the JAR
 * that was decompiled. Only javac runs (in the existing compiler workers); no class of either JAR is loaded or executed.
 *
 * <p>Two separate scores, never mixed:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>compiles + structure</b>: the selected sources compiled as a whole (and, if not, file by file) against the
 *   reference classes; reference signatures (classes, fields, methods with descriptors) the sources declare; reference
 *   method bodies the recompiled classes reproduce ({@link MethodRoundTrip}, identical or equivalent after
 *   normalization).</li>
 *   <li><b>readability</b>: reference string literals that appear verbatim in the sources, and source files of reference
 *   classes that still name a class the reference does not have (an obfuscator's helper, factory or runtime).</li>
 * </ul>
 */
public final class ReferenceCompareJob {
    public record Result(VerificationResult whole, PartialRoundTrip.Result perFile, int referenceBodies,
                         int literals, int literalsFound, int referenceFiles, int filesNamingForeignClasses,
                         List<String> foreignClasses) {
        public int bodiesRecovered() {
            if (whole.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED) return whole.roundTripIdentical() + whole.roundTripEquivalent();
            return perFile == null ? 0 : perFile.identical() + perFile.equivalent();
        }
    }

    public Result run(Path reference, Path decompileOutput, Path output, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies)
            throws IOException {
        reference = reference.toAbsolutePath().normalize(); decompileOutput = decompileOutput.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        output = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path sources = decompileOutput.resolve("selection").resolve("sources");
        if (!Files.isDirectory(sources, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("No selection/sources in the decompile output");
        if (output.getParent() == null || !Files.isDirectory(output.getParent())) throw new IOException("Output parent must exist");
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        var inventory = new InventoryReader().inspect(reference, Limits.defaults());
        if (!inventory.successful()) throw new IOException("Reference rejected: " + inventory.diagnostics().getFirst().code());
        var originals = inventory.entries().stream().map(Inventory.Entry::classInfo).filter(Objects::nonNull)
            .filter(info -> !info.name().startsWith("META-INF/")).toList();
        var referenceClasses = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(reference);
        var whole = new CompilerVerifier().verify(sources, output.resolve("whole"), originals, timeout, dependencies, reference);
        PartialRoundTrip.Result perFile = null;
        if (whole.status() != VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED)
            perFile = new PartialRoundTrip().measure(sources, output.resolve("per-file"), originals, timeout, dependencies, reference);

        // Readability: literals and foreign class names, read from the source text only.
        var texts = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(sources)) {
            for (Path path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(path) || Files.size(path) > 16L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Unsafe source file");
                texts.put(sources.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/'), Files.readString(path, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }
        }
        String all = String.join("\n", texts.values());
        var literals = new TreeSet<String>();
        for (byte[] bytes : referenceClasses.values()) literals.addAll(literals(bytes));
        int found = 0;
        for (String literal : literals) if (all.contains(quote(literal))) found++;
        var inputClasses = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(decompileOutput.resolve("classes.jar")).keySet();
        var foreign = inputClasses.stream().filter(name -> !referenceClasses.containsKey(name) && !name.contains("$")).sorted().toList();
        int referenceFiles = 0, naming = 0;
        for (var entry : texts.entrySet()) {
            String top = entry.getKey().substring(0, entry.getKey().length() - ".java".length());
            if (!referenceClasses.containsKey(top)) continue;
            referenceFiles++;
            String text = entry.getValue();
            if (foreign.stream().anyMatch(name -> mentions(text, name))) naming++;
        }
        var result = new Result(whole, perFile, MethodRoundTrip.countBodies(referenceClasses), literals.size(), found,
            referenceFiles, naming, foreign);
        write(output, reference, decompileOutput, result, inventory.sha256());
        return result;
    }

    private static boolean mentions(String text, String internalName) {
        String dotted = internalName.replace('/', '.');
        int slash = internalName.lastIndexOf('/');
        String simple = internalName.substring(slash + 1);
        if (text.contains(dotted)) return true;
        String pkg = slash < 0 ? "" : internalName.substring(0, slash).replace('/', '.');
        // A simple name only counts when the file imports it or shares its package.
        return (text.contains("import " + dotted + ";") || (!pkg.isEmpty() && text.contains("package " + pkg + ";")))
            && java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("\\b" + java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(simple) + "\\b").matcher(text).find();
    }

    static Set<String> literals(byte[] bytes) {
        var node = new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
        var result = new TreeSet<String>();
        for (var method : node.methods)
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String value && !value.isEmpty() && value.length() <= 200)
                    result.add(value);
        for (var field : node.fields) if (field.value instanceof String value && !value.isEmpty() && value.length() <= 200) result.add(value);
        // An enum's constant names are written as constants in source, not as literals.
        if ((node.access & org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0)
            for (var field : node.fields) if ((field.access & org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0) result.remove(field.name);
        return result;
    }

    /** Java source form of a literal; non-ASCII characters are kept as they are (decompilers that escape them miss). */
    static String quote(String value) {
        var out = new StringBuilder("\"");
        for (char c : value.toCharArray()) {
            switch (c) {
                case '"' -> out.append("\\\"");
                case '\\' -> out.append("\\\\");
                case '\n' -> out.append("\\n");
                case '\t' -> out.append("\\t");
                case '\r' -> out.append("\\r");
                default -> out.append(c);
            }
        }
        return out.append('"').toString();
    }

    private static void write(Path output, Path reference, Path decompileOutput, Result result, String sha) throws IOException {
        var whole = result.whole();
        var report = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        report.put("schema_version", 1); report.put("kind", "reference_comparison"); report.put("behavior", "NOT_VERIFIED");
        report.put("reference_sha256", sha);
        report.put("whole_compilation", EvidenceReport.verification(whole));
        if (result.perFile() != null) report.put("per_file", EvidenceReport.perFile(result.perFile()));
        report.put("reference_bodies", result.referenceBodies()); report.put("bodies_recovered", result.bodiesRecovered());
        report.put("literals", result.literals()); report.put("literals_found", result.literalsFound());
        report.put("reference_source_files", result.referenceFiles());
        report.put("files_naming_foreign_classes", result.filesNamingForeignClasses());
        report.put("foreign_classes", result.foreignClasses().size());
        EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("reference.json"), report);
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("reference.txt"), text(result));
    }

    public static String text(Result result) {
        var whole = result.whole();
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        out.append("Reference comparison (answer key); behavior not verified.\n");
        out.append("Compiles + structure:\n");
        out.append("  whole compilation against the reference: ").append(whole.status())
            .append(whole.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED ? "" : " (" + whole.errors() + " errors in " + whole.fileErrors().size() + " files)").append('\n');
        out.append("  reference signatures declared: ").append(whole.matchedSymbols()).append('/').append(whole.expectedSymbols())
            .append(" (").append(percent(whole.matchedSymbols(), whole.expectedSymbols())).append(")\n");
        if (result.perFile() != null)
            out.append("  files compiled one by one against the reference: ").append(result.perFile().compiledFiles()).append('/').append(result.perFile().files()).append('\n');
        out.append("  reference bodies reproduced (identical or equivalent): ").append(result.bodiesRecovered()).append('/').append(result.referenceBodies())
            .append(" (").append(percent(result.bodiesRecovered(), result.referenceBodies())).append(")")
            .append(whole.status() == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED ? "" : ", per-file credit").append('\n');
        out.append("Readability:\n");
        out.append("  reference string literals present in the sources: ").append(result.literalsFound()).append('/').append(result.literals())
            .append(" (").append(percent(result.literalsFound(), result.literals())).append(")\n");
        out.append("  reference source files naming a class the reference lacks: ").append(result.filesNamingForeignClasses()).append('/')
            .append(result.referenceFiles()).append(" (").append(result.foreignClasses().size()).append(" foreign top-level classes in the input)\n");
        return out.toString();
    }

    static String percent(int part, int total) {
        return total == 0 ? "n/a" : String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%.1f%%", Math.floor(1000.0 * part / total) / 10);
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/RegressionSuite.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassReducer;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Permanent regression cases from the failure lab (Phase 2AT). A case directory holds the reduced {@code classes.jar}
 * and {@code expected.json}: per variant (one engine alone, or all engines combined with source repair, as in the
 * benchmark) the minimum round-trip level of every method body. {@link #check} decompiles each case again and fails a
 * method that drops to a lower level ({@link FailureCase#LEVELS}); a higher level is reported as an improvement so the
 * expectation can be raised. Target code is never executed; levels are recompilation evidence, not behavior.
 */
public final class RegressionSuite {
    public record Check(String caseName, String variant, String method, String expected, String actual) {
        public String verdict() {
            int before = FailureCase.level(expected), after = FailureCase.LEVELS.contains(actual) ? FailureCase.level(actual) : -1;
            return after < before ? "REGRESSED" : after > before ? "IMPROVED" : "SAME";
        }
    }
    public record Report(int cases, List<Check> checks, List<String> errors) {
        public Report { checks = List.copyOf(checks); errors = List.copyOf(errors); }
        public List<Check> regressions() { return checks.stream().filter(check -> check.verdict().equals("REGRESSED")).toList(); }
        public List<Check> improvements() { return checks.stream().filter(check -> check.verdict().equals("IMPROVED")).toList(); }
        public boolean passed() { return errors.isEmpty() && regressions().isEmpty(); }
    }

    /**
     * Turns a minimized case into a regression case: measures every variant twice, records the lower level of each
     * method as its minimum, then writes the classes (and compile-only context) with {@code expected.json}. Nothing is
     * written to {@code destination} when a measurement is unreliable (a worker that could not run).
     *
     * @param provenance where the reduced classes come from and under which license; only authored or license-compatible
     *                   inputs may be committed
     */
    public Map<String,Object> promote(Path minimized, Path destination, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, Duration timeout,
                                      String provenance) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        minimized = minimized.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        var failure = FailureCase.fromJson(Json.decode(Files.readString(minimized.resolve("case.json"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
        if (engines.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Select at least one engine");
        destination = destination.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (Files.exists(destination, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new FileAlreadyExistsException(destination.toString());
        Path classes = minimized.resolve("classes.jar");
        Path context = failure.context() == null ? null : minimized.resolve(failure.context()).normalize();
        if (context != null && !Files.isRegularFile(context, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) context = null;
        // Measurement jobs stay next to the minimized case (lab output), never inside the regression directory. The
        // name is short on purpose: deep job paths can exceed the Windows limit for a process working directory.
        Path work = null;
        for (int index = 1; work == null; index++) {
            try { work = Files.createDirectory(minimized.getParent().resolve(index == 1 ? "promotion" : "promotion-" + index)); }
            catch (FileAlreadyExistsException taken) { if (index >= 1000) throw taken; }
        }
        var variants = new TreeMap<String,Object>(); var unstable = new TreeSet<String>(); var versions = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        engines.forEach(engine -> versions.put(engine.id(), engine.version()));
        for (var variant : variants(engines).entrySet()) {
            boolean repair = variant.getValue().size() > 1;
            Map<String,String> lowest = null;
            for (String run : List.of("a", "b")) {
                var levels = measure(classes, context, work.resolve(variant.getKey() + "-" + run), variant.getValue(), repair, timeout);
                if (lowest == null) { lowest = levels; continue; }
                for (var entry : levels.entrySet()) {
                    String other = lowest.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), "NOT_RECOMPILED");
                    if (!other.equals(entry.getValue())) unstable.add(variant.getKey() + " " + entry.getKey());
                    if (FailureCase.level(entry.getValue()) < FailureCase.level(other)) lowest.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
                }
            }
            var data = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
            data.put("engines", variant.getValue().stream().map(DecompilerEngine::id).toList());
            data.put("source_repair", repair); data.put("minimum_levels", lowest);
            variants.put(variant.getKey(), data);
        }
        Files.createDirectory(destination);
        Files.copy(classes, destination.resolve("classes.jar"));
        if (context != null) Files.copy(context, destination.resolve("context.jar"));
        Files.copy(minimized.resolve("case.json"), destination.resolve("case.json"));
        var expected = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        expected.put("schema_version", 1); expected.put("kind", "regression-case"); expected.put("name", destination.getFileName().toString());
        expected.put("provenance", provenance); expected.put("signature", failure.signature());
        expected.put("classes_sha256", FailureCollector.sha256(Files.readAllBytes(destination.resolve("classes.jar"))));
        expected.put("context", Files.exists(destination.resolve("context.jar")));
        expected.put("variants", variants); expected.put("unstable_at_promotion", List.copyOf(unstable));
        expected.put("measured_with", Map.of("java_version", System.getProperty("java.version"), "engines", versions));
        expected.put("levels", FailureCase.LEVELS);
        expected.put("note", "minimum_levels are the levels measured at promotion (lower of two runs). lab-check fails when a method "
            + "drops below them and reports IMPROVED when one rises; raise the expectation when a fix lands.");
        EvidenceReport.write(destination.resolve("expected.json"), expected);
        return expected;
    }

    /** Re-runs every case under {@code regressions} into a new {@code output} directory and writes the verdicts there. */
    public Report check(Path regressions, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> available, Duration timeout) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        regressions = regressions.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        output = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        if (output.startsWith(regressions)) throw new IOException("Output must be outside the regression directory");
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        var cases = new ArrayList<Path>();
        try (var list = Files.list(regressions)) {
            for (var path : list.sorted().toList())
                if (Files.isDirectory(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && Files.isRegularFile(path.resolve("expected.json"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) cases.add(path);
        }
        if (cases.size() > 1000) throw new IOException("Too many regression cases");
        var checks = new ArrayList<Check>(); var errors = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var directory : cases) {
            String name = directory.getFileName().toString();
            try {
                var expected = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(directory.resolve("expected.json"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                if (!"regression-case".equals(expected.get("kind")) || !Long.valueOf(1).equals(expected.get("schema_version")))
                    throw new IOException("not a regression case");
                byte[] jar = Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("classes.jar"));
                if (!FailureCollector.sha256(jar).equals(expected.get("classes_sha256"))) throw new IOException("classes.jar does not match classes_sha256");
                for (var variant : new TreeMap<>((Map<?,?>) expected.get("variants")).entrySet()) {
                    var data = (Map<?,?>) variant.getValue();
                    var engines = new ArrayList<DecompilerEngine>();
                    for (Object id : (List<?>) data.get("engines"))
                        engines.add(available.stream().filter(engine -> engine.id().equals(id)).findFirst()
                            .orElseThrow(() -> new IOException("engine " + id + " is not available")));
                    Path context = directory.resolve("context.jar");
                    var actual = measure(directory.resolve("classes.jar"), Files.isRegularFile(context, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) ? context : null,
                        output.resolve(name).resolve(String.valueOf(variant.getKey())), engines, Boolean.TRUE.equals(data.get("source_repair")), timeout);
                    for (var level : new TreeMap<>((Map<?,?>) data.get("minimum_levels")).entrySet()) {
                        FailureCase.level(String.valueOf(level.getValue()));
                        checks.add(new Check(name, String.valueOf(variant.getKey()), String.valueOf(level.getKey()), String.valueOf(level.getValue()),
                            actual.getOrDefault(String.valueOf(level.getKey()), "ABSENT")));
                    }
                }
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException error) {
                errors.add(name + ": " + FailureCollector.redact(String.valueOf(error.getMessage()), regressions));
            }
        }
        var report = new Report(cases.size(), checks, errors);
        write(report, output);
        return report;
    }

    /** One variant per engine (engine baseline, no repair) plus {@code combined} with every engine, as in the benchmark. */
    static Map<String,List<DecompilerEngine>> variants(List<DecompilerEngine> engines) {
        var result = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<DecompilerEngine>>();
        for (var engine : engines) result.put(engine.id(), List.of(engine));
        if (engines.size() > 1) result.put("combined", List.copyOf(engines));
        return result;
    }

    /** Level of every original method body after one job; bodies the job did not recompile are NOT_RECOMPILED. */
    private static Map<String,String> measure(Path classes, Path context, Path work, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, boolean repair,
                                              Duration timeout) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        Files.createDirectories(work.getParent());
        var dependencies = context == null ? List.<Path>of() : List.of(context);
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(classes, work, engines, timeout, dependencies, repair);
        String unreliable = unreliable(job);
        if (unreliable != null) throw new IOException("unreliable measurement in " + work.getFileName() + ": " + unreliable);
        return levels(job, MethodRoundTrip.readJar(classes));
    }

    /**
     * A worker that could not start, failed on the host side, ran out of time or was cancelled says nothing about the
     * engine; its NOT_RECOMPILED must never become an expectation or a verdict. An engine exiting with an error is a result.
     */
    static String unreliable(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job) {
        if (job.selection().verification().status() == dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult.Status.WORKER_FAILED)
            return "the compiler worker failed (" + job.selection().verification().detail() + ")";
        for (var engine : job.engines())
            switch (engine.diagnosticCode()) {
                case WORKER_SETUP_FAILED, WORKER_START_FAILED, WORKER_RUNTIME_FAILURE, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, OUTPUT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, CANCELLED -> {
                    return engine.engine() + " worker " + engine.diagnosticCode();
                }
                default -> { }
            }
        return null;
    }

    static Map<String,String> levels(DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, Map<String,byte[]> originals) {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for (var entry : originals.entrySet())
            for (var member : ClassReducer.members(entry.getValue()))
                if (member.method() && member.hasBody()) result.put(entry.getKey() + "." + member.key(), "NOT_RECOMPILED");
        for (var item : job.selection().verification().roundTrip())
            for (var method : item.methods()) result.put(item.className() + "." + method.name() + method.descriptor(), method.outcome().name());
        return result;
    }

    private static void write(Report report, Path output) throws IOException {
        var data = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        data.put("schema_version", 1); data.put("kind", "regression-check"); data.put("cases", (long) report.cases());
        data.put("passed", report.passed()); data.put("errors", report.errors());
        data.put("checks", report.checks().stream().map(check -> Map.of("case", check.caseName(), "variant", check.variant(),
            "method", check.method(), "expected_minimum", check.expected(), "actual", check.actual(), "verdict", check.verdict())).toList());
        data.put("behavior", "NOT_VERIFIED");
        EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("regressions.json"), data);
        var text = new StringBuilder("# ClassRevive regression check\n\n")
            .append(report.passed() ? "PASSED" : "FAILED").append(": ").append(report.cases()).append(" case(s), ")
            .append(report.checks().size()).append(" method check(s), ").append(report.regressions().size()).append(" regressed, ")
            .append(report.improvements().size()).append(" improved, ").append(report.errors().size()).append(" error(s).\n\n");
        if (!report.checks().isEmpty()) {
            text.append("| Case | Variant | Method | Expected minimum | Actual | Verdict |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n");
            for (var check : report.checks())
                text.append("| ").append(check.caseName()).append(" | ").append(check.variant()).append(" | `").append(check.method())
                    .append("` | ").append(check.expected()).append(" | ").append(check.actual()).append(" | ").append(check.verdict()).append(" |\n");
        }
        for (var error : report.errors()) text.append("\nError: ").append(error).append('\n');
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("regressions.md"), text, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/RenameJob.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.intake.MultiRelease;
import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import dev.classrevive.model.Limits;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.ClassRenamer;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.MappingFile;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.ProguardMapping;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.RenameEngine;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.security.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

public final class RenameJob {
    public record Result(boolean successful,int classes,int renamed,int members,int reflectionRewrites,EngineResult worker) {}
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,Duration timeout) throws IOException,InterruptedException { return run(input,output,timeout,null); }
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,Duration timeout,Path mappingFile) throws IOException,InterruptedException { return run(input,output,timeout,mappingFile,false); }
    /** With {@code proguard}, the mapping is a ProGuard/R8 mapping.txt whose safely applicable subset restores original names. */
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,Duration timeout,Path mappingFile,boolean proguard) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        if(proguard&&mappingFile==null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("ProGuard mode requires a mapping file");
        if(timeout.isNegative()||timeout.isZero()||timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofHours(1))>0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Timeout must be >0 and <=1 hour");
        input=input.toAbsolutePath().normalize(); output=SafePaths.resolveParents(output);
        String name=input.getFileName()==null?"":input.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        boolean jar=name.endsWith(".jar");
        if((!jar&&!name.endsWith(".class"))||!Files.isRegularFile(input,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("Expected regular .jar or .class input");
        byte[] mappingBytes=null,proguardBytes=null; MappingFile.Plan mappingPlan=null; ProguardMapping.Parsed proguardMapping=null;
        if(mappingFile!=null) {
            mappingFile=mappingFile.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
            if(!Files.isRegularFile(mappingFile,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("Mapping file must be a regular file");
            if(proguard) {
                proguardBytes=readBounded(mappingFile,ProguardMapping.MAX_BYTES,"ProGuard mapping");
                proguardMapping=ProguardMapping.parse(proguardBytes);
            } else {
                mappingBytes=readBounded(mappingFile,MappingFile.MAX_BYTES,"Mapping file");
                mappingPlan=MappingFile.parse(mappingBytes);
            }
        }
        if(output.getParent()==null||!Files.isDirectory(output.getParent())) throw new IOException("Output parent must exist");
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        var report=new TreeMap<String,Object>(); report.put("schema_version",1); report.put("kind","class_rename");
        report.put("behavior","NOT_VERIFIED");
        report.put("limitation","Generated aliases or explicit mappings, not recovered originals. Standard manifest class attributes and META-INF/services are rewritten and explicit private-member renames are applied; reflection through variables, non-literal strings, serialization, annotations, other resources, external callers and nested archives are not rewritten.");
        try {
            Path snapshot=output.resolve(jar?"input.jar":"input.class");
            copyBounded(input,snapshot,Limits.defaults().maxInputBytes());
            if(mappingBytes!=null) Files.write(output.resolve("mapping.txt"),mappingBytes,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            var inventory=new InventoryReader().inspect(snapshot,Limits.defaults());
            report.put("input_sha256",inventory.sha256());
            if(!inventory.successful()) throw new IOException("Input rejected: "+inventory.diagnostics().getFirst().code());
            // Phase 2BV: decompile disambiguates case-only collisions and drops oversized resources; this command would write them back.
            if(!inventory.notices().isEmpty()) throw new IOException("Input rejected: archive entries that collide by letter case or exceed the entry limit are supported by decompile only");
            var classEntries=inventory.entries().stream().filter(e->e.classInfo()!=null).toList();
            if(classEntries.isEmpty()) throw new IOException("Input has no classes");
            if(jar) {
                // Unlike decompile, rename cannot skip variants: base-only renaming would leave META-INF/versions classes and
                // module descriptors referring to the old names, so the JVM would load inconsistent code on Java 9+.
                long versioned=inventory.entries().stream().filter(e->MultiRelease.versioned(e.name())).count();
                if(versioned>0)
                    throw new IOException("Multi-release archives are unsupported by rename ("+versioned
                        +" META-INF/versions entries); renaming only the base classes would leave the versioned variants inconsistent");
                for(var entry:classEntries) {
                    String internal=entry.classInfo().name();
                    if(!entry.name().equals(internal+".class")) throw new IOException("Class entry path does not match its internal name");
                    rejectDescriptor(internal);
                }
            } else {
                String internal=classEntries.getFirst().classInfo().name();
                if(internal.isEmpty()||internal.endsWith("/")||!InventoryReader.isSafeEntryName(internal+".class"))
                    throw new IOException("Unsafe standalone class identity");
                rejectDescriptor(internal);
            }
            if(jar) ArchiveGuards.rejectSignedOrDigested(snapshot);
            if(proguardMapping!=null) {
                Files.write(output.resolve("proguard-mapping.txt"),proguardBytes,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
                var shapes=new TreeMap<String,ProguardMapping.ClassShape>();
                for(var entry:classEntries) { var info=entry.classInfo();
                    shapes.put(info.name(),new ProguardMapping.ClassShape(info.access(),
                        info.fields().stream().map(m->new ProguardMapping.Member(m.name(),m.descriptor(),m.access())).toList(),
                        info.methods().stream().map(m->new ProguardMapping.Member(m.name(),m.descriptor(),m.access())).toList())); }
                var conversion=ProguardMapping.convert(proguardMapping,shapes);
                var skipped=new TreeMap<String,Object>(); conversion.skipped().forEach((reason,count)->skipped.put(reason.name(),count));
                var samples=new ArrayList<Object>();
                for(var skip:conversion.samples()) samples.add(new TreeMap<String,Object>(Map.of("reason",skip.reason().name(),"rule",skip.rule())));
                var summary=new TreeMap<String,Object>();
                summary.put("applicable_classes",conversion.plan().classes().size()); summary.put("applicable_members",conversion.plan().members().size());
                summary.put("inline_frames_ignored",conversion.inlineFrames()); summary.put("skipped",skipped); summary.put("skipped_samples",samples);
                summary.put("note","Names come from the supplied mapping file. Cross-package classes and non-private members need hierarchy-aware renaming and are skipped.");
                report.put("proguard",summary);
                if(conversion.applied()==0) throw new IOException("ProGuard mapping has no rule applicable to this input");
                mappingBytes=ProguardMapping.format(conversion.plan()).getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                if(mappingBytes.length>MappingFile.MAX_BYTES) throw new IOException("Converted mapping exceeds 1 MiB");
                mappingPlan=MappingFile.parse(mappingBytes);
                Files.write(output.resolve("mapping.txt"),mappingBytes,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            }
            var engine=mappingBytes==null?new RenameEngine():new RenameEngine(output.resolve("mapping.txt"));
            var worker=new ProcessRunner().runRename(engine,snapshot,output.resolve("worker"),timeout);
            if(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException();
            report.put("worker",EvidenceReport.engine(worker));
            boolean success=worker.status()==EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED;
            var forward=new TreeMap<String,String>(); var members=new TreeMap<ClassRenamer.MemberKey,String>(); int reflectionRewrites=0;
            if(success) {
                Path artifact=output.resolve("worker/renamed/renamed.jar");
                Path evidence=output.resolve("worker/renamed/map.bin");
                if(Files.size(evidence)>16L*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Mapping evidence exceeds limit");
                try(var in=new DataInputStream(Files.newInputStream(evidence))) {
                    if(in.readInt()!=3) throw new IOException("Unknown mapping schema");
                    int count=in.readInt(); if(count<0||count>20000) throw new IOException("Invalid mapping count");
                    for(int i=0;i<count;i++) {
                        String from=in.readUTF(),to=in.readUTF();
                        if(forward.put(from,to)!=null) throw new IOException("Duplicate mapping key");
                    }
                    int memberCount=in.readInt(); if(memberCount<0||memberCount>50000) throw new IOException("Invalid member mapping count");
                    for(int i=0;i<memberCount;i++) {
                        var key=new ClassRenamer.MemberKey(in.readUTF(),in.readUTF(),in.readUTF(),in.readBoolean());
                        if(members.put(key,in.readUTF())!=null) throw new IOException("Duplicate member mapping key");
                    }
                    reflectionRewrites=in.readInt(); if(reflectionRewrites<0||reflectionRewrites>1000000) throw new IOException("Invalid reflection rewrite count");
                    if(in.read()!=-1) throw new IOException("Trailing mapping evidence");
                }
                var names=new TreeSet<String>();
                for(var entry:classEntries) names.add(entry.classInfo().name());
                if(!names.containsAll(forward.keySet())) throw new IOException("Mapping references unknown classes");
                if(new HashSet<>(forward.values()).size()!=forward.size()) throw new IOException("Duplicate mapping target");
                var classInfoByName=new TreeMap<String,ClassInfo>();
                for(var entry:classEntries) classInfoByName.put(entry.classInfo().name(),entry.classInfo());
                for(var entry:members.entrySet()) {
                    var key=entry.getKey(); var info=classInfoByName.get(key.owner());
                    if(info==null) throw new IOException("Member mapping references unknown classes");
                    var memberList=key.field()?info.fields():info.methods();
                    boolean found=false;
                    for(var member:memberList) if(member.name().equals(key.name())&&member.descriptor().equals(key.descriptor())) {
                        if((member.access()&2)==0) throw new IOException("Member mapping targets a non-private member");
                        found=true; break;
                    }
                    if(!found) throw new IOException("Member mapping references unknown members");
                    if(key.field()&&(info.access()&0x10000)!=0) throw new IOException("Record member mapping is unsupported");
                }
                var memberTargets=new HashSet<String>();
                for(var entry:members.entrySet()) { var key=entry.getKey();
                    if(!memberTargets.add(key.owner()+"\u0000"+key.field()+"\u0000"+key.descriptor()+"\u0000"+entry.getValue()))
                        throw new IOException("Duplicate member mapping target");
                }
                var renamedInventory=new InventoryReader().inspect(artifact,Limits.defaults());
                if(!renamedInventory.successful()) throw new IOException("Renamed output inventory failed");
                var expected=new TreeSet<String>(); for(String className:names) expected.add(forward.getOrDefault(className,className));
                var actual=new TreeSet<String>(); for(var entry:renamedInventory.entries()) if(entry.classInfo()!=null) actual.add(entry.classInfo().name());
                if(!expected.equals(actual)) throw new IOException("Renamed class set mismatch");
                report.put("output_sha256",copyAndHash(artifact,output.resolve("renamed.jar")));
                report.put("artifact","renamed.jar");
            }
            var inverse=new TreeMap<String,String>(); forward.forEach((from,to)->inverse.put(to,from));
            report.put("status",success?"RENAMED":"WORKER_FAILED"); report.put("classes",classEntries.size());
            report.put("mapping",proguardMapping!=null?"proguard":mappingPlan==null?"planned":"explicit");
            if(mappingPlan!=null) report.put("member_rules",mappingPlan.members().size());
            report.put("renamed",forward.size()); report.put("members_renamed",members.size()); report.put("reflection_rewrites",reflectionRewrites);
            report.put("forward",forward); report.put("inverse",inverse);
            EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("rename.json"),report);
            return new Result(success,classEntries.size(),forward.size(),members.size(),reflectionRewrites,worker);
        } catch(IOException error) {
            report.put("status","FAILED"); report.put("error",String.valueOf(error.getMessage()));
            try { EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("rename.json"),report); }
            catch(IOException reporting) { error.addSuppressed(reporting); }
            try { Files.writeString(output.resolve("failure.txt"),String.valueOf(error.getMessage()),StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW); }
            catch(IOException reporting) { error.addSuppressed(reporting); }
            throw error;
        }
    }
    private static void rejectDescriptor(String internal) throws IOException {
        if(internal.equals("module-info")||internal.equals("package-info")||internal.endsWith("/package-info"))
            throw new IOException("Module and package descriptors are unsupported");
    }
    private static byte[] readBounded(Path file,long limit,String what) throws IOException {
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(file)) {
            byte[] bytes=in.readNBytes((int)limit+1);
            if(bytes.length>limit) throw new IOException(what+" exceeds limit");
            return bytes;
        }
    }
    private static void copyBounded(Path input,Path target,long limit) throws IOException {
        try(var in=Files.newInputStream(input);var out=Files.newOutputStream(target,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
            byte[] buffer=new byte[8192]; long total=0; int count;
            while((count=in.read(buffer))!=-1) { total+=count; if(total>limit) throw new IOException("Input limit exceeded"); out.write(buffer,0,count); }
        }
    }
    private static String copyAndHash(Path source,Path target) throws IOException {
        try {
            var digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            try(var in=new DigestInputStream(Files.newInputStream(source),digest);var out=Files.newOutputStream(target,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
                in.transferTo(out);
            }
            return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest());
        } catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new AssertionError(impossible); }
    }
}
```
