`modules/pipeline/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/RunFingerprint.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CH: what a benchmark row's result depends on, as one SHA-256: every sample and dependency by content, the
 * engines and their versions, the timeout, and the ClassRevive build itself (the bytes of every entry of the running
 * class path). A resumed run must match it exactly, so rows measured by different code are never mixed.
 */
final class RunFingerprint {
    private RunFingerprint() {}

    static String of(List<Path> inputs, Map<Path,List<Path>> dependencies, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        var digest = sha256();
        update(digest, "classrevive-benchmark-v1");
        for (var input : inputs) {
            update(digest, input.getFileName().toString()); file(digest, input);
            for (var jar : dependencies.getOrDefault(input, List.of())) { update(digest, jar.getFileName().toString()); file(digest, jar); }
        }
        for (var engine : engines) { update(digest, engine.id()); update(digest, engine.version()); }
        update(digest, Long.toString(timeout.toSeconds()));
        for (String entry : System.getProperty("java.class.path", "").split(java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(File.pathSeparator))) {
            if (entry.isBlank()) continue;
            Path path = Path.of(entry);
            if (Files.isRegularFile(path)) { update(digest, "jar"); file(digest, path); }
            else if (Files.isDirectory(path)) {
                try (var paths = Files.walk(path)) {
                    for (var item : paths.filter(Files::isRegularFile).sorted().toList()) {
                        update(digest, path.relativize(item).toString().replace('\\', '/')); file(digest, item);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return HexFormat.of().formatHex(digest.digest());
    }
    private static void file(MessageDigest digest, Path file) throws IOException {
        try (var in = Files.newInputStream(file)) {
            byte[] buffer = new byte[65536]; int read;
            while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) digest.update(buffer, 0, read);
        }
    }
    private static MessageDigest sha256() {
        try { return MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); } catch (java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new IllegalStateException(impossible); }
    }
    private static void update(MessageDigest digest, String text) {
        byte[] bytes = text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        digest.update((byte) (bytes.length >>> 24)); digest.update((byte) (bytes.length >>> 16)); digest.update((byte) (bytes.length >>> 8));
        digest.update((byte) bytes.length); digest.update(bytes);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.TransformEngine;
import dev.classrevive.transforms.BuiltinPasses;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.io.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

public final class TransformJob {
    /**
     * {@code methods}: each changed method as {@code class.name+descriptor} (Phase 2CM).
     * {@code link}: Phase 2CN, the JVM verifier's verdict on the transformed classes (null when not checked).
     */
    public record Result(boolean successful,int changes,boolean limitReached,EngineResult worker,SortedSet<String> methods,
                         dev.classrevive.bytecode.LinkCheck.Result link) {
        public Result { methods=Collections.unmodifiableSortedSet(new TreeSet<>(methods)); }
        public Result(boolean successful,int changes,boolean limitReached,EngineResult worker,SortedSet<String> methods) {
            this(successful,changes,limitReached,worker,methods,null);
        }
    }
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,int budget,Duration timeout) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        return run(input,output,budget,timeout,BuiltinPasses.DEFAULT);
    }
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,int budget,Duration timeout,String passes) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        return run(input,output,budget,timeout,passes,List.of());
    }
    /** @param dependencies Phase 2DD: JARs the JVM verifier may load (never link) while it checks the transformed classes */
    public Result run(Path input,Path output,int budget,Duration timeout,String passes,List<Path> dependencies) throws IOException,InterruptedException {
        dependencies=List.copyOf(dependencies);
        var selected = BuiltinPasses.names(passes);
        if(budget<1 || budget>10000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Change budget must be 1..10000");
        if(timeout.isNegative() || timeout.isZero() || timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofHours(1))>0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid timeout");
        input=input.toAbsolutePath().normalize(); output=SafePaths.resolveParents(output);
        String name=input.getFileName()==null?"":input.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        boolean jar=name.endsWith(".jar");
        if((!jar&&!name.endsWith(".class")) || !Files.isRegularFile(input,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("Expected regular .jar or .class input");
        if(output.getParent()==null || !Files.isDirectory(output.getParent())) throw new IOException("Output parent must exist");
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        var report=new TreeMap<String,Object>(); report.put("schema_version",1); report.put("kind","static_transform");
        report.put("behavior","NOT_VERIFIED");
        report.put("passes",selected.stream().map(pass -> BuiltinPasses.JAR_PASSES.contains(pass) ? pass : BuiltinPasses.select(pass).getFirst().id()).toList());
        report.put("instruction_index_scope","input of the named pass within its class");
        try {
            Path snapshot=output.resolve(jar?"input.jar":"input.class");
            try(var in=Files.newInputStream(input);var out=Files.newOutputStream(snapshot,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
                byte[] buffer=new byte[8192]; long total=0; int count;
                while((count=in.read(buffer))!=-1) { total+=count; if(total>Limits.defaults().maxInputBytes()) throw new IOException("Input limit exceeded"); out.write(buffer,0,count); }
            }
            var inventory=new InventoryReader().inspect(snapshot,Limits.defaults());
            report.put("input_sha256",inventory.sha256());
            if(!inventory.successful()) throw new IOException("Input rejected: "+inventory.diagnostics().getFirst().code());
            // Phase 2BV: decompile disambiguates case-only collisions and drops oversized resources; this command would write them back.
            if(!inventory.notices().isEmpty()) throw new IOException("Input rejected: archive entries that collide by letter case or exceed the entry limit are supported by decompile only");
            if(inventory.entries().stream().noneMatch(e -> e.classInfo()!=null)) throw new IOException("Input has no classes");
            if(jar) ArchiveGuards.rejectSignedOrDigested(snapshot);
            else {
                String className=inventory.entries().getFirst().classInfo().name();
                if(className.isEmpty() || className.endsWith("/") || !InventoryReader.isSafeEntryName(className+".class")) throw new IOException("Unsafe standalone class identity");
            }
            var worker=new ProcessRunner().runTransform(new TransformEngine(budget,passes),snapshot,output.resolve("worker"),timeout);
            if(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException();
            report.put("input_sha256",inventory.sha256()); report.put("worker",EvidenceReport.engine(worker)); report.put("behavior","NOT_VERIFIED");
            boolean success=worker.status()==EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED;
            var changes=new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>(); boolean limit=false; var methods=new TreeSet<String>();
            dev.classrevive.bytecode.LinkCheck.Result link=null;
            if(success) {
                Path artifact=output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar");
                var transformed=new InventoryReader().inspect(artifact,Limits.defaults());
                if(!transformed.successful()) throw new IOException("Transformed output inventory failed");
                Path auditPath=output.resolve("worker/transformed/audit.bin");
                if(Files.size(auditPath)>16L*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Audit exceeds limit");
                try(var audit=new DataInputStream(Files.newInputStream(auditPath))) {
                    if(audit.readInt()!=1) throw new IOException("Unknown audit version");
                    int count=audit.readInt(); limit=audit.readBoolean();
                    if(count<0||count>budget) throw new IOException("Invalid audit count");
                    for(int i=0;i<count;i++) changes.add(Map.of("pass",audit.readUTF(),"class",audit.readUTF(),"method",audit.readUTF(),"descriptor",audit.readUTF(),
                        "instruction_index",audit.readInt(),"opcode",audit.readInt(),"left",audit.readInt(),"right",audit.readInt(),"result",audit.readInt()));
                    if(audit.read()!=-1) throw new IOException("Trailing audit data");
                    for(var change:changes) methods.add(change.get("class")+"."+change.get("method")+change.get("descriptor"));
                }
                report.put("output_sha256",transformed.sha256()); report.put("artifact","worker/transformed/transformed.jar");
                // Phase 2CN: whole-jar passes rewrite control flow, so the JVM verifier checks every transformed class (in a
                // fresh JVM; classes are linked, never initialized). Missing dependencies show up as link errors.
                if(!BuiltinPasses.jarPasses(passes).isEmpty()) {
                    link=new dev.classrevive.bytecode.LinkCheck().check(artifact,output.resolve("link"),dependencies,timeout);
                    var linkData=new TreeMap<String,Object>(); linkData.put("linked",link.linked()); linkData.put("classes",link.classes());
                    if(link.errorType()!=null) linkData.put("error_type",link.errorType());
                    report.put("link_check",linkData);
                    Path passReport=output.resolve("worker/transformed/jar-passes.txt");
                    if(Files.isRegularFile(passReport,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && Files.size(passReport)<64*1024) report.put("jar_passes",Files.readString(passReport));
                }
            }
            report.put("status",success?"OUTPUT_VALIDATED":"WORKER_FAILED"); report.put("changes",changes); report.put("change_limit_reached",limit);
            report.put("limitation","Static inventory validation only; no execution or behavioral equivalence proof. Unknown attributes are preserved unchanged.");
            EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("transform.json"),report);
            return new Result(success,changes.size(),limit,worker,methods,link);
        } catch(IOException error) {
            report.put("status","FAILED"); report.put("error",String.valueOf(error.getMessage()));
            try { EvidenceReport.write(output.resolve("transform.json"),report); }
            catch(IOException reporting) { error.addSuppressed(reporting); }
            try { Files.writeString(output.resolve("failure.txt"),String.valueOf(error.getMessage()),StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW); }
            catch(IOException reporting) { error.addSuppressed(reporting); }
            throw error;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/main/resources/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ghidra/ClassReviveNativeExport.java`:

```java
// ClassRevive phase 2CC: post-analysis export for one native library (static triage only).
// Run by analyzeHeadless as -postScript ClassReviveNativeExport.java <output.json> <max-strings> <max-decompiled> <max-c-bytes>.
// It only reads the program Ghidra loaded and analyzed statically: nothing is loaded into a process, run, emulated or
// unpacked. The parent (dev.classrevive.pipeline.NativeReport) reads the JSON strictly; integers only, no fractions.
//@category ClassRevive

import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompInterface;
import ghidra.app.decompiler.DecompileResults;
import ghidra.app.util.headless.HeadlessScript;
import ghidra.program.model.address.Address;
import ghidra.program.model.address.AddressIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Data;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.DataIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Function;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.Instruction;
import ghidra.program.model.listing.InstructionIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.Memory;
import ghidra.program.model.mem.MemoryBlock;
import ghidra.program.model.scalar.Scalar;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.ExternalLocation;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.ExternalLocationIterator;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.Symbol;
import ghidra.program.model.symbol.SymbolTable;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class ClassReviveNativeExport extends HeadlessScript {
    private static final int MAX_IMPORTS = 5000, MAX_EXPORTS = 5000, MAX_SITES = 200, MAX_TABLE_ENTRIES = 2000, MAX_STRING_CHARS = 200;
    private static final long MAX_ENTROPY_BYTES = 64L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final Pattern DESCRIPTOR = Pattern.compile("\\((\\[*([BCDFIJSZ]|L[A-Za-z0-9_/$]+;))*\\)(V|\\[*([BCDFIJSZ]|L[A-Za-z0-9_/$]+;))");
    /** JNINativeInterface slot 215 is RegisterNatives; 216 UnregisterNatives. Offsets by pointer size. */
    private static final int REGISTER_NATIVES_SLOT = 215;

    @Override
    public void run() throws Exception {
        String[] args = getScriptArgs();
        if (args.length != 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Expected <output.json> <max-strings> <max-decompiled> <max-c-bytes>");
        File output = new File(args[0]);
        int maxStrings = Integer.parseInt(args[1]), maxDecompiled = Integer.parseInt(args[2]), maxCBytes = Integer.parseInt(args[3]);
        var report = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
        report.put("schema_version", 1L);
        report.put("tool", "ghidra");
        report.put("ghidra_version", getGhidraVersion());
        report.put("program", currentProgram.getName());
        report.put("format", currentProgram.getExecutableFormat());
        report.put("language", currentProgram.getLanguageID().getIdAsString());
        report.put("compiler", currentProgram.getCompilerSpec().getCompilerSpecID().getIdAsString());
        report.put("pointer_size", (long) currentProgram.getDefaultPointerSize());
        report.put("image_base", currentProgram.getImageBase().toString());
        report.put("sha256", String.valueOf(currentProgram.getExecutableSHA256()));
        report.put("analyzed", currentProgram.getOptions("Program Information").getBoolean("Analyzed", false));
        report.put("analysis_timed_out", isRunningHeadless() && analysisTimeoutOccurred());
        report.put("function_count", (long) currentProgram.getFunctionManager().getFunctionCount());
        report.put("blocks", blocks());
        report.put("imports", imports());
        var exports = exports();
        report.put("exports", exports);
        var jniFunctions = new ArrayList<Function>();

        for (var row : exports) {
            String name = (String) row.get("name");
            // 32-bit Windows and Mach-O decorate C names: _Java_p_A_m@12, _JNI_OnLoad@8.
            String plain = name.startsWith("_J") ? name.substring(1) : name;
            if (plain.indexOf('@') > 0) plain = plain.substring(0, plain.indexOf('@'));
            boolean jni = plain.startsWith("Java_") || plain.startsWith("JNI_OnLoad") || plain.equals("JNI_OnUnload");
            Address address = toAddr((String) row.get("address"));
            Function function = getFunctionAt(address);
            if (function == null && jni) function = createAt(address);
            if (function == null) continue;
            if (jniFunctions.contains(function)) continue;
            if (plain.startsWith("Java_") || plain.equals("JNI_OnUnload")) jniFunctions.add(function);
            if (plain.startsWith("JNI_OnLoad")) jniFunctions.add(0, function);
        }
        report.put("jni_functions", functions(jniFunctions));
        report.put("register_natives_sites", registerNativesSites(jniFunctions));
        var strings = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        var descriptors = new ArrayList<Data>();
        strings(maxStrings, strings, descriptors);
        report.put("strings", strings);
        report.put("native_method_tables", nativeMethodTables(descriptors));
        report.put("decompiled", decompile(jniFunctions, maxDecompiled, maxCBytes));
        Files.writeString(output.toPath(), json(report), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        println("ClassRevive native export written: " + output);
    }

    private List<Map<String,Object>> blocks() throws Exception {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        for (MemoryBlock block : currentProgram.getMemory().getBlocks()) {
            var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
            row.put("name", block.getName());
            row.put("start", block.getStart().toString());
            row.put("size", block.getSize());
            row.put("permissions", (block.isRead() ? "r" : "-") + (block.isWrite() ? "w" : "-") + (block.isExecute() ? "x" : "-"));
            row.put("initialized", block.isInitialized());
            row.put("entropy_millibits", block.isInitialized() && block.getSize() > 0 ? entropy(block) : -1L);
            rows.add(row);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private long entropy(MemoryBlock block) throws Exception {
        long[] counts = new long[256]; long total = 0;
        byte[] buffer = new byte[65536];
        long limit = Math.min(block.getSize(), MAX_ENTROPY_BYTES);
        Address address = block.getStart();
        while (total < limit) {
            monitor.checkCancelled();
            int want = (int) Math.min(buffer.length, limit - total);
            int read = block.getBytes(address.add(total), buffer, 0, want);
            if (read <= 0) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < read; i++) counts[buffer[i] & 0xff]++;
            total += read;
        }
        if (total == 0) return -1;
        double bits = 0;
        for (long count : counts) if (count > 0) { double p = (double) count / total; bits -= p * (Math.log(p) / Math.log(2)); }
        return Math.round(bits * 1000);
    }

    private List<Map<String,Object>> imports() {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        var externals = currentProgram.getExternalManager();
        for (String library : externals.getExternalLibraryNames()) {
            ExternalLocationIterator locations = externals.getExternalLocations(library);
            while (locations.hasNext() && rows.size() < MAX_IMPORTS) {
                ExternalLocation location = locations.next();
                var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                row.put("library", library);
                row.put("name", location.getLabel());
                rows.add(row);
            }
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private List<Map<String,Object>> exports() {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        SymbolTable symbols = currentProgram.getSymbolTable();
        AddressIterator entries = symbols.getExternalEntryPointIterator();
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        while (entries.hasNext() && rows.size() < MAX_EXPORTS) {
            Address address = entries.next();
            Symbol[] atAddress = symbols.getSymbols(address);
            for (Symbol symbol : atAddress) {
                if (symbol.isExternal() || !seen.add(symbol.getName() + "@" + address)) continue;
                // PE exports by name also carry an Ordinal_N label at the same address; keep it only when it is the only name.
                if (atAddress.length > 1 && symbol.getName().matches("Ordinal_[0-9]+")) continue;
                var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                row.put("name", symbol.getName());
                row.put("address", address.toString());
                row.put("function", getFunctionAt(address) != null);
                rows.add(row);
            }
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private final Set<Address> created = new HashSet<>();

    /**
     * Static disassembly at a JNI export that auto-analysis left without a function (packed code is often not followed).
     * Only bytes already in the file are decoded; nothing is emulated. Null when the address holds no initialized code.
     */
    private Function createAt(Address address) {
        try {
            MemoryBlock block = currentProgram.getMemory().getBlock(address);
            if (block == null || !block.isInitialized() || !block.isExecute()) return null;
            disassemble(address);
            Function function = createFunction(address, null);
            if (function != null) created.add(address);
            return function;
        } catch (Exception undecodable) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private List<Map<String,Object>> functions(List<Function> functions) {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        for (Function function : functions) {
            var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
            row.put("name", function.getName());
            row.put("address", function.getEntryPoint().toString());
            row.put("size", function.getBody().getNumAddresses());
            row.put("signature", function.getSignature().getPrototypeString());
            var called = new ArrayList<Object>();
            for (Function callee : function.getCalledFunctions(monitor)) {
                if (called.size() == 50) break;
                called.add(callee.getName() + "@" + callee.getEntryPoint());
            }
            row.put("calls", called);
            row.put("created_by_script", created.contains(function.getEntryPoint()));
            rows.add(row);
        }
        return rows;
    }

    /** Instructions in JNI_OnLoad, the Java_* functions and their callees (3 levels, 300 functions) that use the JNIEnv RegisterNatives offset. */
    private List<Map<String,Object>> registerNativesSites(List<Function> roots) throws Exception {
        long offset = (long) REGISTER_NATIVES_SLOT * currentProgram.getDefaultPointerSize();
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        var queue = new ArrayDeque<Object[]>();
        for (Function root : roots) queue.add(new Object[] {root, 0});
        Set<Address> visited = new HashSet<>();
        while (!queue.isEmpty() && visited.size() < 300 && rows.size() < MAX_SITES) {
            monitor.checkCancelled();
            Object[] next = queue.poll(); Function function = (Function) next[0]; int depth = (Integer) next[1];
            if (function.isExternal() || function.isThunk() || !visited.add(function.getEntryPoint())) continue;
            InstructionIterator instructions = currentProgram.getListing().getInstructions(function.getBody(), true);
            while (instructions.hasNext() && rows.size() < MAX_SITES) {
                Instruction instruction = instructions.next();
                boolean match = false;
                for (int i = 0; i < instruction.getNumOperands() && !match; i++)
                    for (Object operand : instruction.getOpObjects(i))
                        if (operand instanceof Scalar scalar && scalar.getUnsignedValue() == offset) match = true;
                if (!match) continue;
                var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                row.put("function", function.getName());
                row.put("address", instruction.getAddress().toString());
                row.put("instruction", instruction.toString());
                row.put("depth", (long) depth);
                rows.add(row);
            }
            if (depth < 3) for (Function callee : function.getCalledFunctions(monitor)) queue.add(new Object[] {callee, depth + 1});
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private void strings(int max, List<Map<String,Object>> rows, List<Data> descriptors) throws Exception {
        DataIterator data = currentProgram.getListing().getDefinedData(true);
        int seen = 0;
        while (data.hasNext() && seen < 200_000) {
            monitor.checkCancelled();
            Data item = data.next(); seen++;
            if (!item.hasStringValue()) continue;
            Object value = item.getValue();
            if (!(value instanceof String text) || text.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (DESCRIPTOR.matcher(text).matches() && descriptors.size() < 512) descriptors.add(item);
            if (rows.size() >= max) continue;
            var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
            row.put("address", item.getAddress().toString());
            row.put("type", item.getDataType().getName());
            row.put("length", (long) text.length());
            row.put("value", text.length() > MAX_STRING_CHARS ? text.substring(0, MAX_STRING_CHARS) : text);
            rows.add(row);
        }
    }

    /**
     * JNINativeMethod {name, signature, fnPtr} arrays: for every string that is a JVM method descriptor, initialized memory
     * is searched for a pointer to it; the pointer before must point to a name string and the one after into executable code.
     */
    private List<Map<String,Object>> nativeMethodTables(List<Data> descriptors) throws Exception {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        Memory memory = currentProgram.getMemory();
        int size = currentProgram.getDefaultPointerSize();
        if (size != 4 && size != 8) return rows;
        boolean big = currentProgram.getLanguage().isBigEndian();
        for (Data descriptor : descriptors) {
            byte[] pattern = pointer(descriptor.getAddress().getOffset(), size, big);
            Address from = memory.getMinAddress();
            int hits = 0;
            while (from != null && hits < 64 && rows.size() < MAX_TABLE_ENTRIES) {
                monitor.checkCancelled();
                Address hit = memory.findBytes(from, pattern, null, true, monitor);
                if (hit == null) break;
                hits++;
                from = hit.next();
                try {
                    Address nameAddress = toAddr(read(memory, hit.subtract(size), size, big));
                    Address code = toAddr(read(memory, hit.add(size), size, big));
                    String name = cString(memory, nameAddress);
                    MemoryBlock block = memory.getBlock(code);
                    if (name == null || block == null || !block.isExecute()) continue;
                    var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                    row.put("entry", hit.subtract(size).toString());
                    row.put("name", name);
                    row.put("descriptor", (String) descriptor.getValue());
                    row.put("function_address", code.toString());
                    Function function = getFunctionAt(code);
                    row.put("function", function == null ? "" : function.getName());
                    rows.add(row);
                } catch (Exception notATable) {
                    // An address outside memory or an unreadable pointer: not a JNINativeMethod entry.
                }
            }
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private static byte[] pointer(long value, int size, boolean big) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[size];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) bytes[big ? size - 1 - i : i] = (byte) (value >>> (8 * i));
        return bytes;
    }

    private static long read(Memory memory, Address address, int size, boolean big) throws Exception {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[size];
        if (memory.getBytes(address, bytes) != size) throw new IllegalStateException("short read");
        long value = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) value |= (long) (bytes[big ? size - 1 - i : i] & 0xff) << (8 * i);
        return value;
    }

    /** A NUL-terminated printable ASCII name of 1..256 characters, or null. */
    private static String cString(Memory memory, Address address) {
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        try {
            for (int i = 0; i < 257; i++) {
                int b = memory.getByte(address.add(i)) & 0xff;
                if (b == 0) return out.length() == 0 ? null : out.toString();
                if (b < 0x20 || b > 0x7e) return null;
                out.append((char) b);
            }
        } catch (Exception unreadable) {
            return null;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private List<Map<String,Object>> decompile(List<Function> functions, int max, int maxBytes) {
        var rows = new ArrayList<Map<String,Object>>();
        if (max <= 0 || functions.isEmpty()) return rows;
        var decompiler = new DecompInterface();
        try {
            if (!decompiler.openProgram(currentProgram)) return rows;
            for (Function function : functions) {
                if (rows.size() >= max || monitor.isCancelled()) break;
                var row = new LinkedHashMap<String,Object>();
                row.put("name", function.getName());
                row.put("address", function.getEntryPoint().toString());
                DecompileResults result = decompiler.decompileFunction(function, 30, monitor);
                String code = result != null && result.decompileCompleted() && result.getDecompiledFunction() != null
                    ? result.getDecompiledFunction().getC() : null;
                row.put("completed", code != null);
                if (code == null) row.put("error", result == null ? "no result" : String.valueOf(result.getErrorMessage()));
                else {
                    row.put("truncated", code.length() > maxBytes);
                    row.put("c", code.length() > maxBytes ? code.substring(0, maxBytes) : code);
                }
                rows.add(row);
            }
        } finally {
            decompiler.dispose();
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private static String json(Object value) {
        if (value == null) return "null";
        if (value instanceof String text) return quote(text);
        if (value instanceof Boolean || value instanceof Long || value instanceof Integer) return value.toString();
        if (value instanceof Map<?,?> map) {
            var out = new StringBuilder("{");
            for (var entry : map.entrySet()) {
                if (out.length() > 1) out.append(',');
                out.append(quote((String) entry.getKey())).append(':').append(json(entry.getValue()));
            }
            return out.append('}').toString();
        }
        if (value instanceof List<?> list) {
            var out = new StringBuilder("[");
            for (Object item : list) { if (out.length() > 1) out.append(','); out.append(json(item)); }
            return out.append(']').toString();
        }
        return quote(String.valueOf(value));
    }

    private static String quote(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder("\"");
        for (int i = 0; i < text.length(); i++) {
            char c = text.charAt(i);
            if (c == '"' || c == '\\') out.append('\\').append(c);
            else if (c == '\n') out.append("\\n");
            else if (c == '\t') out.append("\\t");
            else if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7e) out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
            else out.append(c);
        }
        return out.append('"').toString();
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/AndroidInputTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.Verdict;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2CW: APK and dex inputs, on the committed fixtures (benchmarks/android) and archives built here. Nothing is run. */
class AndroidInputTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of("../../benchmarks/android");
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void apkAndDexAreRecognizedAndAppBundlesAreNamed() throws Exception {
        var apk = InputIdentifier.identify(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"));
        assertEquals(Verdict.ANDROID_PACKAGE, apk.verdict(), apk.text());
        assertEquals("Android package (APK: 2 dex file(s) at the root, AndroidManifest.xml)", apk.format());
        assertTrue(apk.javaAvailable() && apk.dalvik());
        assertTrue(apk.explanation().contains("dex2jar 2.4.38"), apk.explanation());
        assertTrue(apk.json().toString().contains("root_dex=2"), apk.json().toString());

        var dex = InputIdentifier.identify(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"));
        assertEquals(Verdict.DEX_FILE, dex.verdict(), dex.text());
        assertEquals("Dalvik executable (dex 035, Android)", dex.format());
        assertTrue(dex.text().contains("6 class definitions in the header"), dex.text());
        // A dex whose header size does not match the file is not taken for one.
        byte[] cut = Arrays.copyOf(Files.readAllBytes(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex")), 4000);
        assertEquals(Verdict.UNKNOWN, InputIdentifierTest.identify(cut, "cut.dex").verdict());

        byte[] dexBytes = Files.readAllBytes(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"));
        var bundle = InputIdentifierTest.identify(zip(Map.of("base/dex/classes.dex", dexBytes, "base/manifest/AndroidManifest.xml", new byte[8],
            "BundleConfig.pb", new byte[4])), "app.aab");
        assertEquals(Verdict.ANDROID_BUNDLE, bundle.verdict(), bundle.text());
        assertFalse(bundle.javaAvailable());
        assertTrue(bundle.explanation().contains("bundletool"), bundle.explanation());
        var splits = InputIdentifierTest.identify(zip(Map.of("base.apk", new byte[30], "split_config.arm64_v8a.apk", new byte[30])), "app.apks");
        assertEquals(Verdict.ANDROID_BUNDLE, splits.verdict(), splits.text());
        Path splitsFile = Files.write(directory.resolve("app.xapk"), zip(Map.of("base.apk", new byte[30], "split.apk", new byte[30])));
        assertThrows(InputIdentifier.NoJavaException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(splitsFile));

        // A dex under assets/ is data: reported, not taken for the app's code.
        var payload = InputIdentifierTest.identify(zip(Map.of("classes.dex", dexBytes, "assets/payload.dex", dexBytes)), "app.apk");
        assertEquals(Verdict.ANDROID_PACKAGE, payload.verdict());
        assertTrue(payload.signals().stream().anyMatch(s -> s.startsWith("1 .dex file(s) outside the archive root")), payload.signals().toString());
        // Class files win: a library jar that also carries a classes.dex is still a jar.
        byte[] classFile = classFile();
        var jar = InputIdentifierTest.identify(zip(Map.of("p/Hello.class", classFile, "classes.dex", dexBytes)), "lib.zip");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_ARCHIVE, jar.verdict(), jar.text());
    }

    @Test void anApkIsConvertedDecompiledAndItsOriginRecorded() throws Exception {
        Path apk = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"), directory.resolve("notes.apk"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(apk, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(180));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("selection/sources/demo/notes/NoteStore.java")));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("selection/sources/demo/util/Strings.java")), "classes2.dex is decompiled too");
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().verification() + "\n" + Files.readString(output.resolve("selection/selection.txt")));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("input.jar").toFile())) {
            assertNotNull(zip.getEntry("demo/notes/MainActivity.class"));
            assertNull(zip.getEntry("classes.dex"));
        }
        String origin = Files.readString(output.resolve("input-origin/identification.txt"));
        assertTrue(origin.contains("Verdict: ANDROID_PACKAGE"), origin);
        assertTrue(origin.contains("Converted: Dalvik bytecode (2 dex file(s)) to input.jar by dex2jar 2.4.38"), origin);
        assertTrue(origin.contains("7 classes, 0 untranslated method(s), 0 duplicate class(es) dropped"), origin);
        String conversion = Files.readString(output.resolve("input-origin/conversion.txt"));
        assertTrue(conversion.contains("classes2.dex: 1028 bytes, 1 classes kept"), conversion);
        String line = InputIdentifier.attach(output, output.resolve("report.txt"), output.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(line.startsWith("Input origin: Android package (APK"), line);
        assertTrue(line.contains("converted from Dalvik bytecode by dex2jar 2.4.38 (7 classes, 0 untranslated methods)"), line);
        var report = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json")));
        var recorded = (Map<?,?>) ((Map<?,?>) report.get("input_origin")).get("conversion");
        assertEquals("the converted class files, not the dex", recorded.get("measured_against"));
    }

    /** Phase 2CX: JADX reads the original dex files; CFR reads the converted classes; both are measured the same way. */
    @Test void jadxReadsTheOriginalDexFiles() throws Exception {
        Path apk = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"), directory.resolve("notes.apk"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(apk, output, List.of(new CfrEngine(), new dev.classrevive.jadx.JadxEngine()),
            Duration.ofSeconds(240));
        var jadx = job.engines().stream().filter(result -> result.engine().equals("jadx")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, jadx.status(), jadx.message());
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("input-origin/dalvik.zip").toFile())) {
            assertEquals(List.of("classes.dex", "classes2.dex"), zip.stream().map(ZipEntry::getName).toList());
        }
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("jadx/sources/demo/notes/NoteStore.java")));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("jadx/sources/demo/util/Strings.java")), "classes2.dex reached JADX too");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt"))
            .contains("Dalvik input (Phase 2CX): jadx read the original dex files (input-origin/dalvik.zip)"));
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().verification().detail());
    }

    /** Phase 2CX: a local SDK's android.jar (here a stand-in built from the fixture's stubs) replaces inferred android.* stubs. */
    @Test void aLocalSdkPlatformIsTheAndroidFrameworkForJavac() throws Exception {
        Path classes = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("framework"));
        var sources = new ArrayList<String>(List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        try (var files = Files.walk(FIXTURES.resolve("stubs"))) { files.filter(f -> f.toString().endsWith(".java")).forEach(f -> sources.add(f.toString())); }
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, sources.toArray(String[]::new)));
        Path platforms = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("sdk/platforms"));
        Files.createDirectories(platforms.resolve("android-29"));
        Files.write(platforms.resolve("android-29/android.jar"), jarOf(classes));
        Files.createDirectories(platforms.resolve("android-33"));
        Files.write(platforms.resolve("android-33/android.jar"), jarOf(classes));
        Files.createDirectories(platforms.resolve("android-35"));   // no android.jar: an incomplete install is skipped
        assertEquals(33, AndroidSdk.newest(directory.resolve("sdk"), "test").orElseThrow().apiLevel());
        System.setProperty(AndroidSdk.PROPERTY, directory.resolve("sdk").toString());
        try {
            Path apk = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.apk"), directory.resolve("notes.apk"));
            Path output = directory.resolve("out");
            var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(apk, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(180));
            assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().verification().detail());
            assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains(
                "Android framework for javac (Phase 2CX): Android SDK platform android-33 (found through -Dclassrevive.android.sdk)"));
            Path stubs = output.resolve("stubs/stubs.txt");
            assertFalse(Files.exists(stubs) && Files.readString(stubs).contains("android/app/Activity"), "the SDK supplies android.*");
        } finally {
            System.clearProperty(AndroidSdk.PROPERTY);
        }
    }

    private static byte[] jarOf(Path classes) throws IOException {
        var entries = new TreeMap<String, byte[]>();
        try (var files = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (Path file : files.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList())
                entries.put(classes.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/'), Files.readAllBytes(file));
        }
        return zip(entries);
    }

    @Test void aDexFileIsDecompiledToo() throws Exception {
        Path dex = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"), directory.resolve("classes.dex"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("out");
        new DecompilationJob().runVerified(dex, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(180));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("selection/sources/demo/notes/Note.java")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("input-origin/identification.txt")).contains("Verdict: DEX_FILE"));
    }

    static byte[] zip(Map<String, byte[]> entries) throws IOException {
        var bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(bytes)) {
            for (var entry : new TreeMap<>(entries).entrySet()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey()));
                zip.write(entry.getValue());
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] classFile() throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(ExecutableFixtures.jar()))) {
            for (ZipEntry entry; (entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null; ) if (entry.getName().endsWith(".class")) return zip.readAllBytes();
        }
        throw new AssertionError("no class");
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static dev.classrevive.pipeline.AxmlFixture.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

/** Phase 2CY: the binary manifest decoder, native library triage, and the SDK platform chosen by targetSdkVersion. */
class AndroidPackageTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    static List<Object> manifest() {
        return List.of(
            new Start("manifest", List.of(plain("package", "demo.notes"), android("versionCode", 0x0101021b, 7),
                android("versionName", 0x0101021c, "1.2"))),
            new Start("uses-sdk", List.of(android("minSdkVersion", 0x0101020c, 21), android("targetSdkVersion", 0x01010270, 30))), new End("uses-sdk"),
            new Start("uses-permission", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, "android.permission.INTERNET"))), new End("uses-permission"),
            new Start("uses-permission", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, "android.permission.CAMERA"))), new End("uses-permission"),
            new Start("application", List.of(android("debuggable", 0x0101000f, true))),
            new Start("activity", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, ".SettingsActivity"))), new End("activity"),
            new Start("activity", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, ".MainActivity"))),
            new Start("intent-filter", List.of()),
            new Start("action", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, "android.intent.action.MAIN"))), new End("action"),
            new Start("category", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, "android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"))), new End("category"),
            new End("intent-filter"),
            new End("activity"),
            new Start("service", List.of(android("name", 0x01010003, "demo.notes.SyncService"))), new End("service"),
            new End("application"),
            new End("manifest"));
    }

    @Test void decodesTheManifestAndItsLauncher() {
        var decoded = AndroidPackage.decode(encode(manifest(), false));
        assertEquals("demo.notes", decoded.packageName());
        assertEquals("7", decoded.versionCode());
        assertEquals("1.2", decoded.versionName());
        assertEquals(21, decoded.minSdk());
        assertEquals(30, decoded.targetSdk());
        assertEquals(List.of("android.permission.CAMERA", "android.permission.INTERNET"), decoded.permissions());
        assertEquals(List.of("demo.notes.SettingsActivity", "demo.notes.MainActivity"), decoded.components().get("activity"));
        assertEquals(List.of("demo.notes.SyncService"), decoded.components().get("service"));
        assertEquals("demo.notes.MainActivity", decoded.launcher(), "the activity whose intent filter has MAIN and LAUNCHER");
        assertTrue(decoded.debuggable());
        assertTrue(decoded.problems().isEmpty(), decoded.problems().toString());
        assertTrue(decoded.xml().startsWith("<manifest xmlns:android=\"http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android\" package=\"demo.notes\""), decoded.xml());
        assertTrue(decoded.xml().contains("    <activity android:name=\".MainActivity\">"), decoded.xml());
    }

    @Test void strippedAttributeNamesAreRecoveredFromTheResourceMap() {
        var decoded = AndroidPackage.decode(encode(manifest(), true));
        assertEquals(30, decoded.targetSdk());
        assertEquals("demo.notes.MainActivity", decoded.launcher());
        assertEquals(2, decoded.permissions().size());
    }

    @Test void malformedInputEndsDecodingWithAProblemNotAnException() {
        byte[] good = encode(manifest(), false);
        var cut = AndroidPackage.decode(Arrays.copyOf(good, good.length / 2));
        assertFalse(cut.problems().isEmpty());
        var placeholder = AndroidPackage.decode(new byte[] {3, 0, 8, 0, 8, 0, 0, 0});
        assertNull(placeholder.packageName());
        assertTrue(placeholder.problems().isEmpty(), "an empty document is valid");
        var text = AndroidPackage.decode("<manifest/>".getBytes());
        assertTrue(text.problems().getFirst().startsWith("not Android binary XML"), text.problems().toString());
        var random = new byte[4096];
        new Random(7).nextBytes(random);
        random[0] = 3; random[1] = 0; random[2] = 8; random[3] = 0;
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> AndroidPackage.decode(random));
    }

    @Test void anApkReportsItsManifestAndNativeLibraries() throws Exception {
        byte[] dex = Files.readAllBytes(AndroidInputTest.FIXTURES.resolve("notes.dex"));
        var entries = new TreeMap<String, byte[]>();
        entries.put("classes.dex", dex);
        entries.put("AndroidManifest.xml", encode(manifest(), false));
        entries.put("lib/arm64-v8a/libnotes.so", NativeFixtures.elf());
        entries.put("lib/x86_64/libnotes.so", NativeFixtures.elf());
        Path apk = Files.write(directory.resolve("notes.apk"), AndroidInputTest.zip(entries));
        var found = InputIdentifier.identify(apk);
        assertEquals(InputIdentifier.Verdict.ANDROID_PACKAGE, found.verdict(), found.text());
        String text = found.text();
        assertTrue(text.contains("Android package demo.notes, version 1.2 (code 7), minSdk 21, targetSdk 30"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("components: 2 activities, 1 service; launcher demo.notes.MainActivity"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("2 permission(s) requested: android.permission.CAMERA, android.permission.INTERNET"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("android:debuggable=\"true\""), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("native libraries lib/arm64-v8a: 1 .so (ELF64 x86-64"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("not decompiled to Java"), text);
        var json = found.json();
        assertFalse(json.containsKey(InputIdentifier.MANIFEST_TEXT), "the decoded XML is written apart");
        assertEquals(30L, ((Map<?, ?>) json.get("android_manifest")).get("target_sdk"));
        assertEquals(2, ((List<?>) json.get("native_libraries")).size());

        var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(apk);
        Path output = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("out"));
        InputIdentifier.record(output, resolved);
        String manifest = Files.readString(output.resolve("input-origin/AndroidManifest.xml"));
        assertTrue(manifest.contains("<uses-sdk android:minSdkVersion=\"21\" android:targetSdkVersion=\"30\">"), manifest);
    }

    @Test void theSdkPlatformFollowsTheTargetLevel() {
        var installed = List.of(new AndroidSdk.Platform(Path.of("29.jar"), 29, "t"), new AndroidSdk.Platform(Path.of("33.jar"), 33, "t"),
            new AndroidSdk.Platform(Path.of("34.jar"), 34, "t"));
        assertEquals(33, AndroidSdk.choose(installed, 30).orElseThrow().apiLevel(), "the oldest platform at or above the target");
        assertEquals(29, AndroidSdk.choose(installed, 29).orElseThrow().apiLevel());
        assertEquals(34, AndroidSdk.choose(installed, 35).orElseThrow().apiLevel(), "nothing newer: the newest");
        assertEquals(34, AndroidSdk.choose(installed, null).orElseThrow().apiLevel());
        assertTrue(AndroidSdk.choose(List.of(), 30).isEmpty());
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/AutoDeobfuscationTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscatorClassifier;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2DD: decompile reverses an obfuscator the diagnosis recognizes with HIGH confidence, and only then. */
class AutoDeobfuscationTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of(System.getProperty("classrevive.skidfuscatorFixtures", "missing"));
    @TempDir Path directory;

    private static List<DecompilerEngine> cfr() { return List.of(new dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine()); }

    @Test void reversesARecognizedSkidfuscatorJarBeforeTheEngines() throws Exception {
        Path input = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("skid-fixture-obf.jar"), directory.resolve("app.jar"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("auto");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, output, cfr(), Duration.ofSeconds(120));

        var outcome = job.deobfuscation();
        assertNotNull(outcome);
        assertEquals(AutoDeobfuscation.Status.APPLIED, outcome.status(), outcome.reason());
        assertEquals("Skidfuscator", outcome.obfuscator());
        assertEquals("skidfuscator", outcome.pass());
        assertTrue(outcome.counts().getOrDefault("strings decrypted", 0) > 0, outcome.counts().toString());
        assertTrue(outcome.comparison().keptMethods() <= outcome.comparison().originalMethods());

        // Original, reversed classes and the transform evidence are kept; the worker's input copy is not.
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("deobfuscation/input.jar")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("deobfuscation/worker/transformed/transformed.jar")));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("deobfuscation/transform.json")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve(AutoDeobfuscation.INPUT)));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("input.jar")), "the input snapshot stays the original");

        // The engines read the reversed classes: classes.jar is the reversal, not the input.
        assertEquals(dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.readJar(output.resolve("deobfuscation/worker/transformed/transformed.jar")).keySet(),
            dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.readJar(output.resolve("classes.jar")).keySet());

        String report = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("Deobfuscation (Phase 2DD): Skidfuscator detected ("), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("reversal applied, " + outcome.counts().get("strings decrypted") + " strings decrypted"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("measured against them, not against the original"), report);
        assertFalse(report.contains("compiled against the original classes"), report);
        String json = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"deobfuscation\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"measured_against\":\"reversed classes\""));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"status\":\"APPLIED\""));
        String html = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.html"));
        assertTrue(html.contains("<p class=\"reversal\">Skidfuscator detected ("), html.substring(0, Math.min(html.length(), 4000)));
    }

    @Test void offKeepsTheObfuscatedClassesAndSaysHowToReverse() throws Exception {
        Path input = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("skid-fixture-obf.jar"), directory.resolve("app.jar"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("off");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().withDeobfuscation(false).runVerified(input, output, cfr(), Duration.ofSeconds(120));
        assertEquals(AutoDeobfuscation.Status.OFF, job.deobfuscation().status());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve("deobfuscation")));
        assertEquals(dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.readJar(input).keySet(),
            dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.readJar(output.resolve("classes.jar")).keySet());
        String report = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("automatic reversal turned off (--deobfuscate off); 'classrevive transform --passes skidfuscator' applies it"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"status\":\"OFF\""));
    }

    @Test void aCleanJarIsDecompiledAsItIs() throws Exception {
        Path input = Files.copy(FIXTURES.resolve("skid-fixture.jar"), directory.resolve("clean.jar"));
        Path output = directory.resolve("clean");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, output, cfr(), Duration.ofSeconds(120));
        assertNull(job.deobfuscation());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve("deobfuscation")));
        assertFalse(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Deobfuscation (Phase 2DD)"));
        assertFalse(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"deobfuscation\""));
    }

    @Test void onlyAHighHypothesisWithAReversalPassQualifies() {
        var high = new ObfuscatorClassifier.Hypothesis("Skidfuscator", 100, "HIGH", List.of());
        var medium = new ObfuscatorClassifier.Hypothesis("Skidfuscator", 60, "MEDIUM", List.of());
        var zkm = new ObfuscatorClassifier.Hypothesis("Zelix KlassMaster", 90, "HIGH", List.of());
        var aids = new ObfuscatorClassifier.Hypothesis("Aidsfuscator", 85, "HIGH", List.of());
        assertEquals(Optional.of(high), AutoDeobfuscation.candidate(new ObfuscatorClassifier.Result("SUGGESTED", List.of(high))));
        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), AutoDeobfuscation.candidate(new ObfuscatorClassifier.Result("SUGGESTED", List.of(medium))));
        // The best hypothesis decides: a HIGH obfuscator without a pass is not overridden by a weaker one with a pass.
        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), AutoDeobfuscation.candidate(new ObfuscatorClassifier.Result("SUGGESTED", List.of(zkm, medium))));
        assertEquals("aidsfuscator", AutoDeobfuscation.PASSES.get(AutoDeobfuscation.candidate(
            new ObfuscatorClassifier.Result("SUGGESTED", List.of(aids))).orElseThrow().obfuscator()));
        assertEquals(Optional.empty(), AutoDeobfuscation.candidate(new ObfuscatorClassifier.Result("NONE", List.of())));
    }

    @Test void readsThePassCountsAndIgnoresListLines() throws Exception {
        Path report = directory.resolve("jar-passes.txt");
        Files.writeString(report, "Skidfuscator reversal: detected\n  strings decrypted: 12\n  strings not decrypted: 0\n"
            + "  methods the analysis refused: [a.b()V]\n");
        var counts = AutoDeobfuscation.counts(report);
        assertEquals(Map.of("strings decrypted", 12, "strings not decrypted", 0), counts);
        var outcome = new AutoDeobfuscation.Outcome("Skidfuscator", 100, "skidfuscator", AutoDeobfuscation.Status.APPLIED, null, report,
            counts, 3, null, new AutoDeobfuscation.Comparison(5, 4, List.of("sdk/SDK"), 20, 18, 6, 4));
        assertEquals("Skidfuscator detected (100/100): reversal applied, 12 strings decrypted, 3 method(s) rewritten",
            AutoDeobfuscation.headline(outcome));
        assertTrue(AutoDeobfuscation.text(outcome).contains("kept 18/20 method and 4/6 field signatures of the original; 1 of 5 classes removed (sdk/SDK)"));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/AxmlFixture.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CY test helper: writes Android binary XML (the format aapt compiles AndroidManifest.xml to) from a list of
 * elements, so the decoder is tested on manifests with known content. UTF-16 string pool, a resource map for the android:
 * attributes, one namespace. {@code stripNames} empties the android: attribute names, as R8 and obfuscators do.
 */
final class AxmlFixture {
    private AxmlFixture() {}

    /** {@code value}: a String (type string), Integer (decimal) or Boolean. */
    record Attr(boolean android, String name, int resourceId, Object value) {}
    record Start(String tag, List<Attr> attributes) {}
    record End(String tag) {}

    static Attr android(String name, int id, Object value) { return new Attr(true, name, id, value); }
    static Attr plain(String name, Object value) { return new Attr(false, name, 0, value); }

    static byte[] encode(List<Object> nodes, boolean stripNames) {
        // The android: attribute names come first, in the order of the resource map.
        var androidNames = new LinkedHashMap<String, Integer>();
        for (Object node : nodes)
            if (node instanceof Start start) for (var a : start.attributes()) if (a.android()) androidNames.putIfAbsent(a.name(), a.resourceId());
        var strings = new ArrayList<String>();
        androidNames.keySet().forEach(name -> strings.add(stripNames ? "" : name));
        var index = new HashMap<String, Integer>();
        java.util.function.Function<String, Integer> intern = text -> index.computeIfAbsent(text, key -> { strings.add(key); return strings.size() - 1; });
        int prefix = intern.apply("android"), uri = intern.apply(AndroidPackage.ANDROID);
        var androidIndex = new HashMap<String, Integer>();
        int i = 0;
        for (String name : androidNames.keySet()) androidIndex.put(name, i++);

        var body = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        body.writeBytes(chunk(0x0100, 16, ints(1, -1, prefix, uri)));
        for (Object node : nodes) {
            if (node instanceof Start start) {
                var ext = ByteBuffer.allocate(20 + 20 * start.attributes().size()).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
                ext.putInt(-1).putInt(intern.apply(start.tag())).putShort((short) 20).putShort((short) 20)
                    .putShort((short) start.attributes().size()).putShort((short) 0).putShort((short) 0).putShort((short) 0);
                for (var a : start.attributes()) {
                    int name = a.android() ? androidIndex.get(a.name()) : intern.apply(a.name());
                    int type, data, raw = -1;
                    if (a.value() instanceof String text) { type = 0x03; data = intern.apply(text); raw = data; }
                    else if (a.value() instanceof Boolean flag) { type = 0x12; data = flag ? -1 : 0; }
                    else { type = 0x10; data = (Integer) a.value(); }
                    ext.putInt(a.android() ? uri : -1).putInt(name).putInt(raw).putShort((short) 8).put((byte) 0).put((byte) type).putInt(data);
                }
                body.writeBytes(chunk(0x0102, 16, concat(ints(1, -1), ext.array())));
            } else if (node instanceof End end) {
                body.writeBytes(chunk(0x0103, 16, ints(1, -1, -1, intern.apply(end.tag()))));
            }
        }
        body.writeBytes(chunk(0x0101, 16, ints(1, -1, prefix, uri)));

        var pool = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        var offsets = new int[strings.size()];
        for (int s = 0; s < strings.size(); s++) {
            offsets[s] = pool.size();
            byte[] text = strings.get(s).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_16LE);
            pool.writeBytes(shorts(strings.get(s).length()));
            pool.writeBytes(text);
            pool.writeBytes(shorts(0));
        }
        while (pool.size() % 4 != 0) pool.write(0);
        var poolHeader = ByteBuffer.allocate(20 + 4 * strings.size()).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        poolHeader.putInt(strings.size()).putInt(0).putInt(0).putInt(28 + 4 * strings.size()).putInt(0);
        for (int offset : offsets) poolHeader.putInt(offset);
        byte[] stringPool = chunk(0x0001, 28, concat(poolHeader.array(), pool.toByteArray()));
        var ids = ByteBuffer.allocate(4 * androidNames.size()).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        androidNames.values().forEach(ids::putInt);
        byte[] resourceMap = chunk(0x0180, 8, ids.array());
        return chunk(0x0003, 8, concat(stringPool, resourceMap, body.toByteArray()));
    }

    /** A chunk: type, header size, total size, then {@code rest} (the header's remainder and the body). */
    private static byte[] chunk(int type, int headerSize, byte[] rest) {
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(8 + rest.length).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.putShort((short) type).putShort((short) headerSize).putInt(8 + rest.length).put(rest);
        return b.array();
    }

    private static byte[] ints(int... values) {
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(4 * values.length).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        for (int value : values) b.putInt(value);
        return b.array();
    }

    private static byte[] shorts(int value) { return new byte[] {(byte) value, (byte) (value >> 8)}; }

    private static byte[] concat(byte[]... parts) {
        var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        for (byte[] part : parts) out.writeBytes(part);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test void cancellationDuringLastCompilerDoesNotProduceCompletedAggregate() throws Exception {
        var corpus = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("corpus"));
        var source = directory.resolve("Sample.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Sample { public int value() { return 1; } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none","-d",corpus.toString(),source.toString()));
        var output = directory.resolve("cancelled");
        var failure = new java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<Throwable>();
        var worker = new Thread(() -> {
            try { new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(30)); }
            catch (Throwable error) { failure.set(error); }
        });
        worker.start();
        try {
            Path compiler = output.resolve("case-001-cfr/selection/checks/attempt-0/classes");
            long deadline = System.nanoTime() + Duration.ofSeconds(30).toNanos();
            while (!Files.isDirectory(compiler) && worker.isAlive() && System.nanoTime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(2);
            assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(compiler), "Compiler worker should start");
            worker.interrupt(); worker.join(10000);
            assertFalse(worker.isAlive());
            assertInstanceOf(InterruptedException.class, failure.get());
            assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve("benchmark.json")));
        } finally { worker.interrupt(); worker.join(10000); }
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/CacheAndResumeTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class CacheAndResumeTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    private Path compile(String name, String code) throws Exception {
        var source = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src-" + name));
        Files.writeString(source.resolve(name + ".java"), code);
        var classes = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("classes-" + name));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", classes.toString(), source.resolve(name + ".java").toString()));
        return classes.resolve(name + ".class");
    }

    @Test void reusesEngineOutputsForTheSameInputAndEngineOnly() throws Exception {
        var input = compile("Calc", "public class Calc { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; } }");
        var cache = dir.resolve("engine-cache");
        var engines = List.<dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine());
        var first = new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(cache).runVerified(input, dir.resolve("first"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertTrue(first.engines().stream().noneMatch(result -> result.message().contains("engine cache")), first.engines().toString());
        var second = new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(cache).runVerified(input, dir.resolve("second"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertTrue(second.engines().stream().allMatch(result -> result.message().startsWith("Reused from the engine cache")), second.engines().toString());
        for (String engine : List.of("cfr", "vineflower"))
            assertEquals(Files.readString(dir.resolve("first/" + engine + "/sources/Calc.java")), Files.readString(dir.resolve("second/" + engine + "/sources/Calc.java")));
        assertEquals(first.selection().verification().matchedSymbols(), second.selection().verification().matchedSymbols());
        assertEquals(Files.readString(dir.resolve("first/selection/sources/Calc.java")), Files.readString(dir.resolve("second/selection/sources/Calc.java")));
        // Other input bytes give other keys: nothing is reused.
        var other = compile("Calc2", "public class Calc2 { public int thrice(int x) { return x * 3; } }");
        var third = new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(cache).runVerified(other, dir.resolve("third"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertTrue(third.engines().stream().noneMatch(result -> result.message().contains("engine cache")), third.engines().toString());
        try (var entries = Files.list(cache)) { assertEquals(4, entries.filter(Files::isDirectory).count()); }
    }

    @Test void resumesAnInterruptedBenchmarkOnlyWhenNothingChanged() throws Exception {
        var corpus = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("corpus"));
        Files.copy(compile("Alpha", "public class Alpha { public int one() { return 1; } }"), corpus.resolve("Alpha.class"));
        Files.copy(compile("Beta", "public class Beta { public int two() { return 2; } }"), corpus.resolve("Beta.class"));
        var output = dir.resolve("results");
        var engines = List.<dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine());
        var complete = new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        String finished = Files.readString(output.resolve("benchmark.json"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("run.properties")).startsWith("fingerprint="));
        // Simulate an interruption after the first row: the aggregate, the second row and its folder never existed.
        var progress = Files.readAllLines(output.resolve("progress.jsonl"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        assertEquals(2, progress.size());
        Files.write(output.resolve("progress.jsonl"), List.of(progress.getFirst(), "{\"case\":\"case-002\",\"vari"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        for (String name : List.of("benchmark.json", "benchmark.md", "failures/failures.json", "failures/failures.md")) Files.delete(output.resolve(name));
        assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class, () -> new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(61), true),
            "a different timeout must not resume");
        var resumed = new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60), true);
        assertEquals(complete, resumed);
        String json = Files.readString(output.resolve("benchmark.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"resumed_rows\":1"), json);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("benchmark.md")).contains("Resumed: 1 of 2 rows were reused"));
        // The partial attempt of the second row was set aside, and the row was measured again.
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(output.resolve("interrupted/case-002-cfr-1")));
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(output.resolve("case-002-cfr")));
        assertEquals(2, Files.readAllLines(output.resolve("progress.jsonl"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8).size());
        assertEquals(count(finished, "\"status\":\"STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE\""), count(json, "\"status\":\"STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE\""));
        assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class, () -> new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60), true),
            "a finished run has nothing to resume");
    }

    @Test void engineJarBytesArePartOfTheCacheKey() throws Exception {
        var jar = dir.resolve("engine.jar");
        Files.write(jar, new byte[]{1, 2, 3});
        var input = compile("Keyed", "public class Keyed { public int one() { return 1; } }");
        var output = dir.resolve("keyed-output");
        DecompilerEngine engine = new DecompilerEngine() {
            @Override public String id() { return "fake"; }
            @Override public String version() { return "1.0"; }
            @Override public List<String> command(Path in, Path out) {
                return List.of("java", "-jar", jar.toString(), in.toString(), out.toString());
            }
        };
        String first = EngineCache.key(engine, input, output);
        Files.write(jar, new byte[]{4, 5, 6});
        String second = EngineCache.key(engine, input, output);
        assertNotEquals(first, second, "replacing the engine JAR at the same path must change the cache key");
    }

    @Test void corruptEngineCacheEntryFallsBackToTheEngine() throws Exception {
        var input = compile("Cached", "public class Cached { public int one() { return 1; } }");
        var cache = dir.resolve("broken-cache");
        var engines = List.<DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine());
        new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(cache).runVerified(input, dir.resolve("broken-first"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        Path entry;
        try (var entries = Files.list(cache)) { entry = entries.filter(Files::isDirectory).findFirst().orElseThrow(); }
        // An invalid unicode escape makes Properties.load throw, as a torn write would.
        Files.writeString(entry.resolve("result.properties"), "broken=\\uZZZZ\n");
        var second = new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(cache).runVerified(input, dir.resolve("broken-second"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertFalse(second.engines().getFirst().message().startsWith("Reused from the engine cache"), second.engines().toString());
        assertTrue(second.selection().verification().complete());
        assertEquals(Files.readString(dir.resolve("broken-first/cfr/sources/Cached.java")),
            Files.readString(dir.resolve("broken-second/cfr/sources/Cached.java")));
        try (var entries = Files.list(cache)) { assertEquals(1, entries.filter(Files::isDirectory).count(), "the corrupt entry is replaced"); }
    }

    @Test void resumesRowsOnlyWhenTheirEvidenceStillExists() throws Exception {
        var corpus = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("evidence-corpus"));
        Files.copy(compile("Gamma", "public class Gamma { public int three() { return 3; } }"), corpus.resolve("Gamma.class"));
        var output = dir.resolve("evidence-results");
        var engines = List.<DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine());
        var complete = new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        var progress = Files.readAllLines(output.resolve("progress.jsonl"), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        assertEquals(1, progress.size());
        // Simulate an interruption whose only row lost its evidence before the resume.
        Files.write(output.resolve("progress.jsonl"), List.of(progress.getFirst()), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        for (String name : List.of("benchmark.json", "benchmark.md")) Files.delete(output.resolve(name));
        Files.delete(output.resolve("case-001-cfr/report.json"));
        var resumed = new BenchmarkRunner().run(corpus, output, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60), true);
        assertEquals(complete, resumed);
        String json = Files.readString(output.resolve("benchmark.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"resumed_rows\":0"), json);
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("case-001-cfr/report.json"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS));
        assertTrue(Files.isDirectory(output.resolve("interrupted/case-001-cfr-1")), "the row without evidence is set aside");
    }

    private static int count(String text, String part) { return text.split(java.util.regex.Pattern.quote(part), -1).length - 1; }
}
```
