`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/CaseCollisionJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Stream;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.MethodVisitor;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2BV: classes {@code p/A} and {@code p/a} (plus {@code p/a$Box}) that differ only in letter case and refer to each
 * other, built here with ASM because javac cannot write both on a case-insensitive file system. Nothing runs.
 */
class CaseCollisionJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    List<DecompilerEngine> engines() { return List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()); }

    static void constructor(ClassWriter writer) {
        var init = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC, "<init>", "()V", null, null);
        init.visitCode(); init.visitVarInsn(ALOAD, 0); init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/Object", "<init>", "()V", false);
        init.visitInsn(RETURN); init.visitMaxs(1, 1); init.visitEnd();
    }
    static MethodVisitor constant(ClassWriter writer, int value) {
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, value); method.visitInsn(IRETURN); method.visitMaxs(1, 1); method.visitEnd();
        return method;
    }
    /** {@code public class A { public a other; int value() { return 1; } int sum(a x) { return x.value() + value(); } }} */
    static byte[] upper() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/A", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PUBLIC, "other", "Lp/a;", null, null).visitEnd();
        constructor(writer); constant(writer, 1);
        var sum = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC, "sum", "(Lp/a;)I", null, null);
        sum.visitCode(); sum.visitVarInsn(ALOAD, 1); sum.visitMethodInsn(INVOKEVIRTUAL, "p/a", "value", "()I", false);
        sum.visitVarInsn(ALOAD, 0); sum.visitMethodInsn(INVOKEVIRTUAL, "p/A", "value", "()I", false);
        sum.visitInsn(IADD); sum.visitInsn(IRETURN); sum.visitMaxs(2, 2); sum.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    /** {@code public class a { int value() { return 2; } static A make() { return new A(); } public static class Box { public A held; } }} */
    static byte[] lower() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/a", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitInnerClass("p/a$Box", "p/a", "Box", ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC);
        constructor(writer); constant(writer, 2);
        var make = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "make", "()Lp/A;", null, null);
        make.visitCode(); make.visitTypeInsn(NEW, "p/A"); make.visitInsn(DUP);
        make.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESPECIAL, "p/A", "<init>", "()V", false); make.visitInsn(ARETURN); make.visitMaxs(2, 0); make.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    static byte[] box() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/a$Box", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitInnerClass("p/a$Box", "p/a", "Box", ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PUBLIC, "held", "Lp/A;", null, null).visitEnd();
        constructor(writer); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    Path jar() throws IOException {
        Path jar = directory.resolve("colliding.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var entry : List.of(Map.entry("p/A.class", upper()), Map.entry("p/a.class", lower()), Map.entry("p/a$Box.class", box()),
                    Map.entry("p/readme.txt", "first".getBytes()), Map.entry("p/README.txt", "second".getBytes()))) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey())); zip.write(entry.getValue()); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void renamesClassesApartThatDifferOnlyInCaseAndRecompilesThem() throws Exception {
        Path out = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar(), out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(Map.of("p/a", "p/a_cr2", "p/a$Box", "p/a_cr2$Box"), job.caseRenames());
        var verification = job.selection().verification();
        assertTrue(verification.complete(), job.selection().toString());
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(out.resolve("classes.jar").toFile())) {
            assertEquals(List.of("p/A.class", "p/a_cr2$Box.class", "p/a_cr2.class"), zip.stream().map(ZipEntry::getName).sorted().toList());
        }
        assertEquals("class p/a = p/a_cr2", Files.readAllLines(out.resolve("portable-names/mapping.txt")).stream()
            .filter(line -> line.startsWith("class p/a ")).findFirst().orElseThrow());
        for (String engine : List.of("cfr", "vineflower")) {
            String upper = Files.readString(out.resolve(engine).resolve("sources/p/A.java"));
            assertTrue(upper.contains("a_cr2"), upper);
        }
        // Every selected source has its own path ignoring case, so the round trip compiled on this file system.
        try (Stream<Path> files = Files.walk(out.resolve("selection/sources"))) {
            var names = files.filter(Files::isRegularFile).map(path -> path.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).toList();
            assertEquals(names.size(), new HashSet<>(names).size(), names.toString());
            assertTrue(names.stream().anyMatch(name -> name.endsWith("a_cr2.java")), names.toString());
        }
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("Portable class names: 2 class(es) renamed"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("  p/a -> p/a_cr2\n"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("1 resource path(s) colliding by case left out"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("Result: COMPILED_WITH_SIGNATURE_COVERAGE"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("selection/selection.txt")).contains("  p/a$Box -> p/a_cr2$Box\n"));
        String json = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"portable_names\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"p/a\":\"p/a_cr2\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"inventory_notices\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"code\":\"CASE_COLLISION_SKIPPED\",\"entry\":\"p/README.txt\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("Class entries differ only in letter case: p/A.class, p/a.class"), json);
    }

    @Test void renameStillRefusesCaseCollisions() throws Exception {
        Path input = jar();
        var error = assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new RenameJob().run(input, directory.resolve("renamed"), Duration.ofSeconds(30)));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("supported by decompile only"), error.getMessage());
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/DecompilationJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import java.io.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class DecompilationJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    List<DecompilerEngine> engines() { return List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()); }
    @Test void allFourEnginesProduceEvidenceAndCombinedSelection() throws Exception {
        var engines = List.<DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine(),
            new dev.classrevive.procyon.ProcyonEngine(), new dev.classrevive.jadx.JadxEngine());
        var out = directory.resolve("four");
        var result = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(fixture(true), out, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(4, result.engines().size());
        for (var engine : result.engines()) assertTrue(engine.sourceFiles() > 0, engine.toString());
        assertTrue(result.selection().verification().complete());
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("procyon"));
        // Phase 2BZ: the static obfuscation profile of a javac-compiled input finds nothing.
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"obfuscation\":{"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"suggested_obfuscator\":\"none (no obfuscation technique detected)\""), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Suggested obfuscator: none"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"measured\":true"), report);
        // The four engines already agree on a compiling set, so no method body is composed (additive field, Phase 2BD).
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"method_composition\":{\"count\":0,\"evidence\":\"METHOD_BODIES_FROM_OTHER_ENGINES_ROUND_TRIP_IN_PLACE_BEHAVIOR_NOT_VERIFIED\",\"files\":0,\"methods\":[]}"), report);
        assertTrue(result.selection().methods().isEmpty());
        var verification = result.selection().verification();
        assertTrue(verification.roundTripMeasured());
        assertEquals(verification.roundTrip().stream().mapToInt(item -> item.methods().size()).sum(),
            verification.roundTripIdentical() + verification.roundTripEquivalent() + verification.roundTripDifferent());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("selection/selection.txt")).contains("Method round trip (tie-break among structurally equal candidates)"));
    }
    @Test void standaloneInnerClassRetainsProcyonPartialSource() throws Exception {
        var source = directory.resolve("Outer.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class Outer { public static class Inner { public int value() { return 7; } } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        var output = directory.resolve("orphan");
        new DecompilationJob().runVerified(directory.resolve("Outer$Inner.class"), output,
            List.of(new dev.classrevive.procyon.ProcyonEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("procyon/sources/Outer$Inner.java")).contains("value("));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("report.json")));
    }
    Path fixture(boolean jar) throws Exception {
        var source = directory.resolve("Sample.java");
        Files.writeString(source, """
            package demo;
            public class Sample {
                static { try { java.nio.file.Files.write(java.nio.file.Paths.get("TARGET_EXECUTED"), new byte[]{1}); } catch (Exception e) { throw new RuntimeException(e); } }
                public int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
                public String choose(int i) { switch(i) { case 1: return "one"; default: return "other"; } }
            }
            """);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null,
            "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", directory.toString(), source.toString()));
        var clazz = directory.resolve("demo/Sample.class");
        if (!jar) return clazz;
        var archive = directory.resolve("sample.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(archive))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("demo/Sample.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(clazz)); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("private-resource.txt")); zip.write("do not copy".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return archive;
    }
    @Test void bothRealEnginesProduceRecompilableJavaWithoutExecutingTarget() throws Exception {
        var input = fixture(true); var before = Files.readAllBytes(input);
        var out = directory.resolve("result");
        var results = new DecompilationJob().run(input, out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(2, results.size());
        for (var result : results) {
            assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status(), result.toString());
            assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve(result.engine() + "/TARGET_EXECUTED")));
            var java = out.resolve(result.engine() + "/sources/demo/Sample.java");
            assertTrue(Files.exists(java), result.toString());
            assertTrue(Files.readString(java).contains("int add("));
            assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null,
                "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", directory.resolve("compiled-" + result.engine()).toString(), java.toString()));
            assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve(result.engine() + "/sources/private-resource.txt")));
        }
        assertArrayEquals(before, Files.readAllBytes(input));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt")).contains("not verified"));
    }
    @Test void supportsStandaloneClass() throws Exception {
        var result = new DecompilationJob().run(fixture(false), directory.resolve("out"), List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.getFirst().status());
    }
    @Test void verifiedJobSelectsCompilingSources() throws Exception {
        var out = directory.resolve("verified");

        assertTrue(result.selection().verification().complete());
        assertNull(result.fallback());

    @Test void missingDependencyProducesPartialSourcesAndBytecode() throws Exception {
        var src = directory.resolve("MissingExample.java");
        Files.writeString(src, "public class MissingExample extends Base {} class Base {}");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",src.toString()));
        var out = directory.resolve("partial");

        var result = new DecompilationJob().withStubs(false).runVerified(directory.resolve("MissingExample.class"), out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(30));

    }
    @Test void refusesExistingOutputWithoutChangingIt() throws Exception {
        var out = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("out"));
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("keep.txt"), "original");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new DecompilationJob().run(fixture(true), out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
        assertEquals("original", Files.readString(out.resolve("keep.txt")));
        try (var files = Files.list(out)) { assertEquals(1, files.count()); }
    }
    @Test void rejectsUnsafeClassIdentityBeforeStartingEngines() throws Exception {
        byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(fixture(false));
        byte[] from = "demo/Sample".getBytes(); byte[] to = "../x/Sample".getBytes();
        for (int i = 0; i <= bytes.length - from.length; i++) {
            if (Arrays.equals(Arrays.copyOfRange(bytes, i, i + from.length), from)) {
                System.arraycopy(to, 0, bytes, i, to.length); break;
            }
        }
        var path = directory.resolve("unsafe.class"); Files.write(path, bytes);
        var out = directory.resolve("out");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new DecompilationJob().run(path, out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("cfr")));
    }
    @Test void rejectsMalformedInputBeforeStartingEngines() throws Exception {
        var input = directory.resolve("bad.jar"); Files.write(input, new byte[10]);
        var out = directory.resolve("out");
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new DecompilationJob().run(input, out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("vineflower")));
    }
    @Test void refusesFilesystemRootWithoutUncheckedFailure() throws Exception {
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new DecompilationJob().run(fixture(false), directory.getRoot(), engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
    }
    @Test void keepsSuccessfulEngineWhenOtherFailsToStart() throws Exception {
        var bad = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "missing"; }
            public String version() { return "1"; }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) { return List.of(directory.resolve("missing.exe").toString()); }
        };
        var results = new DecompilationJob().run(fixture(false), directory.resolve("out"), List.of(bad, new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.FAILED, results.get(0).status());
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, results.get(1).status());
    }
    @Test void partialEngineTreesStayCandidatesButCancelledOnesDoNot() throws Exception {
        var out = Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("candidates"));
        for (String engine : List.of("cfr", "vineflower", "procyon", "jadx")) Files.createDirectories(out.resolve(engine).resolve("sources"));
        Files.createDirectories(out.resolve("other"));
        var results = List.of(
            new EngineResult("cfr", "0.152", EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, 0, 1, 1, "ok"),
            new EngineResult("vineflower", "1.11.1", EngineResult.Status.TIMED_OUT, -1, 1, 1, "timeout"),
            // An obfuscated jar: Procyon ends FAILED with 621 usable files; its tree must stay a candidate (Phase 2CK builds on it).
            new EngineResult("procyon", "0.6.0", EngineResult.Status.FAILED, 1, 621, 1, "failed on some classes"),
            new EngineResult("jadx", "1.5.3", EngineResult.Status.CANCELLED, -1, 1, 1, "cancelled"),
            new EngineResult("other", "1", EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, 0, 0, 1, "no sources directory"));
        assertEquals(Set.of("cfr", "vineflower", "procyon"), DecompilationJob.candidateSources(results, out).keySet());
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/EmbeddedLibrariesTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class EmbeddedLibrariesTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    private Path jar(String name, Map<String,String> entries) throws Exception {
        Path jar = dir.resolve(name);
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var entry : entries.entrySet()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey())); zip.write(entry.getValue().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void recognizesRootRelocatedAndMavenDeclaredLibraries() throws Exception {
        var jar = jar("app.jar", Map.of("META-INF/maven/com.google.guava/guava/pom.properties", "groupId=com.google.guava\nartifactId=guava\nversion=33.0-jre\n"));
        var result = EmbeddedLibraries.detect(jar, List.of("app/Main", "app/util/Text", "com/google/common/base/Preconditions",
            "com/google/common/collect/Lists", "app/shaded/com/google/gson/Gson", "app/kotlin/Helper"));
        assertNull(result.self());
        // app/kotlin/Helper is the application's: one-segment prefixes (kotlin/) only count at the root.
        assertEquals(3, result.applicationClasses()); assertEquals(3, result.libraryClasses());
        var guava = result.libraries().getFirst();
        assertEquals("Guava", guava.name()); assertEquals(2, guava.classes()); assertEquals("33.0-jre", guava.version());
        assertTrue(guava.evidence().contains("Maven metadata com.google.guava:guava:33.0-jre"), guava.evidence().toString());
        var gson = result.libraries().get(1);
        assertEquals("Gson", gson.name()); assertEquals(Set.of("app.shaded"), gson.relocatedUnder());
        assertEquals(Set.of("app/shaded/com/google/gson/"), gson.packages());
        assertEquals("Gson", result.libraryOf("app/shaded/com/google/gson/Gson")); assertNull(result.libraryOf("app/Main"));
        String text = EmbeddedLibraries.text(result);
        assertTrue(text.startsWith("Embedded libraries: 3 of 6 classes belong to 2 recognized libraries; 3 are the application's own"), text);
        assertTrue(Json.encode(EmbeddedLibraries.json(result)).contains("\"relocated_under\":[\"app.shaded\"]"));
    }

    @Test void aLibraryDecompiledOnItsOwnIsNotEmbeddedInItself() throws Exception {
        var jar = jar("gson.jar", Map.of("META-INF/maven/com.google.code.gson/gson/pom.properties", "groupId=com.google.code.gson\nartifactId=gson\nversion=2.13.1\n"));
        var result = EmbeddedLibraries.detect(jar, List.of("com/google/gson/Gson", "com/google/gson/JsonObject"));
        assertEquals("Gson", result.self()); assertEquals(List.of(), result.libraries());
        assertEquals(2, result.applicationClasses()); assertEquals(0, result.libraryClasses());
        assertEquals("Embedded libraries: none (the input itself is Gson)\n", EmbeddedLibraries.text(result));
    }

    @Test void reportsAndFoldsABundledLibraryInARealJob() throws Exception {
        var source = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src"));
        Files.createDirectories(source.resolve("app")); Files.createDirectories(source.resolve("org/json"));
        Files.writeString(source.resolve("app/Main.java"), "package app; public class Main { public String run() { return new org.json.Mini().text(); } }");
        Files.writeString(source.resolve("org/json/Mini.java"), "package org.json; public class Mini { public String text() { return \"{}\"; } }");
        var classes = dir.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", classes.toString(), source.resolve("app/Main.java").toString(), source.resolve("org/json/Mini.java").toString()));
        var input = dir.resolve("bundle.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            for (String name : List.of("app/Main.class", "org/json/Mini.class")) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(name))); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var output = dir.resolve("out");
        new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        String json = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"embedded_libraries\":{\"application_classes\":1,"), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"name\":\"JSON-java\""), json);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Embedded libraries: 1 of 2 classes belong to 1 recognized libraries"));
        String html = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.html"));
        assertTrue(html.contains("Application code") && html.contains("library: JSON-java") && html.contains("<details class=\"library\">"), html);
        // Phase 2CJ: the same job names its compiler (javac 21 writes no lambda or enum here, so the Java compiler stays undetermined).
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"compiler\":{") && json.contains("\"language\":\"Java\""), json);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Compiler fingerprint: Java"));
        assertTrue(html.contains(">Compiler<"), html);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult;
import dev.classrevive.verification.ClassCoverage;
import dev.classrevive.verification.ClassRoundTrip;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class EvidenceReportTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    @Test void writesReportsAtomicallyAndRefusesToOverwrite() throws Exception {
        var path = dir.resolve("report.json");
        EvidenceReport.write(path, Map.of("kind", "test"));
        String written = Files.readString(path);
        assertTrue(written.contains("\"kind\":\"test\""), written);
        assertTrue(written.endsWith("\n"), written);
        try (var files = Files.list(dir)) {
            assertTrue(files.noneMatch(file -> file.getFileName().toString().endsWith(".tmp")), "no temporary file remains");
        }
        assertThrows(FileAlreadyExistsException.class, () -> EvidenceReport.write(path, Map.of("kind", "other")));
        assertEquals(written, Files.readString(path));
    }
    @Test void serializesStableEngineDiagnosticCodeAlongsideMessage() {
        var result = new EngineResult("cfr", "0.152", EngineResult.Status.FAILED, 7, 0, 12,
            "See engine.log", EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO);
        String json = Json.encode(EvidenceReport.engine(result));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"diagnostic_code\":\"ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO\""));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"message\":\"See engine.log\""));
    }
    @Test void serializesClassCoverageAsStructuredVerificationEvidence() {
        var result = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, 0, 1, 2, 0, "structural only",
            List.of(new ClassCoverage("demo/A", 2, 1)));
        String json = Json.encode(EvidenceReport.verification(result));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"class_coverage\""));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"class_name\":\"demo/A\""));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"coverage_permille\":500"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"complete\":false"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"round_trip\":{\"classes\":[],\"different\":0,\"equivalent_after_normalization\":0,\"identical\":0,\"measured\":false}"), json);
    }
    @Test void serializesPerMethodRoundTripCountsPerClass() {
        var methods = List.of(new MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult("a", "()V", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL, ""),
            new MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult("b", "()V", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, ""),
            new MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult("c", "()V", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.DIFFERENT, "body differs after normalization"));
        var result = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, 0, 1, 1, 0, "structural only",
            List.of(new ClassCoverage("demo/A", 1, 1)), List.of(new ClassRoundTrip("demo/A", methods)));
        String json = Json.encode(EvidenceReport.verification(result));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"round_trip\":{\"classes\":[{\"class_name\":\"demo/A\",\"different\":1,"
            + "\"equivalent_after_normalization\":1,\"identical\":1}],\"different\":1,\"equivalent_after_normalization\":1,"
            + "\"identical\":1,\"measured\":true}"), json);
    }
    @Test void benchmarkSumsSerializedRoundTripCountsAcrossAttempts() {
        var first = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, 0, 2, 2, 0, "structural only",
            List.of(new ClassCoverage("demo/A", 2, 2)), List.of(
                new ClassRoundTrip("demo/A", List.of(method("a", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL), method("b", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL))),
                new ClassRoundTrip("demo/B", List.of(method("c", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.DIFFERENT)))));
        var second = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, 0, 1, 1, 0, "structural only",
            List.of(new ClassCoverage("demo/A", 1, 1)), List.of(new ClassRoundTrip("demo/A",
                List.of(method("a", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION)))));
        var notCompiled = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, 3, 0, 1, 0, "javac failed",
            List.of(new ClassCoverage("demo/A", 1, 0)));
        var rows = List.<Map<String,Object>>of(Map.of("case", "case-001", "status", "PARTIAL", "verification", EvidenceReport.verification(first)),
            Map.of("case", "case-002", "status", "STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE", "verification", EvidenceReport.verification(second)),
            Map.of("case", "case-003", "status", "PARTIAL", "verification", EvidenceReport.verification(notCompiled)));
        var trip = (Map<?,?>) ((Map<?,?>) BenchmarkRunner.variantSummary(rows, Map.of("case-001", 3, "case-002", 1, "case-003", 4))
            .get("metrics")).get("method_round_trip");
        assertEquals(2L, trip.get("measured_attempts"));
        assertEquals(2L, trip.get("identical")); assertEquals(1L, trip.get("equivalent_after_normalization")); assertEquals(1L, trip.get("different"));
        assertEquals(4L, trip.get("methods_compared")); assertEquals(750L, trip.get("recovered_permille"));
        assertEquals(8L, trip.get("corpus_method_bodies")); assertEquals(375L, trip.get("recovered_of_corpus_permille"));
    }
    private static MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult method(String name, MethodRoundTrip.Outcome outcome) {
        return new MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult(name, "()V", outcome, "");
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ExecutableFixtures.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CE test inputs, written byte by byte by our own code: minimal PE32+ images (an import table, an optional extra
 * section such as a high-entropy {@code .vlizer}, a CLR header, marker text), a jar, a zip and a fake certificate. They are
 * only read as bytes; nothing loads or runs them.
 */
final class ExecutableFixtures {
    private ExecutableFixtures() {}

    static final int RDATA = 0x600, RDATA_RVA = 0x2000, EXTRA = 0xe00;

    /**
     * {@code .text} (a ret), {@code .rdata} with an import table of KERNEL32.dll {@code imports} and {@code marker} as text,
     * and an optional third section {@code extraName} holding {@code extraData}; {@code clr} adds a CLR header directory.
     */
    static byte[] pe(List<String> imports, String marker, String extraName, byte[] extraData, boolean clr, int subsystem) {
        boolean extra = extraName != null;
        int extraRaw = extra ? align(extraData.length, 0x200) : 0;
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(EXTRA + extraRaw).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(0, (byte) 'M').put(1, (byte) 'Z').putInt(0x3c, 0x40);
        b.put(0x40, (byte) 'P').put(0x41, (byte) 'E');
        int coff = 0x44;
        b.putShort(coff, (short) 0x8664).putShort(coff + 2, (short) (extra ? 3 : 2)).putShort(coff + 16, (short) 240).putShort(coff + 18, (short) 0x22);
        int opt = coff + 20;
        b.putShort(opt, (short) 0x20b).putInt(opt + 16, 0x1000).putLong(opt + 24, 0x140000000L).putInt(opt + 32, 0x1000).putInt(opt + 36, 0x200);
        b.putShort(opt + 40, (short) 6).putShort(opt + 48, (short) 6).putInt(opt + 56, extra ? 0x3000 + align(extraData.length, 0x1000) : 0x3000)
            .putInt(opt + 60, 0x400).putShort(opt + 68, (short) subsystem).putInt(opt + 108, 16);
        int dirs = opt + 112;
        if (!imports.isEmpty()) b.putInt(dirs + 8, RDATA_RVA).putInt(dirs + 12, 40);
        if (clr) b.putInt(dirs + 112, 0x2700).putInt(dirs + 116, 72);
        int table = opt + 240;
        section(b, table, ".text", 0x1000, 0x10, 0x400, 0x200, 0x60000020);
        section(b, table + 40, ".rdata", RDATA_RVA, 0x800, RDATA, 0x800, 0x40000040);
        if (extra) {
            section(b, table + 80, extraName, 0x3000, extraData.length, EXTRA, extraRaw, 0xe0000060);
            b.put(EXTRA, extraData);
        }
        b.put(0x400, (byte) 0xc3);
        if (!imports.isEmpty()) {
            b.putInt(rdata(RDATA_RVA), 0x2040).putInt(rdata(RDATA_RVA) + 12, 0x2600).putInt(rdata(RDATA_RVA) + 16, 0x2040);
            for (int i = 0; i < imports.size(); i++) {
                b.putLong(rdata(0x2040) + 8 * i, 0x2100 + 32 * i);
                text(b, rdata(0x2100 + 32 * i) + 2, imports.get(i));
            }
            text(b, rdata(0x2600), "KERNEL32.dll");
        }
        if (marker != null) text(b, rdata(0x2680), marker);
        return b.array();
    }

    static byte[] pe(List<String> imports) { return pe(imports, null, null, null, false, 3); }

    /** A jar with {@code p/Hello} ({@code int value()}) and a manifest. */
    static byte[] jar() throws IOException {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/Hello", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var init = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC, "<init>", "()V", null, null);
        init.visitCode(); init.visitVarInsn(ALOAD, 0); init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/Object", "<init>", "()V", false);
        init.visitInsn(RETURN); init.visitMaxs(0, 0); init.visitEnd();
        var value = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        value.visitCode(); value.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, 42); value.visitInsn(IRETURN); value.visitMaxs(0, 0); value.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return zip(Map.of("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "Manifest-Version: 1.0\r\n\r\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII),
            "p/Hello.class", writer.toByteArray()));
    }

    /** Fixed entry time, so the same entries always give the same zip bytes (DOS times have a two-second resolution). */
    static final LocalDateTime ENTRY_TIME = LocalDateTime.of(2020, 1, 1, 0, 0);

    static ZipEntry entry(String name) {
        var item = new ZipEntry(name);
        item.setTimeLocal(ENTRY_TIME);
        return item;
    }

    static byte[] zip(Map<String,byte[]> entries) throws IOException {
        var bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(bytes)) {
            for (var entry : new TreeMap<>(entries).entrySet()) { out.putNextEntry(entry(entry.getKey())); out.write(entry.getValue()); out.closeEntry(); }
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }

    /** A WIN_CERTIFICATE (revision 2.0, PKCS#7) whose blob holds a common-name attribute; not a real signature. */
    static byte[] certificate(String commonName) {
        byte[] name = commonName.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        int size = align(8 + 7 + name.length + 16, 8);
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(size).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.putInt(0, size).putShort(4, (short) 0x0200).putShort(6, (short) 2);
        b.put(8, new byte[] {0x30, 0x10, 6, 3, 0x55, 4, 3, 0x0c, (byte) name.length}).put(17, name);
        return b.array();
    }

    /** Appends a certificate at the next 8-byte boundary and points the PE certificate directory at it. */
    static byte[] signed(byte[] image, byte[] certificate) {
        int at = align(image.length, 8);
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(at + certificate.length).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(image).put(at, certificate);
        b.putInt(0x58 + 112 + 32, at).putInt(0x58 + 112 + 36, certificate.length);
        return b.array();
    }

    static byte[] concat(byte[]... parts) {
        var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        for (byte[] part : parts) out.writeBytes(part);
        return out.toByteArray();
    }

    static byte[] random(int size, long seed) {
        byte[] bytes = new byte[size];
        new Random(seed).nextBytes(bytes);
        return bytes;
    }

    static int align(int value, int alignment) { return (value + alignment - 1) / alignment * alignment; }
    private static int rdata(int rva) { return rva - RDATA_RVA + RDATA; }
    private static void section(ByteBuffer b, int at, String name, int rva, int virtualSize, int pointer, int rawSize, long flags) {
        byte[] bytes = name.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length && i < 8; i++) b.put(at + i, bytes[i]);
        b.putInt(at + 8, virtualSize).putInt(at + 12, rva).putInt(at + 16, rawSize).putInt(at + 20, pointer).putInt(at + 36, (int) flags);
    }
    private static void text(ByteBuffer b, int at, String value) {
        byte[] bytes = value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) b.put(at + i, bytes[i]);
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/FailureLabTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.LinkCheck;
import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.selection.SelectionResult;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * Phase 2AT failure lab on authored fixtures. CFR 0.152 decompiles a Java 17 pattern {@code instanceof} as an assignment
 * inside the condition, so javac emits {@code dup; astore} where the original had {@code astore; aload}: the method body
 * differs, while Vineflower 1.11.1 recovers it byte for byte. Nothing here executes fixture code.
 */
class FailureLabTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    static final Duration TIMEOUT = Duration.ofSeconds(60);
    // The first divergence after normalization; since Phase 2BB the pass-through store is skipped, so it starts at the constant.
    static final String SIGNATURE = "METHOD_DIFFERENT:cfr:body-differs:const-string/dup";
    static final String PROBE = """
        package demo;
        public class Probe {
            private final String name = "n";
            public int one() { return 1; }
            public String two(int k) { return k > 0 ? "a" : "b"; }
            public boolean named(Object other) { return other instanceof String text && text.equals(name); }
        }
        """;

    List<DecompilerEngine> engines() { return List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()); }

    Path compile(String name, String source, String release) throws Exception {
        Path file = dir.resolve("src").resolve(name + ".java");
        Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
        Files.writeString(file, source);
        Path classes = dir.resolve("classes-" + name.replace('/', '-'));
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", release, "-proc:none", "-Xlint:-options",
            "-d", classes.toString(), file.toString()));
        Path jar = dir.resolve(name.replace('/', '-') + ".jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var paths = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".class")).sorted().toList()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/'))); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(path)); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    /** Runs the probe through CFR and Vineflower and captures every engine candidate, as {@code classrevive lab} does. */
    FailureCollector capture() throws Exception {
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(compile("demo/Probe", PROBE, "17"), dir.resolve("job"), engines(), TIMEOUT);
        var collector = new FailureCollector(dir.resolve("failures"));
        collector.capture(job, dir.resolve("job"), "combined", null, true);
        collector.finish();
        return collector;
    }

    static void assertNoLocalPath(String text, Path root) {
        String absolute = root.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
        assertFalse(text.contains(absolute) || text.contains(absolute.replace('\\', '/')), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains(System.getProperty("user.home")), text);
    }

    @Test void capturesEngineCandidatesWithStableSignaturesAndKeepsTargetDetailsInTheCase() throws Exception {
        var collector = capture();
        assertEquals(1, collector.cases().size(), collector.cases().toString());
        var failure = collector.cases().getFirst();
        assertEquals(SIGNATURE, failure.signature());
        // Not selected since Phase 2AU+: the combined selection now takes a candidate that recovers this method.
        assertEquals("failure-0001", failure.id()); assertEquals("cfr", failure.candidate()); assertFalse(failure.selected());
        assertEquals("0.152", failure.engineVersion()); assertEquals("demo/Probe", failure.className());
        assertEquals("named(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z", failure.method()); assertEquals("demo/Probe.java", failure.sourceFile());
        assertEquals(Map.of("vineflower", "IDENTICAL"), failure.alternatives()); assertEquals(List.of("vineflower"), failure.recoverableBy());
        assertNull(failure.context(), "a one-class job has no other classes to put on the classpath");
        Path caseDirectory = collector.directory().resolve("failure-0001");
        var classes = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(caseDirectory.resolve("classes.jar"));
        assertEquals(Set.of("demo/Probe"), classes.keySet());
        assertEquals(FailureCollector.sha256(classes.get("demo/Probe")), failure.classSha256());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(caseDirectory.resolve("candidate.java")).contains("instanceof String"));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(caseDirectory.resolve("recompiled.class")));
        String json = Files.readString(caseDirectory.resolve("case.json"));
        assertEquals(failure, FailureCase.fromJson(Json.decode(json)));
        assertTrue(failure.excerpt().contains("first difference at normalized instruction"), failure.excerpt());
        assertNoLocalPath(json, dir);
        String summary = Files.readString(collector.directory().resolve("failures.json"));
        assertTrue(summary.contains(SIGNATURE), summary);
        for (String target : List.of("Probe", "named", "demo/")) assertFalse(summary.contains(target), "summary names the target: " + target);
        assertNoLocalPath(summary, dir);
        String markdown = Files.readString(collector.directory().resolve("failures.md"));
        assertTrue(markdown.contains("| `" + SIGNATURE + "` | 1 | 0 | 1 | combined 1 |"), markdown);
    }

    @Test void capturesCompileFailuresAndWorkerFailuresWithoutTargetNamesInTheSignature() throws Exception {
        var input = compile("fixtures/ThrowingInitializer", """
            package fixtures;
            public class ThrowingInitializer {
                static { if (true) throw new IllegalStateException("fixture must never execute"); }
                public int value() { return 42; }
            }
            """, "8");
        var broken = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "broken"; }
            public String version() { return "0"; }
            public List<String> command(Path in, Path out) {
                return List.of(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(), "-cp", dir.resolve("nothing").toString(), "NoSuchWorker");
            }
        };
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, dir.resolve("job"), List.of(broken, new CfrEngine()), TIMEOUT);
        var collector = new FailureCollector(dir.resolve("failures"));
        var cases = collector.capture(job, dir.resolve("job"), "combined", null, true);
        var signatures = cases.stream().map(FailureCase::signature).toList();
        assertTrue(signatures.contains("COMPILE_FAILED:cfr:compiler.err.initializer.must.be.able.to.complete.normally"), signatures.toString());
        assertTrue(signatures.contains("WORKER_FAILED:broken:ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO:java.lang.ClassNotFoundException"), signatures.toString());
        var compile = cases.stream().filter(item -> item.category().equals(FailureCase.COMPILE_FAILED)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals("fixtures/ThrowingInitializer", compile.className());
        assertTrue(compile.excerpt().contains("compiler.err.initializer.must.be.able.to.complete.normally"), compile.excerpt());
        var worker = cases.stream().filter(item -> item.category().equals(FailureCase.WORKER_FAILED)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertNull(worker.className());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(collector.directory().resolve(worker.id()).resolve("classes.jar")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve("job/TARGET_EXECUTED")));
    }

    @Test void groupsBySignatureMostFrequentFirst() {
        var cases = List.of(item("failure-0001", "cfr", "body-differs:astore/dup", true, Map.of("vineflower", "IDENTICAL")),
            item("failure-0002", "jadx", "body-differs:goto/ireturn", true, Map.of()),
            item("failure-0003", "cfr", "body-differs:astore/dup", false, Map.of("vineflower", "DIFFERENT")),
            item("failure-0004", "cfr", "body-differs:astore/dup", true, Map.of("procyon", "EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION")));
        var summary = FailureCollector.summary(cases);
        assertEquals(4L, summary.get("cases")); assertEquals(2L, summary.get("signatures"));
        var groups = (List<?>) summary.get("groups");
        var first = (Map<?,?>) groups.getFirst();
        assertEquals("METHOD_DIFFERENT:cfr:body-differs:astore/dup", first.get("signature"));
        assertEquals(3L, first.get("cases")); assertEquals(2L, first.get("selected")); assertEquals(2L, first.get("recoverable_by_other_candidate"));
        assertEquals(List.of("failure-0001", "failure-0003", "failure-0004"), first.get("case_ids"));
        assertEquals(Map.of("METHOD_DIFFERENT", 4L), summary.get("categories"));
        assertTrue(FailureCollector.markdown(summary, 1).contains("... 1 more in failures.json"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new FailureCase(null, "OTHER", "cfr", "x", "", "v", null, "cfr", true, false,
            null, null, null, null, "", "", Map.of(), null, null));
    }

    static FailureCase item(String id, String engine, String detail, boolean selected, Map<String,String> alternatives) {
        return new FailureCase(id, FailureCase.METHOD_DIFFERENT, engine, detail, "1", "combined", "case-001", engine, selected, false,
            "a/B", "00", "m()V", "a/B.java", "body differs after normalization", "", alternatives, "ff", null);
    }

    @Test void redactsAbsolutePathsAndBoundsExcerpts() {
        String text = "bad class file C:\\Users\\someone\\lib.jar and /home/someone/lib.jar, /tmp/x and " + dir.resolve("job/a.java")
            + " but keeps java/lang/String and (Ljava/lang/Object;)Z";
        String redacted = FailureCollector.redact(text, dir.resolve("job"));
        for (String gone : List.of("someone", "/tmp/x", dir.toString())) assertFalse(redacted.contains(gone), redacted);
        assertTrue(redacted.contains("java/lang/String") && redacted.contains("(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z"), redacted);
        assertTrue(FailureCollector.redact("x".repeat(5000), dir).endsWith("..."));
        assertEquals("compiler-err-x", FailureCollector.slug("compiler.err.X"));
        assertEquals("demo/Outer", FailureCollector.topLevel("demo/Outer$Inner$Deep"));
    }

    @Test void minimizesARealCfrFailureAndKeepsTheEngineThatRecoveredIt() throws Exception {
        var collector = capture();
        Path caseDirectory = collector.directory().resolve("failure-0001");
        var result = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(caseDirectory, dir.resolve("minimized"), engines(),
            new FailureMinimizer.Budget(60, Duration.ofMinutes(15), TIMEOUT));
        String log = Files.readString(dir.resolve("minimized/minimization.json"));
        assertEquals(FailureMinimizer.MINIMIZED, result.status(), log);
        assertEquals(SIGNATURE, result.signature());
        assertTrue(result.accepted() >= 1, log);
        assertTrue(result.minimized().members() < result.original().members(), log);
        assertTrue(result.minimized().bytes() < result.original().bytes(), log);
        var report = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(log);
        // The contrast engine must still recover the method; after reduction the round trip may call it equivalent.
        var contrast = (Map<?,?>) report.get("contrast_levels");
        assertEquals(Set.of("vineflower"), contrast.keySet());
        assertTrue(Set.of("IDENTICAL", "EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION").contains(contrast.get("vineflower")), contrast.toString());
        var outcomes = new TreeSet<String>();
        for (var step : (List<?>) report.get("steps")) outcomes.add(String.valueOf(((Map<?,?>) step).get("outcome")));
        assertTrue(Set.of("ACCEPTED", "REJECTED_LINK", "REJECTED_SIGNATURE", "REJECTED_NOT_REPEATED", "REJECTED_CONTRAST", "REJECTED_ERROR")
            .containsAll(outcomes), outcomes.toString());
        assertEquals("ACCEPTED", ((Map<?,?>) ((List<?>) report.get("steps")).getFirst()).get("outcome"));
        Path jar = result.directory().resolve("classes.jar");
        assertTrue(new LinkCheck().check(jar, dir.resolve("link"), List.of(), TIMEOUT).linked());
        var minimized = FailureCase.fromJson(Json.decode(Files.readString(result.directory().resolve("case.json"))));
        assertEquals(SIGNATURE, minimized.signature());
        assertEquals(FailureCollector.sha256(MethodRoundTrip.readJar(jar).get("demo/Probe")), minimized.classSha256());
        // An independent run on the reduced class still shows the same failure on the same method.
        var again = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, dir.resolve("again"), List.of(new CfrEngine()), TIMEOUT);
        assertTrue(FailureCollector.find(again, dir.resolve("again"), "lab", null, true).stream()
            .anyMatch(found -> found.data().signature().equals(SIGNATURE) && "named(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z".equals(found.data().method())));

        // The same case with an altered detail does not reproduce: one evaluation, nothing written as minimized.
        Path altered = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("altered"));
        Files.copy(caseDirectory.resolve("classes.jar"), altered.resolve("classes.jar"));
        Files.writeString(altered.resolve("case.json"), Files.readString(caseDirectory.resolve("case.json")).replace("const-string/dup", "nop/nop"));
        var refused = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(altered, dir.resolve("altered-out"), engines(), new FailureMinimizer.Budget(10, Duration.ofMinutes(5), TIMEOUT));
        assertEquals(FailureMinimizer.NOT_REPRODUCIBLE, refused.status());
        assertEquals(1, refused.evaluations()); assertNull(refused.directory());
        var unavailable = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(caseDirectory, dir.resolve("no-engine"), List.of(new VineflowerEngine()),
            new FailureMinimizer.Budget(10, Duration.ofMinutes(5), TIMEOUT));
        assertEquals(FailureMinimizer.UNSUPPORTED, unavailable.status()); assertEquals(0, unavailable.evaluations());
        var short_ = new FailureMinimizer().minimize(caseDirectory, dir.resolve("short"), engines(), new FailureMinimizer.Budget(2, Duration.ofMinutes(5), TIMEOUT));
        assertEquals(FailureMinimizer.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, short_.status());
        assertEquals(2, short_.evaluations());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(short_.directory().resolve("classes.jar")), "the last accepted state is kept");
    }

    @Test void promotedCasesFailWhenAMethodDropsAndReportImprovements() throws Exception {
        var collector = capture();
        Path regressions = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("regressions"));
        var expected = new RegressionSuite().promote(collector.directory().resolve("failure-0001"), regressions.resolve("probe"), engines(), TIMEOUT,
            "authored test fixture");
        var variants = (Map<?,?>) expected.get("variants");
        assertEquals(Set.of("cfr", "vineflower", "combined"), variants.keySet());
        String named = "demo/Probe.named(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z";
        assertEquals("DIFFERENT", levels(variants, "cfr").get(named));
        assertEquals("IDENTICAL", levels(variants, "vineflower").get(named));
        // Written in Phase 2AT, when combined still selected CFR here; the round-trip tie-break (2AU) and per-method
        // composition (2BD+) now recover it, so the promoted expectation records the gain and guards it.
        assertEquals("IDENTICAL", levels(variants, "combined").get(named), "combined recovers the body CFR alone gets wrong");
        assertEquals(Boolean.TRUE, ((Map<?,?>) variants.get("combined")).get("source_repair"));
        assertEquals(List.of(), expected.get("unstable_at_promotion"));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(regressions.resolve("probe/promotion")), "measurement jobs never land in the regression directory");

        var engines = engines();
        var clean = new RegressionSuite().check(regressions, dir.resolve("check-1"), engines, TIMEOUT);
        assertTrue(clean.passed(), clean.toString());
        assertEquals(1, clean.cases()); assertEquals(12, clean.checks().size(), clean.checks().toString());

        Path file = regressions.resolve("probe/expected.json");
        String original = Files.readString(file, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        var data = (Map<String,Object>) Json.decode(original);
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") var cfr = (Map<String,Object>) ((Map<String,Object>) ((Map<String,Object>) data.get("variants")).get("cfr")).get("minimum_levels");
        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked") var vineflower = (Map<String,Object>) ((Map<String,Object>) ((Map<String,Object>) data.get("variants")).get("vineflower")).get("minimum_levels");
        cfr.put(named, "IDENTICAL"); vineflower.put(named, "DIFFERENT");
        Files.writeString(file, Json.encode(data) + "\n");
        var changed = new RegressionSuite().check(regressions, dir.resolve("check-2"), engines, TIMEOUT);
        assertFalse(changed.passed());
        assertEquals(List.of(new RegressionSuite.Check("probe", "cfr", named, "IDENTICAL", "DIFFERENT")), changed.regressions());
        assertEquals(List.of(new RegressionSuite.Check("probe", "vineflower", named, "DIFFERENT", "IDENTICAL")), changed.improvements());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("check-2/regressions.md")).contains("| probe | cfr | `" + named + "` | IDENTICAL | DIFFERENT | REGRESSED |"));

        Files.writeString(file, original);
        Files.write(regressions.resolve("probe/classes.jar"), new byte[] {1, 2, 3}, StandardOpenOption.APPEND);
        var tampered = new RegressionSuite().check(regressions, dir.resolve("check-3"), engines, TIMEOUT);
        assertFalse(tampered.passed());
        assertTrue(tampered.errors().getFirst().contains("classes_sha256"), tampered.errors().toString());
        assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class, () -> new RegressionSuite().check(regressions, regressions.resolve("inside"), engines, TIMEOUT));
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    static Map<String,String> levels(Map<?,?> variants, String variant) {
        return (Map<String,String>) ((Map<?,?>) variants.get(variant)).get("minimum_levels");
    }

    @Test void workersThatCouldNotRunNeverBecomeExpectations() {
        var compiled = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, 0, 1, 1, 0, "");
        var failed = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.WORKER_FAILED, 1000, 0, 1, 0, "TIMED_OUT");
        var exited = new EngineResult("cfr", "1", EngineResult.Status.FAILED, 1, 0, 5, "x", EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.ENGINE_EXIT_NONZERO);
        var unstarted = new EngineResult("cfr", "1", EngineResult.Status.FAILED, -1, 0, 5, "x", EngineResult.DiagnosticCode.WORKER_START_FAILED);
        assertNull(RegressionSuite.unreliable(new DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob(List.of(exited), new SelectionResult("cfr", compiled, Map.of(), 1), null)));
        assertTrue(RegressionSuite.unreliable(new DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob(List.of(unstarted), new SelectionResult("cfr", compiled, Map.of(), 1), null))
            .contains("WORKER_START_FAILED"));
        assertTrue(RegressionSuite.unreliable(new DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob(List.of(exited), new SelectionResult("cfr", failed, Map.of(), 1), null))
            .contains("compiler worker failed"));
        assertEquals("SAME", new RegressionSuite.Check("c", "v", "m", "DIFFERENT", "DIFFERENT").verdict());
        assertEquals("REGRESSED", new RegressionSuite.Check("c", "v", "m", "NOT_RECOMPILED", "ABSENT").verdict());
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/GhidraExportTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class GhidraExportTest {
    /** The shape ClassReviveNativeExport.java writes for the fixture DLL (abridged). */
    static String sample() {
        return """
            {"schema_version":1,"tool":"ghidra","ghidra_version":"9.9-test","program":"fixture.dll","format":"Portable Executable (PE)",
             "language":"x86:LE:64:default","compiler":"windows","pointer_size":8,"image_base":"180000000","sha256":"00",
             "analyzed":true,"analysis_timed_out":false,"function_count":5,
             "blocks":[{"name":".text","start":"180001000","size":512,"permissions":"r-x","initialized":true,"entropy_millibits":1200}],
             "imports":[{"library":"KERNEL32.DLL","name":"GetTickCount"}],
             "exports":[{"name":"JNI_OnLoad","address":"180001000","function":true},
                        {"name":"Java_p_Lib_add__II","address":"180001010","function":true}],
             "jni_functions":[{"name":"JNI_OnLoad","address":"180001000","size":11,"signature":"int JNI_OnLoad(void)","calls":["FUN_180001040@180001040"],"created_by_script":false},
                              {"name":"Java_p_Lib_add__II","address":"180001010","size":5,"signature":"int Java_p_Lib_add__II(void)","calls":[],"created_by_script":false}],
             "register_natives_sites":[{"function":"FUN_180001040","address":"180001043","instruction":"CALL qword ptr [RAX + 0x6b8]","depth":1}],
             "strings":[{"address":"1800020a0","type":"string","length":20,"value":"0123456789abcdef0123"}],
             "native_method_tables":[{"entry":"180003000","name":"0123456789abcdef0123","descriptor":"(Ljava/lang/String;)V",
                                      "function_address":"180001030","function":"FUN_180001030"}],
             "decompiled":[{"name":"JNI_OnLoad","address":"180001000","completed":true,"truncated":false,"c":"int JNI_OnLoad(void)\\n{\\n  return 0x10006;\\n}\\n"},
                           {"name":"Java_p_Lib_add__II","address":"180001010","completed":false,"error":"timeout"}]}
            """;
    }

    @Test void readsTheExport() {
        var export = GhidraExport.parse(sample());
        assertEquals("9.9-test", export.ghidraVersion());
        assertEquals(8, export.pointerSize());
        assertTrue(export.analyzed());
        assertEquals(2, export.exports().size());
        assertTrue(export.exports("JNI_OnLoad"));
        assertEquals("CALL qword ptr [RAX + 0x6b8]", export.registerNativesSites().getFirst().instruction());
        assertEquals("(Ljava/lang/String;)V", export.nativeMethodTables().getFirst().descriptor());
        assertTrue(export.decompiled().getFirst().code().contains("return 0x10006;"));
        assertFalse(export.decompiled().get(1).completed());
        assertEquals("timeout", export.decompiled().get(1).error());
        assertEquals(1200, export.blocks().getFirst().entropyMillibits());
    }

    @Test void rejectsOtherDocuments() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample().replace("\"schema_version\":1", "\"schema_version\":2")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample().replace("\"tool\":\"ghidra\"", "\"tool\":\"other\"")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample().replace("\"function_count\":5", "\"function_count\":\"5\"")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample().replace("\"imports\":", "\"imported\":")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse("[1]"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample() + "x"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> GhidraExport.parse(sample().replace("\"size\":512", "\"size\":5.5")));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/GhidraIntegrationTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.condition.EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

/**
 * Phase 2CC: the real Ghidra on the generated JNI DLL. Runs only when GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR names an installation (it is
 * never downloaded); the build stays green without Ghidra. The DLL is analyzed statically and never loaded.
 */
@EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable(named = "GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR", matches = ".+")
class GhidraIntegrationTest {
    @TempDir Path temp;

    @Test void ghidraAnalyzesTheFixtureDllAndTheExportIsLinked() throws Exception {
        Path jar = NativeFixtures.jar(temp, Map.of("native/win-x64/fixture.dll", NativeFixtures.pe(false)));
        var options = NativeAnalysis.Options.defaults(null, System.getenv()).withLimits(1024 * 1024, 1, Duration.ofMinutes(10));
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("native"), options);
        var library = result.libraries().getFirst();
        assertEquals("ANALYZED", result.status(), result.text() + library.notes());
        var ghidra = library.ghidra();
        assertTrue(ghidra.format().contains("PE"), ghidra.format());
        assertEquals(8, ghidra.pointerSize());
        assertTrue(ghidra.exports("JNI_OnLoad") && ghidra.exports("Java_p_Lib_add__II") && ghidra.exports("Java_p_Lib_name"), ghidra.exports().toString());
        var names = ghidra.jniFunctions().stream().map(GhidraExport.Function::name).toList();
        assertTrue(names.containsAll(List.of("JNI_OnLoad", "Java_p_Lib_add__II", "Java_p_Lib_name")), names.toString());
        assertTrue(ghidra.imports().stream().anyMatch(i -> i.name().equals("GetTickCount")), ghidra.imports().toString());
        assertFalse(ghidra.registerNativesSites().isEmpty(), "call [rax+0x6b8] in JNI_OnLoad's callee");
        assertTrue(ghidra.registerNativesSites().getFirst().instruction().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("0x6b8"));
        assertTrue(ghidra.decompiled().stream().anyMatch(d -> d.completed() && d.name().equals("JNI_OnLoad")), ghidra.decompiled().toString());
        var kinds = new TreeSet<String>(); result.links().forEach(l -> kinds.add(l.method().name() + ":" + l.kind()));
        assertTrue(kinds.containsAll(List.of("add:EXPORT", "name:EXPORT")), kinds.toString());
        assertTrue(kinds.contains(NativeFixtures.HEX_NATIVE + ":TABLE"), "JNINativeMethod entry found statically: " + kinds + " " + ghidra.nativeMethodTables());
        assertTrue(result.unresolved().isEmpty(), result.unresolved().toString());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(temp.resolve("native").resolve(library.directory()).resolve("pseudo-c/01-JNI_OnLoad.c")));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/HtmlReportTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class HtmlReportTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    @Test void writesASelfContainedConfidenceMapBesideTheJsonReport() throws Exception {
        var source = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src/p"));
        Files.writeString(source.resolve("Calc.java"), "package p; public class Calc { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; }"
            + " public static class Inner { public String name() { return \"inner\"; } } }");
        var classes = dir.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", classes.toString(), source.resolve("Calc.java").toString()));
        var jar = dir.resolve("calc.jar");
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (String name : List.of("p/Calc.class", "p/Calc$Inner.class")) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry(name)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(name))); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var output = dir.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, output, List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        String html = Files.readString(output.resolve("report.html"));
        assertTrue(html.startsWith("<!doctype html>"), html);
        assertTrue(html.contains("calc.jar") && html.contains("<code>p</code>"), html);
        assertTrue(html.contains("<code>Calc</code>") && html.contains("<code>Calc$Inner</code>"), html);
        // Both classes recompile with every signature and every body identical or equivalent.
        assertEquals(2, html.split("<span class=\"pill exact\">exact</span>", -1).length - 1, html);
        assertTrue(html.contains(job.selection().verification().matchedSymbols() + "/" + job.selection().verification().expectedSymbols()), html);
        // Self-contained: no script and no external resource.
        assertFalse(html.contains("<script") || html.contains("http://") || html.contains("https://") || html.contains("src="), html);
        assertTrue(html.contains("not proof of behavior"), html);
    }

    @Test void escapesEveryNameTakenFromTheInput() {
        assertEquals("a&lt;b&gt;&amp;&quot;c&quot;&#39;d&#7;", HtmlReport.escape("a<b>&\"c\"'d\u0007"));
    }
}
```
