`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/InputIdentifierTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.Verdict;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static dev.classrevive.pipeline.ExecutableFixtures.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class InputIdentifierTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    static InputIdentifier.Identification identify(byte[] bytes, String name) { return InputIdentifier.identify(bytes, name, null); }

    @Test void jarConcatenatedToPeStubIsFoundAndExtractedExactly() throws Exception {
        byte[] jar = jar();
        byte[] exe = concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), jar);
        var found = identify(exe, "app.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.EMBEDDED_JAR, found.verdict(), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.format().startsWith("PE32+ x86-64 console executable"), found.format());
        assertTrue(found.selected().location().contains("overlay"), found.selected().location());
        assertEquals(EXTRA, found.selected().offset());
        assertEquals(1, found.selected().classEntries());
        assertTrue(found.javaAvailable());
        assertNull(found.wrapper());
        Path input = Files.write(directory.resolve("app.exe"), exe);
        var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(input);
        assertTrue(resolved.jar());
        assertArrayEquals(jar, resolved.bytes());
        try (var zip = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(resolved.bytes()))) {
            var names = new ArrayList<String>();
            for (ZipEntry entry; (entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null; ) names.add(entry.getName());
            assertEquals(List.of("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "p/Hello.class"), names);
        }
    }

    @Test void launch4jStyleSignedExecutableSeparatesSignatureFromJar() throws Exception {
        byte[] jar = jar();
        byte[] exe = signed(concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount"), "Launch4j", null, null, false, 2), jar), certificate("ClassRevive Test Signer"));
        var found = identify(exe, "launcher.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.EMBEDDED_JAR, found.verdict(), found.text());
        assertEquals("Launch4j", found.wrapper());
        assertTrue(found.format().contains("GUI executable"), found.format());
        String text = found.text();
        assertTrue(text.contains("Authenticode signature (WIN_CERTIFICATE revision 2.0, type PKCS#7 SignedData)"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("ClassRevive Test Signer"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("data overlay (not the signature)"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("by Launch4j"), text);
        // sign4j style: the zip comment is stretched over the signature, so the end record no longer ends the file.
        byte[] stretched = exe.clone();
        int eocd = EXTRA + jar.length - 22;
        int comment = stretched.length - (eocd + 22);
        ByteBuffer.wrap(stretched).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putShort(eocd + 20, (short) comment);
        var sign4j = identify(stretched, "launcher.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.EMBEDDED_JAR, sign4j.verdict(), sign4j.text());
        assertEquals(EXTRA, sign4j.selected().offset());
        // Only the signature after the sections: the overlay holds no data.
        var plain = identify(signed(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), certificate("Signer")), "signed.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, plain.verdict(), plain.text());
        assertTrue(plain.text().contains("the overlay is only the signature"), plain.text());
    }

    @Test void pkSequencesWithoutCentralDirectoryAreNotArchives() throws Exception {
        byte[] noise = random(64 * 1024, 7);
        var b = ByteBuffer.wrap(noise).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        for (int at : new int[] {100, 5000, 30000}) b.put(at, (byte) 'P').put(at + 1, (byte) 'K').put(at + 2, (byte) 3).put(at + 3, (byte) 4);
        // A fake end record whose central directory points into noise.
        int e = 60000;
        b.put(e, (byte) 'P').put(e + 1, (byte) 'K').put(e + 2, (byte) 5).put(e + 3, (byte) 6);
        b.putShort(e + 4, (short) 0).putShort(e + 6, (short) 0).putShort(e + 8, (short) 1).putShort(e + 10, (short) 1)
            .putInt(e + 12, 46 + 9).putInt(e + 16, 100).putShort(e + 20, (short) 0);
        var unknown = identify(noise, "data.bin");
        assertTrue(unknown.archives().isEmpty(), unknown.text());
        assertEquals(Verdict.UNKNOWN, unknown.verdict(), unknown.text());
        assertTrue(unknown.text().contains("3 'PK\\x03\\x04' sequence(s) outside every valid archive"), unknown.text());
        var inExe = identify(concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), noise), "tool.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, inExe.verdict(), inExe.text());
        Path input = Files.write(directory.resolve("tool.exe"), concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), noise));
        var error = assertThrows(InputIdentifier.NoJavaException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(input));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("NATIVE_NO_JAVA"), error.getMessage());
    }

    @Test void protectedExecutableWithVlizerAndInjectionImportsIsExplained() throws Exception {
        byte[] exe = pe(List.of("OpenProcess", "VirtualAllocEx", "WriteProcessMemory", "CreateRemoteThread", "GetTickCount"),
            "javaw.exe", ".vlizer", random(128 * 1024, 11), false, 3);
        var found = identify(exe, "loader.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_PROTECTED_NO_JAVA, found.verdict(), found.text());
        String text = found.text();
        assertTrue(text.contains("section .vlizer"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("Oreans Code Virtualizer"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("high-entropy section .vlizer: 131072 bytes"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("OpenProcess (import), VirtualAllocEx (import), WriteProcessMemory (import), CreateRemoteThread (import)"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("4/4 of open, allocate, write, start thread"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("no readable JNI or JVMTI name"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("names javaw.exe as text"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("possibly encrypted inside the binary or loaded at run time; not recoverable statically"), text);
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_PROTECTED_NO_JAVA, ((Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Json.encode(found.json()))).get("verdict") instanceof String v
            ? Verdict.valueOf(v) : null);
        Path input = Files.write(directory.resolve("loader.exe"), exe);
        var error = assertThrows(InputIdentifier.NoJavaException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(input));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("(NATIVE_PROTECTED_NO_JAVA)"), error.getMessage());
        // Injection imports alone, with low-entropy code, are not "protected".
        var injector = identify(pe(List.of("OpenProcess", "VirtualAllocEx", "WriteProcessMemory", "CreateRemoteThread")), "injector.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, injector.verdict(), injector.text());
        assertTrue(injector.text().contains("process-injection API set"), injector.text());
    }

    @Test void elfMachOAndNativeImageAreRecognized() {
        var elf = identify(NativeFixtures.elf(), "libfixture.so");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, elf.verdict(), elf.text());
        assertTrue(elf.format().startsWith("ELF64 x86-64 shared object"), elf.format());
        var machO = ByteBuffer.allocate(64).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN).putInt(0, 0xfeedfacf).putInt(4, 0x01000007).putInt(12, 2).array();
        var mac = identify(machO, "tool");
        assertEquals("Mach-O 64 x86-64 executable (macOS)", mac.format());
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, mac.verdict());
        var graal = identify(concat(NativeFixtures.elf(), "com.oracle.svm.core.JavaMainWrapper\0".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII)), "app");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_IMAGE, graal.verdict(), graal.text());
        assertTrue(graal.explanation().contains("no bytecode exists to recover"), graal.explanation());
    }

    @Test void archivesClassFilesAndOtherFormats() throws Exception {
        byte[] jar = jar();
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_ARCHIVE, identify(jar, "renamed.zip").verdict());
        byte[] hello = classBytes(jar);
        var cls = identify(hello, "Hello.bin");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_CLASS, cls.verdict());
        assertTrue(cls.format().contains("Java 8"), cls.format());
        var war = identify(zip(Map.of("WEB-INF/classes/p/Hello.class", hello, "WEB-INF/web.xml", new byte[] {1})), "app.war");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_ARCHIVE_OTHER_LAYOUT, war.verdict(), war.text());
        assertTrue(war.explanation().contains("WEB-INF/classes"), war.explanation());
        var jmod = identify(concat(new byte[] {'J', 'M', 1, 0}, zip(Map.of("classes/p/Hello.class", hello))), "p.jmod");
        assertTrue(jmod.format().startsWith("Java module (jmod"), jmod.format());
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_ARCHIVE_OTHER_LAYOUT, jmod.verdict(), jmod.text());
        var bundle = identify(zip(Map.of("lib/a.jar", jar, "readme.txt", new byte[] {1})), "bundle.zip");
        // Phase 2DB: a zip of jars with classes is a bundle of Java jars (JavaBundleTest has the details).
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_BUNDLE, bundle.verdict(), bundle.text());
        assertTrue(bundle.explanation().contains("take lib/a.jar"), bundle.explanation());
        var dotnet = identify(pe(List.of("_CorExeMain"), null, null, null, true, 3), "managed.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.DOTNET, dotnet.verdict(), dotnet.text());
        var nsis = identify(concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), "ï¾­ÞNullsoftInst".getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1), random(4096, 3)), "setup.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.INSTALLER, nsis.verdict(), nsis.text());
        assertTrue(nsis.explanation().startsWith("NSIS"), nsis.explanation());
        var msi = identify(concat(new byte[] {(byte) 0xd0, (byte) 0xcf, 0x11, (byte) 0xe0, (byte) 0xa1, (byte) 0xb1, 0x1a, (byte) 0xe1}, new byte[512]), "setup.msi");
        assertEquals(Verdict.INSTALLER, msi.verdict(), msi.text());
        assertTrue(msi.format().contains("Windows Installer"), msi.format());
        var script = identify(concat("#!/bin/sh\nexec java -jar \"$0\" \"$@\"\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII), jar), "tool.run");
        assertEquals(Verdict.EMBEDDED_JAR, script.verdict(), script.text());
        assertTrue(script.wrapper().startsWith("shell-script stub"), script.wrapper());
        assertTrue(script.format().startsWith("script (#!/bin/sh)"), script.format());
        var random = identify(random(4096, 5), "blob.dat");
        assertEquals(Verdict.UNKNOWN, random.verdict());
    }

    @Test void launcherWithoutEmbeddedJarPointsToTheJarNextToIt() throws Exception {
        Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("app"));
        Files.write(directory.resolve("app").resolve("main.jar"), jar());
        Path exe = Files.write(directory.resolve("Main.exe"), pe(List.of("GetTickCount"), "launch4j lib/main.jar", null, null, false, 2));
        var found = InputIdentifier.identify(exe);
        assertEquals(Verdict.EXTERNAL_JAR_LAUNCHER, found.verdict(), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.explanation().contains("app/main.jar"), found.explanation());
        assertTrue(found.text().contains(".jar names written in the file: lib/main.jar"), found.text());
    }

    @Test void decompilationTakesTheEmbeddedJarAndRecordsItsOrigin() throws Exception {
        byte[] jar = jar();
        Path exe = Files.write(directory.resolve("app.exe"), signed(concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount"), "Launch4j", null, null, false, 2), jar),
            certificate("Signer")));
        Path output = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(exe, output, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().verification().detail());
        assertArrayEquals(jar, Files.readAllBytes(output.resolve("input.jar")));
        String origin = Files.readString(output.resolve("input-origin/identification.txt"));
        assertTrue(origin.contains("Verdict: EMBEDDED_JAR"), origin);
        assertTrue(origin.contains("Extracted: bytes 0xe00.."), origin);
        String line = InputIdentifier.attach(output, output.resolve("report.txt"), output.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(line.startsWith("Input origin: PE32+ x86-64 GUI executable"), line);
        assertTrue(line.contains("wrapper: Launch4j"), line);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Input origin:"));
        var report = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.json")));
        assertEquals("EMBEDDED_JAR", ((Map<?,?>) report.get("input_origin")).get("verdict"));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("selection/sources/p/Hello.java")));
        // A protected executable: refused with what it is, and no output directory.
        Path loader = Files.write(directory.resolve("loader.exe"), pe(List.of("OpenProcess"), null, ".vlizer", random(96 * 1024, 2), false, 3));
        assertThrows(InputIdentifier.NoJavaException.class,
            () -> new DecompilationJob().runVerified(loader, directory.resolve("refused"), List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60)));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(directory.resolve("refused")));
    }

    private static byte[] classBytes(byte[] jar) throws IOException {
        try (var zip = new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(jar))) {
            for (ZipEntry entry; (entry = zip.getNextEntry()) != null; ) if (entry.getName().endsWith(".class")) return zip.readAllBytes();
        }
        throw new AssertionError("no class");
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/JavaBundleTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.InputIdentifier.Verdict;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import static dev.classrevive.pipeline.ExecutableFixtures.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Phase 2DB: zips of jars, alone or inside an executable, written by the test itself and only read as bytes. */
class JavaBundleTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    /** A jar of empty public classes with these internal names, and a manifest (with Main-Class when {@code main} is set). */
    static byte[] classes(String main, String... names) throws IOException {
        var entries = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        entries.put("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", ("Manifest-Version: 1.0\r\n" + (main == null ? "" : "Main-Class: " + main + "\r\n") + "\r\n")
            .getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
        for (String name : names) {
            var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
            writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
            writer.visitEnd();
            entries.put(name + ".class", writer.toByteArray());
        }
        return zip(entries);
    }

    /** A zip whose entries are all stored (not deflated), as some launchers write their payload. */
    static byte[] stored(Map<String,byte[]> entries) throws IOException {
        var bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(bytes)) {
            for (var entry : new TreeMap<>(entries).entrySet()) {
                var item = entry(entry.getKey());
                var crc = new CRC32(); crc.update(entry.getValue());
                item.setMethod(ZipEntry.STORED); item.setSize(entry.getValue().length); item.setCompressedSize(entry.getValue().length);
                item.setCrc(crc.getValue());
                out.putNextEntry(item); out.write(entry.getValue()); out.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }

    private Map<String,byte[]> launcherPayload() throws IOException {
        var payload = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        payload.put("libs/gson.jar", classes(null, "com/google/gson/Gson", "com/google/gson/JsonElement", "com/google/gson/JsonParser"));
        payload.put("client-1.0.jar", classes(null, "app/Client", "app/Render"));
        payload.put("loader.jar", classes("boot/Loader", "boot/Loader"));
        payload.put("bridge.jar", zip(Map.of("readme.txt", new byte[] {1})));
        payload.put("native.dll", random(512, 9));
        return payload;
    }

    @Test void zipInsideAnExecutableSectionIsABundleAndTheApplicationJarIsTaken() throws Exception {
        byte[] exe = pe(List.of("CreateProcessW"), "javaw.exe", ".rdata2", zip(launcherPayload()), false, 2);
        var found = InputIdentifierTest.identify(exe, "Launcher.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_BUNDLE, found.verdict(), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.javaAvailable());
        assertTrue(found.selected().location().contains("inside the executable's image"), found.selected().location());
        assertEquals(EXTRA, found.selected().offset());
        String text = found.text();
        assertTrue(text.contains("nested jar client-1.0.jar: 2 classes"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("<- main"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("nested jar libs/gson.jar: 3 classes") && text.contains("library Gson, library folder"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("nested jar loader.jar: 1 classes") && text.contains("Main-Class"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("nested jar bridge.jar: 0 classes"), text);
        assertTrue(text.contains("1 other entry in the bundle (not Java, never run): native.dll"), text);
        assertTrue(found.explanation().contains("4 nested .jar entries") && found.explanation().contains("3 with classes (6 classes in all)"),
            found.explanation());
        assertTrue(found.explanation().contains("take client-1.0.jar"), found.explanation());
        // The JNI wording no longer suggests there is no Java.
        assertTrue(text.contains("does not start a JVM through JNI itself"), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains("no readable JNI or JVMTI name (JNI_CreateJavaVM"), text);
        var bundle = (Map<?,?>) found.json().get("bundle");
        assertEquals("client-1.0.jar", bundle.get("main"));
        assertEquals(4, ((List<?>) bundle.get("jars")).size());

        Path input = Files.write(directory.resolve("Launcher.exe"), exe);
        var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(input);
        assertEquals("client-1.0.jar", resolved.entry());
        assertArrayEquals(launcherPayload().get("client-1.0.jar"), resolved.bytes());
        assertEquals(List.of("libs/gson.jar", "loader.jar"), List.copyOf(resolved.classpath().keySet()));
        // --entry: a full name or a unique base name; anything else is refused with the names.
        assertEquals("loader.jar", InputIdentifier.resolve(input, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "loader.jar").entry());
        assertEquals("libs/gson.jar", InputIdentifier.resolve(input, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "gson.jar").entry());
        var missing = assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(input, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "nope.jar"));
        assertTrue(missing.getMessage().contains("client-1.0.jar"), missing.getMessage());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(input, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "bridge.jar"));
        Path plain = Files.write(directory.resolve("plain.exe"), concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), jar()));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> InputIdentifier.resolve(plain, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "x.jar"));

        // identify --output: the nested jars written as data.
        Path evidence = InputIdentifier.write(directory.resolve("evidence"), found);
        assertEquals(List.of("bundle/libs_gson.jar", "bundle/client-1.0.jar", "bundle/loader.jar", "bundle/bridge.jar").stream().sorted().toList(),
            InputIdentifier.extractBundle(input, found, evidence).stream().sorted().toList());
        assertArrayEquals(launcherPayload().get("loader.jar"), Files.readAllBytes(evidence.resolve("bundle/loader.jar")));
    }

    @Test void storedPayloadInTheOverlayAndALibraryOutsideALibFolder() throws Exception {
        // The largest jar is Gson by its packages: the smaller application jar is taken; nested jars are stored, not deflated.
        var payload = Map.of("gson-2.10.jar", classes(null, "com/google/gson/A", "com/google/gson/B", "com/google/gson/C", "com/google/gson/D"),
            "app.jar", classes(null, "app/Main"));
        var found = InputIdentifierTest.identify(concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), stored(payload)), "app.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_BUNDLE, found.verdict(), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.selected().location().contains("overlay"), found.selected().location());
        assertEquals("app.jar", ((Map<?,?>) found.json().get("bundle")).get("main"));
        // Only libraries: the largest is taken.
        var libraries = InputIdentifierTest.identify(zip(Map.of("lib/gson.jar", payload.get("gson-2.10.jar"))), "libs.zip");
        assertEquals(Verdict.JAVA_BUNDLE, libraries.verdict(), libraries.text());
        assertEquals("lib/gson.jar", ((Map<?,?>) libraries.json().get("bundle")).get("main"));
    }

    @Test void backslashFoldersAndVariantsOfTheMainJar() throws Exception {
        // Zips written on Windows may name "libs\\x.jar"; a jar holding the main jar's classes under other mappings is a variant.
        var payload = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        payload.put("libs\\big.jar", classes(null, "x/A", "x/B", "x/C", "x/D", "x/E"));
        payload.put("client-a.jar", classes(null, "app/Client", "app/Render", "app/World"));
        payload.put("client-b.jar", classes(null, "app/Client", "app/Render", "app/World", "app/Extra"));
        payload.put("bridge.jar", classes(null, "bridge/Hook"));
        // Mostly other names, but one class of the main jar: still left off, since the verifier refuses a class defined twice.
        payload.put("client-c.jar", classes(null, "a/a", "a/b", "app/Client"));
        Path input = Files.write(directory.resolve("variants.exe"), concat(pe(List.of("GetTickCount")), zip(payload)));
        var found = InputIdentifier.identify(input);
        assertEquals("client-b.jar", ((Map<?,?>) found.json().get("bundle")).get("main"), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.text().contains("nested jar libs\\big.jar: 5 classes, ") && found.text().contains("library folder"), found.text());
        assertTrue(found.text().contains("nested jar client-a.jar: 3 classes") && found.text().contains("variant of the main jar"), found.text());
        var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(input);
        assertEquals(List.of("libs\\big.jar", "bridge.jar"), List.copyOf(resolved.classpath().keySet()));
        assertEquals(List.of("client-a.jar", "client-c.jar"), resolved.leftOff());
        assertEquals("libs\\big.jar", InputIdentifier.resolve(input, Duration.ofSeconds(10), "big.jar").entry());
    }

    @Test void nestedJarsWithoutClassesAreNoJava() throws Exception {
        byte[] payload = zip(Map.of("a.jar", zip(Map.of("readme.txt", new byte[] {1})), "b.jar", new byte[] {1, 2, 3}));
        var exe = InputIdentifierTest.identify(pe(List.of("GetTickCount"), null, ".rdata2", payload, false, 2), "empty.exe");
        assertEquals(Verdict.NATIVE_NO_JAVA, exe.verdict(), exe.text());
        assertTrue(exe.text().contains("2 nested .jar entries"), exe.text());
        assertFalse(exe.javaAvailable());
        var plain = InputIdentifierTest.identify(payload, "empty.zip");
        assertEquals(Verdict.ARCHIVE_WITHOUT_CLASSES, plain.verdict(), plain.text());
    }

    @Test void inflationIsBoundedByTheRecordedSize() throws Exception {
        byte[] jar = classes(null, "p/A");
        byte[] payload = zip(Map.of("p.jar", jar));
        var archive = InputIdentifier.archives(payload, -1).getFirst();
        var entry = JavaBundle.entries(payload, archive).getFirst();
        assertArrayEquals(jar, JavaBundle.data(payload, archive, entry));
        var lie = new JavaBundle.Entry(entry.name(), entry.flags(), entry.method(), entry.compressed(), entry.size() - 1, entry.local());
        assertNull(JavaBundle.data(payload, archive, lie));
        assertEquals("Gson", JavaBundle.library(List.of("com/google/gson/A", "com/google/gson/B")));
        assertNull(JavaBundle.library(List.of("com/google/gson/A", "app/Main")));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/JniNamesTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class JniNamesTest {
    @Test void decodesShortAndLongNames() {
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("p/Lib", "name", null), JniNames.decode("Java_p_Lib_name").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("p/Lib", "add", "(II)"), JniNames.decode("Java_p_Lib_add__II").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("com/github/luben/zstd/Zstd", "compressUnsafe", "(JJJJI)"),
            JniNames.decode("Java_com_github_luben_zstd_Zstd_compressUnsafe__JJJJI").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("a/B", "m", "([BLjava/lang/String;)"),
            JniNames.decode("Java_a_B_m___3BLjava_lang_String_2").orElseThrow());
    }

    @Test void decodesEscapes() {
        // JNA: Native._getPointer is Native__1getPointer (a separator, then an escaped underscore), not a signature.
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("com/sun/jna/Native", "_getPointer", null), JniNames.decode("Java_com_sun_jna_Native__1getPointer").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("my_pkg/C", "x", null), JniNames.decode("Java_my_1pkg_C_x").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("p/C$I", "é", null), JniNames.decode("Java_p_C_00024I__000e9").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(new JniNames.Method("p/A", "m", "(I)"), JniNames.decode("_Java_p_A_m__I@16").orElseThrow());
    }

    @Test void rejectsOtherSymbols() {
        assertTrue(JniNames.decode("JNI_OnLoad").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(JniNames.decode("Java_Only").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(JniNames.decode("Java_p_A_m_0zz").isEmpty());
        assertTrue(JniNames.decode("Java_p__").isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void matchesTheDeclaredMethod() {
        var shortName = JniNames.decode("Java_p_Lib_add").orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(shortName.matches("p/Lib", "add", "(II)I"));
        assertTrue(JniNames.decode("Java_p_Lib_add__II").orElseThrow().matches("p/Lib", "add", "(II)I"));
        assertFalse(JniNames.decode("Java_p_Lib_add__J").orElseThrow().matches("p/Lib", "add", "(II)I"));
    }

    @Test void obfuscatedNames() {
        assertTrue(JniNames.obfuscatedName("0a2b4acb11223344"));
        assertTrue(JniNames.obfuscatedName("abcdefabcdefabcdef"));
        assertTrue(JniNames.obfuscatedName("bad-name"));
        assertFalse(JniNames.obfuscatedName("compress"));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/JsonTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class JsonTest {
    @Test void escapesControlsQuotesAndSurrogates() {
        assertEquals("\"a\\n\\t\\\"\\\\\\u0000\\ud800\"", Json.encode("a\n\t\"\\\0\ud800"));
    }
    @Test void sortsKeysAndHandlesNestedValues() {
        var values = new HashMap<String,Object>();
        values.put("z", null); values.put("a", List.of(true, 12, "ok"));
        assertEquals("{\"a\":[true,12,\"ok\"],\"z\":null}", Json.encode(values));
    }
    @Test void decodesWhatItEncodes() {
        var values = new TreeMap<String,Object>();
        values.put("text", "a\n\t\"\\\0\ud800/é"); values.put("list", List.of(true, false, -12L, List.of(), Map.of()));
        values.put("none", null); values.put("nested", Map.of("k", 9_000_000_000L));
        assertEquals(values, Json.decode(Json.encode(values)));
        assertEquals(List.of("x"), Json.decode(" [ \"\\u0078\" ] "));
    }
    @Test void decodingIsStrict() {
        for (String bad : List.of("", "{", "[1,]", "{\"a\":1,\"a\":2}", "1.5", "1e3", "01x", "\"open", "[1] 2", "nul", "{a:1}",
                "\"\\q\"", "\"tab\there\"", "-", "99999999999999999999"))
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> Json.decode(bad), bad);
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> Json.decode("[".repeat(100) + "]".repeat(100)));
    }
    @Test void rejectsNonFiniteOrUnknownValues() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> Json.encode(Double.NaN));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> Json.encode(new Object()));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/KotlinInputTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2DG: a class carrying {@code @kotlin.Metadata} must come out of Vineflower as Java, not as a .kt file. */
class KotlinInputTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    @Test void vineflowerWritesJavaForKotlinClasses() throws Exception {
        // A stand-in for kotlinc's annotation; Vineflower's Kotlin plugin chooses classes by its name alone.
        var kotlin = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src/kotlin")).resolve("Metadata.java");
        Files.writeString(kotlin, """
            package kotlin;
            @java.lang.annotation.Retention(java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME)
            public @interface Metadata { int k() default 1; int[] mv() default {}; String[] d1() default {}; String[] d2() default {}; }
            """);
        var main = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src/k")).resolve("Main.java");
        Files.writeString(main, """
            package k;
            @kotlin.Metadata(k = 1, mv = {2, 0, 0})
            public final class Main { public int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } }
            """);
        var classes = directory.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString(),
            kotlin.toString(), main.toString()));
        var jar = directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("k/Main.class")); out.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve("k/Main.class"))); out.closeEntry();
        }
        var result = new ProcessRunner().run(new VineflowerEngine(), jar, directory.resolve("vineflower"), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED, result.status(), result.toString());
        var sources = directory.resolve("vineflower/sources");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(sources.resolve("k/Main.java")).contains("public int add("));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(sources.resolve("k/Main.kt")));
    }
    @Test void enginePreferenceNamesTheSourceFilesOfKotlinClasses() throws Exception {
        var jar = directory.resolve("classes.jar");
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var name : new String[] {"k/Main", "k/Main$Companion", "k/Other", "j/Util"}) {
                var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
                writer.visit(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_8, org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
                if (name.startsWith("k/")) writer.visitAnnotation("Lkotlin/Metadata;", true).visitEnd();
                writer.visitEnd();
                out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name + ".class")); out.write(writer.toByteArray()); out.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        try (var out = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(directory.resolve("none.jar")))) {
            var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
            writer.visit(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_8, org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "j/Util", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
            writer.visitEnd();
            out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("j/Util.class")); out.write(writer.toByteArray()); out.closeEntry();
        }
        var preference = DecompilationJob.enginePreference(jar);
        assertEquals(java.util.Set.of("k/Main.java", "k/Other.java"), preference.kotlinFiles());
        assertTrue(preference.reason().contains("jadx is tried first"), preference.reason());
        assertEquals(dev.classrevive.selection.EnginePreference.NONE, DecompilationJob.enginePreference(directory.resolve("none.jar")));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/MemberNameJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2BW: a native-stub shape seen in obfuscated jars, built with ASM because javac cannot write it. {@code p/Stub} declares
 * {@code private static native void 0a2b4acb()}, which its static initializer calls after {@code p/Loader.register(Class)};
 * a private method {@code 1sum()} reads a private field {@code 2count}, and the public {@code total()} calls it. Nothing runs.
 */
class MemberNameJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    List<DecompilerEngine> engines() { return List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()); }

    static byte[] loader() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/Loader", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        CaseCollisionJobTest.constructor(writer);
        var register = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "register", "(Ljava/lang/Class;)V", null, null);
        register.visitCode(); register.visitInsn(RETURN); register.visitMaxs(0, 1); register.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    static byte[] stub() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/Stub", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC, "2count", "I", null, null).visitEnd();
        CaseCollisionJobTest.constructor(writer);
        writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC | ACC_NATIVE, "0a2b4acb", "()V", null, null).visitEnd();
        var sum = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC, "1sum", "(I)I", null, null);
        sum.visitCode(); sum.visitFieldInsn(GETSTATIC, "p/Stub", "2count", "I"); sum.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); sum.visitInsn(IADD);
        sum.visitInsn(IRETURN); sum.visitMaxs(2, 1); sum.visitEnd();
        var total = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "total", "()I", null, null);
        total.visitCode(); total.visitInsn(ICONST_3); total.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "p/Stub", "1sum", "(I)I", false);
        total.visitInsn(IRETURN); total.visitMaxs(1, 0); total.visitEnd();
        var init = writer.visitMethod(ACC_STATIC, "<clinit>", "()V", null, null);
        init.visitCode(); init.visitLdcInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Type.getObjectType("p/Stub"));
        init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "p/Loader", "register", "(Ljava/lang/Class;)V", false);
        init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "p/Stub", "0a2b4acb", "()V", false);
        init.visitInsn(RETURN); init.visitMaxs(1, 0); init.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    Path jar() throws IOException {
        Path jar = directory.resolve("stubs.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var entry : List.of(Map.entry("p/Loader.class", loader()), Map.entry("p/Stub.class", stub()))) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey())); zip.write(entry.getValue()); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void renamesNonIdentifierPrivateMembersAndRecompilesThem() throws Exception {
        Path out = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar(), out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(Map.of(), job.caseRenames());
        assertEquals(Map.of("p/Stub#0a2b4acb()V", "_0a2b4acb", "p/Stub#1sum(I)I", "_1sum", "p/Stub#2count:I", "_2count"), job.memberRenames());
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().toString());
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(out.resolve("classes.jar").toFile())) {
            var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/Stub.class")).readAllBytes()).accept(node, 0);
            assertEquals(List.of("<init>", "_0a2b4acb", "_1sum", "total", "<clinit>"), node.methods.stream().map(m -> m.name).toList());
            assertEquals("_2count", node.fields.getFirst().name);
        }
        assertTrue(Files.readAllLines(out.resolve("portable-names/mapping.txt")).contains("method p/Stub#0a2b4acb()V = _0a2b4acb"));
        for (String engine : List.of("cfr", "vineflower")) {
            String source = Files.readString(out.resolve(engine).resolve("sources/p/Stub.java"));
            assertTrue(source.contains("_0a2b4acb();"), source);
            assertFalse(source.contains(" 0a2b4acb"), source);
        }
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("Portable member names: 3 private member(s) renamed"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("  p/Stub#0a2b4acb()V -> _0a2b4acb\n"), report);
        assertFalse(report.contains("Portable class names"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("Result: COMPILED_WITH_SIGNATURE_COVERAGE"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("selection/selection.txt")).contains("  p/Stub#2count:I -> _2count\n"));
        String json = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"renamed_members\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"p/Stub#1sum(I)I\":\"_1sum\""), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"mapping_file\":\"portable-names/mapping.txt\""), json);
    }

    @Test void leavesNonPrivateMembersUnchangedAndReportsThem() throws Exception {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/Open", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "3open", "I", null, null).visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        Path jar = directory.resolve("open.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/Open.class")); zip.write(writer.toByteArray()); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        Path out = directory.resolve("open");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, out, List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(Map.of(), job.memberRenames());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("portable-names/mapping.txt")));
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("1 member name(s) that are no Java identifiers left unchanged"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("p/Open#3open:I (not private"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"members_left_unchanged\""));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/MultiReleaseJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** A minimal multi-release JAR built here (base Java 8 class, Java 9 variant and module descriptor); nothing runs. */
class MultiReleaseJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    List<DecompilerEngine> engines() { return List.of(new CfrEngine()); }

    Path compile(String release, String folder, Map<String,String> sources) throws Exception {
        Path root = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve(folder)); var paths = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var source : sources.entrySet()) {
            Path path = root.resolve("src").resolve(source.getKey()); Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            Files.writeString(path, source.getValue()); paths.add(path.toString());
        }
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", release, "-proc:none", "-d", root.resolve("classes").toString())); args.addAll(paths);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        return root.resolve("classes");
    }
    /** {@code entries} maps archive paths to compiled class files; the manifest declares Multi-Release. */
    Path jar(String name, Map<String,Path> entries) throws Exception {
        Path jar = directory.resolve(name);
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF"));
            zip.write("Manifest-Version: 1.0\r\nMulti-Release: true\r\n\r\n".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
            for (var entry : entries.entrySet()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey())); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(entry.getValue())); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return jar;
    }
    Path base() throws Exception {
        return compile("8", "base", Map.of("p/A.java", "package p; public class A { public int value() { return 1; } }"));
    }
    Path nine() throws Exception {
        return compile("9", "nine", Map.of("module-info.java", "module demo { exports p; }",
            "p/A.java", "package p; public class A { public int value() { return 9; } }"));
    }

    @Test void decompilesTheBaseVersionAndReportsIgnoredVariants() throws Exception {
        Path base = base(), nine = nine();
        Path input = jar("multi.jar", new TreeMap<>(Map.of("p/A.class", base.resolve("p/A.class"),
            "META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class", nine.resolve("p/A.class"),
            "META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class", nine.resolve("module-info.class"))));
        Path out = directory.resolve("out");
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(input, out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), job.selection().toString());
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(out.resolve("classes.jar").toFile())) {
            assertEquals(List.of("p/A.class"), zip.stream().map(ZipEntry::getName).toList());
        }
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("cfr/sources/p/A.java")).contains("return 1;"));
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("Input classes: 1"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("Multi-release: base version decompiled; 2 META-INF/versions variant class(es) ignored (manifest Multi-Release: true)"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class (Java 9, no base class)"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("META-INF/versions/9/p/A.class (Java 9, replaces base class)"), report);
        String json = Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("BASE_VERSION_DECOMPILED_VARIANTS_IGNORED"), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"manifest_multi_release\":true"), json);
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"has_base_class\":false"), json);
    }
    @Test void stillRejectsVersionedEntriesThatDoNotNameTheirClass() throws Exception {
        Path base = base(), nine = nine();
        for (String path : List.of("META-INF/versions/9/p/B.class", "META-INF/versions/8/p/A.class", "META-INF/versions/09/p/A.class")) {
            Path input = jar("bad-" + Math.abs(path.hashCode()) + ".jar", new TreeMap<>(Map.of("p/A.class", base.resolve("p/A.class"), path, nine.resolve("p/A.class"))));
            Path out = directory.resolve("out-" + Math.abs(path.hashCode()));
            var error = assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new DecompilationJob().run(input, out, engines(), Duration.ofSeconds(30)));
            assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("invalid multi-release variant: " + path), error.getMessage());
            assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("cfr")));
        }
    }
    @Test void renameStillRefusesMultiReleaseArchivesWithAReason() throws Exception {
        Path base = base(), nine = nine();
        Path input = jar("rename.jar", new TreeMap<>(Map.of("p/A.class", base.resolve("p/A.class"),
            "META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class", nine.resolve("module-info.class"))));
        Path out = directory.resolve("rename");
        var error = assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> new RenameJob().run(input, out, Duration.ofSeconds(20)));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("unsupported by rename (1 META-INF/versions entries)"), error.getMessage());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("worker")));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.PosixFilePermissions;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;

class NativeAnalysisTest {
    @TempDir Path temp;

    private Path fixtureJar() throws IOException {
        var resources = new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        resources.put("native/linux-x64/libfixture.so", NativeFixtures.elf());
        resources.put("native/win-x64/fixture.dll", NativeFixtures.pe(false));
        resources.put("native/readme.txt", "not native".getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));
        return NativeFixtures.jar(temp, resources);
    }

    private static NativeAnalysis.Options options(String home, Map<String,String> environment) {
        return NativeAnalysis.Options.defaults(home, environment).withLimits(1024 * 1024, 4, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
    }

    /** A stand-in for analyzeHeadless: records its arguments and copies canned.json (when present) to the export path. */
    private Path fakeGhidra(String canned) throws IOException {
        Path home = Files.createDirectories(temp.resolve("fake-ghidra"));
        Path support = Files.createDirectories(home.resolve("support"));
        Files.createDirectories(home.resolve("Ghidra"));
        Files.writeString(home.resolve("Ghidra/application.properties"), "application.version=9.9-test\n");
        if (canned != null) Files.writeString(support.resolve("canned.json"), canned);
        if (GhidraEngine.windows()) {
            // %0 launcher, %1 project, ... %11 export path; after two shifts the export path is %9.
            Files.writeString(support.resolve("analyzeHeadless.bat"), """
                @echo off\r
                set "HERE=%~dp0"\r
                echo %* >> "%HERE%args.txt"\r
                if not exist "%~1" echo missing-project >> "%HERE%args.txt"\r
                shift\r
                shift\r
                if exist "%HERE%canned.json" copy /y "%HERE%canned.json" "%~9" > nul\r
                exit /b 0\r
                """);
        } else {
            Path script = support.resolve("analyzeHeadless");
            Files.writeString(script, """
                #!/bin/sh
                here=$(dirname "$0")
                echo "$@" >> "$here/args.txt"
                [ -d "$1" ] || echo missing-project >> "$here/args.txt"
                [ -f "$here/canned.json" ] && cp "$here/canned.json" "${11}"
                exit 0
                """);
            Files.setPosixFilePermissions(script, PosixFilePermissions.fromString("rwxr-xr-x"));
        }
        return home;
    }

    @Test void withoutGhidraTheHeadersStillLinkExports() throws Exception {
        Path jar = fixtureJar();
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("native"), options(null, Map.of()));
        assertEquals("SKIPPED_NOT_CONFIGURED", result.status());
        assertTrue(result.text().startsWith("Native analysis: " + NativeAnalysis.NOT_CONFIGURED + "\n"), result.text());
        assertEquals(2, result.libraries().size());
        // The host platform's library comes first.
        if (GhidraEngine.windows()) assertEquals("native/win-x64/fixture.dll", result.libraries().getFirst().entry());
        assertTrue(result.libraries().stream().allMatch(l -> l.status().equals("HEADERS_ONLY")));
        var linked = result.links().stream().map(l -> l.method().key() + " " + l.kind() + " " + l.symbol()).sorted().toList();
        assertEquals(List.of("p/Lib#add(II)I EXPORT Java_p_Lib_add__II", "p/Lib#add(II)I EXPORT Java_p_Lib_add__II",
            "p/Lib#name()Ljava/lang/String; EXPORT Java_p_Lib_name"), linked);
        assertEquals(Map.of("p/Lib#" + NativeFixtures.HEX_NATIVE + NativeFixtures.HEX_DESCRIPTOR,
            "registered dynamically by JNI_OnLoad (no Java_* export matches)"), result.unresolved());
        assertTrue(result.text().contains("Native layer (2BZ hex-named natives): 0/1 bound statically; the others registered dynamically by JNI_OnLoad"), result.text());
        Path dll = temp.resolve("native").resolve(result.libraries().stream().filter(l -> l.entry().endsWith(".dll")).findFirst().orElseThrow().directory());
        assertArrayEquals(NativeFixtures.pe(false), Files.readAllBytes(dll.resolve("fixture.dll")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dll.resolve("functions.txt")).contains("Exports (ClassRevive header reader):\n  JNI_OnLoad\n"));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(dll.resolve("report.json")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(temp.resolve("native/summary.txt")).contains(NativeAnalysis.INTERPRETATION));
        var json = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(temp.resolve("native/report.json")));
        assertEquals("SKIPPED_NOT_CONFIGURED", json.get("status"));
        assertEquals(1L, json.get("obfuscated_native_methods"));
    }

    @Test void fakeGhidraIsRunWithTheIsolatedCommandAndItsExportIsLinked() throws Exception {
        Path jar = fixtureJar();
        Path home = fakeGhidra(GhidraExportTest.sample());
        Files.createDirectory(temp.resolve("out"));
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("out").resolve("native"), options(null, Map.of("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR", home.toString())));
        assertEquals("ANALYZED", result.status(), result.text());
        assertEquals("9.9-test", result.ghidraVersion());
        assertTrue(result.libraries().stream().allMatch(l -> l.status().equals("ANALYZED")), result.text());
        String args = Files.readString(home.resolve("support/args.txt"));
        assertFalse(args.contains("missing-project"), args);
        for (String expected : List.of("-import", "-readOnly", "-deleteProject", "-scriptPath", "-postScript", GhidraEngine.SCRIPT,
                "-analysisTimeoutPerFile", "40", "-max-cpu"))
            assertTrue(args.contains(expected), expected + " in " + args);
        assertFalse(args.contains("-noanalysis"), args);
        var table = result.links().stream().filter(l -> l.kind().equals("TABLE")).toList();
        assertEquals(2, table.size());
        assertEquals("p/Lib#" + NativeFixtures.HEX_NATIVE + NativeFixtures.HEX_DESCRIPTOR, table.getFirst().method().key());
        assertEquals("FUN_180001030", table.getFirst().symbol());
        assertTrue(result.unresolved().containsKey("p/Lib#name()Ljava/lang/String;"), result.unresolved().toString());
        assertTrue(result.text().contains("Native layer (2BZ hex-named natives): 1/1 bound statically"), result.text());
        assertTrue(result.text().contains("1 RegisterNatives site(s), 1 JNINativeMethod entry, 1 pseudo-C"), result.text());
        Path library = temp.resolve("out/native").resolve(result.libraries().getFirst().directory());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(library.resolve("pseudo-c/01-JNI_OnLoad.c")).contains("return 0x10006;"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(library.resolve("pseudo-c/02-Java_p_Lib_add__II.c")).contains("could not decompile"));
        String functions = Files.readString(library.resolve("functions.txt"));
        assertTrue(functions.contains("FUN_180001040 @ 180001043: CALL qword ptr [RAX + 0x6b8]"), functions);
        assertTrue(functions.contains("implements p.Lib#add(II)"), functions);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(library.resolve("strings.txt")).contains(NativeFixtures.HEX_NATIVE));
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(temp.resolve("out/native/ghidra-script").resolve(GhidraEngine.SCRIPT)));
        try (var left = Files.list(library)) {
            assertTrue(left.noneMatch(p -> p.getFileName().toString().endsWith("-project")), "the throwaway project folder is removed");
        }
        // attach adds the section to report.txt and native_analysis to report.json.
        Path out = temp.resolve("out");
        Files.writeString(out.resolve("report.txt"), "ClassRevive\n");
        EvidenceReport.write(out.resolve("report.json"), Map.of("kind", "decompilation"));
        NativeAnalysis.attach(out.resolve("report.txt"), out.resolve("report.json"), result);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.txt")).contains("\nNative analysis: Ghidra 9.9-test (static)\n"));
        var report = (Map<?,?>) Json.decode(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json")));
        assertEquals("decompilation", report.get("kind"));
        assertEquals("ANALYZED", ((Map<?,?>) report.get("native_analysis")).get("status"));
    }

    @Test void aGhidraRunWithoutExportIsRetriedWithoutAnalysisAndReported() throws Exception {
        var resources = Map.of("native/fixture.dll", NativeFixtures.pe(false));
        Path jar = NativeFixtures.jar(temp, resources);
        Path home = fakeGhidra(null);
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("native"), options(home.toString(), Map.of()));
        assertEquals("PARTIAL", result.status());
        var library = result.libraries().getFirst();
        assertEquals("GHIDRA_FAILED", library.status());
        assertEquals("ghidra-noanalysis", library.engine().engine());
        assertTrue(library.notes().stream().anyMatch(n -> n.contains("retried with -noanalysis")), library.notes().toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(home.resolve("support/args.txt")).contains("-noanalysis"));
        // The header triage still links the exports.
        assertTrue(result.links().stream().anyMatch(l -> l.symbol().equals("Java_p_Lib_add__II")));
    }

    @Test void limitsAndConfigurationProblems() throws Exception {
        var resources = Map.of("native/fixture.dll", NativeFixtures.pe(false), "native/libjunk.so", new byte[] {1, 2, 3, 4});
        Path jar = NativeFixtures.jar(temp, resources);
        var small = NativeAnalysis.Options.defaults(null, Map.of("GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR", temp.resolve("nowhere").toString()))
            .withLimits(1024, 1, Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("native"), small);
        assertEquals("SKIPPED_NOT_CONFIGURED", result.status());
        assertTrue(result.text().contains(NativeAnalysis.NOT_CONFIGURED + "; GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR does not point to a Ghidra installation"), result.text());
        var byEntry = new TreeMap<String,String>(); result.libraries().forEach(l -> byEntry.put(l.entry(), l.status()));
        assertEquals(Map.of("native/fixture.dll", "SKIPPED_OVERSIZED", "native/libjunk.so", "NOT_NATIVE"), byEntry);
        assertTrue(result.unresolved().values().stream().allMatch(r -> r.startsWith("no bundled native library could be read")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new NativeAnalysis().run(jar, temp.resolve("other"),
            options(temp.resolve("nowhere").toString(), Map.of())));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> NativeAnalysis.Options.defaults(null, Map.of()).withLimits(0, 1, Duration.ofSeconds(1)));
    }

    @Test void projectLocationsWithDotElementsAreRefusedByGhidra() {
        assertFalse(GhidraEngine.projectLocationAccepted(temp.resolve(".analysis").resolve("out")));
        assertTrue(GhidraEngine.projectLocationAccepted(temp.resolve("analysis").resolve("out")));
        assertEquals("a_b_c.dll", NativeAnalysis.safe("a/b c.dll", 80));
        assertEquals("library", NativeAnalysis.safe("..", 80));
        assertTrue(NativeAnalysis.nativeName("lib/libz.so.1"));
        assertFalse(NativeAnalysis.nativeName("lib/notes.solution"));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/NativeBinaryTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;

class NativeBinaryTest {
    @Test void readsPeSectionsExportsAndImports() {
        var headers = NativeBinary.parse(NativeFixtures.pe(false));
        assertEquals("PE32+", headers.format());
        assertEquals("x86-64", headers.machine());
        assertEquals(List.of(".text", ".rdata", ".data"), headers.sections().stream().map(NativeBinary.Section::name).toList());
        assertEquals("r-x", headers.sections().getFirst().permissions());
        assertEquals(List.of("JNI_OnLoad", "Java_p_Lib_add__II", "Java_p_Lib_name"), headers.exports());
        assertEquals(List.of(new NativeBinary.Import("KERNEL32.dll", "GetTickCount")), headers.imports());
        assertEquals(List.of("KERNEL32.dll"), headers.neededLibraries());
        var packing = NativeBinary.packing(headers);
        assertEquals("NOT_DETECTED", packing.verdict(), packing.hints().toString());
        assertTrue(packing.suspectedPackers().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void packedLayoutGivesHintsAndAThemidaHypothesis() {
        var headers = NativeBinary.parse(NativeFixtures.pe(true));
        var packing = NativeBinary.packing(headers);
        assertEquals("LIKELY_PACKED", packing.verdict());
        String hints = String.join("\n", packing.hints());
        assertTrue(hints.contains("3 sections without a name"), hints);
        assertTrue(hints.contains("section .boot (Themida/WinLicense name)"), hints);
        assertTrue(hints.contains("section .upx1 (UPX name)"), hints);
        assertTrue(hints.contains("executable section .upx1 has no file data (4096 bytes filled at run time)"), hints);
        assertTrue(hints.contains("executable section .boot has entropy 7.9"), hints);
        assertTrue(hints.contains("entry point in section .boot, not the first code section"), hints);
        assertEquals(List.of("Themida/WinLicense 3.x", "UPX"), packing.suspectedPackers());
        assertTrue(headers.sections().getFirst().unnamed());
    }

    @Test void readsElfDynamicSymbols() {
        var headers = NativeBinary.parse(NativeFixtures.elf());
        assertEquals("ELF64", headers.format());
        assertEquals("x86-64", headers.machine());
        assertEquals(List.of(".text", ".dynsym", ".dynstr", ".shstrtab"), headers.sections().stream().map(NativeBinary.Section::name).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("Java_p_Lib_add__II"), headers.exports());
        assertEquals(List.of(new NativeBinary.Import("", "puts")), headers.imports());
        assertEquals("NOT_DETECTED", NativeBinary.packing(headers).verdict());
    }

    @Test void malformedInputIsReportedNotThrown() {
        byte[] pe = NativeFixtures.pe(false);
        var truncated = NativeBinary.parse(Arrays.copyOf(pe, 0x150));
        assertTrue(truncated.problems().stream().anyMatch(p -> p.contains("truncated")), truncated.problems().toString());
        assertFalse(NativeBinary.parse(new byte[] {1, 2, 3}).known());
        var random = new byte[4096]; new Random(7).nextBytes(random);
        assertFalse(NativeBinary.parse(random).known());
        byte[] badOffset = pe.clone(); badOffset[0x3c] = (byte) 0xff; badOffset[0x3f] = 0x7f;
        assertFalse(NativeBinary.parse(badOffset).known());
        var elf = Arrays.copyOf(NativeFixtures.elf(), 0x210);
        assertDoesNotThrow(() -> NativeBinary.parse(elf));
    }

    @Test void entropyAndNamesAreBounded() {
        assertEquals(0, NativeBinary.entropy(new byte[100], 0, 100));
        byte[] all = new byte[256]; for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++) all[i] = (byte) i;
        assertEquals(8000, NativeBinary.entropy(all, 0, 256));
        assertEquals(-1, NativeBinary.entropy(all, 300, 10));
        assertEquals("a\\x0ab\\xe9", NativeBinary.clean("a\nbé"));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/NativeFixtures.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.ByteOrder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CC test inputs, written byte by byte: a minimal x86-64 JNI DLL (PE32+), a minimal ELF64 shared object and a jar
 * whose class declares the matching native methods. They are only parsed and given to Ghidra; nothing loads or runs them.
 */
final class NativeFixtures {
    private NativeFixtures() {}

    static final long IMAGE_BASE = 0x180000000L;
    static final String HEX_NATIVE = "0123456789abcdef0123";
    static final String HEX_DESCRIPTOR = "(Ljava/lang/String;)V";

    /**
     * Exports JNI_OnLoad, Java_p_Lib_add__II and Java_p_Lib_name and imports KERNEL32.dll!GetTickCount. JNI_OnLoad calls a
     * helper that does {@code call [rax+0x6b8]} (JNIEnv slot 215, RegisterNatives), and .data holds one JNINativeMethod
     * entry {@code {HEX_NATIVE, HEX_DESCRIPTOR, 0x1030}}. With {@code packed}, the sections lose their names and a
     * {@code .upx1} section without file data and a high-entropy {@code .boot} section holding the entry point are added.
     */
    static byte[] pe(boolean packed) {
        int sections = packed ? 5 : 3;
        int fileSize = 0x400 + 0x200 * 3 + (packed ? 0x1000 : 0);
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(fileSize).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        b.put(0, (byte) 'M').put(1, (byte) 'Z').putInt(0x3c, 0x40);
        b.put(0x40, (byte) 'P').put(0x41, (byte) 'E');
        int coff = 0x44;
        b.putShort(coff, (short) 0x8664).putShort(coff + 2, (short) sections).putShort(coff + 16, (short) 240).putShort(coff + 18, (short) 0x2022);
        int opt = coff + 20;
        b.putShort(opt, (short) 0x20b).putInt(opt + 4, 0x200).putInt(opt + 8, 0x400);
        b.putInt(opt + 16, packed ? 0x5000 : 0).putInt(opt + 20, 0x1000).putLong(opt + 24, IMAGE_BASE);
        b.putInt(opt + 32, 0x1000).putInt(opt + 36, 0x200).putShort(opt + 40, (short) 6).putShort(opt + 48, (short) 6);
        b.putInt(opt + 56, packed ? 0x6000 : 0x4000).putInt(opt + 60, 0x400).putShort(opt + 68, (short) 2).putShort(opt + 70, (short) 0x160);
        b.putLong(opt + 72, 0x100000).putLong(opt + 80, 0x1000).putLong(opt + 88, 0x100000).putLong(opt + 96, 0x1000);
        b.putInt(opt + 108, 16);
        int dirs = opt + 112;
        b.putInt(dirs, 0x2000).putInt(dirs + 4, 0x100);          // export
        b.putInt(dirs + 8, 0x2100).putInt(dirs + 12, 40);        // import
        b.putInt(dirs + 96, 0x2140).putInt(dirs + 100, 16);      // IAT
        int table = opt + 240;
        String blank = "        ";
        section(b, table, packed ? blank : ".text", 0x1000, 0x100, 0x400, 0x200, 0x60000020);
        section(b, table + 40, packed ? blank : ".rdata", 0x2000, 0x200, 0x600, 0x200, 0x40000040);
        section(b, table + 80, packed ? blank : ".data", 0x3000, 0x100, 0x800, 0x200, 0xc0000040);
        if (packed) {
            section(b, table + 120, ".upx1", 0x4000, 0x1000, 0, 0, 0xe0000060);
            section(b, table + 160, ".boot", 0x5000, 0x1000, 0xa00, 0x1000, 0x60000060);
            var random = new Random(2026);
            for (int i = 0; i < 0x1000; i++) b.put(0xa00 + i, (byte) random.nextInt(256));
        }
        // .text: JNI_OnLoad @0x1000 = call 0x1040; mov eax,0x10006; ret
        put(b, 0x400, 0xE8, 0x3B, 0, 0, 0, 0xB8, 0x06, 0x00, 0x01, 0x00, 0xC3);
        put(b, 0x410, 0x43, 0x8D, 0x04, 0x08, 0xC3);                   // Java_p_Lib_add__II: lea eax,[r8+r9]; ret
        put(b, 0x420, 0x31, 0xC0, 0xC3);                               // Java_p_Lib_name: xor eax,eax; ret
        put(b, 0x430, 0xC3);                                           // the hex-named native's implementation
        put(b, 0x440, 0x48, 0x8B, 0x01, 0xFF, 0x90, 0xB8, 0x06, 0, 0, 0xC3); // mov rax,[rcx]; call [rax+0x6b8]; ret
        // .rdata (file 0x600 = RVA 0x2000): export directory, names, strings, imports
        int r = 0x600 - 0x2000;
        b.putInt(r + 0x2000 + 12, 0x2050).putInt(r + 0x2000 + 16, 1).putInt(r + 0x2000 + 20, 3).putInt(r + 0x2000 + 24, 3);
        b.putInt(r + 0x2000 + 28, 0x2028).putInt(r + 0x2000 + 32, 0x2034).putInt(r + 0x2000 + 36, 0x2040);
        b.putInt(r + 0x2028, 0x1000).putInt(r + 0x202c, 0x1010).putInt(r + 0x2030, 0x1020);
        b.putInt(r + 0x2034, 0x2060).putInt(r + 0x2038, 0x2070).putInt(r + 0x203c, 0x2090);
        b.putShort(r + 0x2040, (short) 0).putShort(r + 0x2042, (short) 1).putShort(r + 0x2044, (short) 2);
        text(b, r + 0x2050, "fixture.dll");
        text(b, r + 0x2060, "JNI_OnLoad");
        text(b, r + 0x2070, "Java_p_Lib_add__II");
        text(b, r + 0x2090, "Java_p_Lib_name");
        text(b, r + 0x20a0, HEX_NATIVE);
        text(b, r + 0x20c0, HEX_DESCRIPTOR);
        b.putInt(r + 0x2100, 0x2130).putInt(r + 0x2100 + 12, 0x2170).putInt(r + 0x2100 + 16, 0x2140);
        b.putLong(r + 0x2130, 0x2150).putLong(r + 0x2140, 0x2150);
        text(b, r + 0x2152, "GetTickCount");
        text(b, r + 0x2170, "KERNEL32.dll");
        // .data (file 0x800 = RVA 0x3000): JNINativeMethod {name, signature, fnPtr} with absolute addresses
        b.putLong(0x800, IMAGE_BASE + 0x20a0).putLong(0x808, IMAGE_BASE + 0x20c0).putLong(0x810, IMAGE_BASE + 0x1030);
        return b.array();
    }

    /** ELF64 x86-64 shared object exporting Java_p_Lib_add__II and importing puts (section headers only, no program headers). */
    static byte[] elf() {
        var b = ByteBuffer.allocate(0x340).order(ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN);
        put(b, 0, 0x7f, 'E', 'L', 'F', 2, 1, 1);
        b.putShort(16, (short) 3).putShort(18, (short) 62).putInt(20, 1).putLong(24, 0x1000).putLong(40, 0x200);
        b.putShort(52, (short) 64).putShort(58, (short) 64).putShort(60, (short) 5).putShort(62, (short) 4);
        put(b, 0x40, 0x31, 0xC0, 0xC3);                                   // .text
        // .dynstr at 0x80: "\0Java_p_Lib_add__II\0puts\0"
        text(b, 0x81, "Java_p_Lib_add__II"); text(b, 0x94, "puts");
        // .dynsym at 0xa0: null, Java_p_Lib_add__II (GLOBAL FUNC, section 1), puts (GLOBAL FUNC, undefined)
        b.putInt(0xb8, 1).put(0xbc, (byte) 0x12).putShort(0xbe, (short) 1).putLong(0xc0, 0x1000);
        b.putInt(0xd0, 0x14).put(0xd4, (byte) 0x12).putShort(0xd6, (short) 0);
        // .shstrtab at 0x100: "\0.text\0.dynsym\0.dynstr\0.shstrtab\0"
        text(b, 0x101, ".text"); text(b, 0x107, ".dynsym"); text(b, 0x10f, ".dynstr"); text(b, 0x117, ".shstrtab");
        elfSection(b, 0x200 + 64, 1, 1, 6, 0x1000, 0x40, 3, 0, 0);
        elfSection(b, 0x200 + 128, 7, 11, 2, 0, 0xa0, 72, 3, 24);
        elfSection(b, 0x200 + 192, 15, 3, 2, 0, 0x80, 0x19, 0, 0);
        elfSection(b, 0x200 + 256, 23, 3, 0, 0, 0x100, 0x21, 0, 0);
        return b.array();
    }

    /** Class {@code p/Lib} with natives add(II)I, name()String and the hex-named one, plus the given resources. */
    static Path jar(Path directory, Map<String,byte[]> resources) throws IOException {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "p/Lib", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC | ACC_NATIVE, "add", "(II)I", null, null).visitEnd();
        writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC | ACC_NATIVE, "name", "()Ljava/lang/String;", null, null).visitEnd();
        writer.visitMethod(ACC_STATIC | ACC_NATIVE, HEX_NATIVE, HEX_DESCRIPTOR, null, null).visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        Path jar = directory.resolve("natives.jar");
        try (var out = new JarOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            out.putNextEntry(new JarEntry("p/Lib.class")); out.write(writer.toByteArray()); out.closeEntry();
            for (var resource : resources.entrySet()) { out.putNextEntry(new JarEntry(resource.getKey())); out.write(resource.getValue()); out.closeEntry(); }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    private static void section(ByteBuffer b, int at, String name, int rva, int virtualSize, int pointer, int rawSize, long flags) {
        byte[] bytes = name.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length && i < 8; i++) b.put(at + i, bytes[i]);
        b.putInt(at + 8, virtualSize).putInt(at + 12, rva).putInt(at + 16, rawSize).putInt(at + 20, pointer).putInt(at + 36, (int) flags);
    }
    private static void elfSection(ByteBuffer b, int at, int name, int type, long flags, long address, long offset, long size, int link, long entrySize) {
        b.putInt(at, name).putInt(at + 4, type).putLong(at + 8, flags).putLong(at + 16, address).putLong(at + 24, offset)
            .putLong(at + 32, size).putInt(at + 40, link).putLong(at + 56, entrySize);
    }
    private static void put(ByteBuffer b, int at, int... values) { for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) b.put(at + i, (byte) values[i]); }
    private static void text(ByteBuffer b, int at, String value) {
        byte[] bytes = value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII);
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) b.put(at + i, bytes[i]);
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/NestingJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.jadx.JadxEngine;
import dev.classrevive.procyon.ProcyonEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * Phase 2BX: an obfuscated jar's shape. An obfuscator stripped {@code InnerClasses} (and here also {@code EnclosingMethod},
 * {@code NestHost}, {@code NestMembers}), so engines disagree on {@code p/Outer$Helper}: JADX nests it inside
 * {@code Outer.java} by name, the others write {@code Outer$Helper.java}. The enum {@code p/Outer$Level} has a constant
 * body {@code Outer$Level$1}, which the top-level form writes as a class extending a final enum. Nothing runs.
 */
class NestingJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    static final String SOURCE = """
        package p;
        public class Outer {
            int value = 3;
            public int twice() { return new Helper().scale(value) + Level.HIGH.weight(); }
            static class Helper { int scale(int x) { return x * 2; } }
            public enum Level {
                LOW(1), HIGH(2) { @Override public int weight() { return code * 10; } };
                final int code;
                Level(int code) { this.code = code; }
                public int weight() { return code; }
            }
        }
        """;

    /** javac output with every nesting attribute removed by ASM, as an obfuscator left the classes of a real jar. */
    Path jar() throws IOException {
        Path src = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src/p")), out = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("classes"));
        Files.writeString(src.resolve("Outer.java"), SOURCE);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", out.toString(), src.resolve("Outer.java").toString()));
        Path jar = directory.resolve("stripped.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var classes = Files.list(out.resolve("p"))) {
            for (var file : classes.sorted().toList()) {
                var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
                new ClassReader(Files.readAllBytes(file)).accept(new ClassVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9, writer) {
                    @Override public void visitInnerClass(String name, String outer, String inner, int access) {}
                    @Override public void visitOuterClass(String owner, String name, String descriptor) {}
                    @Override public void visitNestHost(String host) {}
                    @Override public void visitNestMember(String member) {}
                }, 0);
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/" + file.getFileName())); zip.write(writer.toByteArray()); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            var reader = new ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/Outer.class")).readAllBytes());
            var inner = new ArrayList<String>();
            reader.accept(new ClassVisitor(Opcodes.ASM9) {
                @Override public void visitInnerClass(String name, String outer, String innerName, int access) { inner.add(name); }
            }, 0);
            assertEquals(List.of(), inner, "the fixture has no InnerClasses attribute");
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void theSelectedSourcesDeclareEachBinaryClassOnceAndFoldTheEnumConstantBody() throws Exception {
        Path out = directory.resolve("out");
        List<DecompilerEngine> engines = List.of(new CfrEngine(), new JadxEngine(), new ProcyonEngine(), new VineflowerEngine());
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar(), out, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(90));
        String report = Files.readString(out.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        // The engines really disagree: JADX nests Helper by name, CFR writes it as its own file.
        assertTrue(Files.exists(out.resolve("cfr/sources/p/Outer$Helper.java")), report);
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("jadx/sources/p/Outer$Helper.java")), report);
        assertTrue(Files.exists(out.resolve("cfr/sources/p/Outer$Level$1.java")), report);
        assertTrue(job.selection().verification().complete(), report);
        for (var attempt : job.selection().tried()) {
            var origins = attempt.origins();
            // No attempt combines JADX's nesting Outer.java with another engine's top-level $ file.
            if ("jadx".equals(origins.get("p/Outer.java")))
                assertTrue(origins.keySet().stream().noneMatch(file -> file.startsWith("p/Outer$")), attempt.id() + " " + origins);
            for (var line : attempt.verification().toString().split("\n")) assertFalse(line.contains("same.binary.name"), line);
        }
        // Vineflower writes Outer$Level$1 as its own file; folded into HIGH's body, its whole tree compiles with every signature.
        assertEquals("vineflower", job.selection().candidate(), report);
        assertEquals(List.of(new dev.classrevive.verification.EnumBodyFolding.Fold("p/Outer$Level.java", "p/Outer$Level$1.java", "HIGH")),
            job.selection().folds(), report);
        assertTrue(Files.exists(out.resolve("vineflower/sources/p/Outer$Level$1.java")), "engine output is kept as written");
        assertFalse(Files.exists(out.resolve("selection/sources/p/Outer$Level$1.java")), report);
        String level = Files.readString(out.resolve("selection/sources/p/Outer$Level.java"));
        assertTrue(level.matches("(?s).*HIGH\\(2\\) \\{.*return this\\.code \\* 10;.*"), level);
        assertTrue(report.contains("p/Outer$Level$1.java <- vineflower (folded into p/Outer$Level.java)"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(out.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"enum_bodies_folded\""), "report.json lists the folds");
    }
}
```
