`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/ProjectExportTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProjectExportTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    @Test void exportsAProjectWithSourcesResourcesAndABuildFileThatCompiles() throws Exception {
        var source = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src/p"));
        Files.writeString(source.resolve("Config.java"), "package p; public class Config { public String file() { return \"app.properties\"; } }");
        var classes = dir.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", classes.toString(), source.resolve("Config.java").toString()));
        var jar = dir.resolve("app.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            entry(zip, "META-INF/MANIFEST.MF", "Manifest-Version: 1.0\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            entry(zip, "META-INF/APP.SF", "signature".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            entry(zip, "p/Config.class", Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve("p/Config.class")));
            entry(zip, "app.properties", "name=demo\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            entry(zip, "META-INF/services/p.Plugin", "p.Config\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
        var output = dir.resolve("out");
        new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, output, List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        Path project = output.resolve("project");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(project.resolve("src/main/java/p/Config.java")).contains("app.properties"));
        assertEquals("name=demo\n", Files.readString(project.resolve("src/main/resources/app.properties")));
        assertEquals("p.Config\n", Files.readString(project.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/services/p.Plugin")));
        // The manifest and signature files describe the original JAR, not this project.
        assertFalse(Files.exists(project.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(project.resolve("src/main/resources/META-INF/APP.SF")));
        String build = Files.readString(project.resolve("build.gradle"));
        assertTrue(build.contains("id 'java'") && build.contains("options.release = 8"), build);
        assertEquals("rootProject.name = 'app-decompiled'\n", Files.readString(project.resolve("settings.gradle")));
        String readme = Files.readString(project.resolve("README.md"));
        assertTrue(readme.contains("not the original source") && readme.contains("COMPILED"), readme);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("report.txt")).contains("IDE project: project/ (1 sources, 2 resources, 0 libraries, release 8)"));
        // The exported sources compile on their own, as the build file says.
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", dir.resolve("rebuilt").toString(), project.resolve("src/main/java/p/Config.java").toString()));
    }

    @Test void refusesResourceNamesThatCouldLeaveTheProjectAndCopiesLibraries() throws Exception {
        var jar = dir.resolve("evil.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            entry(zip, "../escape.txt", new byte[]{1});
            entry(zip, "a/../../escape2.txt", new byte[]{2});
            entry(zip, "C:/abs.txt", new byte[]{3});
            entry(zip, "ok/data.bin", new byte[]{4});
        }
        var library = Files.write(dir.resolve("lib-1.0.jar"), new byte[]{5});
        var output = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("out"));
        var verification = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, 2, 0, 3, 0, "test");
        var result = ProjectExport.write(output, output.resolve("missing-sources"), jar, List.of(library), List.of(), verification, "evil.jar");
        assertEquals(1, result.resources()); assertEquals(3, result.skippedResources()); assertEquals(1, result.libraries());
        assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{4}, Files.readAllBytes(output.resolve("project/src/main/resources/ok/data.bin")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve("escape.txt")) || Files.exists(output.resolve("escape.txt")) || Files.exists(output.resolve("project/escape2.txt")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("project/build.gradle")).contains("implementation files('lib/lib-1.0.jar')"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("project/README.md")).contains("2 javac error(s)"));
        assertFalse(ProjectExport.safe("a//b") || ProjectExport.safe("/a") || ProjectExport.safe("a\\b") || ProjectExport.safe("./a"));
    }

    private static void entry(ZipOutputStream zip, String name, byte[] bytes) throws Exception {
        zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name)); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry();
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/RealMultiReleaseLibraryTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * Gson 2.13.1 (Apache-2.0) is a real multi-release JAR ({@code META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class}) whose sources
 * need error_prone_annotations at compile time. Gradle resolves both from its cache with hash verification
 * (pipeline/build.gradle.kts); they are copied here and decompiled, never committed, loaded or executed.
 */
class RealMultiReleaseLibraryTest {
    static final String GSON_SHA256 = "94855942d4992f112946d3de1c334e709237b8126d8130bf07807c018a4a2120";
    static final String ANNOTATIONS_SHA256 = "6661d5335090a5fc61dd869d2095bc6c1e2156e3aa47a6e4ababdf64c99a7889";
    @TempDir Path directory;

    Path copy(String property, String sha256) throws Exception {
        String location = System.getProperty("classrevive.fixture." + property);
        assertNotNull(location, "Gradle passes the resolved fixture path");
        Path copy = directory.resolve(Path.of(location).getFileName().toString());
        Files.copy(Path.of(location), copy);
        assertEquals(sha256, HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(Files.readAllBytes(copy))));
        return copy;
    }

    @Test void decompilesTheBaseVersionAndCompilesOnlyWithTheExplicitAnnotationDependency() throws Exception {
        Path gson = copy("gson", GSON_SHA256), annotations = copy("error_prone_annotations", ANNOTATIONS_SHA256);
        List<DecompilerEngine> engines = List.of(new VineflowerEngine());

        Path bare = directory.resolve("bare");
        // Stubs off (Phase 2CT): this checks what javac reports when the annotation JAR is really absent.
        var withoutDependency = new DecompilationJob().withStubs(false).runVerified(gson, bare, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(120));
        String report = Files.readString(bare.resolve("report.txt"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("Multi-release: base version decompiled; 1 META-INF/versions variant class(es) ignored (manifest Multi-Release: true)"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class (Java 9, no base class)"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(bare.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"multi_release\""));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(bare.resolve("classes.jar").toFile())) {
            assertTrue(zip.stream().noneMatch(entry -> entry.getName().startsWith("META-INF/")));
        }
        var bareVerification = withoutDependency.selection().verification();
        assertEquals(0, bareVerification.syntaxErrors(), "Vineflower output parses; the failure is attribution");
        assertTrue(Files.readString(bare.resolve("selection/checks/attempt-0/engine.log"))
            .contains("package com.google.errorprone.annotations does not exist"));

        // Without source repair (as in a single-engine benchmark baseline) the remaining errors are decompiler output:
        // generic casts and a final local assigned twice. Classes compile only partially.
        Path resolved = directory.resolve("resolved");
        var withDependency = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(gson, resolved, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(120), List.of(annotations), false);
        var verification = withDependency.selection().verification();
        assertEquals("vineflower", withDependency.selection().candidate());
        assertEquals(0, verification.syntaxErrors());
        assertFalse(Files.readString(resolved.resolve("selection/checks/attempt-0/engine.log")).contains("com.google.errorprone"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(resolved.resolve("selection/checks/attempt-0-dependencies/dependencies.txt"))
            .contains("multi-release-variants-ignored=1"));
        assertTrue(verification.matchedSymbols() > bareVerification.matchedSymbols(),
            verification.matchedSymbols() + " vs " + bareVerification.matchedSymbols());
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, verification.status());
        assertTrue(verification.errors() > 0);
        assertEquals(List.of(), withDependency.selection().repairs());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(resolved.resolve("report.json")).contains("\"source_repairs\":{\"count\":0,"));

        // Phase 2AS: the compiler-guided repair pass edits only the reported positions and recompiles.
        Path repaired = directory.resolve("repaired");
        var withRepair = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(gson, repaired, engines, Duration.ofSeconds(120), List.of(annotations));
        var repairedVerification = withRepair.selection().verification();
        String selection = Files.readString(repaired.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        assertTrue(withRepair.selection().candidate().startsWith("repair-"), selection);
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, repairedVerification.status(), selection);
        assertEquals(0, repairedVerification.errors());
        assertEquals(repairedVerification.expectedSymbols(), repairedVerification.matchedSymbols(), selection);
        assertTrue(repairedVerification.roundTripMeasured());
        var rules = new TreeSet<String>(); var files = new TreeSet<String>();
        withRepair.selection().repairs().forEach(edit -> { rules.add(edit.rule()); files.add(edit.file()); });
        assertEquals(Set.of("raw-cast-to-target", "raw-argument", "raw-diamond", "raw-type-argument", "drop-final-local", "capture-copy",
            "renamed-local"), rules, selection);
        assertTrue(files.contains("com/google/gson/internal/bind/ReflectiveTypeAdapterFactory.java"), files.toString());
        // Every repaired file came from a file javac reported, and each edit names its diagnostic.
        assertTrue(verification.fileErrors().keySet().containsAll(files), files + " vs " + verification.fileErrors().keySet());
        assertTrue(withRepair.selection().repairs().stream().allMatch(edit -> edit.code().startsWith("compiler.err.") && edit.line() > 0));
        files.forEach(file -> assertTrue(withRepair.selection().provenance().get(file).endsWith("+repair"), file));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(repaired.resolve("report.txt")).contains("Source repairs: " + withRepair.selection().repairs().size()));
        String json = Files.readString(repaired.resolve("report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"evidence\":\"COMPILER_DIAGNOSTIC_GUIDED_EDITS_BEHAVIOR_NOT_VERIFIED\""), json.substring(0, 200));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"rule\":\"capture-copy\""));
        // Gson's own sources contain text that the placeholder heuristic counts, so "complete" stays false on that alone.
        assertTrue(repairedVerification.placeholderSignals() > 0 || repairedVerification.complete());
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.jadx.JadxEngine;
import dev.classrevive.procyon.ProcyonEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/**
 * The committed failure-lab regression cases (benchmarks/regressions, Phase 2AT): every method of every case must stay
 * at or above the level recorded in its expected.json. Run alone with {@code ./gradlew checkRegressions}.
 */
class RegressionCasesTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    @Test void committedCasesKeepTheirMinimumLevels() throws Exception {
        String location = System.getProperty("classrevive.regressions");
        assertNotNull(location, "the Gradle build passes benchmarks/regressions");
        List<DecompilerEngine> engines = List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine(), new ProcyonEngine(), new JadxEngine());
        var report = new RegressionSuite().check(Path.of(location), dir.resolve("check"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        String details = Files.readString(dir.resolve("check/regressions.md"));
        assertTrue(report.cases() >= 1, details);
        assertEquals(List.of(), report.errors(), details);
        assertEquals(List.of(), report.regressions(), details);
        assertTrue(report.passed(), details);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import java.io.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class RenameJobTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    byte[] type(String name,String fieldType) {
        var writer=new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(52,1,name,null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        writer.visitField(1,"other","L"+fieldType+";",null,null).visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    private static List<String> fieldDescriptors(byte[] bytes) {
        var result=new ArrayList<String>();
        new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(bytes).accept(new org.objectweb.asm.ClassVisitor(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ASM9) {
            @Override public org.objectweb.asm.FieldVisitor visitField(int access,String name,String descriptor,String signature,Object value) {
                result.add(descriptor); return null;
            }
        },0);
        return result;
    }
    private static List<Object> constants(byte[] bytes) {
        var result=new ArrayList<Object>();
        new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(bytes).accept(new org.objectweb.asm.ClassVisitor(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ASM9) {
            @Override public org.objectweb.asm.MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access,String name,String descriptor,String signature,String[] exceptions) {
                return new org.objectweb.asm.MethodVisitor(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ASM9) {
                    @Override public void visitLdcInsn(Object value) { result.add(value); }
                };
            }
        },0);
        return result;
    }
    byte[] caller() {
        var writer=new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(52,1,"p/caller",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        var method=writer.visitMethod(9,"lookup","()Ljava/lang/Class;",null,null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn("p.ab");
        method.visitMethodInsn(184,"java/lang/Class","forName","(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;",false);
        method.visitInsn(176); method.visitMaxs(1,0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    byte[] memberType(String name) {
        var writer=new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(52,1,name,null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        writer.visitField(2,"x","I",null,null).visitEnd();
        var getter=writer.visitMethod(2,"a","()I",null,null);
        getter.visitCode(); getter.visitVarInsn(25,0); getter.visitFieldInsn(180,name,"x","I"); getter.visitInsn(172); getter.visitMaxs(1,1);
        getter.visitEnd();
        var caller=writer.visitMethod(1,"run","()I",null,null);
        caller.visitCode(); caller.visitVarInsn(25,0); caller.visitMethodInsn(183,name,"a","()I",false); caller.visitInsn(172); caller.visitMaxs(1,1);
        caller.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    private static Set<String> memberNames(byte[] bytes,boolean fields) {
        var result=new TreeSet<String>();
        new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(bytes).accept(new org.objectweb.asm.ClassVisitor(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ASM9) {
            @Override public org.objectweb.asm.FieldVisitor visitField(int access,String name,String descriptor,String signature,Object value) {
                if(fields) result.add(name); return null;
            }
            @Override public org.objectweb.asm.MethodVisitor visitMethod(int access,String name,String descriptor,String signature,String[] exceptions) {
                if(!fields) result.add(name); return null;
            }
        },0);
        return result;
    }
    Path fixture(boolean signed) throws Exception {
        Path input=directory.resolve("input.jar");
        var manifest=new Manifest(); manifest.getMainAttributes().put(Attributes.Name.MANIFEST_VERSION,"1.0");
        manifest.getMainAttributes().put(Attributes.Name.MAIN_CLASS,"p.ab");
        var header=new ByteArrayOutputStream(); manifest.write(header);
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/ab.class")); zip.write(type("p/ab","p/cd")); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/cd.class")); zip.write(type("p/cd","p/ab")); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/caller.class")); zip.write(caller()); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("asset.txt")); zip.write(new byte[]{0,1,2,3}); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")); zip.write(header.toByteArray()); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/services/p.ab")); zip.write("p.cd\n".getBytes(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); zip.closeEntry();
            if(signed) { zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/TEST.SF")); zip.write(new byte[]{1}); zip.closeEntry(); }
        }
        return input;
    }
    @Test void renamesJarClassesAndPreservesResourcesAndOriginal() throws Exception {
        Path input=fixture(false); byte[] before=Files.readAllBytes(input); Path output=directory.resolve("result");
        var result=new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20));
        assertTrue(result.successful(),result.toString()); assertEquals(3,result.classes()); assertEquals(2,result.renamed()); assertEquals(1,result.reflectionRewrites());
        assertArrayEquals(before,Files.readAllBytes(input));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("input.jar")));
        try(var zip=new ZipFile(output.resolve("renamed.jar").toFile())) {
            assertArrayEquals(new byte[]{0,1,2,3},zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("asset.txt")).readAllBytes());
            var manifest=new Manifest(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")));
            assertEquals("p.Class00001",manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue("Main-Class"));
            assertEquals("p.Class00002\n",new String(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("META-INF/services/p.Class00001")).readAllBytes(),java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            assertNull(zip.getEntry("META-INF/services/p.ab"));
            var first=zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/Class00001.class")).readAllBytes();
            assertEquals(List.of("Lp/Class00002;"),fieldDescriptors(first));
            assertNotNull(zip.getEntry("p/Class00002.class"));
            assertEquals(List.of("p.Class00001"),constants(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/caller.class")).readAllBytes()));
        }
        String report=Files.readString(output.resolve("rename.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("NOT_VERIFIED")); assertTrue(report.contains("\"renamed\":2"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"reflection_rewrites\":1"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"p/ab\":\"p/Class00001\""));
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20)));
    }
    @Test void keepsUnchangedManifestBytesIdentical() throws Exception {

    @Test void appliesExplicitMappingAndDisablesPlanner() throws Exception {
        Path input=directory.resolve("explicit.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/ab.class")); zip.write(memberType("p/ab")); zip.closeEntry();

        }
        Path mapping=directory.resolve("mapping.txt");
        String rules="# explicit rules\nclass p.ab=p/Class00009\nmethod p/ab#a()I=value\nfield p/ab#x:I=count\n";
        Files.writeString(mapping,rules,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Path output=directory.resolve("explicit-out");

            assertEquals(new TreeSet<>(List.of("count")),memberNames(bytes,true));
        }
        String report=Files.readString(output.resolve("rename.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"mapping\":\"explicit\""));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"member_rules\":2"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"members_renamed\":2"));

    @Test void restoresSafeProguardNamesAndReportsSkippedRules() throws Exception {
        // Authored as if already obfuscated; the mapping says what the names were before obfuscation.
        Path sources=Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("pg-src/p"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("a.java"),"package p; public class a implements java.io.Serializable {"
            +" private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L; private int b; public int c() { return d(this) + b; }"
            +" private static int d(a self) { return self.b + 1; } }");
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("b.java"),"package p; public class b { public int e(a target) { return target.c(); } }");
        Path classes=directory.resolve("pg-classes");
        assertEquals(0,javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-Xlint:-options","-proc:none",
            "-d",classes.toString(),sources.resolve("a.java").toString(),sources.resolve("b.java").toString()));
        Path input=directory.resolve("proguarded.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            for(String name:List.of("p/a.class","p/b.class")) { zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(name))); zip.closeEntry(); }
        }
        Path mapping=directory.resolve("proguard-mapping.txt");
        Files.writeString(mapping,"""
            # compiler: R8
            p.Account -> p.a:
                long serialVersionUID -> serialVersionUID
                int balance -> b
                1:1:int total():1:1 -> c
                1:1:int next(p.Account):1:1 -> d
            p.Ledger -> p.b:
                int read(p.Account) -> e
            p.Moved -> q.z:
            """,java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Path output=directory.resolve("proguard-out");
        var result=new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20),mapping,true);
        assertTrue(result.successful(),result.toString());
        assertEquals(2,result.renamed()); assertEquals(2,result.members());
        try(var zip=new ZipFile(output.resolve("renamed.jar").toFile())) {
            var account=zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/Account.class")).readAllBytes();
            var ledger=zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("p/Ledger.class")).readAllBytes();
            assertEquals(new TreeSet<>(List.of("serialVersionUID","balance")),memberNames(account,true));
            assertTrue(memberNames(account,false).containsAll(List.of("c","next")));
            assertTrue(memberNames(ledger,false).contains("e"));
            var loader=new ClassLoader(null) {
                final Map<String,byte[]> bytes=Map.of("p.Account",account,"p.Ledger",ledger);
                @Override protected Class<?> findClass(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException {
                    byte[] value=bytes.get(name); if(value==null) throw new ClassNotFoundException(name);
                    return defineClass(name,value,0,value.length);
                }
            };
            // Linking runs the JVM verifier on the renamed classes; no initializer or method is invoked.
            assertDoesNotThrow(()->Class.forName("p.Account",false,loader).getDeclaredMethods());
            assertDoesNotThrow(()->Class.forName("p.Ledger",false,loader).getDeclaredMethods());
        }
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("proguard-mapping.txt")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("mapping.txt")).contains("method p/a#d(Lp/a;)I = next"));
        String report=Files.readString(output.resolve("rename.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"mapping\":\"proguard\""));
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"NOT_PRIVATE\":2"),report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("\"CLASS_NOT_IN_INPUT\":1"),report);
    }
    @Test void proguardMappingWithNothingApplicableFailsWithEvidence() throws Exception {
        Path input=directory.resolve("pg-none.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/ab.class")); zip.write(memberType("p/ab")); zip.closeEntry();

    }
    @Test void workerFailureOnUnknownMemberRetainsEvidence() throws Exception {
        Path input=directory.resolve("bad-member.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/ab.class")); zip.write(memberType("p/ab")); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        Path mapping=directory.resolve("bad-member.txt"); Files.writeString(mapping,"method p/ab#missing()V=x\n");
        Path output=directory.resolve("bad-member-out");
        var result=new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20),mapping);
        assertFalse(result.successful());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve("renamed.jar")));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("rename.json")).contains("WORKER_FAILED"));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("mapping.txt")));
        assertTrue(Files.exists(output.resolve("worker/engine.log")));
    }
    @Test void rejectsMissingOrMalformedMappingBeforeOutputCreation() throws Exception {
        Path input=fixture(false); Path output=directory.resolve("mapping-bad");
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20),directory.resolve("absent.txt")));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output));
        Path bad=directory.resolve("bad.txt"); Files.writeString(bad,"garbage without equals\n");
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new RenameJob().run(input,output,Duration.ofSeconds(20),bad));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output));
    }
}
```

`modules/pipeline/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/pipeline/StubJobTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.pipeline;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class StubJobTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    /** An application JAR whose library (lib/*) is missing, as with a mod decompiled without its game. */
    private Path applicationOnly() throws Exception {
        var library = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src/lib"));
        Files.writeString(library.resolve("Base.java"), "package lib; public abstract class Base { protected Base(String name) {} public int size() { return 0; } public abstract void tick(); }");
        Files.writeString(library.resolve("Registry.java"), "package lib; public class Registry { public static Registry get() { return null; } public void add(String key, int value) {} }");
        var app = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src/app"));
        Files.writeString(app.resolve("Mod.java"), "package app; import lib.*; public class Mod extends Base { public Mod() { super(\"mod\"); }"
            + " @Override public void tick() { Registry.get().add(\"ticks\", size()); } public int twice() { return size() * 2; } }");
        var classes = dir.resolve("classes");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-g", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d",
            classes.toString(), library.resolve("Base.java").toString(), library.resolve("Registry.java").toString(), app.resolve("Mod.java").toString()));
        var jar = dir.resolve("mod.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("app/Mod.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve("app/Mod.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void compilesAgainstInferredStubsAndSaysSo() throws Exception {
        var jar = applicationOnly();
        var engines = List.<dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine>of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine());
        var without = new DecompilationJob().withStubs(false).runVerified(jar, dir.resolve("without"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, without.selection().verification().status());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve("without/stubs")));
        var with = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, dir.resolve("with"), engines, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, with.selection().verification().status(), with.selection().verification().detail());
        assertTrue(with.selection().verification().complete());
        // Phase 2DF: still complete, but marked as compiled against stubs, and the bytecode fallback is kept.
        assertTrue(with.selection().stubBacked());
        assertNotNull(with.fallback());
        assertFalse(without.selection().stubBacked());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.json")).contains("\"stub_backed\":true"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.txt")).contains("Result: COMPILED_WITH_SIGNATURE_COVERAGE\nStub-backed: yes"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.html")).contains("Stub-backed: compiled against 2 inferred stub classes"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.html")).contains("the bytecode fallback is kept"));
        assertEquals(List.of("lib/Base", "lib/Registry"), Files.readAllLines(dir.resolve("with/stubs/stubs.txt")));
        String json = Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.json"));
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"missing_type_stubs\":{\"classes\":2,"), json);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/report.txt")).contains("Inferred stubs: 2 missing class(es) in 1 package(s)"));
        // The exported project carries the stubs as a labeled library, so it builds too.
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(dir.resolve("with/project/lib/" + DecompilationJob.STUB_JAR)));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(dir.resolve("with/project/README.md")).contains("inferred stand-ins"));
    }

    @Test void stubsAreStillInferredWithSixteenDependencyJars() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2DF: 16 unrelated dependency JARs used to skip stub synthesis silently.
        var jar = applicationOnly();
        var dependencies = new ArrayList<Path>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
            writer.visit(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_8, org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "unrelated/D" + i, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
            writer.visitEnd();
            var dependency = dir.resolve("dep" + i + ".jar");
            try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(dependency))) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("unrelated/D" + i + ".class")); zip.write(writer.toByteArray()); zip.closeEntry();
            }
            dependencies.add(dependency);
        }
        var job = new DecompilationJob().runVerified(jar, dir.resolve("deps"), List.of(new CfrEngine()), Duration.ofSeconds(60), dependencies);
        assertEquals(List.of("lib/Base", "lib/Registry"), Files.readAllLines(dir.resolve("deps/stubs/stubs.txt")));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, job.selection().verification().status(), job.selection().verification().detail());
        assertTrue(job.selection().stubBacked());
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test void evaluatesLiteralStringInWorkerWithoutLoggingItsContents() throws Exception {
        var writer=new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(52,1,"LiteralString",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        var method=writer.visitMethod(9,"value","()I",null,null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn("private-literal");
        method.visitMethodInsn(182,"java/lang/String","length","()I",false);
        method.visitInsn(172); method.visitMaxs(1,0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        Path input=directory.resolve("LiteralString.class"); Files.write(input,writer.toByteArray());
        Path output=directory.resolve("string-result");
        var result=new TransformJob().run(input,output,100,Duration.ofSeconds(20),"string-length");
        assertTrue(result.successful()); assertEquals(1,result.changes());
        String report=Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(report.contains("string-length-v1")); assertTrue(report.contains("\"result\":15"));
        assertFalse(report.contains("private-literal"));
    }
    /** Phase 2DI: an output under a linked parent folder (macOS's /var) is written to the real folder; a linked output is refused. */
    @Test void writesBelowALinkedParentButNotIntoALinkedOutput() throws Exception {
        var writer=new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(52,1,"Plain",null,"java/lang/Object",null); writer.visitEnd();
        Path input=directory.resolve("Plain.class"); Files.write(input,writer.toByteArray());
        Path real=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("real"));
        Path alias;
        try { alias=Files.createSymbolicLink(directory.resolve("alias"),real); }
        catch(IOException|UnsupportedOperationException unavailable) { org.junit.jupiter.api.Assumptions.abort("Symbolic links unavailable: "+unavailable); return; }
        var result=new TransformJob().run(input,alias.resolve("result"),100,Duration.ofSeconds(20),"string-length");
        assertTrue(result.successful());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(real.resolve("result/transform.json"),LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS));
        Path target=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("target"));
        Path linkedOutput=Files.createSymbolicLink(directory.resolve("linked-output"),target);
        assertThrows(IOException.class,() -> new TransformJob().run(input,linkedOutput,100,Duration.ofSeconds(20),"string-length"));
        try(var entries=Files.list(target)) { assertEquals(0,entries.count()); }
    }
    @Test void foldsAZkmFlagProvedOverTheWholeJarInTheWorker() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2CM: the worker reads every class before it transforms any, so a flag held in H is folded in U.
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("H.java"), "public class H { private static String[] k; static { Q(new String[3]); }"
            + " public static String[] t() { return k; } public static void Q(String[] a) { k = a; } }");
        Files.writeString(directory.resolve("U.java"), "public class U { public static int m() { String[] f = H.t(); if (f == null) return 2; return 1; } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", directory.toString(), directory.resolve("H.java").toString(), directory.resolve("U.java").toString()));
        Path input = directory.resolve("flags.jar");
        try (var jar = new JarOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(input))) {
            for (String name : new String[] {"H.class", "U.class"}) {
                jar.putNextEntry(new JarEntry(name)); jar.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(name))); jar.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var result = new TransformJob().run(input, directory.resolve("folded"), 100, Duration.ofSeconds(20), "zkm-flags");
        assertTrue(result.successful());
        assertEquals(1, result.changes());
        assertEquals(java.util.Set.of("U.m()I"), result.methods());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(directory.resolve("folded/transform.json")).contains("zkm-flags-v1"));
    }
    @Test void decryptsSupportedStringLiteralInWorkerWithoutLoggingItOrChangingInput() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("DecodeFixture.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class DecodeFixture {"
            + "private static String decode(String s) { char[] c=s.toCharArray();"
            + "for(int i=0;i<c.length;i++) c[i]=(char)(c[i]^7); return new String(c); }"
            + "public static String value() { return decode(\"Obkkh\"); } }");

            "-proc:none", "-d", directory.toString(), source.toString()));

        assertArrayEquals(original, Files.readAllBytes(input));
        String evidence = Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(evidence.contains("string-decryptor-v1"));
        assertFalse(evidence.contains("Obkkh")); assertFalse(evidence.contains("Hello"));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar").toFile())) {
            var type = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode();
            new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("DecodeFixture.class")).readAllBytes()).accept(type, 0);
            var value = type.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals("value")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
            assertTrue(java.util.Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.LdcInsnNode literal && "Hello".equals(literal.cst)));
            assertFalse(java.util.Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.MethodInsnNode call && call.name.equals("decode")));
        }
    }

    @Test void decryptsIntegerBitReversalsInWorkerWithoutLoggingDecodedText() throws Exception {
        Path source = directory.resolve("IntegerBitReverseFixture.java");
        Files.writeString(source, "public class IntegerBitReverseFixture {"
            + "private static String decodeBits(String s) { char[] c=s.toCharArray();"
            + "for(int i=0;i<c.length;i++) c[i]=(char)Integer.reverse(s.charAt(i)<<16); return new String(c); }"
            + "private static String decodeBytes(String s) { char[] c=s.toCharArray();"
            + "for(int i=0;i<c.length;i++) c[i]=(char)Integer.reverseBytes(s.charAt(i)<<16); return new String(c); }"
            + "public static String bits() { return decodeBits(\"Masking\"); }"
            + "public static String bytes() { return decodeBytes(\"Masking\"); } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options",
            "-proc:none", "-d", directory.toString(), source.toString()));
        Path input = directory.resolve("IntegerBitReverseFixture.class"), output = directory.resolve("integer-bit-reversal");
        byte[] original = Files.readAllBytes(input);
        var result = new TransformJob().run(input, output, 100, Duration.ofSeconds(20), "string-decryptor");
        assertTrue(result.successful(), result.toString()); assertEquals(2, result.changes());
        assertArrayEquals(original, Files.readAllBytes(input));
        String evidence = Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(evidence.contains("string-decryptor-v1")); assertFalse(evidence.contains("Masking"));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar").toFile())) {
            var type = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode();
            new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("IntegerBitReverseFixture.class")).readAllBytes()).accept(type, 0);
            StringBuilder expectedBits = new StringBuilder(), expectedBytes = new StringBuilder();
            for (char value : "Masking".toCharArray()) {
                expectedBits.append((char)Integer.reverse(value << 16));
                expectedBytes.append((char)Integer.reverseBytes(value << 16));
            }
            for (var expected : java.util.Map.of("bits", expectedBits.toString(), "bytes", expectedBytes.toString()).entrySet()) {
                var method = type.methods.stream().filter(value -> value.name.equals(expected.getKey())).findFirst().orElseThrow();
                assertTrue(java.util.Arrays.stream(method.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.LdcInsnNode literal && expected.getValue().equals(literal.cst)), expected.getKey());
                assertFalse(evidence.contains(expected.getValue()));
            }
        }
    }

    @Test void runsExplicitUnaryPassInWorker() throws Exception {

    }
    @Test void foldsConstantConditionalInWorkerAndRecordsDecision() throws Exception {
        // Version 52 requires stack map frames; a frameless fixture would be refused as malformed.
        var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(52, 1, "BranchFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(9, "value", "()I", null, null);
        var target = new org.objectweb.asm.Label();
        method.visitCode(); method.visitInsn(5); method.visitInsn(6); method.visitJumpInsn(161, target);
        method.visitIntInsn(16, 10); method.visitInsn(172);
        method.visitLabel(target); method.visitIntInsn(16, 20); method.visitInsn(172);
        method.visitMaxs(2, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        Path input = directory.resolve("BranchFixture.class"); Files.write(input, writer.toByteArray());
        Path output = directory.resolve("branch-result");
        var result = new TransformJob().run(input, output, 100, Duration.ofSeconds(20), "integer-branches");
        assertTrue(result.successful(), result.toString()); assertEquals(1, result.changes());
        String evidence = Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(evidence.contains("integer-branches-v2")); assertTrue(evidence.contains("\"result\":1"));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar").toFile())) {
            var type = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode();
            new org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader(zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("BranchFixture.class")).readAllBytes()).accept(type, 0);
            assertFalse(java.util.Arrays.stream(type.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node.getOpcode() == 161));
            assertTrue(java.util.Arrays.stream(type.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node.getOpcode() == 167));
        }
    }

    @Test void foldsRealBytecodeAndRecordsOperands() throws Exception {
        var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(52, 1, "Arithmetic", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(9, "value", "()I", null, null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitInsn(5); method.visitInsn(6); method.visitInsn(96);
        method.visitInsn(172); method.visitMaxs(2, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        Path input = directory.resolve("Arithmetic.class"); Files.write(input, writer.toByteArray());
        Path output = directory.resolve("folded");
        var result = new TransformJob().run(input, output, 1, Duration.ofSeconds(20));
        assertTrue(result.successful()); assertEquals(1, result.changes()); assertTrue(result.limitReached());
        String evidence = Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(evidence.contains("\"left\":2")); assertTrue(evidence.contains("\"right\":3"));
        assertTrue(evidence.contains("\"result\":5"));
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar").toFile())) {
            byte[] bytes = zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry("Arithmetic.class")).readAllBytes();
            assertFalse(java.util.Arrays.equals(writer.toByteArray(), bytes));
        }
    }
    Path fixture(boolean signed) throws Exception {
        Path source=directory.resolve("Example.java");
        Files.writeString(source,"public class Example { public int value(int x) { return x + 1; } }");
        assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        Path jar=directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try(var out=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Example.class")); out.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("Example.class"))); out.closeEntry();
            out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("asset.txt")); out.write(new byte[]{0,1,2,3}); out.closeEntry();
            if(signed) { out.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/TEST.SF")); out.write(new byte[]{1}); out.closeEntry(); }
        }
        return jar;
    }

        }
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json")).contains("NOT_VERIFIED"));

        Path input=fixture(true); Path output=directory.resolve("result");
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->new TransformJob().run(input,output,100,Duration.ofSeconds(20)));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(output.resolve("worker")));
        String failure = Files.readString(output.resolve("transform.json"));
        assertTrue(failure.contains("FAILED")); assertTrue(failure.contains("input_sha256"));
    }
    @Test void acceptsStandaloneClassAndRejectsBadBudget() throws Exception {
        fixture(false); Path input=directory.resolve("Example.class");
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->new TransformJob().run(input,directory.resolve("bad"),0,Duration.ofSeconds(20)));
        assertFalse(Files.exists(directory.resolve("bad")));
        assertTrue(new TransformJob().run(input,directory.resolve("result"),100,Duration.ofSeconds(20)).successful());
    }
```

`modules/sandbox/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/sandbox/BehaviorComparison.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.sandbox;

import java.util.*;
import java.security.*;

/** Finite stdout/stderr observations cannot establish universal program equivalence. */
public final class BehaviorComparison {
    public enum Status { MATCHED_CASES, MISMATCH, INCONCLUSIVE }
    public record OutputEvidence(String stdoutSha256,int stdoutBytes,String stderrSha256,int stderrBytes,
        String inputSha256,String imageId,String isolationEvidenceId,boolean isolationVerified,
        BehaviorObservation.Outcome outcome,int exitCode,boolean truncated) {}
    public record CaseResult(String id,Status status,String reason,OutputEvidence original,OutputEvidence recovered) {}
    public record Result(Status status,int matched,int mismatched,int inconclusive,List<CaseResult> cases) {
        public Result { cases=List.copyOf(cases); }
    }
    private BehaviorComparison() {}
    public static Result compare(List<BehaviorObservation> original,List<BehaviorObservation> recovered) {
        var left=index(original); var right=index(recovered);
        long bytes=0; for(var item:original) bytes+=item.outputBytes(); for(var item:recovered) bytes+=item.outputBytes();
        if(bytes>32L*1024*1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Comparison output budget exceeds 32 MiB");
        var ids=new TreeSet<String>(left.keySet()); ids.addAll(right.keySet());
        var cases=new ArrayList<CaseResult>(); int matched=0,mismatched=0,inconclusive=0;
        for(String id:ids) {
            var a=left.get(id); var b=right.get(id); String reason=null;
            if(a==null || b==null) reason="MISSING_OBSERVATION";
            else if(!a.isolationVerified() || !b.isolationVerified()) reason="ISOLATION_NOT_VERIFIED";
            else if(!a.inputSha256().equals(b.inputSha256()) || !a.imageId().equals(b.imageId()) || !a.isolationEvidenceId().equals(b.isolationEvidenceId())) reason="CONTEXT_MISMATCH";
            else if(a.outcome()!=BehaviorObservation.Outcome.COMPLETED || b.outcome()!=BehaviorObservation.Outcome.COMPLETED) reason="INCOMPLETE_EXECUTION";
            else if(a.truncated() || b.truncated()) reason="TRUNCATED_OUTPUT";
            else if(a.exitCode()!=0 || b.exitCode()!=0) reason="UNSUCCESSFUL_EXECUTION";
            Status status;
            if(reason!=null) { status=Status.INCONCLUSIVE; inconclusive++; }
            else if(Arrays.equals(a.stdout(),b.stdout()) && Arrays.equals(a.stderr(),b.stderr())) { status=Status.MATCHED_CASES; reason="OBSERVED_BYTES_MATCH"; matched++; }
            else { status=Status.MISMATCH; reason="OBSERVED_BYTES_DIFFER"; mismatched++; }
            cases.add(new CaseResult(id,status,reason,evidence(a),evidence(b)));
        }
        Status status=mismatched>0?Status.MISMATCH:(inconclusive>0 || cases.isEmpty()?Status.INCONCLUSIVE:Status.MATCHED_CASES);
        return new Result(status,matched,mismatched,inconclusive,cases);
    }
    private static Map<String,BehaviorObservation> index(List<BehaviorObservation> observations) {
        if(observations.size()>100) throw new IllegalArgumentException("At most 100 cases per side");
        var map=new HashMap<String,BehaviorObservation>();
        for(var observation:observations) if(map.putIfAbsent(observation.caseId(),observation)!=null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate case ID");
        return map;
    }
    private static OutputEvidence evidence(BehaviorObservation observation) {
        if(observation==null) return null;
        byte[] out=observation.stdout(),err=observation.stderr();
        return new OutputEvidence(hash(out),out.length,hash(err),err.length,observation.inputSha256(),observation.imageId(),
            observation.isolationEvidenceId(),observation.isolationVerified(),observation.outcome(),observation.exitCode(),observation.truncated());
    }
    private static String hash(byte[] bytes) {
        try { return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes)); }
        catch(NoSuchAlgorithmException impossible) { throw new IllegalStateException(impossible); }
    }
}
```

`modules/sandbox/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/sandbox/BehaviorObservation.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.sandbox;

import java.util.Objects;

/** Coordinator evidence, not target-supplied attestation. Never executes a program. */
public record BehaviorObservation(String caseId,String inputSha256,String imageId,String isolationEvidenceId,
        boolean isolationVerified,Outcome outcome,int exitCode,byte[] stdout,byte[] stderr,boolean truncated) {
    public enum Outcome { COMPLETED, TIMED_OUT, CANCELLED, INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILED }
    public BehaviorObservation {
        Objects.requireNonNull(caseId); Objects.requireNonNull(inputSha256); Objects.requireNonNull(imageId);
        Objects.requireNonNull(isolationEvidenceId); Objects.requireNonNull(outcome);
        if(!caseId.matches("[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,127}") || !inputSha256.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}") ||
            !imageId.matches("sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}") || isolationEvidenceId.length()>256 ||
            (isolationVerified && isolationEvidenceId.isBlank())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid observation identity or context");
        if(stdout.length>1024*1024 || stderr.length>1024*1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Observation output exceeds 1 MiB per stream");
        stdout=stdout.clone(); stderr=stderr.clone();
    }
    @Override public byte[] stdout() { return stdout.clone(); }
    @Override public byte[] stderr() { return stderr.clone(); }
    int outputBytes() { return stdout.length+stderr.length; }
}
```

`modules/sandbox/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/sandbox/SandboxPolicy.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.sandbox;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Experimental policy builder only. Runtime conformance must pass before target execution is enabled. */
public final class SandboxPolicy {
    private SandboxPolicy() {}
    public static String localEndpoint() {
        return System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains("win")
            ? "npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine" : "unix:///var/run/docker.sock";
    }
    static void validateEndpoint(String endpoint) {
        if(!Set.of("npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine","unix:///var/run/docker.sock").contains(endpoint))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only explicit local Docker endpoints are supported");
    }
    public static List<String> command(String docker,String endpoint,String image,String name,Path input,String main,List<String> arguments) {
        validateEndpoint(endpoint); arguments=List.copyOf(arguments);
        if(!image.matches("sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}") || !name.matches("classrevive-[a-z0-9-]{1,64}"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require immutable image ID and ClassRevive container name");
        if(!main.matches("[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*(\\.[A-Za-z_$][A-Za-z0-9_$]*)*") || arguments.size()>64)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid main class or argument count");
        String path=input.toAbsolutePath().normalize().toString();
        if(path.contains(",") || path.contains("\n") || path.contains("\r") || path.contains("\""))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Ambiguous mount path");
        int chars=0;
        for(String argument:arguments) { chars+=argument.length(); if(argument.indexOf('\0')>=0 || chars>8192) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Argument budget exceeded"); }
        var command=new ArrayList<>(List.of(docker,"--host",endpoint,"run","--pull=never","--rm","--name",name,
            "--network=none","--read-only","--cap-drop=ALL","--security-opt=no-new-privileges","--user=65534:65534",
            "--memory=512m","--memory-swap=512m","--cpus=1","--pids-limit=64","--ipc=private","--cgroupns=private",
            "--no-healthcheck","--log-driver=none","--ulimit=nofile=256:256",
            "--tmpfs=/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,nodev,size=64m,mode=1777",
            "--mount","type=bind,source="+path+",destination=/input,readonly","--workdir=/tmp",
            "--env=JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=","--env=_JAVA_OPTIONS=","--env=JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS=","--env=CLASSPATH=",
            "--entrypoint=/opt/java/openjdk/bin/java",image,"-Xmx256m","-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m","-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1",
            "-Djava.io.tmpdir=/tmp","-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8","-cp","/input/*",main));
        command.addAll(arguments); return List.copyOf(command);
    }
}
```

`modules/sandbox/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/sandbox/SandboxProbe.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.sandbox;

import java.io.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** Read-only daemon check; availability alone does not verify containment. */
public final class SandboxProbe {
    public record Result(boolean available,String status,String detail) {}
    public Result check(String docker,Duration timeout) throws InterruptedException {
        if(timeout.isNegative()||timeout.isZero()||timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(30))>0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Probe timeout must be >0 and <=30 seconds");
        Process process=null; Thread reader=null; var output=new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        try {
            var builder=new ProcessBuilder(docker,"--host",SandboxPolicy.localEndpoint(),"info","--format","{{.OSType}}").redirectErrorStream(true);
            builder.environment().keySet().removeIf(key->key.startsWith("DOCKER_") || key.equals("SSH_AUTH_SOCK"));
            process=builder.start(); process.getOutputStream().close(); Process running=process;
            reader=Thread.ofVirtual().start(()->{
                try(var stream=running.getInputStream()) { byte[] buffer=new byte[1024]; int count;
                    while((count=stream.read(buffer))!=-1) synchronized(output) { if(output.size()<8192) output.write(buffer,0,Math.min(count,8192-output.size())); }
                } catch(IOException ignored) { }
            });
            if(!process.waitFor(timeout.toMillis(),TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) return new Result(false,"UNAVAILABLE","Docker probe timed out");
            reader.join(1000);
            String text; synchronized(output) { text=output.toString(java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim(); }
            if(process.exitValue()!=0) return new Result(false,"UNAVAILABLE","Local Docker daemon did not answer successfully");
            if(!text.equals("linux")) return new Result(false,"UNSUPPORTED","A Linux Docker daemon is required");
            return new Result(true,"AVAILABLE_NOT_VERIFIED","Daemon available; image and isolation conformance are not verified. Target execution remains disabled.");
        } catch(IOException error) { return new Result(false,"UNAVAILABLE","Docker CLI unavailable: "+error.getClass().getSimpleName()); }
        finally {
            if(process!=null) {
                if(process.isAlive()) { process.descendants().forEach(child->child.destroyForcibly()); process.destroyForcibly(); }
                try { process.getInputStream().close(); } catch(IOException ignored) { }
            }
            if(reader!=null) reader.interrupt();
        }
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test void matchesOnlyObservedCasesAndPreservesRawBytes() {

            new BehaviorObservation("one",hash,image,"probe-v1",true,BehaviorObservation.Outcome.COMPLETED,1,new byte[0],new byte[0],false),

            new BehaviorObservation("one","c".repeat(64),image,"probe-v1",true,BehaviorObservation.Outcome.COMPLETED,0,new byte[0],new byte[0],false));
        for(var item:bad) assertEquals(BehaviorComparison.Status.INCONCLUSIVE,BehaviorComparison.compare(List.of(good),List.of(item)).status());
    }
    @Test void observationDefensivelyCopiesOutputs() {
        byte[] bytes={1}; var a=observation("one",bytes); bytes[0]=2;
        byte[] copy=a.stdout(); copy[0]=3; assertEquals(1,a.stdout()[0]);
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->observation("one",new byte[1024*1024+1]));
    }
    @Test void contextAndInfrastructureDifferencesRemainInconclusive() {
```

`modules/selection/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/selection/EnginePreference.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.selection;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2DG: which engine to try first, per source file, from the compiler fingerprint (Phase 2CJ), for the cases where
 * selection's own evidence cannot decide. Measured per file compiled alone against the original classes: on two Kotlin
 * jars (kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 and a 991-class client) JADX leads on classes kotlinc wrote (406 of 671 and 86 of 322; the
 * next best 354 and 63), and Vineflower on Java classes, in those jars (32 of 32, 187 of 191) and on 19 of 22 javac
 * libraries. It only orders or proposes candidates: no engine is left out and every choice is still verified.
 *
 * @param kotlinFiles source files ({@code a/b/C.java}) whose top-level class carries {@code kotlin.Metadata}
 */
public record EnginePreference(Set<String> kotlinFiles, String reason) {
    public static final String KOTLIN_FIRST = "jadx";
    public static final String JAVA_FIRST = "vineflower";
    public static final EnginePreference NONE = new EnginePreference(Set.of(), "");

    public EnginePreference { kotlinFiles = Set.copyOf(kotlinFiles); }

    public boolean active() { return !kotlinFiles.isEmpty(); }
    /** The engine measured best for the language of {@code file}'s class. */
    public String preferred(String file) { return kotlinFiles.contains(file) ? KOTLIN_FIRST : JAVA_FIRST; }
    /**
     * The alternatives in the order to try them for {@code file} when their evidence ties: for a Kotlin file JADX first,
     * then by name; any other file by name, as before this phase.
     */
    public <V> List<Map.Entry<String,V>> order(String file, NavigableMap<String,V> alternatives) {
        var entries = new ArrayList<>(alternatives.entrySet());
        if (kotlinFiles.contains(file))
            entries.sort(Comparator.comparing((Map.Entry<String,V> entry) -> !entry.getKey().equals(KOTLIN_FIRST)).thenComparing(Map.Entry::getKey));
        return entries;
    }
}
```

`modules/selection/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/selection/NestingForms.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.selection;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import dev.classrevive.verification.SourceText;

/**
 * Phase 2BX: source files grouped by outer class ("family"), so a hybrid never holds one binary class in two forms.
 * Without an {@code InnerClasses} attribute, engines disagree: CFR, Vineflower and Procyon write {@code a/B$C.java} as a
 * top-level file, while JADX nests {@code C} inside {@code a/B.java} by name. Mixing JADX's {@code B.java} with another
 * engine's {@code B$C.java} declares {@code a/B$C} twice ({@code compiler.err.same.binary.name}).
 *
 * <p>A family is the file stem up to the first {@code $} of its simple name. Two file sets hold a family in different
 * forms when exactly one of them has {@code $} files for it and the other's outer file nests them: it never names them
 * by binary name ({@code B$}) outside comments and strings, and it declares every named member ({@code class C}).
 * An outer file that refers to {@code B$C} or lacks a declaration of {@code C} is a top-level form whose member files
 * are missing (an engine that failed on them), never a nested form.
 */
final class NestingForms {
    private final Map<Path,String> code = new HashMap<>();

    /** {@code a/B$C$D.java} and {@code a/B.java} belong to {@code a/B}. */
    static String family(String file) {
        String stem = file.endsWith(".java") ? file.substring(0, file.length() - ".java".length()) : file;
        int slash = stem.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = stem.indexOf('$', slash + 1);
        return dollar <= slash + 1 ? stem : stem.substring(0, dollar);
    }
    /** The {@code $} files of a family ({@code a/B$...java}); '$' sorts before '.', and '%' right after '$'. */
    static SortedMap<String,Path> members(NavigableMap<String,Path> files, String family) {
        return files.subMap(family + "$", true, family + "%", false);
    }
    /** Every file of a family: the outer file and its {@code $} files. */
    static SortedMap<String,Path> all(NavigableMap<String,Path> files, String family) {
        var result = new TreeMap<>(members(files, family));
        Path outer = files.get(family + ".java");
        if (outer != null) result.put(family + ".java", outer);
        return result;
    }
    /** True when {@code mix} and {@code pick} hold {@code family} in different nesting forms. */
    boolean otherForm(NavigableMap<String,Path> mix, NavigableMap<String,Path> pick, String family) throws IOException {
        var mixMembers = members(mix, family); var pickMembers = members(pick, family);
        if (mixMembers.isEmpty() == pickMembers.isEmpty()) return false;
        var nesting = mixMembers.isEmpty() ? mix : pick;
        Path outer = nesting.get(family + ".java");
        return outer != null && nests(outer, family, (mixMembers.isEmpty() ? pickMembers : mixMembers).keySet());
    }
    private boolean nests(Path outer, String family, Set<String> memberFiles) throws IOException {
        String text = code.get(outer);
        if (text == null) { text = SourceText.mask(Files.readString(outer)); code.put(outer, text); }
        String simple = family.substring(family.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
        if (text.contains(simple + "$")) return false;
        for (var file : memberFiles) {
            String stem = file.substring(0, file.length() - ".java".length());
            String name = stem.substring(stem.lastIndexOf('$') + 1);
            if (name.isEmpty() || name.chars().allMatch(Character::isDigit)) continue; // anonymous: no declaration to find
            if (!Pattern.compile("\\b(class|interface|enum|record)\\s+" + Pattern.quote(name) + "\\b").matcher(text).find()) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

`modules/selection/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/selection/SelectionResult.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.selection;

import dev.classrevive.verification.EnumBodyFolding;
import dev.classrevive.verification.IdiomResugar;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodSplice;
import dev.classrevive.verification.SourceRepair;
import dev.classrevive.verification.VerificationResult;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

/**
 * {@code repairs} lists the compiler-guided source edits present in the selected sources (empty for engine output);
 * {@code methods} lists the method bodies taken from another engine's version of their file (Phase 2BD);
 * {@code tried} holds every verified attempt in attempt order (engine candidates, hybrids, repairs, swaps,
 * compositions), so failure capture (Phase 2AT) can compare the selected candidate with the alternatives it beat;
 * {@code folds} lists the enum constant bodies folded into their enum in the selected sources (Phase 2BX).
 * {@link #stubBacked()} (Phase 2DF) says the selected candidate compiled only against inferred stubs for missing libraries.
 * {@code idioms} (Phase 2DH) lists the compiler idioms undone in the selected sources, read from the original bytecode.
 */
public record SelectionResult(String candidate, VerificationResult verification, Map<String,String> provenance, int attempts,
                              List<SourceRepair.Edit> repairs, List<MethodSplice.Splice> methods, List<Attempt> tried,
                              List<EnumBodyFolding.Fold> folds, List<IdiomResugar.Rewrite> idioms) {
    /** One verified attempt: candidate id, source file to producer, and its verification. */
    public record Attempt(String id, Map<String,String> origins, VerificationResult verification) {
        public Attempt { origins = Map.copyOf(origins); }
    }
    public SelectionResult {
        provenance = Map.copyOf(provenance); repairs = List.copyOf(repairs); methods = List.copyOf(methods); tried = List.copyOf(tried);
        folds = List.copyOf(folds); idioms = List.copyOf(idioms);
    }
    public SelectionResult(String candidate, VerificationResult verification, Map<String,String> provenance, int attempts,
                           List<SourceRepair.Edit> repairs, List<MethodSplice.Splice> methods, List<Attempt> tried,
                           List<EnumBodyFolding.Fold> folds) {
        this(candidate, verification, provenance, attempts, repairs, methods, tried, folds, List.of());
    }
    /** Phase 2DF: the selected candidate compiled against inferred stubs (Phase 2CT), not the real libraries. */
    public boolean stubBacked() { return verification.stubBacked(); }
    /** Phase 2DF: this selection with its verification marked as stub-backed or not. */
    public SelectionResult withStubBacked(boolean value) {
        return new SelectionResult(candidate, verification.withStubBacked(value), provenance, attempts, repairs, methods, tried, folds, idioms);
    }
    public SelectionResult(String candidate, VerificationResult verification, Map<String,String> provenance, int attempts,
                           List<SourceRepair.Edit> repairs, List<MethodSplice.Splice> methods, List<Attempt> tried) {
        this(candidate, verification, provenance, attempts, repairs, methods, tried, List.of());
    }
    public SelectionResult(String candidate, VerificationResult verification, Map<String,String> provenance, int attempts,
                           List<SourceRepair.Edit> repairs) {
        this(candidate, verification, provenance, attempts, repairs, List.of(), List.of());
    }
    public SelectionResult(String candidate, VerificationResult verification, Map<String,String> provenance, int attempts) {
        this(candidate, verification, provenance, attempts, List.of());
    }
}

```

`modules/selection/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/selection/SourceSelector.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.selection;

import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import dev.classrevive.verification.*;
import dev.classrevive.engine.WorkerConcurrency;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

public final class SourceSelector {
    /** Compiler-guided repair rounds after the hybrids; each is one javac analysis and one recompilation. */
    static final int MAX_REPAIR_ROUNDS = 3;
    /** Post-repair attempts that retry a still-failing file with another engine's version (Phase 2AZ). */
    /** Phase 2BS: 12 rather than 6, so files that fail only late (flow errors after repairs) still get their swaps. */
    private static final int MAX_POST_REPAIR_SWAPS = 12;
    /** Repair-then-swap cycles (Phase 2BB): each cycle runs up to MAX_REPAIR_ROUNDS repairs, then post-repair swaps. */
    private static final int MAX_REPAIR_CYCLES = 2;
    private final boolean sourceRepair;
    /** Phase 2BX: set per {@link #select} call; a selector is not shared between concurrent selections. */
    private EnumBodyFolding folding = EnumBodyFolding.none();
    private NestingForms forms = new NestingForms();
    private EnginePreference preference = EnginePreference.NONE;
    public SourceSelector() { this(true); }
    /** @param sourceRepair whether the best candidate that parsed but failed to compile gets the bounded repair pass */
    public SourceSelector(boolean sourceRepair) { this.sourceRepair = sourceRepair; }
    public SelectionResult select(Map<String,Path> candidates, Path output, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        return select(candidates,output,originals,timeout,List.of());
    }
    public SelectionResult select(Map<String,Path> candidates, Path output, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies) throws IOException {
        return select(candidates,output,originals,timeout,dependencies,null);
    }
    /** Phase 2DG: as below, with ties between engines broken by the compiler fingerprint's {@link EnginePreference}. */
    public SelectionResult select(Map<String,Path> candidates, Path output, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                                  Path originalClasses, EnginePreference preference) throws IOException {
        this.preference = preference;
        return select(candidates, output, originals, timeout, dependencies, originalClasses);
    }
    /** {@code originalClasses} feeds per-method round-trip evidence, used to break ties among structurally equal candidates. */
    public SelectionResult select(Map<String,Path> candidates, Path output, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                                  Path originalClasses) throws IOException {
        dependencies=List.copyOf(dependencies);
        output = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        Path checks = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve("checks"));
        var verifier = new CompilerVerifier();
        folding = EnumBodyFolding.plan(originals, originalClasses); forms = new NestingForms();
        var alternatives = new TreeMap<String,NavigableMap<String,Path>>();
        var blanks = new TreeMap<String,SortedSet<String>>();
        var typedSites = new TreeMap<String,PlaceholderTypes.Result>();
        var report = new StringBuilder("Selection: compilation and structural signatures; behavior not verified.\n");
        if (preference.active()) report.append("Engine preference (Phase 2DG): ").append(preference.reason()).append('\n');
        Candidate best = null; int attempts = 0;
        var tried = new ArrayList<SelectionResult.Attempt>();
        // Engine candidates are independent, so they compile concurrently; results are ranked in the same sorted order
        // and attempt numbering as before, so the choice does not depend on which compilation finishes first.
        var ids = new ArrayList<String>(); var directories = new ArrayList<Path>(); var attemptDirectories = new ArrayList<Path>();
        for (var item : new TreeMap<>(candidates).entrySet()) {
            if (!item.getKey().matches("[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}")) throw new IOException("Invalid candidate id");
            if (!Files.isDirectory(item.getValue(), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) continue;
            var files = inventory(item.getValue());
            // Phase 2BY: a file that declares no type (Procyon writes 0 bytes for each class it fails on) supplies no class.
            var blank = new TreeSet<String>();
            // package-info.java and module-info.java declare no type by design and are kept.
            for (var file : files.entrySet())
                if (!file.getKey().matches("(.*/)?(package|module)-info\\.java") && !declaresType(file.getValue())) blank.add(file.getKey());
            blank.forEach(files::remove);
            if (!blank.isEmpty()) blanks.put(item.getKey(), blank);
            // Phase 2CL: JADX's placeholder type `??` stops javac at parsing; each such local gets its initializer's type.
            if (placeholders(files)) {
                Path work = Files.createDirectories(output.resolve("typed-work")).resolve(item.getKey());
                var typed = new PlaceholderTypes().type(item.getValue(), work, originals, timeout, dependencies);
                interrupted();
                files.putAll(typed.files());
                typedSites.put(item.getKey(), typed);
            }
            alternatives.put(item.getKey(), files);
            // An engine tree that splits enum constant bodies into files is verified as folded, like every mix (Phase 2BX).
            Path verified = item.getValue();
            if (folds(files)) { verified = output.resolve("folded").resolve(item.getKey()); Files.createDirectories(verified); copy(files, verified); }
            else if (typedSites.containsKey(item.getKey()) && !typedSites.get(item.getKey()).files().isEmpty()) {
                verified = output.resolve("typed").resolve(item.getKey()); Files.createDirectories(verified); copy(files, verified);
            }
            ids.add(item.getKey()); directories.add(verified); attemptDirectories.add(checks.resolve("attempt-" + attempts++));
        }
        var verifications = verifyAll(verifier, directories, attemptDirectories, originals, timeout, dependencies, originalClasses);
        for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
            String id = ids.get(i); var files = alternatives.get(id); var verification = verifications.get(i);
            var origins = new TreeMap<String,String>(); files.keySet().forEach(name -> origins.put(name, id));
            var candidate = new Candidate(id, files, origins, verification, List.of());
            append(report, candidate, tried);
            if (blanks.containsKey(id)) report.append(id).append(": ").append(blanks.get(id).size())
                .append(" file(s) declare no type (empty or comments only); they supply no class\n");
            if (typedSites.containsKey(id)) {
                var typed = typedSites.get(id);
                var rules = new TreeMap<String,Long>();
                typed.sites().forEach(site -> rules.merge(site.rule(), 1L, Long::sum));
                report.append(id).append(": JADX output that is no Java fixed in ").append(typed.files().size())
                    .append(" file(s) (Phase 2CL): ").append(rules.getOrDefault("initializer", 0L) + rules.getOrDefault("object", 0L))
                    .append(" placeholder type(s) `??` (").append(rules.getOrDefault("initializer", 0L)).append(" from the initializer, ")
                    .append(rules.getOrDefault("object", 0L)).append(" as Object), ")
                    .append(rules.getOrDefault("long-literal", 0L) + rules.getOrDefault("double-bits", 0L))
                    .append(" oversized integer literal(s) (").append(rules.getOrDefault("long-literal", 0L)).append(" long, ")
                    .append(rules.getOrDefault("double-bits", 0L)).append(" double bits)")
                    .append(typed.status() == dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult.Status.OUTPUT_PRODUCED || typed.status() == dev.classrevive.engine.EngineResult.Status.NO_SOURCES
                        ? "" : "; typing worker " + typed.status()).append('\n');
            }
            if (files.isEmpty()) report.append(id).append(": no .java files; ranked below every candidate with sources\n");
            if (best == null || better(candidate, best)) best = candidate;
        }
        // Phase 2DG: when the best engine tree is blind (stopped while parsing at javac's error cap), the hybrids below
        // cannot rank most files either, so the tree they grow from decides them. With Kotlin classes in the input, one more
        // candidate takes each file from the engine measured best for its class's language; it is verified like the others
        // and kept only when it is better, or as blind as the tree it starts from.
        if (best != null && preference.active() && blind(best.verification)) {
            var files = new TreeMap<>(best.files); var origins = new TreeMap<>(best.origins); int taken = 0;
            for (var file : new ArrayList<>(best.files.keySet())) {
                String want = preference.preferred(file);
                if (!files.containsKey(file) || want.equals(origins.get(file)) || !alternatives.containsKey(want)
                    || !supplies(files, alternatives.get(want), file)) continue;
                if (take(files, origins, alternatives.get(want), want, file) != null) taken++;
            }
            if (taken > 0) {
                Path sources = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve("by-language"));
                copy(files, sources);
                var result = verifier.verify(sources, checks.resolve("attempt-" + attempts++), originals, timeout, dependencies, originalClasses);
                interrupted();
                var candidate = new Candidate("by-language", files, origins, result, List.of());
                append(report, candidate, tried);
                boolean keep = better(candidate, best) || blindTie(candidate.verification, best.verification);
```
