```java
    @Test void balancesCoverageAcrossClassesInsteadOfFavoringOneLargeClass() throws Exception {
        var aMethods = new ArrayList<MemberInfo>();
        aMethods.add(new MemberInfo("<init>", "()V", 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) aMethods.add(new MemberInfo("m" + i, "()I", 0));
        var a = new ClassInfo("A", "java/lang/Object", 52, 0, 0, List.of(), List.of(), aMethods);
        var bMethods = new ArrayList<MemberInfo>();
        bMethods.add(new MemberInfo("<init>", "()V", 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) bMethods.add(new MemberInfo("m" + i, "()I", 0));
        var b = new ClassInfo("B", "java/lang/Object", 52, 0, 0, List.of(), List.of(), bMethods);
        String balanced = source("A", 2) + " " + source("B", 10);
        String lopsided = source("A", 6) + " " + source("B", 0);
        var candidates = Map.of("balanced", candidate("balanced", balanced, null), "lopsided", candidate("lopsided", lopsided, null));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(candidates, dir.resolve("selection"), List.of(a, b), Duration.ofSeconds(20));
        assertEquals("balanced", result.candidate(), Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt")));
    }
    Path tree(String id, Map<String,String> files) throws Exception {
        var root = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve(id));
        for (var file : files.entrySet()) Files.writeString(root.resolve(file.getKey()), file.getValue());
        return root;
    }
    @Test void aFamilyInTheOtherNestingFormIsTakenWholeSoNoBinaryNameIsDeclaredTwice() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2BX: without InnerClasses one engine writes A$B.java top-level, another nests B inside A.java. Taking only
        // A$B.java alone from the top-level engine would declare A$B twice (compiler.err.same.binary.name).
        var nested = tree("nested", Map.of("A.java", "/* loaded from: A$B.class */ public class A { Missing m; B b; static class B {} }",
            "C.java", "public class C { D d; static class D {} }"));
        var top = tree("top", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { A$B b; }", "A$B.java", "class A$B {}",
            "C.java", "public class C { C$D d; Missing1 x; Missing2 y; }", "C$D.java", "class C$D {}"));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("nested", nested, "top", top), dir.resolve("selection"),
            List.of(info("A"), info("A$B"), info("C"), info("C$D")), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        String report = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, result.verification().status(), report);
        assertEquals(Map.of("A.java", "top", "A$B.java", "top", "C.java", "nested"), result.provenance(), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("1 of them as a whole nesting family"), report);
        for (var attempt : result.tried())
            assertFalse(attempt.origins().containsKey("A$B.java") && "nested".equals(attempt.origins().get("A.java")), report);
    }
    @Test void aNestingOuterFileNeverReplacesATopLevelFamily() throws Exception {
        // Other files name top-level members by binary name (A$B), so a nested A.java would leave them unresolved.
        var top = tree("top", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { Missing m; A$B b; }", "A$B.java", "class A$B {}",
            "U.java", "class U { A$B b; }"));
        var nested = tree("nested", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { B b; static class B {} }", "U.java", "class U { A.B b; Missing u; Missing2 v; }"));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("nested", nested, "top", top), dir.resolve("selection"),
            List.of(info("A"), info("A$B"), info("U")), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        String report = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        for (var attempt : result.tried())
            if (attempt.origins().containsKey("A$B.java")) assertEquals("top", attempt.origins().get("A.java"), attempt.id() + "\n" + report);
        assertEquals("top", result.candidate(), report);
        assertEquals("top", result.provenance().get("A.java"), report);
    }
    @Test void anOuterFileThatNamesItsMemberByBinaryNameIsNotANestedForm() throws Exception {
        // The partial engine failed on A$B: its A.java still refers to A$B, so the member file is missing, not nested,
        // and the other engine's A$B.java is added alone rather than replacing the family.
        var partial = tree("partial", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { A$B b; }"));
        var top = tree("top", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { Missing m; A$B b; }", "A$B.java", "class A$B {}"));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("partial", partial, "top", top), dir.resolve("selection"),

        assertEquals(Map.of("A.java", "partial", "A$B.java", "top"), result.provenance(), report);
    }
    @Test void anEnumConstantBodyWrittenAsItsOwnFileIsFoldedBackIntoTheEnum() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2BX: the body of HIGH, written as top-level E$1 extending E, cannot compile (E is final without bodies).
        // The original <clinit> assigns NEW E$1 to HIGH, so its members become HIGH's body.
        Path src = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("original/src")), out = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("original/out"));
        Files.writeString(src.resolve("E.java"), "public enum E { LOW(1), HIGH(2) { int weight() { return code * 10; } }; "
            + "final int code; E(int code) { this.code = code; } int weight() { return code; } }");
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options",
            "-proc:none", "-d", out.toString(), src.resolve("E.java").toString()));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("original/classes.jar");
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (String name : List.of("E", "E$1")) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry(name + ".class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(out.resolve(name + ".class"))); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var originals = List.of(new ClassInfo("E", "java/lang/Enum", 52, 0, 0x4421, List.of(), List.of(), List.of()),
            new ClassInfo("E$1", "E", 52, 0, 0x4010, List.of(), List.of(), List.of()));
        var split = tree("split", Map.of(
            "E.java", "/* E$1 */ public enum E {\n    LOW(1),\n    HIGH(2);\n    final int code;\n    E(int code) { this.code = code; }\n"
                + "    int weight() { return code; }\n}\n",
            "E$1.java", "import java.util.List;\n\nfinal class E$1 extends E {\n    E$1(String name, int ordinal, int code) {\n    }\n\n"
                + "    @Override\n    int weight() { List<String> none = null; return code * 10; }\n}\n"));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("split", split), dir.resolve("selection"), originals, Duration.ofSeconds(30),
            List.of(), jar);
        String report = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, result.verification().status(), report);
        assertEquals(List.of(new dev.classrevive.verification.EnumBodyFolding.Fold("E.java", "E$1.java", "HIGH")), result.folds());
        String folded = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/sources/E.java"));
        assertTrue(folded.contains("HIGH(2) {"), folded);
        assertTrue(folded.contains("return code * 10;"), folded);
        assertTrue(folded.contains("import java.util.List;"), folded);
        assertFalse(folded.contains("E$1("), folded);
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve("selection/sources/E$1.java")));
        assertTrue(report.contains("  E$1.java -> E.java (constant HIGH)\n"), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("E$1.java <- split (folded into E.java)\n"), report);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(split.resolve("E$1.java")).contains("extends E"), "engine output is never modified");
    }
    @Test void aFileThatDeclaresNoTypeNeverSuppliesAClass() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2BY: Procyon writes a 0-byte file for each class it fails on. It compiled with 0 errors, so the per-file
        // hybrid took it over a real version with errors, and the class vanished from the selected sources.
        var real = tree("real", Map.of("A.java", "public class A { Missing m; }", "B.java", "public class B { A a; }"));
        var empty = tree("empty", Map.of("A.java", "", "B.java", "public class B { A a; Missing x; Missing2 y; }"));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("empty", empty, "real", real), dir.resolve("selection"),
            List.of(info("A"), info("B")), Duration.ofSeconds(30));
        String report = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        assertEquals("real", result.provenance().get("A.java"), report);
        for (var attempt : result.tried()) assertNotEquals("empty", attempt.origins().get("A.java"), attempt.id() + "\n" + report);
        assertEquals("public class A { Missing m; }", Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/sources/A.java")));
        assertTrue(report.contains("empty: 1 file(s) declare no type (empty or comments only); they supply no class"), report);
    }
    @Test void classesLeftEmptyByTheBestEngineTreeAreFilledInOnceTheHybridsAreSpent() throws Exception {

        // tree without Y and Z. CFR's nine F files differ only in a comment, so the single-file hybrids spend the budget
        // before they reach Y and Z. The fill then takes CFR's real Y and Z. package-info.java declares no type by design.
        var procyonFiles = new HashMap<>(Map.of("A.java", "public class A { Y y; Z z; }", "Y.java", "", "Z.java", "/* class Z failed */",

    @Test void aMissingFamilyIsFilledInItsTopLevelFormNotFromTheEngineThatNestsIt() throws Exception {

    @Test void aFileJavacNeverReachedInACappedCompilationIsNotCountedAsClean() {
        // Phase 2BY: past -Xmaxerrs javac stops reporting, so an unlisted file of such a compilation is unknown, not clean.
        var capped = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, 0, 1, 0, "",
            List.of(), List.of(), SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, Map.of("A.java", 1000));

    @Test void enginePreferenceOrdersOnlyKotlinFilesAndOnlyBlindTreesGetAByLanguageMix() {
        // Phase 2DG: JADX first for Kotlin files; Java files and inputs without Kotlin keep the name order.
        var preference = new EnginePreference(Set.of("k/Main.java"), "test");
        var alternatives = new TreeMap<String,Integer>(Map.of("cfr", 1, "jadx", 2, "procyon", 3, "vineflower", 4));
        assertEquals(List.of("jadx", "cfr", "procyon", "vineflower"), preference.order("k/Main.java", alternatives).stream().map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "jadx", "procyon", "vineflower"), preference.order("j/Util.java", alternatives).stream().map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "jadx", "procyon", "vineflower"), EnginePreference.NONE.order("k/Main.java", alternatives).stream().map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList());
        assertEquals("jadx", preference.preferred("k/Main.java")); assertEquals("vineflower", preference.preferred("j/Util.java"));
        assertFalse(EnginePreference.NONE.active());
        // Blind: both stopped while parsing at javac's cap. A tree that parsed, or one under the cap, is still compared by evidence.
        var capped = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, 0, 1, 0, "",
            List.of(), List.of(), SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, Map.of("A.java", 1000));
        var cappedToo = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, 0, 1, 7, "",
            List.of(), List.of(), SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, Map.of("B.java", 1000));
        var underCap = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, 40, 0, 1, 0, "",
            List.of(), List.of(), 40, Map.of("B.java", 40));
        var parsedCapped = new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, SourceSelector.JAVAC_ERROR_CAP, 0, 1, 0, "",
            List.of(), List.of(), 0, Map.of("B.java", 1000));
        assertTrue(SourceSelector.blindTie(capped, cappedToo));
        assertFalse(SourceSelector.blindTie(capped, underCap));
        assertFalse(SourceSelector.blindTie(capped, parsedCapped));
    }
    @Test void anEnumSwitchPrintedOnOrdinalsIsUndoneInTheSelectedSourcesAndRecorded() throws Exception {
        // Phase 2DH, like the first test JAR: CFR printed javac 21's switch on the ordinal of an enum of the same file.
        Path original = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("original-src"));
        Files.writeString(original.resolve("S.java"), "public class S { enum K { A, B, C }\n"
            + " static int f(K k) { switch (k) { case A: return 1; case B: return 2; default: return 3; } } }");
        Path classes = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("original-classes"));
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options",
            "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString(), original.resolve("S.java").toString()));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar");
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var name : List.of("S.class", "S$K.class")) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry(name)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(name))); zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        var a = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve("a"));
        Files.writeString(a.resolve("S.java"), "public class S {\n    static int f(K k) {\n        switch (k.ordinal()) {\n"
            + "            case 0: {\n                return 1;\n            }\n            case 1: {\n                return 2;\n            }\n"
            + "        }\n        return 3;\n    }\n\n    static enum K {\n        A,\n        B,\n        C;\n\n    }\n}\n");
        var originals = List.of(
            new ClassInfo("S", "java/lang/Object", 52, 0, 0x21, List.of(), List.of(), List.of(new MemberInfo("<init>", "()V", 1),
                new MemberInfo("f", "(LS$K;)I", 8))),
            new ClassInfo("S$K", "java/lang/Enum", 52, 0, 0x4030, List.of(), List.of(new MemberInfo("A", "LS$K;", 0x4019),
                new MemberInfo("B", "LS$K;", 0x4019), new MemberInfo("C", "LS$K;", 0x4019)), List.of()));
        var result = new SourceSelector().select(Map.of("a", a), dir.resolve("selection"), originals, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), jar);
        String report = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/selection.txt"));
        assertEquals("idioms-1", result.candidate(), report);
        assertEquals(List.of(new dev.classrevive.verification.IdiomResugar.Rewrite("S.java", 3, "enum-switch", "switch (k.ordinal())",
            "switch (k) case A, B")), result.idioms(), report);
        assertEquals(0, result.verification().roundTripDifferent(), report);
        assertTrue(report.contains("Compiler idioms undone in the selected sources (Phase 2DH): 1 rewrite(s) in 1 file(s)"), report);
        assertEquals("a", result.provenance().get("S.java"));
        String selected = Files.readString(dir.resolve("selection/sources/S.java"));
        assertTrue(selected.contains("switch (k) {") && selected.contains("case A: {") && selected.contains("case B: {"), selected);
        // Engine baselines without source repairs keep the engine's text.
        var baseline = new SourceSelector(false).select(Map.of("a", a), dir.resolve("baseline"), originals, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), jar);
        assertEquals("a", baseline.candidate());
        assertEquals(List.of(), baseline.idioms());
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/README.md`:

```md
# Static transform API (experimental)

`BytecodePass.apply(byte[], maxChanges)` returns a defensive byte-array copy, immutable change records and a limit-reached flag. It never defines or executes target classes. `IntegerConstantPass` folds adjacent integer constants for arithmetic, bitwise and shift operations using JVM integer semantics. Division/remainder by zero are preserved. It does not skip labels, stack-map frames or debug nodes, and classes containing opaque attributes are left unchanged.

Audit indexes identify the original ASM instruction-list position (including metadata nodes), not a byte offset. Chained replacements retain the first original index. `changeLimitReached` means the requested cap was reached, not that additional opportunities were proven to exist.

This module is not connected to CLI commands yet. It does not rename symbols, decrypt protected strings, resolve reflection or prove behavioral equivalence. Parsing is in-process and not a security sandbox. Future job integration must preserve original snapshots, run transforms within resource-limited workers and report before/after hashes and skipped transformations explicitly.

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/ArchiveMetadata.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import java.util.regex.*;

/** Deterministic rewrite of standard manifest class attributes and META-INF/services entries. */
final class ArchiveMetadata {
    private ArchiveMetadata() {}
    private static final String SERVICES = "META-INF/services/";
    private static final List<String> CLASS_ATTRIBUTES = List.of("Main-Class","Premain-Class","Agent-Class","Launcher-Agent-Class");
    private static final Pattern PROVIDER = Pattern.compile("^(\\s*)([^\\s#]+)(.*)$");
    record Service(String name, byte[] bytes) {}

    static byte[] rewriteManifest(byte[] bytes, Map<String,String> forward) throws IOException {
        Manifest manifest;
        try (var in = new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)) { manifest = new Manifest(in); }
        boolean changed = false;
        for (String attribute : CLASS_ATTRIBUTES) {
            var name = new Attributes.Name(attribute);
            String value = manifest.getMainAttributes().getValue(name);
            if (value == null) continue;
            String mapped = forward.get(value.replace('.','/'));
            if (mapped != null) { manifest.getMainAttributes().put(name, mapped.replace('/','.')); changed = true; }
        }
        if (!changed) return bytes;
        var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(); manifest.write(out); return out.toByteArray();
    }

    static Service rewriteServices(String path, byte[] bytes, Map<String,String> forward) throws IOException {
        String dotted = path.substring(SERVICES.length());
        String mappedInterface = forwardDotted(dotted, forward);
        String newPath = mappedInterface == null ? path : SERVICES + mappedInterface;
        String text = decodeStrict(bytes,"Service file").replace("\r\n","\n").replace('\r','\n');
        var lines = text.split("\n",-1);
        var rebuilt = new StringBuilder(); boolean changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
            String line = lines[i];
            var matcher = PROVIDER.matcher(line);
            if (matcher.matches()) {
                String mapped = forwardDotted(matcher.group(2), forward);
                if (mapped != null) { line = matcher.group(1) + mapped + matcher.group(3); changed = true; }
            }
            if (i > 0) rebuilt.append('\n');
            rebuilt.append(line);
        }
        if (!changed) return new Service(newPath, bytes);
        return new Service(newPath, rebuilt.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }

    private static String forwardDotted(String dotted, Map<String,String> forward) {
        String mapped = forward.get(dotted.replace('.','/'));
        return mapped == null ? null : mapped.replace('/','.');
    }

    static String decodeStrict(byte[] bytes,String what) throws IOException {
        try {
            return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
                .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();
        } catch (CharacterCodingException error) {
            throw new IOException(what + " is not valid UTF-8");
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/BuiltinPasses.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import java.util.*;

/** Explicit allowlist; no classpath scanning or target-controlled plugin discovery. */
public final class BuiltinPasses {
    public static final String DEFAULT = "integer-constants";
    /** Phase 2CN: passes that need the whole jar at once; they run before the per-class passes, in the order given. */
    public static final Set<String> JAR_PASSES = Set.of(dev.classrevive.transforms.skid.SkidfuscatorReverser.ID,
        dev.classrevive.transforms.skid.AidsfuscatorReverser.ID);
    private BuiltinPasses() {}
    /** The whole-jar passes of a selection, in order; they must come before every per-class pass. */
    public static List<String> jarPasses(String selection) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(selection);
        var result = new ArrayList<String>(); boolean classPassSeen = false;
        for (String name : selection.split(",",-1)) {
            if (JAR_PASSES.contains(name)) {
                if (classPassSeen) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Whole-jar pass must come first: " + name);
                result.add(name);
            } else classPassSeen = true;
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    /** Every pass name of a selection, validated (whole-jar and per-class). */
    public static List<String> names(String selection) {
        jarPasses(selection); select(selection);
        return List.of(selection.split(",",-1));
    }
    public static List<BytecodePass> select(String selection) { return select(selection, List.of()); }
    /**
     * The per-class passes of a selection; whole-jar passes ({@link #JAR_PASSES}) are skipped here.
     * @param classes every class of the input, for passes that need the whole program (Phase 2CM: {@code zkm-flags}
     * proves a flag constant over all of its reads and writes); empty when only the names are validated
     */
    public static List<BytecodePass> select(String selection, Collection<byte[]> classes) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(selection);
        var result = new ArrayList<BytecodePass>(); var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        for (String name : selection.split(",",-1)) {
            if (!seen.add(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate pass: " + name);
            if (JAR_PASSES.contains(name)) continue;
            result.add(switch(name) {
                case "integer-constants" -> new IntegerConstantPass();
                case "integer-unary" -> new IntegerUnaryPass();
                case "integer-branches" -> new IntegerBranchPass();
                case "string-length" -> new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.LENGTH);
                case "string-char-at" -> new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.CHAR_AT);
                case "string-decryptor" -> new StaticStringDecryptorPass();
                case ZkmFlagPass.NAME -> classes.isEmpty() ? ZkmFlagPass.none() : ZkmFlagPass.plan(classes);
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown pass: " + name);
            });
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/ClassRenamer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.commons.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Coherent class-set remapping with explicit private-member renaming. Runtime reflection, external callers and resources are not rewritten. */
public final class ClassRenamer {
    /** Explicit member rule; a null descriptor renames every member with that name and kind. */
    public record MemberRule(String owner,String name,String descriptor,boolean field,String target) {
        public MemberRule {
            Objects.requireNonNull(owner,"owner"); Objects.requireNonNull(name,"name"); Objects.requireNonNull(target,"target");
        }
    }
    public record MemberKey(String owner,String name,String descriptor,boolean field) implements Comparable<MemberKey> {
        public MemberKey {
            Objects.requireNonNull(owner,"owner"); Objects.requireNonNull(name,"name"); Objects.requireNonNull(descriptor,"descriptor");
        }
        @Override public int compareTo(MemberKey other) {
            int order=owner.compareTo(other.owner); if(order!=0) return order;
            order=Boolean.compare(field,other.field); if(order!=0) return order;
            order=name.compareTo(other.name); if(order!=0) return order;
            return descriptor.compareTo(other.descriptor);
        }
    }
    public record Result(Map<String,byte[]> classes,Map<String,String> forward,Map<String,String> inverse,Map<MemberKey,String> members,String limitation,int reflectionRewrites) {
        public Result {
            classes=copy(classes); forward=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(forward)); inverse=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(inverse));
            members=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(members));
        }
        @Override public Map<String,byte[]> classes() { return copy(classes); }
        private static Map<String,byte[]> copy(Map<String,byte[]> input) {
            var result=new TreeMap<String,byte[]>(); input.forEach((name,bytes)->result.put(name,bytes.clone())); return Collections.unmodifiableMap(result);
        }
    }
    public Result rename(Map<String,byte[]> classes,Map<String,String> requested) { return rename(classes,requested,List.of(),false); }
    public Result rename(Map<String,byte[]> classes,Map<String,String> requested,boolean rewriteReflectionStrings) { return rename(classes,requested,List.of(),rewriteReflectionStrings); }
    public Result rename(Map<String,byte[]> classes,Map<String,String> requested,List<MemberRule> memberRules,boolean rewriteReflectionStrings) {
        if(classes.isEmpty() || classes.size()>20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require 1..20000 classes");
        if(memberRules.size()>50000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member rule limit exceeded");
        var mapping=new TreeMap<>(requested); var input=new TreeMap<String,byte[]>(); long total=0;
        for(var entry:classes.entrySet()) {
            byte[] bytes=entry.getValue(); total+=bytes.length;
            if(bytes.length>16*1024*1024 || total>128L*1024*1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class byte budget exceeded");
            if(!validOriginal(entry.getKey()) || !new ClassReader(bytes).getClassName().equals(entry.getKey())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class identity mismatch");
            input.put(entry.getKey(),bytes.clone());
        }
        for(var entry:mapping.entrySet()) {
            String from=entry.getKey(),to=entry.getValue();
            if(!input.containsKey(from) || !validTarget(to) || special(from) || special(to))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid, missing or cross-package class mapping");
            for(String nested:input.keySet()) if(nested.startsWith(from+"$") &&
                !mapping.getOrDefault(nested,nested).startsWith(to+"$"))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Nested classes require coherent explicit mappings");
        }
        // A class may leave its package only when its whole package moves with it (Phase 2BV): every class of a source
        // package lands in one target package that no other package uses, so package-private access is unchanged.
        var packages=new HashMap<String,String>(); var targets=new HashMap<String,String>();
        for(String name:input.keySet()) {
            String source=packageName(name), target=packageName(mapping.getOrDefault(name,name));
            String previous=packages.putIfAbsent(source,target), owner=targets.putIfAbsent(target,source);
            if((previous!=null && !previous.equals(target)) || (owner!=null && !owner.equals(source)))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid, missing or cross-package class mapping");
        }
        var expanded=expandMemberRules(input,memberRules);
        var outputs=new HashSet<String>();
        for(String name:input.keySet()) if(!outputs.add(mapping.getOrDefault(name,name).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Output class name collision");
        var result=new TreeMap<String,byte[]>(); var remapper=new Renamer(mapping,expanded); int reflectionRewrites=0;
        for(var entry:input.entrySet()) {
            if(mapping.isEmpty() && expanded.isEmpty()) { result.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue()); continue; }
            // Descriptors never declare the private members of other classes, so they pass through when no class moves (Phase 2BW).
            if(special(entry.getKey()) && mapping.isEmpty()) { result.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue()); continue; }
            if(special(entry.getKey())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Descriptor classes require archive-aware renaming");
            var reader=new ClassReader(entry.getValue()); var node=new ClassNode(); reader.accept(node,0);
            if(IntegerConstantPass.hasOpaqueAttributes(node)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Opaque attributes prevent safe metadata rewriting");
            if(rewriteReflectionStrings) reflectionRewrites+=rewriteReflectionStrings(node,mapping);
            var writer=new ClassWriter(reader,0); node.accept(new ClassRemapper(writer,remapper));
            byte[] bytes=writer.toByteArray();
            if(!readable(bytes)) {
                // Phase 2CD: a StackMapTable whose uninitialized entries do not point at a NEW (Skidfuscator writes
                // Uninitialized(0)) comes out of the copy unreadable. Such a class never verified; it is written without
                // frames (the decompilers do not need them) rather than failing the whole job.
                var plain=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(entry.getValue()).accept(plain,ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
                if(rewriteReflectionStrings) rewriteReflectionStrings(plain,mapping);
                var unframed=new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS); plain.accept(new ClassRemapper(unframed,remapper));
                bytes=unframed.toByteArray();
            }
            if(bytes.length>16*1024*1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Renamed class exceeds byte limit");
            result.put(mapping.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(),entry.getKey()),bytes);
        }
        var inverse=new TreeMap<String,String>(); mapping.forEach((from,to)->inverse.put(to,from));
        return new Result(result,mapping,inverse,expanded,"Names are generated aliases or explicit mappings, not original source names. Only literal Class.forName/ClassLoader.loadClass arguments are optionally rewritten; reflection, serialization, annotations, resources and external callers are not handled by this core. Behavior NOT_VERIFIED.",reflectionRewrites);
    }
    /** True when ASM reads the class back with its frames. */
    static boolean readable(byte[] bytes) {
        try { new ClassReader(bytes).accept(new ClassNode(),0); return true; }
        catch(RuntimeException malformed) { return false; }
    }
    private static TreeMap<MemberKey,String> expandMemberRules(Map<String,byte[]> input,List<MemberRule> rules) {
        var expanded=new TreeMap<MemberKey,String>();
        var byOwner=new TreeMap<String,List<MemberRule>>();
        for(var rule:rules) {
            if(!input.containsKey(rule.owner())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member mapping references an unknown class");
            if(special(rule.owner())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member mapping targets a descriptor class");
            if(!validMemberName(rule.target())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid member target name");
            byOwner.computeIfAbsent(rule.owner(),owner->new ArrayList<>()).add(rule);
        }
        for(var entry:byOwner.entrySet()) {
            String owner=entry.getKey(); var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(input.get(owner)).accept(node,0);
            if(IntegerConstantPass.hasOpaqueAttributes(node)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Opaque attributes prevent safe member renaming");
            boolean record=(node.access&Opcodes.ACC_RECORD)!=0;
            var present=new HashSet<MemberKey>();
            for(var field:node.fields) present.add(new MemberKey(owner,field.name,field.desc,true));
            for(var method:node.methods) present.add(new MemberKey(owner,method.name,method.desc,false));
            var exact=new TreeMap<MemberKey,String>();
            var wildcard=new ArrayList<MemberRule>();
            for(var rule:entry.getValue()) {
                if(rule.descriptor()==null) wildcard.add(rule);
                else exact.put(new MemberKey(owner,rule.name(),rule.descriptor(),rule.field()),rule.target());
            }
            for(var same:exact.entrySet()) {
                if(!present.contains(same.getKey())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member mapping matches no member in "+owner);
                checkRenameable(owner,node,same.getKey(),record);
                expanded.put(same.getKey(),same.getValue());
            }
            for(var rule:wildcard) {
                int matches=0;
                for(var key:present) if(key.field()==rule.field() && key.name().equals(rule.name())) {
                    if(exact.containsKey(key)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Overlapping member mapping in "+owner);
                    checkRenameable(owner,node,key,record);
                    expanded.put(key,rule.target()); matches++;
                }
                if(matches==0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member mapping matches no member in "+owner);
            }
            for(var renamed:expanded.entrySet()) if(renamed.getKey().owner().equals(owner)
                && serializationMember(renamed.getValue(),renamed.getKey().descriptor(),renamed.getKey().field()))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Serialization member names cannot be introduced in "+owner);
            var methods=new HashSet<String>(); var fields=new HashSet<String>();
            for(var key:present) {
                String target=expanded.getOrDefault(key,key.name());
                boolean added=key.field()?fields.add(target+"\u0000"+key.descriptor()):methods.add(target+"\u0000"+key.descriptor());
                if(!added) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member rename collision in "+owner);
            }
        }
        return expanded;
    }
    private static void checkRenameable(String owner,ClassNode node,MemberKey key,boolean record) {
        int access=-1;
        if(key.field()) { for(var field:node.fields) if(field.name.equals(key.name()) && field.desc.equals(key.descriptor())) access=field.access; }
        else { for(var method:node.methods) if(method.name.equals(key.name()) && method.desc.equals(key.descriptor())) access=method.access; }
        if((access&Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE)==0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only private members can be renamed in "+owner);
        if(key.name().startsWith("<")) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Constructors and initializers cannot be renamed in "+owner);
        if(key.field() && record) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Record members cannot be renamed in "+owner);
        if(serializationMember(key.name(),key.descriptor(),key.field()))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Serialization members are looked up by name and cannot be renamed in "+owner);
    }
    /**
     * Private members Java serialization finds by exact name and descriptor. Renaming one away from, or onto, these
     * names silently changes serialization behavior even though the class still verifies.
     */
    static boolean serializationMember(String name,String descriptor,boolean field) {
        if(field) return name.equals("serialVersionUID")&&descriptor.equals("J")
            || name.equals("serialPersistentFields")&&descriptor.equals("[Ljava/io/ObjectStreamField;");
        return name.equals("writeObject")&&descriptor.equals("(Ljava/io/ObjectOutputStream;)V")
            || name.equals("readObject")&&descriptor.equals("(Ljava/io/ObjectInputStream;)V")
            || name.equals("readObjectNoData")&&descriptor.equals("()V")
            || name.equals("writeReplace")&&descriptor.equals("()Ljava/lang/Object;")
            || name.equals("readResolve")&&descriptor.equals("()Ljava/lang/Object;");
    }
    private static boolean validMemberName(String name) {
        return name!=null && name.matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*") && !name.startsWith("<");
    }
    /** Rewrites only member access whose declaring owner is renamed; private members have no inherited resolution. */
    private static final class Renamer extends Remapper {
        private final Map<String,String> classes;
        private final Map<MemberKey,String> members;
        Renamer(Map<String,String> classes,Map<MemberKey,String> members) { this.classes=classes; this.members=members; }
        @Override public String map(String internalName) { return classes.getOrDefault(internalName,internalName); }
        @Override public String mapMethodName(String owner,String name,String descriptor) {
            String target=members.get(new MemberKey(owner,name,descriptor,false)); return target==null?name:target;
        }
        @Override public String mapFieldName(String owner,String name,String descriptor) {
            String target=members.get(new MemberKey(owner,name,descriptor,true)); return target==null?name:target;
        }
    }
    /** Rewrites only literal class names consumed directly by Class.forName(String) or ClassLoader.loadClass(String). */
    private static int rewriteReflectionStrings(ClassNode type,Map<String,String> mapping) {
        int rewrites=0;
        for(var method:type.methods) for(var instruction:method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if(!(instruction instanceof MethodInsnNode call)) continue;
            boolean forName=call.getOpcode()==Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC && call.owner.equals("java/lang/Class") && call.name.equals("forName")
                && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;");
            boolean loadClass=call.getOpcode()==Opcodes.INVOKEVIRTUAL && call.owner.equals("java/lang/ClassLoader") && call.name.equals("loadClass")
                && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Class;");
            if(!forName&&!loadClass) continue;
            var argument=previousReal(instruction);
            if(!(argument instanceof LdcInsnNode literal) || !(literal.cst instanceof String text)) continue;
            String replacement=remapClassName(text,mapping);
            if(replacement!=null && !replacement.equals(text)) { literal.cst=replacement; rewrites++; }
        }
        return rewrites;
    }
    private static AbstractInsnNode previousReal(AbstractInsnNode node) {
        var current=node.getPrevious();
        while(current!=null && (current instanceof LabelNode || current instanceof LineNumberNode || current instanceof FrameNode)) current=current.getPrevious();
        return current;
    }
    private static String remapClassName(String text,Map<String,String> mapping) {
        String mapped=mapping.get(text);
        if(mapped!=null) return mapped;
        mapped=mapping.get(text.replace('.','/'));
        if(mapped!=null) return mapped.replace('/','.');
        if(text.startsWith("[") && text.endsWith(";")) {
            int start=text.indexOf('L');
            if(start>=0) { mapped=mapping.get(text.substring(start+1,text.length()-1)); if(mapped!=null) return text.substring(0,start+1)+mapped+";"; }
        }
        return null;
    }
    public static Map<String,String> plan(Collection<String> names) {
        if(names.size()>20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class count limit exceeded");
        var sorted=new TreeSet<>(names); var reserved=new HashSet<String>();
        for(String name:sorted) { if(!validOriginal(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid class identity"); reserved.add(name.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)); }
        var result=new TreeMap<String,String>(); int counter=1;
        for(String name:sorted) {
            String simple=name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('/')+1);
            if(simple.length()>2 || simple.contains("$") || special(name) || sorted.stream().anyMatch(other->other.startsWith(name+"$"))) continue;
            String alias;
            do { alias=packageName(name)+"Class"+String.format(Locale.ROOT,"%05d",counter++); } while(reserved.contains(alias.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)));
            reserved.add(alias.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)); result.put(name,alias);
        }
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(result);
    }
    /**
     * Phase 2BV: the smallest coherent mapping that gives every class a name javac can write on any file system.
     * <ol>
     * <li>A package or class name segment that is no Java identifier (the JVM allows {@code anti-leak/Loader}) gets each
     * offending character replaced by {@code _} and, when it starts with a digit, a leading {@code _}. A package moves as
     * a whole; a package name already used gets the suffix {@code _crN}.</li>
     * <li>In each group of names equal ignoring letter case (after step 1), the first in {@link String} order keeps its
     * name (upper case sorts first, so {@code app/A} stays and {@code app/a} moves); every other one gets the stable
     * suffix {@code _cr2}, {@code _cr3}, ... (the first one free ignoring case).</li>
     * </ol>
     * Nested classes ({@code name$...}) always follow their outer class. Deterministic for a given class set; names that
     * are already portable and distinct ignoring case are never touched.
     */
    public static Map<String,String> portableIdentities(Collection<String> names) {
        if(names.size()>20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class count limit exceeded");
        var effective=new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for(String name:new TreeSet<>(names)) { if(!validOriginal(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid class identity"); effective.put(name,name); }
        var packages=new TreeSet<String>(); effective.keySet().forEach(name->packages.add(packageName(name)));
        var usedPackages=new HashSet<String>(); packages.forEach(name->usedPackages.add(caseKey(name)));
        var movedPackages=new HashMap<String,String>();
        for(String source:packages) {
            String target=portablePath(source);
            if(target.equals(source)) continue;
            String base=target.substring(0,target.length()-1), candidate=target;
            for(int suffix=2;usedPackages.contains(caseKey(candidate));suffix++) candidate=base+"_cr"+suffix+"/";
            usedPackages.add(caseKey(candidate)); movedPackages.put(source,candidate);
        }
        for(var entry:effective.entrySet()) {
            String name=entry.getKey(), source=packageName(name), simple=name.substring(source.length());
            entry.setValue(movedPackages.getOrDefault(source,source)+(special(name)?simple:portableSegment(simple)));
        }
        var taken=new HashMap<String,Integer>();
        effective.values().forEach(name->taken.merge(caseKey(name),1,Integer::sum));
        boolean changed=true;
        while(changed) {
            changed=false;
            var groups=new TreeMap<String,List<String>>();
            effective.forEach((original,current)->groups.computeIfAbsent(caseKey(current),key->new ArrayList<>()).add(original));
            var touched=new HashSet<String>();
            for(var group:groups.values()) {
                if(group.size()<2 || group.stream().anyMatch(touched::contains)) continue;
                // Equal names after step 1: an original that was already portable keeps its name.
                group.sort(Comparator.comparing((String original)->effective.get(original))
                    .thenComparing(original->!original.equals(effective.get(original))).thenComparing(Comparator.naturalOrder()));
                for(String original:group.subList(1,group.size())) {
                    String from=effective.get(original);
                    if(special(from)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Module and package descriptors that collide cannot be renamed: "+original);
                    String to=null;
                    for(int suffix=2;to==null;suffix++) {
                        String candidate=from+"_cr"+suffix, key=caseKey(candidate);
                        if(!taken.containsKey(key) && taken.keySet().stream().noneMatch(other->other.startsWith(key+"$"))) to=candidate;
                    }
                    for(var entry:effective.entrySet()) {
                        if(!entry.getKey().equals(original) && !entry.getKey().startsWith(original+"$")) continue;
                        String current=entry.getValue(), moved=to+current.substring(from.length());
                        taken.computeIfPresent(caseKey(current),(key,count)->count==1?null:count-1);
                        taken.merge(caseKey(moved),1,Integer::sum);
                        entry.setValue(moved); touched.add(entry.getKey());
                    }
                    changed=true;
                }
            }
        }
        var result=new TreeMap<String,String>();
        effective.forEach((original,current)->{ if(!original.equals(current)) result.put(original,current); });
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(result);
    }
    /** Phase 2BW member plan: {@code renamed} feeds {@link #rename}; {@code kept} are non-portable names left unchanged, with the reason. */
    public record MemberPlan(Map<MemberKey,String> renamed,Map<MemberKey,String> kept) {
        public MemberPlan { renamed=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(renamed)); kept=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(kept)); }
        public List<MemberRule> rules() {
            return renamed.entrySet().stream().map(e->new MemberRule(e.getKey().owner(),e.getKey().name(),e.getKey().descriptor(),e.getKey().field(),e.getValue())).toList();
        }
    }
    /** Reserved keywords and literals javac never accepts as a member name ({@code yield} cannot be called unqualified since Java 14). */
    private static final Set<String> RESERVED=Set.of("abstract","assert","boolean","break","byte","case","catch","char","class","const",
        "continue","default","do","double","else","enum","extends","final","finally","float","for","goto","if","implements","import",
        "instanceof","int","interface","long","native","new","package","private","protected","public","return","short","static",
        "strictfp","super","switch","synchronized","this","throw","throws","transient","try","void","volatile","while","true","false",
        "null","_","yield");
    /**
     * Phase 2BW: portable names for fields and methods whose names are no Java identifiers ({@code 0a2b4acb...}, which
     * the JVM allows) or are reserved words. Only private members are renamed: they are never inherited or overridden, so
     * every reference names the declaring class and {@link #rename} rewrites them all. The new name is the
     * {@link #portableSegment} image (offending characters become {@code _}, a leading digit gets a {@code _} prefix, a
     * reserved word gets a {@code _} suffix), with {@code _crN} when a member of the same kind in that class already uses it.
     * Non-private members, and names the mapping file cannot express, are left unchanged and listed in {@code kept}.
     * Deterministic for a given class set; reads only member headers and never runs the classes.
     */
    public static MemberPlan portableMembers(Map<String,byte[]> classes) {
        if(classes.size()>20000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class count limit exceeded");
        var renamed=new TreeMap<MemberKey,String>(); var kept=new TreeMap<MemberKey,String>();
        var nodes=new TreeMap<String,ClassNode>(); String opaque=null;
        for(var type:classes.entrySet()) {
            var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(type.getValue()).accept(node,0);
            if(!node.name.equals(type.getKey())) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class identity mismatch");
            nodes.put(type.getKey(),node);
            if(opaque==null && IntegerConstantPass.hasOpaqueAttributes(node)) opaque=type.getKey();
        }
        for(var type:nodes.entrySet()) {
            String owner=type.getKey(); var node=type.getValue();
            if(special(owner)) continue;
            var members=new ArrayList<MemberKey>(); var access=new HashMap<MemberKey,Integer>();
            for(var field:node.fields) { var key=new MemberKey(owner,field.name,field.desc,true); members.add(key); access.put(key,field.access); }
            for(var method:node.methods) { var key=new MemberKey(owner,method.name,method.desc,false); members.add(key); access.put(key,method.access); }
            Collections.sort(members);
            var usedFields=new HashSet<String>(); var usedMethods=new HashSet<String>();
            for(var key:members) (key.field()?usedFields:usedMethods).add(key.name());
            boolean record=(node.access&Opcodes.ACC_RECORD)!=0;
            for(var key:members) {
                String name=key.name();
                if(name.startsWith("<") || portableMember(name)) continue;
                String reason=null;
                if(opaque!=null) reason="opaque attributes in "+opaque+" prevent safe rewriting";
                else if((access.get(key)&Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE)==0) reason="not private: it may be inherited or overridden";
                else if(key.field() && record) reason="record component";
                else if(serializationMember(name,key.descriptor(),key.field())) reason="serialization member";
                else if(!mappingExpressible(name,key.field())) reason="name the mapping file cannot express";
                if(reason!=null) { kept.put(key,reason); continue; }
                String base=RESERVED.contains(name)?name+"_":portableSegment(name), target=base;
                var used=key.field()?usedFields:usedMethods;
                for(int suffix=2;used.contains(target) || RESERVED.contains(target) || serializationMember(target,key.descriptor(),key.field());suffix++)
                    target=base+"_cr"+suffix;
                used.add(target); renamed.put(key,target);
            }
        }
        return new MemberPlan(renamed,kept);
    }
    /** Whether javac accepts the name as a field or method name as it is. */
    static boolean portableMember(String name) { return !name.isEmpty() && portableSegment(name).equals(name) && !RESERVED.contains(name); }
    /** {@link MappingFile} splits on whitespace, {@code =}, {@code #} and the descriptor delimiter. */
    private static boolean mappingExpressible(String name,boolean field) {
        return name.length()<=1024 && name.chars().noneMatch(c->c<=' ' || Character.isWhitespace(c) || Character.isISOControl(c)
            || Character.isSurrogate((char)c) || c=='=' || c=='#' || c==(field?':':'('));
    }
    /** A package path ({@code a/b/}, or empty) with every segment made a Java identifier. */
    private static String portablePath(String path) {
        if(path.isEmpty()) return path;
        var result=new StringBuilder();
        for(String segment:path.substring(0,path.length()-1).split("/",-1)) result.append(portableSegment(segment)).append('/');
        return result.toString();
    }
    /** Character-wise, so {@code a-b$c} still starts with the image of {@code a-b} plus {@code $}. */
    private static String portableSegment(String segment) {
        var result=new StringBuilder(segment.length()+1);
        if(!segment.isEmpty() && !(Character.isLetter(segment.charAt(0)) || segment.charAt(0)=='_' || segment.charAt(0)=='$')) result.append('_');
        segment.codePoints().forEach(c->result.appendCodePoint(Character.isLetterOrDigit(c) || c=='_' || c=='$' ? c : '_'));
        return result.toString();
    }
    private static String caseKey(String name) { return java.text.Normalizer.normalize(name,java.text.Normalizer.Form.NFC).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT); }
    private static String packageName(String name) { return name.substring(0,name.lastIndexOf('/')+1); }
    private static boolean special(String name) { return name.equals("module-info") || name.endsWith("/package-info") || name.equals("package-info"); }
    private static boolean validOriginal(String name) { return name!=null && name.length()<=4096 && name.matches("[\\p{L}\\p{N}_$-]+(/[\\p{L}\\p{N}_$-]+)*"); }
    private static boolean validTarget(String name) { return name!=null && name.length()<=4096 && name.matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*(/[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*)*"); }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Folds only adjacent literal integer comparisons and conditional branches. */
public final class IntegerBranchPass implements BytecodePass {
    private static final int MAX_CLASS_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int MAX_CHANGES = 1_000_000;

    @Override public String id() { return "integer-branches-v2"; }

    @Override public TransformResult apply(byte[] original, int maxChanges) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(original);
        if (original.length > MAX_CLASS_BYTES || maxChanges < 1 || maxChanges > MAX_CHANGES)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require class <=16 MiB and change budget 1..1000000");
        var reader = new ClassReader(original);
        var type = new ClassNode();
        reader.accept(type, 0);
        if (IntegerConstantPass.hasOpaqueAttributes(type)) return new TransformResult(original, List.of(), false);

        // Version 50+ classes need a stack map frame after an unconditional jump, so dead fall-through code must go.
        boolean framesRequired = (type.version & 0xFFFF) >= V1_6;
        var changes = new ArrayList<TransformResult.Change>();
        outer: for (var method : type.methods) {
            var initial = method.instructions.toArray();
            var indices = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode, Integer>();
            for (int i = 0; i < initial.length; i++) indices.put(initial[i], i);
            var removed = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode, Boolean>());
            for (int i = 0; i < initial.length; i++) {
                AbstractInsnNode leftNode = initial[i];
                if (removed.contains(leftNode)) continue;
                Integer left = IntegerConstantPass.literal(leftNode);
                if (left == null) continue;

                AbstractInsnNode next = leftNode.getNext();
                Integer right = 0;
                JumpInsnNode branch;
                boolean unary = next instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && isUnary(jump.getOpcode());
                if (unary) {
                    branch = (JumpInsnNode) next;
                } else {
                    Integer rightLiteral = IntegerConstantPass.literal(next);
                    if (rightLiteral == null || !(next.getNext() instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) || !isBinary(jump.getOpcode())) continue;
                    right = rightLiteral;
                    branch = jump;
                }
                if (IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(leftNode)
                    || !unary && IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(next)
                    || IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(branch)) continue;

                boolean taken = evaluate(branch.getOpcode(), left, right);
                List<AbstractInsnNode> dead = List.of();
                if (taken && framesRequired) {
                    dead = unreachableAfter(branch, method);
                    if (dead == null) continue;
                }
                changes.add(new TransformResult.Change(id(), type.name, method.name, method.desc, indices.get(leftNode),
                    branch.getOpcode(), left, right, taken ? 1 : 0));
                method.instructions.set(leftNode, new InsnNode(NOP));
                if (!unary) method.instructions.set(next, new InsnNode(NOP));
                method.instructions.set(branch, taken ? new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, branch.label) : new InsnNode(NOP));
                for (var node : dead) { method.instructions.remove(node); removed.add(node); }
                if (changes.size() == maxChanges) break outer;
            }
        }
        if (changes.isEmpty()) return new TransformResult(original, changes, false);
        var writer = new ClassWriter(reader, 0);
        type.accept(writer);
        byte[] transformed = writer.toByteArray();
        if (transformed.length > MAX_CLASS_BYTES) return new TransformResult(original, List.of(), false);
        return new TransformResult(transformed, changes, changes.size() == maxChanges);
    }

    /**
     * Instructions between a new GOTO and the next stack map frame. A verified version 50+ method has a frame at every
     * jump target and handler, so these are reachable only by the fall-through the GOTO removed. Labels and line numbers
     * stay. Returns null (refuse the fold) when the region touches an exception range, reaches a jump/switch target
     * (a malformed input without the required frame) or carries type annotations.
     */
    private static List<AbstractInsnNode> unreachableAfter(JumpInsnNode branch, MethodNode method) {
        var guarded = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<LabelNode, Boolean>());
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) { guarded.add(block.start); guarded.add(block.end); guarded.add(block.handler); }
        for (var node : method.instructions) {
            if (node instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) guarded.add(jump.label);
            else if (node instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { guarded.add(table.dflt); guarded.addAll(table.labels); }
            else if (node instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { guarded.add(lookup.dflt); guarded.addAll(lookup.labels); }
        }
        var dead = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var node = branch.getNext(); node != null && !(node instanceof FrameNode); node = node.getNext()) {
            if (node instanceof LabelNode label) {
                if (framed(label)) break;
                if (guarded.contains(label)) return null;
                continue;
            }
            if (node instanceof LineNumberNode) continue;
            if (IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(node)) return null;
            dead.add(node);
        }
        return dead;
    }

    private static boolean framed(LabelNode label) {
        var node = label.getNext();
        while (node instanceof LabelNode || node instanceof LineNumberNode) node = node.getNext();
        return node instanceof FrameNode;
    }

    private static boolean isUnary(int opcode) {
        return opcode == IFEQ || opcode == IFNE || opcode == IFLT || opcode == IFGE || opcode == IFGT || opcode == IFLE;
    }

    private static boolean isBinary(int opcode) {
        return opcode == IF_ICMPEQ || opcode == IF_ICMPNE || opcode == IF_ICMPLT || opcode == IF_ICMPGE
            || opcode == IF_ICMPGT || opcode == IF_ICMPLE;
    }

    private static boolean evaluate(int opcode, int left, int right) {
        return switch (opcode) {
            case IFEQ, IF_ICMPEQ -> left == right;
            case IFNE, IF_ICMPNE -> left != right;
            case IFLT, IF_ICMPLT -> left < right;
            case IFGE, IF_ICMPGE -> left >= right;
            case IFGT, IF_ICMPGT -> left > right;
            case IFLE, IF_ICMPLE -> left <= right;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported integer branch opcode: " + opcode);
        };
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/IntegerConstantPass.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Folds only adjacent literal operands; labels, frames and debug nodes are hard boundaries. */
public final class IntegerConstantPass implements BytecodePass {
    public String id() { return "integer-constants-v1"; }
    public TransformResult apply(byte[] original, int maxChanges) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(original);
        if (original.length > 16 * 1024 * 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Class exceeds 16 MiB");
        if (maxChanges < 1 || maxChanges > 1_000_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Change budget must be 1..1000000");
        var reader = new ClassReader(original);
        var type = new ClassNode(); reader.accept(type,0);
        // Opaque attributes may contain code offsets or constant-pool indexes we cannot rewrite.
        if (hasOpaqueAttributes(type)) return new TransformResult(original,List.of(),false);
        var changes = new ArrayList<TransformResult.Change>();
        outer: for (var method : type.methods) {
            var indices = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
            var initial = method.instructions.toArray();
            for (int i=0;i<initial.length;i++) indices.put(initial[i],i);
            var cursor = method.instructions.getFirst();
            while (cursor != null) {
                var second = cursor.getNext();
                var operation = second == null ? null : second.getNext();
                Integer left = literal(cursor), right = literal(second);
                Integer value = left == null || right == null || operation == null ? null : evaluate(left,right,operation.getOpcode());
                if (value == null || hasInstructionAnnotations(cursor) || hasInstructionAnnotations(second) || hasInstructionAnnotations(operation)) { cursor = cursor.getNext(); continue; }
                int index = indices.get(cursor);
                changes.add(new TransformResult.Change(id(),type.name,method.name,method.desc,index,operation.getOpcode(),left,right,value));
                var replacement = new LdcInsnNode(value);
                method.instructions.set(cursor,replacement);
                method.instructions.remove(second); method.instructions.remove(operation);
                indices.put(replacement,index); cursor = replacement;
                if (changes.size() == maxChanges) break outer;
            }
        }
        if (changes.isEmpty()) return new TransformResult(original,changes,false);
        // Stack at every retained boundary is unchanged; existing frames/maxima remain valid.
        var writer = new ClassWriter(reader,0); type.accept(writer);
        return new TransformResult(writer.toByteArray(),changes,changes.size() == maxChanges);
    }
    static boolean hasOpaqueAttributes(ClassNode type) {
        if (type.attrs != null && !type.attrs.isEmpty()) return true;
        if (type.fields.stream().anyMatch(field -> field.attrs != null && !field.attrs.isEmpty())) return true;
        if (type.methods.stream().anyMatch(method -> method.attrs != null && !method.attrs.isEmpty())) return true;
        return type.recordComponents != null && type.recordComponents.stream().anyMatch(part -> part.attrs != null && !part.attrs.isEmpty());
    }
    static boolean hasInstructionAnnotations(AbstractInsnNode node) {
        return node != null && ((node.visibleTypeAnnotations != null && !node.visibleTypeAnnotations.isEmpty()) ||
            (node.invisibleTypeAnnotations != null && !node.invisibleTypeAnnotations.isEmpty()));
    }
    static Integer literal(AbstractInsnNode node) {
        if (node == null) return null;
        int opcode = node.getOpcode();
        if (opcode >= ICONST_M1 && opcode <= ICONST_5) return opcode - ICONST_0;
        if (node instanceof IntInsnNode number && (opcode == BIPUSH || opcode == SIPUSH)) return number.operand;
        if (node instanceof LdcInsnNode number && number.cst instanceof Integer value) return value;
        return null;
    }
    private static Integer evaluate(int left, int right, int opcode) {
        return switch (opcode) {
            case IADD -> left + right; case ISUB -> left - right; case IMUL -> left * right;
            case IDIV -> right == 0 ? null : Integer.valueOf(left / right);
            case IREM -> right == 0 ? null : Integer.valueOf(left % right);
            case IAND -> left & right; case IOR -> left | right; case IXOR -> left ^ right;
            case ISHL -> left << right; case ISHR -> left >> right; case IUSHR -> left >>> right;
            default -> null;
        };
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Folds adjacent literal unary integer operations without crossing control-flow boundaries. */
public final class IntegerUnaryPass implements BytecodePass {
    public String id() { return "integer-unary-v1"; }
    public TransformResult apply(byte[] original, int maxChanges) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(original);
        if (original.length > 16*1024*1024 || maxChanges < 1 || maxChanges > 1_000_000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require class <=16 MiB and change budget 1..1000000");
        var reader = new ClassReader(original); var type = new ClassNode(); reader.accept(type,0);
        if (IntegerConstantPass.hasOpaqueAttributes(type)) return new TransformResult(original,List.of(),false);
        var changes = new ArrayList<TransformResult.Change>();
        outer: for (var method : type.methods) {
            var indices = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
            var initial = method.instructions.toArray();
            for (int i=0;i<initial.length;i++) indices.put(initial[i],i);
            var cursor = method.instructions.getFirst();
            while (cursor != null) {
                Integer literal = IntegerConstantPass.literal(cursor);
                var operation = cursor.getNext();
                Integer value = literal == null || operation == null ? null : switch(operation.getOpcode()) {
                    case INEG -> -literal; case I2B -> (int)(byte)(int)literal;
                    case I2C -> (int)(char)(int)literal; case I2S -> (int)(short)(int)literal;
                    default -> null;
                };
                if (value == null || IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(cursor) || IntegerConstantPass.hasInstructionAnnotations(operation)) { cursor = cursor.getNext(); continue; }
                int index = indices.get(cursor);
                changes.add(new TransformResult.Change(id(),type.name,method.name,method.desc,index,operation.getOpcode(),literal,0,value));
                var replacement = new LdcInsnNode(value);
                method.instructions.set(cursor,replacement); method.instructions.remove(operation);
                indices.put(replacement,index); cursor = replacement;
                if (changes.size()==maxChanges) break outer;
            }
        }
        if (changes.isEmpty()) return new TransformResult(original,changes,false);
        var writer = new ClassWriter(reader,0); type.accept(writer);
        return new TransformResult(writer.toByteArray(),changes,changes.size()==maxChanges);
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/MappingFile.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/** Parses an explicit rename mapping file: class rules plus private method/field rules. */
public final class MappingFile {
    /** Explicit plan; a member rule with a null descriptor applies to every member with that name and kind. */
    public record Plan(Map<String,String> classes,List<ClassRenamer.MemberRule> members) {
        public Plan {
            classes=Collections.unmodifiableMap(new TreeMap<>(classes));
            members=List.copyOf(members);
        }
    }
    public static final int MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
    private static final int MAX_CLASS_RULES = 20000;
    private static final int MAX_MEMBER_RULES = 50000;
    private static final int MAX_LINE = 4096;
    private static final Pattern FIELD_DESCRIPTOR = Pattern.compile("\\[*(?:[BCDFIJSZ]|L[^;\\s]+;)");
    private static final Pattern METHOD_DESCRIPTOR = Pattern.compile("\\((?:\\[*(?:[BCDFIJSZ]|L[^;\\s]+;))*\\)(?:V|\\[*(?:[BCDFIJSZ]|L[^;\\s]+;))");

    public static Plan parse(byte[] bytes) {
        if (bytes.length > MAX_BYTES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mapping file exceeds 1 MiB");
        int offset = bytes.length >= 3 && (bytes[0] & 0xFF) == 0xEF && (bytes[1] & 0xFF) == 0xBB && (bytes[2] & 0xFF) == 0xBF ? 3 : 0;
        String text;
        try { text = ArchiveMetadata.decodeStrict(Arrays.copyOfRange(bytes, offset, bytes.length), "Mapping file"); }
        catch (IOException error) { throw new IllegalArgumentException(error.getMessage()); }
        var classes = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        var members = new ArrayList<ClassRenamer.MemberRule>();
        int number = 0;
        for (String raw : text.split("\n", -1)) {
            number++;
            String line = raw.endsWith("\r") ? raw.substring(0, raw.length() - 1) : raw;
            line = line.trim();
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("#")) continue;
            if (line.length() > MAX_LINE) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mapping line " + number + " exceeds " + MAX_LINE + " characters");
            int equals = line.indexOf('=');
            if (equals < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mapping line " + number + " has no '='");
            String left = line.substring(0, equals).trim(), target = line.substring(equals + 1).trim();
            if (left.isEmpty() || target.isEmpty() || target.chars().anyMatch(Character::isWhitespace) || target.indexOf('=') >= 0 || target.indexOf('#') >= 0)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid mapping target on line " + number);
            int space = left.indexOf(' ');
            if (space < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mapping line " + number + " requires a rule kind");
            String kind = left.substring(0, space), rest = left.substring(space + 1).trim();
            switch (kind) {
                case "class" -> {
                    if (classes.put(toInternal(rest, number), toInternal(target, number)) != null)
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate class mapping on line " + number);
                    if (classes.size() > MAX_CLASS_RULES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many class mappings");
                }
                case "method", "field" -> {
                    int hash = rest.indexOf('#');
                    if (hash < 1) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Member rule on line " + number + " requires owner#name");
                    String owner = toInternal(rest.substring(0, hash), number);
                    String member = rest.substring(hash + 1).trim();
                    boolean field = kind.equals("field");
                    String name, descriptor = null;
                    if (field) {
                        int colon = member.indexOf(':');
                        if (colon >= 0) { name = member.substring(0, colon).trim(); descriptor = member.substring(colon + 1).trim(); }
                        else name = member;
                        if (descriptor != null && !FIELD_DESCRIPTOR.matcher(descriptor).matches())
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid field descriptor on line " + number);
                    } else {
                        int paren = member.indexOf('(');
                        if (paren >= 0) { name = member.substring(0, paren).trim(); descriptor = member.substring(paren).trim(); }
                        else name = member;
                        if (descriptor != null && !METHOD_DESCRIPTOR.matcher(descriptor).matches())
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid method descriptor on line " + number);
                    }
                    if (name.isEmpty() || name.chars().anyMatch(Character::isWhitespace) || name.indexOf('#') >= 0)
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid member name on line " + number);
                    members.add(new ClassRenamer.MemberRule(owner, name, descriptor, field, target));
                    if (members.size() > MAX_MEMBER_RULES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Too many member rules");
                }
                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown mapping kind on line " + number);
            }
        }
        if (classes.isEmpty() && members.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mapping file has no entries");
        members.sort(Comparator.comparing(ClassRenamer.MemberRule::owner)
            .thenComparing(ClassRenamer.MemberRule::field)
            .thenComparing(ClassRenamer.MemberRule::name)
            .thenComparing(rule -> rule.descriptor() == null ? "" : rule.descriptor())
            .thenComparing(ClassRenamer.MemberRule::target));
        for (int i = 1; i < members.size(); i++)
            if (sameRule(members.get(i - 1), members.get(i))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate member mapping");
        return new Plan(classes, members);
    }

    private static boolean sameRule(ClassRenamer.MemberRule first, ClassRenamer.MemberRule second) {
        return first.owner().equals(second.owner()) && first.field() == second.field()
            && first.name().equals(second.name()) && Objects.equals(first.descriptor(), second.descriptor());
    }
    private static String toInternal(String name, int number) {
        if (name.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty name on line " + number);
        return name.indexOf('/') >= 0 ? name : name.replace('.', '/');
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/PassPipeline.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import java.util.*;

/** One ordered sweep of trusted pass instances; indices are relative to each pass input. */
public final class PassPipeline {
    private final List<BytecodePass> passes;
    public PassPipeline(List<BytecodePass> passes) {
        this.passes = List.copyOf(passes);
        if (passes.isEmpty() || passes.size()>64) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require 1..64 passes");
        var ids = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var pass : this.passes)
            if (pass.id()==null || !pass.id().matches("[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}") || !ids.add(pass.id()))
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid or duplicate pass ID");
    }
    public TransformResult apply(byte[] original, int maxChanges) {
        if (original.length>16*1024*1024 || maxChanges<1 || maxChanges>1_000_000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Require class <=16 MiB and change budget 1..1000000");
        byte[] bytes = original.clone(); var changes = new ArrayList<TransformResult.Change>();
        for (var pass : passes) {
            int remaining = maxChanges-changes.size(); if (remaining==0) break;
            var result = Objects.requireNonNull(pass.apply(bytes.clone(),remaining));
            byte[] next = result.bytes();
            if (next.length>16*1024*1024 || result.changes().size()>remaining ||
                result.changes().stream().anyMatch(change -> !pass.id().equals(change.pass())) ||
                (result.changes().isEmpty() && !Arrays.equals(bytes,next)))
                throw new IllegalStateException("Pass violated output/audit contract: " + pass.id());
            bytes = next; changes.addAll(result.changes());
        }
        return new TransformResult(bytes,changes,changes.size()==maxChanges);
    }
}
```
