`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/AidsEvaluator.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CZ: a concrete, bounded interpreter for the code Aidsfuscator generates to decrypt numbers and strings: its
 * decryptor methods and the initializers at the start of {@code <clinit>} that fill their arrays. It runs the target's
 * bytecode on values of its own (ints, longs, arrays, strings), never defining, loading or initializing a target class.
 * The JDK is reached only through a closed allowlist: {@code String} operations, {@code Throwable.getStackTrace()} (which
 * returns the modelled frames: the decryptor and its caller, the class and method of the call site) with
 * {@code StackTraceElement}'s names, and the AES-CBC decryption of the AES initializer ({@code Cipher},
 * {@code SecretKeySpec}, {@code IvParameterSpec}, {@code Base64}), run on constants. Static fields are those of the
 * class being reversed, kept in a map. Anything else, an exception or a budget overrun refuses the evaluation.
 */
final class AidsEvaluator implements Opcodes {
    static final int MAX_STEPS = 2_000_000, MAX_ARRAY = 1 << 20, MAX_DEPTH = 4;
    private final ClassNode owner;
    /** {@code name:desc} of the owner's static fields to their current values. */
    final Map<String,Object> statics = new HashMap<>();
    /** After {@link #runInitializer}: the fields it wrote and the instructions it ran before the program's code. */
    final Set<String> written = new HashSet<>();
    final Set<AbstractInsnNode> executed = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    private final Set<AbstractInsnNode> sinceStatement = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    private long steps;

    static final class Refusal extends RuntimeException {
        Refusal(String why) { super(why, null, false, false); }
    }
    /** An object between {@code new} and its constructor. */
    private record Uninitialized(String type, int id) {}
    /** A {@code Throwable} created by the interpreted code: its stack trace is the interpreter's own frames. */
    private record Trace(StackTraceElement[] frames) {}
    private int allocations;

    AidsEvaluator(ClassNode owner) { this.owner = owner; }

    /**
     * Where the program's code starts: the first instruction of the statement holding the first instruction the
     * interpreter would not run ({@code null} when it reached a return), and the stack depth there.
     */
    record Stop(AbstractInsnNode at, int stackDepth) {}

    /**
     * Runs a {@code <clinit>} from its first instruction until it reaches an instruction outside the obfuscator's
     * initializer: a field of the class not in {@code fields}, any other class's member, a call outside the allowlist
     * (a decryptor call of the program included), or a return. Returns where it stopped; throws {@link Refusal} when the
     * initializer itself fails.
     */
    Stop runInitializer(MethodNode clinit, Set<String> fields) {
        steps = 0;
        var frames = new ArrayDeque<StackTraceElement>();
        frames.push(new StackTraceElement(owner.name.replace('/', '.'), "<clinit>", null, -1));
        return (Stop) execute(clinit, new Object[Math.max(clinit.maxLocals, 1)], frames, fields, true, 0);
    }

    /** Calls a static method of the owner on constant arguments, as if from {@code callerMethod} of the owner. */
    Object call(MethodNode method, Object[] args, String callerMethod) {
        steps = 0;
        var frames = new ArrayDeque<StackTraceElement>();
        frames.push(new StackTraceElement(owner.name.replace('/', '.'), callerMethod, null, -1));
        return invoke(method, args, frames, 0);
    }

    private Object invoke(MethodNode method, Object[] args, Deque<StackTraceElement> frames, int depth) {
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH || (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0) throw new Refusal("call depth or instance method");
        var locals = new Object[Math.max(method.maxLocals, 1)];
        int slot = 0;
        var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc);
        for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) { locals[slot] = args[i]; slot += types[i].getSize(); }
        frames.push(new StackTraceElement(owner.name.replace('/', '.'), method.name, null, -1));
        try { return execute(method, locals, frames, null, false, depth); }
        finally { frames.pop(); }
    }

    private Object execute(MethodNode method, Object[] locals, Deque<StackTraceElement> frames, Set<String> fields, boolean initializer, int depth) {
        var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        var stack = new ArrayList<Object>();
        int pc = 0;
        // The program's first statement starts at the last instruction run with an empty stack before a foreign one.
        AbstractInsnNode statement = null;
        while (true) {
            if (++steps > MAX_STEPS) throw new Refusal("budget");
            if (pc >= insns.length) throw new Refusal("fell off the code");
            var insn = insns[pc];
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            if (op < 0) { pc++; continue; }
            if (stack.isEmpty()) {
                statement = insn;
                if (initializer) { executed.addAll(sinceStatement); sinceStatement.clear(); }
            }
            if (initializer && foreign(insn, fields)) return new Stop(statement, 0);
            if (initializer) sinceStatement.add(insn);
            int next = pc + 1;
            switch (insn) {
                case InsnNode plain -> {
                    if (op >= IRETURN && op <= ARETURN) return stack.removeLast();
                    if (op == RETURN) {
                        if (!initializer) return null;
                        executed.addAll(sinceStatement);
                        return new Stop(null, 0);
                    }
                    simple(op, stack);
                }
                case IntInsnNode i -> {
                    if (op == NEWARRAY) stack.add(newArray(i.operand, intValue(stack.removeLast())));
                    else stack.add(i.operand);
                }
                case LdcInsnNode ldc -> {
                    if (ldc.cst instanceof Integer || ldc.cst instanceof String || ldc.cst instanceof Float) stack.add(ldc.cst);
                    else if (ldc.cst instanceof Long || ldc.cst instanceof Double) { stack.add(ldc.cst); stack.add(null); }
                    else throw new Refusal("ldc " + ldc.cst);
                }
                case VarInsnNode var -> {
                    if (op >= ILOAD && op <= ALOAD) { stack.add(locals[var.var]); if (op == LLOAD || op == DLOAD) stack.add(null); }
                    else if (op >= ISTORE && op <= ASTORE) {
                        if (op == LSTORE || op == DSTORE) stack.removeLast();
                        locals[var.var] = stack.removeLast();
                    } else throw new Refusal("ret");
                }
                case IincInsnNode inc -> locals[inc.var] = intValue(locals[inc.var]) + inc.incr;
                case JumpInsnNode jump -> {
                    if (branch(op, stack)) next = index.get(jump.label);
                }
                case TableSwitchInsnNode table -> {
                    int key = intValue(stack.removeLast());
                    next = index.get(key >= table.min && key <= table.max ? table.labels.get(key - table.min) : table.dflt);
                }
                case LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup -> {
                    int at = lookup.keys.indexOf(intValue(stack.removeLast()));
                    next = index.get(at >= 0 ? lookup.labels.get(at) : lookup.dflt);
                }
                case FieldInsnNode field -> {
                    if (!field.owner.equals(owner.name) || op == GETFIELD || op == PUTFIELD) throw new Refusal("field " + field.owner + "." + field.name);
                    String key = field.name + ":" + field.desc;
                    if (op == GETSTATIC) {
                        if (!statics.containsKey(key)) throw new Refusal("unset field " + key);
                        stack.add(statics.get(key)); if (Type.getType(field.desc).getSize() == 2) stack.add(null);
                    } else {
                        if (Type.getType(field.desc).getSize() == 2) stack.removeLast();
                        statics.put(key, stack.removeLast());
                        if (initializer) written.add(key);
                    }
                }
                case TypeInsnNode type -> {
                    switch (op) {
                        case NEW -> {
                            if (!ALLOCATABLE.contains(type.desc)) throw new Refusal("new " + type.desc);
                            stack.add(new Uninitialized(type.desc, allocations++));
                        }
                        case ANEWARRAY -> {
                            int length = intValue(stack.removeLast());
                            if (length < 0 || length > MAX_ARRAY) throw new Refusal("array size");
                            stack.add(type.desc.equals("java/lang/String") ? new String[length] : type.desc.equals("java/lang/StackTraceElement") ? new StackTraceElement[length] : new Object[length]);
                        }
                        case CHECKCAST -> {
                            Object value = stack.getLast();
                            if (value != null && !castable(value, type.desc)) throw new Refusal("checkcast " + type.desc);
                        }
                        default -> throw new Refusal("type op " + op);
                    }
                }
                case MethodInsnNode call -> invokeInsn(call, stack, frames, depth);
                default -> throw new Refusal("instruction " + op);
            }
            pc = next;
        }
    }

    /** Whether an initializer instruction is no longer the obfuscator's (the program's own code starts there). */
    private boolean foreign(AbstractInsnNode insn, Set<String> fields) {
        if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field) return !field.owner.equals(owner.name) || !fields.contains(field.name + ":" + field.desc);
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) return !allowed(call);
        if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode type && type.getOpcode() == NEW) return !ALLOCATABLE.contains(type.desc);
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        return op == ATHROW || op == MONITORENTER || op == MONITOREXIT || insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode || insn instanceof MultiANewArrayInsnNode;
    }

    private static final Set<String> ALLOCATABLE = Set.of("java/lang/String", "java/lang/Throwable", "javax/crypto/spec/IvParameterSpec",
        "javax/crypto/spec/SecretKeySpec", "java/lang/StringBuilder");

    private static boolean allowed(MethodInsnNode call) {
        return switch (call.owner) {
            case "java/lang/String" -> Set.of("charAt(I)C", "getBytes(Ljava/lang/String;)[B", "hashCode()I", "intern()Ljava/lang/String;", "length()I",
                "substring(II)Ljava/lang/String;", "toCharArray()[C", "<init>([C)V", "<init>([BLjava/lang/String;)V", "<init>([B)V").contains(call.name + call.desc);
            case "java/lang/Throwable" -> Set.of("<init>()V", "getStackTrace()[Ljava/lang/StackTraceElement;").contains(call.name + call.desc);
            case "java/lang/StackTraceElement" -> Set.of("getClassName()Ljava/lang/String;", "getMethodName()Ljava/lang/String;").contains(call.name + call.desc);
            case "java/util/Base64" -> (call.name + call.desc).equals("getDecoder()Ljava/util/Base64$Decoder;");
            case "java/util/Base64$Decoder" -> (call.name + call.desc).equals("decode(Ljava/lang/String;)[B");
            case "javax/crypto/Cipher" -> Set.of("getInstance(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljavax/crypto/Cipher;", "doFinal([B)[B",
                "init(ILjava/security/Key;Ljava/security/spec/AlgorithmParameterSpec;)V").contains(call.name + call.desc);
            case "javax/crypto/spec/SecretKeySpec" -> (call.name + call.desc).equals("<init>([BLjava/lang/String;)V");
            case "javax/crypto/spec/IvParameterSpec" -> (call.name + call.desc).equals("<init>([B)V");
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    private void invokeInsn(MethodInsnNode call, List<Object> stack, Deque<StackTraceElement> frames, int depth) {
        var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc);
        var args = new Object[types.length];
        for (int k = types.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) { if (types[k].getSize() == 2) stack.removeLast(); args[k] = stack.removeLast(); }
        // A static helper of the owner (Aidsfuscator's decryptors call none, but its polymorphic masks may).
        if (call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC && call.owner.equals(owner.name)) {
            MethodNode target = null;
            for (var method : owner.methods) if (method.name.equals(call.name) && method.desc.equals(call.desc)) target = method;
            if (target == null) throw new Refusal("missing " + call.name);
            Object result = invoke(target, args, frames, depth + 1);
            push(stack, result, Type.getReturnType(call.desc));
            return;
        }
        if (!allowed(call)) throw new Refusal("call " + call.owner + "." + call.name + call.desc);
        if (call.name.equals("<init>")) {
            var target = (Uninitialized) stack.removeLast();
            Object built = construct(call, args, frames);
            for (int k = 0; k < stack.size(); k++) if (target.equals(stack.get(k))) stack.set(k, built);
            return;
        }
        Object receiver = call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC ? null : stack.removeLast();
        if (call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC && receiver == null) throw new Refusal("null receiver");
        Object result;
        try {
            result = switch (call.owner + "." + call.name) {
                case "java/lang/String.charAt" -> (int) ((String) receiver).charAt(intValue(args[0]));
                case "java/lang/String.getBytes" -> ((String) receiver).getBytes((String) args[0]);
                case "java/lang/String.hashCode" -> receiver.hashCode();
                case "java/lang/String.intern" -> receiver;
                case "java/lang/String.length" -> ((String) receiver).length();
                case "java/lang/String.substring" -> ((String) receiver).substring(intValue(args[0]), intValue(args[1]));
                case "java/lang/String.toCharArray" -> ((String) receiver).toCharArray();
                case "java/lang/Throwable.getStackTrace" -> ((Trace) receiver).frames().clone();
                case "java/lang/StackTraceElement.getClassName" -> ((StackTraceElement) receiver).getClassName();
                case "java/lang/StackTraceElement.getMethodName" -> ((StackTraceElement) receiver).getMethodName();
                case "java/util/Base64.getDecoder" -> Base64.getDecoder();
                case "java/util/Base64$Decoder.decode" -> ((Base64.Decoder) receiver).decode((String) args[0]);
                case "javax/crypto/Cipher.getInstance" -> {
                    if (!"AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding".equals(args[0])) throw new Refusal("cipher " + args[0]);
                    yield javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
                }
                case "javax/crypto/Cipher.init" -> {
                    ((javax.crypto.Cipher) receiver).init(intValue(args[0]), (java.security.Key) args[1], (java.security.spec.AlgorithmParameterSpec) args[2]);
                    yield null;
                }
                case "javax/crypto/Cipher.doFinal" -> ((javax.crypto.Cipher) receiver).doFinal((byte[]) args[0]);
                default -> throw new Refusal("call " + call.name);
            };
        } catch (Refusal refusal) {
            throw refusal;
        } catch (Exception | Error failure) {
            throw new Refusal("call failed: " + failure);
        }
        push(stack, result, Type.getReturnType(call.desc));
    }

    private Object construct(MethodInsnNode call, Object[] args, Deque<StackTraceElement> frames) {
        try {
            return switch (call.owner + call.desc) {
                case "java/lang/String([C)V" -> new String((char[]) args[0]);
                case "java/lang/String([B)V" -> new String((byte[]) args[0], java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                case "java/lang/String([BLjava/lang/String;)V" -> new String((byte[]) args[0], (String) args[1]);
                case "java/lang/Throwable()V" -> new Trace(frames.toArray(StackTraceElement[]::new));
                case "javax/crypto/spec/SecretKeySpec([BLjava/lang/String;)V" -> {
                    if (!"AES".equals(args[1])) throw new Refusal("key " + args[1]);
                    yield new javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec((byte[]) args[0], "AES");
                }
                case "javax/crypto/spec/IvParameterSpec([B)V" -> new javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec((byte[]) args[0]);
                default -> throw new Refusal("constructor " + call.owner + call.desc);
            };
        } catch (Refusal refusal) {
            throw refusal;
        } catch (Exception failure) {
            throw new Refusal("constructor failed: " + failure);
        }
    }

    private static void push(List<Object> stack, Object value, Type type) {
        if (type.getSort() == Type.VOID) return;
        if (type.getSort() == Type.CHAR && value instanceof Character c) value = (int) c;
        stack.add(value);
        if (type.getSize() == 2) stack.add(null);
    }

    private static boolean castable(Object value, String type) {
        return switch (type) {
            case "[Ljava/lang/StackTraceElement;" -> value instanceof StackTraceElement[];
            case "java/lang/String" -> value instanceof String;
            case "[Ljava/lang/String;" -> value instanceof String[];
            case "[Ljava/lang/Object;" -> value instanceof Object[];
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    private static Object newArray(int kind, int length) {
        if (length < 0 || length > MAX_ARRAY) throw new Refusal("array size");
        return switch (kind) {
            case T_INT -> new int[length]; case T_CHAR -> new char[length]; case T_BYTE, T_BOOLEAN -> new byte[length];
            case T_SHORT -> new short[length]; case T_LONG -> new long[length];
            default -> throw new Refusal("array kind " + kind);
        };
    }

    static int intValue(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof Integer i) return i;
        throw new Refusal("not an int: " + value);
    }
    private static long longValue(Object value) {
        if (value instanceof Long l) return l;
        throw new Refusal("not a long: " + value);
    }

    private static boolean branch(int op, List<Object> stack) {
        return switch (op) {
            case GOTO -> true;
            case IFEQ, IFNE, IFLT, IFGE, IFGT, IFLE -> {
                int v = intValue(stack.removeLast());
                yield switch (op) { case IFEQ -> v == 0; case IFNE -> v != 0; case IFLT -> v < 0; case IFGE -> v >= 0; case IFGT -> v > 0; default -> v <= 0; };
            }
            case IF_ICMPEQ, IF_ICMPNE, IF_ICMPLT, IF_ICMPGE, IF_ICMPGT, IF_ICMPLE -> {
                int b = intValue(stack.removeLast()), a = intValue(stack.removeLast());
                yield switch (op) { case IF_ICMPEQ -> a == b; case IF_ICMPNE -> a != b; case IF_ICMPLT -> a < b; case IF_ICMPGE -> a >= b; case IF_ICMPGT -> a > b; default -> a <= b; };
            }
            case IFNULL -> stack.removeLast() == null;
            case IFNONNULL -> stack.removeLast() != null;
            case IF_ACMPEQ, IF_ACMPNE -> { Object b = stack.removeLast(), a = stack.removeLast(); yield (a == b) == (op == IF_ACMPEQ); }
            default -> throw new Refusal("jump " + op);
        };
    }

    /** Zero-operand instructions: constants, arithmetic, conversions, arrays and the stack shuffles (wide values take two slots). */
    private static void simple(int op, List<Object> stack) {
        switch (op) {
            case NOP -> { }
            case ACONST_NULL -> stack.add(null);
            case ICONST_M1, ICONST_0, ICONST_1, ICONST_2, ICONST_3, ICONST_4, ICONST_5 -> stack.add(op - ICONST_0);
            case LCONST_0, LCONST_1 -> { stack.add((long) (op - LCONST_0)); stack.add(null); }
            case IADD, ISUB, IMUL, IDIV, IREM, ISHL, ISHR, IUSHR, IAND, IOR, IXOR -> {
                int b = intValue(stack.removeLast()), a = intValue(stack.removeLast());
                Integer r = Interpret.binaryInt(op, a, b);
                if (r == null) throw new Refusal("division by zero");
                stack.add(r);
            }
            case LADD, LSUB, LMUL, LAND, LOR, LXOR -> {
                stack.removeLast(); long b = longValue(stack.removeLast()); stack.removeLast(); long a = longValue(stack.removeLast());
                stack.add(switch (op) { case LADD -> a + b; case LSUB -> a - b; case LMUL -> a * b; case LAND -> a & b; case LOR -> a | b; default -> a ^ b; });
                stack.add(null);
            }
            case LSHL, LSHR, LUSHR -> {
                int s = intValue(stack.removeLast()); stack.removeLast(); long a = longValue(stack.removeLast());
                stack.add(switch (op) { case LSHL -> a << s; case LSHR -> a >> s; default -> a >>> s; }); stack.add(null);
            }
            case INEG -> stack.add(-intValue(stack.removeLast()));
            case I2B -> stack.add((int) (byte) intValue(stack.removeLast()));
            case I2C -> stack.add((int) (char) intValue(stack.removeLast()));
            case I2S -> stack.add((int) (short) intValue(stack.removeLast()));
            case I2L -> { stack.add((long) intValue(stack.removeLast())); stack.add(null); }
            case L2I -> { stack.removeLast(); stack.add((int) longValue(stack.removeLast())); }
            case ARRAYLENGTH -> stack.add(java.lang.reflect.Array.getLength(array(stack.removeLast())));
            case IALOAD, BALOAD, CALOAD, SALOAD, AALOAD -> {
                int i = intValue(stack.removeLast()); Object array = array(stack.removeLast());
                check(array, i);
                stack.add(switch (array) {
                    case int[] a -> a[i]; case byte[] a -> (int) a[i]; case char[] a -> (int) a[i]; case short[] a -> (int) a[i];
                    case Object[] a -> a[i];
                    default -> throw new Refusal("array load");
                });
            }
            case IASTORE, BASTORE, CASTORE, SASTORE, AASTORE -> {
                Object value = stack.removeLast(); int i = intValue(stack.removeLast()); Object array = array(stack.removeLast());
                check(array, i);
                switch (array) {
                    case int[] a -> a[i] = intValue(value); case byte[] a -> a[i] = (byte) intValue(value);
                    case char[] a -> a[i] = (char) intValue(value); case short[] a -> a[i] = (short) intValue(value);
                    case Object[] a -> {
                        if (value != null && !a.getClass().getComponentType().isInstance(value)) throw new Refusal("array store type");
                        a[i] = value;
                    }
                    default -> throw new Refusal("array store");
                }
            }
            case POP -> stack.removeLast();
            case POP2 -> { stack.removeLast(); stack.removeLast(); }
            case DUP -> stack.add(stack.getLast());
            case DUP_X1 -> { Object a = stack.removeLast(), b = stack.removeLast(); stack.add(a); stack.add(b); stack.add(a); }
            case DUP_X2 -> { Object a = stack.removeLast(), b = stack.removeLast(), c = stack.removeLast(); stack.add(a); stack.add(c); stack.add(b); stack.add(a); }
            case DUP2 -> { Object a = stack.get(stack.size() - 1), b = stack.get(stack.size() - 2); stack.add(b); stack.add(a); }
            case DUP2_X1 -> { Object a = stack.removeLast(), b = stack.removeLast(), c = stack.removeLast(); stack.add(b); stack.add(a); stack.add(c); stack.add(b); stack.add(a); }
            case DUP2_X2 -> {
                Object a = stack.removeLast(), b = stack.removeLast(), c = stack.removeLast(), d = stack.removeLast();
                stack.add(b); stack.add(a); stack.add(d); stack.add(c); stack.add(b); stack.add(a);
            }
            case SWAP -> { Object a = stack.removeLast(), b = stack.removeLast(); stack.add(a); stack.add(b); }
            default -> throw new Refusal("opcode " + op);
        }
    }

    private static Object array(Object value) {
        if (value == null || !value.getClass().isArray()) throw new Refusal("not an array");
        return value;
    }
    private static void check(Object array, int i) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= java.lang.reflect.Array.getLength(array)) throw new Refusal("index out of bounds");
    }
}

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/AidsParameters.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Handle;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CZ: Aidsfuscator's method salts. Its Method Salting appends an {@code int} to every method it can edit and gives
 * a whole override tree (super classes, interfaces and their implementations, joined) one salt; every call passes that
 * salt, as a literal or computed from the caller's own salt. Here:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>declarations are grouped by overriding inside the jar, and calls are resolved to their group (up the super
 *   classes and interfaces of the named owner);</li>
 *   <li>{@link #find}: a group whose calls all pass one and the same literal (once the callers are rewritten) gets that
 *   value as a known parameter of each declaration, so the rewriting folds what the body computes from it;</li>
 *   <li>{@link #remove}: once no declaration of a group reads the parameter, every declaration gets its descriptor back
 *   ({@link ParameterRecovery#rewriteDeclaration}) and every call drops its literal.</li>
 * </ul>
 * A group is left alone when a method handle names one of its methods, a call passes a computed value, a declaration
 * still reads the parameter or the shorter descriptor is taken.
 */
final class AidsParameters implements Opcodes {
    int groupsFound, methods, calls;
    /** Up to 20 groups left alone and why. */
    final List<String> kept = new ArrayList<>();
    private final Map<String,ClassNode> nodes;
    private final Set<String> skip;
    private final Map<String,MethodNode> declarations = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,String> owners = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,String> parent = new HashMap<>();
    private final Set<String> assigned = new HashSet<>();

    AidsParameters(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, Set<String> skip) {
        this.nodes = nodes; this.skip = skip;
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (skip.contains(node.name)) continue;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                String key = SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc);
                declarations.put(key, method); owners.put(key, node.name); parent.put(key, key);
            }
        }
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (skip.contains(node.name)) continue;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (!virtual(method)) continue;
                for (String ancestor : ancestors(node.name)) {
                    var declared = declared(ancestor, method.name, method.desc);
                    if (declared != null && virtual(declared)) union(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc), SkidModel.key(ancestor, method.name, method.desc));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static boolean virtual(MethodNode method) {
        return (method.access & (ACC_STATIC | ACC_PRIVATE)) == 0 && !method.name.startsWith("<");
    }

    private String root(String key) {
        String current = key;
        while (!parent.get(current).equals(current)) current = parent.get(current);
        parent.put(key, current);
        return current;
    }
    private void union(String a, String b) { String ra = root(a), rb = root(b); if (!ra.equals(rb)) parent.put(ra, rb); }

    private MethodNode declared(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        var node = nodes.get(owner);
        if (node == null || skip.contains(owner)) return null;
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(name) && method.desc.equals(desc)) return method;
        return null;
    }

    /** The jar's super classes and interfaces of a class, transitively (not the class itself). */
    private List<String> ancestors(String owner) {
        var result = new ArrayList<String>(); var seen = new HashSet<String>(); var pending = new ArrayDeque<String>();
        var start = nodes.get(owner);
        if (start == null) return result;
        if (start.superName != null) pending.add(start.superName);
        pending.addAll(start.interfaces);
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            String type = pending.poll();
            if (!seen.add(type)) continue;
            var node = nodes.get(type);
            if (node == null) continue;
            result.add(type);
            if (node.superName != null) pending.add(node.superName);
            pending.addAll(node.interfaces);
        }
        return result;
    }

    /** The declaration a call reaches: the named owner, then its super classes and interfaces in the jar; null for a library method. */
    private String resolve(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        if (declared(owner, name, desc) != null) return SkidModel.key(owner, name, desc);
        if (name.startsWith("<")) return null;
        for (String ancestor : ancestors(owner)) if (declared(ancestor, name, desc) != null) return SkidModel.key(ancestor, name, desc);
        return null;
    }

    private static boolean trailingInt(String desc) {
        var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(desc);
        return args.length > 0 && args[args.length - 1].getSort() == Type.INT;
    }

    static int lastSlot(MethodNode method) {
        int slot = (method.access & ACC_STATIC) != 0 ? 0 : 1;
        var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc);
        for (int k = 0; k < args.length - 1; k++) slot += args[k].getSize();
        return slot;
    }

    /** The literal pushed right before a call (no label in between), or null. */
    private static Integer literalArgument(MethodInsnNode call) {
        var push = SeedInterpreter.previous(call);
        Integer value = SkidModel.literal(push);
        if (value == null) return null;
        for (var node = push.getNext(); node != call; node = node.getNext()) if (node instanceof LabelNode) return null;
        return value;
    }

    /** Groups named by a method handle (a lambda or method reference), which cannot get a literal. */
    private Set<String> handleRoots() {
        var result = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    var handles = new ArrayList<Handle>();
                    if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) {
                        handles.add(indy.bsm);
                        for (Object arg : indy.bsmArgs) if (arg instanceof Handle h) handles.add(h);
                    } else if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof Handle h) handles.add(h);
                    for (var h : handles) {
                        String key = resolve(h.getOwner(), h.getName(), h.getDesc());
                        if (key != null) result.add(root(key));
                    }
                }
        return result;
    }

    /** Gives every qualifying group its salt as a known parameter; returns the number of declarations newly given one. */
    int find(Map<String,Map<Integer,int[]>> seedParameters) {
        var values = new HashMap<String,Set<Integer>>();
        var computed = new HashSet<String>(handleRoots());
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || !trailingInt(call.desc)) continue;
                    String key = resolve(call.owner, call.name, call.desc);
                    if (key == null) continue;
                    String root = root(key);
                    Integer literal = literalArgument(call);
                    if (literal == null) computed.add(root); else values.computeIfAbsent(root, k -> new TreeSet<>()).add(literal);
                }
        int added = 0;
        for (var entry : values.entrySet()) {
            if (computed.contains(entry.getKey()) || entry.getValue().size() != 1) continue;
            int value = entry.getValue().iterator().next();
            for (var declaration : declarations.entrySet()) {
                if (!root(declaration.getKey()).equals(entry.getKey()) || seedParameters.containsKey(declaration.getKey())) continue;
                var method = declaration.getValue();
                if (!trailingInt(method.desc)) continue;
                int slot = lastSlot(method);
                if (writes(method, slot)) continue;
                seedParameters.put(declaration.getKey(), Map.of(slot, new int[] {value}));
                added++;
            }
            if (assigned.add(entry.getKey())) groupsFound++;
        }
        return added;
    }

    private static boolean writes(MethodNode method, int slot) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var == slot && var.getOpcode() != ILOAD) return true;
            if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == slot) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean reads(MethodNode method, int slot) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var == slot) return true;
            if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == slot) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private void keep(String what) { if (kept.size() < 20) kept.add(what); }

    /**
     * Removes the salt parameter of every group whose declarations no longer read it. A group nothing in the jar calls
     * (or names by a handle) qualifies too when a searched key showed one of its declarations' trailing int to be the
     * salt ({@code confirmed}): then the parameter is never the program's own.
     */
    void remove(Map<String,Map<Integer,int[]>> seedParameters, Set<String> changed, Set<MethodNode> confirmed) {
        var handles = handleRoots();
        var groups = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<String>>();
        for (String key : declarations.keySet()) groups.computeIfAbsent(root(key), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(key);
        // Calls are resolved before any descriptor changes (the keys are the original descriptors).
        var callRoots = new IdentityHashMap<MethodInsnNode,String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && trailingInt(call.desc)) {
                        String key = resolve(call.owner, call.name, call.desc);
                        if (key != null) callRoots.put(call, root(key));
                    }
        for (var group : groups.values()) {
            String first = group.getFirst();
            String groupRoot = root(first);
            boolean uncalled = !callRoots.containsValue(groupRoot) && !handles.contains(groupRoot)
                && group.stream().allMatch(key -> trailingInt(declarations.get(key).desc))
                && group.stream().anyMatch(key -> confirmed.contains(declarations.get(key)))
                && group.stream().allMatch(key -> declarations.get(key).instructions.size() == 0 || confirmed.contains(declarations.get(key)));
            if (!uncalled) {
                if (group.stream().noneMatch(seedParameters::containsKey)) continue;
                if (!group.stream().allMatch(seedParameters::containsKey)) { keep(first + ": not every declaration has the salt"); continue; }
            }
            if (group.stream().anyMatch(key -> reads(declarations.get(key), lastSlot(declarations.get(key))))) { keep(first + ": the salt is still read"); continue; }
            var sites = new ArrayList<MethodInsnNode>();
            var siteMethods = new IdentityHashMap<MethodInsnNode,MethodNode>();
            var siteOwners = new IdentityHashMap<MethodInsnNode,String>();
            String root = root(first);
            boolean literalOnly = true;
            for (var node : nodes.values())
                for (var method : node.methods)
                    for (var insn : method.instructions)
                        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && root.equals(callRoots.get(call))) {
                            if (literalArgument(call) == null) literalOnly = false;
                            sites.add(call); siteMethods.put(call, method); siteOwners.put(call, node.name);
                        }
            if (!literalOnly) { keep(first + ": a call passes a computed value"); continue; }
            if (group.stream().anyMatch(key -> taken(key, group))) { keep(first + ": the shorter descriptor is taken"); continue; }
            for (String key : group) {
                var method = declarations.get(key);
                ParameterRecovery.rewriteDeclaration(method, lastSlot(method));
                method.desc = ParameterRecovery.dropLastInt(method.desc);
                if (method.signature != null && parameterCount(method.signature) > Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc).length)
                    method.signature = dropLastInt(method.signature);
                changed.add(owners.get(key));
                methods++;
            }
            for (var call : sites) {
                siteMethods.get(call).instructions.remove(SeedInterpreter.previous(call));
                call.desc = ParameterRecovery.dropLastInt(call.desc);
                changed.add(siteOwners.get(call));
                calls++;
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * A generic signature without its trailing {@code I} parameter (Aidsfuscator appends the salt to the signature too);
     * unchanged when it has none, null for null. A class name ending in I ends in {@code ;} and an int array in {@code [I}.
     */
    static String dropLastInt(String signature) {
        if (signature == null) return null;
        int close = signature.indexOf(')');
        if (close < 2 || signature.charAt(close - 1) != 'I' || signature.charAt(close - 2) == '[') return signature;
        return signature.substring(0, close - 1) + signature.substring(close);
    }

    /** The number of parameters of a method signature (type parameters and generic arguments skipped). */
    static int parameterCount(String signature) {
        int at = signature.indexOf('(') + 1, count = 0;
        while (at < signature.length() && signature.charAt(at) != ')') {
            while (signature.charAt(at) == '[') at++;
            char c = signature.charAt(at);
            if (c == 'L' || c == 'T') {
                int depth = 0;
                for (; at < signature.length(); at++) {
                    char d = signature.charAt(at);
                    if (d == '<') depth++;
                    else if (d == '>') depth--;
                    else if (d == ';' && depth == 0) break;
                }
            }
            at++; count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    /** True when the declaration's class, or a jar class above or below it, already has the shorter descriptor outside the group. */
    private boolean taken(String key, List<String> group) {
        var method = declarations.get(key);
        String owner = owners.get(key);
        String shorter = ParameterRecovery.dropLastInt(method.desc);
        var related = new ArrayList<String>(List.of(owner));
        if (virtual(method)) {
            related.addAll(ancestors(owner));
            for (var node : nodes.values()) if (ancestors(node.name).contains(owner)) related.add(node.name);
        }
        for (String type : related) {
            var other = declared(type, method.name, shorter);
            if (other != null && !group.contains(SkidModel.key(type, method.name, shorter))) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/AidsReferences.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CZ: Aidsfuscator's Reference Obfuscation. Each method call ({@code invokestatic}, {@code invokevirtual},
 * {@code invokeinterface}) and field access became {@code <int index>; <int key>; invokedynamic "<kind char>"} with the
 * bootstrap of a generated class. That class holds the references as {@code "owner:name:desc"} strings whose chars are
 * XORed with the key's upper 16 bits, at {@code index ^ indexKey}; its main invoker maps the kind char (a lookupswitch)
 * to {@code findVirtual}, {@code findStatic}, {@code findGetter}, {@code findSetter}, {@code findStaticGetter} or
 * {@code findStaticSetter}. Once both ints are literals (the key is salted: it becomes one when the caller's salt is
 * known), the original instruction is written back. Whether a virtual call was {@code invokeinterface} comes from the
 * owner's class header (the jar's, or the JDK's read as a resource, never loaded).
 */
final class AidsReferences implements Opcodes {
    /** {@code searched}: decoded with a key found by search (the caller's salt unknown). */
    int decoded, searched;
    private final String owner, bootstrapName, bootstrapDesc;
    private final Map<Integer,String> references = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<Integer,String> kinds = new HashMap<>();
    private Integer indexKey;
    private final Map<String,ClassNode> nodes;
    private final Map<String,Boolean> interfaces = new HashMap<>();

    AidsReferences(ClassNode reference, Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        this.owner = reference.name; this.nodes = nodes;
        String name = null, desc = null;
        for (var method : reference.methods) {
            if (method.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup;Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodType;)Ljava/lang/invoke/CallSite;")) {
                name = method.name; desc = method.desc;
            }
            if (method.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup;Ljava/lang/invoke/MutableCallSite;Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodType;II)Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandle;"))
                readInvoker(method);
            // <the array>; <int j>; ldc "<token>"; aastore (Aidsfuscator keeps the array on the stack with dup)
            if ((method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0) continue;
            for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                if (insn.getOpcode() != AASTORE) continue;
                var value = SeedInterpreter.previous(insn);
                Integer at = SkidModel.literal(SeedInterpreter.previous(value));
                if (value instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String token && at != null) references.put(at, token);
            }
        }
        bootstrapName = name; bootstrapDesc = desc;
    }

    boolean usable() { return bootstrapName != null && indexKey != null && !references.isEmpty() && kinds.size() >= 2; }

    /** The index key ({@code iload 4; <int>; ixor}) and the kind char of each lookupswitch case. */
    private void readInvoker(MethodNode method) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn.getOpcode() == IXOR && indexKey == null) {
                var right = SeedInterpreter.previous(insn); var left = SeedInterpreter.previous(right);
                if (left instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.getOpcode() == ILOAD && var.var == 4 && SkidModel.literal(right) != null) indexKey = SkidModel.literal(right);
                else if (right instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.getOpcode() == ILOAD && var.var == 4 && SkidModel.literal(left) != null) indexKey = SkidModel.literal(left);
            }
            if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup)
                for (int k = 0; k < lookup.keys.size(); k++) {
                    String kind = kind(lookup.keys.get(k), lookup.labels.get(k));
                    if (kind != null) kinds.put(lookup.keys.get(k), kind);
                }
        }
    }

    /** The {@code find*} a case reaches; a field case tests the char again to pick the getter or the setter. */
    private static String kind(int key, LabelNode label) {
        for (var node = SeedInterpreter.next(label); node != null; node = SeedInterpreter.next(node)) {
            if (node instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals("java/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup") && call.name.startsWith("find")) return call.name;
            if (node instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && jump.getOpcode() == IF_ICMPEQ) {
                Integer getter = SkidModel.literal(SeedInterpreter.previous(jump));
                if (getter == null) return null;
                return key == getter ? find(SeedInterpreter.next(jump.label)) : find(SeedInterpreter.next(jump));
            }
            if (node instanceof JumpInsnNode || node.getOpcode() >= IRETURN && node.getOpcode() <= RETURN || node.getOpcode() == ATHROW) return null;
        }
        return null;
    }
    private static String find(AbstractInsnNode from) {
        for (var node = from; node != null; node = SeedInterpreter.next(node)) {
            if (node instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals("java/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup") && call.name.startsWith("find")) return call.name;
            if (node instanceof JumpInsnNode) return null;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Writes back every reference of the method whose index and key are literals, and with {@code search} also those
     * whose key is salted with a salt no call reveals; returns the number decoded.
     */
    int decode(MethodNode method, boolean search) {
        int count = 0;
        for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if (!(insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) || !indy.bsm.getOwner().equals(owner) || !indy.bsm.getName().equals(bootstrapName)
                || !indy.bsm.getDesc().equals(bootstrapDesc) || indy.name.length() != 1) continue;
            var keyPush = SeedInterpreter.previous(indy);
            Integer key = SkidModel.literal(keyPush);
            // A key salted with an unknown salt: iload s; <mask>; iand|ior; <c>; ixor (only its upper 16 bits matter).
            List<AbstractInsnNode> keyCode = key != null ? List.of(keyPush) : search ? saltedKey(keyPush) : null;
            if (keyCode == null) continue;
            var indexPush = SeedInterpreter.previous(keyCode.getFirst());
            Integer index = SkidModel.literal(indexPush);
            if (index == null || label(indexPush, indy)) continue;
            String token = references.get(index ^ indexKey);
            String kind = kinds.get((int) indy.name.charAt(0));
            if (token == null || kind == null) continue;
            int upper = key != null ? key >>> 16 : search(token, keyCode, kind);
            if (upper < 0) continue;
            String[] parts = split(token, upper);
            if (parts == null) continue;
            if (key == null) { searched++; deduce(method, keyCode, upper); }
            String target = parts[0].replace('.', '/'), name = parts[1], desc = parts[2];
            AbstractInsnNode replacement = switch (kind) {
                case "findStatic" -> new MethodInsnNode(INVOKESTATIC, target, name, desc, isInterface(target));
                case "findVirtual" -> {
                    Boolean itf = isInterface(target);
                    yield itf == null ? null : new MethodInsnNode(itf ? INVOKEINTERFACE : INVOKEVIRTUAL, target, name, desc, itf);
                }
                case "findGetter" -> new FieldInsnNode(GETFIELD, target, name, Type.getReturnType(desc).getDescriptor());
                case "findSetter" -> new FieldInsnNode(PUTFIELD, target, name, Type.getReturnType(desc).getDescriptor());
                case "findStaticGetter" -> new FieldInsnNode(GETSTATIC, target, name, Type.getReturnType(desc).getDescriptor());
                case "findStaticSetter" -> new FieldInsnNode(PUTSTATIC, target, name, Type.getReturnType(desc).getDescriptor());
                default -> null;
            };
            if (replacement instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC && isInterface(target) == null) replacement = null;
            if (replacement == null) continue;
            method.instructions.remove(indexPush);
            for (var node : keyCode) method.instructions.remove(node);
            method.instructions.set(indy, replacement);
            count++;
        }
        decoded += count;
        return count;
    }

    private static String[] split(String token, int key) {
        var chars = token.toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) chars[i] = (char) (chars[i] ^ key);
        var parts = new String(chars).split(":", -1);
        return parts.length == 3 ? parts : null;
    }

    /** The five instructions {@code iload s; <mask>; iand|ior; <c>; ixor} ending at {@code xor}, or null. */
    private static List<AbstractInsnNode> saltedKey(AbstractInsnNode xor) {
        if (xor == null || xor.getOpcode() != IXOR) return null;
        var c = SeedInterpreter.previous(xor); var op = SeedInterpreter.previous(c);
        var mask = SeedInterpreter.previous(op); var load = SeedInterpreter.previous(mask);
        if (SkidModel.literal(c) == null || op == null || op.getOpcode() != IAND && op.getOpcode() != IOR || SkidModel.literal(mask) == null
            || !(load instanceof VarInsnNode var) || var.getOpcode() != ILOAD || label(load, xor)) return null;
        return List.of(load, mask, op, c, xor);
    }

    /**
     * The one reference the token decodes to over every upper half the salted key can take: with {@code ior} the mask's
     * bits are 1, with {@code iand} the bits outside it are 0, the other bits are free (at most 2^16 keys). A key is
     * accepted when the reference is well formed and its owner (the jar's or the JDK's) declares the member; null when
     * no key or more than one key passes.
     */
    private int search(String token, List<AbstractInsnNode> keyCode, String kind) {
        int mask = SkidModel.literal(keyCode.get(1)) >>> 16, c = SkidModel.literal(keyCode.get(3)) >>> 16;
        boolean or = keyCode.get(2).getOpcode() == IOR;
        int free = (or ? ~mask : mask) & 0xFFFF, fixed = or ? mask : 0;
        int found = -1;
        // Every subset of the free bits.
        for (int bits = free; ; bits = (bits - 1) & free) {
            int upper = ((fixed | bits) ^ c) & 0xFFFF;
            var parts = split(token, upper);
            if (parts != null && valid(parts, kind)) {
                if (found >= 0) return -1;
                found = upper;
            }
            if (bits == 0) break;
        }
        return found;
    }

    /**
     * What a searched key tells about the salt: a salted key is {@code decKey << 16} with its low half zero, so
     * {@code salt | mask} (with {@code ior}) or {@code salt & mask} (with {@code iand}) is {@code (decKey << 16) ^ c}.
     * Keyed by {@code slot:mask:opcode}; a value seen twice differently is dropped.
     */
    final Map<MethodNode,Map<String,Integer>> deduced = new IdentityHashMap<>();
    private final Set<String> conflicting = new HashSet<>();
    private void deduce(MethodNode method, List<AbstractInsnNode> keyCode, int upper) {
        int slot = ((VarInsnNode) keyCode.get(0)).var, mask = SkidModel.literal(keyCode.get(1)), c = SkidModel.literal(keyCode.get(3));
        String key = slot + ":" + mask + ":" + keyCode.get(2).getOpcode();
        int value = (upper << 16) ^ c;
        var values = deduced.computeIfAbsent(method, m -> new HashMap<>());
        Integer previous = values.putIfAbsent(key, value);
        if (previous != null && previous != value) conflicting.add(System.identityHashCode(method) + "|" + key);
        if (slot == AidsParameters.lastSlot(method) && method.desc.contains("I)")) confirmed.add(method);
    }

    /** Methods whose trailing int a searched key showed to be Aidsfuscator's salt. */
    final Set<MethodNode> confirmed = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());

    /**
     * Writes each deduced {@code iload slot; <mask>; ior|iand} of the method as the constant (the slot must never be
     * stored: a salt parameter or salt local); returns the number of places rewritten.
     */
    int applyDeduced(MethodNode method) {
        // Kept for later rounds: more such expressions appear as the method folds (a mask hidden by the flattening key).
        var values = deduced.get(method);
        if (values == null) return 0;
        int count = 0;
        for (var entry : values.entrySet()) {
            if (conflicting.contains(System.identityHashCode(method) + "|" + entry.getKey())) continue;
            var parts = entry.getKey().split(":");
            int slot = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]), mask = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]), op = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
            boolean stored = false;
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var == slot && var.getOpcode() != ILOAD || insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == slot) stored = true;
            if (stored) continue;
            for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
                if (!(insn instanceof VarInsnNode load) || load.getOpcode() != ILOAD || load.var != slot) continue;
                var push = SeedInterpreter.next(load); var combine = SeedInterpreter.next(push);
                Integer literal = SkidModel.literal(push);
                if (literal == null || literal != mask || combine == null || combine.getOpcode() != op || label(load, combine)) continue;
                method.instructions.insertBefore(load, new LdcInsnNode(entry.getValue()));
                method.instructions.remove(load); method.instructions.remove(push); method.instructions.remove(combine);
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    private boolean valid(String[] parts, String kind) {
        if (!parts[0].matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*(\\.[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*)*")) return false;
        if (!parts[1].matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*|<init>")) return false;
        try { Type.getMethodType(parts[2]).getArgumentTypes(); } catch (RuntimeException malformed) { return false; }
        if (!parts[2].matches("\\(([ZBCSIJFD]|\\[+([ZBCSIJFD]|L[^;()]+;)|L[^;()]+;)*\\)(V|[ZBCSIJFD]|\\[+([ZBCSIJFD]|L[^;()]+;)|L[^;()]+;)")) return false;
        boolean field = !kind.equals("findStatic") && !kind.equals("findVirtual");
        if (field && !parts[2].startsWith("()")) return false;
        return declares(parts[0].replace('.', '/'), parts[1], field ? Type.getReturnType(parts[2]).getDescriptor() : parts[2], field, new HashSet<>());
    }

    /** Whether the class or one of its super types (the jar's, or the JDK's class files read as resources) declares the member. */
    private boolean declares(String type, String name, String desc, boolean field, Set<String> seen) {
        if (type == null || !seen.add(type)) return false;
        var node = header(type);
        if (node == null) return false;
        if (field) { for (var f : node.fields) if (f.name.equals(name) && f.desc.equals(desc)) return true; }
        else for (var m : node.methods) if (m.name.equals(name) && m.desc.equals(desc)) return true;
        if (declares(node.superName, name, desc, field, seen)) return true;
        for (String itf : node.interfaces) if (declares(itf, name, desc, field, seen)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private final Map<String,Optional<ClassNode>> headers = new HashMap<>();
    private ClassNode header(String type) {
        return headers.computeIfAbsent(type, t -> {
            var node = nodes.get(t);
            if (node != null) return Optional.of(node);
            try (var in = ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(t + ".class")) {
                if (in == null) return Optional.empty();
                var read = new ClassNode();
                new ClassReader(in.readAllBytes()).accept(read, ClassReader.SKIP_CODE | ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
                return Optional.of(read);
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) { return Optional.empty(); }
        }).orElse(null);
    }

    private static boolean label(AbstractInsnNode from, AbstractInsnNode to) {
        for (var node = from.getNext(); node != to; node = node.getNext()) if (node instanceof LabelNode) return true;
        return false;
    }

    /** Whether a class is an interface: the jar's header, else the JDK's class file read as a resource; null when unknown. */
    private Boolean isInterface(String type) {
        return interfaces.computeIfAbsent(type, t -> {
            var node = nodes.get(t);
            if (node != null) return (node.access & ACC_INTERFACE) != 0;
            try (var in = ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(t + ".class")) {
                if (in == null) return null;
                return (new ClassReader(in.readAllBytes()).getAccess() & ACC_INTERFACE) != 0;
            } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) { return null; }
        });
    }
}
```
