`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/Interpret.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import java.util.Deque;

/** Phase 2CN: Java semantics of the primitive instructions, shared by the evaluator and the abstract interpreter. */
final class Interpret implements Opcodes {
    static final Object REFUSED = new Object();
    private Interpret() {}

    static boolean compare(int op, int a, int b) {
        return switch (op) {
            case IFEQ, IF_ICMPEQ -> a == b; case IFNE, IF_ICMPNE -> a != b;
            case IFLT, IF_ICMPLT -> a < b; case IFGE, IF_ICMPGE -> a >= b;
            case IFGT, IF_ICMPGT -> a > b; case IFLE, IF_ICMPLE -> a <= b;
            default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("not an int comparison: " + op);
        };
    }

    /** Int binary arithmetic; null when the instruction would throw (division by zero). */
    static Integer binaryInt(int op, int a, int b) {
        return switch (op) {
            case IADD -> a + b; case ISUB -> a - b; case IMUL -> a * b;
            case IDIV -> b == 0 ? null : a / b; case IREM -> b == 0 ? null : a % b;
            case ISHL -> a << b; case ISHR -> a >> b; case IUSHR -> a >>> b;
            case IAND -> a & b; case IOR -> a | b; case IXOR -> a ^ b;
            default -> null;
        };
    }

    static Integer unaryInt(int op, int v) {
        return switch (op) {
            case INEG -> -v; case I2B -> (int) (byte) v; case I2C -> (int) (char) v; case I2S -> (int) (short) v;
            default -> null;
        };
    }

    private static boolean wide(Object value) { return value instanceof Long || value instanceof Double; }

    /** Executes one zero-operand instruction on a value stack (long/double are one entry); REFUSED when unsupported. */
    static Object plain(int op, Deque<Object> stack) {
        switch (op) {
            case NOP -> { return null; }
            case ICONST_M1, ICONST_0, ICONST_1, ICONST_2, ICONST_3, ICONST_4, ICONST_5 -> stack.push(op - ICONST_0);
            case LCONST_0, LCONST_1 -> stack.push((long) (op - LCONST_0));
            case FCONST_0, FCONST_1, FCONST_2 -> stack.push((float) (op - FCONST_0));
            case DCONST_0, DCONST_1 -> stack.push((double) (op - DCONST_0));
            case POP -> stack.pop();
            case POP2 -> { Object top = stack.pop(); if (!wide(top)) stack.pop(); }
            case DUP -> stack.push(stack.peek());
            case DUP_X1 -> { Object a = stack.pop(), b = stack.pop(); stack.push(a); stack.push(b); stack.push(a); }
            case DUP_X2 -> {
                Object a = stack.pop(), b = stack.pop();
                if (wide(b)) { stack.push(a); stack.push(b); stack.push(a); }
                else { Object c = stack.pop(); stack.push(a); stack.push(c); stack.push(b); stack.push(a); }
            }
            case DUP2 -> {
                Object a = stack.pop();
                if (wide(a)) { stack.push(a); stack.push(a); }
                else { Object b = stack.pop(); stack.push(b); stack.push(a); stack.push(b); stack.push(a); }
            }
            case SWAP -> { Object a = stack.pop(), b = stack.pop(); stack.push(a); stack.push(b); }
            case IADD, ISUB, IMUL, IDIV, IREM, ISHL, ISHR, IUSHR, IAND, IOR, IXOR -> {
                int b = (Integer) stack.pop(), a = (Integer) stack.pop();
                Integer r = binaryInt(op, a, b);
                if (r == null) throw new ArithmeticException();
                stack.push(r);
            }
            case LADD, LSUB, LMUL, LDIV, LREM, LAND, LOR, LXOR -> {
                long b = (Long) stack.pop(), a = (Long) stack.pop();
                stack.push(switch (op) {
                    case LADD -> a + b; case LSUB -> a - b; case LMUL -> a * b; case LDIV -> a / b; case LREM -> a % b;
                    case LAND -> a & b; case LOR -> a | b; default -> a ^ b; });
            }
            case LSHL, LSHR, LUSHR -> {
                int b = (Integer) stack.pop(); long a = (Long) stack.pop();
                stack.push(op == LSHL ? a << b : op == LSHR ? a >> b : a >>> b);
            }
            case FADD, FSUB, FMUL, FDIV, FREM -> {
                float b = (Float) stack.pop(), a = (Float) stack.pop();
                stack.push(switch (op) { case FADD -> a + b; case FSUB -> a - b; case FMUL -> a * b; case FDIV -> a / b; default -> a % b; });
            }
            case DADD, DSUB, DMUL, DDIV, DREM -> {
                double b = (Double) stack.pop(), a = (Double) stack.pop();
                stack.push(switch (op) { case DADD -> a + b; case DSUB -> a - b; case DMUL -> a * b; case DDIV -> a / b; default -> a % b; });
            }
            case INEG, I2B, I2C, I2S -> stack.push(unaryInt(op, (Integer) stack.pop()));
            case LNEG -> stack.push(-(Long) stack.pop());
            case FNEG -> stack.push(-(Float) stack.pop());
            case DNEG -> stack.push(-(Double) stack.pop());
            case I2L -> stack.push((long) (Integer) stack.pop());
            case I2F -> stack.push((float) (Integer) stack.pop());
            case I2D -> stack.push((double) (Integer) stack.pop());
            case L2I -> stack.push((int) (long) (Long) stack.pop());
            case L2F -> stack.push((float) (Long) stack.pop());
            case L2D -> stack.push((double) (Long) stack.pop());
            case F2I -> stack.push((int) (float) (Float) stack.pop());
            case F2L -> stack.push((long) (float) (Float) stack.pop());
            case F2D -> stack.push((double) (Float) stack.pop());
            case D2I -> stack.push((int) (double) (Double) stack.pop());
            case D2L -> stack.push((long) (double) (Double) stack.pop());
            case D2F -> stack.push((float) (double) (Double) stack.pop());
            case LCMP -> { long b = (Long) stack.pop(), a = (Long) stack.pop(); stack.push(Long.compare(a, b)); }
            case FCMPL, FCMPG -> {
                float b = (Float) stack.pop(), a = (Float) stack.pop();
                stack.push(Float.isNaN(a) || Float.isNaN(b) ? (op == FCMPG ? 1 : -1) : a > b ? 1 : a == b ? 0 : -1);
            }
            case DCMPL, DCMPG -> {
                double b = (Double) stack.pop(), a = (Double) stack.pop();
                stack.push(Double.isNaN(a) || Double.isNaN(b) ? (op == DCMPG ? 1 : -1) : a > b ? 1 : a == b ? 0 : -1);
            }
            default -> { return REFUSED; }
        }
        return null;
    }
}

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/MapleCleanup.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CS: undoes the shapes Skidfuscator's MapleIR back end leaves in every method it touched (it lowers code to SSA
 * and back), so the bytecode reads like javac's again and the decompilers rebuild ordinary expressions:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>stack spills</b>: a local stored once and loaded once, later in the same straight-line code, with everything
 *   in between balanced on the stack, becomes the stack value it was ({@code istore 6; iload 6} disappears). Pure pushes
 *   in between (loads of other locals, constants) are hoisted in front of the stored expression first, which restores
 *   javac's evaluation order ({@code a.get(); istore 7; iload 2; iload 7; iadd} becomes {@code iload 2; a.get(); iadd});</li>
 *   <li><b>constructions</b>: {@code new T; astore y; aload y; <args>; invokespecial T.<init>} becomes
 *   {@code new T; dup; <args>; invokespecial T.<init>; astore y};</li>
 *   <li><b>dead stores</b>: a store to a local that is never loaded (and has no debug name) becomes {@code pop};</li>
 *   <li><b>comparisons with zero</b>: {@code iconst_0; if_icmpXX} becomes {@code ifXX} (javac's form).</li>
 * </ul>
 * Every rewrite keeps the order of side effects; only loads of locals and constants move.
 */
final class MapleCleanup implements Opcodes {
    int spills, constructions, deadStores, comparisons;

    boolean apply(String owner, MethodNode method) {
        boolean any = false;
        for (int round = 0; round < 32; round++) {
            boolean changed = comparisons(method) | constructions(method) | spills(owner, method) | deadStores(method);
            if (!changed) break;
            any = true;
        }
        return any;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- comparisons with zero

    private boolean comparisons(MethodNode method) {
        boolean changed = false;
        for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if (!(insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) || jump.getOpcode() < IF_ICMPEQ || jump.getOpcode() > IF_ICMPLE) continue;
            var zero = previous(insn);
            if (zero == null || zero.getOpcode() != ICONST_0 || labelBetween(zero, insn)) continue;
            method.instructions.remove(zero);
            method.instructions.set(jump, new JumpInsnNode(jump.getOpcode() - IF_ICMPEQ + IFEQ, jump.label));
            comparisons++; changed = true;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- constructions

    private boolean constructions(MethodNode method) {
        boolean changed = false;
        for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if (!(insn instanceof TypeInsnNode alloc) || alloc.getOpcode() != NEW) continue;
            if (!(next(alloc) instanceof VarInsnNode store) || store.getOpcode() != ASTORE || labelBetween(alloc, store)) continue;
            if (!(next(store) instanceof VarInsnNode load) || load.getOpcode() != ALOAD || load.var != store.var || labelBetween(store, load)) continue;
            // The matching constructor call: the first invokespecial T.<init> after the load whose receiver is that load.
            MethodInsnNode init = null;
            int depth = 0; // values pushed above the receiver
            for (var at = next(load); at != null; at = next(at)) {
                if (labelBetween(previous(at), at)) break;
                if (at instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.var == store.var) break;
                if (at instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.getOpcode() == INVOKESPECIAL && call.name.equals("<init>")
                    && call.owner.equals(alloc.desc) && argumentSlots(call.desc) == depth) { init = call; break; }
                int delta = stackDelta(at);
                if (delta == Integer.MIN_VALUE) break;
                depth += delta;
                if (depth < 0) break;
            }
            if (init == null) continue;
            method.instructions.set(store, new InsnNode(DUP));
            method.instructions.remove(load);
            method.instructions.insert(init, new VarInsnNode(ASTORE, store.var));
            constructions++; changed = true;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- stack spills

    private boolean spills(String owner, MethodNode method) {
        Frame<BasicValue>[] frames;
        try { frames = new Analyzer<>(new BasicInterpreter()).analyze(owner, method); }
        catch (AnalyzerException error) { return false; }
        var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        var uses = new HashMap<Integer,List<AbstractInsnNode>>();
        for (var insn : insns) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.getOpcode() != RET) uses.computeIfAbsent(v.var, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(insn);
            if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc) uses.computeIfAbsent(inc.var, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(insn);
        }
        var named = debugNamed(method);
        int parameters = parameterSlots(method);
        for (var entry : uses.entrySet()) {
            int var = entry.getKey();
            var list = entry.getValue();
            if (var < parameters || named.contains(var) || list.size() != 2) continue;
            if (!(list.get(0) instanceof VarInsnNode store) || store.getOpcode() < ISTORE || store.getOpcode() > ASTORE) continue;
            if (!(list.get(1) instanceof VarInsnNode load) || load.getOpcode() != store.getOpcode() - ISTORE + ILOAD) continue;
            int s = index.get(store), l = index.get(load);
            if (s >= l || frames[s] == null || frames[l] == null) continue;
            // Straight-line code between them (no label: nothing jumps in, no handler starts).
            boolean straight = true;
            for (int i = s + 1; i < l; i++) {
                if (insns[i] instanceof LabelNode || insns[i] instanceof JumpInsnNode || insns[i] instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode
                    || insns[i] instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode || insns[i].getOpcode() == ATHROW || insns[i].getOpcode() >= IRETURN && insns[i].getOpcode() <= RETURN) { straight = false; break; }
            }
            if (!straight || coveredDifferently(method, insns, s, l)) continue;
            // A lambda or method reference must keep its variable when it is the receiver of a call: Java has no
            // (x -> ...).apply(...) expression.
            if (previous(store) instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode && lambdaReceiver(insns, frames, l)) continue;
            int base = frames[s].getStackSize() - 1; // stack entries below the stored value
            // Pure pushes right before the load, stacked above `base`: hoist them in front of the stored expression.
            var hoist = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
            int k = l - 1;
            while (k > s && pushOnly(insns[k]) && !writtenBetween(insns, s, l, insns[k])) { hoist.addFirst(insns[k]); k--; }
            // Everything between the store and the hoisted pushes must be balanced and never consume an entry at or below
            // `base` (the stored value will sit there).
            boolean balanced = frames[k + 1] != null && frames[k + 1].getStackSize() == base;
            for (int i = s + 1; balanced && i <= k; i++) {
                if (insns[i].getOpcode() < 0) continue;
                int pops = pops(insns[i]);
                if (frames[i] == null || pops < 0 || frames[i].getStackSize() - pops < base) balanced = false;
            }
            if (!balanced) continue;
            if (!hoist.isEmpty()) {
                // Where the stored expression starts: the first instruction (going back, straight-line) with `base` entries.
                int start = s;
                while (start > 0 && frames[start] != null && frames[start].getStackSize() > base && !(insns[start - 1] instanceof LabelNode)
                    && !(insns[start - 1] instanceof JumpInsnNode)) start--;
                if (frames[start] == null || frames[start].getStackSize() != base) continue;
                boolean safe = true;
                for (var push : hoist) if (writtenBetween(insns, start, s + 1, push)) safe = false;
                if (!safe) continue;
                var anchor = insns[start];
                for (var push : hoist) { method.instructions.remove(push); method.instructions.insertBefore(anchor, push); }
            }
            method.instructions.remove(store);
            method.instructions.remove(load);
            spills++;
            return true; // frames are stale: one rewrite per analysis
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** True when the value the load at {@code l} pushes is consumed as the receiver of a call. */
    private static boolean lambdaReceiver(AbstractInsnNode[] insns, Frame<BasicValue>[] frames, int l) {
        if (frames[l] == null) return true;
        int position = frames[l].getStackSize(); // index of the loaded value
        for (int j = l + 1; j < insns.length; j++) {
            if (insns[j].getOpcode() < 0) continue;
            if (frames[j] == null) return true;
            int pops = pops(insns[j]);
            if (pops < 0) return true;
            if (frames[j].getStackSize() - pops <= position)
                return insns[j] instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC && frames[j].getStackSize() - pops == position;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** True when some try range covers part, but not all, of the instructions from s to l (moving values would cross it). */
    private static boolean coveredDifferently(MethodNode method, AbstractInsnNode[] insns, int s, int l) {
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
            int start = method.instructions.indexOf(block.start), end = method.instructions.indexOf(block.end);
            boolean a = s >= start && s < end, b = l >= start && l < end;
            if (a != b) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean pushOnly(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        return op >= ACONST_NULL && op <= ALOAD;
    }

    /** True when the local a push loads is stored somewhere in [from, to). */
    private static boolean writtenBetween(AbstractInsnNode[] insns, int from, int to, AbstractInsnNode push) {
        if (!(push instanceof VarInsnNode load)) return false;
        for (int i = from; i < to; i++) {
            if (insns[i] instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.var == load.var && v.getOpcode() >= ISTORE && v.getOpcode() <= ASTORE) return true;
            if (insns[i] instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == load.var) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dead stores

    private boolean deadStores(MethodNode method) {
        var loaded = new HashSet<Integer>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.getOpcode() >= ILOAD && v.getOpcode() <= ALOAD) loaded.add(v.var);
            if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc) loaded.add(inc.var);
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.getOpcode() == RET) loaded.add(v.var);
        }
        var named = debugNamed(method);
        int parameters = parameterSlots(method);
        boolean changed = false;
        for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if (!(insn instanceof VarInsnNode store) || store.getOpcode() < ISTORE || store.getOpcode() > ASTORE) continue;
            if (loaded.contains(store.var) || named.contains(store.var) || store.var < parameters) continue;
            // A handler's stored exception stays (javac always stores it, even unused).
            var before = previous(insn);
            if (store.getOpcode() == ASTORE && (before == null || isHandlerStart(method, insn))) continue;
            boolean wide = store.getOpcode() == LSTORE || store.getOpcode() == DSTORE;
            method.instructions.set(store, new InsnNode(wide ? POP2 : POP));
            deadStores++; changed = true;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    private static boolean isHandlerStart(MethodNode method, AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
            AbstractInsnNode first = block.handler;
            while (first != null && first.getOpcode() < 0) first = first.getNext();
            if (first == insn) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- helpers

    private static Set<Integer> debugNamed(MethodNode method) {
        var named = new HashSet<Integer>();
        if (method.localVariables != null) for (var local : method.localVariables) named.add(local.index);
        return named;
    }

    private static int parameterSlots(MethodNode method) {
        int slots = (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        for (var type : Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc)) slots += type.getSize();
        return slots;
    }

    private static int argumentSlots(String desc) { return Type.getArgumentTypes(desc).length; }

    /** Net stack entries an instruction pushes (pops negative); MIN_VALUE when it branches or is not modelled. */
    private static int stackDelta(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op >= ACONST_NULL && op <= ALOAD) return 1;
        if (op >= ISTORE && op <= ASTORE) return -1;
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
            int pops = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc).length + (op == INVOKESTATIC ? 0 : 1);
            return (Type.getReturnType(call.desc).getSort() == Type.VOID ? 0 : 1) - pops;
        }
        if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy)
            return (Type.getReturnType(indy.desc).getSort() == Type.VOID ? 0 : 1) - Type.getArgumentTypes(indy.desc).length;
        if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode) return switch (op) { case GETSTATIC -> 1; case PUTSTATIC -> -1; case GETFIELD -> 0; default -> -2; };
        if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode) return op == NEW ? 1 : 0; // ANEWARRAY, CHECKCAST, INSTANCEOF: 1 in, 1 out
        if (op == DUP) return 1;
        if (op == POP) return -1;
        if (op >= IALOAD && op <= SALOAD) return -1;
        if (op >= IASTORE && op <= SASTORE) return -3;
        if (op >= IADD && op <= LXOR) return (op >= INEG && op <= DNEG) ? 0 : -1;
        if (op >= I2L && op <= I2S || op == ARRAYLENGTH || op == NEWARRAY) return 0;
        return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
    }

    /** Stack entries an instruction consumes (reads counts as consuming), or -1 when not modelled. */
    private static int pops(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op >= ACONST_NULL && op <= ALOAD || op == NEW || op == GETSTATIC) return 0;
        if (op >= ISTORE && op <= ASTORE || op == POP || op == DUP || op == ARRAYLENGTH || op == NEWARRAY || op == ANEWARRAY
            || op == GETFIELD || op == PUTSTATIC || op == CHECKCAST || op == INSTANCEOF || op == MONITORENTER || op == MONITOREXIT) return 1;
        if (op >= IALOAD && op <= SALOAD || op == PUTFIELD) return 2;
        if (op >= IASTORE && op <= SASTORE) return 3;
        if (op >= INEG && op <= DNEG || op >= I2L && op <= I2S) return 1;
        if (op >= IADD && op <= LXOR || op >= LCMP && op <= DCMPG) return 2;
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) return Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc).length + (op == INVOKESTATIC ? 0 : 1);
        if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) return Type.getArgumentTypes(indy.desc).length;
        return -1;
    }

    private static boolean labelBetween(AbstractInsnNode a, AbstractInsnNode b) {
        for (var node = a.getNext(); node != null && node != b; node = node.getNext()) if (node instanceof LabelNode) return true;
        return false;
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode next(AbstractInsnNode insn) { return SeedInterpreter.next(insn); }
    static AbstractInsnNode previous(AbstractInsnNode insn) { return SeedInterpreter.previous(insn); }
}

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/MethodRewriter.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.AnalyzerException;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Frame;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: rewrites one method from the {@link SeedAnalyzer} frames, round after round until nothing changes:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>an int value computed from the obfuscator's material that has one possible value becomes that constant;</li>
 *   <li>a branch or switch on such a value with one feasible successor becomes a jump (or falls through); switch cases
 *   no input reaches are dropped;</li>
 *   <li>{@code throw new X()} whose first covering handler catches exactly {@code X} and does not start by storing the
 *   exception (Skidfuscator's handlers first re-derive the seed) becomes a jump to the handler with a null exception;</li>
 *   <li>unreachable instructions and try ranges where nothing can throw are removed;</li>
 *   <li>a peephole pass drops pushes that are immediately popped, jumps to the next instruction and jump chains.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
final class MethodRewriter implements Opcodes {
    static final int MAX_ROUNDS = 24;
    /** Counts per change kind, for the audit. */
    static final class Stats {
        int folded, branches, switchesPruned, dead, throwGotos, handlers, storesDropped, peephole, rounds, unanalyzable, assumed, threaded;
        /** Up to 20 methods (and the reason) the analysis refused. */
        final List<String> refused = new ArrayList<>();
        void refuse(String what) { unanalyzable++; if (refused.size() < 20) refused.add(what); }
        void add(Stats other) {
            folded += other.folded; branches += other.branches; switchesPruned += other.switchesPruned; dead += other.dead;
            throwGotos += other.throwGotos; handlers += other.handlers; storesDropped += other.storesDropped; peephole += other.peephole;
            rounds += other.rounds; unanalyzable += other.unanalyzable; assumed += other.assumed; threaded += other.threaded;
            for (String item : other.refused) if (refused.size() < 20) refused.add(item);
        }
        int total() { return folded + branches + switchesPruned + dead + throwGotos + handlers + storesDropped + peephole; }
    }

    private final SeedInterpreter interpreter;
    private final SeedAnalyzer analyzer;
    private final PureCalls pureCalls;

    /** Which static calls with primitive arguments have no side effect (their result may be dropped with their call). */
    interface PureCalls { boolean pure(MethodInsnNode call, Object[] literalArguments); }

    /** The literal arguments right before a call (int literals only), or null when any argument is computed. */
    static Object[] literalArguments(MethodInsnNode call) {
        var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc);
        Object[] args = new Object[types.length];
        AbstractInsnNode at = call;
        for (int k = types.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            at = previousReal(at);
            if (types[k].getSort() == Type.LONG && at instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof Long wide) { args[k] = wide; continue; }
            if (types[k].getSort() == Type.LONG && (at != null && (at.getOpcode() == LCONST_0 || at.getOpcode() == LCONST_1))) { args[k] = (long) (at.getOpcode() - LCONST_0); continue; }
            Integer value = SkidModel.literal(at);
            if (value == null || types[k].getSort() > Type.INT) return null;
            args[k] = value;
        }
        return args;
    }

    MethodRewriter(SeedInterpreter interpreter, PureCalls pureCalls) {
        this.interpreter = interpreter; this.analyzer = new SeedAnalyzer(interpreter); this.pureCalls = pureCalls;
    }

    boolean rewrite(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer,int[]> parameters, Stats stats) {
        return rewrite(owner, method, parameters, stats, Set.of());
    }

    /** {@code seeds}: locals known from their shape to hold the obfuscator's values (Phase 2CZ: Aidsfuscator's flow ints). */
    boolean rewrite(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer,int[]> parameters, Stats stats, Set<Integer> seeds) {
        // Phase 2DC: abstract and native methods have nothing to analyze; that is no refusal.
        if (method.instructions.size() == 0) return false;
        boolean changed = false;
        var seedLocals = new HashSet<Integer>(seeds);
        var generated = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Boolean>());
        interpreter.generated(generated);
        for (int round = 0; round < MAX_ROUNDS; round++) {
            boolean step;
            try { step = round(owner, method, parameters, stats, seedLocals, generated); }
            catch (AnalyzerException | RuntimeException error) { stats.refuse(owner + "." + method.name + method.desc + ": " + error); return changed; }
            step |= peephole(method, stats);
            if (!step) break;
            changed = true; stats.rounds++;
        }
        interpreter.generated(Set.of());
        return changed;
    }

    /** {@code seedLocals}: locals that held an obfuscator value in some round (their stores die once their loads are folded). */
    private boolean round(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer,int[]> parameters, Stats stats, Set<Integer> seedLocals,
                          Set<AbstractInsnNode> generated) throws AnalyzerException {
        var result = analyzer.analyze(owner, method, parameters, seedLocals);
        if (result == null) { stats.refuse(owner + "." + method.name + method.desc + ": " + analyzer.lastFailure); return false; }
        var insns = result.insns();
        Frame<SV>[] frames = result.frames();
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        var replace = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,InsnList>();
        var loads = new HashSet<Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            if (frames[i] == null) continue;
            if (insns[i] instanceof VarInsnNode store && store.getOpcode() == ISTORE && frames[i].getStack(frames[i].getStackSize() - 1).tainted)
                seedLocals.add(store.var);
            if (insns[i] instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.getOpcode() >= ILOAD && var.getOpcode() <= ALOAD) loads.add(var.var);
            if (insns[i] instanceof IincInsnNode inc) loads.add(inc.var);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            var insn = insns[i];
            var frame = frames[i];
            if (frame == null || insn.getOpcode() < 0 || replace.containsKey(insn)) continue;
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            // Phase 2CZ: a goto into a dispatcher (iload k; switch) while k holds one obfuscator value goes straight to that
            // case (Aidsfuscator's flattening; once every goto is threaded the dispatcher is dead).
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && op == GOTO) {
                var target = dispatchTarget(jump, frame);
                if (target != null) {
                    var list = new InsnList(); list.add(new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, target));
                    replace.put(insn, list); stats.threaded++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            // Branches with one feasible successor.
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && op != GOTO && op != JSR) {
                var targets = result.feasible().get(insn);
                if (targets != null && targets.size() == 1) {
                    int target = targets.iterator().next();
                    var list = new InsnList();
                    int operands = op >= IFEQ && op <= IFLE || op == IFNULL || op == IFNONNULL ? 1 : 2;
                    for (int k = 0; k < operands; k++) list.add(new InsnNode(POP));
                    if (target != i + 1) list.add(new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, (LabelNode) insns[target]));
                    replace.put(insn, list); stats.branches++;
                    if (result.assumed().contains(insn)) stats.assumed++;
                }
                continue;
            }
            if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) {
                var targets = result.feasible().get(insn);
                if (targets == null || targets.isEmpty()) continue;
                if (targets.size() == 1) {
                    var list = new InsnList();
                    list.add(new InsnNode(POP));
                    list.add(new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, (LabelNode) insns[targets.iterator().next()]));
                    replace.put(insn, list); stats.branches++;
                } else {
                    var pruned = prune(insn, targets, index);
                    if (pruned != null) { var list = new InsnList(); list.add(pruned); replace.put(insn, list); stats.switchesPruned++; }
                }
                continue;
            }
            // Skidfuscator's goto in disguise: throw new X() into a handler of exactly X that re-derives the seed first.
            if (op == NEW && frame.getStackSize() == 0) {
                var list = throwGoto(method, (TypeInsnNode) insn, index);
                if (list != null) {
                    var dup = next(insn); var ctor = next(dup); var athrow = next(ctor);
                    var nullPush = new InsnList(); nullPush.add(new InsnNode(ACONST_NULL));
                    replace.put(insn, nullPush); replace.put(dup, new InsnList()); replace.put(ctor, new InsnList()); replace.put(athrow, list);
                    stats.throwGotos++;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            // A dead store of an obfuscator value.
            if (op == ISTORE && !loads.contains(((VarInsnNode) insn).var) && seedLocals.contains(((VarInsnNode) insn).var)) {
                var list = new InsnList(); list.add(new InsnNode(POP)); replace.put(insn, list); stats.storesDropped++;
                continue;
            }
            // Folding.
            if (!foldable(insn) || constantPush(insn)) continue;
            var out = new Frame<SV>(frame);
            out.execute(insn, interpreter);
            if (out.getStackSize() == 0) continue;
            SV top = out.getStack(out.getStackSize() - 1);
            // A pure call whose result is dropped and that the analysis evaluated without error on every possible input.
            if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC && top.tainted && top.ints != null
                && next(insn) != null && next(insn).getOpcode() == POP && pureCalls.pure(call, null)) {
                var list = new InsnList();
                for (int size : operandSizes(insn)) list.add(new InsnNode(size == 2 ? POP2 : POP));
                replace.put(insn, list); replace.put(next(insn), new InsnList()); stats.folded++;
                continue;
            }
            if (!top.tainted || !top.singleton()) continue;
            var list = new InsnList();
            for (int size : operandSizes(insn)) list.add(new InsnNode(size == 2 ? POP2 : POP));
            var constant = push(top.single());
            generated.add(constant);
            list.add(constant);
            replace.put(insn, list); stats.folded++;
        }
        boolean changed = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
            var insn = insns[i];
            if (frames[i] == null && insn.getOpcode() >= 0) { method.instructions.remove(insn); stats.dead++; changed = true; continue; }
            var list = replace.get(insn);
            if (list != null) { method.instructions.insertBefore(insn, list); method.instructions.remove(insn); changed = true; }
        }
        changed |= removeIdleHandlers(method, stats);
        return changed;
    }

    /** The case label a goto reaches through {@code iload k; switch} when k is one obfuscator value; null otherwise. */
    private static LabelNode dispatchTarget(JumpInsnNode jump, Frame<SV> frame) {
        var load = start(jump.label);
        if (!(load instanceof VarInsnNode var) || var.getOpcode() != ILOAD || var.var >= frame.getLocals()) return null;
        var dispatch = next(load);
        SV key = frame.getLocal(var.var);
        if (!key.tainted || !key.singleton()) return null;
        // Nothing but labels, frames and line numbers between the load and the switch.
        for (var node = load.getNext(); node != dispatch; node = node.getNext()) if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return null;
        int value = key.single();
        if (dispatch instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table)
            return value >= table.min && value <= table.max ? table.labels.get(value - table.min) : table.dflt;
        if (dispatch instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) {
            int at = lookup.keys.indexOf(value);
            return at >= 0 ? lookup.labels.get(at) : lookup.dflt;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** A switch without the cases whose label no input reaches; null when every case stays. */
    private static AbstractInsnNode prune(AbstractInsnNode insn, Set<Integer> targets, Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> index) {
        var keys = new ArrayList<Integer>(); var labels = new ArrayList<LabelNode>(); LabelNode dflt;
        if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) {
            for (int k = 0; k < table.labels.size(); k++) { keys.add(table.min + k); labels.add(table.labels.get(k)); }
            dflt = table.dflt;
        } else {
            var lookup = (LookupSwitchInsnNode) insn;
            keys.addAll(lookup.keys); labels.addAll(lookup.labels); dflt = lookup.dflt;
        }
        var keptKeys = new ArrayList<Integer>(); var keptLabels = new ArrayList<LabelNode>();
        for (int k = 0; k < keys.size(); k++) {
            if (labels.get(k) == dflt || !targets.contains(index.get(labels.get(k)))) continue;
            keptKeys.add(keys.get(k)); keptLabels.add(labels.get(k));
        }
        if (!targets.contains(index.get(dflt)) && !keptLabels.isEmpty()) {
            // The default is never taken: the last kept case becomes the default.
            dflt = keptLabels.removeLast(); keptKeys.removeLast();
        }
        int before = keys.size();
        if (keptKeys.size() == before) return null;
        int[] sortedKeys = keptKeys.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
        Integer[] order = new Integer[sortedKeys.length];
        for (int k = 0; k < order.length; k++) order[k] = k;
        Arrays.sort(order, Comparator.comparingInt(k -> sortedKeys[k]));
        int[] finalKeys = new int[order.length]; LabelNode[] finalLabels = new LabelNode[order.length];
        for (int k = 0; k < order.length; k++) { finalKeys[k] = sortedKeys[order[k]]; finalLabels[k] = keptLabels.get(order[k]); }
        return new LookupSwitchInsnNode(dflt, finalKeys, finalLabels);
    }

    /** The jump replacing {@code new X; dup; invokespecial X.<init>()V; athrow}, or null when the pattern does not hold. */
    private static InsnList throwGoto(MethodNode method, TypeInsnNode alloc, Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> index) {
        var dup = next(alloc); var ctor = next(dup); var athrow = next(ctor);
        if (dup == null || dup.getOpcode() != DUP || !(ctor instanceof MethodInsnNode init) || !init.name.equals("<init>")
            || !init.desc.equals("()V") || !init.owner.equals(alloc.desc) || athrow == null || athrow.getOpcode() != ATHROW) return null;
        for (var node = alloc.getNext(); node != athrow; node = node.getNext()) if (node instanceof LabelNode) return null;
        int at = index.get(athrow);
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
            if (at < index.get(block.start) || at >= index.get(block.end)) continue;
            if (block.type == null || !block.type.equals(alloc.desc)) return null; // the first covering handler must catch exactly X
            var first = block.handler.getNext();
            while (first != null && first.getOpcode() < 0) first = first.getNext();
            if (first == null || first.getOpcode() == ASTORE) return null; // javac's handlers store the exception first
            var list = new InsnList();
            list.add(new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, block.handler));
            return list;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** Removes try ranges in which no instruction can throw (their handlers become plain code or dead). */
    private static boolean removeIdleHandlers(MethodNode method, Stats stats) {
        boolean changed = false;
        for (var it = method.tryCatchBlocks.iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
            var block = it.next();
            boolean throwing = false;
            for (AbstractInsnNode insn = block.start; insn != null && insn != block.end; insn = insn.getNext())
                if (canThrow(insn)) { throwing = true; break; }
            if (!throwing) { it.remove(); stats.handlers++; changed = true; }
        }
        return changed;
    }

    static boolean canThrow(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op < 0) return false;
        if (op >= NOP && op <= ALOAD || op >= ISTORE && op <= ASTORE || op >= POP && op <= SWAP) return false;
        if (op >= IADD && op <= DREM) return op == IDIV || op == IREM || op == LDIV || op == LREM;
        if (op >= INEG && op <= DCMPG) return false;
        if (op >= IFEQ && op <= LOOKUPSWITCH) return false;
        if (op >= IRETURN && op <= RETURN) return false;
        if (op == IFNULL || op == IFNONNULL || op == IINC) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean foldable(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op == ILOAD || op == GETSTATIC || op == GETFIELD) return true;
        if (op >= IADD && op <= DREM || op >= ISHL && op <= LXOR || op == INEG || op == I2B || op == I2C || op == I2S) return true;
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
            if (call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC && Type.getReturnType(call.desc).getSort() <= Type.INT && Type.getReturnType(call.desc).getSort() >= Type.BOOLEAN
                && (PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) || call.owner.equals("java/lang/Integer") && call.name.equals("parseInt"))) return true;
            return false; // Random(long).nextInt() stays: its result feeds a store that dies with the seed field
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean constantPush(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        return op >= ICONST_M1 && op <= ICONST_5 || op == BIPUSH || op == SIPUSH || insn instanceof LdcInsnNode;
    }

    /** Operand sizes (1 or 2 slots) of a foldable instruction, top of stack last. */
    private static List<Integer> operandSizes(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op == ILOAD || op == GETSTATIC) return List.of();
        if (op == GETFIELD || op == INEG || op == I2B || op == I2C || op == I2S) return List.of(1);
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
            var sizes = new ArrayList<Integer>();
            if (call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC) sizes.add(1);
            for (var type : Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc)) sizes.add(type.getSize());
            return sizes;
        }
        return List.of(1, 1); // int binary operations
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode push(int value) {
        if (value >= -1 && value <= 5) return new InsnNode(ICONST_0 + value);
        if (value >= Byte.MIN_VALUE && value <= Byte.MAX_VALUE) return new IntInsnNode(BIPUSH, value);
        if (value >= Short.MIN_VALUE && value <= Short.MAX_VALUE) return new IntInsnNode(SIPUSH, value);
        return new LdcInsnNode(value);
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode next(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        for (var node = insn.getNext(); node != null; node = node.getNext()) if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return node;
        return null;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- peephole

    boolean peephole(MethodNode method, Stats stats) {
        boolean any = false, changed = true;
        int guard = 0;
        while (changed && guard++ < 64) {
            changed = false;
            var targets = jumpTargets(method);
            for (var insn = method.instructions.getFirst(); insn != null; ) {
                var following = insn.getNext();
                if (insn.getOpcode() == POP || insn.getOpcode() == POP2) {
                    var producer = previousReal(insn);
                    if (producer != null && !targets.contains(labelBetween(producer, insn)) && dropPopped(method, producer, insn)) {
                        changed = true; stats.peephole++; insn = method.instructions.getFirst(); continue;
                    }
                }
                if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) {
                    var destination = resolve(jump.label);
                    if (destination != jump.label && destination != null) { jump.label = destination; changed = true; stats.peephole++; }
                    if (jump.getOpcode() == GOTO && nextRealOrLabelTarget(jump) == jump.label) {
                        method.instructions.remove(jump); changed = true; stats.peephole++; insn = following; continue;
                    }
                }
                if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) {
                    if (threadSwitch(method, insn)) { changed = true; stats.peephole++; insn = method.instructions.getFirst(); continue; }
                }
                insn = following;
            }
            any |= changed;
        }
        return any;
    }

    /** Removes {@code producer; pop} when the producer has no side effect (its operands are popped instead). */
    private boolean dropPopped(MethodNode method, AbstractInsnNode producer, AbstractInsnNode pop) {
        int op = producer.getOpcode();
        boolean wide = pop.getOpcode() == POP2;
        boolean pushWide = op == LCONST_0 || op == LCONST_1 || op == DCONST_0 || op == DCONST_1 || op == LLOAD || op == DLOAD
            || producer instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && (ldc.cst instanceof Long || ldc.cst instanceof Double);
        boolean pushNarrow = op >= ACONST_NULL && op <= ICONST_5 || op == FCONST_0 || op == FCONST_1 || op == FCONST_2 || op == BIPUSH
            || op == SIPUSH || op == ILOAD || op == FLOAD || op == ALOAD || op == DUP
            || producer instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc2 && !(ldc2.cst instanceof Long || ldc2.cst instanceof Double);
        if (wide ? pushWide : pushNarrow) { method.instructions.remove(producer); method.instructions.remove(pop); return true; }
        if (wide) return false;
        if (op == IADD || op == ISUB || op == IMUL || op == ISHL || op == ISHR || op == IUSHR || op == IAND || op == IOR || op == IXOR) {
            method.instructions.insertBefore(producer, new InsnNode(POP)); method.instructions.remove(producer); return true;
        }
        if (op == INEG || op == I2B || op == I2C || op == I2S) { method.instructions.remove(producer); return true; }
        if (producer instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC && Type.getReturnType(call.desc).getSize() == 1) {
            boolean parse = call.owner.equals("java/lang/Integer") && call.name.equals("parseInt") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)I")
                && previousReal(call) instanceof LdcInsnNode digits && digits.cst instanceof String text && text.matches("-?[0-9]{1,10}");
            Object[] literalArgs = literalArguments(call);
            // Also a JDK function Skidfuscator planted as a "pure" hash: literal arguments, one of them a folded 32-bit seed
            // hash (at least 2^20), result dropped. The program never called it; it goes with its test.
            boolean planted = literalArgs != null && (call.owner.startsWith("java/") || call.owner.startsWith("javax/"))
                && PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc)
                && Arrays.stream(literalArgs).anyMatch(v -> v instanceof Integer i && Math.abs((long) i) >= 1 << 20);
            if (parse || PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) && literalArgs != null && (planted || pureCalls.pure(call, literalArgs))) {
                var list = new InsnList();
                var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc);
                for (int k = args.length - 1; k >= 0; k--) list.add(new InsnNode(args[k].getSize() == 2 ? POP2 : POP));
                method.instructions.insertBefore(producer, list);
                method.instructions.remove(producer); method.instructions.remove(pop);
                return true;
            }
        }
        // new Random(<long>).nextInt(); pop
        if (producer instanceof MethodInsnNode nextInt && nextInt.owner.equals("java/util/Random") && nextInt.name.equals("nextInt")
            && SeedInterpreter.randomSeed(nextInt) != null) {
            var init = previousReal(nextInt); var ldc = previousReal(init); var dup = previousReal(ldc); var alloc = previousReal(dup);
            for (var node : List.of(alloc, dup, ldc, init, nextInt, pop)) method.instructions.remove(node);
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** A switch whose cases (after jump threading) all lead to one place becomes {@code pop; goto}. */
    private static boolean threadSwitch(MethodNode method, AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        List<LabelNode> labels; LabelNode dflt;
        if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { labels = table.labels; dflt = table.dflt; }
        else { labels = ((LookupSwitchInsnNode) insn).labels; dflt = ((LookupSwitchInsnNode) insn).dflt; }
        boolean changed = false;
        for (int k = 0; k < labels.size(); k++) {
            var destination = resolve(labels.get(k));
            if (destination != null && destination != labels.get(k)) { labels.set(k, destination); changed = true; }
        }
        var resolvedDefault = resolve(dflt);
        if (resolvedDefault != null && resolvedDefault != dflt) {
            if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) table.dflt = resolvedDefault; else ((LookupSwitchInsnNode) insn).dflt = resolvedDefault;
            dflt = resolvedDefault; changed = true;
        }
        LabelNode only = dflt;
        for (var label : labels) if (label != only && start(label) != start(only) && !sameBlock(label, only)) { only = null; break; }
        if (only != null) {
            var list = new InsnList(); list.add(new InsnNode(POP)); list.add(new JumpInsnNode(GOTO, only));
            method.instructions.insertBefore(insn, list); method.instructions.remove(insn);
            return true;
        }
        return changed;
    }

    /**
     * True when the straight-line code at both labels is the same instructions up to an unconditional jump, return or
     * throw (Skidfuscator's handler dispatch ends, once folded, in identical {@code seed = C; goto handler} cases).
     */
    private static boolean sameBlock(LabelNode a, LabelNode b) {
        var x = start(a); var y = start(b);
        for (int steps = 0; steps < 24 && x != null && y != null; steps++) {
            if (x == y) return true; // the two paths meet (one may fall through where the other jumps)
            if (x instanceof JumpInsnNode j && j.getOpcode() == GOTO) { x = start(j.label); continue; }
            if (y instanceof JumpInsnNode j && j.getOpcode() == GOTO) { y = start(j.label); continue; }
            if (!sameInsn(x, y)) return false;
            int op = x.getOpcode();
            if (op >= IRETURN && op <= RETURN || op == ATHROW) return true;
            if (x instanceof JumpInsnNode || x instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || x instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) return false;
            x = next(x); y = next(y);
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean sameInsn(AbstractInsnNode x, AbstractInsnNode y) {
        if (x.getOpcode() != y.getOpcode() || x.getType() != y.getType()) return false;
        return switch (x) {
            case VarInsnNode v -> v.var == ((VarInsnNode) y).var;
            case IntInsnNode i -> i.operand == ((IntInsnNode) y).operand;
            case LdcInsnNode l -> l.cst.equals(((LdcInsnNode) y).cst);
            case JumpInsnNode j -> start(j.label) == start(((JumpInsnNode) y).label);
            case InsnNode plain -> true;
            default -> false;
        };
    }

    /** First real instruction at or after a label. */
    private static AbstractInsnNode start(LabelNode label) {
        AbstractInsnNode node = label;
        while (node != null && node.getOpcode() < 0) node = node.getNext();
        return node;
    }

    /** Follows a chain of unconditional jumps from a label; a cycle leaves the label as it is. */
    private static LabelNode resolve(LabelNode label) {
        var seen = new HashSet<LabelNode>();
        seen.add(label);
        LabelNode current = label;
        while (true) {
            var first = start(current);
            if (!(first instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) || jump.getOpcode() != GOTO) return current;
            if (!seen.add(jump.label)) return label;
            current = jump.label;
        }
    }

    private static LabelNode nextRealOrLabelTarget(JumpInsnNode jump) {
        for (var node = jump.getNext(); node != null; node = node.getNext()) {
            if (node instanceof LabelNode label && label == jump.label) return label;
            if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return null;
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static AbstractInsnNode previousReal(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn == null) return null;
        for (var node = insn.getPrevious(); node != null; node = node.getPrevious()) {
            if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return node;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** A label between two instructions that something jumps to (then the pair is not straight-line code). */
    private static LabelNode labelBetween(AbstractInsnNode first, AbstractInsnNode second) {
        for (var node = first.getNext(); node != null && node != second; node = node.getNext())
            if (node instanceof LabelNode label) return label;
        return null;
    }

    private static Set<LabelNode> jumpTargets(MethodNode method) {
        var targets = new HashSet<LabelNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) targets.add(jump.label);
            else if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { targets.add(table.dflt); targets.addAll(table.labels); }
            else if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { targets.add(lookup.dflt); targets.addAll(lookup.labels); }
        }
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) { targets.add(block.handler); targets.add(block.start); targets.add(block.end); }
        return targets;
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/ParameterRecovery.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CP: removes the trailing {@code int} that Skidfuscator's interprocedural pass adds to methods only called from
 * inside the jar (the caller's constant is the method's seed key). After the flow pass the parameter is never read, so:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>every declaration of the method in the jar (overrides included) gets the original descriptor back, its locals
 *   above the parameter move down one slot, and its parameter annotations and names lose the extra entry;</li>
 *   <li>every call drops the literal it pushed for the parameter;</li>
 *   <li>a name Skidfuscator suffixed with {@code $<number>} to avoid a collision gets its base name back when that is free.</li>
 * </ul>
 * A method is left alone when the parameter is still read, a call passes a computed value, a method handle names it, or the
 * new descriptor would collide with a method of its class hierarchy. Calls that Skidfuscator rewrote to a descriptor no
 * method has (its own bug, seen as {@code m:(I)} calls to an {@code m()} method) lose the literal as well.
 */
final class ParameterRecovery implements Opcodes {
    int methods, calls, renamed, brokenCalls, skipped;
    /** Up to 20 groups left alone and why. */
    final List<String> kept = new ArrayList<>();
    private void keep(String what, int count) { skipped += count; if (kept.size() < 20) kept.add(what); }

    void apply(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, SkidModel model, Set<String> changed) {
        var handles = handleTargets(nodes);
        // Candidate declarations: seed parameters (found before the flow pass) that nothing reads any more.
        var candidates = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<MethodNode>>(); // group key name+desc -> declarations
        var owners = new IdentityHashMap<MethodNode,String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                var parameter = model.seedParameters.get(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc));
                if (parameter == null) continue;
                int slot = parameter.keySet().iterator().next();
                if (reads(method, slot)) { keep(node.name + "." + method.name + method.desc + ": parameter still read", 1); continue; }
                if (handles.contains(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc))) { keep(node.name + "." + method.name + method.desc + ": method handle", 1); continue; }
                candidates.computeIfAbsent(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(method);
                owners.put(method, node.name);
            }
        }
        for (var entry : candidates.entrySet()) {
            var group = entry.getValue();
            String name = group.getFirst().name, desc = group.getFirst().desc;
            String newDesc = dropLastInt(desc);
            // A seed parameter never overrides (SkidModel); no subclass in the jar may override it either.
            String owner0 = owners.get(group.getFirst());
            boolean complete = true;
            var first = group.getFirst();
            if (!first.name.startsWith("<") && (first.access & (ACC_STATIC | ACC_PRIVATE)) == 0)
                for (var node : nodes.values())
                    if (subclass(node, owner0, nodes))
                        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(name) && method.desc.equals(desc)) complete = false;
            if (!complete) { keep(name + desc + ": another declaration keeps the parameter", group.size()); continue; }
            // Every call to the group passes a literal right before the call.
            var sites = new ArrayList<MethodInsnNode>();
            var siteMethods = new IdentityHashMap<MethodInsnNode,MethodNode>();
            boolean literalOnly = true;
            for (var node : nodes.values())
                for (var method : node.methods)
                    for (var insn : method.instructions)
                        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.name.equals(name) && call.desc.equals(desc)
                            && owner0.equals(model.declaring(call.owner, call.name, call.desc))) {
                            if (!literalArgument(call)) literalOnly = false;
                            sites.add(call); siteMethods.put(call, method);
                        }
            if (!literalOnly) { keep(name + desc + ": a call passes a computed value", group.size()); continue; }
            // The new name and descriptor must be free in every class that declares the method and in their super classes.
            String newName = baseName(name, newDesc, group, owners, nodes, model);
            if (newName == null) { keep(name + desc + ": the shorter descriptor collides", group.size()); continue; }
            for (var method : group) {
                String owner = owners.get(method);
                rewriteDeclaration(method, model.seedParameters.get(SkidModel.key(owner, method.name, method.desc)).keySet().iterator().next());
                method.desc = newDesc;
                if (!newName.equals(method.name)) { method.name = newName; renamed++; }
                changed.add(owner);
                methods++;
            }
            for (var call : sites) {
                var push = SeedInterpreter.previous(call);
                siteMethods.get(call).instructions.remove(push);
                call.desc = newDesc; call.name = newName;
                calls++;
            }
            for (var node : nodes.values()) for (var method : node.methods) if (sites.stream().anyMatch(method.instructions::contains)) changed.add(node.name);
        }
        // Skidfuscator's own broken calls: m:(...I) on a class whose hierarchy declares only m:(...).
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || !call.desc.contains("I)") || model.declaring(call.owner, call.name, call.desc) != null
                        || !nodes.containsKey(call.owner) || !literalArgument(call)) continue;
                    String shorter = dropLastInt(call.desc);
                    if (shorter == null || model.declaring(call.owner, call.name, shorter) == null) continue;
                    method.instructions.remove(SeedInterpreter.previous(call));
                    call.desc = shorter;
                    brokenCalls++; changed.add(node.name);
                }
    }

    /** The descriptor without its last parameter when that is an int; null otherwise. */
    static String dropLastInt(String desc) {
        var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(desc);
        if (args.length == 0 || args[args.length - 1].getSort() != Type.INT) return null;
        return Type.getMethodDescriptor(Type.getReturnType(desc), Arrays.copyOf(args, args.length - 1));
    }

    private static boolean reads(MethodNode method, int slot) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var == slot) return true;
            if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == slot) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean literalArgument(MethodInsnNode call) {
        var push = SeedInterpreter.previous(call);
        if (SkidModel.literal(push) == null) return false;
        for (var node = push.getNext(); node != call; node = node.getNext()) if (node instanceof LabelNode) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private static Set<String> handleTargets(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        var result = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) {
                        for (Object arg : indy.bsmArgs) if (arg instanceof org.objectweb.asm.Handle h) result.add(SkidModel.key(h.getOwner(), h.getName(), h.getDesc()));
                    } else if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof org.objectweb.asm.Handle h) result.add(SkidModel.key(h.getOwner(), h.getName(), h.getDesc()));
                }
        return result;
    }

    /**
     * The name to give the group: the base of a {@code name$<number>} when Skidfuscator suffixed it and the base is free,
     * else the name itself when it is free with the new descriptor; null when neither is.
     */
    private static String baseName(String name, String newDesc, List<MethodNode> group, Map<MethodNode,String> owners,
                                   Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, SkidModel model) {
        int dollar = name.lastIndexOf('$');
        if (dollar > 0 && name.substring(dollar + 1).matches("-?[0-9]{1,10}") && free(name.substring(0, dollar), newDesc, group, owners, nodes))
            return name.substring(0, dollar);
        return free(name, newDesc, group, owners, nodes) ? name : null;
    }

    private static boolean free(String name, String desc, List<MethodNode> group, Map<MethodNode,String> owners, Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        for (var method : group) {
            var seen = new HashSet<String>();
            for (String type = owners.get(method); type != null && seen.add(type); ) {
                var node = nodes.get(type);
                if (node == null) break;
                for (var other : node.methods) if (other.name.equals(name) && other.desc.equals(desc)) return false;
                type = node.superName;
            }
            // Subclasses declaring name+desc would start to override it.
            for (var node : nodes.values()) {
                if (!subclass(node, owners.get(method), nodes)) continue;
                for (var other : node.methods) if (other.name.equals(name) && other.desc.equals(desc)) return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private static boolean subclass(ClassNode node, String ancestor, Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        for (String type = node.superName; type != null && seen.add(type); ) {
            if (type.equals(ancestor)) return true;
            var parent = nodes.get(type);
            type = parent == null ? null : parent.superName;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Moves locals above {@code slot} down by one and drops the parameter's metadata (also Aidsfuscator's salts, 2CZ). */
    static void rewriteDeclaration(MethodNode method, int slot) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var > slot) var.var--;
            else if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var > slot) inc.var--;
        }
        if (method.localVariables != null) {
            method.localVariables.removeIf(local -> local.index == slot);
            for (var local : method.localVariables) if (local.index > slot) local.index--;
        }
        int count = Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc).length;
        if (method.visibleParameterAnnotations != null && method.visibleParameterAnnotations.length == count)
            method.visibleParameterAnnotations = Arrays.copyOf(method.visibleParameterAnnotations, count - 1);
        if (method.invisibleParameterAnnotations != null && method.invisibleParameterAnnotations.length == count)
            method.invisibleParameterAnnotations = Arrays.copyOf(method.invisibleParameterAnnotations, count - 1);
        if (method.visibleAnnotableParameterCount == count) method.visibleAnnotableParameterCount--;
        if (method.invisibleAnnotableParameterCount == count) method.invisibleAnnotableParameterCount--;
        if (method.parameters != null && method.parameters.size() == count) method.parameters.removeLast();
        method.maxLocals = Math.max(0, method.maxLocals - 1);
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/PureEvaluator.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: evaluates static methods with primitive parameters and a primitive result by interpreting their bytecode,
 * with a step budget. Only primitive arithmetic, locals, branches and calls to other such methods are interpreted; any
 * field, object, array, exception handler or native method refuses the evaluation. Nothing is loaded or initialized:
 * jar methods come from the jar's bytes, JDK methods from the platform's class files read as resources.
 *
 * <p>A short allowlist of JDK methods whose bodies use lookup tables or intrinsics ({@code Character.toLowerCase(int)},
 * ...) is evaluated by calling the JDK's own method: that runs JDK code on constants, never target code.
 */
final class PureEvaluator implements Opcodes {
    static final int MAX_STEPS = 20_000;
    private static final int MAX_DEPTH = 8;
    private final Map<String,ClassNode> jar;
    private final Map<String,Optional<ClassNode>> jdk = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<String,Boolean> refused = new HashMap<>();

    PureEvaluator(Map<String,ClassNode> jar) { this.jar = jar; }

    /** True when the descriptor has only primitive parameters (at least one) and a primitive, non-void result. */
    static boolean primitiveDescriptor(String desc) {
        var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(desc);
        if (args.length == 0) return false;
        for (var arg : args) if (arg.getSort() < Type.BOOLEAN || arg.getSort() > Type.DOUBLE) return false;
        int result = Type.getReturnType(desc).getSort();
        return result >= Type.BOOLEAN && result <= Type.DOUBLE;
    }

    /** Evaluates {@code owner.name desc} on boxed primitive arguments (int-like ones as Integer); empty when refused. */
    Optional<Object> evaluate(String owner, String name, String desc, Object[] args) {
        if (!primitiveDescriptor(desc)) return Optional.empty();
        String key = owner + "." + name + desc;
        if (refused.containsKey(key)) return Optional.ofNullable(Allowlist.call(owner, name, desc, args));
        try {
            var budget = new int[] {MAX_STEPS};
            Object result = invoke(owner, name, desc, args, budget, 0);
            if (result != null) return Optional.of(result);
        } catch (Refusal refusal) {
            if (refusal.permanent) refused.put(key, true);
        } catch (ArithmeticException | IndexOutOfBoundsException | ClassCastException error) {
            // A division by zero or a malformed body: no value.
        }
        Object reflected = Allowlist.call(owner, name, desc, args);
        return Optional.ofNullable(reflected);
    }

    private static final class Refusal extends RuntimeException {
        final boolean permanent;
        Refusal(boolean permanent) { super(null, null, false, false); this.permanent = permanent; }
    }

    private final Map<String,Boolean> pure = new HashMap<>();

    /**
     * True when calling the method has no effect besides its result or an {@code ArithmeticException} (a division by zero):
     * an allowlisted JDK class, or a static method whose body only does primitive arithmetic, branches and calls to such
     * methods. A call is dropped only when its arguments are literals it was evaluated on without error.
     */
    boolean pureBody(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        if (Allowlist.CLASSES.contains(owner)) return primitiveDescriptor(desc);
        String key = owner + "." + name + desc;
        Boolean known = pure.get(key);
        if (known != null) return known;
        pure.put(key, false); // recursion counts as impure
        boolean result = pureBodyOf(method(owner, name, desc));
        pure.put(key, result);
        return result;
    }

    private boolean pureBodyOf(MethodNode method) {
        if (method == null || (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || (method.access & (ACC_NATIVE | ACC_ABSTRACT)) != 0
            || !method.tryCatchBlocks.isEmpty() || !primitiveDescriptor(method.desc)) return false;
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            if (op < 0) continue;
            if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
                if (op != INVOKESTATIC || !primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) || !pureBody(call.owner, call.name, call.desc)) return false;
                continue;
            }
            boolean allowed = op >= ICONST_M1 && op <= LDC && !(insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && !(ldc.cst instanceof Number))
                || op >= ILOAD && op <= DLOAD || op >= ISTORE && op <= DSTORE || op >= POP && op <= DCMPG || op >= IFEQ && op <= IF_ICMPLE || op == GOTO || op == TABLESWITCH || op == LOOKUPSWITCH
                || op >= IRETURN && op <= DRETURN;
            if (op == ACONST_NULL || op == IINC) allowed = op == IINC;
            if (!allowed) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private MethodNode method(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        ClassNode node = jar.get(owner);
        if (node == null) node = jdkClass(owner).orElse(null);
        if (node == null) return null;
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(name) && method.desc.equals(desc)) return method;
        return null;
    }

    private Optional<ClassNode> jdkClass(String owner) {
        return jdk.computeIfAbsent(owner, name -> {
            if (!(name.startsWith("java/") || name.startsWith("javax/"))) return Optional.empty();
            try (InputStream in = ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader().getResourceAsStream(name + ".class")) {
                if (in == null) return Optional.empty();
                byte[] bytes = in.readNBytes(8 * 1024 * 1024);
                var node = new ClassNode();
                new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
                return Optional.of(node);
            } catch (Exception error) {
                return Optional.empty();
            }
        });
    }

    private Object invoke(String owner, String name, String desc, Object[] args, int[] budget, int depth) {
        if (depth > MAX_DEPTH) throw new Refusal(false);
        MethodNode method = method(owner, name, desc);
        if (method == null || (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || (method.access & (ACC_NATIVE | ACC_ABSTRACT)) != 0
            || !method.tryCatchBlocks.isEmpty()) throw new Refusal(true);
        var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        Object[] locals = new Object[Math.max(method.maxLocals, 1) + 2];
        int slot = 0;
        var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(desc);
        for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) { locals[slot] = args[i]; slot += types[i].getSize(); }
        var stack = new ArrayDeque<Object>();
        int pc = 0;
        while (pc < insns.length) {
            if (--budget[0] < 0) throw new Refusal(false);
            var insn = insns[pc];
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            int next = pc + 1;
            if (op < 0) { pc = next; continue; }
            switch (insn) {
                case VarInsnNode var -> {
                    if (op >= ILOAD && op <= ALOAD) { if (op == ALOAD || locals[var.var] == null) throw new Refusal(true); stack.push(locals[var.var]); }
                    else if (op >= ISTORE && op <= DSTORE) locals[var.var] = stack.pop();
                    else throw new Refusal(true);
                }
                case IincInsnNode inc -> locals[inc.var] = (Integer) locals[inc.var] + inc.incr;
                case IntInsnNode push -> { if (op == NEWARRAY) throw new Refusal(true); stack.push(push.operand); }
                case LdcInsnNode ldc -> {
                    if (ldc.cst instanceof Integer || ldc.cst instanceof Long || ldc.cst instanceof Float || ldc.cst instanceof Double) stack.push(ldc.cst);
                    else throw new Refusal(true);
                }
                case JumpInsnNode jump -> {
                    boolean taken = switch (op) {
                        case GOTO -> true;
                        case IFEQ -> (Integer) stack.pop() == 0; case IFNE -> (Integer) stack.pop() != 0;
                        case IFLT -> (Integer) stack.pop() < 0; case IFGE -> (Integer) stack.pop() >= 0;
                        case IFGT -> (Integer) stack.pop() > 0; case IFLE -> (Integer) stack.pop() <= 0;
                        case IF_ICMPEQ, IF_ICMPNE, IF_ICMPLT, IF_ICMPGE, IF_ICMPGT, IF_ICMPLE -> {
                            int b = (Integer) stack.pop(), a = (Integer) stack.pop();
                            yield Interpret.compare(op, a, b);
                        }
                        default -> throw new Refusal(true);
                    };
                    if (taken) next = index.get(jump.label);
                }
                case TableSwitchInsnNode table -> {
                    int key = (Integer) stack.pop();
                    next = index.get(key >= table.min && key <= table.max ? table.labels.get(key - table.min) : table.dflt);
                }
                case LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup -> {
                    int key = (Integer) stack.pop(), at = lookup.keys.indexOf(key);
                    next = index.get(at >= 0 ? lookup.labels.get(at) : lookup.dflt);
                }
                case MethodInsnNode call -> {
                    if (op != INVOKESTATIC || !primitiveDescriptor(call.desc)) throw new Refusal(true);
                    var argTypes = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc);
                    Object[] callArgs = new Object[argTypes.length];
                    for (int i = argTypes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) callArgs[i] = stack.pop();
                    Object result;
                    try { result = invoke(call.owner, call.name, call.desc, callArgs, budget, depth + 1); }
                    catch (Refusal refusal) {
                        result = Allowlist.call(call.owner, call.name, call.desc, callArgs);
                        if (result == null) throw refusal;
                    }
                    stack.push(result);
                }
                case InsnNode plain -> {
                    if (op >= IRETURN && op <= DRETURN) return normalize(Type.getReturnType(desc), stack.pop());
                    Object value = Interpret.plain(op, stack);
                    if (value == Interpret.REFUSED) throw new Refusal(true);
                }
                default -> throw new Refusal(true);
            }
            pc = next;
        }
        throw new Refusal(true);
    }

    private static Object normalize(Type type, Object value) {
        return switch (type.getSort()) {
            case Type.BOOLEAN, Type.BYTE, Type.CHAR, Type.SHORT, Type.INT -> (Integer) value;
            default -> value;
        };
    }

    /** JDK methods with table- or intrinsic-based bodies, evaluated by the JDK itself on constants. */
    static final class Allowlist {
        static final Set<String> CLASSES = Set.of("java/lang/Math", "java/lang/StrictMath", "java/lang/Integer", "java/lang/Long",
            "java/lang/Short", "java/lang/Byte", "java/lang/Character", "java/lang/Boolean", "java/lang/Float", "java/lang/Double",
            "java/util/Objects");
        static Object call(String owner, String name, String desc, Object[] args) {
            if (!CLASSES.contains(owner) || !primitiveDescriptor(desc)) return null;
            try {
                var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(desc);
                Class<?>[] parameters = new Class<?>[types.length];
                Object[] values = new Object[types.length];
                for (int i = 0; i < types.length; i++) {
                    parameters[i] = primitive(types[i]);
                    values[i] = convert(types[i], args[i]);
                }
                var method = Class.forName(owner.replace('/', '.'), false, ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader()).getMethod(name, parameters);
                if (!java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(method.getModifiers()) || !Type.getMethodDescriptor(method).equals(desc)) return null;
                Object result = method.invoke(null, values);
                return switch (Type.getReturnType(desc).getSort()) {
                    case Type.BOOLEAN -> ((Boolean) result) ? 1 : 0;
                    case Type.CHAR -> (int) (Character) result;
                    case Type.BYTE -> (int) (Byte) result;
                    case Type.SHORT -> (int) (Short) result;
                    default -> result;
                };
            } catch (ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException | LinkageError error) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        private static Class<?> primitive(Type type) {
            return switch (type.getSort()) {
                case Type.BOOLEAN -> boolean.class; case Type.BYTE -> byte.class; case Type.CHAR -> char.class; case Type.SHORT -> short.class;
                case Type.INT -> int.class; case Type.LONG -> long.class; case Type.FLOAT -> float.class; default -> double.class;
            };
        }
        private static Object convert(Type type, Object value) {
            return switch (type.getSort()) {
                case Type.BOOLEAN -> ((Integer) value) != 0; case Type.BYTE -> (byte) (int) (Integer) value;
                case Type.CHAR -> (char) (int) (Integer) value; case Type.SHORT -> (short) (int) (Integer) value;
                default -> value;
            };
        }
    }
}
```
