`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SV.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Value;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntFunction;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: an abstract JVM value. Int values carry the finite set of values they can take ({@code ints}, null when
 * unknown) and, when they were computed from one local variable by known pure operations, that provenance
 * ({@link Prov}): a branch on such a value narrows the local's set on each edge.
 */
final class SV implements Value {
    enum Kind { UNINIT, INT, LONG, FLOAT, DOUBLE, REF, RET }
    static final int MAX_SET = 1024;
    static final SV UNINIT = new SV(Kind.UNINIT, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV INT_TOP = new SV(Kind.INT, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV LONG_TOP = new SV(Kind.LONG, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV FLOAT_TOP = new SV(Kind.FLOAT, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV DOUBLE_TOP = new SV(Kind.DOUBLE, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV REF_TOP = new SV(Kind.REF, null, null, null, null, false, false);
    static final SV RET = new SV(Kind.RET, null, null, null, null, false, false);

    final Kind kind;
    /** INT: sorted distinct values, or null when unknown. */
    final int[] ints;
    /** INT: the local this value was computed from, or null. */
    final Prov prov;
    /** LONG: a Long constant; REF: a String constant (from ldc); otherwise null. */
    final Object constant;
    /** REF: an internal name or array descriptor when known. */
    final String type;
    /**
     * Computed from the obfuscator's material (a seed field, the injected seed parameter, an unfolded operation on two
     * literals, which javac never emits, or a seed local): only such values are folded and only such branches pruned, so
     * the program's own constants and dead branches stay as written.
     */
    final boolean tainted;
    /** Pushed directly by a constant instruction (iconst, bipush, sipush, ldc). */
    final boolean literal;
    /** The result of one of the obfuscator's hash functions (a factory hash or a pure function applied to one). */
    final boolean hashed;

    private SV(Kind kind, int[] ints, Prov prov, Object constant, String type, boolean tainted, boolean literal) {
        this(kind, ints, prov, constant, type, tainted, literal, false);
    }
    private SV(Kind kind, int[] ints, Prov prov, Object constant, String type, boolean tainted, boolean literal, boolean hashed) {
        this.kind = kind; this.ints = ints; this.prov = prov; this.constant = constant; this.type = type;
        this.tainted = tainted; this.literal = literal; this.hashed = hashed;
    }
    SV hashedValue() { return kind != Kind.INT || hashed ? this : new SV(kind, ints, prov, null, null, true, false, true); }

    /**
     * The provenance of an int value: {@code fn(value of local)}. {@code fn} returns null when it cannot be computed for
     * an input (then a branch keeps that input on both edges). Instances are canonical per producing instruction.
     */
    record Prov(int local, IntFunction<Integer> fn) {
        @Override public boolean equals(Object other) { return this == other; }
        @Override public int hashCode() { return System.identityHashCode(this); }
    }

    static SV ints(int[] values, Prov prov, boolean tainted) {
        if (values == null || values.length > MAX_SET) return prov == null && !tainted ? INT_TOP : new SV(Kind.INT, null, prov, null, null, tainted, false);
        return new SV(Kind.INT, values, prov, null, null, tainted, false);
    }
    static SV ints(int[] values, Prov prov) { return ints(values, prov, false); }
    static SV of(int value) { return new SV(Kind.INT, new int[] {value}, null, null, null, false, false); }
    static SV literal(int value) { return new SV(Kind.INT, new int[] {value}, null, null, null, false, true); }
    static SV ref(String type, Object constant) { return new SV(Kind.REF, null, null, constant, type, false, false); }
    static SV longConstant(Long value) { return new SV(Kind.LONG, null, null, value, null, false, false); }
    SV withProv(Prov prov) { return kind == Kind.INT ? new SV(kind, ints, prov, null, null, tainted, false, hashed) : this; }
    SV withoutProv() { return prov == null && !literal ? this : new SV(kind, ints, null, constant, type, tainted, false); }
    SV taint() { return tainted || kind != Kind.INT ? this : new SV(kind, ints, prov, null, null, true, literal); }

    boolean singleton() { return kind == Kind.INT && ints != null && ints.length == 1; }
    int single() { return ints[0]; }

    static int[] sorted(Collection<Integer> values) {
        if (values.size() > MAX_SET) return null;
        int[] result = values.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).sorted().distinct().toArray();
        return result;
    }
    static int[] union(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) return null;
        var set = new TreeSet<Integer>();
        for (int v : a) set.add(v);
        for (int v : b) set.add(v);
        return set.size() > MAX_SET ? null : sorted(set);
    }

    SV merge(SV other) {
        if (this == other || equals(other)) return this;
        if (kind != other.kind) return UNINIT;
        return switch (kind) {
            // Only the obfuscator's values need sets; the program's own values widen at once (loop counters converge).
            case INT -> tainted || other.tainted ? ints(union(ints, other.ints), prov == other.prov ? prov : null, true) : INT_TOP;
            case LONG -> Objects.equals(constant, other.constant) ? this : LONG_TOP;
            case REF -> ref(Objects.equals(type, other.type) ? type : null, Objects.equals(constant, other.constant) ? constant : null);
            default -> this;
        };
    }

    @Override public int getSize() { return kind == Kind.LONG || kind == Kind.DOUBLE ? 2 : 1; }
    @Override public boolean equals(Object o) {
        return o instanceof SV v && v.kind == kind && Arrays.equals(v.ints, ints) && v.prov == prov
            && Objects.equals(v.constant, constant) && Objects.equals(v.type, type) && v.tainted == tainted && v.literal == literal && v.hashed == hashed;
    }
    @Override public int hashCode() { return Objects.hash(kind, Arrays.hashCode(ints), constant, type); }
    @Override public String toString() {
        return kind + (ints == null ? "" : Arrays.toString(ints.length > 4 ? Arrays.copyOf(ints, 4) : ints)) + (prov != null ? "@" + prov.local : "")
            + (constant != null ? "=" + constant : "") + (tainted ? "*" : "");
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SdkRecovery.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import net.openhft.hashing.LongHashFunction;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CR: undoes the transformers that call Skidfuscator's {@code sdk/SDK} runtime.
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>Type Check</b>: {@code o instanceof T} became {@code SDK.checkType(o, "<xxh3(seed) of T's internal name>", seed)};
 *   the type is found in a dictionary of class names (the jar's classes, every type the jar names, and the JDK's classes,
 *   listed from the {@code jrt:/} image without loading any) and the call becomes {@code instanceof T} again.</li>
 *   <li><b>String Equals Hash</b> / <b>Equals-IgnoreCase Hash</b>: {@code x.equals("lit")} became
 *   {@code SDK.hash(x).equals("<xxh3 of lit>")} (lower-cased first for {@code equalsIgnoreCase}). The literal is gone: it is
 *   recovered only when it is in a dictionary of the jar's strings and names. Unrecovered comparisons stay as they are.</li>
 * </ul>
 * XXH3 is computed with OpenHFT zero-allocation-hashing (Skidfuscator's {@code sdk/*} is a copy of it); the {@code sdk/*}
 * classes of the target are never run. They are removed once no other class refers to them.
 */
final class SdkRecovery implements Opcodes {
    static final String SDK = "sdk/SDK";
    int typeChecks, typeUnresolved, equalsRecovered, equalsUnresolved, sdkClassesRemoved;
    private Map<Long,String> unseeded;
    private final Map<Integer,Map<Long,String>> typeTables = new HashMap<>();
    private Set<String> typeNames;

    void apply(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, Set<String> changed, Set<String> removedClasses) {
        if (!nodes.containsKey(SDK)) return;
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (node.name.startsWith("sdk/")) continue;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (method.instructions.size() == 0) continue;
                boolean uses = false;
                for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals(SDK)) { uses = true; break; }
                if (!uses) continue;
                Frame<SourceValue>[] frames;
                try { frames = new Analyzer<>(new SourceInterpreter()).analyze(node.name, method); }
                catch (AnalyzerException error) { continue; }
                var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
                var edits = new ArrayList<Runnable>();
                for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) {
                    if (!(insns[i] instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || frames[i] == null) continue;
                    var frame = frames[i];
                    if (call.owner.equals(SDK) && call.name.equals("checkType") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/String;I)Z")) {
                        var hash = single(frame.getStack(frame.getStackSize() - 2)); var seed = single(frame.getStack(frame.getStackSize() - 1));
                        Integer seedValue = SkidModel.literal(seed);
                        if (!(hash instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc) || !(ldc.cst instanceof String text) || seedValue == null || !adjacent(hash, seed, call)) { typeUnresolved++; continue; }
                        String type = typeName(nodes, seedValue, text);
                        if (type == null) { typeUnresolved++; continue; }
                        edits.add(() -> {
                            method.instructions.remove(hash); method.instructions.remove(seed);
                            method.instructions.set(call, new TypeInsnNode(INSTANCEOF, type));
                        });
                        typeChecks++;
                    } else if (call.owner.equals("java/lang/String") && (call.name.equals("equals") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z")
                        || call.name.equals("equalsIgnoreCase") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)Z"))) {
                        boolean ignoreCase = call.name.equals("equalsIgnoreCase");
                        var receiver = single(frame.getStack(frame.getStackSize() - 2)); var argument = single(frame.getStack(frame.getStackSize() - 1));
                        AbstractInsnNode constant, hashed;
                        if (isSdkHash(argument) && receiver instanceof LdcInsnNode) { constant = receiver; hashed = argument; }
                        else if (isSdkHash(receiver) && argument instanceof LdcInsnNode) { constant = argument; hashed = receiver; }
                        else continue;
                        if (!(((LdcInsnNode) constant).cst instanceof String text)) continue;
                        long value;
                        try { value = Long.parseLong(text); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { continue; }
                        String literal = literal(nodes, value, ignoreCase);
                        if (literal == null) { equalsUnresolved++; continue; }
                        // The hash's input: for equalsIgnoreCase, x.toLowerCase() (its call goes too).
                        int at = index(insns, hashed);
                        var input = at < 0 || frames[at] == null ? null : single(frames[at].getStack(frames[at].getStackSize() - 1));
                        boolean lower = ignoreCase && input instanceof MethodInsnNode m && m.owner.equals("java/lang/String") && m.name.equals("toLowerCase") && m.desc.equals("()Ljava/lang/String;");
                        edits.add(() -> {
                            ((LdcInsnNode) constant).cst = literal;
                            method.instructions.remove(hashed);
                            if (lower) method.instructions.remove(input);
                        });
                        equalsRecovered++;
                    }
                }
                if (!edits.isEmpty()) { edits.forEach(Runnable::run); changed.add(node.name); }
            }
        }
        // The runtime goes when nothing outside sdk/ refers to it.
        boolean referenced = false;
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (node.name.startsWith("sdk/")) continue;
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.startsWith("sdk/") || insn instanceof TypeInsnNode type && type.desc.startsWith("sdk/")
                        || insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field && field.owner.startsWith("sdk/")) referenced = true;
        }
        if (!referenced) for (var name : nodes.keySet()) if (name.startsWith("sdk/")) { removedClasses.add(name); sdkClassesRemoved++; }
    }

    private static boolean isSdkHash(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        return insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals(SDK) && call.name.equals("hash") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;");
    }

    private static AbstractInsnNode single(SourceValue value) { return value.insns.size() == 1 ? value.insns.iterator().next() : null; }

    private static int index(AbstractInsnNode[] insns, AbstractInsnNode insn) { for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) if (insns[i] == insn) return i; return -1; }

    /** {@code hash; seed; call} with nothing but labels-free code between: they are removed as one. */
    private static boolean adjacent(AbstractInsnNode hash, AbstractInsnNode seed, AbstractInsnNode call) {
        return SeedInterpreter.next(hash) == seed && SeedInterpreter.next(seed) == call;
    }

    private String typeName(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, int seed, String hash) {
        long value;
        try { value = Long.parseLong(hash); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { return null; }
        var table = typeTables.computeIfAbsent(seed, s -> {
            var function = LongHashFunction.xx3(s);
            var result = new HashMap<Long,String>();
            for (String name : typeNames(nodes)) result.putIfAbsent(function.hashChars(name), name);
            return result;
        });
        return table.get(value);
    }

    /** Internal names of the jar's classes, every type the jar mentions, and the JDK's classes. */
    private Set<String> typeNames(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        if (typeNames != null) return typeNames;
        var names = new TreeSet<String>(nodes.keySet());
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (node.superName != null) names.add(node.superName);
            names.addAll(node.interfaces);
            for (var field : node.fields) addType(names, Type.getType(field.desc));
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                for (var type : Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc)) addType(names, type);
                addType(names, Type.getReturnType(method.desc));
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode t) addType(names, Type.getObjectType(t.desc));
                    else if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode m) addType(names, Type.getObjectType(m.owner));
                    else if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f) { addType(names, Type.getObjectType(f.owner)); addType(names, Type.getType(f.desc)); }
                    else if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode l && l.cst instanceof Type t && t.getSort() != Type.METHOD) addType(names, t);
                }
                for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) if (block.type != null) names.add(block.type);
            }
        }
        try {
            var jrt = FileSystems.getFileSystem(URI.create("jrt:/"));
            try (var paths = Files.walk(jrt.getPath("/modules"))) {
                paths.forEach(path -> {
                    String text = path.toString();
                    if (!text.endsWith(".class") || path.getNameCount() < 3) return;
                    String name = path.subpath(2, path.getNameCount()).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                    names.add(name.substring(0, name.length() - ".class".length()));
                });
            }
        } catch (Exception error) {
            // Without the runtime image only the jar's own names are tried.
        }
        typeNames = names;
        return names;
    }

    /** Short strings found by {@link #search}, for every equals hash of the jar (computed once). */
    private Map<Long,String> searched;

    private Map<Long,String> searched(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        if (searched != null) return searched;
        var wanted = new HashSet<Long>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (isSdkHash(insn)) {
                        for (var near : new AbstractInsnNode[] {SeedInterpreter.next(insn), SeedInterpreter.previous(insn), SeedInterpreter.previous(SeedInterpreter.previous(insn))})
                            if (near instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String text)
                                try { wanted.add(Long.parseLong(text)); } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
                    }
        searched = wanted.isEmpty() ? Map.of() : search(wanted);
        return searched;
    }

    static final String LOWER = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", MIXED = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_-. ";

    /**
     * A bounded exhaustive search for the literals behind equals hashes: every lower-case string of 1..6 letters and every
     * string of 1..4 characters from letters, digits, {@code _-.} and space (about 360 million candidates, in parallel).
     * Longer or other literals stay unrecovered.
     */
    static Map<Long,String> search(Set<Long> wanted) {
        var found = new java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<Long,String>();
        for (var plan : List.of(new Object[] {LOWER, 6}, new Object[] {MIXED, 4})) {
            String alphabet = (String) plan[0]; int max = (Integer) plan[1];
            java.util.stream.IntStream.range(0, alphabet.length()).parallel().forEach(first -> {
                var function = LongHashFunction.xx3();
                char[] buffer = new char[max];
                buffer[0] = alphabet.charAt(first);
                if (wanted.contains(function.hashChars(buffer, 0, 1))) found.putIfAbsent(function.hashChars(buffer, 0, 1), new String(buffer, 0, 1));
                for (int length = 2; length <= max; length++) {
                    int[] digits = new int[length];
                    for (int k = 1; k < length; k++) buffer[k] = alphabet.charAt(0);
                    while (true) {
                        long h = function.hashChars(buffer, 0, length);
                        if (wanted.contains(h)) found.putIfAbsent(h, new String(buffer, 0, length));
                        int k = length - 1;
                        while (k >= 1 && ++digits[k] == alphabet.length()) { digits[k] = 0; buffer[k] = alphabet.charAt(0); k--; }
                        if (k < 1) break;
                        buffer[k] = alphabet.charAt(digits[k]);
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        return found;
    }

    private static void addType(Set<String> names, Type type) {
        if (type.getSort() == Type.ARRAY) type = type.getElementType();
        if (type.getSort() == Type.OBJECT) names.add(type.getInternalName());
    }

    /** A dictionary of the jar's strings, names and their lower-case forms, keyed by unseeded XXH3. */
    private String literal(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, long hash, boolean ignoreCase) {
        if (unseeded == null) {
            var function = LongHashFunction.xx3();
            var words = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
            for (var node : nodes.values()) {
                if (node.name.startsWith("sdk/")) continue;
                String simple = node.name.substring(node.name.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
                words.add(simple); words.add(simple.substring(simple.lastIndexOf('$') + 1));
                for (var field : node.fields) { words.add(field.name); if (field.value instanceof String s) words.add(s); }
                for (var method : node.methods) {
                    words.add(method.name);
                    for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String s && s.length() <= 4096) words.add(s);
                }
            }
            unseeded = new HashMap<>();
            for (String word : words) {
                unseeded.putIfAbsent(function.hashChars(word), word);
                unseeded.putIfAbsent(function.hashChars(word.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)), word);
            }
        }
        String found = unseeded.get(hash);
        if (found == null) found = searched(nodes).get(hash);
        if (found == null) return null;
        // equals needs the exact text; equalsIgnoreCase accepts any casing (the dictionary's spelling is kept).
        if (!ignoreCase && LongHashFunction.xx3().hashChars(found) != hash) return null;
        return found;
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SeedAnalyzer.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.AnalyzerException;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Frame;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntPredicate;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: a forward data-flow analysis over one method with {@link SeedInterpreter} values, path-sensitive on int
 * branches: when a branch tests a value computed from a local by known operations, each edge carries the local's set
 * narrowed to the inputs that take that edge, and an edge no input takes is not followed. This is what makes the
 * obfuscator's per-block seed a single constant in every block, even after an exception handler (where the seed is one of
 * the protected blocks' seeds until the handler's switch on its hash sorts them).
 *
 * <p>Only the frames are computed; nothing is executed.
 */
final class SeedAnalyzer implements Opcodes {
    /** {@code assumed}: branches decided by the trap invariant, not by evaluation. */
    record Result(AbstractInsnNode[] insns, Frame<SV>[] frames, Map<AbstractInsnNode,Set<Integer>> feasible, Set<AbstractInsnNode> assumed) {
        int index(AbstractInsnNode insn) { for (int i = 0; i < insns.length; i++) if (insns[i] == insn) return i; return -1; }
    }

    static final int WIDEN_AFTER = 6;
    private final Set<AbstractInsnNode> assumed = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
    private MethodNode current;
    private AbstractInsnNode[] currentInsns;
    private Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> currentIndex;
    private final SeedInterpreter interpreter;
    /** Why the last {@link #analyze} returned null. */
    String lastFailure = "";
    SeedAnalyzer(SeedInterpreter interpreter) { this.interpreter = interpreter; }

    /** Null when the method cannot be analyzed (JSR/RET, a budget overrun or a malformed body). */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    Result analyze(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer,int[]> knownParameters) { return analyze(owner, method, knownParameters, Set.of()); }

    /** {@code seedLocals}: locals known to hold the obfuscator's seed (from earlier rounds); what they store stays tainted. */
    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    Result analyze(String owner, MethodNode method, Map<Integer,int[]> knownParameters, Set<Integer> seedLocals) {
        var insns = method.instructions.toArray();
        int n = insns.length;
        if (n == 0) { lastFailure = "no code"; return null; }
        var index = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) index.put(insns[i], i);
        var handlers = new ArrayList<List<TryCatchBlockNode>>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) handlers.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (var block : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
            int start = index.get(block.start), end = index.get(block.end);
            for (int i = start; i < end; i++) handlers.get(i).add(block);
        }
        Frame<SV>[] frames = new Frame[n];
        current = method; currentInsns = insns; currentIndex = index;
        var initial = new Frame<SV>(method.maxLocals, method.maxStack);
        boolean isStatic = (method.access & ACC_STATIC) != 0;
        int local = 0;
        if (!isStatic) initial.setLocal(local++, method.name.equals("<init>") ? SV.ref(owner, null) : SV.ref(owner, null));
        for (var type : Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc)) {
            SV value = interpreter.newValue(type);
            if (knownParameters.containsKey(local)) value = SV.ints(knownParameters.get(local), null, true);
            initial.setLocal(local++, value);
            if (type.getSize() == 2) initial.setLocal(local++, SV.UNINIT);
        }
        while (local < method.maxLocals) initial.setLocal(local++, SV.UNINIT);
        initial.setReturn(interpreter.newValue(Type.getReturnType(method.desc)));
        var queue = new ArrayDeque<Integer>();
        var queued = new boolean[n];
        var widenings = new int[n];
        frames[0] = initial; queue.add(0); queued[0] = true;
        long budget = 200L * n + 20_000;
        try {
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
                if (--budget < 0) { lastFailure = "budget"; return null; }
                int i = queue.poll(); queued[i] = false;
                var insn = insns[i];
                var frame = frames[i];
                int op = insn.getOpcode();
                if (op == JSR || op == RET) { lastFailure = "jsr"; return null; }
                // Only an instruction that can throw reaches a handler; the seed stores between them never do, so the handler
                // sees exactly the seeds of the protected blocks.
                if (MethodRewriter.canThrow(insn)) for (var block : handlers.get(i)) {
                    var handlerFrame = new Frame<SV>(frame);
                    handlerFrame.clearStack();
                    handlerFrame.push(SV.ref(block.type == null ? "java/lang/Throwable" : block.type, null));
                    merge(frames, index.get(block.handler), handlerFrame, queue, queued, i, null);
                }
                if (op < 0) { if (i + 1 < n) merge(frames, i + 1, new Frame<>(frame), queue, queued, i, widenings); continue; }
                var out = new Frame<SV>(frame);
                out.execute(insn, interpreter);
                if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.getOpcode() >= ISTORE && var.getOpcode() <= ASTORE) {
                    invalidate(out, var.var);
                    if (var.getOpcode() == ISTORE && seedLocals.contains(var.var)) out.setLocal(var.var, out.getLocal(var.var).taint());
                }
                if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc) invalidate(out, inc.var);
                for (var edge : edges(insn, frame, out, index, i)) {
                    if (edge.target >= n) continue;
                    merge(frames, edge.target, edge.frame, queue, queued, i, widenings);
                }
            }
        } catch (AnalyzerException | RuntimeException error) {
            lastFailure = error.toString();
            return null;
        }
        // Feasible successors of every reachable branch, from the fixed-point frames.
        var feasible = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Set<Integer>>();
        assumed.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (frames[i] == null) continue;
            var insn = insns[i];
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode || insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) {
                var out = new Frame<SV>(frames[i]);
                try { out.execute(insn, interpreter); } catch (AnalyzerException error) { return null; }
                var targets = new TreeSet<Integer>();
                for (var edge : edges(insn, frames[i], out, index, i)) targets.add(edge.target);
                feasible.put(insn, targets);
            }
        }
        return new Result(insns, frames, feasible, Set.copyOf(assumed));
    }

    private record Edge(int target, Frame<SV> frame) {}

    /** The successors of {@code insn}, each with its frame narrowed by the branch it takes; infeasible edges are absent. */
    private List<Edge> edges(AbstractInsnNode insn, Frame<SV> before, Frame<SV> after, Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> index, int i) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        var edges = new ArrayList<Edge>();
        if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) {
            int target = index.get(jump.label);
            if (op == GOTO) { edges.add(new Edge(target, after)); return edges; }
            if (op >= IFEQ && op <= IFLE || op >= IF_ICMPEQ && op <= IF_ICMPLE) {
                SV left, right;
                if (op <= IFLE) { left = before.getStack(before.getStackSize() - 1); right = SV.literal(0); }
                else { left = before.getStack(before.getStackSize() - 2); right = before.getStack(before.getStackSize() - 1); }
                int cmp = op <= IFLE ? op : op - IF_ICMPEQ + IFEQ;
                // Only the obfuscator's tests are decided; the program's own branches on constants stay as written.
                if (!left.tainted && !right.tainted) { edges.add(new Edge(target, after)); edges.add(new Edge(i + 1, after)); }
                else {
                    branch(edges, after, left, right, cmp, true, target);
                    branch(edges, after, left, right, cmp, false, i + 1);
                }
                // Skidfuscator's trap invariant: when only the obfuscator's values are compared and the analysis cannot decide,
                // the side that goes straight to a trap (an uncaught throw it planted) is the one never taken.
                // With known constants on both sides the outcome is evaluated (and must avoid the trap); otherwise it is assumed.
                if (edges.size() == 2 && obfuscatorOnly(left) && obfuscatorOnly(right)) {
                    boolean trapTaken = trap(target), trapFallthrough = trap(i + 1);
                    if (trapTaken != trapFallthrough) {
                        int dropped = trapTaken ? target : i + 1;
                        if (left.singleton() && right.singleton()) {
                            boolean taken = Interpret.compare(cmp, left.single(), right.single());
                            int kept = taken ? target : i + 1;
                            if (kept != dropped) edges.removeIf(edge -> edge.target == dropped);
                        } else {
                            edges.removeIf(edge -> edge.target == dropped);
                            assumed.add(insn);
                        }
                    }
                }
                return edges;
            }
            edges.add(new Edge(target, after)); edges.add(new Edge(i + 1, after)); // reference comparisons, null checks
            return edges;
        }
        if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) {
            SV key = before.getStack(before.getStackSize() - 1);
            if (!key.tainted) key = SV.INT_TOP;
            var cases = new LinkedHashMap<Integer,LabelNode>();
            LabelNode dflt;
            if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) {
                for (int k = 0; k < table.labels.size(); k++) cases.put(table.min + k, table.labels.get(k));
                dflt = table.dflt;
            } else {
                var lookup = (LookupSwitchInsnNode) insn;
                for (int k = 0; k < lookup.keys.size(); k++) cases.put(lookup.keys.get(k), lookup.labels.get(k));
                dflt = lookup.dflt;
            }
            for (var entry : cases.entrySet()) {
                int k = entry.getKey();
                var frame = narrow(after, key, value -> value == k);
                if (frame != null) edges.add(new Edge(index.get(entry.getValue()), frame));
            }
            var frame = narrow(after, key, value -> !cases.containsKey(value));
            if (frame != null) edges.add(new Edge(index.get(dflt), frame));
            return edges;
        }
        if (op >= IRETURN && op <= RETURN || op == ATHROW) return edges;
        edges.add(new Edge(i + 1, after));
        return edges;
    }

    private static boolean obfuscatorOnly(SV value) { return value.kind == SV.Kind.INT && (value.tainted || value.literal); }

    /**
     * A trap: straight-line code from {@code at} that throws {@code null} or a new exception built without an argument (or
     * with Skidfuscator's "Error in hash"), not caught by a handler of exactly that type (that would be a throw-goto).
     */
    private boolean trap(int at) {
        if (closedLoop(at)) return true;
        int steps = 0;
        for (int i = at; i < currentInsns.length && steps < 12; i++) {
            var insn = currentInsns[i];
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            if (op < 0) continue;
            steps++;
            if (op == ACONST_NULL) { var next = nextReal(i + 1); return next != null && next.getOpcode() == ATHROW; }
            if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode alloc && op == NEW) {
                var dup = nextReal(i + 1);
                if (dup == null || dup.getOpcode() != DUP) return false;
                var arg = nextReal(currentIndex.get(dup) + 1);
                var init = arg instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && "Error in hash".equals(ldc.cst) ? nextReal(currentIndex.get(arg) + 1) : arg;
                if (!(init instanceof MethodInsnNode ctor) || !ctor.name.equals("<init>") || !ctor.owner.equals(alloc.desc)) return false;
                var athrow = nextReal(currentIndex.get(init) + 1);
                if (athrow == null || athrow.getOpcode() != ATHROW) return false;
                int t = currentIndex.get(athrow);
                for (var block : current.tryCatchBlocks)
                    if (t >= currentIndex.get(block.start) && t < currentIndex.get(block.end) && alloc.desc.equals(block.type)) return false;
                return true;
            }
            // A trap may first scramble a seed field: constants, field reads, XOR and field writes only.
            boolean scramble = op >= ICONST_M1 && op <= LDC || op == GETSTATIC || op == GETFIELD || op == PUTSTATIC || op == PUTFIELD
                || op == IXOR || op == ALOAD || op == ILOAD;
            if (!scramble) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /**
     * A region reachable from {@code at} (at most 48 instructions) that has no way out and no side effect: constants, local
     * loads and stores, arithmetic, stack moves, static calls with primitive descriptors, jumps and switches inside the
     * region. Skidfuscator plants such endless loops as traps too.
     */
    private boolean closedLoop(int at) {
        var seen = new HashSet<Integer>();
        var pending = new ArrayDeque<Integer>(List.of(at));
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            int i = pending.poll();
            if (i >= currentInsns.length || !seen.add(i)) continue;
            if (seen.size() > 48) return false;
            var insn = currentInsns[i];
            int op = insn.getOpcode();
            if (op < 0) { pending.add(i + 1); continue; }
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) {
                if (op == JSR) return false;
                pending.add(currentIndex.get(jump.label));
                if (op != GOTO) pending.add(i + 1);
                continue;
            }
            if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) {
                pending.add(currentIndex.get(table.dflt)); for (var l : table.labels) pending.add(currentIndex.get(l)); continue;
            }
            if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) {
                pending.add(currentIndex.get(lookup.dflt)); for (var l : lookup.labels) pending.add(currentIndex.get(l)); continue;
            }
            boolean pure = op >= ACONST_NULL && op <= DLOAD || op >= ISTORE && op <= DSTORE || op >= POP && op <= DCMPG || op == IINC
                || insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && op == INVOKESTATIC && PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc);
            if (!pure) return false;
            pending.add(i + 1);
        }
        return !seen.isEmpty();
    }

    private AbstractInsnNode nextReal(int from) {
        for (int i = from; i < currentInsns.length; i++) if (currentInsns[i].getOpcode() >= 0) return currentInsns[i];
        return null;
    }

    private void branch(List<Edge> edges, Frame<SV> after, SV left, SV right, int cmp, boolean taken, int target) {
        Frame<SV> frame;
        if (right.singleton() && left.kind == SV.Kind.INT) {
            int c = right.single();
            frame = narrow(after, left, v -> Interpret.compare(cmp, v, c) == taken);
        } else if (left.singleton() && right.kind == SV.Kind.INT) {
            int c = left.single();
            frame = narrow(after, right, v -> Interpret.compare(cmp, c, v) == taken);
        } else frame = after;
        if (frame != null) edges.add(new Edge(target, frame));
    }

    /**
     * The frame on an edge where {@code tested} satisfies {@code keep}: null when no possible value does. When the tested
     * value comes from a local, that local's set is narrowed to the inputs that take the edge.
     */
    private static Frame<SV> narrow(Frame<SV> after, SV tested, IntPredicate keep) {
        if (tested.kind != SV.Kind.INT) return after;
        if (tested.ints != null) {
            boolean any = false;
            for (int v : tested.ints) if (keep.test(v)) { any = true; break; }
            if (!any) return null;
        }
        var prov = tested.prov;
        if (prov == null || prov.local() >= after.getLocals()) return after;
        SV local = after.getLocal(prov.local());
        if (local.kind != SV.Kind.INT || local.ints == null) return after;
        var kept = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int s : local.ints) {
            Integer v = prov.fn().apply(s);
            if (v == null || keep.test(v)) kept.add(s);
        }
        if (kept.isEmpty()) return null;
        if (kept.size() == local.ints.length) return after;
        var frame = new Frame<SV>(after);
        frame.setLocal(prov.local(), SV.ints(SV.sorted(kept), null, local.tainted));
        return frame;
    }

    /** A store to {@code local} makes stack values computed from its old value lose that provenance. */
    private static void invalidate(Frame<SV> frame, int local) {
        for (int s = 0; s < frame.getStackSize(); s++) {
            SV value = frame.getStack(s);
            if (value.prov != null && value.prov.local() == local) frame.setStack(s, value.withoutProv());
        }
        for (int l = 0; l < frame.getLocals(); l++) {
            SV value = frame.getLocal(l);
            if (value.prov != null) frame.setLocal(l, value.withoutProv());
        }
    }

    /**
     * Merges into a successor's frame. Along a backward edge (a loop), after {@value #WIDEN_AFTER} changes, int values that
     * still grow become unknown (their taint kept): a loop counter initialized from a decrypted constant would otherwise
     * grow one value per iteration. Handler entries (merged from the protected instructions) are never widened, so the set
     * of seeds a handler can see stays exact.
     */
    private void merge(Frame<SV>[] frames, int target, Frame<SV> frame, Deque<Integer> queue, boolean[] queued, int source, int[] widenings)
            throws AnalyzerException {
        if (frames[target] == null) {
            frames[target] = new Frame<>(frame);
        } else {
            var before = new Frame<SV>(frames[target]);
            if (!frames[target].merge(frame, interpreter)) return;
            if (widenings != null && target <= source && ++widenings[target] > WIDEN_AFTER) {
                var merged = frames[target];
                for (int l = 0; l < merged.getLocals(); l++) {
                    SV value = merged.getLocal(l);
                    if (value.kind == SV.Kind.INT && value.ints != null && !value.equals(before.getLocal(l)))
                        merged.setLocal(l, SV.ints(null, null, value.tainted));
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < merged.getStackSize(); k++) {
                    SV value = merged.getStack(k);
                    if (value.kind == SV.Kind.INT && value.ints != null && !value.equals(before.getStack(k)))
                        merged.setStack(k, SV.ints(null, null, value.tainted));
                }
            }
        }
        if (!queued[target]) { queued[target] = true; queue.add(target); }
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SeedInterpreter.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.AnalyzerException;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Interpreter;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntFunction;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: the transfer functions of the seed analysis. Int constants, int arithmetic, the obfuscator's seed fields,
 * {@code Integer.parseInt("digits")}, {@code new Random(long).nextInt()} and calls to statically evaluable pure
 * methods produce finite sets; everything else is unknown.
 */
final class SeedInterpreter extends Interpreter<SV> implements Opcodes {
    /** Values the jar-wide model knows: the obfuscator's seed fields. */
    interface Facts {
        Integer staticInt(String owner, String name, String desc);
        Integer instanceInt(String owner, String name, String desc);
        /** The obfuscator's own hash and XOR helpers (a factory class method, a per-class XOR helper). */
        boolean hashFunction(String owner, String name, String desc);
    }
    static final int MAX_PRODUCT = 4096;
    private final Facts facts;
    private final PureEvaluator pure;
    private final Map<List<Object>,SV.Prov> provs = new HashMap<>();
    private final Map<List<Object>,Optional<Object>> calls = new HashMap<>();
    /** Constant pushes the reversal itself wrote in place of obfuscator values (they stay the obfuscator's in later rounds). */
    private Set<AbstractInsnNode> generated = Set.of();
    void generated(Set<AbstractInsnNode> pushes) { this.generated = pushes; }

    SeedInterpreter(Facts facts, PureEvaluator pure) { super(ASM9); this.facts = facts; this.pure = pure; }

    private SV.Prov prov(List<Object> key, int local, IntFunction<Integer> fn) {
        return provs.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new SV.Prov(local, fn));
    }

    @Override public SV newValue(Type type) {
        if (type == null) return SV.UNINIT;
        return switch (type.getSort()) {
            case Type.VOID -> null;
            case Type.BOOLEAN, Type.CHAR, Type.BYTE, Type.SHORT, Type.INT -> SV.INT_TOP;
            case Type.FLOAT -> SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case Type.LONG -> SV.LONG_TOP;
            case Type.DOUBLE -> SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case Type.ARRAY -> SV.ref(type.getDescriptor(), null);
            case Type.OBJECT -> SV.ref(type.getInternalName(), null);
            default -> SV.REF_TOP;
        };
    }

    @Override public SV newOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        SV value = newOperation0(insn);
        return generated.contains(insn) ? value.taint() : value;
    }

    private SV newOperation0(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        switch (op) {
            case ACONST_NULL: return SV.ref(null, null);
            case ICONST_M1, ICONST_0, ICONST_1, ICONST_2, ICONST_3, ICONST_4, ICONST_5: return SV.literal(op - ICONST_0);
            case LCONST_0, LCONST_1: return SV.longConstant((long) (op - LCONST_0));
            case FCONST_0, FCONST_1, FCONST_2: return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case DCONST_0, DCONST_1: return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case BIPUSH, SIPUSH: return SV.literal(((IntInsnNode) insn).operand);
            case LDC: {
                Object cst = ((LdcInsnNode) insn).cst;
                if (cst instanceof Integer value) return SV.literal(value);
                if (cst instanceof Long value) return SV.longConstant(value);
                if (cst instanceof Float) return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
                if (cst instanceof Double) return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
                if (cst instanceof String text) return SV.ref("java/lang/String", text);
                if (cst instanceof Type type) return SV.ref(type.getSort() == Type.METHOD ? "java/lang/invoke/MethodType" : "java/lang/Class", null);
                return SV.REF_TOP;
            }
            case JSR: return SV.RET;
            case GETSTATIC: {
                var field = (FieldInsnNode) insn;
                Integer known = facts.staticInt(field.owner, field.name, field.desc);
                return known != null ? SV.of(known).taint() : newValue(Type.getType(field.desc));
            }
            case NEW: return SV.ref(((TypeInsnNode) insn).desc, null);
            default: throw new IllegalStateException("newOperation " + op);
        }
    }

    @Override public SV copyOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV value) {
        if (insn.getOpcode() == ILOAD && value.kind == SV.Kind.INT) {
            int local = ((VarInsnNode) insn).var;
            return value.withProv(prov(List.of(insn), local, s -> s));
        }
        if (insn.getOpcode() >= ISTORE && insn.getOpcode() <= ASTORE) return value.withoutProv();
        return value;
    }

    @Override public SV unaryOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV value) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        switch (op) {
            case INEG, I2B, I2C, I2S: return mapInt(insn, value, v -> Interpret.unaryInt(op, v));
            case IINC: {
                int incr = ((IincInsnNode) insn).incr;
                SV mapped = mapInt(insn, value, v -> v + incr);
                return mapped.withoutProv();
            }
            case L2I, F2I, D2I: return SV.INT_TOP;
            case I2L, F2L, D2L: return SV.LONG_TOP;
            case I2F, L2F, D2F: return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case I2D, L2D, F2D: return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case LNEG: return SV.LONG_TOP;
            case FNEG: return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case DNEG: return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case GETFIELD: {
                var field = (FieldInsnNode) insn;
                Integer known = facts.instanceInt(field.owner, field.name, field.desc);
                return known != null ? SV.of(known).taint() : newValue(Type.getType(field.desc));
            }
            case NEWARRAY: {
                String desc = switch (((IntInsnNode) insn).operand) {
                    case T_BOOLEAN -> "[Z"; case T_CHAR -> "[C"; case T_BYTE -> "[B"; case T_SHORT -> "[S"; case T_INT -> "[I";
                    case T_FLOAT -> "[F"; case T_DOUBLE -> "[D"; default -> "[J"; };
                return SV.ref(desc, null);
            }
            case ANEWARRAY: return SV.ref("[" + Type.getObjectType(((TypeInsnNode) insn).desc).getDescriptor(), null);
            case ARRAYLENGTH, INSTANCEOF: return SV.INT_TOP;
            case CHECKCAST: return SV.ref(((TypeInsnNode) insn).desc, value.constant);
            default: return null; // branches, switches, returns, PUTSTATIC, ATHROW, monitors
        }
    }

    private SV mapInt(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV value, IntFunction<Integer> fn) {
        if (value.kind != SV.Kind.INT) return SV.INT_TOP;
        int[] result = null;
        if (value.ints != null) {
            var out = new ArrayList<Integer>(value.ints.length);
            for (int v : value.ints) { Integer r = fn.apply(v); if (r == null) { out = null; break; } out.add(r); }
            if (out != null) result = SV.sorted(out);
        }
        SV.Prov prov = null;
        if (value.prov != null) {
            var parent = value.prov;
            prov = prov(List.of(insn, parent), parent.local(), s -> { Integer p = parent.fn().apply(s); return p == null ? null : fn.apply(p); });
        }
        return SV.ints(result, prov, value.tainted);
    }

    @Override public SV binaryOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV a, SV b) {
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        switch (op) {
            case IADD, ISUB, IMUL, IDIV, IREM, ISHL, ISHR, IUSHR, IAND, IOR, IXOR: {
                int[] result = null;
                if (a.kind == SV.Kind.INT && b.kind == SV.Kind.INT && a.ints != null && b.ints != null && (long) a.ints.length * b.ints.length <= MAX_PRODUCT) {
                    var out = new TreeSet<Integer>();
                    boolean failed = false;
                    for (int x : a.ints) for (int y : b.ints) { Integer r = Interpret.binaryInt(op, x, y); if (r == null) failed = true; else out.add(r); }
                    if (!failed) result = SV.sorted(out);
                }
                SV.Prov prov = null;
                if (a.prov != null && b.singleton()) {
                    var parent = a.prov; int c = b.single();
                    prov = prov(List.of(insn, parent, "L", c), parent.local(), s -> { Integer p = parent.fn().apply(s); return p == null ? null : Interpret.binaryInt(op, p, c); });
                } else if (b.prov != null && a.singleton()) {
                    var parent = b.prov; int c = a.single();
                    prov = prov(List.of(insn, parent, "R", c), parent.local(), s -> { Integer p = parent.fn().apply(s); return p == null ? null : Interpret.binaryInt(op, c, p); });
                }
                // javac folds operations on two literals; an unfolded one is the obfuscator's. An operation with a value of
                // the program (neither literal nor obfuscator-derived) is the program's, even if its other operand was decrypted.
                boolean constantA = a.tainted || a.literal, constantB = b.tainted || b.literal;
                return SV.ints(result, prov, constantA && constantB);
            }
            case LADD, LSUB, LMUL, LDIV, LREM, LSHL, LSHR, LUSHR, LAND, LOR, LXOR: return SV.LONG_TOP;
            case FADD, FSUB, FMUL, FDIV, FREM: return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case DADD, DSUB, DMUL, DDIV, DREM: return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case LCMP, FCMPL, FCMPG, DCMPL, DCMPG: return SV.INT_TOP;
            case IALOAD, BALOAD, CALOAD, SALOAD: return SV.INT_TOP;
            case LALOAD: return SV.LONG_TOP;
            case FALOAD: return SV.FLOAT_TOP;
            case DALOAD: return SV.DOUBLE_TOP;
            case AALOAD: {
                String type = a.type != null && a.type.startsWith("[") ? a.type.substring(1) : null;
                if (type != null && type.startsWith("L")) type = type.substring(1, type.length() - 1);
                return SV.ref(type, null);
            }
            default: return null; // IF_ICMPxx, IF_ACMPxx, PUTFIELD
        }
    }

    @Override public SV ternaryOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV a, SV b, SV c) { return null; }

    @Override public SV naryOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, List<? extends SV> values) {
        if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
            Type result = Type.getReturnType(call.desc);
            if (call.getOpcode() == INVOKESTATIC) {
                if (call.owner.equals("java/lang/Integer") && call.name.equals("parseInt") && call.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)I")
                    && values.getFirst().constant instanceof String text) {
                    // Skidfuscator's constructor seed. It counts as a constant (like a literal): an operation joining it with the
                    // obfuscator's values is the obfuscator's; alone it stays as written.
                    try { return SV.literal(Integer.parseInt(text)); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { return SV.INT_TOP; }
                }
                // Only the obfuscator's functions, or a pure function applied to one of their results (Skidfuscator's
                // "pure function hashing"), are evaluated; the program's own calls on constants stay as they are.
                boolean own = facts.hashFunction(call.owner, call.name, call.desc);
                if (PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) && result.getSort() <= Type.INT
                    && (own || values.stream().anyMatch(v -> v.hashed))) {
                    SV evaluated = evaluate(call, values);
                    if (evaluated != null) return own && facts.hashFunction(call.owner, call.name, "hash") ? evaluated.hashedValue() : evaluated;
                    // A pure-function hash this analysis cannot evaluate (a java.awt method, say): its value is unknown but
                    // still the obfuscator's, so a test on it may be decided by Skidfuscator's trap invariant.
                    return SV.ints(null, null, true);
                }
                // A JDK pure function or factory hash on literals only (Skidfuscator sometimes emits the hash already
                // folded): a constant, but not the obfuscator's by itself; only a test guarding a trap is decided with it.
                if (PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) && result.getSort() <= Type.INT
                    && (own || PureEvaluator.Allowlist.CLASSES.contains(call.owner))
                    && values.stream().allMatch(v -> v.literal || v.kind == SV.Kind.LONG && v.constant != null)) {
                    SV evaluated = evaluate(call, values);
                    if (evaluated != null && evaluated.singleton()) return SV.literal(evaluated.single());
                }
                // A static function this analysis does not run (outside the allowlist) applied to literals of which one looks
                // like a folded seed hash (a 32-bit value, at least 2^20 in size): Skidfuscator's pure-function hash, opaque.
                if (PureEvaluator.primitiveDescriptor(call.desc) && result.getSort() <= Type.INT
                    && values.stream().allMatch(v -> v.literal || v.kind == SV.Kind.LONG && v.constant != null)
                    && values.stream().anyMatch(v -> v.singleton() && Math.abs((long) v.single()) >= 1 << 20)) {
                    return SV.ints(null, null, true);
                }
            }
            if (call.owner.equals("java/util/Random") && call.name.equals("nextInt") && call.desc.equals("()I")) {
                Long seed = randomSeed(call);
                if (seed != null) return SV.of(new Random(seed).nextInt()).taint();
            }
            return newValue(result);
        }
        if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) return newValue(Type.getReturnType(indy.desc));
        if (insn instanceof MultiANewArrayInsnNode array) return SV.ref(array.desc, null);
        return SV.REF_TOP;
    }

    /** {@code new Random(<ldc long>).nextInt()} written as one expression (Skidfuscator's class seed). */
    static Long randomSeed(MethodInsnNode nextInt) {
        var init = previous(nextInt);
        if (!(init instanceof MethodInsnNode ctor) || !ctor.owner.equals("java/util/Random") || !ctor.name.equals("<init>") || !ctor.desc.equals("(J)V")) return null;
        var ldc = previous(init);
        var dup = previous(ldc);
        var alloc = previous(dup);
        if (ldc instanceof LdcInsnNode constant && constant.cst instanceof Long seed && dup != null && dup.getOpcode() == DUP
            && alloc instanceof TypeInsnNode type && type.getOpcode() == NEW && type.desc.equals("java/util/Random")) return seed;
        return null;
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode next(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn == null) return null;
        for (var node = insn.getNext(); node != null; node = node.getNext()) if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return node;
        return null;
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode previous(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn == null) return null;
        for (var node = insn.getPrevious(); node != null; node = node.getPrevious()) if (node.getOpcode() >= 0) return node;
        return null;
    }

    private SV evaluate(MethodInsnNode call, List<? extends SV> values) {
        var types = Type.getArgumentTypes(call.desc);
        var choices = new ArrayList<Object[]>();
        int varying = -1; long product = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) {
            SV value = values.get(i);
            Object[] options;
            if (value.kind == SV.Kind.INT && value.ints != null) {
                options = Arrays.stream(value.ints).boxed().toArray();
                if (options.length > 1) varying = varying == -1 ? i : -2;
            } else if (value.kind == SV.Kind.LONG && value.constant instanceof Long constant) {
                options = new Object[] {constant};
            } else return null;
            product *= options.length;
            if (product > MAX_PRODUCT) return null;
            choices.add(options);
        }
        var out = new TreeSet<Integer>();
        var args = new Object[values.size()];
        if (!enumerate(call, choices, 0, args, out)) return null;
        SV.Prov prov = null;
        // Provenance through the call: exactly one argument varies (or is the only one with provenance) and the others are fixed.
        int provArg = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) if (values.get(i).prov != null) provArg = provArg == -1 ? i : -2;
        if (provArg >= 0 && (varying == -1 || varying == provArg)) {
            boolean fixed = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) if (i != provArg && choices.get(i).length != 1) fixed = false;
            if (fixed) {
                var parent = values.get(provArg).prov;
                Object[] base = new Object[values.size()];
                for (int i = 0; i < values.size(); i++) base[i] = choices.get(i)[0];
                int index = provArg;
                // Canonical per call, parent and fixed arguments (not the varying one), so a growing set keeps its provenance.
                var key = new ArrayList<Object>(Arrays.asList(base)); key.set(index, "varying");
                prov = prov(List.of(call, parent, key), parent.local(), s -> {
                    Integer p = parent.fn().apply(s);
                    if (p == null) return null;
                    Object[] actual = base.clone(); actual[index] = p;
                    Object r = call(call, actual);
                    return r instanceof Integer value ? value : null;
                });
            }
        }
        boolean tainted = values.stream().anyMatch(v -> v.tainted)
            && values.stream().allMatch(v -> v.tainted || v.literal || v.kind == SV.Kind.LONG && v.constant != null);
        return SV.ints(SV.sorted(out), prov, tainted);
    }

    private boolean enumerate(MethodInsnNode call, List<Object[]> choices, int i, Object[] args, Set<Integer> out) {
        if (i == choices.size()) {
            Object r = call(call, args.clone());
            if (!(r instanceof Integer value)) return false;
            out.add(value);
            return true;
        }
        for (Object option : choices.get(i)) { args[i] = option; if (!enumerate(call, choices, i + 1, args, out)) return false; }
        return true;
    }

    private Object call(MethodInsnNode call, Object[] args) {
        var key = new ArrayList<Object>(); key.add(call.owner); key.add(call.name); key.add(call.desc); key.addAll(Arrays.asList(args));
        return calls.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> pure.evaluate(call.owner, call.name, call.desc, args)).orElse(null);
    }

    @Override public void returnOperation(AbstractInsnNode insn, SV value, SV expected) { }

    @Override public SV merge(SV a, SV b) { return a.merge(b); }

    @Override public SV newExceptionValue(TryCatchBlockNode block, org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Frame<SV> frame, Type type) {
        return SV.ref(type.getInternalName(), null);
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SkidModel.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Frame;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: what the whole jar tells about Skidfuscator's seeds, found by static analysis only:
 * <ul>
 *   <li><b>class seed fields</b>: a static int of a class that its {@code <clinit>} sets to one obfuscator-derived
 *   constant ({@code new Random(long).nextInt() ^ C}); other writes are allowed only right before a throw (the
 *   obfuscator's traps);</li>
 *   <li><b>instance seed fields</b>: an int field that every constructor of the class sets to the same obfuscator-derived
 *   constant ({@code C ^ classSeed});</li>
 *   <li><b>injected seed parameters</b>: a trailing int parameter that the body only XORs, and that every call in the jar
 *   passes as a literal.</li>
 * </ul>
 */
final class SkidModel implements SeedInterpreter.Facts, Opcodes {
    final Map<String,ClassNode> classes;
    final PureEvaluator pure;
    final Map<String,Integer> staticSeeds = new HashMap<>();
    final Map<String,Integer> instanceSeeds = new HashMap<>();
    /** Method key {@code owner.name desc} to the parameter's local index and possible values. */
    final Map<String,Map<Integer,int[]>> seedParameters = new HashMap<>();

    SkidModel(Map<String,ClassNode> classes) {
        this.classes = classes;
        this.pure = new PureEvaluator(classes);
    }

    static String key(String owner, String name, String desc) { return owner + "." + name + desc; }

    @Override public Integer staticInt(String owner, String name, String desc) { return desc.equals("I") ? staticSeeds.get(owner + "." + name) : null; }
    @Override public Integer instanceInt(String owner, String name, String desc) { return desc.equals("I") ? instanceSeeds.get(owner + "." + name) : null; }

    SeedInterpreter interpreter() { return new SeedInterpreter(this, pure); }

    private Set<String> factories;
    /**
     * A method of a hash factory class (only pure static {@code (I)I} methods, no fields), or a per-class XOR helper
     * {@code static int x(int a, int b) { return b ^ a; }}. With {@code desc} "hash": only the factory hashes (whose
     * results are "hashed").
     */
    @Override public boolean hashFunction(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        if (factories == null) {
            factories = new HashSet<>();
            for (var node : classes.values()) if (SkidfuscatorReverser.factory(node, pure)) factories.add(node.name);
        }
        if (factories.contains(owner)) return true;
        if (desc.equals("hash")) return false;
        var node = classes.get(owner);
        if (node == null) return false;
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(name) && method.desc.equals(desc)) return SkidfuscatorReverser.xorHelper(method);
        return false;
    }

    void build() {
        findSeedParameters();
        var writes = fieldWrites();
        for (var node : classes.values()) {
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (!method.name.equals("<clinit>") || method.instructions.size() == 0) continue;
                collect(node.name, method, PUTSTATIC, writes, staticSeeds);
            }
        }
        for (var node : classes.values()) {
            // Every constructor that writes the field writes the same constant (one delegating with this(...) may not write it).
            var values = new HashMap<String,Set<Integer>>();
            var rejected = new HashSet<String>();
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (!method.name.equals("<init>") || method.instructions.size() == 0) continue;
                var found = new HashMap<String,Integer>();
                rejected.addAll(collect(node.name, method, PUTFIELD, writes, found));
                found.forEach((name, value) -> values.computeIfAbsent(name, k -> new HashSet<>()).add(value));
            }
            values.forEach((name, set) -> { if (set.size() == 1 && !rejected.contains(name)) instanceSeeds.put(name, set.iterator().next()); });
        }
    }

    /** Finds writes {@code owner.f = <one tainted constant>} of int fields of the class in one method; returns the rejected fields. */
    private Set<String> collect(String owner, MethodNode method, int opcode, Map<String,List<AbstractInsnNode>> writes, Map<String,Integer> into) {
        var result = new SeedAnalyzer(interpreter()).analyze(owner, method, seedParameters.getOrDefault(key(owner, method.name, method.desc), Map.of()));
        if (result == null) return Set.of();
        var candidates = new HashMap<String,Integer>();
        var rejected = new HashSet<String>();
        for (int i = 0; i < result.insns().length; i++) {
            Frame<SV> frame = result.frames()[i];
            if (frame == null || !(result.insns()[i] instanceof FieldInsnNode field) || field.getOpcode() != opcode
                || !field.owner.equals(owner) || !field.desc.equals("I")) continue;
            String name = owner + "." + field.name;
            SV value = frame.getStack(frame.getStackSize() - 1);
            if (!value.tainted || !value.singleton()) { rejected.add(name); continue; }
            Integer previous = candidates.putIfAbsent(name, value.single());
            if (previous != null && previous != value.single()) rejected.add(name);
        }
        for (var entry : candidates.entrySet()) {
            if (rejected.contains(entry.getKey())) continue;
            // Every other write in the jar must be a trap: straight-line code that ends in a throw.
            boolean onlyTraps = true;
            for (var write : writes.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), List.of())) {
                if (method.instructions.contains(write)) continue;
                if (!trap(write)) { onlyTraps = false; break; }
            }
            if (onlyTraps) into.put(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue()); else rejected.add(entry.getKey());
        }
        return rejected;
    }

    private static boolean trap(AbstractInsnNode write) {
        int steps = 0;
        for (var node = write.getNext(); node != null && steps < 16; node = node.getNext()) {
            int op = node.getOpcode();
            if (op < 0) continue;
            steps++;
            if (op == ATHROW) return true;
            if (node instanceof JumpInsnNode || node instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || node instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode
                || op >= IRETURN && op <= RETURN || node instanceof MethodInsnNode && !((MethodInsnNode) node).name.equals("<init>")) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private Map<String,List<AbstractInsnNode>> fieldWrites() {
        var writes = new HashMap<String,List<AbstractInsnNode>>();
        for (var node : classes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field && (insn.getOpcode() == PUTSTATIC || insn.getOpcode() == PUTFIELD) && field.desc.equals("I"))
                        writes.computeIfAbsent(field.owner + "." + field.name, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(insn);
        return writes;
    }

    /**
     * A trailing int parameter that the body only loads straight into an XOR (never stores), and that every call in the
     * jar with the same name and descriptor passes as a literal.
     */
    private void findSeedParameters() {
        var literals = new HashMap<String,Set<Integer>>();
        var nonLiteral = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var node : classes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || !call.desc.contains("I)")) continue;
                    String declaring = declaring(call.owner, call.name, call.desc);
                    if (declaring == null) continue; // a library method
                    String signature = key(declaring, call.name, call.desc);
                    var previous = SeedInterpreter.previous(call);
                    Integer literal = literal(previous);
                    if (literal == null) nonLiteral.add(signature);
                    else literals.computeIfAbsent(signature, k -> new TreeSet<>()).add(literal);
                }
        for (var node : classes.values()) {
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                var args = Type.getArgumentTypes(method.desc);
                if (args.length == 0 || args[args.length - 1].getSort() != Type.INT || method.instructions.size() == 0
                    || SkidfuscatorReverser.xorHelper(method)) continue;
                String signature = key(node.name, method.name, method.desc);
                if (nonLiteral.contains(signature) || !literals.containsKey(signature)) continue;
                // An override is called through its super type's signature too: every declaration of the group must qualify.
                if (overridesOutside(node, method)) continue;
                int slot = (method.access & ACC_STATIC) != 0 ? 0 : 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < args.length - 1; k++) slot += args[k].getSize();
                int loads = 0; boolean onlyXor = true;
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode var && var.var == slot) {
                        if (var.getOpcode() != ILOAD) { onlyXor = false; break; }
                        loads++;
                        var next = SeedInterpreter.next(insn);
                        if (next == null || next.getOpcode() != IXOR) { onlyXor = false; break; }
                    }
                    if (insn instanceof IincInsnNode inc && inc.var == slot) { onlyXor = false; break; }
                }
                if (!onlyXor || loads == 0) continue;
                int[] values = literals.get(signature).stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray();
                seedParameters.put(key(node.name, method.name, method.desc), Map.of(slot, values));
            }
        }
    }

    /** The jar class that declares {@code name desc} for a call on {@code owner} (walking up the super classes), or null. */
    String declaring(String owner, String name, String desc) {
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        for (String type = owner; type != null && seen.add(type); ) {
            var node = classes.get(type);
            if (node == null) return null;
            for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(name) && method.desc.equals(desc)) return type;
            type = node.superName;
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** True when a super class or interface (in the jar or not) also declares the method: calls may name the other owner. */
    private boolean overridesOutside(ClassNode node, MethodNode method) {
        if (method.name.startsWith("<") || (method.access & (ACC_STATIC | ACC_PRIVATE)) != 0) return false;
        var pending = new ArrayDeque<String>();
        if (node.superName != null) pending.add(node.superName);
        pending.addAll(node.interfaces);
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        while (!pending.isEmpty()) {
            String type = pending.poll();
            if (!seen.add(type)) continue;
            var parent = classes.get(type);
            if (parent == null) return !type.equals("java/lang/Object") || method.name.equals("hashCode") || method.name.equals("equals");
            for (var other : parent.methods) if (other.name.equals(method.name) && other.desc.equals(method.desc)) return true;
            if (parent.superName != null) pending.add(parent.superName);
            pending.addAll(parent.interfaces);
        }
        return false;
    }

    static Integer literal(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn == null) return null;
        int op = insn.getOpcode();
        if (op >= ICONST_M1 && op <= ICONST_5) return op - ICONST_0;
        if (op == BIPUSH || op == SIPUSH) return ((IntInsnNode) insn).operand;
        if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof Integer value) return value;
        return null;
    }
}
```
