`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SkidfuscatorReverser.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import dev.classrevive.transforms.TransformResult;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CN: reverses Skidfuscator's flow obfuscation over a whole jar, statically. It recovers the per-block seed
 * (class seed fields, injected seed parameters, {@code Integer.parseInt} and {@code Random(long).nextInt()} seeds, the
 * hash functions of the factory class and pure JDK methods, evaluated on constants), folds the encrypted numbers,
 * decides the opaque predicates and seed switches, turns the caught-throw gotos back into jumps, removes the dead traps,
 * and then the seed fields, the hash factory and the XOR helpers once nothing uses them. Target code is never executed.
 * The obfuscator's own idea of "seed" is recognized by taint (see {@link SV#tainted}), so the program's own constants and
 * branches are left as they are.
 */
public final class SkidfuscatorReverser implements Opcodes {
    public static final String ID = "skidfuscator";

    /** Totals for the report: named counts in pass order, refused methods, kept parameters and classes that could not be written (up to 20 each). */
    public record Report(boolean detected, Map<String,Integer> counts, List<String> refused, List<String> parametersKept, List<String> writeFailures) {
        public Report { counts = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(counts)); refused = List.copyOf(refused); parametersKept = List.copyOf(parametersKept);
            writeFailures = List.copyOf(writeFailures); }
        public int count(String name) { return counts.getOrDefault(name, 0); }
        @Override public String toString() {
            var out = new StringBuilder("Skidfuscator reversal: ").append(detected ? "detected" : "not detected");
            counts.forEach((name, value) -> out.append(System.lineSeparator()).append("  ").append(name).append(": ").append(value));
            if (!refused.isEmpty()) out.append(System.lineSeparator()).append("  methods the analysis refused: ").append(refused);
            if (!parametersKept.isEmpty()) out.append(System.lineSeparator()).append("  injected parameters kept: ").append(parametersKept);
            if (!writeFailures.isEmpty()) out.append(System.lineSeparator()).append("  classes kept as they were (write failed): ").append(writeFailures);
            return out.toString();
        }
    }
    public record Result(Map<String,byte[]> entries, Report report, List<TransformResult.Change> changes) {}

    /** {@code entries}: jar entry name to bytes; only {@code .class} entries are read, others are returned as they are. */
    public Result apply(Map<String,byte[]> entries, int maxChanges) {
        var nodes = new LinkedHashMap<String,ClassNode>();
        var entryOf = new HashMap<String,String>();
        for (var entry : entries.entrySet()) {
            if (!entry.getKey().endsWith(".class")) continue;
            try {
                var node = new ClassNode();
                new ClassReader(entry.getValue()).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
                if (nodes.putIfAbsent(node.name, node) == null) entryOf.put(node.name, entry.getKey());
            } catch (RuntimeException unreadable) {
                // Left as it is.
            }
        }
        if (!detected(nodes)) {
            return new Result(entries, new Report(false, Map.of("classes", nodes.size()), List.of(), List.of(), List.of()), List.of());
        }
        var model = new SkidModel(nodes);
        model.build();
        var interpreter = model.interpreter();
        // A call whose result is dropped goes when it has no side effect and, on its literal arguments, evaluates without error.
        // (null arguments: the analysis already evaluated the call on every input it can see.)
        // Only the obfuscator's functions and the JDK's allowlisted pure classes are dropped this way (never a call of the program).
        var rewriter = new MethodRewriter(interpreter, (call, args) ->
            (model.hashFunction(call.owner, call.name, call.desc) || PureEvaluator.Allowlist.CLASSES.contains(call.owner))
            && model.pure.pureBody(call.owner, call.name, call.desc)
            && (args == null || model.pure.evaluate(call.owner, call.name, call.desc, args).isPresent()));
        var total = new MethodRewriter.Stats();
        var changed = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
        var changes = new ArrayList<TransformResult.Change>();
        int methodsChanged = 0;
        var rewritten = new LinkedHashMap<MethodNode,String>(); // method -> owner, for the MapleIR clean-up
        boolean sdk = nodes.containsKey("sdk/SDK");
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            if (sdk && node.name.startsWith("sdk/")) continue;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (method.instructions.size() == 0) continue;
                var stats = new MethodRewriter.Stats();
                var parameters = model.seedParameters.getOrDefault(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc), Map.of());
                if (rewriter.rewrite(node.name, method, parameters, stats)) {
                    changed.add(node.name); methodsChanged++; rewritten.put(method, node.name);
                    if (changes.size() < maxChanges)
                        changes.add(new TransformResult.Change(ID, node.name, method.name, method.desc, -1, 0, stats.folded, stats.branches, stats.total()));
                }
                total.add(stats);
            }
        }
        // Seed fields nothing reads any more: drop their writes and the fields.
        int seedFieldsRemoved = 0;
        var reads = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions)
                    if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field && (insn.getOpcode() == GETSTATIC || insn.getOpcode() == GETFIELD))
                        reads.add(field.owner + "." + field.name);
        var seeds = new HashSet<String>(model.staticSeeds.keySet()); seeds.addAll(model.instanceSeeds.keySet());
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            boolean touched = false;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                // Phase 2DC: per method; the class-wide flag re-ran the rewriter on every later method, abstract ones included.
                boolean methodTouched = false;
                for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field) || !seeds.contains(field.owner + "." + field.name) || reads.contains(field.owner + "." + field.name)) continue;
                    if (insn.getOpcode() == PUTSTATIC) { method.instructions.set(insn, new InsnNode(POP)); methodTouched = true; }
                    else if (insn.getOpcode() == PUTFIELD) { method.instructions.insertBefore(insn, new InsnNode(POP)); method.instructions.set(insn, new InsnNode(POP)); methodTouched = true; }
                }
                if (methodTouched) { rewriter.rewrite(node.name, method, Map.of(), total); touched = true; }
            }
            int before = node.fields.size();
            node.fields.removeIf(field -> seeds.contains(node.name + "." + field.name) && !reads.contains(node.name + "." + field.name));
            seedFieldsRemoved += before - node.fields.size();
            if (touched || before != node.fields.size()) changed.add(node.name);
        }
        // Phase 2CO: strings (the seeds are literals now) and the ASCII-art field.
        var strings = new StringRecovery();
        strings.apply(nodes, changed);
        // Phase 2CP: the injected seed parameters, now unread.
        var parameters = new ParameterRecovery();
        parameters.apply(nodes, model, changed);
        // Phase 2CR: the SDK's hashed type checks and string comparisons (recovered literals also key string switches).
        var sdkRemoved = new HashSet<String>();
        var sdkRecovery = new SdkRecovery();
        sdkRecovery.apply(nodes, changed, sdkRemoved);
        // Phase 2CQ: switches on a hash of the key.
        var switches = new SwitchRecovery();
        switches.apply(nodes, model.pure, changed);
        // Phase 2CS: MapleIR's shapes in the methods Skidfuscator rebuilt (never in untouched javac code).
        var cleanup = new MapleCleanup();
        for (var entry : rewritten.entrySet()) {
            var method = entry.getKey();
            if (nodes.get(entry.getValue()).methods.contains(method) && cleanup.apply(entry.getValue(), method)) changed.add(entry.getValue());
        }
        // Unreferenced XOR helpers and hash factories, and empty static initializers.
        int helpersRemoved = 0, factoriesRemoved = 0;
        var referenced = references(nodes);
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            int before = node.methods.size();
            node.methods.removeIf(method -> xorHelper(method) && !referenced.contains(SkidModel.key(node.name, method.name, method.desc)));
            helpersRemoved += before - node.methods.size();
            if (node.methods.removeIf(SkidfuscatorReverser::emptyClinit)) changed.add(node.name);
            if (before != node.methods.size()) changed.add(node.name);
        }
        var removedClasses = new HashSet<String>(sdkRemoved);
        var referencedClasses = new HashSet<String>();
        for (String reference : references(nodes)) referencedClasses.add(reference.substring(0, reference.lastIndexOf('.', reference.indexOf('('))));
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            if (factory(node, model.pure) && !referencedClasses.contains(node.name)) { removedClasses.add(node.name); factoriesRemoved++; }

        var output = new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        int writeFailures = 0; var writeFailed = new ArrayList<String>();
        var hierarchy = new Hierarchy(nodes);
        for (var entry : entries.entrySet()) {
            String name = entry.getKey();
            String internal = null;
            if (name.endsWith(".class")) for (var e : entryOf.entrySet()) if (e.getValue().equals(name)) { internal = e.getKey(); break; }
            if (internal != null && removedClasses.contains(internal)) continue;
            if (internal == null || !changed.contains(internal)) { output.put(name, entry.getValue()); continue; }
            var node = nodes.get(internal);
            try {
                int flags = (node.version & 0xFFFF) >= V1_6 ? ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES : ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS;
                var writer = hierarchy.writer(flags);
                node.accept(writer);
                output.put(name, writer.toByteArray());
            } catch (RuntimeException error) {
                writeFailures++; if (writeFailed.size() < 20) writeFailed.add(Hierarchy.failure(internal, error));
                output.put(name, entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        var counts = new LinkedHashMap<String,Integer>();
        counts.put("classes", nodes.size()); counts.put("methods changed", methodsChanged);
        counts.put("seed values folded", total.folded); counts.put("opaque branches decided", total.branches);
        counts.put("of which by the trap invariant (unevaluable hash)", total.assumed);
        counts.put("switches pruned", total.switchesPruned); counts.put("dead instructions removed", total.dead);
        counts.put("throw-gotos turned into jumps", total.throwGotos); counts.put("idle try ranges removed", total.handlers);
        counts.put("seed stores removed", total.storesDropped); counts.put("peephole edits", total.peephole);
        counts.put("methods refused", total.unanalyzable);
        counts.put("seed fields", model.staticSeeds.size() + model.instanceSeeds.size()); counts.put("seed fields removed", seedFieldsRemoved);
        counts.put("seed parameters", model.seedParameters.size()); counts.put("hash factories removed", factoriesRemoved);
        counts.put("XOR helpers removed", helpersRemoved);
        counts.put("strings decrypted", strings.decrypted); counts.put("strings not decrypted", strings.failed);
        counts.put("decryptors removed", strings.decryptorsRemoved); counts.put("array generators removed", strings.generatorsRemoved);
        counts.put("key fields removed", strings.fieldsRemoved); counts.put("ASCII-art fields removed", strings.ahegaoRemoved);
        counts.put("injected parameters removed", parameters.methods); counts.put("calls rewritten", parameters.calls);
        counts.put("names restored", parameters.renamed); counts.put("broken calls fixed", parameters.brokenCalls);
        counts.put("type checks recovered", sdkRecovery.typeChecks); counts.put("type checks not recovered", sdkRecovery.typeUnresolved);
        counts.put("equals literals recovered", sdkRecovery.equalsRecovered); counts.put("equals literals not recovered", sdkRecovery.equalsUnresolved);
        counts.put("SDK classes removed", sdkRecovery.sdkClassesRemoved);
        counts.put("hashed switches recovered", switches.recovered); counts.put("hashed switches ambiguous", switches.ambiguous);
        counts.put("hashed switches not matched", switches.unmatched);
        counts.put("stack spills removed", cleanup.spills); counts.put("constructions restored", cleanup.constructions);
        counts.put("dead stores removed", cleanup.deadStores); counts.put("zero comparisons restored", cleanup.comparisons);
        counts.put("class write failures", writeFailures);
        var report = new Report(true, counts, total.refused, parameters.kept, writeFailed);
        return new Result(output, report, changes);
    }

    /** Skidfuscator's seed updates ({@code ldc C; iload s; ixor; istore s}) in at least one method, or its SDK. */
    static boolean detected(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        if (nodes.containsKey("sdk/SDK")) return true;
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                int updates = 0;
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn.getOpcode() != IXOR) continue;
                    var load = SeedInterpreter.previous(insn); var constant = SeedInterpreter.previous(load); var store = SeedInterpreter.next(insn);
                    if (load instanceof VarInsnNode l && l.getOpcode() == ILOAD && SkidModel.literal(constant) != null
                        && store instanceof VarInsnNode s && s.getOpcode() == ISTORE && s.var == l.var) updates++;
                }
                if (updates >= 3) return true;
            }
        return false;
    }

    /** {@code owner.name desc} of every method referenced by an instruction or a method handle. */
    private static Set<String> references(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes) {
        var result = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var node : nodes.values())
            for (var method : node.methods)
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) result.add(SkidModel.key(call.owner, call.name, call.desc));
                    else if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy) {
                        handle(indy.bsm, result);
                        for (Object arg : indy.bsmArgs) if (arg instanceof org.objectweb.asm.Handle h) handle(h, result);
                    } else if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof org.objectweb.asm.Handle h) handle(h, result);
                }
        return result;
    }
    private static void handle(org.objectweb.asm.Handle handle, Set<String> into) { into.add(SkidModel.key(handle.getOwner(), handle.getName(), handle.getDesc())); }

    /** {@code private static int x(int a, int b) { return b ^ a; }}, Skidfuscator's per-class XOR helper. */
    static boolean xorHelper(MethodNode method) {
        if (!method.desc.equals("(II)I") || (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || (method.access & ACC_PRIVATE) == 0) return false;
        var ops = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() >= 0) ops.add(insn.getOpcode());
        return ops.equals(List.of(ILOAD, ILOAD, IXOR, IRETURN));
    }

    /** A class of only pure static {@code (I)I} methods and no fields: the hash factory. */
    static boolean factory(ClassNode node, PureEvaluator pure) {
        if (!node.fields.isEmpty() || node.methods.isEmpty() || (node.access & ACC_INTERFACE) != 0) return false;
        for (var method : node.methods) {
            if (method.name.equals("<init>") && method.desc.equals("()V")) continue;
            if (!method.desc.equals("(I)I") || (method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || !pure.pureBody(node.name, method.name, method.desc)) return false;
        }
        return node.methods.stream().anyMatch(m -> m.desc.equals("(I)I"));
    }

    private static boolean emptyClinit(MethodNode method) {
        if (!method.name.equals("<clinit>")) return false;
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() >= 0 && insn.getOpcode() != RETURN) return false;
        return true;
    }

    static int argumentSlots(String desc) { int slots = 0; for (var t : Type.getArgumentTypes(desc)) slots += t.getSize(); return slots; }
}

```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/StringRecovery.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CO: decrypts Skidfuscator's strings statically, once the flow pass has turned every seed into a literal.
 * Skidfuscator gives each class one of three decryptors (all keyed by {@code Integer.toString(blockSeed).getBytes()}):
 * <ul>
 *   <li>{@code dec(byte[] data, byte[] keys, int seed)}: {@code data[i] ^= seedBytes[i % n]; data[i] ^= keys[i % m]}, UTF-16;</li>
 *   <li>{@code dec(byte[] data, int seed)} with the key array in a static {@code byte[]} field set by {@code <clinit>};</li>
 *   <li>{@code dec(byte[] index, int seed)} reading a static {@code String} buffer built in {@code <clinit>} by
 *   {@code ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes).asCharBuffer().toString()}; the 8-byte index holds the length and offset (big-endian),
 *   the slice is UTF-16BE.</li>
 * </ul>
 * Byte arrays come from generated {@code private static byte[] x()} methods returning an array literal. The decryptors
 * are recognized by their shape and the algorithms are implemented here; the target's decryptor is never run. Each call
 * {@code gen(); [gen();] <literal>; dec(...)} becomes {@code ldc "<plain text>"}. Then the decryptors, generators, key
 * fields and their {@code <clinit>} code are removed once unused, and so is Skidfuscator's {@code nothing_to_see_here}
 * field (ASCII art written in {@code <clinit>}).
 */
final class StringRecovery implements Opcodes {
    enum Kind { KEY_ARGUMENT, KEY_FIELD, BUFFER }
    record Decryptor(String owner, MethodNode method, Kind kind, String field) {}
    int decrypted, failed, decryptorsRemoved, generatorsRemoved, fieldsRemoved, ahegaoRemoved;

    void apply(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, Set<String> changed) {
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            var decryptors = new HashMap<String,Decryptor>();
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                var decryptor = recognize(node, method);
                if (decryptor != null) decryptors.put(method.name + method.desc, decryptor);
            }
            if (decryptors.isEmpty()) continue;
            var cache = new HashMap<String,byte[]>();
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC || !call.owner.equals(node.name)) continue;
                    var decryptor = decryptors.get(call.name + call.desc);
                    if (decryptor == null) continue;
                    if (decrypt(node, method, call, decryptor, cache)) { decrypted++; changed.add(node.name); } else failed++;
                }
            }
        }
        // Remove what no instruction uses any more: decryptors, array generators, key fields with their <clinit> code.
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            boolean removedSomething = true;
            while (removedSomething) {
                removedSomething = false;
                var used = usedMethods(node);
                for (var it = node.methods.iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
                    var method = it.next();
                    if (used.contains(method.name + method.desc)) continue;
                    if (recognize(node, method) != null) { it.remove(); decryptorsRemoved++; removedSomething = true; changed.add(node.name); }
                    else if (generator(node, method) != null && (method.access & ACC_PRIVATE) != 0) { it.remove(); generatorsRemoved++; removedSomething = true; changed.add(node.name); }
                }
                for (var it = node.fields.iterator(); it.hasNext(); ) {
                    var field = it.next();
                    if ((field.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || !(field.desc.equals("[B") || field.desc.equals("Ljava/lang/String;"))) continue;
                    if (readOutsideClinit(node, field) || readInClinit(node, field)) continue;
                    if (removeKeyInit(node, field)) { it.remove(); fieldsRemoved++; removedSomething = true; changed.add(node.name); }
                }
            }
            if (removeAhegao(node)) { ahegaoRemoved++; changed.add(node.name); }
        }
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- recognition

    /** A Skidfuscator decryptor of this class, or null. */
    static Decryptor recognize(ClassNode node, MethodNode method) {
        if ((method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0) return null;
        boolean keyArgument = method.desc.equals("([B[BI)Ljava/lang/String;");
        if (!keyArgument && !method.desc.equals("([BI)Ljava/lang/String;")) return null;
        boolean toString = false, getBytes = false, utf16 = false, utf16be = false, substring = false;
        String bytesField = null, bufferField = null;
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call) {
                if (call.owner.equals("java/lang/Integer") && call.name.equals("toString") && call.desc.equals("(I)Ljava/lang/String;")) toString = true;
                if (call.owner.equals("java/lang/String") && call.name.equals("getBytes")) getBytes = true;
                if (call.owner.equals("java/lang/String") && call.name.equals("substring")) substring = true;
            } else if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field && insn.getOpcode() == GETSTATIC) {
                if (field.owner.equals("java/nio/charset/StandardCharsets") && field.name.equals("UTF_16")) utf16 = true;
                if (field.owner.equals("java/nio/charset/StandardCharsets") && field.name.equals("UTF_16BE")) utf16be = true;
                if (field.owner.equals(node.name) && field.desc.equals("[B")) bytesField = field.name;
                if (field.owner.equals(node.name) && field.desc.equals("Ljava/lang/String;")) bufferField = field.name;
            }
        }
        if (!toString || !getBytes) return null;
        if (keyArgument && utf16 && bytesField == null) return new Decryptor(node.name, method, Kind.KEY_ARGUMENT, null);
        if (!keyArgument && utf16 && bytesField != null) return new Decryptor(node.name, method, Kind.KEY_FIELD, bytesField);
        if (!keyArgument && utf16be && substring && bufferField != null) return new Decryptor(node.name, method, Kind.BUFFER, bufferField);
        return null;
    }

    /** The literal bytes a {@code static byte[] x()} generator returns, or null. */
    static byte[] generator(ClassNode node, MethodNode method) {
        if ((method.access & ACC_STATIC) == 0 || !method.desc.equals("()[B")) return null;
        var insns = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() >= 0) insns.add(insn);
        if (insns.size() < 3) return null;
        Integer length = SkidModel.literal(insns.get(0));
        if (length == null || length < 0 || length > 1 << 20 || !(insns.get(1) instanceof IntInsnNode array) || array.getOpcode() != NEWARRAY
            || array.operand != T_BYTE || insns.getLast().getOpcode() != ARETURN) return null;
        byte[] bytes = new byte[length];
        int at = 2;
        while (at + 4 <= insns.size() - 1) {
            if (insns.get(at).getOpcode() != DUP || insns.get(at + 3).getOpcode() != BASTORE) return null;
            Integer index = SkidModel.literal(insns.get(at + 1)), value = SkidModel.literal(insns.get(at + 2));
            if (index == null || value == null || index < 0 || index >= length) return null;
            bytes[index] = (byte) (int) value;
            at += 4;
        }
        return at == insns.size() - 1 ? bytes : null;
    }

    private static byte[] generated(ClassNode node, MethodInsnNode call, Map<String,byte[]> cache) {
        if (call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC || !call.owner.equals(node.name) || !call.desc.equals("()[B")) return null;
        String key = call.name;
        if (cache.containsKey(key)) return cache.get(key);
        byte[] bytes = null;
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals(call.name) && method.desc.equals("()[B")) bytes = generator(node, method);
        cache.put(key, bytes);
        return bytes;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- decryption

    private boolean decrypt(ClassNode node, MethodNode method, MethodInsnNode call, Decryptor decryptor, Map<String,byte[]> cache) {
        var seed = previous(call);
        Integer key = SkidModel.literal(seed);
        if (key == null) return false;
        var data = previous(seed);
        AbstractInsnNode keys = null;
        if (decryptor.kind == Kind.KEY_ARGUMENT) { keys = data; data = previous(keys); }
        if (!(data instanceof MethodInsnNode dataCall) || keys != null && !(keys instanceof MethodInsnNode)) return false;
        byte[] payload = generated(node, dataCall, cache);
        if (payload == null) return false;
        String plain;
        switch (decryptor.kind) {
            case KEY_ARGUMENT -> {
                byte[] keyBytes = generated(node, (MethodInsnNode) keys, cache);
                if (keyBytes == null) return false;
                plain = xorUtf16(payload, key, keyBytes);
            }
            case KEY_FIELD -> {
                byte[] keyBytes = fieldBytes(node, decryptor.field, cache);
                if (keyBytes == null) return false;
                plain = xorUtf16(payload, key, keyBytes);
            }
            default -> {
                String buffer = bufferString(node, decryptor.field, cache);
                if (buffer == null || payload.length != 8) return false;
                int size = ((payload[0] & 0xFF) << 24) | ((payload[1] & 0xFF) << 16) | ((payload[2] & 0xFF) << 8) | (payload[3] & 0xFF);
                int offset = ((payload[4] & 0xFF) << 24) | ((payload[5] & 0xFF) << 16) | ((payload[6] & 0xFF) << 8) | (payload[7] & 0xFF);
                if (offset < 0 || size < 0 || offset + size > buffer.length()) return false;
                byte[] slice = buffer.substring(offset, offset + size).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE);
                byte[] seedBytes = Integer.toString(key).getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
                for (int i = 0; i < slice.length; i++) slice[i] ^= seedBytes[i % seedBytes.length];
                plain = new String(slice, StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE);
            }
        }
        // No label between the argument instructions and the call: they are one straight-line expression.
        AbstractInsnNode first = data;
        for (var node2 = first.getNext(); node2 != call; node2 = node2.getNext()) if (node2 instanceof LabelNode) return false;
        for (AbstractInsnNode node2 = first, next; node2 != call; node2 = next) { next = node2.getNext(); if (node2.getOpcode() >= 0) method.instructions.remove(node2); }
        method.instructions.set(call, new LdcInsnNode(plain));
        return true;
    }

    /** {@code dec(data, keys, seed)}: both XOR keys over the UTF-16 bytes (Integer.toString of a seed is ASCII in every charset). */
    static String xorUtf16(byte[] payload, int seed, byte[] keys) {
        byte[] bytes = payload.clone();
        byte[] seedBytes = Integer.toString(seed).getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
        if (keys.length == 0) return null;
        for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
            bytes[i] ^= seedBytes[i % seedBytes.length];
            bytes[i] ^= keys[i % keys.length];
        }
        return new String(bytes, StandardCharsets.UTF_16);
    }

    /** The bytes {@code <clinit>} stores into a static byte[] field: {@code invokestatic gen()[B; putstatic field}. */
    private static byte[] fieldBytes(ClassNode node, String field, Map<String,byte[]> cache) {
        for (var put : clinitPuts(node, field, "[B")) {
            if (previous(put) instanceof MethodInsnNode gen) return generated(node, gen, cache);
        }
        return null;
    }

    /** The String {@code <clinit>} builds with {@code ByteBuffer.wrap(gen()).asCharBuffer().toString()}: raw big-endian chars. */
    private static String bufferString(ClassNode node, String field, Map<String,byte[]> cache) {
        for (var put : clinitPuts(node, field, "Ljava/lang/String;")) {
            var toString = previous(put); var asChars = previous(toString); var wrap = previous(asChars); var gen = previous(wrap);
            if (toString instanceof MethodInsnNode t && t.name.equals("toString") && asChars instanceof MethodInsnNode a && a.name.equals("asCharBuffer")
                && wrap instanceof MethodInsnNode w && w.owner.equals("java/nio/ByteBuffer") && w.name.equals("wrap") && gen instanceof MethodInsnNode g) {
                byte[] bytes = generated(node, g, cache);
                if (bytes == null) return null;
                char[] chars = new char[bytes.length / 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) chars[i] = (char) (((bytes[2 * i] & 0xFF) << 8) | (bytes[2 * i + 1] & 0xFF));
                return new String(chars);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static List<FieldInsnNode> clinitPuts(ClassNode node, String field, String desc) {
        var result = new ArrayList<FieldInsnNode>();
        for (var method : node.methods) {
            if (!method.name.equals("<clinit>")) continue;
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode put && put.getOpcode() == PUTSTATIC && put.owner.equals(node.name) && put.name.equals(field) && put.desc.equals(desc))
                    result.add(put);
        }
        return result;
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------- removal

    private static Set<String> usedMethods(ClassNode node) {
        var used = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var method : node.methods)
            for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals(node.name)) used.add(call.name + call.desc);
                else if (insn instanceof InvokeDynamicInsnNode indy)
                    for (Object arg : indy.bsmArgs) if (arg instanceof org.objectweb.asm.Handle h && h.getOwner().equals(node.name)) used.add(h.getName() + h.getDesc());
            }
        return used;
    }

    private static boolean readOutsideClinit(ClassNode node, FieldNode field) {
        for (var method : node.methods) {
            if (method.name.equals("<clinit>")) continue;
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f && f.owner.equals(node.name) && f.name.equals(field.name)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    private static boolean readInClinit(ClassNode node, FieldNode field) {
        for (var method : node.methods) {
            if (!method.name.equals("<clinit>")) continue;
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f && f.getOpcode() == GETSTATIC && f.owner.equals(node.name) && f.name.equals(field.name)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    /** Removes {@code <clinit>}'s {@code gen()[B; [ByteBuffer.wrap; asCharBuffer; toString;] putstatic field}. */
    private static boolean removeKeyInit(ClassNode node, FieldNode field) {
        var puts = clinitPuts(node, field.name, field.desc);
        if (puts.isEmpty()) return false;
        for (var put : puts) {
            var chain = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>(List.of(put));
            AbstractInsnNode at = previous(put);
            if (field.desc.equals("Ljava/lang/String;")) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { if (!(at instanceof MethodInsnNode)) return false; chain.add(at); at = previous(at); }
            }
            if (!(at instanceof MethodInsnNode gen) || !gen.desc.equals("()[B")) return false;
            chain.add(at);
            for (var node2 = at.getNext(); node2 != put; node2 = node2.getNext()) if (node2 instanceof LabelNode) return false;
            var clinit = node.methods.stream().filter(m -> m.instructions.contains(put)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
            for (var insn : chain) clinit.instructions.remove(insn);
        }
        return true;
    }

    /** Skidfuscator's {@code private static String[] nothing_to_see_here}, written only by its own {@code <clinit>} code. */
    private static boolean removeAhegao(ClassNode node) {
        FieldNode field = null;
        for (var candidate : node.fields)
            if (candidate.name.startsWith("nothing_to_see_here") && candidate.desc.equals("[Ljava/lang/String;") && (candidate.access & ACC_STATIC) != 0) field = candidate;
        if (field == null || readOutsideClinit(node, field)) return false;
        MethodNode clinit = null;
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals("<clinit>")) clinit = method;
        if (clinit == null) return false;
        String name = field.name;
        var remove = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : clinit.instructions) {
            if (!(insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f) || !f.owner.equals(node.name) || !f.name.equals(name)) continue;
            if (f.getOpcode() == PUTSTATIC) {
                var alloc = previous(f); var length = previous(alloc);
                if (!(alloc instanceof TypeInsnNode t) || t.getOpcode() != ANEWARRAY || SkidModel.literal(length) == null) return false;
                remove.addAll(List.of(length, alloc, f));
            } else {
                var index = next(f); var value = next(index); var store = next(value);
                if (SkidModel.literal(index) == null || !(value instanceof LdcInsnNode) || store == null || store.getOpcode() != AASTORE) return false;
                remove.addAll(List.of(f, index, value, store));
            }
        }
        for (var insn : remove) clinit.instructions.remove(insn);
        node.fields.remove(field);
        return true;
    }

    static AbstractInsnNode previous(AbstractInsnNode insn) { return SeedInterpreter.previous(insn); }
    static AbstractInsnNode next(AbstractInsnNode insn) { return SeedInterpreter.next(insn); }
    static int slots(String desc) { int n = 0; for (var t : Type.getArgumentTypes(desc)) n += t.getSize(); return n; }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SwitchRecovery.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntUnaryOperator;

/**
 * Phase 2CQ: undoes Skidfuscator's Flow Switch. After the flow pass a protected switch reads
 * <pre>{@code <key>; ldc S; ixor; istore t; iload t; invokestatic Factory.h(I)I; lookupswitch {h(k ^ S): ...}}</pre>
 * where {@code h} is the hash factory's legacy hash {@code ((v * 31 >>> 4) % v) ^ (v >>> 16)}. Each original key {@code k}
 * is found by a bounded search over the values a switch key usually takes (−65536..1048575: enum ordinals, chars and
 * ordinary int constants, plus the {@code hashCode()} of string literals of the class for string switches). A switch is
 * rewritten only when every case has exactly one key in that space; the {@code tableswitch} / {@code lookupswitch}
 * choice follows javac's cost rule. The hash is evaluated statically (a native copy of the two known factory hashes,
 * otherwise {@link PureEvaluator}); nothing is executed.
 */
final class SwitchRecovery implements Opcodes {
    static final int LOW = -65536, HIGH = 1048575;
    int recovered, ambiguous, unmatched;
    private final Map<String,int[]> tables = new HashMap<>();

    void apply(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, PureEvaluator pure, Set<String> changed) {
        for (var node : nodes.values()) {
            Set<Integer> stringHashes = null;
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray()) {
                    if (!(insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode)) continue;
                    var hash = SeedInterpreter.previous(insn);
                    if (!(hash instanceof MethodInsnNode call) || call.getOpcode() != INVOKESTATIC || !call.desc.equals("(I)I")) continue;
                    var load = SeedInterpreter.previous(call); var store = SeedInterpreter.previous(load);
                    var xor = SeedInterpreter.previous(store); var seed = SeedInterpreter.previous(xor);
                    Integer s = SkidModel.literal(seed);
                    if (!(load instanceof VarInsnNode l) || l.getOpcode() != ILOAD || !(store instanceof VarInsnNode st) || st.getOpcode() != ISTORE
                        || st.var != l.var || xor.getOpcode() != IXOR || s == null || !onlyPairedLoads(method, l.var)) continue;
                    for (var n = seed.getNext(); n != insn; n = n.getNext()) if (n instanceof LabelNode) { s = null; break; }
                    if (s == null) continue;
                    var function = function(nodes, pure, call);
                    if (function == null) { unmatched++; continue; }
                    if (stringHashes == null) stringHashes = stringHashes(node);
                    var keys = keys(insn);
                    var original = new LinkedHashMap<Integer,Integer>(); // obfuscated key -> original key
                    boolean ok = true;
                    var inverse = inverse(call, s, function);
                    for (int key : keys) {
                        var found = new TreeSet<Integer>(inverse.getOrDefault(key, List.of()));
                        for (int text : stringHashes) if (function.applyAsInt(text ^ s) == key) found.add(text);
                        if (found.size() != 1) { if (found.isEmpty()) unmatched++; else ambiguous++; ok = false; break; }
                        original.put(key, found.first());
                    }
                    if (!ok) continue;
                    var replacement = rebuild(insn, original);
                    for (var n : List.of(seed, xor, store, load, call)) method.instructions.remove(n);
                    method.instructions.set(insn, replacement);
                    recovered++; changed.add(node.name);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Every load of the temporary comes straight after its store (Skidfuscator reuses one temporary for all switches). */
    private static boolean onlyPairedLoads(MethodNode method, int var) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions)
            if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode v && v.var == var && v.getOpcode() == ILOAD
                && !(SeedInterpreter.previous(insn) instanceof VarInsnNode p && p.getOpcode() == ISTORE && p.var == var)) return false;
        return true;
    }

    private static List<Integer> keys(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) return lookup.keys;
        var table = (TableSwitchInsnNode) insn;
        var keys = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int k = 0; k < table.labels.size(); k++) keys.add(table.min + k);
        return keys;
    }

    /** Original key -> obfuscated key preimages within the search space, cached per hash method and seed. */
    private Map<Integer,List<Integer>> inverse(MethodInsnNode call, int seed, IntUnaryOperator function) {
        String key = call.owner + "." + call.name + "#" + seed;
        int[] table = tables.computeIfAbsent(key, k -> {
            int[] values = new int[HIGH - LOW + 1];
            for (int v = LOW; v <= HIGH; v++) values[v - LOW] = function.applyAsInt(v ^ seed);
            return values;
        });
        var result = new HashMap<Integer,List<Integer>>();
        // Only the keys this switch uses are needed; the table is scanned once per switch.
        return new AbstractMap<Integer,List<Integer>>() {
            @Override public List<Integer> get(Object hashed) {
                return result.computeIfAbsent((Integer) hashed, h -> {
                    var found = new ArrayList<Integer>();
                    for (int i = 0; i < table.length && found.size() < 2; i++) if (table[i] == h) found.add(i + LOW);
                    return found;
                });
            }
            @Override public List<Integer> getOrDefault(Object hashed, List<Integer> fallback) { return get(hashed); }
            @Override public Set<Entry<Integer,List<Integer>>> entrySet() { return result.entrySet(); }
        };
    }

    /** The hash as a fast function: a native copy of the factory's legacy or bitwise hash, or the static evaluator. */
    static IntUnaryOperator function(Map<String,ClassNode> nodes, PureEvaluator pure, MethodInsnNode call) {
        var owner = nodes.get(call.owner);
        if (owner == null) return null;
        MethodNode method = null;
        for (var m : owner.methods) if (m.name.equals(call.name) && m.desc.equals(call.desc)) method = m;
        if (method == null) return null;
        var ops = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn.getOpcode() < 0) continue;
            ops.add(insn instanceof IntInsnNode push ? "push" + push.operand : insn instanceof VarInsnNode v ? insn.getOpcode() + "@" + v.var : String.valueOf(insn.getOpcode()));
        }
        var legacy = List.of(ILOAD + "@0", String.valueOf(IFEQ), ILOAD + "@0", "push31", String.valueOf(IMUL), String.valueOf(ICONST_4),
            String.valueOf(IUSHR), ILOAD + "@0", String.valueOf(IREM), ILOAD + "@0", "push16", String.valueOf(IUSHR), String.valueOf(IXOR),
            String.valueOf(IRETURN), String.valueOf(ICONST_0), String.valueOf(IRETURN));
        if (ops.equals(legacy)) return v -> v == 0 ? 0 : (((v * 31) >>> 4) % v) ^ (v >>> 16);
        var bitwise = List.of(ILOAD + "@0", "push7", "push29", String.valueOf(ISHL), String.valueOf(IAND), "push29", String.valueOf(ISHR),
            ILOAD + "@0", String.valueOf(ICONST_3), String.valueOf(ISHL), String.valueOf(IOR), String.valueOf(IRETURN));
        if (ops.equals(bitwise)) return v -> ((v & (7 << 29)) >> 29) | (v << 3);
        if (!pure.pureBody(call.owner, call.name, call.desc)) return null;
        return v -> pure.evaluate(call.owner, call.name, call.desc, new Object[] {v}).map(r -> (Integer) r).orElse(Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    }

    private static Set<Integer> stringHashes(ClassNode node) {
        var result = new HashSet<Integer>();
        for (var method : node.methods)
            for (var insn : method.instructions)
                if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String text) result.add(text.hashCode());
        return result;
    }

    /** A switch on the original keys, as javac would choose it (tableswitch when its cost is not higher). */
    static AbstractInsnNode rebuild(AbstractInsnNode insn, Map<Integer,Integer> original) {
        List<LabelNode> labels; LabelNode dflt;
        if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { labels = lookup.labels; dflt = lookup.dflt; }
        else { labels = ((TableSwitchInsnNode) insn).labels; dflt = ((TableSwitchInsnNode) insn).dflt; }
        var oldKeys = keys(insn);
        var cases = new TreeMap<Integer,LabelNode>();
        for (int k = 0; k < oldKeys.size(); k++) {
            if (labels.get(k) == dflt && insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode) continue; // a table's holes
            cases.put(original.get(oldKeys.get(k)), labels.get(k));
        }
        if (cases.isEmpty()) return new LookupSwitchInsnNode(dflt, new int[0], new LabelNode[0]);
        long lo = cases.firstKey(), hi = cases.lastKey(), n = cases.size();
        long tableSpace = 4 + (hi - lo + 1), tableTime = 3, lookupSpace = 3 + 2 * n, lookupTime = n;
        if (tableSpace + 3 * tableTime <= lookupSpace + 3 * lookupTime) {
            var table = new LabelNode[(int) (hi - lo + 1)];
            for (int k = 0; k < table.length; k++) table[k] = cases.getOrDefault((int) (lo + k), dflt);
            return new TableSwitchInsnNode((int) lo, (int) hi, dflt, table);
        }
        return new LookupSwitchInsnNode(dflt, cases.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray(), cases.values().toArray(new LabelNode[0]));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.jar.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ArchiveMetadataTest {
    @Test void rewritesRecognizedManifestAttributesAndKeepsUnchangedBytesIdentical() throws Exception {
        var manifest=new Manifest(); manifest.getMainAttributes().put(Attributes.Name.MANIFEST_VERSION,"1.0");
        manifest.getMainAttributes().put(Attributes.Name.MAIN_CLASS,"p.ab");
        manifest.getMainAttributes().putValue("Agent-Class","p.cd");
        manifest.getMainAttributes().putValue("Custom-Class","p.ab");
        var buffer=new ByteArrayOutputStream(); manifest.write(buffer); byte[] input=buffer.toByteArray();
        byte[] output=ArchiveMetadata.rewriteManifest(input,Map.of("p/ab","p/Class00001"));
        var parsed=new Manifest(new ByteArrayInputStream(output));
        assertEquals("p.Class00001",parsed.getMainAttributes().getValue("Main-Class"));
        assertEquals("p.cd",parsed.getMainAttributes().getValue("Agent-Class"));
        assertEquals("p.ab",parsed.getMainAttributes().getValue("Custom-Class"));
        assertSame(input,ArchiveMetadata.rewriteManifest(input,Map.of("p/other","p/X")));
    }
    @Test void rewritesServicePathAndProviderLines() throws Exception {
        var forward=Map.of("p/ab","p/Class00001","p/cd","p/Class00002");
        byte[] content="# providers\np.cd # keep\n p.cd\nexternal.Provider\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        var result=ArchiveMetadata.rewriteServices("META-INF/services/p.ab",content,forward);
        assertEquals("META-INF/services/p.Class00001",result.name());
        assertEquals("# providers\np.Class00002 # keep\n p.Class00002\nexternal.Provider\n",new String(result.bytes(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        byte[] untouched="p.external\r\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        var same=ArchiveMetadata.rewriteServices("META-INF/services/p.external",untouched,forward);
        assertEquals("META-INF/services/p.external",same.name());
        assertSame(untouched,same.bytes());
    }
    @Test void rejectsInvalidServiceEncoding() {
        assertThrows(IOException.class,()->ArchiveMetadata.rewriteServices("META-INF/services/p.ab",new byte[]{(byte)0xC3},Map.of("p/ab","p/Class00001")));
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test void renamesPrivateMembersAndRewritesOwnReferences() {

    /**
     * Phase 2BW: {@code p/n} with a private static native {@code 0a2b()} called from {@code <clinit>}, a private field
     * {@code do}, a private method {@code if} next to an existing {@code if_}, a public {@code 9up()} and a valid {@code ok()}.
     */
    static byte[] nonIdentifierMembers() {
        var writer=new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8,ACC_PUBLIC|ACC_SUPER,"p/n",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PRIVATE|ACC_STATIC,"do","I",null,null).visitEnd();
        writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE|ACC_STATIC|ACC_NATIVE,"0a2b","()V",null,null).visitEnd();
        for(String name:List.of("if","if_","ok","9up")) {
            var method=writer.visitMethod((name.equals("9up")?ACC_PUBLIC:ACC_PRIVATE)|ACC_STATIC,name,"()I",null,null);
            method.visitCode(); method.visitFieldInsn(GETSTATIC,"p/n","do","I"); method.visitInsn(IRETURN); method.visitMaxs(1,0); method.visitEnd();
        }
        var init=writer.visitMethod(ACC_STATIC,"<clinit>","()V",null,null);
        init.visitCode(); init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC,"p/n","0a2b","()V",false);
        init.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC,"p/n","if","()I",false); init.visitInsn(POP); init.visitInsn(RETURN); init.visitMaxs(1,0); init.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    @Test void plansPortableNamesForPrivateNonIdentifierMembers() {
        var classes=Map.of("p/n",nonIdentifierMembers(),"p/b",type("p/b","p/n"));
        var plan=ClassRenamer.portableMembers(classes);
        assertEquals(Map.of(new ClassRenamer.MemberKey("p/n","0a2b","()V",false),"_0a2b",
            new ClassRenamer.MemberKey("p/n","do","I",true),"do_",
            new ClassRenamer.MemberKey("p/n","if","()I",false),"if__cr2"),plan.renamed());
        assertEquals(Set.of(new ClassRenamer.MemberKey("p/n","9up","()I",false)),plan.kept().keySet());
        assertTrue(plan.kept().values().iterator().next().startsWith("not private"));
        assertEquals(plan,ClassRenamer.portableMembers(new TreeMap<>(classes)),"deterministic");
        var result=new ClassRenamer().rename(classes,Map.of(),plan.rules(),false);
        var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.classes().get("p/n")).accept(node,0);
        assertEquals(List.of("_0a2b","if__cr2","if_","ok","9up","<clinit>"),node.methods.stream().map(m->m.name).toList());
        assertEquals("do_",node.fields.getFirst().name);
        var calls=new ArrayList<String>();
        for(var method:node.methods) for(var instruction:method.instructions.toArray()) {
            if(instruction instanceof MethodInsnNode call) calls.add(call.name);
            if(instruction instanceof FieldInsnNode access) calls.add(access.name);
        }
        assertEquals(List.of("do_","do_","do_","do_","_0a2b","if__cr2"),calls);
    }

        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(classes,new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","run",null,false,"x")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(classes,new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","a",null,false,"bad name")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(classes,new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","a","()V",false,"x")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(classes,new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","a","()I",false,"run")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(classes,
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","a",null,false,"v"),new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","a","()I",false,"w")));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->renameMembers(Map.of("p/c",privateConstructor("p/c")),

            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/r","x",null,true,"y")));

        assertEquals(Set.of("p/a","p/b"),reprocessed.classes().keySet());
        assertEquals("p/b",new ClassReader(reprocessed.classes().get("p/b")).getClassName());
    }
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;
import java.util.Arrays;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

class IntegerBranchPassTest {
    @Test void registersAsAnOptInPass() {
        assertEquals("integer-branches-v2", BuiltinPasses.select("integer-branches").getFirst().id());
        assertEquals("integer-constants", BuiltinPasses.DEFAULT);
    }

    @Test void foldsTrueTwoOperandComparisonAndKeepsStackValid() throws Exception {
        byte[] input = fixture(2, 3, IF_ICMPLT);
        var result = new IntegerBranchPass().apply(input, 10);
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().size());
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().getFirst().result());
        var type = read(result.bytes());
        var instructions = type.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray();
        assertEquals(2, Arrays.stream(instructions).filter(node -> node.getOpcode() == NOP).count());
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node.getOpcode() == GOTO));
        assertFalse(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node.getOpcode() == IF_ICMPLT));
        new Analyzer<>(new BasicVerifier()).analyze(type.name, type.methods.getFirst());
    }

    @Test void foldsFalseUnaryComparisonToFallthrough() throws Exception {
        byte[] input = fixture(5, 0, IFEQ);
        var result = new IntegerBranchPass().apply(input, 10);
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().size());
        assertEquals(0, result.changes().getFirst().result());
        var type = read(result.bytes());
        var instructions = type.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray();
        assertEquals(2, Arrays.stream(instructions).filter(node -> node.getOpcode() == NOP).count());
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node.getOpcode() == NOP));
        assertFalse(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof JumpInsnNode jump && jump.getOpcode() != GOTO));
        new Analyzer<>(new BasicVerifier()).analyze(type.name, type.methods.getFirst());
    }

    @Test void foldsEverySupportedIntegerComparisonOpcode() {
        int[][] cases = {
            {0, 0, IFEQ, 1}, {1, 0, IFNE, 1}, {-1, 0, IFLT, 1}, {0, 0, IFGE, 1},
            {1, 0, IFGT, 1}, {1, 0, IFLE, 0},
            {1, 1, IF_ICMPEQ, 1}, {1, 1, IF_ICMPNE, 0}, {1, 2, IF_ICMPLT, 1},
            {1, 2, IF_ICMPGE, 0}, {2, 1, IF_ICMPGT, 1}, {2, 1, IF_ICMPLE, 0}
        };
        var pass = new IntegerBranchPass();
        for (int[] item : cases) {
            var result = pass.apply(fixture(item[0], item[1], item[2]), 10);
            assertEquals(1, result.changes().size(), "opcode=" + item[2]);
            assertEquals(item[3], result.changes().getFirst().result(), "opcode=" + item[2]);
        }
    }

    @Test void everyFoldPassesJvmVerificationAndKeepsTheSelectedPath() throws Throwable {
        int[][] cases = {
            {0, 0, IFEQ}, {1, 0, IFEQ}, {-1, 0, IFLT}, {1, 0, IFLT}, {0, 0, IFGE}, {-1, 0, IFGE},
            {1, 0, IFGT}, {0, 0, IFGT}, {0, 0, IFLE}, {1, 0, IFLE}, {1, 0, IFNE}, {0, 0, IFNE},
            {1, 1, IF_ICMPEQ}, {1, 2, IF_ICMPEQ}, {1, 2, IF_ICMPNE}, {1, 1, IF_ICMPNE}, {1, 2, IF_ICMPLT}, {2, 1, IF_ICMPLT},
            {2, 2, IF_ICMPGE}, {1, 2, IF_ICMPGE}, {2, 1, IF_ICMPGT}, {1, 1, IF_ICMPGT}, {1, 1, IF_ICMPLE}, {2, 1, IF_ICMPLE},
            {Integer.MIN_VALUE, Integer.MAX_VALUE, IF_ICMPLT}
        };
        for (int version : new int[] {V1_5, V1_8, V17}) for (int[] item : cases) {
            byte[] input = fixture(version, item[0], item[1], item[2]);
            int expected = (int) linkAndCall(input);
            var result = new IntegerBranchPass().apply(input, 10);
            assertEquals(1, result.changes().size(), "opcode=" + item[2]);
            assertEquals(expected == 20 ? 1 : 0, result.changes().getFirst().result(), "opcode=" + item[2]);
            assertEquals(expected, linkAndCall(result.bytes()), "version=" + version + " opcode=" + item[2]);
        }
    }

    @Test void removesOnlyDeadFallThroughUpToTheNextFrame() {
        var result = new IntegerBranchPass().apply(fixture(V1_8, 2, 3, IF_ICMPLT), 10);
        var instructions = read(result.bytes()).methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray();
        assertFalse(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof IntInsnNode push && push.operand == 10));
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(instructions).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof IntInsnNode push && push.operand == 20));
        var legacy = read(new IntegerBranchPass().apply(fixture(V1_5, 2, 3, IF_ICMPLT), 10).bytes()).methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray();
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(legacy).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof IntInsnNode push && push.operand == 10));
    }

    @Test void refusesTakenFoldWhenDeadRegionReachesAnUnframedTarget() {

    @Test void refusesTakenFoldWhenDeadRegionTouchesAnExceptionRange() {

    @Test void preservesInstructionTypeAnnotations() {

    private static ClassNode read(byte[] bytes) {
        var type = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(bytes).accept(type, 0); return type;
    }

    /** Links (so the JVM verifier runs) and calls a fixture this test generated; never target code. */
    private static Object linkAndCall(byte[] bytes) throws Throwable {
        var type = new ClassLoader(null) { Class<?> define() { return defineClass(null, bytes, 0, bytes.length); } }.define();
        try { return type.getMethod("value").invoke(null); }
        catch (java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException error) { throw error.getCause(); }
    }

    private static byte[] fixture(int left, int right, int opcode) { return fixture(V1_8, left, right, opcode); }

    private static byte[] fixture(int version, int left, int right, int opcode) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(version, ACC_PUBLIC, "BranchFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        var target = new Label();
        method.visitCode();
        method.visitLdcInsn(left);
        if (opcode >= IF_ICMPEQ && opcode <= IF_ICMPLE) method.visitLdcInsn(right);
        method.visitJumpInsn(opcode, target);
        method.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, 10); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitLabel(target); method.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, 20); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] fixtureWithBoundary() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "BoundaryFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        var boundary = new Label(); var target = new Label();
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn(1); method.visitLabel(boundary); method.visitLineNumber(12, boundary); method.visitLdcInsn(2);
        method.visitJumpInsn(IF_ICMPEQ, target); method.visitInsn(ICONST_0); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitLabel(target); method.visitInsn(ICONST_1); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(2, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] referenceComparisonFixture() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "ReferenceFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        var target = new Label(); method.visitCode(); method.visitInsn(ACONST_NULL); method.visitInsn(ACONST_NULL);
        method.visitJumpInsn(IF_ACMPEQ, target); method.visitInsn(ICONST_0); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitLabel(target); method.visitInsn(ICONST_1); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/IntegerConstantPassTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

class IntegerConstantPassTest {
    byte[] fixture(int a, int b, int opcode, boolean boundary) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "Example", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn(a);
        if (boundary) { var label = new Label(); method.visitLabel(label); method.visitLineNumber(42, label); }
        method.visitLdcInsn(b); method.visitInsn(opcode); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(2, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    @Test void foldsEverySupportedOperationWithJvmIntegerSemantics() throws Exception {
        int[][] cases = {{2,3,IADD,5},{2,3,ISUB,-1},{Integer.MAX_VALUE,2,IMUL,-2},
            {Integer.MIN_VALUE,-1,IDIV,Integer.MIN_VALUE},{-7,3,IREM,-1},{6,3,IAND,2},
            {6,3,IOR,7},{6,3,IXOR,5},{1,33,ISHL,2},{-4,1,ISHR,-2},{-1,1,IUSHR,Integer.MAX_VALUE}};
        for (int[] item : cases) {
            byte[] input = fixture(item[0],item[1],item[2],false), original = input.clone();
            var result = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input, 100);
            assertEquals(1, result.changes().size());
            var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(node, 0);
            assertEquals(item[3], ((LdcInsnNode)node.methods.getFirst().instructions.getFirst()).cst);
            assertEquals(2,node.methods.getFirst().instructions.size());
            assertArrayEquals(original,input);
            JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(input,result.bytes());
            new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Analyzer<>(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.BasicVerifier()).analyze(node.name,node.methods.getFirst());
        }
    }
    @Test void preservesThrowingOperationsAndInstructionBoundaries() {
        for (byte[] input : List.of(fixture(5,0,IDIV,false), fixture(5,0,IREM,false), fixture(1,2,IADD,true))) {
            var result = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,100);
            assertTrue(result.changes().isEmpty()); assertArrayEquals(input,result.bytes());
        }
    }
    @Test void hasDefensiveByteCopiesAndRejectsInvalidBudget() {
        byte[] input = fixture(1,2,IADD,false);
        var result = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,1);
        byte[] first = result.bytes(); first[0]=0;
        assertNotEquals(0,result.bytes()[0]);
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,0));
    }
    @Test void boundsChainedFoldingAndKeepsOriginalInstructionIndex() {
        var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture(1,2,IADD,false)).accept(node,0);
        var method = node.methods.getFirst();
        var tail = new InsnList(); tail.add(new LdcInsnNode(3)); tail.add(new InsnNode(IADD));
        method.instructions.insertBefore(method.instructions.getLast(),tail);
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer);
        var once = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(writer.toByteArray(),1);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),once.bytes());
        assertEquals(1,once.changes().size()); assertTrue(once.changeLimitReached());
        var twice = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(writer.toByteArray(),2);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),twice.bytes());
        assertEquals(2,twice.changes().size());
        assertEquals(6,twice.changes().getLast().result());
        assertEquals(0,twice.changes().getLast().instructionIndex());
    }
    @Test void leavesUnknownAttributesUntouched() {
        var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture(1,2,IADD,false)).accept(node,0);
        node.attrs = new ArrayList<>();
        node.attrs.add(new Attribute("UnknownOffsets") {
            @Override protected ByteVector write(ClassWriter writer, byte[] code, int length, int stack, int locals) {
                return new ByteVector().putInt(1234);
            }
        });
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer); byte[] input = writer.toByteArray();
        var result = new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,100);
        assertTrue(result.changes().isEmpty()); assertArrayEquals(input,result.bytes());
    }
    @Test void preservesAlternateEntryFramesWhileFoldingEarlierExpression() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(V1_8,ACC_PUBLIC,"Branches",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC,"value","(Z)I",null,null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitInsn(ICONST_4); method.visitInsn(ICONST_5); method.visitInsn(IADD); method.visitInsn(POP);
        var other = new Label(); var join = new Label();
        method.visitVarInsn(ILOAD,0); method.visitJumpInsn(IFEQ,other);
        method.visitInsn(ICONST_1); method.visitJumpInsn(GOTO,join);
        method.visitLabel(other); method.visitInsn(ICONST_2);
        method.visitLabel(join); method.visitInsn(ICONST_3); method.visitInsn(IADD); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0,0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        byte[] input=writer.toByteArray(); var result=new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,100);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(input,result.bytes());
        assertEquals(1,result.changes().size()); assertSerializedMetadata(input,result.bytes(),0);
        var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(node,0);
        assertEquals(1, Arrays.stream(node.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray()).filter(i -> i.getOpcode()==IADD).count());
    }
    @Test void preservesExceptionHandlerAndThrowingDivisionAfterFolding() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(V1_8,ACC_PUBLIC,"Handlers",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        var method=writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC,"value","()I",null,null);
        var start=new Label(); var end=new Label(); var handler=new Label();
        method.visitTryCatchBlock(start,end,handler,"java/lang/ArithmeticException"); method.visitCode();
        method.visitInsn(ICONST_4); method.visitInsn(ICONST_5); method.visitInsn(IADD); method.visitInsn(POP);
        method.visitLabel(start); method.visitInsn(ICONST_1); method.visitInsn(ICONST_0); method.visitInsn(IDIV);
        method.visitLabel(end); method.visitInsn(IRETURN); method.visitLabel(handler);
        method.visitInsn(POP); method.visitInsn(ICONST_M1); method.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0,0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        byte[] input=writer.toByteArray(); var result=new IntegerConstantPass().apply(input,100);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(input,result.bytes());
        assertEquals(1,result.changes().size()); assertSerializedMetadata(input,result.bytes(),1);
    }
    private void assertSerializedMetadata(byte[] input, byte[] output, int handlers) {
        var before=new ClassNode(); var after=new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(input).accept(before,ClassReader.EXPAND_FRAMES);
        new ClassReader(output).accept(after,ClassReader.EXPAND_FRAMES);
        assertEquals(frames(before),frames(after));
        assertEquals(handlers,after.methods.getFirst().tryCatchBlocks.size());
        var errors=new java.io.StringWriter();
        org.objectweb.asm.util.CheckClassAdapter.verify(new ClassReader(output),false,new java.io.PrintWriter(errors));
        assertEquals("",errors.toString());
    }
    private List<String> frames(ClassNode type) {
        return Arrays.stream(type.methods.getFirst().instructions.toArray()).filter(i -> i instanceof FrameNode)
            .map(i -> (FrameNode)i).map(f -> f.type + ":" + f.local + ":" + f.stack).toList();
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/JvmVerification.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import java.util.Arrays;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertDoesNotThrow;

/** Makes the real JVM verifier check pass output; linking via getDeclaredMethods runs no fixture code. */
final class JvmVerification {
    private JvmVerification() {}

    /** Verifies output that differs from input; refused (unchanged) inputs may be deliberately malformed. */
    static void assertVerifiesIfChanged(byte[] input, byte[] output) {
        if (Arrays.equals(input, output)) return;
        var type = new ClassLoader(null) { Class<?> define() { return defineClass(null, output, 0, output.length); } }.define();
        assertDoesNotThrow(type::getDeclaredMethods, "transformed class must pass JVM verification");
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.List;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class MappingFileTest {
    private static MappingFile.Plan parse(String text) {
        return MappingFile.parse(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
    @Test void parsesClassMethodAndFieldRulesWithDottedNames() {
        var plan=parse("# comment\r\n\nclass p.ab=p.Class00001\nclass p/cd=p/Class00002\nmethod p.ab#run()V=reset\nmethod p/cd#x=allX\nfield p/cd#count:I=total\nfield p.ab#b=bl\n");
        assertEquals("p/Class00001",plan.classes().get("p/ab"));
        assertEquals("p/Class00002",plan.classes().get("p/cd"));
        assertEquals(List.of(
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/ab","run","()V",false,"reset"),
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/ab","b",null,true,"bl"),
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/cd","x",null,false,"allX"),
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/cd","count","I",true,"total")),plan.members());
    }
    @Test void acceptsBomArrayDescriptorsAndBlankLines() {
        var plan=parse("\uFEFF\nfield p/a#arr:[I=items\nmethod p/a#m(I[Ljava/lang/String;)V=go\n");
        assertEquals(List.of(
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","m","(I[Ljava/lang/String;)V",false,"go"),
            new ClassRenamer.MemberRule("p/a","arr","[I",true,"items")),plan.members());
    }
    @Test void rejectsMalformedLinesAndDuplicates() {
        for (String text : List.of(
            "class p/a p/b", "bogus p/a=p/b", "class p/a=", "method p/a#()V=x", "field p/a#x:bad=x",
            "method p/a#m(foo)=x", "field p/a#x:I=", "class p/a=p/b extra", "# nothing\n", "",
            "class p/a=p/b\nclass p/a=p/c", "method p/a#m()V=x\nmethod p/a#m()V=y")) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->parse(text),text);
        }
    }
    @Test void rejectsLimitedOrInvalidInput() {
        var many=new StringBuilder();
        for (int i=0;i<20001;i++) many.append("class p.C").append(i).append("=p.X").append(i).append('\n');
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->parse(many.toString()));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->MappingFile.parse(new byte[MappingFile.MAX_BYTES+1]));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,()->MappingFile.parse(new byte[]{(byte)0xC3}));
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/PassPipelineTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import java.util.List;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

class PassPipelineTest {
    static byte[] fixture(int value, int opcode) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "Unary", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()I", null, null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn(value); method.visitInsn(opcode);
        method.visitInsn(IRETURN); method.visitMaxs(1, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    @Test void foldsUnaryWithJvmSemantics() throws Exception {
        int[][] cases = {{Integer.MIN_VALUE, INEG, Integer.MIN_VALUE}, {255,I2B,-1}, {-1,I2C,65535}, {65535,I2S,-1}};
        for (var item : cases) {
            var result = new IntegerUnaryPass().apply(fixture(item[0], item[1]), 10);
            JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(fixture(item[0], item[1]), result.bytes());
            assertEquals(1, result.changes().size()); assertEquals(item[2], result.changes().getFirst().result());
            var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(node,0);
            new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Analyzer<>(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.BasicVerifier()).analyze(node.name,node.methods.getFirst());
        }
    }
    @Test void preservesBoundariesAndUnrecognizedOperations() {
        byte[] input = fixture(1,I2L);
        assertArrayEquals(input,new IntegerUnaryPass().apply(input,10).bytes());
        var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture(1,INEG)).accept(node,0);
        var label = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.LabelNode();
        var instructions = node.methods.getFirst().instructions;
        instructions.insert(instructions.getFirst(),label);
        instructions.insert(label,new org.objectweb.asm.tree.LineNumberNode(12,label));
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer); input = writer.toByteArray();
        assertArrayEquals(input,new IntegerUnaryPass().apply(input,10).bytes());
    }
    @Test void preservesInstructionTypeAnnotations() {
        var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture(255,I2B)).accept(node,0);
        var operation = node.methods.getFirst().instructions.getFirst().getNext();
        operation.visibleTypeAnnotations = new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        operation.visibleTypeAnnotations.add(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.TypeAnnotationNode(
            TypeReference.newTypeArgumentReference(TypeReference.CAST,0).getValue(),null,"LExampleAnnotation;"));
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer); byte[] input = writer.toByteArray();
        var result = new IntegerUnaryPass().apply(input,10);
        assertArrayEquals(input,result.bytes()); assertTrue(result.changes().isEmpty());
    }
    @Test void followsExplicitPassOrderInOneSweep() {
        var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture(2,INEG)).accept(node,0);
        var tail = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.InsnList(); tail.add(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.LdcInsnNode(3));
        tail.add(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.InsnNode(IADD));
        node.methods.getFirst().instructions.insertBefore(node.methods.getFirst().instructions.getLast(),tail);
        node.methods.getFirst().maxStack=2;
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer);
        var forward = new PassPipeline(BuiltinPasses.select("integer-unary,integer-constants")).apply(writer.toByteArray(),10);
        var reverse = new PassPipeline(BuiltinPasses.select("integer-constants,integer-unary")).apply(writer.toByteArray(),10);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),forward.bytes()); JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),reverse.bytes());
        assertEquals(2,forward.changes().size()); assertEquals(1,forward.changes().getLast().result());
        assertEquals(1,reverse.changes().size());
    }
    @Test void registryRejectsUnknownEmptyAndDuplicateSelections() {
        for (String selection : new String[]{"", "unknown", "integer-unary,integer-unary", "integer-unary,"})
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> BuiltinPasses.select(selection));
    }
    @Test void chainPreservesInputAndSharesBudget() {
        byte[] input = fixture(255,I2B), before = input.clone();
        var pipeline = new PassPipeline(BuiltinPasses.select("integer-constants,integer-unary"));
        var result = pipeline.apply(input, 1);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(input,result.bytes());
        assertEquals(1,result.changes().size()); assertTrue(result.changeLimitReached()); assertArrayEquals(before,input);
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new PassPipeline(List.of(new IntegerConstantPass(),new IntegerConstantPass())));
    }
    @Test void rejectsPassThatExceedsBudget() {
        BytecodePass broken = new BytecodePass() {
            public String id() { return "broken"; }
            public TransformResult apply(byte[] bytes,int limit) {
                var change = new TransformResult.Change(id(),"X","v","()I",0,IADD,1,1,2);
                return new TransformResult(bytes,List.of(change,change),false);
            }
        };
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException.class, () -> new PassPipeline(List.of(broken)).apply(fixture(1,INEG),1));
    }
}
```
