`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/ProguardMappingTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ProguardMappingTest {
    private static final int PRIVATE = 0x0002, PUBLIC = 0x0001;

    private static ProguardMapping.Parsed parse(String text) { return ProguardMapping.parse(text.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)); }
    private static ProguardMapping.Member member(String name, String descriptor, int access) { return new ProguardMapping.Member(name, descriptor, access); }
    private static ProguardMapping.ClassShape shape(List<ProguardMapping.Member> fields, List<ProguardMapping.Member> methods) {
        return new ProguardMapping.ClassShape(PUBLIC, fields, methods);
    }

    @Test void parsesClassFieldMethodRangesCommentsAndInlineFrames() {
        var parsed = parse("""
            # compiler: R8
            # {"id":"com.android.tools.r8.mapping","version":"2.2"}
            com.example.Service -> com.example.a:
            # {"id":"sourceFile","fileName":"Service.java"}
                int retries -> a
                java.lang.String[] names -> b
                1:4:void connect(java.lang.String,int):10:13 -> a
                5:5:void com.example.Util.log(java.lang.String):40:40 -> b
                void <init>() -> <init>
            """);
        var entry = parsed.classes().getFirst();
        assertEquals("com/example/Service", entry.original()); assertEquals("com/example/a", entry.obfuscated());
        assertEquals(5, entry.members().size());
        assertEquals(new ProguardMapping.MemberLine("void", "connect", "java.lang.String,int", false, "a"), entry.members().get(2));
        assertTrue(entry.members().get(1).field());
    }

    @Test void rejectsMalformedAndDuplicateInput() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parse("    int x -> a\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parse("com.example.A -> a\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parse("a.A -> a.a:\n    nonsense\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parse("a.A -> a.a:\na.B -> a.a:\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> parse("# only comments\n"));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> ProguardMapping.parse(new byte[ProguardMapping.MAX_BYTES + 1]));
    }

    @Test void convertsSamePackageClassesAndPrivateMembersUsingObfuscatedDescriptors() {
        var parsed = parse("""
            com.example.Service -> com.example.a:
                int retries -> a
                com.example.Config config -> b
                void connect(com.example.Config,int) -> a
                void open() -> b
            com.example.Config -> com.example.b:
            com.example.Moved -> z.c:
            """);
        var input = new TreeMap<String,ProguardMapping.ClassShape>();
        input.put("com/example/a", shape(
            List.of(member("a", "I", PRIVATE), member("b", "Lcom/example/b;", PRIVATE)),
            List.of(member("a", "(Lcom/example/b;I)V", PRIVATE), member("b", "()V", PUBLIC))));
        input.put("com/example/b", shape(List.of(), List.of()));
        input.put("z/c", shape(List.of(), List.of()));
        var conversion = ProguardMapping.convert(parsed, input);
        assertEquals(Map.of("com/example/a", "com/example/Service", "com/example/b", "com/example/Config"), conversion.plan().classes());
        var targets = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for (var rule : conversion.plan().members()) targets.put(rule.owner() + "#" + rule.name() + rule.descriptor(), rule.target());
        assertEquals(Map.of("com/example/a#aI", "retries", "com/example/a#bLcom/example/b;", "config",
            "com/example/a#a(Lcom/example/b;I)V", "connect"), targets);
        assertEquals(1, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.CROSS_PACKAGE));
        assertEquals(1, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.NOT_PRIVATE));
    }

    @Test void formattedPlanRoundTripsThroughTheExplicitMappingParser() {
        var parsed = parse("p.Original -> p.a:\n    int count -> a\n    void run(java.lang.String[]) -> b\n");
        var input = Map.of("p/a", shape(List.of(member("a", "I", PRIVATE)), List.of(member("b", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", PRIVATE))));
        var plan = ProguardMapping.convert(parsed, input).plan();
        var reparsed = MappingFile.parse(ProguardMapping.format(plan).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        assertEquals(plan, reparsed);
    }

    @Test void skipsSerializationMembersMissingSignaturesAndRecordFields() {
        var parsed = parse("""
            p.Data -> p.a:
                long serialVersionUID -> a
                void readObject(java.io.ObjectInputStream) -> b
                void changed(int) -> c
            p.Point -> p.b:
                int x -> a
            """);
        var input = new TreeMap<String,ProguardMapping.ClassShape>();
        input.put("p/a", shape(List.of(member("a", "J", PRIVATE)),
            List.of(member("b", "(Ljava/io/ObjectInputStream;)V", PRIVATE), member("c", "(J)V", PRIVATE))));
        input.put("p/b", new ProguardMapping.ClassShape(0x10000 | PUBLIC, List.of(member("a", "I", PRIVATE)), List.of()));
        var conversion = ProguardMapping.convert(parsed, input);
        assertTrue(conversion.plan().members().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(2, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.SERIALIZATION_MEMBER));
        assertEquals(1, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.MEMBER_NOT_FOUND));
        assertEquals(1, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.RECORD_FIELD));
    }

    @Test void unqualifiedInlineFrameMakesTheKeyAmbiguousInsteadOfRenamingIt() {
        // An inlined same-class frame shares obfuscated name and descriptor with a method kept under its own name.
        var parsed = parse("""
            p.Worker -> p.a:
                1:1:void helper():5:5 -> a
                1:1:void a():9 -> a
                2:2:void first():3:3 -> b
                2:2:void second():7:7 -> b
            """);
        var input = Map.of("p/a", shape(List.of(), List.of(member("a", "()V", PRIVATE), member("b", "()V", PRIVATE))));
        var conversion = ProguardMapping.convert(parsed, input);
        assertTrue(conversion.plan().members().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(2, conversion.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.AMBIGUOUS));
    }

    @Test void dropsIncoherentNestedAndCollidingRules() {
        var parsed = parse("""
            p.Outer -> p.a:
            p.Outer$Inner -> q.b:
            p.Taken -> p.c:
            """);
        var input = new TreeMap<String,ProguardMapping.ClassShape>();
        for (String name : List.of("p/a", "p/a$b", "p/c", "p/Taken")) input.put(name, shape(List.of(), List.of()));
        var parsedNested = parse("p.Outer -> p.a:\np.Outer$Inner -> p.x:\n");
        var nested = ProguardMapping.convert(parsedNested, Map.of("p/a", shape(List.of(), List.of()), "p/a$b", shape(List.of(), List.of())));
        assertTrue(nested.plan().classes().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, nested.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.NESTED_INCOHERENT));
        var colliding = ProguardMapping.convert(parsed, input);
        assertFalse(colliding.plan().classes().containsKey("p/c"));
        assertEquals(1, colliding.skipped().get(ProguardMapping.Reason.OUTPUT_COLLISION));
    }

    @Test void convertsPrimitiveArrayAndUnmappedLibraryTypes() {
        var classes = Map.of("p/Original", "p/a");
        assertEquals("[[I", ProguardMapping.descriptor("int[][]", classes));
        assertEquals("Lp/a;", ProguardMapping.descriptor("p.Original", classes));
        assertEquals("Ljava/util/List;", ProguardMapping.descriptor("java.util.List", classes));
        assertEquals("(JLp/a;)Z", ProguardMapping.methodDescriptor("long,p.Original", "boolean", classes));
        assertEquals("()V", ProguardMapping.methodDescriptor("", "void", classes));
    }
}
```

```java
    @Test void decodesPureCharArrayXorLoopWithoutLoggingPlaintext() throws Exception {
        byte[] input = compile("DecodeFixture", "public class DecodeFixture {"
            + "private static String decode(String s) { char[] c=s.toCharArray();"
            + "for(int i=0;i<c.length;i++) c[i]=(char)(c[i]^7); return new String(c); }"
            + "public static String value() { return decode(\"Obkkh\"); } }");
        var result = decrypt(input, 10);
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().size());
        assertEquals("string-decryptor-v1", result.changes().getFirst().pass());
        assertFalse(result.changes().toString().contains("Hello"));
        assertFalse(result.changes().toString().contains("Obkkh"));
        var type = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(type, 0);
        var value = type.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals("value")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof LdcInsnNode literal && "Hello".equals(literal.cst)));
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof TypeInsnNode allocation && allocation.getOpcode() == NEW && allocation.desc.equals("java/lang/String")));
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof MethodInsnNode constructor
            && constructor.owner.equals("java/lang/String") && constructor.name.equals("<init>") && constructor.desc.equals("(Ljava/lang/String;)V")));
        assertFalse(Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.name.equals("decode")));
    }

    }

    @Test void decodesBoundedStringSubstringFromFreshStringObjects() throws Exception {

    @Test void stopsInfiniteDecoderAtFuelLimitAndHonorsChangeBudget() throws Exception {

    @Test void refusesOverlongStringInputs() throws Exception {
        String longValue = "x".repeat(4097);
        byte[] input = compile("LongFixture", "public class LongFixture {"
            + "private static String decode(String s) { return new String(s.toCharArray()); }"

        assertArrayEquals(input, decrypt(input, 10).bytes());
    }

    /** Applies the pass and makes the JVM verifier check changed output; linking runs no fixture code. */
    private static TransformResult decrypt(byte[] input, int maxChanges) {
        var result = BuiltinPasses.select("string-decryptor").getFirst().apply(input, maxChanges);
        byte[] bytes = result.bytes();
        if (Arrays.equals(input, bytes)) return result; // some inputs are deliberately malformed; refusal keeps them as-is
        var type = new ClassLoader(null) { Class<?> define() { return defineClass(null, bytes, 0, bytes.length); } }.define();
        assertDoesNotThrow(type::getDeclaredMethods, "transformed class must pass JVM verification");
        return result;
    }

    private byte[] compile(String name, String source) throws Exception {
        Path file = directory.resolve(name + ".java"); Files.writeString(file, source);
        var compiler = ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler(); assertNotNull(compiler);
        assertEquals(0, compiler.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none",
            "-d", directory.toString(), file.toString()));
        return Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve(name + ".class"));
    }

    private void assertDecodesCharset(String name, String charset, String input, String mutation, String expected) throws Exception {
        byte[] bytes = compile(name, "import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets; public class " + name + " {"
            + "private static String decode(String s) { byte[] b=s.getBytes(StandardCharsets." + charset + "); "
            + mutation + " return new String(b,StandardCharsets." + charset + "); }"
            + "public static String value() { return decode(\"" + input + "\"); } }");
        var result = decrypt(bytes, 10);
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().size(), charset);
        var type = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(type, 0);
        var value = type.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals("value")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(value.instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(node -> node instanceof LdcInsnNode literal && expected.equals(literal.cst)), charset);
    }

    private static byte[] loopingFixture() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "LoopingFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var decoder = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC, "decode", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", null, null);
        decoder.visitCode(); var loop = new Label(); decoder.visitLabel(loop); decoder.visitJumpInsn(GOTO, loop); decoder.visitMaxs(0, 1); decoder.visitEnd();
        var value = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()Ljava/lang/String;", null, null);
        value.visitCode(); value.visitLdcInsn("x"); value.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "LoopingFixture", "decode", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", false);
        value.visitInsn(ARETURN); value.visitMaxs(1, 0); value.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] labeledFixture() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "LabelFixture", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var decoder = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC, "decode", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", null, null);
        decoder.visitCode(); decoder.visitVarInsn(ALOAD, 0); decoder.visitInsn(ARETURN); decoder.visitMaxs(0, 0); decoder.visitEnd();
        var value = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "value", "()Ljava/lang/String;", null, null);
        var alternate = new Label(); var join = new Label();
        value.visitCode(); value.visitInsn(ICONST_0); value.visitJumpInsn(IFEQ, alternate);
        value.visitLdcInsn("encrypted"); value.visitJumpInsn(GOTO, join);
        value.visitLabel(alternate); value.visitLdcInsn("encrypted"); value.visitLabel(join);
        value.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "LabelFixture", "decode", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", false);
        value.visitInsn(ARETURN); value.visitMaxs(0, 0); value.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/StringConstantPassTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

class StringConstantPassTest {
    static byte[] fixture(String text,Integer index) {
        var writer=new ClassWriter(0); writer.visit(V1_8,ACC_PUBLIC,"Strings",null,"java/lang/Object",null);
        var method=writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC|ACC_STATIC,"value","()I",null,null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitLdcInsn(text); if(index!=null) method.visitLdcInsn(index);
        method.visitMethodInsn(INVOKEVIRTUAL,"java/lang/String",index==null?"length":"charAt",index==null?"()I":"(I)C",false);
        method.visitInsn(IRETURN); method.visitMaxs(2,0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd(); return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    @Test void usesUtf16LengthAndCodeUnits() throws Exception {
        String text="A\uD83D\uDE00";
        for(int index=-1;index<3;index++) {
            var pass=new StringConstantPass(index==-1?StringConstantPass.Operation.LENGTH:StringConstantPass.Operation.CHAR_AT);
            var result=pass.apply(fixture(text,index==-1?null:index),10);
            JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(fixture(text,index==-1?null:index),result.bytes());
            assertEquals(1,result.changes().size()); assertEquals(index==-1?3:(int)text.charAt(index),result.changes().getFirst().result());
            var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(result.bytes()).accept(node,0);
            new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.Analyzer<>(new org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.BasicVerifier()).analyze(node.name,node.methods.getFirst());
        }
        assertEquals(0,new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.LENGTH).apply(fixture("",null),10).changes().getFirst().result());
    }
    @Test void preservesThrowingIndices() {
        for(int index:new int[]{-1,1,Integer.MAX_VALUE}) {
            byte[] input=fixture("a",index);
            assertArrayEquals(input,new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.CHAR_AT).apply(input,10).bytes());
        }
    }
    @Test void requiresExactCallAndAdjacentOperands() {
        for(int variant=0;variant<4;variant++) {
            var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture("hello",null)).accept(node,0);
            var instructions=node.methods.getFirst().instructions;
            var call=(MethodInsnNode)instructions.getFirst().getNext();
            if(variant==0) call.owner="Other";
            if(variant==1) call.setOpcode(INVOKESTATIC);
            if(variant==2) call.itf=true;
            if(variant==3) { var label=new LabelNode(); instructions.insertBefore(call,label); instructions.insert(label,new LineNumberNode(1,label)); }
            var writer=new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer); byte[] input=writer.toByteArray();
            assertArrayEquals(input,new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.LENGTH).apply(input,10).bytes());
        }
    }
    @Test void preservesAnnotationsAndSharesPipelineBudget() {
        var node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture("secret",null)).accept(node,0);
        var call=node.methods.getFirst().instructions.getFirst().getNext();
        call.invisibleTypeAnnotations=new java.util.ArrayList<>();
        call.invisibleTypeAnnotations.add(new TypeAnnotationNode(TypeReference.newTypeArgumentReference(TypeReference.METHOD_INVOCATION_TYPE_ARGUMENT,0).getValue(),null,"LMarker;"));
        var writer=new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer); byte[] annotated=writer.toByteArray();
        assertArrayEquals(annotated,new StringConstantPass(StringConstantPass.Operation.LENGTH).apply(annotated,10).bytes());
        node=new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(fixture("hello",null)).accept(node,0);
        var extra=new InsnList(); extra.add(new LdcInsnNode(3)); extra.add(new InsnNode(IADD));
        node.methods.getFirst().instructions.insertBefore(node.methods.getFirst().instructions.getLast(),extra);
        writer=new ClassWriter(0); node.accept(writer);
        var pipeline=new PassPipeline(BuiltinPasses.select("string-length,integer-constants"));
        var limited=pipeline.apply(writer.toByteArray(),1);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),limited.bytes());
        assertEquals(1,limited.changes().size()); assertTrue(limited.changeLimitReached());
        var complete=pipeline.apply(writer.toByteArray(),2);
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(writer.toByteArray(),complete.bytes());
        assertEquals(2,complete.changes().size()); assertEquals(8,complete.changes().getLast().result());
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/ZkmFlagPassTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.analysis.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/** Phase 2CM: ZKM-shaped flag holders built with ASM, as in a ZKM-obfuscated input. Classes are only verified, never run. */
class ZkmFlagPassTest {
    @Test void registersAsAnOptInPassThatNeedsTheWholeProgram() {
        assertEquals("zkm-flags-v1", BuiltinPasses.select("zkm-flags").getFirst().id());
        assertTrue(((ZkmFlagPass) BuiltinPasses.select("zkm-flags").getFirst()).flags().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void aFlagTheInitializerSetsToAFreshArrayIsNeverNull() throws Exception {
        // g6: static { Q(new String[3]); }  t() = getstatic k  Q(a) = putstatic k
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[Ljava/lang/String;", clinit -> {
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_3); clinit.visitTypeInsn(ANEWARRAY, "java/lang/String");
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
        });
        var user = user("z/U", "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", IFNULL);
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, user));
        assertEquals(1, pass.flags().size(), pass.rejected().toString());
        assertEquals(1, pass.flags().iterator().next().value());
        var result = pass.apply(user, 100);
        assertEquals(1, result.changes().size());
        assertEquals(0, result.changes().getFirst().result()); // ifnull never taken
        var method = method(result.bytes(), "m");
        assertFalse(has(method, IFNULL) || has(method, IFNONNULL));
        assertFalse(calls(method, "t"), "the read is dropped once nothing tests it");
        assertEquals(List.of(1), returnedConstants(method));
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(user, result.bytes());
    }

    @Test void aFlagTheInitializerOnlyStoresBehindItsOwnTestStaysNull() throws Exception {
        // I: static { if (h() != null) b(new int[2]); }  -- never stores, so y stays null.
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[I", clinit -> {
            var skip = new Label();
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "t", "()[I", false);
            clinit.visitJumpInsn(IFNULL, skip);
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_2); clinit.visitIntInsn(NEWARRAY, T_INT);
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([I)V", false);
            clinit.visitLabel(skip);
        });
        var user = user("z/U", "z/H", "t", "()[I", IFNONNULL);
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, user));
        assertEquals(0, pass.flags().iterator().next().value(), pass.rejected().toString());
        var result = pass.apply(user, 100);
        assertEquals(0, result.changes().getFirst().result()); // ifnonnull never taken
        assertEquals(List.of(1), returnedConstants(method(result.bytes(), "m")));
        JvmVerification.assertVerifiesIfChanged(user, result.bytes());
    }

    @Test void aBooleanFlagSetThroughItsWrapperDuringInitializationIsProvedButTheWrapperIsNeverFolded() throws Exception {
        // G: static { if (s()) K(true); }  s() = !B()  B() = getstatic t  K(z) = putstatic t   => t is true afterwards
        // (here the accessor is t(), the setter Q and the field k)
        var holder = holder("z/H", "Z", clinit -> {
            var skip = new Label();
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "s", "()Z", false);
            clinit.visitJumpInsn(IFEQ, skip);
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_1);
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "(Z)V", false);
            clinit.visitLabel(skip);
        }, writer -> {
            var s = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "s", "()Z", null, null);
            s.visitCode(); var no = new Label();
            s.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "t", "()Z", false);
            s.visitJumpInsn(IFNE, no); s.visitInsn(ICONST_1); s.visitInsn(IRETURN);
            s.visitLabel(no); s.visitInsn(ICONST_0); s.visitInsn(IRETURN);
            s.visitMaxs(0, 0); s.visitEnd();
        });
        var direct = user("z/U", "z/H", "t", "()Z", IFEQ);
        var wrapped = user("z/W", "z/H", "s", "()Z", IFEQ);
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, direct, wrapped));
        var values = new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
        pass.flags().forEach(flag -> values.put(flag.key(), flag.value()));
        assertEquals(Map.of("z/H.k:Z", 1), values, pass.rejected().toString());
        // B() is true: `ifeq` falls through. s() computes a value from the flag: its callers are not folded.
        assertEquals(List.of(1), returnedConstants(method(pass.apply(direct, 100).bytes(), "m")));
        assertTrue(pass.apply(wrapped, 100).changes().isEmpty());
        // The initializer runs before the store and calls s(); s() is a wrapper: neither is folded.
        var folded = pass.apply(holder, 100);
        assertTrue(has(method(folded.bytes(), "<clinit>"), IFEQ));
        assertTrue(has(method(folded.bytes(), "s"), IFNE));
    }

    @Test void aMethodTheInitializerCallsBeforeTheStoreIsNotFoldedForThatFlag() throws Exception {
        // static { early(); Q(new String[1]); }  early() tests t() and sees null; later readers see the array.
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[Ljava/lang/String;", clinit -> {
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/E", "m", "()I", false); clinit.visitInsn(POP);
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_1); clinit.visitTypeInsn(ANEWARRAY, "java/lang/String");
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
        });
        var early = user("z/E", "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", IFNULL);
        var late = user("z/U", "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", IFNULL);
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, early, late));
        assertEquals(1, pass.flags().iterator().next().value(), pass.rejected().toString());
        assertTrue(pass.apply(early, 100).changes().isEmpty());
        assertEquals(1, pass.apply(late, 100).changes().size());
    }

    @Test void aFlagWhoseInitializerCallsNativeCodeIsNotProved() {
        // ZKM with a native layer: static { Loader.registerNativesForClass(...); 0a2b...(); Q(new String[3]); } -- the native layer could set k.
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[Ljava/lang/String;", clinit -> {
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "n0a2b", "()V", false);
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_3); clinit.visitTypeInsn(ANEWARRAY, "java/lang/String");
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
        }, writer -> writer.visitMethod(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC | ACC_NATIVE, "n0a2b", "()V", null, null).visitEnd());
        var user = user("z/U", "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", IFNULL);
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, user));
        assertTrue(pass.flags().isEmpty());
        assertEquals("its <clinit> calls native code (n0a2b), which could set it", pass.rejected().get("z/H.k:[Ljava/lang/String;"));
        assertTrue(pass.apply(user, 100).changes().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void aFlagAReachableStoreChangesIsNotProved() {
        // C.<init>-like: if (t() == null) Q(new String[2]);  -- the flag starts null and flips once that code runs.
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[Ljava/lang/String;", clinit -> { });
        var flipper = user("z/F", "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", IFNONNULL, body -> {
            body.visitInsn(ICONST_2); body.visitTypeInsn(ANEWARRAY, "java/lang/String");
            body.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
        });
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, flipper));
        assertTrue(pass.flags().isEmpty());
        assertTrue(pass.rejected().get("z/H.k:[Ljava/lang/String;").startsWith("a reachable store of another value in z/F.m()I"),
            pass.rejected().toString());
        assertTrue(pass.apply(flipper, 100).changes().isEmpty());
    }

    @Test void anAccessorWhoseValueIsUsedAsDataIsNoFlag() {
        // A singleton-like getter: its result is dereferenced (arraylength), so it is program state, not a flag.
        var holder = holder("z/H", "[Ljava/lang/String;", clinit -> {
            clinit.visitInsn(ICONST_3); clinit.visitTypeInsn(ANEWARRAY, "java/lang/String");
            clinit.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "Q", "([Ljava/lang/String;)V", false);
        });
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, "z/D", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var m = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "m", "()I", null, null);
        m.visitCode();
        m.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, "z/H", "t", "()[Ljava/lang/String;", false);
        m.visitInsn(ARRAYLENGTH); m.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        var pass = ZkmFlagPass.plan(List.of(holder, writer.toByteArray()));
        assertTrue(pass.flags().isEmpty());
        assertEquals("used as data in z/D.m()I", pass.rejected().get("z/H.k:[Ljava/lang/String;"));
    }

    // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    /** A ZKM flag holder: static field k, accessor t() (getstatic; return), setter Q (load 0; putstatic; return). */
    @SafeVarargs
    private static byte[] holder(String name, String desc, Consumer<MethodVisitor> clinit, Consumer<ClassWriter>... extra) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(ACC_PRIVATE | ACC_STATIC, "k", desc, null, null).visitEnd();
        String field = "k";
        var type = Type.getType(desc);
        var get = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "t", "()" + desc, null, null);
        get.visitCode(); get.visitFieldInsn(GETSTATIC, name, field, desc); get.visitInsn(type.getOpcode(IRETURN)); get.visitMaxs(0, 0); get.visitEnd();
        var set = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "Q", "(" + desc + ")V", null, null);
        set.visitCode(); set.visitVarInsn(type.getOpcode(ILOAD), 0); set.visitFieldInsn(PUTSTATIC, name, field, desc); set.visitInsn(RETURN);
        set.visitMaxs(0, 0); set.visitEnd();
        var init = writer.visitMethod(ACC_STATIC, "<clinit>", "()V", null, null);
        init.visitCode(); clinit.accept(init); init.visitInsn(RETURN); init.visitMaxs(0, 0); init.visitEnd();
        for (var more : extra) more.accept(writer);
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    /** m()I: v = owner.accessor(); store and reload it, then `test` jumps to `return 2`, else `return 1`. */
    private static byte[] user(String name, String owner, String accessor, String desc, int test) { return user(name, owner, accessor, desc, test, body -> { }); }
    private static byte[] user(String name, String owner, String accessor, String desc, int test, Consumer<MethodVisitor> fallThrough) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC, name, null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var m = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "m", "()I", null, null);
        m.visitCode(); var jump = new Label();
        var type = Type.getReturnType(desc);
        m.visitMethodInsn(INVOKESTATIC, owner, accessor, desc, false);
        m.visitVarInsn(type.getOpcode(ISTORE), 0); m.visitVarInsn(type.getOpcode(ILOAD), 0);
        m.visitJumpInsn(test, jump);
        fallThrough.accept(m);
        m.visitInsn(ICONST_1); m.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        m.visitLabel(jump); m.visitInsn(ICONST_2); m.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }
    private static MethodNode method(byte[] bytes, String name) {
        var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, 0);
        return node.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals(name)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
    }
    private static boolean has(MethodNode method, int opcode) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() == opcode) return true;
        return false;
    }
    private static boolean calls(MethodNode method, String name) {
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.name.equals(name)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    /** The constants pushed right before each return still in the method. */
    private static List<Integer> returnedConstants(MethodNode method) throws AnalyzerException {
        new Analyzer<>(new BasicVerifier()).analyze("x", method);
        var result = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() == IRETURN) {
            var previous = insn.getPrevious();
            while (previous.getOpcode() < 0) previous = previous.getPrevious();
            result.add(previous.getOpcode() - ICONST_0);
        }
        return result;
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/AidsfuscatorReverserTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.Handle;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CZ: the Aidsfuscator reversal over a synthetic jar written for ClassRevive in Aidsfuscator's shapes (the
 * obfuscator itself has no license, so none of its output is committed): an FNV-1a salt dispatcher and a class salt read
 * through {@code MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass()}, a hash integrity field backed by the SHA-256 of the class file,
 * salt parameters, a flattened method, a string decryptor keyed by its caller's stack trace and a number decryptor with
 * their initializer, and {@code invokedynamic} references through a {@code MutableCallSite} bootstrap, one of them in a
 * method nothing calls. Classes are linked by the JVM verifier in an isolated loader; none is initialized or executed.
 */
class AidsfuscatorReverserTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    static final int SALT = 0x5A5A1234, FAKE = 0x1111, MASK = 0x0F0F0F0F, LOCAL_SALT = 0x13572468;
    static final int WEIGHT_SALT = 0x2468ACE0, CALL_SALT = 0x0BADF00D, ORPHAN_SALT = 0x31415926, HASH_VALUE = 0x600DCAFE, HASH_PARAM = 0x0FF1CE;
    static final int K0 = 0x11111111, K1 = 0x22222222, K2 = 0x33333333, DEC_KEY = 0x4321, INDEX_KEY = 0x1234;
    static final char STATIC_KIND = '帀';

    private static String hex(int value) { return "0x" + Integer.toHexString(value); }
    private static String escape(String text) {
        var out = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : text.toCharArray()) out.append(String.format("\\u%04x", (int) c));
        return out.toString();
    }
    /** The string decryptor's encryption for a call from {@code method} of {@code app.App}. */
    private static String encrypt(String plain, int key, String method) {
        int hash = ("app.App".hashCode() ^ method.hashCode()) >> 16;
        var chars = plain.toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) chars[i] = (char) (chars[i] ^ key ^ hash);
        return new String(chars);
    }

    private Map<String,byte[]> obfuscatedJar() throws Exception {
        int q = WEIGHT_SALT | MASK;
        String token = "app.App:answer:()I";
        var tokenChars = token.toCharArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < tokenChars.length; i++) tokenChars[i] = (char) (tokenChars[i] ^ DEC_KEY);
        var sources = Map.of(
            "d/Dispatcher.java", """
                package d;
                import java.util.*;
                public class Dispatcher {
                    private static Map<Long,Integer> values = new HashMap<>();
                    static { init(); }
                    private static long hash(String s) { long h = 0xcbf29ce484222325L; for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) { h ^= s.charAt(i); h *= 0x100000001b3L; } return h; }
                    private static void init() { values.put(%sL, %s); }
                    public static int get(Object type, int fake) { return values.get(hash(((Class<?>) type).getName())) ^ fake; }
                }
                """.formatted(AidsfuscatorReverser.fnv("app.App"), hex(SALT ^ FAKE)),
            "app/Hash.java", """
                package app;
                public class Hash {
                    static java.io.InputStream in;
                    static { in = Hash.class.getResourceAsStream("/h.bin"); }
                    public static String sha(byte[] bytes) throws Exception { java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256"); return ""; }
                    public static int get(Class<?> type, int key) { return 0; }
                }
                """,
            "app/Refs.java", """
                package app;
                import java.lang.invoke.*;
                public class Refs {
                    static String[] refs = new String[1];
                    static { fill(); }
                    static void fill() { refs[0] = "%s"; }
                    public static CallSite bootstrap(MethodHandles.Lookup lookup, String name, MethodType type) { return new MutableCallSite(type); }
                    static String decode(int index, int key) { return refs[index]; }
                    static int marker(int index, int key) { return 0; }
                    private static MethodHandle invoker(MethodHandles.Lookup lookup, MutableCallSite site, String name, MethodType type, int idx, int key) throws Exception {
                        int index = idx ^ %s;
                        char kind = name.charAt(0);
                        String[] parts = decode(index, key).split(":");
                        Class<?> owner = Class.forName(parts[0]);
                        MethodType target = MethodType.fromMethodDescriptorString(parts[2], Refs.class.getClassLoader());
                        switch (kind) {
                            case '\\u4e00': return lookup.findVirtual(owner, parts[1], target);
                            case '\\u5e00': return lookup.findStatic(owner, parts[1], target);
                            case '\\u6e00': case '\\u7e00':
                                if (kind != '\\u6e00') return lookup.findSetter(owner, parts[1], target.returnType());
                                else return lookup.findGetter(owner, parts[1], target.returnType());
                            default: return null;
                        }
                    }
                }
                """.formatted(escape(new String(tokenChars)), hex(INDEX_KEY)),
            "app/App.java", """
                package app;
                import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles;
                public class App {
                    public static final int SALT = d.Dispatcher.get(MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass(), %s);
                    static final int HASH = Hash.get(MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass(), %s);
                    private static String[] strings = { "%s", "%s" };
                    private static Object[] cache = new Object[2];
                    private static int[] numbers = { %s };
                    static String GREETING;
                    static { GREETING = dec(0x55, %s); }

                    private static String dec(int index, int key) {
                        char[] chars = strings[index ^ 0x55].toCharArray();
                        StackTraceElement[] trace = (StackTraceElement[]) cache[index ^ 0x55];
                        if (trace == null) { trace = new Throwable().getStackTrace(); cache[index ^ 0x55] = trace; }
                        StackTraceElement caller = trace[1];
                        int hash = (caller.getClassName().hashCode() ^ caller.getMethodName().hashCode()) >> 16;
                        for (int i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) chars[i] = (char) (chars[i] ^ key ^ hash);
                        return new String(chars).intern();
                    }
                    private static int num(int index, int key) { return numbers[index ^ 0x66] ^ key; }

                    static int weight(int code, int salt) {
                        int state = (salt | %s) ^ %s;
                        while (true) {
                            switch (state) {
                                case %s: if (code == 1) { state = (salt | %s) ^ %s; break; } state = (salt | %s) ^ %s; break;
                                case %s: return (salt | %s) ^ %s;
                                case %s: return -1;
                                default: return 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    static int local() { int s = (SALT & 0x00FF00FF) ^ %s; return (s | %s) ^ %s; }
                    static int hashed() { return HASH ^ %s; }
                    public static int answer() { return 42; }
                    static int callAnswer(int salt) { return Refs.marker(%s, (salt | %s) ^ %s); }
                    static int orphan(int salt) { return Refs.marker(%s, (salt | %s) ^ %s); }
                    static String greet() { return dec(0x54, %s); }
                    static int number() { return num(0x66, 0x7777); }
                    public static void main(String[] args) {
                        System.out.println(weight(7, %s) + local() + callAnswer(%s) + greet() + number() + GREETING);
                    }
                }
                """.formatted(hex(FAKE), hex(HASH_PARAM),
                    escape(encrypt("ledger", 0x2222, "<clinit>")), escape(encrypt("hello", 0x3333, "greet")),
                    hex(1000 ^ 0x7777), hex(0x2222),
                    hex(MASK), hex(q ^ K0),
                    hex(K0), hex(MASK), hex(q ^ K1), hex(MASK), hex(q ^ K2),
                    hex(K1), hex(MASK), hex(q ^ 10),
                    hex(K2),
                    hex((SALT & 0x00FF00FF) ^ LOCAL_SALT), hex(MASK), hex((LOCAL_SALT | MASK) ^ 42),
                    hex(HASH_VALUE ^ 77),
                    hex(INDEX_KEY), hex(MASK), hex((CALL_SALT | MASK) ^ (DEC_KEY << 16)),
                    hex(INDEX_KEY), hex(MASK), hex((ORPHAN_SALT | MASK) ^ (DEC_KEY << 16)),
                    hex(0x3333), hex(WEIGHT_SALT), hex(CALL_SALT)));
        var src = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("src"));
        var files = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var source : sources.entrySet()) {
            var file = src.resolve(source.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
            Files.writeString(file, source.getValue());
            files.add(file.toString());
        }
        var classes = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("classes"));
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-nowarn", "-d", classes.toString()));
        args.addAll(files);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        var entries = new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        for (String name : List.of("d/Dispatcher", "app/Hash", "app/Refs")) entries.put(name + ".class", Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(name + ".class")));
        // Refs.marker(index, key) becomes invokedynamic "<static kind>" (II)I through the bootstrap.
        var app = new ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve("app/App.class"))).accept(app, 0);
        var bootstrap = new Handle(H_INVOKESTATIC, "app/Refs", "bootstrap",
            "(Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodHandles$Lookup;Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/invoke/MethodType;)Ljava/lang/invoke/CallSite;", false);
        for (var method : app.methods)
            for (var insn : method.instructions.toArray())
                if (insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.name.equals("marker"))
                    method.instructions.set(insn, new InvokeDynamicInsnNode(String.valueOf(STATIC_KIND), "(II)I", bootstrap));
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        app.accept(writer);
        byte[] appBytes = writer.toByteArray();
        entries.put("app/App.class", appBytes);
        // The hash resource: SHA-256 hex of App.class, then HASH_VALUE ^ hex.hashCode() ^ param.
        String sha = AidsfuscatorReverser.sha256(appBytes);
        var resource = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream();
        resource.write(sha.getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1));
        int stored = HASH_VALUE ^ sha.hashCode() ^ HASH_PARAM;
        resource.write(new byte[] {(byte) (stored >> 24), (byte) (stored >> 16), (byte) (stored >> 8), (byte) stored});
        entries.put("h.bin", resource.toByteArray());
        return entries;
    }

    private static MethodNode method(ClassNode node, String name) {
        return node.methods.stream().filter(m -> m.name.equals(name)).findFirst().orElseThrow(() -> new AssertionError("no " + name));
    }
    private static List<Integer> opcodes(MethodNode method) {
        var result = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() >= 0) result.add(insn.getOpcode());
        return result;
    }
    private static Integer returnedConstant(MethodNode method) {
        var real = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn.getOpcode() >= 0) real.add(insn);
        return real.size() == 2 && real.get(1).getOpcode() == IRETURN ? SkidModel.literal(real.getFirst()) : null;
    }

    @Test void theSyntheticJarIsReversedLinkedAndCleaned() throws Exception {
        var result = new AidsfuscatorReverser().apply(obfuscatedJar(), 10_000);
        var report = result.report();
        assertTrue(report.detected(), report.toString());
        assertEquals(List.of(), report.refused(), report.toString());
        assertEquals(1, report.count("class salts resolved"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(1, report.count("hash fields resolved"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(2, report.count("references decoded"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(1, report.count("of which with a searched key (no call reveals the salt)"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(0, report.count("references not decoded"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(2, report.count("strings decrypted"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(1, report.count("numbers decrypted"), report.toString());
        assertEquals(0, report.count("class write failures"), report.toString());
        SkidfuscatorReverserTest.link(result.entries());

        // The dispatcher, the reference bootstrap and the hash class and its resource are gone.
        assertEquals(Set.of("app/App.class"), result.entries().keySet());
        var app = SkidfuscatorReverserTest.node(result.entries().get("app/App.class"));
        assertEquals(List.of("GREETING"), app.fields.stream().map(f -> f.name).toList());
        assertTrue(app.methods.stream().noneMatch(m -> m.name.equals("dec") || m.name.equals("num")), "decryptors removed");
        // Salt parameters are gone from the declarations and the calls; the method nothing calls too (its salt was searched).
        assertEquals("(I)I", method(app, "weight").desc);
        assertEquals("()I", method(app, "callAnswer").desc);
        assertEquals("()I", method(app, "orphan").desc);
        // Flattening and salts folded: weight has no dispatcher left and returns 10 as a constant.
        var weight = opcodes(method(app, "weight"));
        assertFalse(weight.contains(LOOKUPSWITCH) || weight.contains(TABLESWITCH), weight.toString());
        assertTrue(Arrays.stream(method(app, "weight").instructions.toArray()).anyMatch(i -> Integer.valueOf(10).equals(SkidModel.literal(i))));
        assertEquals(42, returnedConstant(method(app, "local")));
        assertEquals(77, returnedConstant(method(app, "hashed")));
        // References are calls again.
        for (String name : List.of("callAnswer", "orphan")) {
            var calls = Arrays.stream(method(app, name).instructions.toArray()).filter(i -> i instanceof MethodInsnNode).map(i -> (MethodInsnNode) i).toList();
            assertEquals(1, calls.size(), name);
            assertEquals("app/App.answer()I", calls.getFirst().owner + "." + calls.getFirst().name + calls.getFirst().desc);
        }
        // Strings and numbers are literals; the initializer is gone from <clinit>.
        assertEquals(Set.of("ledger", "hello"), SkidfuscatorReverserTest.literals(app));
        assertEquals(1000, returnedConstant(method(app, "number")));
        assertEquals(List.of(LDC, PUTSTATIC, RETURN), opcodes(method(app, "<clinit>")));
    }

    @Test void aJarWithoutAidsfuscatorIsLeftAsItIs() throws Exception {
        var src = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("plain"));
        Files.writeString(src.resolve("Plain.java"), "public class Plain { static int twice(int x) { int k = 100000; return x * 2 + k; } }");
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d",
            src.toString(), src.resolve("Plain.java").toString()));
        var entries = Map.of("Plain.class", Files.readAllBytes(src.resolve("Plain.class")));
        var result = new AidsfuscatorReverser().apply(entries, 100);
        assertFalse(result.report().detected());
        assertSame(entries, result.entries());
    }

    @Test void flowIntsMaskedLongsFoldBackToTheLong() {
        long original = 0x5DEECE66DL;
        int block = 0x13572468;
        long mask = block & 0xFFFFFFFFL;
        long obf = ((original << 32 >>> 32) ^ mask) | (((original >>> 32) ^ mask) << 32);
        var method = new MethodNode(ACC_STATIC, "m", "()J", null, null);
        var insns = method.instructions;
        insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(obf)); insns.add(new InsnNode(DUP2)); insns.add(new IntInsnNode(BIPUSH, 32)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LSHL));
        insns.add(new IntInsnNode(BIPUSH, 32)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LUSHR)); insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(block)); insns.add(new InsnNode(I2L));
        insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(0xFFFFFFFFL)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LAND)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LXOR)); insns.add(new InsnNode(DUP2_X2));
        insns.add(new InsnNode(POP2)); insns.add(new IntInsnNode(BIPUSH, 32)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LUSHR)); insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(block));
        insns.add(new InsnNode(I2L)); insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(0xFFFFFFFFL)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LAND)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LXOR));
        insns.add(new IntInsnNode(BIPUSH, 32)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LSHL)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LOR)); insns.add(new InsnNode(LRETURN));
        assertEquals(1, new AidsConstants().foldMaskedLongs(method));
        assertEquals(2, method.instructions.size());
        assertEquals(original, ((LdcInsnNode) method.instructions.getFirst()).cst);
    }

    @Test void reusedIntegersArePutBackOnlyForLocalsSetOnce() {
        var method = new MethodNode(ACC_STATIC, "m", "(I)I", null, null);
        var insns = method.instructions;
        insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(123456)); insns.add(new VarInsnNode(ISTORE, 1));
        insns.add(new LdcInsnNode(654321)); insns.add(new VarInsnNode(ISTORE, 2));
        insns.add(new VarInsnNode(ILOAD, 1)); insns.add(new VarInsnNode(ILOAD, 1)); insns.add(new InsnNode(IADD));
        insns.add(new VarInsnNode(ILOAD, 2)); insns.add(new InsnNode(IADD)); insns.add(new IincInsnNode(2, 1));
        insns.add(new InsnNode(IRETURN));
        // Local 1 is only loaded: put back. Local 2 is incremented: it is the program's and stays.
        assertEquals(1, AidsfuscatorReverser.inlineReusedIntegers(method));
        assertEquals(List.of(LDC, ISTORE, LDC, LDC, IADD, ILOAD, IADD, IINC, IRETURN), opcodes(method));
    }

    @Test void aGenericSignatureLosesTheAppendedSaltOnly() {
        assertEquals("()Ljava/util/List<Ljava/lang/String;>;", AidsParameters.dropLastInt("(I)Ljava/util/List<Ljava/lang/String;>;"));
        assertEquals("(Ljava/util/Map<TK;TV;>;)V", AidsParameters.dropLastInt("(Ljava/util/Map<TK;TV;>;I)V"));
        assertEquals("([I)V", AidsParameters.dropLastInt("([I)V"));
        assertEquals(2, AidsParameters.parameterCount("<T:Ljava/lang/Object;>(Ljava/util/Map<TT;Ljava/util/List<TT;>;>;[I)TT;"));
    }
}
```

`modules/transforms/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/transforms/skid/SkidfuscatorReverserTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.transforms.skid;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter;
import org.objectweb.asm.Label;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;
import static org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.*;

/**
 * Phase 2CN/2CO: the reversal over a real Skidfuscator 2.1.0 output (benchmarks/obfuscated/skidfuscator, our own fixture
 * source obfuscated with the default configuration) and over synthetic classes. Classes are defined and linked in an
 * isolated loader (the JVM verifier runs); none is initialized or executed.
 */
class SkidfuscatorReverserTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of(System.getProperty("classrevive.skidfuscatorFixtures", "missing"));

    static Map<String,byte[]> entries(Path jar) throws Exception {
        var result = new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
        try (var zip = new ZipFile(jar.toFile())) {
            for (var entry : Collections.list(zip.entries())) result.put(entry.getName(), zip.getInputStream(entry).readAllBytes());
        }
        return result;
    }
    static ClassNode node(byte[] bytes) { var node = new ClassNode(); new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES); return node; }
    static Set<String> literals(ClassNode node) {
        var result = new TreeSet<String>();
        for (var method : node.methods) for (var insn : method.instructions) if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc && ldc.cst instanceof String s) result.add(s);
        return result;
    }
    /** Defines every class in one isolated loader and links it (JVM verification); nothing is initialized. */
    static void link(Map<String,byte[]> entries) throws Exception {
        var bytes = new HashMap<String,byte[]>();
        entries.forEach((name, value) -> { if (name.endsWith(".class")) bytes.put(name.substring(0, name.length() - 6).replace('/', '.'), value); });
        var loader = new ClassLoader(null) {
            @Override protected Class<?> findClass(String name) throws ClassNotFoundException {
                byte[] value = bytes.get(name);
                if (value == null) return ClassLoader.getPlatformClassLoader().loadClass(name);
                return defineClass(name, value, 0, value.length);
            }
        };
        for (String name : bytes.keySet()) {
            var type = Class.forName(name, false, loader);
            assertDoesNotThrow(type::getDeclaredMethods, name);
        }
    }

    @Test void theFixtureIsRecoveredVerifiedAndCleaned() throws Exception {
        var obfuscated = entries(FIXTURES.resolve("skid-fixture-obf.jar"));
        var reference = entries(FIXTURES.resolve("skid-fixture.jar"));
        var result = new SkidfuscatorReverser().apply(obfuscated, 10_000);
        var report = result.report();
        assertTrue(report.detected());
        assertEquals(List.of(), report.refused());
        assertEquals(0, report.count("class write failures"));
        assertEquals(0, report.count("strings not decrypted"));
        assertTrue(report.count("strings decrypted") >= 30, report.toString());
        link(result.entries());
        // The hash factory is gone; only the SDK stays, for the one literal the bounded search cannot find ("Administrator").
        assertEquals(1, report.count("hash factories removed"));
        assertEquals(3, report.count("type checks recovered"));
        assertEquals(4, report.count("equals literals recovered"));
        assertEquals(4, report.count("hashed switches recovered"));
        assertEquals(12, report.count("injected parameters removed"));

        for (var entry : reference.entrySet()) {
            if (!entry.getKey().endsWith(".class")) continue;
            var expected = node(entry.getValue());
            var actual = node(result.entries().get(entry.getKey()));
            // Fields: the seed fields, key fields and the ASCII-art field are gone; the program's fields are untouched.
            assertEquals(expected.fields.stream().map(f -> f.name + f.desc).sorted().toList(),
                actual.fields.stream().map(f -> f.name + f.desc).sorted().toList(), expected.name);
            // Methods: the injected seed parameters are gone, so every signature is the reference's again.
            assertEquals(expected.methods.stream().map(m -> m.name + m.desc).sorted().toList(),
                actual.methods.stream().map(m -> m.name + m.desc).sorted().toList(), expected.name);
            // No decryptor, generator, XOR helper or seed switch is left.
            for (var method : actual.methods) {
                assertFalse(method.desc.endsWith("[B") && method.desc.startsWith("()"), expected.name + "." + method.name);
                assertFalse(StringRecovery.recognize(actual, method) != null, expected.name + "." + method.name);
                assertFalse(SkidfuscatorReverser.xorHelper(method), expected.name + "." + method.name);
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    assertFalse(insn instanceof FieldInsnNode f && f.name.startsWith("nothing_to_see_here"));
                    assertFalse(insn instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.owner.equals("java/lang/Integer") && call.name.equals("parseInt"),
                        expected.name + "." + method.name + " keeps a constructor seed");
                }
            }
            // Every literal of the reference is back, except those Skidfuscator replaced by a hash (equals against a constant).
            var missing = new TreeSet<>(literals(expected));
            missing.removeAll(literals(actual));
            missing.removeAll(Set.of("root", "Administrator", "start", "stop", "pause"));
            assertEquals(Set.of(), missing, expected.name);
        }
    }

    @Test void theProgramsOwnConstantsAndBranchesStay() throws Exception {
        // A seed local with Skidfuscator's updates, beside the program's own constant local and branch on it.
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "t/Prog", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var m = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "f", "()I", null, null);
        m.visitCode();
        m.visitLdcInsn(1000); m.visitLdcInsn(7); m.visitInsn(IXOR); m.visitVarInsn(ISTORE, 1); // seed = 1000 ^ 7 (unfolded: obfuscator)
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { m.visitLdcInsn(11 + k); m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 1); m.visitInsn(IXOR); m.visitVarInsn(ISTORE, 1); }
        m.visitInsn(ICONST_5); m.visitVarInsn(ISTORE, 0); // int x = 5 (the program's)
        var other = new Label();
        m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); m.visitInsn(ICONST_5); m.visitJumpInsn(IF_ICMPNE, other); // if (x == 5)
        m.visitLdcInsn(1000 ^ 7 ^ 11 ^ 12 ^ 13 ^ 42); m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 1); m.visitInsn(IXOR); m.visitInsn(IRETURN); // return 42 (encrypted)
        m.visitLabel(other);
        m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); m.visitInsn(IRETURN); // return x (x is read twice: a real variable, not a spill)
        m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        var result = new SkidfuscatorReverser().apply(Map.of("t/Prog.class", writer.toByteArray()), 100);
        var method = node(result.entries().get("t/Prog.class")).methods.stream().filter(x -> x.name.equals("f")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        var ops = new ArrayList<String>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn.getOpcode() < 0) continue;
            ops.add(insn instanceof IntInsnNode push ? "push " + push.operand : insn instanceof JumpInsnNode ? "jump " + insn.getOpcode()
                : insn instanceof VarInsnNode var ? insn.getOpcode() + "@" + var.var : String.valueOf(insn.getOpcode()));
        }
        // The program's x = 5 and its branch stay; the encrypted 42 is folded; the seed local is gone.
        assertEquals(List.of(String.valueOf(ICONST_5), ISTORE + "@0", ILOAD + "@0", String.valueOf(ICONST_5), "jump " + IF_ICMPNE,
            "push 42", String.valueOf(IRETURN), ILOAD + "@0", String.valueOf(IRETURN)), ops);
        link(result.entries());
    }

    @Test void aJarWithoutSkidfuscatorIsReturnedAsItIs() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "t/Plain", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var m = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "f", "(I)I", null, null);
        m.visitCode(); m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); m.visitLdcInsn(77); m.visitInsn(IXOR); m.visitInsn(IRETURN); m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        byte[] bytes = writer.toByteArray();
        var result = new SkidfuscatorReverser().apply(Map.of("t/Plain.class", bytes), 100);
        assertFalse(result.report().detected());
        assertArrayEquals(bytes, result.entries().get("t/Plain.class"));
    }

    @Test void theBitwiseAndLegacyHashesEvaluateStatically() {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "h/Factory", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var legacy = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "legacy", "(I)I", null, null);
        legacy.visitCode();
        var zero = new Label();
        legacy.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); legacy.visitJumpInsn(IFEQ, zero);
        legacy.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); legacy.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, 31); legacy.visitInsn(IMUL); legacy.visitInsn(ICONST_4); legacy.visitInsn(IUSHR);
        legacy.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); legacy.visitInsn(IREM); legacy.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); legacy.visitIntInsn(BIPUSH, 16); legacy.visitInsn(IUSHR);
        legacy.visitInsn(IXOR); legacy.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        legacy.visitLabel(zero); legacy.visitInsn(ICONST_0); legacy.visitInsn(IRETURN);
        legacy.visitMaxs(0, 0); legacy.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        var nodes = Map.of("h/Factory", node(writer.toByteArray()));
        var pure = new PureEvaluator(nodes);
        for (int s : new int[] {1, -7, 123456789, Integer.MIN_VALUE, 0}) {
            int expected = s == 0 ? 0 : (((s * 31) >>> 4) % s) ^ (s >>> 16);
            assertEquals(expected, pure.evaluate("h/Factory", "legacy", "(I)I", new Object[] {s}).orElseThrow());
        }
        assertTrue(pure.pureBody("h/Factory", "legacy", "(I)I"));
        assertEquals(1197013600, pure.evaluate("java/lang/Math", "max", "(II)I", new Object[] {5, 1197013600}).orElseThrow());
        assertEquals((int) 'a', pure.evaluate("java/lang/Character", "toLowerCase", "(I)I", new Object[] {(int) 'A'}).orElseThrow());
    }

    /** Phase 2DC: a method with many locals and blocks whose frames take more than ASM's default 100 million operations. */
    static void wideMethod(ClassWriter writer, int locals, int blocks) {
        var m = writer.visitMethod(ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_STATIC, "f", "(I)I", null, null);
        m.visitCode();
        for (int i = 1; i <= locals; i++) { m.visitInsn(ICONST_0); m.visitVarInsn(ISTORE, i); }
        var labels = new Label[blocks];
        for (int i = 0; i < blocks; i++) labels[i] = new Label();
        for (int i = 0; i < blocks; i++) { m.visitLabel(labels[i]); m.visitVarInsn(ILOAD, 0); m.visitJumpInsn(IFEQ, labels[(i * 7 + 3) % blocks]); m.visitIincInsn(0, -1); }
        m.visitInsn(ICONST_0); m.visitInsn(IRETURN); m.visitMaxs(0, 0); m.visitEnd();
    }

    @Test void aLargeRebuiltMethodGetsItsFramesWithinTheRaisedBudget() {
        var plain = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        plain.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "l/Wide", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        assertThrows(org.objectweb.asm.LimitExceededException.class, () -> { wideMethod(plain, 400, 2500); plain.visitEnd(); plain.toByteArray(); });
        var writer = new Hierarchy(Map.of()).writer(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(V1_8, ACC_PUBLIC | ACC_SUPER, "l/Wide", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        wideMethod(writer, 400, 2500); writer.visitEnd();
        assertTrue(writer.toByteArray().length > 0);
    }

    @Test void aClassThatCannotBeWrittenIsReportedWithItsReason() {
        assertEquals("a/B: frame computation over its budget (Too many operations)",
            Hierarchy.failure("a/B", new org.objectweb.asm.LimitExceededException("Too many operations")));
        assertEquals("a/B: a method grew past 64 KiB of code",
            Hierarchy.failure("a/B", new org.objectweb.asm.MethodTooLargeException("a/B", "f", "()V", 70000)));
        assertEquals("a/B: IllegalStateException: odd", Hierarchy.failure("a/B", new IllegalStateException("odd")));
        var report = new SkidfuscatorReverser.Report(true, Map.of("class write failures", 1), List.of(), List.of(), List.of("a/B: why"));
        assertTrue(report.toString().contains("classes kept as they were (write failed): [a/B: why]"), report.toString());
    }

    @Test void abstractAndNativeMethodsAreNoRefusals() {
        var model = new SkidModel(new HashMap<>());
        var rewriter = new MethodRewriter(model.interpreter(), (call, args) -> false);
        var stats = new MethodRewriter.Stats();

        assertEquals(0, stats.unanalyzable);
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/ClassCoverage.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

public record ClassCoverage(String className, int expectedSymbols, int matchedSymbols) {
    public ClassCoverage {
        if (className == null || className.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("className is required");
        if (expectedSymbols < 0 || matchedSymbols < 0 || matchedSymbols > expectedSymbols)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid class signature counts");
    }

    public int coveragePermille() {
        return expectedSymbols == 0 ? 0 : (int) ((matchedSymbols * 1000L) / expectedSymbols);
    }

    public boolean complete() {
        return expectedSymbols > 0 && matchedSymbols == expectedSymbols;
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/ClassRoundTrip.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.Outcome;
import java.util.List;

/** Per-method round-trip outcomes for one original class; selection uses the totals only to break structural ties. */
public record ClassRoundTrip(String className, List<MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult> methods) {
    public ClassRoundTrip {
        if (className == null || className.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("className is required");
        methods = List.copyOf(methods);
    }
    public int identical() { return count(Outcome.IDENTICAL); }
    public int equivalent() { return count(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION); }
    public int different() { return count(Outcome.DIFFERENT); }
    private int count(Outcome outcome) { return (int) methods.stream().filter(method -> method.outcome() == outcome).count(); }
}
```
