`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/CompilerVerifier.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.*;
import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;

public final class CompilerVerifier {
    public VerificationResult verify(Path sources, Path work, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout) throws IOException {
        return verify(sources,work,originals,timeout,List.of());
    }
    public VerificationResult verify(Path sources, Path work, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies) throws IOException {
        return verify(sources,work,originals,timeout,dependencies,null);
    }
    /**
     * @param originalClasses optional normalized class JAR holding the bytes the engines decompiled; when present and
     *                        the candidate compiles, each method body is also compared by {@link MethodRoundTrip}.
     */
    public VerificationResult verify(Path sources, Path work, List<ClassInfo> originals, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                                     Path originalClasses) throws IOException {
        // A module descriptor is not ordinary source: it is neither recompiled nor counted (CompilerWorker skips module-info.java).
        int descriptors = (int) originals.stream().filter(info -> info.name().equals("module-info")).count();
        var allOriginals = originals;
        originals = originals.stream().filter(info -> !info.name().equals("module-info")).toList();
        Map<String,Set<String>> expectedByClass = symbolsByClass(originals);
        int expectedCount = expectedByClass.values().stream().mapToInt(Set::size).sum();
        int release = release(originals);
        int newest = originals.stream().mapToInt(ClassInfo::javaVersion).max().orElse(release);
        String releaseNote = (newest < release ? "release=" + release + " (Java " + newest + " class files; javac 21 targets 8 at the lowest)"
            : "release=" + release) + (descriptors > 0 ? "; module descriptor not recompiled" : "");
        if (release < 0)
            return new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.UNSUPPORTED_RELEASE, 0, 0, expectedCount, 0,
                "JDK 21 verifies class files up to Java 21 (Java 1.1..7 with --release 8); preview unsupported", coverage(expectedByClass, Map.of()));
        Path workerLocation;
        try { workerLocation = Path.of(CompilerWorker.class.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()); }
        catch (Exception error) { throw new IOException("Cannot locate compiler worker", error); }
        var names=new HashSet<String>(); allOriginals.forEach(info->names.add(info.name()));
        var classpath=DependencyClasspath.prepare(dependencies,work.resolveSibling(work.getFileName()+"-dependencies"),names);
        var engine = new DecompilerEngine() {
            public String id() { return "javac"; }
            public String version() { return System.getProperty("java.version"); }
            public List<String> command(Path input, Path output) {
                var command = new ArrayList<>(List.of(Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString(),
                    "-Xmx256m", "-XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=128m", "-XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2", "-Dfile.encoding=UTF-8",
                    "-cp", workerLocation.toString(), CompilerWorker.class.getName(), input.toString(), output.toString(), Integer.toString(release)));
                classpath.forEach(path->command.add(path.toString())); return command;
            }
        };
        var result = new ProcessRunner().runCompiler(engine, sources, work, timeout);
        Path properties = work.resolve("compile.properties");
        if (result.exitCode() != 0 || !Files.isRegularFile(properties) || Files.size(properties) > 8192)
            return new VerificationResult(VerificationResult.Status.WORKER_FAILED, 1000, 0, expectedCount, 0,
                result.status().toString(), coverage(expectedByClass, Map.of()));
        var values = new Properties();
        try (var input = Files.newInputStream(properties)) { values.load(input); }
        int errors = Integer.parseInt(values.getProperty("errors", "1000"));
        var status = Boolean.parseBoolean(values.getProperty("compiled")) ? VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED : VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED;
        var compiled = new ArrayList<ClassInfo>();
        var compiledBytes = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(work.resolve("classes"))) {
            for (Path path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".class")).toList()) {
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(path) || Files.size(path) > 16L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Unsafe compiled output");
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path);
                var info = new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes);
                compiled.add(info); compiledBytes.put(info.name(), bytes);
            }
        }
        Map<String,Set<String>> actualByClass = symbolsByClass(compiled);
        var classCoverage = coverage(expectedByClass, actualByClass);
        int matchedCount = classCoverage.stream().mapToInt(ClassCoverage::matchedSymbols).sum();
        int signals = 0;
        try (var paths = Files.walk(sources)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".java")).toList()) {
                if (Files.isSymbolicLink(path) || Files.size(path) > 16L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Unsafe source output");
                signals += placeholderSignals(Files.readString(path));
            }
        }
        List<ClassRoundTrip> roundTrip = originalClasses != null && status == VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED
            ? MethodRoundTrip.compare(MethodRoundTrip.readJar(originalClasses), compiledBytes) : List.of();
        int syntaxErrors = Integer.parseInt(values.getProperty("syntax-errors", Integer.toString(errors)));
        return new VerificationResult(status, errors, matchedCount, expectedCount, signals,
            releaseNote + missingPackages(values.getProperty("missing-packages", ""), allOriginals)
                + runtimeTypes(values.getProperty("jdk-runtime-types", ""))
                + "; structural signatures only; behavior not verified", classCoverage, roundTrip,
            syntaxErrors, fileErrors(work.resolve("file-errors.txt")), diagnostics(work.resolve("diagnostics.tsv")));
    }
    /** Reads the worker's located errors: bounded, with the path rules and escapes of the source repair logs. */
    static List<VerificationResult.CompilerDiagnostic> diagnostics(Path path) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return List.of();
        if (Files.size(path) > 1024L * 1024) throw new IOException("Compiler diagnostics exceed limit");
        var result = new ArrayList<VerificationResult.CompilerDiagnostic>();
        for (String line : Files.readAllLines(path, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            String[] fields = line.split("\t", -1);
            if (fields.length != 5 || result.size() >= CompilerWorker.MAX_DIAGNOSTICS) throw new IOException("Invalid compiler diagnostics");
            for (int i = 0; i < fields.length; i++) fields[i] = SourceRepair.unescape(fields[i]);
            if (!safeSourcePath(fields[0]) || !fields[3].startsWith("compiler.err.")) throw new IOException("Invalid compiler diagnostics");
            long row, column;
            try { row = Long.parseLong(fields[1]); column = Long.parseLong(fields[2]); }
            catch (NumberFormatException error) { throw new IOException("Invalid compiler diagnostics"); }
            if (row < -1 || column < -1) throw new IOException("Invalid compiler diagnostics");
            result.add(new VerificationResult.CompilerDiagnostic(fields[0], row, column, fields[3], fields[4]));
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
    /**
     * The javac release for the originals, or -1 when JDK 21 cannot compile for it (newer than 21, or preview). Java 1.1..7
     * class files are verified with {@code --release 8}, the lowest release javac 21 accepts; their source is valid Java 8.
     */
    static int release(List<ClassInfo> originals) {
        int release = originals.stream().mapToInt(ClassInfo::javaVersion).max().orElse(21);
        if (release > 21 || originals.stream().anyMatch(c -> c.minorVersion() == 65535)) return -1;
        return Math.max(8, release);
    }
    /**
     * Phase 2BC: packages javac reported as nonexistent and that no input class belongs to, as
     * {@code "; missing packages (supply with --classpath): a.b (27), c.d (3)"}, largest first; empty when there are none.
     * Packages of the input are dropped: their absence means a decompiled file failed, not a missing dependency.
     */
    static String missingPackages(String property, List<ClassInfo> originals) {
        var own = new HashSet<String>();
        for (var info : originals) {
            int slash = info.name().lastIndexOf('/');
            if (slash > 0) own.add(info.name().substring(0, slash).replace('/', '.'));
        }
        var counts = new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
        for (String entry : property.split(",")) {
            int colon = entry.lastIndexOf(':');
            if (colon <= 0) continue;
            String name = entry.substring(0, colon);
            // An unresolved class used as a qualifier (`XZ.CHECK_NONE`) is also reported as a "package"; packages are lowercase.
            if (!name.matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*(\\.[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*)*") || own.contains(name)
                || Character.isUpperCase(name.charAt(0))) continue;
            try { counts.merge(name, Integer.parseInt(entry.substring(colon + 1)), Integer::sum); } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) { }
        }
        if (counts.isEmpty()) return "";
        var joined = new StringJoiner(", ", "; missing packages (supply with --classpath): ", "");
        counts.entrySet().stream().sorted(Map.Entry.<String,Integer>comparingByValue().reversed().thenComparing(Map.Entry.comparingByKey()))
            .limit(20).forEach(entry -> joined.add(entry.getKey() + " (" + entry.getValue() + ")"));
        return joined.toString();
    }
    /**
     * Phase 2BL: JDK types outside the Java 8 API that the compiled classes use, read by javac from the running JDK, as
     * {@code "; outside the Java 8 API, read from the running JDK: sun.misc.Unsafe"}; empty when there are none.
     */
    static String runtimeTypes(String property) {
        var names = Arrays.stream(property.split(",")).filter(name -> name.matches("[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*(\\.[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*)+"))
            .distinct().sorted().limit(20).toList();
        return names.isEmpty() ? "" : "; outside the Java 8 API, read from the running JDK: " + String.join(", ", names);
    }
    /** A relative path with "/" separators and no empty, "." or ".." part, ending in .java. */
    static boolean safeSourcePath(String name) {
        boolean safe = !name.isEmpty() && !name.startsWith("/") && !name.contains("\\") && name.endsWith(".java");
        for (String part : name.split("/", -1)) safe &= !part.isEmpty() && !part.equals(".") && !part.equals("..");
        return safe;
    }
    /** Reads the worker's per-file error counts; bounded, and only relative paths without "." or ".." parts. */
    static Map<String,Integer> fileErrors(Path path) throws IOException {
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(path, java.nio.file.LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return Map.of();
        if (Files.size(path) > 4L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IOException("Per-file compiler errors exceed limit");
        var result = new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
        for (String line : Files.readAllLines(path, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            if (line.isEmpty()) continue;
            int tab = line.indexOf('\t');
            if (tab <= 0 || result.size() >= 20_000) throw new IOException("Invalid per-file compiler errors");
            String name = line.substring(tab + 1);
            boolean safe = safeSourcePath(name);
            int count;
            try { count = Integer.parseInt(line.substring(0, tab)); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { count = -1; }
            if (!safe || count <= 0 || result.put(name, count) != null) throw new IOException("Invalid per-file compiler errors");
        }
        return result;
    }
    /**
     * Text markers of methods an engine replaced with a stub or flagged as possibly wrong. Engine-specific
     * entries were confirmed in the pinned CFR 0.152, Vineflower 1.11.1, Procyon 0.6.0 and JADX 1.5.3 jars.
     * Counts distinct markers per file; a generic throw also matches authored code, so this stays a heuristic.
     */
    public static final List<String> PLACEHOLDER_SIGNALS = List.of(
        "throw new UnsupportedOperationException", "could not be decompiled", "Couldn't be decompiled", "$FF: Couldn't be decompiled",
        "has failed to decompile", "Decompilation failed",
        "An error occurred while decompiling this method.",
        "Method dump skipped", "JADX ERROR:", "Code restructure failed");
    public static int placeholderSignals(String text) {
        int signals = 0;
        for (var signal : PLACEHOLDER_SIGNALS) if (text.contains(signal)) signals++;
        return signals;
    }
    private static Map<String,Set<String>> symbolsByClass(List<ClassInfo> classes) {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,Set<String>>();
        for (var info : classes) {
            Set<String> symbols = result.computeIfAbsent(info.name(), ignored -> new TreeSet<>());
            symbols.add(info.name() + ":class:" + (info.access() & 0x16611) + ":" + info.superName() + ":" + String.join(",", new TreeSet<>(info.interfaces())));
            for (var field : info.fields()) if ((field.access() & 0x1000) == 0)
                symbols.add(info.name() + ":field:" + (field.access() & 0xdf) + ":" + field.name() + field.descriptor());
            for (var method : info.methods()) if ((method.access() & (0x1000 | 0x40)) == 0 && !method.name().equals("<clinit>"))
                symbols.add(info.name() + ":method:" + (method.access() & 0xd3f) + ":" + method.name() + method.descriptor());
        }
        return result;
    }
    private static List<ClassCoverage> coverage(Map<String,Set<String>> expected, Map<String,Set<String>> actual) {
        var result = new ArrayList<ClassCoverage>(expected.size());
        for (var entry : expected.entrySet()) {
            Set<String> found = actual.getOrDefault(entry.getKey(), Set.of());
            long matched = entry.getValue().stream().filter(found::contains).count();
            result.add(new ClassCoverage(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue().size(), Math.toIntExact(matched)));
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/CompilerWorker.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import javax.tools.*;

/** Runs only the JDK compiler; never loads target classes or annotation processors. */
public final class CompilerWorker {
    /** javac's message for {@code compiler.err.doesnt.exist}; the package is reported as a likely missing dependency. */
    private static final java.util.regex.Pattern MISSING_PACKAGE =
        java.util.regex.Pattern.compile("package ([\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*(?:\\.[\\p{L}_$][\\p{L}\\p{N}_$]*)*) does not exist");
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Path sources = Path.of(args[0]), output = Path.of(args[1]);
        var compiler = ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler();
        if (compiler == null) throw new IllegalStateException("A JDK is required for verification");
        var files = sourceFiles(sources);
        Path empty = Files.createDirectory(output.resolve("empty-classpath"));
        var dependencies = new ArrayList<Path>();
        for (int i = 3; i < args.length; i++) dependencies.add(Path.of(args[i]));
        // Errors before the first ENTER event are syntax errors: javac then stops before attribution, so a single
        // unparsable file hides every other error and no class is generated. Per-file counts guide hybrid selection.
        int[] errors = {0}, syntaxErrors = {0};
        boolean[] entered = {false};
        var fileErrors = new TreeMap<String,Integer>();
        var missingPackages = new TreeMap<String,Integer>(); // "package X does not exist": likely a dependency not on the classpath
        var diagnostics = new StringBuilder(); int[] located = {0};
        var relative = new HashMap<Path,String>();
        for (var file : files) relative.put(file.toPath().toAbsolutePath().normalize(), sources.relativize(file.toPath()).toString().replace('\\', '/'));
        boolean success = false;
        var runtimeTypes = new TreeSet<String>();
        try (var manager = compiler.getStandardFileManager(null, Locale.ROOT, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
            JdkRuntimeClasses.configure(manager, args[2], dependencies, empty);
            if (!files.isEmpty()) {
                var task = (com.sun.source.util.JavacTask) compiler.getTask(null, manager, diagnostic -> {
                    if (diagnostic.getKind() == Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR) {
                        errors[0]++;
                        if (!entered[0]) syntaxErrors[0]++;
                        var uri = diagnostic.getSource() == null ? null : diagnostic.getSource().toUri();
                        String name = uri == null || !"file".equals(uri.getScheme()) ? null : relative.get(Path.of(uri).toAbsolutePath().normalize());
                        if (name != null) {
                            fileErrors.merge(name, 1, Integer::sum);
                            if (located[0]++ < MAX_DIAGNOSTICS) diagnostics.append(SourceRepairWorker.escape(name)).append('\t')
                                .append(position(diagnostic.getLineNumber())).append('\t').append(position(diagnostic.getColumnNumber()))
                                .append('\t').append(SourceRepairWorker.escape(String.valueOf(diagnostic.getCode()))).append('\t')
                                .append(SourceRepairWorker.escape(clip(diagnostic.getMessage(Locale.ROOT)))).append('\n');
                        }
                        if ("compiler.err.doesnt.exist".equals(diagnostic.getCode())) {
                            var missing = MISSING_PACKAGE.matcher(diagnostic.getMessage(Locale.ROOT));
                            if (missing.find() && (missingPackages.size() < 50 || missingPackages.containsKey(missing.group(1)))) missingPackages.merge(missing.group(1), 1, Integer::sum);
                        }
                    }
                    System.out.println(diagnostic.getCode() + ": " + diagnostic.getMessage(Locale.ROOT));
                }, List.of("--release", args[2], "-proc:none", "-implicit:none", "-encoding", "UTF-8",
                    "-sourcepath", empty.toString(), "-d", output.toString(),
                    "-Xmaxerrs", "1000"), null, manager.getJavaFileObjectsFromFiles(files));
                task.addTaskListener(new com.sun.source.util.TaskListener() {
                    @Override public void started(com.sun.source.util.TaskEvent event) {
                        if (event.getKind() == com.sun.source.util.TaskEvent.Kind.ENTER) entered[0] = true;
                    }
                });
                success = task.call();
            }
        }
        if (success && JdkRuntimeClasses.applies(args[2])) runtimeTypes.addAll(JdkRuntimeClasses.used(compiler, output, dependencies, empty, 50));
        var result = new Properties();
        result.setProperty("compiled", Boolean.toString(success));
        result.setProperty("errors", Integer.toString(errors[0]));
        result.setProperty("syntax-errors", Integer.toString(syntaxErrors[0]));
        var missing = new StringJoiner(",");
        missingPackages.forEach((name, count) -> missing.add(name + ":" + count));
        result.setProperty("missing-packages", missing.toString());
        result.setProperty("jdk-runtime-types", String.join(",", runtimeTypes));
        try (var stream = Files.newOutputStream(output.getParent().resolve("compile.properties"), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
            result.store(stream, "Compiler result; no target execution");
        }
        var lines = new StringBuilder();
        fileErrors.forEach((name, count) -> lines.append(count).append('\t').append(name).append('\n'));
        Files.writeString(output.getParent().resolve("file-errors.txt"), lines, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
        Files.writeString(output.getParent().resolve("diagnostics.tsv"), diagnostics, java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
    }
    /** Located errors kept as failure evidence (file, line, column, code, message); javac itself stops at 100. */
    static final int MAX_DIAGNOSTICS = 100, MAX_MESSAGE = 500;
    private static long position(long value) { return value == Diagnostic.NOPOS ? -1 : value; }
    private static String clip(String message) {
        String text = message == null ? "" : message;
        return text.length() <= MAX_MESSAGE ? text : text.substring(0, MAX_MESSAGE) + "...";
    }
    /** The candidate's .java files in path order, within the source tree limits; links are refused. */
    static List<java.io.File> sourceFiles(Path sources) throws java.io.IOException {
        var files = new ArrayList<java.io.File>();
        long bytes = 0;
        try (var paths = Files.walk(sources)) {
            var iterator = paths.iterator(); int visited = 0;
            while (iterator.hasNext()) {
                var path = iterator.next();
                if (++visited > 20_001 || Files.isSymbolicLink(path)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsafe source tree");
                // A module descriptor is not compiled with ordinary sources (decompilers often print it as invalid Java).
                if (Files.isRegularFile(path) && path.toString().endsWith(".java") && !path.getFileName().toString().equals("module-info.java")) {
                    long size = Files.size(path); bytes += size;
                    if (size > 16L * 1024 * 1024 || bytes > 128L * 1024 * 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source size limit");
                    files.add(path.toFile());
                }
            }
        }
        files.sort(Comparator.comparing(java.io.File::getPath));
        return files;
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/ControlFlowEquivalence.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.Type;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Control-flow comparison for the round trip (Phase 2AX). Two bodies are equivalent when their control-flow graphs,
 * walked in parallel from the entry, have the same instructions in every block (constants and local slots normalized
 * as in {@link MethodRoundTrip}, locals matched by a consistent bijection) and the same edges, where a conditional
 * branch may also be the negated condition with its two successors swapped. Block layout therefore does not matter:
 * {@code if (c) { A } else { B }} equals {@code if (!c) { B } else { A }}. A trace follows fall-through and
 * unconditional jumps from block to block until a real control decision, so a jump to a block that only returns is
 * read as that return. Bodies with {@code jsr} are never called equivalent. Everything is parsed with ASM only;
 * nothing is loaded or executed.
 *
 * <p>Phase 2BH: an edge to a block that only jumps elsewhere goes straight to where it jumps ({@code if (c) goto A;
 * goto B; A:} is {@code if (!c) goto B; A:}); a test of a value that is 0 or 1 whose two successors return the
 * constants 1 and 0 is a return of that value ({@code if (!b()) return false; return true;} is {@code return b();});
 * and blocks are paired as a relation, not one to one, and a trace follows an unconditional edge into a block
 * whatever else reaches it, so one return or one tail shared by several paths equals copies of it. The walk then
 * checks a bisimulation: every paired couple of traces runs the same instructions (under one mapping of locals) and
 * leads to paired successors, so both bodies run the same instructions on every path.
 *
 * <p>Also since Phase 2BH, bodies with exception handlers are compared: blocks also start where a handler's range
 * starts or ends and at each handler, a block's exceptional successors are the handlers whose range holds it (in
 * table order, without entries that an earlier one already catches), and every instruction of a trace that can throw
 * must have the same catch types leading to paired handlers as its counterpart. An instruction that cannot throw
 * (a load, a constant, a jump...) may lie inside a range on one side and outside on the other. A trace never runs
 * into a handler.
 */
final class ControlFlowEquivalence {
    private static final int MAX_BLOCKS = 20_000;
    /** Paired couples visited before giving up; a relation is quadratic at worst, so this bounds the walk. */
    private static final int MAX_PAIRS = 200_000;
    /** Blocks one trace follows through unconditional edges before it ends as a jump. */
    private static final int MAX_TRACE_BLOCKS = 256;
    private enum Kind { FALL, GOTO, COND, EXIT, SWITCH }

    /** An exceptional successor: the caught type (null catches anything) and the handler's block. */
    private record Handler(String type, int block) {}

    private static final class Block {
        final List<AbstractInsnNode> body = new ArrayList<>();
        Kind kind; int opcode; LabelNode label; int taken = -1, next = -1;
        AbstractInsnNode terminator;
        List<Integer> targets = List.of();
        /** Index in the method of the block's first instruction, or -1 while it has none. */
        int first = -1;
        List<Handler> handlers = List.of();
        boolean handler;
    }

    private ControlFlowEquivalence() {}

    static boolean equivalent(MethodNode a, MethodNode b) { return equivalent(a, b, Set.of()); }

    static boolean equivalent(MethodNode a, MethodNode b, Set<String> privates) { return equivalent(a, b, MethodRoundTrip.Sides.of(privates)); }

    static boolean equivalent(MethodNode a, MethodNode b, MethodRoundTrip.Sides sides) {
        try {
            // Locals are matched by variable (MethodRoundTrip.webs) when both bodies have them, else by slot.
            var websLeft = MethodRoundTrip.webs(a, parameterSlots(a)); var websRight = MethodRoundTrip.webs(b, parameterSlots(b));
            if (websLeft == null || websRight == null) websLeft = websRight = null;
            var left = blocks(a, MethodRoundTrip.localRewrites(a, parameterSlots(a), websLeft), sides.original().forwarders());
            var right = blocks(b, MethodRoundTrip.localRewrites(b, parameterSlots(b), websRight), sides.recompiled().forwarders());
            if (left == null || right == null) return false;
            return new Walk(left, right, parameterSlots(a), sides, websLeft, websRight).run();
        } catch (RuntimeException unexpected) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private static int parameterSlots(MethodNode method) {
        int slots = Type.getArgumentsAndReturnSizes(method.desc) >> 2; // includes the implicit receiver slot
        return (method.access & Opcodes.ACC_STATIC) != 0 ? slots - 1 : slots;
    }

    /** Basic blocks in layout order, or null for shapes this comparison does not model. */
    private static List<Block> blocks(MethodNode method, Map<AbstractInsnNode,List<AbstractInsnNode>> rewrites, Map<String,List<AbstractInsnNode>> forwarders) {
        var targets = new HashSet<LabelNode>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) targets.add(jump.label);
            else if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { targets.add(table.dflt); targets.addAll(table.labels); }
            else if (insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { targets.add(lookup.dflt); targets.addAll(lookup.labels); }
        }
        for (var range : method.tryCatchBlocks) { targets.add(range.start); targets.add(range.end); targets.add(range.handler); }
        var blocks = new ArrayList<Block>(); var at = new HashMap<LabelNode,Integer>();
        Block current = null; int index = -1;
        var items = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>(); var positions = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (var insn : method.instructions) {
            index++;
            for (var item : rewrites.getOrDefault(insn, List.of(insn))) { items.add(item); positions.add(index); }
        }
        for (int item = 0; item < items.size(); item++) {
            var insn = items.get(item); index = positions.get(item);
            if (insn instanceof LineNumberNode || insn instanceof FrameNode) continue;
            if (insn instanceof LabelNode label) {
                if (!targets.contains(label)) continue;
                if (current != null && !current.body.isEmpty()) { current.kind = Kind.FALL; current = null; }
                if (current == null) { current = new Block(); blocks.add(current); }
                at.put(label, blocks.size() - 1);
                continue;
            }
            if (current == null) { current = new Block(); blocks.add(current); }
            if (current.first < 0) current.first = index;
            int opcode = insn.getOpcode();
            if (opcode == Opcodes.JSR || opcode == Opcodes.RET) return null;
            if (insn instanceof JumpInsnNode jump) {
                current.kind = opcode == Opcodes.GOTO ? Kind.GOTO : Kind.COND; current.opcode = opcode; current.label = jump.label;
            } else if (insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) {
                current.kind = Kind.SWITCH; current.terminator = insn;
            } else if (opcode >= Opcodes.IRETURN && opcode <= Opcodes.RETURN || opcode == Opcodes.ATHROW) {
                current.kind = Kind.EXIT; current.opcode = opcode;
            } else {
                // As in MethodRoundTrip.render: a forwarding method's call is its instructions, a dup of a just-loaded
                // local is that load again.
                var forwarded = MethodRoundTrip.inlined(insn, forwarders);
                var reloaded = MethodRoundTrip.reloadedDup(insn, current.body.isEmpty() ? null : current.body.getLast());
                if (forwarded != null) current.body.addAll(forwarded);
                else current.body.add(reloaded != null ? reloaded : insn);
                continue;
            }
            current = null;
            if (blocks.size() > MAX_BLOCKS) return null;
        }
        // A trailing block without a terminator (an unused label at the end) carries nothing; anything else is malformed.
        if (!blocks.isEmpty() && blocks.getLast().kind == null) {
            if (!blocks.getLast().body.isEmpty()) return null;
            blocks.removeLast();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < blocks.size(); i++) {
            var block = blocks.get(i);
            if (block.kind == null) return null;
            if (block.kind == Kind.FALL || block.kind == Kind.COND) {
                if (i + 1 >= blocks.size()) return null;
                block.next = i + 1;
            }
            if (block.kind == Kind.GOTO || block.kind == Kind.COND) {
                Integer target = at.get(block.label);
                if (target == null || target >= blocks.size()) return null;
                block.taken = target;
            }
            if (block.kind == Kind.SWITCH) {
                var list = new ArrayList<Integer>();
                var labels = new ArrayList<LabelNode>();
                if (block.terminator instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode table) { labels.add(table.dflt); labels.addAll(table.labels); }
                else if (block.terminator instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode lookup) { labels.add(lookup.dflt); labels.addAll(lookup.labels); }
                for (var label : labels) {
                    Integer target = at.get(label);
                    if (target == null || target >= blocks.size()) return null;
                    list.add(target);
                }
                block.targets = List.copyOf(list);
            }
        }
        if (blocks.isEmpty() || !handlers(method, blocks, at)) return null;
        thread(blocks);
        for (var block : blocks) if (booleanReturn(blocks, block)) { block.kind = Kind.EXIT; block.opcode = Opcodes.IRETURN; block.taken = block.next = -1; }
        return blocks;
    }

    /**
     * Each block's exceptional successors, from the handler ranges that hold its first instruction (ranges start and end
     * at block boundaries, so they hold all of it). An entry for a type and handler already listed, or after an entry
     * that catches anything, is never used by that block and is left out. Returns false for a malformed table.
     */
    private static boolean handlers(MethodNode method, List<Block> blocks, Map<LabelNode,Integer> at) {
        if (method.tryCatchBlocks.isEmpty()) return true;
        var position = new IdentityHashMap<AbstractInsnNode,Integer>();
        int index = 0;
        for (var insn : method.instructions) position.put(insn, index++);
        for (var range : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
            Integer handler = at.get(range.handler);
            if (handler == null || !position.containsKey(range.start) || !position.containsKey(range.end)) return false;
            blocks.get(handler).handler = true;
        }
        for (var block : blocks) {
            if (block.first < 0) continue;
            var list = new ArrayList<Handler>();
            for (var range : method.tryCatchBlocks) {
                if (position.get(range.start) > block.first || block.first >= position.get(range.end)) continue;
                var entry = new Handler(range.type, at.get(range.handler));
                if (!list.contains(entry)) list.add(entry);
                if (range.type == null) break;
            }
            block.handlers = List.copyOf(list);
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2BH: every edge into a block that holds nothing but a {@code goto} (and is not the entry or a handler) is
     * redirected to where that jump leads, following chains of such blocks; a cycle of empty jumps keeps its last edge.
     */
    private static void thread(List<Block> blocks) {
        for (var block : blocks) {
            block.next = through(blocks, block.next);
            block.taken = through(blocks, block.taken);
            if (!block.targets.isEmpty()) block.targets = block.targets.stream().map(target -> through(blocks, target)).toList();
        }
    }

    private static int through(List<Block> blocks, int target) {
        var seen = new HashSet<Integer>();
        while (target > 0 && blocks.get(target).body.isEmpty() && blocks.get(target).kind == Kind.GOTO && !blocks.get(target).handler && seen.add(target))
            target = blocks.get(target).taken;
        return target;
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2BH: {@code ifne} (or {@code ifeq}) on a value that can only be 0 or 1, whose taken successor returns the
     * constant 1 (or 0) and whose other successor returns 0 (or 1), returns that value either way. Values known to be 0
     * or 1: the result of a method whose return type is {@code boolean} (JVMS 6.5 {@code ireturn} narrows it), of
     * {@code instanceof}, and a {@code boolean} field ({@code putfield} and {@code putstatic} narrow what they store).
     */
    private static boolean booleanReturn(List<Block> blocks, Block block) {
        if (block.kind != Kind.COND || block.opcode != Opcodes.IFNE && block.opcode != Opcodes.IFEQ || block.body.isEmpty()) return false;
        var last = block.body.getLast();
        boolean bit = last instanceof MethodInsnNode call && call.desc.endsWith(")Z") || last.getOpcode() == Opcodes.INSTANCEOF
            || last instanceof FieldInsnNode field && (field.getOpcode() == Opcodes.GETFIELD || field.getOpcode() == Opcodes.GETSTATIC) && field.desc.equals("Z");
        if (!bit) return false;
        int taken = constantReturn(blocks, block.taken), next = constantReturn(blocks, block.next);
        return block.opcode == Opcodes.IFNE ? taken == 1 && next == 0 : taken == 0 && next == 1;
    }

    /** The int constant 0 or 1 that a block pushes and returns at once (directly or through a jump to a bare return); else -1. */
    private static int constantReturn(List<Block> blocks, int index) {
        if (index < 0) return -1;
        var block = blocks.get(index);
        if (block.body.size() != 1) return -1;
        String constant = MethodRoundTrip.token(block.body.getFirst(), Set.of());
        if (!"int 0".equals(constant) && !"int 1".equals(constant)) return -1;
        boolean returns = block.kind == Kind.EXIT && block.opcode == Opcodes.IRETURN;
        if (!returns && (block.kind == Kind.GOTO || block.kind == Kind.FALL)) {
            var successor = blocks.get(block.kind == Kind.GOTO ? block.taken : block.next);
            returns = successor.body.isEmpty() && successor.kind == Kind.EXIT && successor.opcode == Opcodes.IRETURN;
        }
        return returns ? constant.charAt(4) - '0' : -1;
    }

    /**
     * Whether an instruction can throw: anything but locals, constants (other than class, method type, method handle and
     * dynamic constants, which may fail to resolve), stack and arithmetic operations except integer division and
     * remainder, conversions, comparisons, jumps, switches and returns.
     */
    private static boolean mayThrow(AbstractInsnNode insn) {
        int opcode = insn.getOpcode();
        if (insn instanceof VarInsnNode || insn instanceof IincInsnNode || insn instanceof JumpInsnNode
            || insn instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode || insn instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode) return false;
        if (insn instanceof LdcInsnNode ldc) return !(ldc.cst instanceof Number || ldc.cst instanceof String);
        if (insn instanceof IntInsnNode) return opcode == Opcodes.NEWARRAY;
        if (insn instanceof InsnNode) {
            if (opcode >= Opcodes.IALOAD && opcode <= Opcodes.SALOAD || opcode >= Opcodes.IASTORE && opcode <= Opcodes.SASTORE) return true;
            return opcode == Opcodes.IDIV || opcode == Opcodes.LDIV || opcode == Opcodes.IREM || opcode == Opcodes.LREM
                || opcode == Opcodes.ARRAYLENGTH || opcode == Opcodes.ATHROW || opcode == Opcodes.MONITORENTER || opcode == Opcodes.MONITOREXIT;
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Joined blocks from one head up to a real control decision, with the handlers of each body instruction's block and
     * those of the block that ends the trace.
     */
    private record Trace(List<AbstractInsnNode> body, List<List<Handler>> handlers, Kind kind, int opcode, int taken, int next,
                         AbstractInsnNode terminator, List<Integer> targets, List<Handler> exit) {}

    private static final class Walk {
        private final List<Block> left, right; private final int fixed; private final MethodRoundTrip.Sides sides;
        private final Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> websLeft, websRight;
        private final Set<Long> paired = new HashSet<>();
        private final Map<Integer,Integer> slotsLeft = new HashMap<>(), slotsRight = new HashMap<>();
        private final ArrayDeque<int[]> work = new ArrayDeque<>();

        Walk(List<Block> left, List<Block> right, int fixed, MethodRoundTrip.Sides sides, Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> websLeft,
             Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> websRight) {
            this.sides = sides; this.websLeft = websLeft; this.websRight = websRight;
            this.left = left; this.right = right; this.fixed = fixed;
        }

        boolean run() {
            if (!pair(0, 0)) return false;
            while (!work.isEmpty()) {
                int[] next = work.pop();
                if (!same(trace(left, next[0]), trace(right, next[1]))) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        /** Records a couple of blocks to compare; each couple is compared once, and a block may be paired with several. */
        private boolean pair(int a, int b) {
            if (paired.add((long) a * right.size() + b)) {
                if (paired.size() > MAX_PAIRS) return false;
                work.push(new int[] {a, b});
            }
            return true;
        }

        private static Trace trace(List<Block> blocks, int head) {
            var body = new ArrayList<AbstractInsnNode>(); var handlers = new ArrayList<List<Handler>>(); var seen = new HashSet<Integer>();
            int at = head;
            while (true) {
                var block = blocks.get(at); seen.add(at); body.addAll(block.body);
                for (int i = 0; i < block.body.size(); i++) handlers.add(block.handlers);
                if (block.kind != Kind.FALL && block.kind != Kind.GOTO)
                    return new Trace(body, handlers, block.kind, block.opcode, block.taken, block.next, block.terminator, block.targets, block.handlers);
                int target = block.kind == Kind.FALL ? block.next : block.taken;
                var successor = blocks.get(target);
                if (successor.body.isEmpty() && successor.kind == Kind.EXIT && !successor.handler)
                    return new Trace(body, handlers, Kind.EXIT, successor.opcode, -1, -1, null, List.of(), successor.handlers);
                if (seen.contains(target) || successor.handler || seen.size() >= MAX_TRACE_BLOCKS)
                    return new Trace(body, handlers, Kind.GOTO, Opcodes.GOTO, target, -1, null, List.of(), block.handlers);
                at = target;
            }
        }

        private boolean same(Trace a, Trace b) {
            if (a.body.size() != b.body.size() || a.kind != b.kind) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < a.body.size(); i++) {
                if (!sameInstruction(a.body.get(i), b.body.get(i))) return false;
                // Which handlers hold an instruction matters only when it can throw.
                if (mayThrow(a.body.get(i)) && !sameHandlers(a.handlers.get(i), b.handlers.get(i))) return false;
            }
            if (a.kind == Kind.EXIT && a.opcode == Opcodes.ATHROW && !sameHandlers(a.exit, b.exit)) return false;
            return switch (a.kind) {
                case EXIT -> a.opcode == b.opcode;
                case GOTO -> pair(a.taken, b.taken);
                case COND -> a.opcode == b.opcode ? pair(a.taken, b.taken) && pair(a.next, b.next)
                    : a.opcode == negate(b.opcode) && pair(a.taken, b.next) && pair(a.next, b.taken);
                case SWITCH -> sameSwitch(a.terminator, b.terminator) && a.targets.size() == b.targets.size()
                    && pairAll(a.targets, b.targets);
                case FALL -> false;
            };
        }

        private boolean sameHandlers(List<Handler> a, List<Handler> b) {
            if (a.size() != b.size()) return false;
            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++)
                if (!Objects.equals(a.get(i).type(), b.get(i).type()) || !pair(a.get(i).block(), b.get(i).block())) return false;
            return true;
        }

        private boolean pairAll(List<Integer> a, List<Integer> b) {
            for (int i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) if (!pair(a.get(i), b.get(i))) return false;
            return true;
        }

        private static boolean sameSwitch(AbstractInsnNode a, AbstractInsnNode b) {
            if (a instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode x && b instanceof TableSwitchInsnNode y) return x.min == y.min && x.max == y.max;
            if (a instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode x && b instanceof LookupSwitchInsnNode y) return x.keys.equals(y.keys);
            return false;
        }

        /** IFEQ/IFNE, IFLT/IFGE, IFGT/IFLE, the IF_ICMP and IF_ACMP pairs, and IFNULL/IFNONNULL are each other's negation. */
        private static int negate(int opcode) {
            if (opcode >= Opcodes.IFEQ && opcode <= Opcodes.IF_ACMPNE) return ((opcode - Opcodes.IFEQ) ^ 1) + Opcodes.IFEQ;
            if (opcode == Opcodes.IFNULL) return Opcodes.IFNONNULL;
            if (opcode == Opcodes.IFNONNULL) return Opcodes.IFNULL;
            return -1;
        }

        private boolean sameInstruction(AbstractInsnNode a, AbstractInsnNode b) {
            if (a instanceof VarInsnNode x && b instanceof VarInsnNode y) return x.getOpcode() == y.getOpcode() && sameSlot(variable(websLeft, x), variable(websRight, y));
            if (a instanceof IincInsnNode x && b instanceof IincInsnNode y) return x.incr == y.incr && sameSlot(variable(websLeft, x), variable(websRight, y));
            String left = MethodRoundTrip.token(a, sides.privates(), sides.original().fields());
            String right = MethodRoundTrip.token(b, sides.privates(), sides.recompiled().fields());
            return left != null && left.equals(right);
        }

        private static int variable(Map<AbstractInsnNode,Integer> webs, AbstractInsnNode insn) {
            return webs != null ? webs.get(insn) : insn instanceof VarInsnNode local ? local.var : ((IincInsnNode) insn).var;
        }

        /** Parameter slots must match; other locals must map one-to-one, in whatever order the two bodies use them. */
        private boolean sameSlot(int a, int b) {
            if (a < fixed || b < fixed) return a == b;
            Integer mapped = slotsLeft.get(a), back = slotsRight.get(b);
            if (mapped == null && back == null) { slotsLeft.put(a, b); slotsRight.put(b, a); return true; }
            return mapped != null && mapped == b && back != null && back == a;
        }
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/DependencyClasspath.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.intake.InventoryReader;
import dev.classrevive.intake.MultiRelease;
import dev.classrevive.model.Limits;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.file.attribute.BasicFileAttributes;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Produces local class-only snapshots; manifests cannot expand javac's dependency search. */
final class DependencyClasspath {
    /**
     * Phase 2DF: the 16 JARs a user may pass, plus the two the pipeline adds itself (an Android SDK's android.jar and the
     * inferred-stub JAR), so neither is dropped when the user's 16 are all given. Callers still cap user JARs at 16.
     */
    static final int MAX_INPUTS = 18;
    static List<Path> prepare(List<Path> inputs, Path output, Set<String> originals) throws IOException {
        inputs=List.copyOf(inputs);
        if(inputs.size()>MAX_INPUTS) throw new IllegalArgumentException("At most 16 dependency JARs, plus the Android SDK and inferred stubs");
        if(inputs.isEmpty()) return List.of();
        Files.createDirectory(output);
        var paths=new ArrayList<Path>(); var names=new HashSet<String>(originals);
        var evidence=new StringBuilder("Class-only compiler dependencies; no target execution.\n");
        long total=0, expanded=0;
        for(int i=0;i<inputs.size();i++) {
            Path input=dev.classrevive.engine.SafePaths.resolveParents(inputs.get(i));
            if(!input.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".jar") || !Files.isRegularFile(input,LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS))
                throw new IOException("Expected regular dependency JAR");
            Path snapshot=output.resolve(i+"-input.jar");
            try(var in=Files.newInputStream(input); var out=Files.newOutputStream(snapshot,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW)) {
                byte[] buffer=new byte[8192]; int count;
                while((count=in.read(buffer))!=-1) { total+=count; if(total>128L*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Dependency byte budget exceeded"); out.write(buffer,0,count); }
            }
            var inventory=new InventoryReader().inspect(snapshot,Limits.defaults());
            if(!inventory.successful()) throw new IOException("Invalid dependency inventory");
            expanded+=inventory.expandedBytes();
            if(expanded>512L*1024*1024) throw new IOException("Expanded dependency budget exceeded");
            Path normalized=output.resolve(i+"-classes.jar"); int classes=0;
            // Multi-release dependencies contribute their base classes only; valid META-INF/versions/N variants are dropped.
            var variants=new HashSet<String>(); MultiRelease.variants(inventory).forEach(variant->variants.add(variant.entry()));
            try(var zip=new ZipFile(snapshot.toFile()); var out=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(normalized,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW))) {
                for(var entry:inventory.entries()) {
                    if(entry.classInfo()==null || variants.contains(entry.name())) continue;
                    String name=entry.classInfo().name();
                    // These are classpath inputs, not a module path: descriptors are not dependency types.
                    if(name.equals("module-info") && entry.name().equals("module-info.class")) continue;
                    if(!entry.name().equals(name+".class") || !names.add(name))
                        throw new IOException("Dependency class overlap, identity mismatch or invalid multi-release variant: "+entry.name());
                    var item=new ZipEntry(entry.name()); item.setTime(0); out.putNextEntry(item);
                    try(var in=zip.getInputStream(zip.getEntry(entry.name()))) { in.transferTo(out); }
                    out.closeEntry(); classes++;
                }
            }
            if(classes==0) throw new IOException("Dependency contains no classes");
            evidence.append(i).append(" sha256=").append(inventory.sha256()).append(" classes=").append(classes);
            if(!variants.isEmpty()) evidence.append(" multi-release-variants-ignored=").append(variants.size());
            evidence.append('\n');
            paths.add(normalized.toAbsolutePath());
        }
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("dependencies.txt"),evidence,StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
        return List.copyOf(paths);
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/verification/EnumBodyFolding.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;
import org.objectweb.asm.ClassReader;
import org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes;
import org.objectweb.asm.tree.*;

/**
 * Phase 2BX: enum constant bodies folded back into their enum. Without an {@code InnerClasses} attribute, CFR, Vineflower
 * and Procyon write the body of {@code JAVA_7(7, 51, false) { boolean isSupported() {...} }} as a separate top-level file
 * {@code E$1.java} extending {@code E}, and {@code E.java} as an enum without bodies: javac then treats {@code E} as final
 * and rejects {@code E$1} ({@code compiler.err.cant.inherit.from.final}). Java source can express such a class only as a
 * constant body, so each body file is folded into the constant the original {@code <clinit>} assigns it to.
 *
 * <p>The plan comes from the original bytecode alone: an {@code ACC_ENUM} class {@code E}, a class {@code E$N} whose
 * superclass is {@code E}, and in {@code E.<clinit>} a {@code NEW E$N} followed by {@code PUTSTATIC E.K:LE;}. The class
 * bytes are parsed with ASM, nothing is defined or run. A fold is applied to a source tree only when {@code E.java}
 * declares {@code enum E} and constant {@code K} has no body; a constant that already has one (an earlier fold, a
 * repaired copy) only drops the duplicate {@code E$N.java}. Constructors of the body are dropped (a constant body has
 * none; its arguments stay on the constant), its other members and its imports are kept. Evidence only: the folded
 * source is measured by the same compilation and signature checks as any other; behavior is not verified.
 */
public final class EnumBodyFolding {
    /** {@code bodyClass} (for example {@code p/E$1}) is the body of constant {@code constant} of {@code enumClass}. */
    public record Body(String enumClass, String bodyClass, String constant) {}
    /** A body folded into a source tree: {@code bodyFile} removed, its members now in {@code enumFile}. */
    public record Fold(String enumFile, String bodyFile, String constant) {}
    private static final EnumBodyFolding NONE = new EnumBodyFolding(List.of());
    private static final Pattern MODIFIERS = Pattern.compile(
        "\\s*(?:@[\\w.$]+\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\))?\\s*|(?:public|protected|private|static|final|synchronized|strictfp|native|abstract)\\s+)*(?:<[^>]*>\\s*)?");
    private static final Pattern IMPORT = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*import\\s+(static\\s+)?([\\w.$*]+)\\s*;");
    private final List<Body> bodies;

    public EnumBodyFolding(List<Body> bodies) { this.bodies = List.copyOf(bodies); }
    public List<Body> bodies() { return bodies; }
    public static EnumBodyFolding none() { return NONE; }

    /** The bodies of the original classes; none when {@code originalClasses} is null or holds no such enum. */
    public static EnumBodyFolding plan(List<ClassInfo> originals, Path originalClasses) throws IOException {
        if (originalClasses == null) return NONE;
        var byName = new HashMap<String,ClassInfo>();
        originals.forEach(info -> byName.put(info.name(), info));
        var enums = new TreeMap<String,Set<String>>();
        for (var info : originals) {
            var parent = info.superName() == null ? null : byName.get(info.superName());
            if (parent != null && (parent.access() & Opcodes.ACC_ENUM) != 0 && info.name().startsWith(parent.name() + "$"))
                enums.computeIfAbsent(parent.name(), ignored -> new TreeSet<>()).add(info.name());
        }
        if (enums.isEmpty()) return NONE;
        var bytes = MethodRoundTrip.readJar(originalClasses);
        var result = new ArrayList<Body>();
        for (var entry : enums.entrySet()) {
            byte[] data = bytes.get(entry.getKey());
            if (data == null) continue;
            var node = new ClassNode();
            try { new ClassReader(data).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES); }
            catch (RuntimeException malformed) { continue; }
            String descriptor = "L" + entry.getKey() + ";";
            for (var method : node.methods) {
                if (!method.name.equals("<clinit>")) continue;
                String pending = null; var seen = new HashSet<String>();
                for (var insn : method.instructions) {
                    if (insn instanceof TypeInsnNode type && type.getOpcode() == Opcodes.NEW)
                        pending = entry.getValue().contains(type.desc) ? type.desc : null;
                    else if (insn instanceof FieldInsnNode field && field.getOpcode() == Opcodes.PUTSTATIC && pending != null
                        && field.owner.equals(entry.getKey()) && field.desc.equals(descriptor)) {
                        if (seen.add(pending)) result.add(new Body(entry.getKey(), pending, field.name));
                        pending = null;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return new EnumBodyFolding(result);
    }

    /** Folds every planned body whose files are in {@code root}; returns the folds made, in plan order. */
    public List<Fold> apply(Path root) throws IOException {
        if (bodies.isEmpty()) return List.of();
        var folds = new ArrayList<Fold>();
        var byEnum = new LinkedHashMap<String,List<Body>>();
        for (var body : bodies) byEnum.computeIfAbsent(body.enumClass(), ignored -> new ArrayList<>()).add(body);
        for (var entry : byEnum.entrySet()) {
            Path enumPath = root.resolve(entry.getKey() + ".java");
            if (!Files.isRegularFile(enumPath, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) continue;
            String text = Files.readString(enumPath), original = text;
            String simple = entry.getKey().substring(entry.getKey().lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
            var removed = new ArrayList<Path>();
            for (var body : entry.getValue()) {
                Path bodyPath = root.resolve(body.bodyClass() + ".java");
                if (!Files.isRegularFile(bodyPath, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) continue;
                var constant = constant(text, simple, body.constant());
                if (constant == null) continue;
                if (!constant.hasBody()) {
                    String bodyText = Files.readString(bodyPath);
                    String members = members(bodyText, body.bodyClass().substring(body.bodyClass().lastIndexOf('/') + 1));
                    if (members == null) continue;
                    text = text.substring(0, constant.end()) + " {\n" + members + "\n    }" + text.substring(constant.end());
                    text = imports(text, bodyText, entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
                }
                removed.add(bodyPath);
                folds.add(new Fold(entry.getKey() + ".java", body.bodyClass() + ".java", body.constant()));
            }
            if (removed.isEmpty()) continue;
            if (!text.equals(original)) Files.writeString(enumPath, text);
            for (var path : removed) Files.delete(path);
        }
        return folds;
    }

    private record Constant(int end, boolean hasBody) {}
    /** Constant {@code name} of {@code enum simple}: the offset right after its name or arguments, and whether a body follows. */
    private static Constant constant(String text, String simple, String name) {
        String masked = SourceText.mask(text);
        var header = Pattern.compile("\\benum\\s+" + Pattern.quote(simple) + "(?![\\w$])").matcher(masked);
        if (!header.find()) return null;
        int open = masked.indexOf('{', header.end());
        if (open < 0) return null;
        int close = SourceText.close(masked, open);
        if (close < 0) return null;
        // The constant list ends at the first ';' at depth 0, or at the closing brace.
        int i = open + 1;
        while (i < close) {
            while (i < close && (Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(i)) || masked.charAt(i) == ',')) i++;
            while (i < close && masked.charAt(i) == '@') { // annotations on a constant
                i++;
                while (i < close && (Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(masked.charAt(i)) || masked.charAt(i) == '.')) i++;
                while (i < close && Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(i))) i++;
                if (i < close && masked.charAt(i) == '(') { int end = SourceText.close(masked, i); if (end < 0) return null; i = end + 1; }
                while (i < close && Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(i))) i++;
            }
            if (i >= close || masked.charAt(i) == ';') return null;
            int start = i;
            while (i < close && Character.isJavaIdentifierPart(masked.charAt(i))) i++;
            if (i == start) return null;
            String found = masked.substring(start, i);
            int j = i;
            while (j < close && Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(j))) j++;
            if (j < close && masked.charAt(j) == '(') { int end = SourceText.close(masked, j); if (end < 0) return null; i = end + 1; j = i; }
            int end = i;
            while (j < close && Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(j))) j++;
            boolean body = j < close && masked.charAt(j) == '{';
            if (found.equals(name)) return new Constant(end, body);
            if (body) { int bodyEnd = SourceText.close(masked, j); if (bodyEnd < 0) return null; j = bodyEnd + 1; }
            while (j < close && Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(j))) j++;
            if (j >= close || masked.charAt(j) == ';') return null;
            if (masked.charAt(j) != ',') return null; // not a constant list: give up rather than guess
            i = j + 1;
        }
        return null;
    }
    /** The members of type {@code simple} in {@code text}, constructors left out; null when the declaration is not found. */
    static String members(String text, String simple) {
        String masked = SourceText.mask(text);
        var header = Pattern.compile("\\b(?:class|enum)\\s+" + Pattern.quote(simple) + "(?![\\w$])").matcher(masked);
        if (!header.find()) return null;
        int open = masked.indexOf('{', header.end());
        if (open < 0) return null;
        int close = SourceText.close(masked, open);
        if (close < 0) return null;
        var kept = new StringBuilder();
        var constructor = Pattern.compile(MODIFIERS.pattern() + Pattern.quote(simple) + "\\s*\\(");
        int i = open + 1;
        while (i < close) {
            while (i < close && (Character.isWhitespace(masked.charAt(i)) || masked.charAt(i) == ';')) i++;
            if (i >= close) break;
            int start = i, depth = 0; boolean initializer = false;
            while (i < close) {
                char c = masked.charAt(i);
                if (c == '(' || c == '[') depth++;
                else if (c == ')' || c == ']') depth--;
                else if (c == '=' && depth == 0) initializer = true;
                else if (c == ';' && depth == 0) { i++; break; }
                else if (c == '{' && depth == 0) {
                    int end = SourceText.close(masked, i);
                    if (end < 0 || end > close) return null;
                    i = end + 1;
                    if (!initializer) break;
                    continue;
                }
                i++;
            }
            String member = text.substring(start, i);
            if (!constructor.matcher(masked.substring(start, i)).lookingAt()) kept.append("        ").append(member.strip()).append('\n');
        }
        return kept.toString().stripTrailing();
    }
    /** {@code text} with the imports of {@code bodyText} it lacks, none naming the enum or its body classes. */
    private static String imports(String text, String bodyText, String enumClass, List<Body> bodies) {
        var excluded = new HashSet<String>();
        excluded.add(enumClass.replace('/', '.'));
        bodies.forEach(body -> excluded.add(body.bodyClass().replace('/', '.')));
        var present = new HashSet<String>(); int last = -1;
        var own = IMPORT.matcher(text);
        while (own.find()) { present.add(own.group(0).strip()); last = own.end(); }
        var added = new StringBuilder();
        var other = IMPORT.matcher(bodyText);
        while (other.find()) {
            String line = other.group(0).strip();
            if (other.group(1) == null && excluded.contains(other.group(2))) continue;
            if (present.add(line)) added.append('\n').append(line);
        }
        if (added.isEmpty()) return text;
        if (last < 0) {
            var pkg = Pattern.compile("(?m)^\\s*package\\s+[\\w.$]+\\s*;").matcher(SourceText.mask(text));
            last = pkg.find() ? pkg.end() : 0;
            if (last == 0) return added.substring(1) + "\n" + text;
        }
        return text.substring(0, last) + added + text.substring(last);
    }
}
```
