`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/DependencyClasspathTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class DependencyClasspathTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;
    Path dependency() throws Exception {
        Path source=directory.resolve("Library.java"); Files.writeString(source,"public class Library { public static int value(){return 42;} }");
        assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none",source.toString()));
        Path jar=directory.resolve("library.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Library.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(directory.resolve("Library.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")); zip.write("Manifest-Version: 1.0\nClass-Path: secret.jar\n\n".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("Library.java")); zip.write("invalid".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return jar;
    }
    @Test void stripsImplicitDependenciesAndSources() throws Exception {
        Path jar=dependency(); Path output=directory.resolve("deps");
        var paths=DependencyClasspath.prepare(List.of(jar),output,Set.of("Target"));
        try(var zip=new ZipFile(paths.getFirst().toFile())) {
            assertEquals(1,zip.size()); assertNotNull(zip.getEntry("Library.class"));
        }
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("dependencies.txt")).contains("sha256="));
    }
    @Test void acceptsDisjointModularJarsOnClasspath() throws Exception {
        var jars=new ArrayList<Path>();
        for(String name:List.of("First","Second")) {
            Path folder=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve(name));
            Path module=folder.resolve("module-info.java"), source=folder.resolve(name+".java");
            Files.writeString(module,"module "+name.toLowerCase()+" {}");
            Files.writeString(source,"package sample; public class "+name+" {}");
            assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","9","-proc:none","-d",folder.toString(),module.toString(),source.toString()));
            Path jar=directory.resolve(name+".jar");
            try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
                for(String entry:List.of("module-info.class","sample/"+name+".class")) {
                    zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(folder.resolve(entry))); zip.closeEntry();
                }
            }
            jars.add(jar);
        }
        var normalized=DependencyClasspath.prepare(jars,directory.resolve("modular"),Set.of("module-info","Target"));
        assertEquals(2,normalized.size());
        for(Path path:normalized) try(var zip=new ZipFile(path.toFile())) { assertNull(zip.getEntry("module-info.class")); assertEquals(1,zip.size()); }
    }
    /** Base Library (release 8) plus a Java 9 variant and module descriptor under META-INF/versions/9. */
    Path multiRelease(String variantPath) throws Exception {
        Path base=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("mr-base")), nine=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("mr-nine"));
        Files.writeString(base.resolve("Library.java"),"package lib; public class Library { public static int value(){return 1;} }");
        Files.writeString(nine.resolve("Library.java"),"package lib; public class Library { public static int value(){return 9;} }");
        Files.writeString(nine.resolve("module-info.java"),"module lib { exports lib; }");
        assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","8","-proc:none","-d",base.toString(),base.resolve("Library.java").toString()));
        assertEquals(0,ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null,null,null,"--release","9","-proc:none","-d",nine.toString(),
            nine.resolve("module-info.java").toString(),nine.resolve("Library.java").toString()));
        Path jar=directory.resolve("multi-release.jar");
        try(var zip=new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/MANIFEST.MF")); zip.write("Manifest-Version: 1.0\nMulti-Release: true\n\n".getBytes()); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("lib/Library.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(base.resolve("lib/Library.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(variantPath)); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(nine.resolve("lib/Library.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("META-INF/versions/9/module-info.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(nine.resolve("module-info.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return jar;
    }
    @Test void multiReleaseDependencyContributesOnlyItsBaseClasses() throws Exception {
        Path output=directory.resolve("deps");
        var paths=DependencyClasspath.prepare(List.of(multiRelease("META-INF/versions/9/lib/Library.class")),output,Set.of("Target"));
        try(var zip=new ZipFile(paths.getFirst().toFile())) {
            assertEquals(List.of("lib/Library.class"),zip.stream().map(ZipEntry::getName).toList());
        }
        assertTrue(Files.readString(output.resolve("dependencies.txt")).contains("classes=1 multi-release-variants-ignored=2"));
    }
    @Test void rejectsVersionedDependencyEntryThatDoesNotNameItsClass() throws Exception {
        var error=assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class,()->DependencyClasspath.prepare(
            List.of(multiRelease("META-INF/versions/9/lib/Other.class")),directory.resolve("deps"),Set.of("Target")));
        assertTrue(error.getMessage().contains("META-INF/versions/9/lib/Other.class"),error.getMessage());
    }
    @Test void rejectsOriginalClassOverlap() throws Exception {
        Path jar=dependency();
        assertThrows(java.io.IOException.class,()->DependencyClasspath.prepare(List.of(jar),directory.resolve("deps"),Set.of("Library")));
    }
    @Test void compilerResolvesOnlyExplicitDependencyClasses() throws Exception {
        Path jar=dependency(); Path sources=Files.createDirectory(directory.resolve("src"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("Target.java"),"public class Target { public int value(){return Library.value();} }");
        var original=new dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo("Target","java/lang/Object",52,0,1,List.of(),List.of(),
            List.of(new dev.classrevive.model.MemberInfo("<init>","()V",1),new dev.classrevive.model.MemberInfo("value","()I",1)));
        var verifier=new CompilerVerifier();
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED,verifier.verify(sources,directory.resolve("missing"),List.of(original),java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(20)).status());
        assertTrue(verifier.verify(sources,directory.resolve("resolved"),List.of(original),java.time.Duration.ofSeconds(20),List.of(jar)).complete());
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/IdiomResugarTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;
import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Compiler idioms undone in decompiler-shaped files (Phase 2DH). Sources and classes are compiled, never run. */
class IdiomResugarTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    record Original(Path jar, List<ClassInfo> infos) {}

    /** javac 21's classes (release 8) for the original sources, as the job's normalized class JAR. */
    Original original(Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path sources = write("original-src", files), classes = dir.resolve("original-classes");
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        for (var name : files.keySet()) args.add(sources.resolve(name).toString());
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar"); var infos = new ArrayList<ClassInfo>();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var paths = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".class")).sorted().toList()) {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path);
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/'))); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry();
                infos.add(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes));
            }
        }
        return new Original(jar, infos);
    }
    Path write(String name, Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path root = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve(name));
        for (var file : files.entrySet()) {
            Path path = root.resolve(file.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
        }
        return root;
    }
    IdiomResugar.Proposal propose(Original original, Path mix) throws IOException {
        return new IdiomResugar().propose(mix, dir.resolve("idioms"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
    }
    /** The mix with the rewritten files compiles with every signature, and no body is DIFFERENT. */
    void recompilesToTheOriginal(Original original, Path mix, IdiomResugar.Proposal proposal) throws IOException {
        var files = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(mix)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList()) {
                String file = mix.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                files.put(file, Files.readString(proposal.files().getOrDefault(file, path)));
            }
        }
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(write("merged", files), dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60),
            List.of(), original.jar());
        assertTrue(verified.complete(), verified.toString());
        assertEquals(0, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
    }

    @Test void aSwitchOnTheOrdinalOfAnEnumBecomesASwitchOnTheEnumWithItsConstantsFromTheBytecode() throws Exception {
        // The first test JAR (Phase 2DH): javac 21 compiles a switch on an enum of the same file to a switch on ordinal(),
        // and CFR printed it so. The constants come from the enum's class initializer, not from the case values.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Inv.java", "package p; public class Inv { public enum Kind { TOOL, FOOD, BOOK }\n"
            + " public static String describe(Kind k) { switch (k) { case TOOL: return \"util\"; case FOOD: return \"fresh\"; default: return \"read\"; } } }\n"));
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/Inv.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Inv {\n"
            + "    public static String describe(Kind kind) {\n        switch (kind.ordinal()) {\n            case 0: {\n                return \"util\";\n"
            + "            }\n            case 1: {\n                return \"fresh\";\n            }\n        }\n        return \"read\";\n    }\n\n"
            + "    public static enum Kind {\n        TOOL,\n        FOOD,\n        BOOK;\n\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of(new IdiomResugar.Rewrite("p/Inv.java", 5, "enum-switch", "switch (kind.ordinal())", "switch (kind) case TOOL, FOOD")),
            proposal.rewrites(), proposal.toString());
        String text = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Inv.java"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("switch (kind) {") && text.contains("case TOOL: {") && text.contains("case FOOD: {"), text);
        recompilesToTheOriginal(original, mix, proposal);
    }

    @Test void aSwitchOnASyntheticSwitchMapIsReadFromTheHoldersInitializerAndMakesTheFileCompile() throws Exception {
        // javac keeps the switch map of an enum of another class in the synthetic Use$1; javac cannot see that synthetic
        // field in a class file, so the printed file does not compile alone. Case 1 is BLUE and case 2 GREEN here: the
        // values follow the order of the original case labels, not the ordinals.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Color.java", "package p; public enum Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE }\n",
            "p/Use.java", "package p; public class Use { static int f(Color c) { switch (c) { case BLUE: return 1; case GREEN: return 2; default: return 0; } } }\n"));
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/Color.java", "package p;\n\npublic enum Color {\n    RED,\n    GREEN,\n    BLUE;\n\n}\n",
            "p/Use.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Use {\n    static int f(Color color) {\n"
            + "        switch (Use$1.$SwitchMap$p$Color[color.ordinal()]) {\n            case 1: {\n                return 1;\n            }\n"
            + "            case 2: {\n                return 2;\n            }\n        }\n        return 0;\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of(new IdiomResugar.Rewrite("p/Use.java", 5, "enum-switch", "switch (Use$1.$SwitchMap$p$Color[color.ordinal()])",
            "switch (color) case BLUE, GREEN")), proposal.rewrites(), proposal.toString());
        recompilesToTheOriginal(original, mix, proposal);
    }

    @Test void aSwitchMapHolderPrintedAsAFileOfItsOwnIsLeftAlone() throws Exception {
        // Like an obfuscated jar without InnerClasses: the holder Use$1 is a source file of the mix, so Use compiles in the mix but
        // not alone, and a rewritten switch would make javac generate a second Use$1.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Color.java", "package p; public enum Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE }\n",
            "p/Use.java", "package p; public class Use { static int f(Color c) { switch (c) { case BLUE: return 1; default: return 0; } } }\n"));
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/Color.java", "package p;\npublic enum Color { RED, GREEN, BLUE }\n",
            "p/Use$1.java", "package p;\nclass Use$1 {\n    static final int[] $SwitchMap$p$Color = new int[Color.values().length];\n}\n",
            "p/Use.java", "package p;\npublic class Use {\n    static int f(Color c) {\n"
            + "        switch (Use$1.$SwitchMap$p$Color[c.ordinal()]) {\n            case 1: return 1;\n            default: return 0;\n        }\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of(), proposal.rewrites(), proposal.toString());
        assertEquals(List.of(new IdiomResugar.Refusal("p/Use.java", 4, "enum-switch", "holder-declared-in-another-file")), proposal.refusals());
    }

    @Test void syntheticAccessorCallsBecomeTheMemberAccessTheirBytecodePerforms() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Outer.java", "package p; public class Outer { private int count; private static String label = \"x\";\n"
            + " private int bump(int by) { return count + by; }\n"
            + " class Inner { int read() { return count; } void write(int v) { count = v; } int both(int v) { return bump(v) + (count = v); }\n"
            + "  String name() { return label; } int post() { return count++; } } }\n"));
        // CFR-shaped: the accessors javac generated are called by name. access$008 (count++) does more than one access.
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/Outer.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Outer {\n    private int count;\n    private static String label = \"x\";\n\n"
            + "    private int bump(int by) {\n        return this.count + by;\n    }\n\n    class Inner {\n"
            + "        int read() {\n            return Outer.access$000(Outer.this);\n        }\n\n"
            + "        void write(int v) {\n            Outer.access$002(Outer.this, v);\n        }\n\n"
            + "        int both(int v) {\n            return Outer.access$100(Outer.this, v) + Outer.access$002(Outer.this, v);\n        }\n\n"
            + "        String name() {\n            return Outer.access$200();\n        }\n\n"
            + "        int post() {\n            return Outer.access$008(Outer.this);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        // The file does not compile alone (javac does not see the synthetic accessors), so a rewrite is kept when it adds
        // no error; access$008 (count++) does more than one access and stays.
        assertEquals(5, proposal.rewrites().size(), proposal.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Outer.java")).contains("return Outer.access$008(Outer.this);"));
        assertTrue(proposal.refusals().contains(new IdiomResugar.Refusal("p/Outer.java", 29, "accessor-call", "accessor-not-a-plain-access")),
            proposal.toString());
        // Without the increment, every call is a plain access and the file compiles once they are all rewritten.
        Path plain = write("plain", Map.of("p/Outer.java", Files.readString(mix.resolve("p/Outer.java"))
            .replace("return Outer.access$008(Outer.this);", "return Outer.this.count++;")));
        proposal = new IdiomResugar().propose(plain, dir.resolve("idioms-plain"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(List.of("Outer.this.count", "Outer.this.count = v", "Outer.this.bump(v)", "(Outer.this.count = v)", "Outer.label"),
            proposal.rewrites().stream().map(IdiomResugar.Rewrite::after).toList(), proposal.toString());
        String text = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Outer.java"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("return Outer.this.bump(v) + (Outer.this.count = v);") && !text.contains("access$"), text);
        recompilesToTheOriginal(original, plain, proposal);
    }

    @Test void assertionsDisabledTestsBecomeAssertStatementsAndTheSyntheticFieldGoes() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Checked.java", "package p; public class Checked {\n"
            + " static int half(int x) { assert x % 2 == 0 : \"odd\"; return x / 2; }\n"
            + " static String name(String s) { assert s != null; return s; } }\n"));
        // JADX-shaped: the synthetic field, its initialization in a static block and the tests are printed.
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/Checked.java", "package p;\n\n/* loaded from: classes.jar */\npublic class Checked {\n"
            + "    static final /* synthetic */ boolean $assertionsDisabled;\n\n    static {\n"
            + "        $assertionsDisabled = !Checked.class.desiredAssertionStatus();\n    }\n\n"
            + "    static int half(int x) {\n        if (!$assertionsDisabled && x % 2 != 0) {\n            throw new AssertionError(\"odd\");\n        }\n"
            + "        return x / 2;\n    }\n\n    static String name(String s) {\n        if (!$assertionsDisabled && s == null) {\n"
            + "            throw new AssertionError();\n        }\n        return s;\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of("assert x % 2 == 0 : \"odd\";"), proposal.rewrites().stream().map(IdiomResugar.Rewrite::after).toList(), proposal.toString());
        String text = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Checked.java"));
        assertTrue(text.contains("assert x % 2 == 0 : \"odd\";") && text.contains("assert s != null;"), text);
        assertFalse(text.contains("$assertionsDisabled") || text.contains("static {"), text);
        recompilesToTheOriginal(original, mix, proposal);
    }

    @Test void leavesAlonePlainIntSwitchesEnumsItCannotReadAndFieldsThatAreNotSynthetic() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Plain.java", "package p; public class Plain {\n"
            + " static boolean $assertionsDisabled = false;\n"

    }

    @Test void aKotlinWhenMappingsHolderTheSourceDoesNotDeclareIsFoundAmongTheEnclosingClassesMembers() throws Exception {
        // kotlinc keeps a `when` on an enum in Outer$WhenMappings; decompilers print WhenMappings.$EnumSwitchMapping$0
        // without declaring it, so javac cannot resolve the holder. Its values are read from the original class.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/T.java", "package p; public class T { enum P { A, B, C }\n"
            + " static final class WhenMappings { static final int[] $EnumSwitchMapping$0;\n"
            + "  static { int[] map = new int[P.values().length]; map[P.B.ordinal()] = 1; map[P.A.ordinal()] = 2; $EnumSwitchMapping$0 = map; } }\n"
            + " static int f(P p) { switch (WhenMappings.$EnumSwitchMapping$0[p.ordinal()]) { case 1: return 10; case 2: return 20; default: return 0; } } }\n"));
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/T.java", "package p;\n\npublic final class T {\n    static int f(P p) {\n"
            + "        switch (WhenMappings.$EnumSwitchMapping$0[p.ordinal()]) {\n            case 1: return 10;\n            case 2: return 20;\n"
            + "            default: return 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    enum P { A, B, C }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of(new IdiomResugar.Rewrite("p/T.java", 5, "enum-switch", "switch (WhenMappings.$EnumSwitchMapping$0[p.ordinal()])",
            "switch (p) case B, A")), proposal.rewrites(), proposal.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/T.java")).contains("case B: return 10;"), proposal.toString());
    }

    @Test void anAccessorThatStoresAndLoadsTheValueAgainAsD8WritesItIsAnAssignment() throws Exception {
        // d8 returns the stored value by loading the parameter again instead of dup_x1. The classes are written with ASM.
        Path classes = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("d8-classes").resolve("p"));
        var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES | org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_8, org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, "p/O", null,
            "java/lang/Object", null);
        writer.visitField(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE, "v", "I", null, null).visitEnd();
        var init = writer.visitMethod(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "<init>", "()V", null, null);
        init.visitCode(); init.visitVarInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ALOAD, 0);
        init.visitMethodInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL, "java/lang/Object", "<init>", "()V", false);
        init.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.RETURN); init.visitMaxs(0, 0); init.visitEnd();
        var accessor = writer.visitMethod(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_STATIC | org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC, "access$002", "(Lp/O;I)I", null, null);
        accessor.visitCode(); accessor.visitVarInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ALOAD, 0); accessor.visitVarInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ILOAD, 1);
        accessor.visitFieldInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.PUTFIELD, "p/O", "v", "I"); accessor.visitVarInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ILOAD, 1);
        accessor.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.IRETURN); accessor.visitMaxs(0, 0); accessor.visitEnd();
        var f = writer.visitMethod(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(Lp/O;)I", null, null);
        f.visitCode(); f.visitVarInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ALOAD, 0); f.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ICONST_5);
        f.visitMethodInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "p/O", "access$002", "(Lp/O;I)I", false);
        f.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.IRETURN); f.visitMaxs(0, 0); f.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        byte[] bytes = writer.toByteArray();
        Path jar = dir.resolve("d8.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) { zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("p/O.class")); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry(); }
        var original = new Original(jar, List.of(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes)));
        Path mix = write("mix", Map.of("p/O.java", "package p;\n\npublic class O {\n    private int v;\n\n"
            + "    static int f(O o) {\n        return O.access$002(o, 5);\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = propose(original, mix);
        assertEquals(List.of("(o.v = 5)"), proposal.rewrites().stream().map(IdiomResugar.Rewrite::after).toList(), proposal.toString());
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/MethodRoundTripTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;
import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import dev.classrevive.verification.MethodRoundTrip.Outcome;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import org.objectweb.asm.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class MethodRoundTripTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    /** Known source; javac output is only parsed, never loaded. */
    static final String FIXTURE = """
        package demo;
        public class Fixture {
            private final StringBuilder log = new StringBuilder();
            public int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }
            public int answer() { return 42; }
            public long wide(long x) { return x * 100000L + 7; }
            public void record(String value) { log.append(value); log.append('|'); }
            public String choose(String key) {
                switch (key) { case "one": return "1"; case "two": return "2"; default: return "?"; }
            }
            public int loop(int n) {
                int total = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (i % 3 == 0) continue; total += i; }
                return total;
            }
            public int guarded(String text) {
                try { return Integer.parseInt(text); } catch (NumberFormatException error) { return -1; }
            }
            static int helper(int v) { return v << 2; }
            interface Shape { double area(); }
            static final class Square implements Shape { final double side; Square(double side) { this.side = side; } public double area() { return side * side; } }
        }
        """;

    Map<String,byte[]> compile(String source, String name) throws Exception { return compile(source, name, "17"); }

    Map<String,byte[]> compile(String source, String name, String release) throws Exception {
        Path src = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve(name).resolve("src/demo"));
        Path out = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve(name).resolve("classes"));
        Files.writeString(src.resolve("Fixture.java"), source);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", release, "-proc:none", "-Xlint:-options",
            "-d", out.toString(), src.resolve("Fixture.java").toString()));
        var result = new TreeMap<String,byte[]>();
        try (var paths = Files.walk(out)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(p -> p.toString().endsWith(".class")).toList()) {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path);
                result.put(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes).name(), bytes);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    Path jar(Map<String,byte[]> classes) throws Exception {
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            for (var entry : classes.entrySet()) { zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry.getKey() + ".class")); zip.write(entry.getValue()); zip.closeEntry(); }
        }
        return jar;
    }

    /** Runs the real verification path: worker javac on the candidate source, then per-method comparison. */
    VerificationResult roundTrip(String candidate) throws Exception {
        var originals = compile(FIXTURE, "original");
        List<ClassInfo> infos = new ArrayList<>();
        for (var bytes : originals.values()) infos.add(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes));
        Path sources = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("candidate/demo"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("Fixture.java"), candidate);
        var result = new CompilerVerifier().verify(dir.resolve("candidate"), dir.resolve("verify"), infos, Duration.ofSeconds(30),
            List.of(), jar(originals));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, result.status());
        assertTrue(result.roundTripMeasured());
        return result;
    }

    static Map<String,Outcome> outcomes(VerificationResult result) {
        var map = new TreeMap<String,Outcome>();
        for (var type : result.roundTrip()) for (var method : type.methods())
            map.put(type.className() + "." + method.name() + method.descriptor(), method.outcome());
        return map;
    }

    static void onlyDifferent(VerificationResult result, String method) {
        var outcomes = outcomes(result);
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcomes.get(method), outcomes.toString());
        outcomes.forEach((name, outcome) -> { if (!name.equals(method)) assertEquals(Outcome.IDENTICAL, outcome, name); });
        assertEquals(1, result.roundTripDifferent());
    }

    @Test void sameSourceIsIdenticalForEveryMethod() throws Exception {
        var result = roundTrip(FIXTURE);
        var outcomes = outcomes(result);
        assertEquals(11, outcomes.size(), outcomes.toString()); // 9 bodies in Fixture, 2 in Square, none in Shape
        outcomes.forEach((name, outcome) -> assertEquals(Outcome.IDENTICAL, outcome, name));
        assertEquals(outcomes.size(), result.roundTripIdentical());
        assertEquals(Set.of("demo/Fixture", "demo/Fixture$Shape", "demo/Fixture$Square"),
            new TreeSet<>(result.roundTrip().stream().map(ClassRoundTrip::className).toList()));
    }

    @Test void swappedOperatorIsDifferent() throws Exception {
        onlyDifferent(roundTrip(FIXTURE.replace("return a + b;", "return a - b;")), "demo/Fixture.add(II)I");
    }

    @Test void changedConstantIsDifferent() throws Exception {
        onlyDifferent(roundTrip(FIXTURE.replace("return 42;", "return 43;")), "demo/Fixture.answer()I");
    }

    @Test void removedCallIsDifferent() throws Exception {
        onlyDifferent(roundTrip(FIXTURE.replace(" log.append('|');", "")), "demo/Fixture.record(Ljava/lang/String;)V");
    }

    @Test void engineThrowStubIsDifferentEvenThoughSignaturesMatch() throws Exception {
        var result = roundTrip(FIXTURE.replace("return v << 2;",
            "throw new IllegalStateException(\"An error occurred while decompiling this method.\");"));
        assertEquals(result.expectedSymbols(), result.matchedSymbols(), "signatures alone cannot see the stub");
        onlyDifferent(result, "demo/Fixture.helper(I)I");
    }

    @Test void smallMutationsAreAlwaysDetectedInProcess() throws Exception {
        var original = compile(FIXTURE, "base");
        var mutations = Map.of(
            "loop(I)I", FIXTURE.replace("i % 3 == 0", "i % 3 == 1"),
            "loop(I)I#", FIXTURE.replace("i < n", "i <= n"),
            "wide(J)J", FIXTURE.replace("+ 7;", "+ 8;"),
            "choose(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", FIXTURE.replace("return \"2\";", "return \"3\";"),
            "guarded(Ljava/lang/String;)I", FIXTURE.replace("return -1;", "return 0;"));
        int index = 0;
        for (var mutation : new TreeMap<>(mutations).entrySet()) {
            var mutated = compile(mutation.getValue(), "mutant" + index++);
            String method = mutation.getKey().replace("#", "");
            var results = MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, mutated);
            for (var type : results) for (var result : type.methods()) {
                boolean target = type.className().equals("demo/Fixture") && (result.name() + result.descriptor()).equals(method);
                assertEquals(target ? Outcome.DIFFERENT : Outcome.IDENTICAL, result.outcome(), mutation.getKey() + " -> " + result);
            }
        }
    }

    @Test void aDifferentBodyNamesItsFirstDivergingOpcodesWithoutOperands() throws Exception {
        var original = compile(FIXTURE, "base");
        var operator = compile(FIXTURE.replace("return a + b;", "return a - b;"), "operator");
        var constant = compile(FIXTURE.replace("return \"2\";", "return \"secret\";"), "constant");
        var added = MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, operator).stream().flatMap(type -> type.methods().stream())
            .filter(method -> method.name().equals("add")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, added.outcome());
        assertEquals("iadd/isub", added.difference());
        var chosen = MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, constant).stream().flatMap(type -> type.methods().stream())
            .filter(method -> method.name().equals("choose")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        assertEquals("const-string/const-string", chosen.difference(), "the detail names no target constant");
        for (var type : MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, operator))
            for (var method : type.methods()) if (method.outcome() != Outcome.DIFFERENT) assertEquals("", method.difference());
        String context = MethodRoundTrip.differenceContext(original.get("demo/Fixture"), constant.get("demo/Fixture"),
            "choose", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", 2);
        assertTrue(context.contains("secret") && context.startsWith("first difference at normalized instruction"), context);
        assertEquals("", MethodRoundTrip.differenceContext(original.get("demo/Fixture"), null, "choose", "(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;", 2));
        assertEquals("<end>/ireturn", MethodRoundTrip.difference(List.of("a"), List.of("a", "op172")));
    }

    @Test void lineNumbersDoNotMatter() throws Exception {

    @Test void constantFormsAndSlotNumbersAreEquivalentAfterNormalization() {

        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(generated(false, false, false), generated(false, true, false)));

    @Test void jumpToReturnIsEquivalentToReturningInPlace() throws Exception {
        // javac compiles a returned conditional as one return reached by GOTO; decompilers often print two returns.
        String ternary = "package demo; public class Fixture { int f(boolean c, int x) { return c ? 0 : x; }"
            + " void g(boolean c) { if (c) { System.out.println(); } else { System.out.print(1); } } }";
        var original = compile(ternary, "ternary").get("demo/Fixture");
        var branches = compile(ternary.replace("return c ? 0 : x;", "if (c) return 0; return x;"), "branches").get("demo/Fixture");
        var swapped = compile(ternary.replace("return c ? 0 : x;", "if (c) return x; return 0;"), "swapped").get("demo/Fixture");
        var changed = compile(ternary.replace("return c ? 0 : x;", "if (c) return 1; return x;"), "changed").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, branches, "f(ZI)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, swapped, "f(ZI)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, changed, "f(ZI)I"));
        // A GOTO to code that is not a return stays a jump, so g's if/else is still compared as written.
        assertEquals(Outcome.IDENTICAL, outcome(original, branches, "g(Z)V"));
        var noElse = compile(ternary.replace("} else { System.out.print(1); }", "} System.out.print(1);"), "no-else").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, noElse, "g(Z)V"));
    }

    @Test void invertedBranchWithSwappedBlocksIsEquivalentButOtherChangesAreNot() throws Exception {
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture { static void a() {} static void b() {} static void c() {}"
            + " static void h(int x) { if (x > 0) { a(); } else { b(); } c(); }"
            + " static int t(int x) { try { a(); return x; } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; } } }";
        var original = compile(base, "branch-original").get("demo/Fixture");
        var inverted = compile(base.replace("if (x > 0) { a(); } else { b(); }", "if (x <= 0) { b(); } else { a(); }"), "inverted").get("demo/Fixture");
        var swappedOnly = compile(base.replace("if (x > 0) { a(); } else { b(); }", "if (x > 0) { b(); } else { a(); }"), "swapped-only").get("demo/Fixture");
        var otherTest = compile(base.replace("if (x > 0) { a(); } else { b(); }", "if (x < 0) { b(); } else { a(); }"), "other-test").get("demo/Fixture");
        var reordered = compile(base.replace("try { a(); return x; } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; }",
            "try { a(); } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; } return x;"), "reordered-try").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, inverted, "h(I)V"));
        assertEquals("same control flow, different block layout", MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(original, inverted).stream()
            .filter(result -> result.name().equals("h")).findFirst().orElseThrow().reason());
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, swappedOnly, "h(I)V"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, otherTest, "h(I)V"));
        // Since Phase 2BH bodies with exception handlers are matched by control flow too: the load and return that left
        // the try block cannot throw, so where the handler's range ends does not matter for them.
        assertNotEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, reordered, "t(I)I"));
    }

    @Test void objectMethodOnInterfaceReceiverMatchesAcrossJavacVersions() {
        // Older javac: invokevirtual java/lang/Object.toString on a Map receiver; javac 21: invokeinterface java/util/Map.toString.
        byte[] older = call(Opcodes.INVOKEVIRTUAL, "java/lang/Object", "toString", "()Ljava/lang/String;", false);
        byte[] newer = call(Opcodes.INVOKEINTERFACE, "java/util/Map", "toString", "()Ljava/lang/String;", true);
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(older, newer));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, single(older, call(Opcodes.INVOKEINTERFACE, "java/util/Map", "hashCode", "()I", true)));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, single(call(Opcodes.INVOKEVIRTUAL, "java/util/HashMap", "size", "()I", false),
            call(Opcodes.INVOKEINTERFACE, "java/util/Map", "size", "()I", true)));
    }

    /** static Object f(java.util.Map m) { return m.&lt;call&gt;(); } with the given invoke spelling (the result is boxed or returned). */
    static byte[] call(int opcode, String owner, String name, String descriptor, boolean itf) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(Ljava/util/Map;)Ljava/lang/Object;", null, null);
        method.visitCode(); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0); method.visitMethodInsn(opcode, owner, name, descriptor, itf);
        if (descriptor.endsWith(")I")) method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "java/lang/Integer", "valueOf", "(I)Ljava/lang/Integer;", false);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ARETURN); method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void privateCallOpcodeMatchesAcrossJavacVersions() {
        // javac before 11 calls a private method with invokespecial; with nestmates (JEP 181) it uses invokevirtual.
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(selfCall(true, Opcodes.INVOKEVIRTUAL), selfCall(true, Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL), "f()I"));
        // For an overridable method, invokespecial is a non-virtual call (like super.m()), so the two forms differ.
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(selfCall(false, Opcodes.INVOKEVIRTUAL), selfCall(false, Opcodes.INVOKESPECIAL), "f()I"));
    }

    /** class G { [private|public] int p() { return 1; } int f() { return this.p(); } } with the given call opcode. */
    static byte[] selfCall(boolean privateTarget, int opcode) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V11, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var p = writer.visitMethod(privateTarget ? Opcodes.ACC_PRIVATE : Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "p", "()I", null, null);
        p.visitCode(); p.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_1); p.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN); p.visitMaxs(0, 0); p.visitEnd();
        var f = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "f", "()I", null, null);
        f.visitCode(); f.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 0); f.visitMethodInsn(opcode, "G", "p", "()I", false);
        f.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN); f.visitMaxs(0, 0); f.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void aLocalThatOnlyPassesAValueThroughIsEquivalentToTheExpression() throws Exception {
        String direct = "package demo; public class Fixture { static String f(String s) { return s.trim(); } }";
        var original = compile(direct, "temp-direct").get("demo/Fixture");
        var temp = compile(direct.replace("return s.trim();", "String t = s.trim(); return t;"), "temp-local").get("demo/Fixture");
        var reused = compile(direct.replace("return s.trim();", "String t = s.trim(); System.out.print(t); return t;"), "temp-reused").get("demo/Fixture");
        var parameter = compile(direct.replace("return s.trim();", "s = s.trim(); return s;"), "temp-parameter").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, temp, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, reused, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;"));
        // Since Phase 2BH locals are variables (webs), not slots: the parameter's new value is a variable of its own,
        // read only by the load right after its store, so it passes the value through like any local.
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, parameter, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;"));
        var parameterRead = compile(direct.replace("return s.trim();", "String t = s.trim(); return s;"), "temp-parameter-read").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, parameterRead, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/String;"));
    }

    static Outcome outcome(byte[] original, byte[] recompiled, String method) {
        return MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(original, recompiled).stream()
            .filter(result -> (result.name() + result.descriptor()).equals(method)).findFirst().orElseThrow().outcome();
    }

        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(locals(1, 2), locals(2, 1)));
    }

    }

    static Outcome single(byte[] original, byte[] recompiled) {
        var results = MethodRoundTrip.compare(Map.of("G", original), Map.of("G", recompiled));
        var methods = results.getFirst().methods();
        assertEquals(1, methods.size());
        return methods.getFirst().outcome();
    }

    /** static int f(int p) { int a = 5; int b = p + 200; return a * b + 70000; } in several byte-level spellings. */
    static byte[] generated(boolean ldcConstants, boolean shiftedSlots, boolean padPool) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS | ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        if (padPool) { writer.newUTF8("padding entry"); writer.newConst(123456789); writer.newClass("java/util/List"); }
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(I)I", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        int a = shiftedSlots ? 3 : 1, b = shiftedSlots ? 5 : 2;
        if (ldcConstants) method.visitLdcInsn(5); else method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_5);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ISTORE, a);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, 0);
        if (ldcConstants) method.visitLdcInsn(200); else method.visitIntInsn(Opcodes.SIPUSH, 200);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IADD);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ISTORE, b);
        var line = new Label(); method.visitLabel(line); method.visitLineNumber(shiftedSlots ? 99 : 3, line);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, a);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, b);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IMUL);
        method.visitLdcInsn(70000);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IADD);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0);
        method.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** static int f() { x = 1; y = 2; return x + y; } with x and y stored in the given slots. */
    static byte[] locals(int x, int y) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "()I", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_1); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ISTORE, x);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_2); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ISTORE, y);
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, x); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, y);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IADD); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    static byte[] floating(double value) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "()D", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        if (value == 0.0 && Double.doubleToRawLongBits(value) == 0) method.visitInsn(Opcodes.DCONST_0); else method.visitLdcInsn(value);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.DRETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd();
        writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    // Phase 2BH: javac's variations and decompilers' rewritings that keep the JVM semantics.

    static Map<String,Outcome> outcomes(List<ClassRoundTrip> results) {
        var map = new TreeMap<String,Outcome>();
        for (var type : results) for (var method : type.methods()) map.put(type.className() + "." + method.name() + method.descriptor(), method.outcome());
        return map;
    }

    @Test void anEnumsValuesMethodIsTheArrayItBuilds() throws Exception {
        // javac 15 and later build an enum's $VALUES in a private static synthetic $values(); older javac inline it.
        byte[] newer = compile("package demo; public enum Fixture { A, B, C; }", "enum-values").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(inlinedValues(newer, false), newer, "<clinit>()V"));
        // The array built in another order is another class initializer.
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(inlinedValues(newer, true), newer, "<clinit>()V"));
        // A $values() that is not synthetic is an ordinary call, never read as its body.
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(inlinedValues(newer, false), declaredValues(newer), "<clinit>()V"));
    }

    /** The enum with $values() inlined into its class initializer and removed, as javac before 15 wrote it; optionally A and B swapped. */
    static byte[] inlinedValues(byte[] bytes, boolean swap) {
        var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
        var values = node.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals("$values")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        var initializer = node.methods.stream().filter(method -> method.name.equals("<clinit>")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        var body = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.InsnList(); var fields = new ArrayList<org.objectweb.asm.tree.FieldInsnNode>();
        for (var insn : values.instructions) {
            if (insn.getOpcode() < 0 || insn.getOpcode() == Opcodes.ARETURN) continue;
            var copy = insn.clone(Map.of()); body.add(copy);
            if (copy instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.FieldInsnNode field) fields.add(field);
        }
        if (swap) { String first = fields.get(0).name; fields.get(0).name = fields.get(1).name; fields.get(1).name = first; }
        var call = Arrays.stream(initializer.instructions.toArray())
            .filter(insn -> insn instanceof org.objectweb.asm.tree.MethodInsnNode method && method.name.equals("$values")).findFirst().orElseThrow();
        initializer.instructions.insertBefore(call, body); initializer.instructions.remove(call);
        node.methods.remove(values);
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS); node.accept(writer);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** The enum with its $values() no longer marked synthetic. */
    static byte[] declaredValues(byte[] bytes) {
        var node = new org.objectweb.asm.tree.ClassNode();
        new ClassReader(bytes).accept(node, ClassReader.SKIP_DEBUG | ClassReader.SKIP_FRAMES);
        for (var method : node.methods) if (method.name.equals("$values")) method.access &= ~Opcodes.ACC_SYNTHETIC;
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS); node.accept(writer);
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void accessorsNumberedInAnotherOrderAreTheSameAccess() throws Exception {
        // Before Java 11, javac reaches an outer class's private fields through access$NNN, numbered in the order it
        // meets the accesses: with g first, b's accessor is access$000 instead of access$100.
        String source = "package demo; public class Fixture { private int a = 1; private int b = 2;"
            + " class In { int f() { return a + b; } int g() { return b; } } }";
        String methods = "int f() { return a + b; } int g() { return b; }";
        var original = compile(source, "accessors", "8");
        var reordered = compile(source.replace(methods, "int g() { return b; } int f() { return a + b; }"), "accessors-reordered", "8");
        var results = MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, reordered);
        var outcomes = outcomes(results);
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcomes.get("demo/Fixture$In.f()I"), outcomes.toString());
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcomes.get("demo/Fixture$In.g()I"));
        assertEquals("synthetic accessor numbered differently", results.stream().filter(type -> type.className().equals("demo/Fixture"))
            .flatMap(type -> type.methods().stream()).filter(method -> method.name().equals("access$000")).findFirst().orElseThrow().reason());
        // g reading a instead of b calls an accessor that forwards to another field.
        var changed = compile(source.replace(methods, "int g() { return a; } int f() { return a + b; }"), "accessors-changed", "8");
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcomes(MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, changed)).get("demo/Fixture$In.g()I"));
    }

    @Test void aDupOfAJustLoadedLocalIsThatLoadAgain() throws Exception {
        // javac writes this.n += 1 as aload_0; dup; getfield and this.n = this.n + 1 as aload_0; aload_0; getfield.
        String source = "package demo; public class Fixture { int n; int m; void f() { this.n += 1; } }";
        var compound = compile(source, "dup-compound").get("demo/Fixture");
        var spelled = compile(source.replace("this.n += 1;", "this.n = this.n + 1;"), "dup-spelled").get("demo/Fixture");
        var other = compile(source.replace("this.n += 1;", "this.n = this.m + 1;"), "dup-other").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(compound, spelled, "f()V"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(compound, other, "f()V"));
    }

    @Test void aTestOfAZeroOrOneValueWhoseBranchesReturnItReturnsIt() throws Exception {
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture {"
            + " static boolean f(String s) { if (!s.isEmpty()) return false; return true; }"
            + " static boolean g(Object o) { if (o instanceof String) return true; return false; }"
            + " static int h(String s) { if (s.length() != 0) return 1; return 0; } }";
        var original = compile(base, "boolean").get("demo/Fixture");
        var direct = compile(base.replace("if (!s.isEmpty()) return false; return true;", "return s.isEmpty();")
            .replace("if (o instanceof String) return true; return false;", "return o instanceof String;")
            .replace("if (s.length() != 0) return 1; return 0;", "return s.length();"), "boolean-direct").get("demo/Fixture");
        var negated = compile(base.replace("if (!s.isEmpty()) return false; return true;", "return !s.isEmpty();"), "boolean-negated").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, direct, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Z"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, direct, "g(Ljava/lang/Object;)Z"));
        // length() can be any int, so returning it is not returning the test's 0 or 1.
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, direct, "h(Ljava/lang/String;)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, negated, "f(Ljava/lang/String;)Z"));
    }

    @Test void aJumpOverAGotoIsTheNegatedJumpAndASharedTailEqualsItsCopies() {
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(branches(0), branches(1)));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, single(branches(0), branches(2)));
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(tails(false, 1), tails(true, 1)));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, single(tails(false, 1), tails(true, 2)));
    }

    /** static void f(boolean c) { if (c) a(); b(); } as javac writes it (0), with the test over a goto (1), or with the opposite test over a goto (2). */
    static byte[] branches(int shape) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(Z)V", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        var skip = new Label(); var call = new Label();
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, 0);
        if (shape == 0) method.visitJumpInsn(Opcodes.IFEQ, skip);
        else { method.visitJumpInsn(shape == 1 ? Opcodes.IFNE : Opcodes.IFEQ, call); method.visitJumpInsn(Opcodes.GOTO, skip); method.visitLabel(call); }
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "a", "()V", false);
        method.visitLabel(skip);
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "b", "()V", false);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    /** static int f(int x) { if (x > 0) { a(); return 1; } b(); return k; } with each return written out, or reaching one shared tail. */
    static byte[] tails(boolean shared, int k) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(I)I", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        var other = new Label(); var tail = new Label();
        method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ILOAD, 0); method.visitJumpInsn(Opcodes.IFLE, other);
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "a", "()V", false);
        if (shared) method.visitJumpInsn(Opcodes.GOTO, tail); else { method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_1); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN); }
        method.visitLabel(other);
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "b", "()V", false);
        if (!shared || k != 1) { method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_0 + k); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN); }
        if (shared) { method.visitLabel(tail); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.ICONST_1); method.visitInsn(Opcodes.IRETURN); }
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void bodiesWithHandlersAreComparedUnderTheirHandlers() throws Exception {
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture { static void a() {}"
            + " static int t(int x) { try { a(); return x; } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; } } }";
        String body = "try { a(); return x; } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; }";
        var original = compile(base, "handlers").get("demo/Fixture");
        var moved = compile(base.replace(body, "try { a(); } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; } return x;"), "handlers-moved").get("demo/Fixture");
        var otherType = compile(base.replace("RuntimeException", "IllegalStateException"), "handlers-type").get("demo/Fixture");
        var outside = compile(base.replace(body, "a(); try { x = x + 0; } catch (RuntimeException e) { return 0; } return x;"), "handlers-outside").get("demo/Fixture");
        var otherHandler = compile(base.replace("return 0;", "return 1;"), "handlers-handler").get("demo/Fixture");
        // Only the call can throw, and it is caught the same way in both.
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, moved, "t(I)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, otherType, "t(I)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, outside, "t(I)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, otherHandler, "t(I)I"));
    }

    @Test void aSlotReusedByVariablesOfDisjointScopesHoldsTwoVariables() throws Exception {
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture { static int a() { return 1; } static int b() { return 2; } static void use(int v) {}"
            + " static void f() { { int i = a(); use(i); use(i); } { int j = b(); use(j); use(j); } } }";
        String body = "{ int i = a(); use(i); use(i); } { int j = b(); use(j); use(j); }";
        var shared = compile(base, "webs-shared").get("demo/Fixture"); // javac gives j the slot i had
        var separate = compile(base.replace(body, "int i = a(); use(i); use(i); int j = b(); use(j); use(j);"), "webs-separate").get("demo/Fixture");
        var crossed = compile(base.replace(body, "int i = a(); use(i); use(i); int j = b(); use(j); use(i);"), "webs-crossed").get("demo/Fixture");
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(shared, separate, "f()V"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(shared, crossed, "f()V"));
    }

    @Test void aLocalStoredAndAtOnceLoadedTwiceIsADupAndAStoreNeverLoadedIsDead() throws Exception {
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, single(twice(0), twice(1)));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, single(twice(0), twice(2)));
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture { static int f(int x) { int y = 0; y = x + 1; return y; }"
            + " static int g(String s) { String t = s.trim(); return 1; } }";
        var original = compile(base, "dead").get("demo/Fixture");
        var direct = compile(base.replace("int y = 0; y = x + 1; return y;", "return x + 1;")
            .replace("String t = s.trim(); return 1;", "s.trim(); return 1;"), "dead-direct").get("demo/Fixture");
        var read = compile(base.replace("int y = 0; y = x + 1; return y;", "int y = 0; if (x > 0) y = x + 1; return y;"), "dead-read").get("demo/Fixture");
        var dropped = compile(base.replace("String t = s.trim(); return 1;", "return 1;"), "dead-dropped").get("demo/Fixture");
        // y = 0 is overwritten before it is read; t is never read, but trim() still runs.
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, direct, "f(I)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcome(original, direct, "g(Ljava/lang/String;)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, read, "f(I)I"));
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcome(original, dropped, "g(Ljava/lang/String;)I"));
    }

    /** static void f(Object p) { pair(v(), v()'s value again) } with a dup (0), a local stored and loaded twice (1), or that local and then p (2). */
    static byte[] twice(int shape) {
        var writer = new ClassWriter(ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(Opcodes.V17, Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, "G", null, "java/lang/Object", null);
        var method = writer.visitMethod(Opcodes.ACC_STATIC, "f", "(Ljava/lang/Object;)V", null, null);
        method.visitCode();
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "v", "()Ljava/lang/Object;", false);
        if (shape == 0) method.visitInsn(Opcodes.DUP);
        else { method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ASTORE, 1); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, 1); method.visitVarInsn(Opcodes.ALOAD, shape == 1 ? 1 : 0); }
        method.visitMethodInsn(Opcodes.INVOKESTATIC, "G", "pair", "(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/Object;)V", false);
        method.visitInsn(Opcodes.RETURN);
        method.visitMaxs(0, 0); method.visitEnd(); writer.visitEnd();
        return writer.toByteArray();
    }

    @Test void capturedVariableFieldsMatchWhateverTheVariablesAreCalled() throws Exception {
        // An anonymous class keeps each captured local in a synthetic field named after it (val$name).
        String base = "package demo; public class Fixture { static Runnable r(String name, String other) {"
            + " return new Runnable() { public void run() { System.out.println(name); System.out.println(other); } }; } }";
        var original = compile(base, "captured");
        var renamed = compile(base.replace("name", "label").replace("other", "second"), "captured-renamed");
        var outcomes = outcomes(MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, renamed));
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcomes.get("demo/Fixture$1.run()V"), outcomes.toString());
        assertEquals(Outcome.EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, outcomes.get("demo/Fixture$1.<init>(Ljava/lang/String;Ljava/lang/String;)V"));
        // Printing one captured value twice captures one variable: nothing to pair the other field with.
        var one = compile(base.replace("System.out.println(other);", "System.out.println(name);"), "captured-one");
        assertEquals(Outcome.DIFFERENT, outcomes(MethodRoundTrip.compare(original, one)).get("demo/Fixture$1.run()V"));
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/MethodSpliceTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;
import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Per-method composition (Phase 2BD) on small decompiler-shaped files. Sources and classes are compiled, never run. */
class MethodSpliceTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    record Original(Path jar, List<ClassInfo> infos) {}

    /** javac's classes for the original sources, as the job's normalized class JAR, with their structural records. */
    Original original(Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path sources = write("original-src", files), classes = dir.resolve("original-classes");
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        for (var name : files.keySet()) args.add(sources.resolve(name).toString());
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar"); var infos = new ArrayList<ClassInfo>();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var paths = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".class")).sorted().toList()) {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path);
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/'))); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry();
                infos.add(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes));
            }
        }
        return new Original(jar, infos);
    }
    Path write(String name, Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path root = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve(name));
        for (var file : files.entrySet()) {
            Path path = root.resolve(file.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
        }
        return root;
    }

    @Test void takesAFailingBodyFromAnotherEngineWhenItRecompilesInPlaceToTheOriginalBytes() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Calc.java",
            "package p; public class Calc { private int base = 3; public int f(int n) { return n * base + 1; } public int g(int x) { return x - base; } }"));
        // Engine a misses a name in f; engine b gets f right (under another parameter name) but breaks g, so neither
        // whole file compiles and a whole-file swap cannot help.
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Calc {\n   private int base = 3;\n\n"
            + "   public int f(int n) {\n      return n * bse + 1;\n   }\n\n   public int g(int x) {\n      return x - base;\n   }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p;\npublic class Calc {\n    private int base = 3;\n"
            + "    public int f(int value) { return value * this.base + 1; }\n    public int g(int x) { return x - undefined; }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().propose(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar(),
            Map.of("a", a, "b", b));
        assertEquals(List.of(new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Calc.java", "p/Calc", "f", "(I)I", "b", "IDENTICAL", 6, 8, List.of())), proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        assertEquals(List.of(), proposal.unspliced());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Calc.java"));
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("public int f(int value) { return value * this.base + 1; }"), spliced);
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("return x - base;"), spliced);

        // The mix with the spliced file compiles with every signature, and every body recompiles to the original.
        Path merged = write("merged", Map.of("p/Calc.java", spliced));
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(merged, dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertTrue(verified.complete(), verified.toString());
        assertEquals(0, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
    }

    @Test void writesATypeNameCanonicallyWhenTheFileDoesNotImportIt() throws Exception {
        // Like Guava's TreeRangeSet: Vineflower imports java.util.Map.Entry, CFR imports java.util.Map and writes Map.Entry.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Pairs.java", "package p; import java.util.Map; public class Pairs {\n"
            + " public static int first(Map<String, Integer> map) { Map.Entry<String, Integer> e = map.entrySet().iterator().next(); return e.getValue(); }\n}\n"));
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Pairs.java", "package p;\n\nimport java.util.Map.Entry;\n\npublic class Pairs {\n"
            + "   public static int first(java.util.Map<String, Integer> map) {\n      Entry<String, Integer> e = map.entrySet().iterator().nxt();\n"
            + "      return e.getValue();\n   }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Pairs.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.Map;\npublic class Pairs {\n"
            + "    public static int first(Map<String, Integer> map) {\n        Map.Entry<String, Integer> e = map.entrySet().iterator().next();\n"
            + "        return e.getValue();\n    }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().propose(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar(),
            Map.of("a", a, "b", b));
        assertEquals(List.of(new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Pairs.java", "p/Pairs", "first", "(Ljava/util/Map;)I", "b", "IDENTICAL", 6, 9,
            List.of("java.util.Map"))), proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Pairs.java"));
        // The file's imports are untouched; only the copied body names the type canonically.
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("import java.util.Map.Entry;") && !spliced.contains("import java.util.Map;"), spliced);
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("java.util.Map.Entry<String, Integer> e = map.entrySet().iterator().next();"), spliced);
    }

    @Test void aConstructorWhoseOwnThisCallFailsIsStubbedWithNeutralArgumentsAndReplaced() throws Exception {
        // Like Guava's AbstractSortedMultiset(): the error is inside this(...), which the stub of the other bodies must keep.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Sized.java", "package p; public class Sized { final int size;\n"
            + " public Sized() { this(16); }\n public Sized(int size) { this.size = size; }\n}\n"));
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Sized.java", "package p;\npublic class Sized {\n   final int size;\n"
            + "   public Sized() {\n      this(sixteen());\n   }\n   public Sized(int size) {\n      this.size = size;\n   }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Sized.java", "package p;\npublic class Sized {\n    final int size;\n"
            + "    public Sized() { this(16); }\n    public Sized(int n) { this.size = m; }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().propose(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar(),
            Map.of("a", a, "b", b));
        assertEquals(List.of(new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Sized.java", "p/Sized", "<init>", "()V", "b", "IDENTICAL", 4, 6, List.of())),
            proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Sized.java")).contains("public Sized() { this(16); }"));
    }

    @Test void inAFileThatCompilesADifferentBodyIsReplacedOnlyWhenTheOtherEngineRecompilesToTheOriginal() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p; public class Calc {\n public int f(int n) { return n * 3 + 1; }\n"
            + " public int g(int x) { int y = x * 2; return y + x; }\n public int h(int x) { return x - 1; }\n}\n"));
        // Both engines compile. Engine a writes f and h with operands swapped (javac then emits other bytecode); engine b
        // gets f right under another parameter name but writes h its own different way.
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Calc {\n   public int f(int n) {\n      return 1 + n * 3;\n   }\n\n"
            + "   public int g(int x) {\n      int y = x * 2;\n      return y + x;\n   }\n\n   public int h(int x) {\n      return -1 + x;\n   }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p;\npublic class Calc {\n    public int f(int value) { return value * 3 + 1; }\n"
            + "    public int g(int x) { return x * 2 + x; }\n    public int h(int x) { return x + -1; }\n}\n"));
        var measured = new CompilerVerifier().verify(a, dir.resolve("measure"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, measured.status(), measured.toString());
        assertEquals(2, measured.roundTripDifferent(), measured.toString());
        // The targets are what the mix measured, plus g, which is identical in place and must be left alone.
        var targets = new ArrayList<>(measured.roundTrip());
        targets.add(new ClassRoundTrip("p/Calc", List.of(new MethodRoundTrip.MethodResult("g", "(I)I", MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.DIFFERENT, ""))));
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a, "b", b), targets);
        assertEquals(List.of(new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Calc.java", "p/Calc", "f", "(I)I", "b", "IDENTICAL", 4, 6, List.of(),
            MethodSplice.ROUND_TRIP_DIFFERENT, "DIFFERENT", List.of(), List.of())), proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        var reasons = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        proposal.unspliced().forEach(item -> reasons.put(item.method(), item.reason()));
        assertEquals(Map.of("g(I)I", "not-different-in-place", "h(I)I", "b:round-trip-different"), reasons, proposal.toString());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Calc.java"));
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("public int f(int value) { return value * 3 + 1; }") && spliced.contains("return -1 + x;"), spliced);

        // In the mix, f is now identical and h is still the only DIFFERENT body.
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(write("merged", Map.of("p/Calc.java", spliced)), dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(),
            Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertTrue(verified.complete(), verified.toString());
        assertEquals(1, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
        // Nothing DIFFERENT, nothing to do (and no worker started).
        var nothing = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("none"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a, "b", b), verified.roundTrip().stream().filter(type -> type.different() == 0).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of(), nothing.splices());
        assertFalse(Files.exists(dir.resolve("none")));
    }

    @Test void aDifferentLambdaOrAnonymousClassMethodIsRecoveredThroughItsEnclosingMethod() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Tasks.java", "package p; public class Tasks {\n"
            + " public Runnable task() { return new Runnable() { public void run() { int x = 5; System.out.println(x * 3 + 1); } }; }\n"
            + " public Runnable later() { return () -> { int x = 5; System.out.println(x * 3 + 1); }; }\n}\n"));
        // Engine a swaps the operands inside the anonymous class and the lambda: Tasks$1.run and lambda$later$0 are
        // DIFFERENT while task() and later() themselves are identical. Engine b gets both right.
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Tasks.java", "package p;\n\npublic class Tasks {\n   public Runnable task() {\n      return new Runnable() {\n"
            + "         public void run() {\n            int x = 5;\n            System.out.println(1 + x * 3);\n         }\n      };\n   }\n\n"
            + "   public Runnable later() {\n      return () -> {\n         int x = 5;\n         System.out.println(1 + x * 3);\n      };\n   }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Tasks.java", "package p;\npublic class Tasks {\n"
            + "    public Runnable task() { return new Runnable() { public void run() { int x = 5; System.out.println(x * 3 + 1); } }; }\n"
            + "    public Runnable later() { return () -> { int x = 5; System.out.println(x * 3 + 1); }; }\n}\n"));
        var measured = new CompilerVerifier().verify(a, dir.resolve("measure"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(2, measured.roundTripDifferent(), measured.toString());
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a, "b", b), measured.roundTrip());
        assertEquals(List.of(
            new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Tasks.java", "p/Tasks", "task", "()Ljava/lang/Runnable;", "b", "IDENTICAL", 4, 11, List.of(),
                MethodSplice.ROUND_TRIP_DIFFERENT, "IDENTICAL", List.of("p/Tasks$1.run()V"), List.of()),
            new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Tasks.java", "p/Tasks", "later", "()Ljava/lang/Runnable;", "b", "IDENTICAL", 13, 18, List.of(),
                MethodSplice.ROUND_TRIP_DIFFERENT, "IDENTICAL", List.of("p/Tasks.lambda$later$0()V"), List.of())), proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(write("merged", Map.of("p/Tasks.java", Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Tasks.java")))),
            dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(0, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
    }

    @Test void aCopiedBodyThatFailsOnlyByARepairableErrorIsRepairedInPlace() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Names.java", "package p; import java.util.*; public class Names {\n"
            + " public int count() { List<String> l = new ArrayList<String>(); l.add(\"x\"); return l.size(); }\n"
            + " public int pick(int x) { switch (x) { case 1: return 10; default: return 20; } }\n}\n"));
```
