```java
        // javac rejects: an argument cast up to Object for a List<String>, and an unreachable break after a return.
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Names.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class Names {\n"
            + "  public int count() { List<String> l = new ArrayList<String>(); l.add(\"x\"); return l.size() + 0; }\n"
            + "  public int pick(int x) { return x == 1 ? 10 : 20; }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Names.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class Names {\n"
            + "  public int count() { List<String> l = new ArrayList<String>(); l.add((Object)\"x\"); return l.size(); }\n"
            + "  public int pick(int x) { switch (x) { case 1: return 10; break; default: return 20; } }\n}\n"));
        var measured = new CompilerVerifier().verify(a, dir.resolve("measure"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(2, measured.roundTripDifferent(), measured.toString());
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a, "b", b), measured.roundTrip());
        assertEquals(List.of(
            new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Names.java", "p/Names", "count", "()I", "b", "IDENTICAL", 4, 4, List.of(),
                MethodSplice.ROUND_TRIP_DIFFERENT, "DIFFERENT", List.of(), List.of("drop-object-cast")),
            new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Names.java", "p/Names", "pick", "(I)I", "b", "IDENTICAL", 5, 5, List.of(),
                MethodSplice.ROUND_TRIP_DIFFERENT, "DIFFERENT", List.of(), List.of("drop-unreachable-jump"))), proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Names.java"));
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("l.add(\"x\"); return l.size(); }") && spliced.contains("case 1: return 10;  default: return 20;"), spliced);
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(write("merged", Map.of("p/Names.java", spliced)), dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(),
            Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertTrue(verified.complete(), verified.toString());
        assertEquals(0, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
    }

    /** method name to "engine outcome before rules" for each splice, for tests that need not pin lines. */
    private static Map<String,String> summary(MethodSplice.Proposal proposal) {
        var result = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        for (var splice : proposal.splices())
            result.put(splice.method(), splice.engine() + " " + splice.roundTrip() + " " + splice.before() + " " + String.join(",", splice.bodyRepairs()));
        return result;
    }

    @Test void theMethodsOwnBodyLosesTheCastsJavacNineAddsAndItsRedundantCasts() throws Exception {
        // Like CFR 0.152, built by a javac older than 9: a generic value passed to a parameter declared as a type variable
        // was cast to the parameter's erasure only. javac 21 casts it to the instantiated type (JDK-8058199); the original
        // here is written in the forms javac 21 compiles to the older bytecode.
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Gen.java", "package p; import java.util.*; public class Gen {\n"
            + " static class Pair<A, B> { static <A, B> Pair<A, B> make(A a, B b) { return new Pair<A, B>(); } }\n"
            + " static class Box<T> { Box(T t) {} }\n"
            + " public void add(Set<String> s, List<String> l) { ((Set) s).add(l.get(0)); }\n"
            + " public void put(Map<String, Integer> m, Map.Entry<String, Integer> e) { ((Map) m).put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()); }\n"
            + " public Pair<Integer, String> pair(List<String> l) { return (Pair) Pair.make(1, (Object) l.get(0)); }\n"
            + " public Box<String> box(List<String> l) { return new Box(l.get(0)); }\n"
            + " public Object first(List<String> l) { Object o = l.get(0); return o; }\n"
            + " public int size(Set<String> s, List<String> l) { s.add(l.get(0)); return s.size(); }\n}\n"));
        // What a decompiler prints: plain generic calls, a redundant cast, and in size() a body DIFFERENT for another
        // reason whose cast the original has too (it must stay).
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Gen.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class Gen {\n"
            + "   static class Pair<A, B> {\n      static <A, B> Pair<A, B> make(A a, B b) {\n         return new Pair<A, B>();\n      }\n   }\n"
            + "   static class Box<T> {\n      Box(T t) {\n      }\n   }\n"
            + "   public void add(Set<String> s, List<String> l) {\n      s.add(l.get(0));\n   }\n"
            + "   public void put(Map<String, Integer> m, Map.Entry<String, Integer> e) {\n      m.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());\n   }\n"
            + "   public Pair<Integer, String> pair(List<String> l) {\n      return Pair.make(1, l.get(0));\n   }\n"
            + "   public Box<String> box(List<String> l) {\n      return new Box<>(l.get(0));\n   }\n"
            + "   public Object first(List<String> l) {\n      Object o = (String)l.get(0);\n      return o;\n   }\n"
            + "   public int size(Set<String> s, List<String> l) {\n      s.add(l.get(0));\n      return s.size() + 0;\n   }\n}\n"));
        var measured = new CompilerVerifier().verify(a, dir.resolve("measure"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, measured.status(), measured.toString());
        assertEquals(6, measured.roundTripDifferent(), measured.toString());
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a), measured.roundTrip());
        // Engine a's file is the mix itself, so its own bodies are named after it.
        assertEquals(Map.of("add", "a IDENTICAL DIFFERENT raw-receiver", "put", "a IDENTICAL DIFFERENT raw-receiver",
            "pair", "a IDENTICAL DIFFERENT erased-argument", "box", "a IDENTICAL DIFFERENT raw-creation",
            "first", "a IDENTICAL DIFFERENT drop-redundant-cast"), summary(proposal), proposal.toString());
        assertEquals(List.of("size(Ljava/util/Set;Ljava/util/List;)I"), proposal.unspliced().stream().map(MethodSplice.Unspliced::method).toList(),
            proposal.toString());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Gen.java"));
        for (var expected : List.of("((java.util.Set) s).add(l.get(0));", "((java.util.Map) m).put(e.getKey(), e.getValue());",
            "return ((p.Gen.Pair) Pair.make(1, ((java.lang.Object) l.get(0))));", "return new Box(l.get(0));", "Object o = l.get(0);",
            "s.add(l.get(0));\n      return s.size() + 0;"))
            assertTrue(spliced.contains(expected), expected + " in " + spliced);
        var verified = new CompilerVerifier().verify(write("merged", Map.of("p/Gen.java", spliced)), dir.resolve("verify"), original.infos(),
            Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertTrue(verified.complete(), verified.toString());
        assertEquals(1, verified.roundTripDifferent(), verified.toString());
    }

    @Test void anotherEnginesBodyRefusedByTheRoundTripIsTriedAgainWithoutTheCastsJavacNineAdds() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of("p/Sets.java", "package p; import java.util.*; public class Sets {\n"
            + " public void add(Set<String> s, List<String> l) { ((Set) s).add(l.get(0)); }\n}\n"));
        // Engine a (the mix) reads another element; engine b is right but for javac 21's cast, and also needs a repair.
        Path a = write("a", Map.of("p/Sets.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class Sets {\n"
            + "  public void add(Set<String> s, List<String> l) { ((Set) s).add(l.get(1)); }\n}\n"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of("p/Sets.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\npublic class Sets {\n"
            + "  public void add(Set<String> s, List<String> l) { s.add((Object)l.get(0)); }\n}\n"));
        var measured = new CompilerVerifier().verify(a, dir.resolve("measure"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar());
        assertEquals(1, measured.roundTripDifferent(), measured.toString());
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().proposeForDifferent(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            original.jar(), Map.of("a", a, "b", b), measured.roundTrip());
        assertEquals(Map.of("add", "b IDENTICAL DIFFERENT drop-object-cast,raw-receiver"), summary(proposal), proposal.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Sets.java")).contains("{ ((java.util.Set) s).add(l.get(0)); }"));
    }

    @Test void refusesBodiesWhoseSyntheticsAnonymousClassesOrBytecodeDoNotMatch() throws Exception {
        var original = original(Map.of(
            "p/Mixed.java", "package p; import java.util.Date; public class Mixed {\n"
                + " public boolean m1() { Date d = null; return d == null; }\n"
                + " public int m2(int x) { return x + 1; }\n"
                + " public Runnable m3() { return new Runnable() { public void run() {} }; }\n"
                + " public int m4(int x) { return x * 2; }\n}\n",
            "p/Field.java", "package p; public class Field { int f = 1; public int k() { return f; } }"));
        Path a = write("a", Map.of(
            "p/Mixed.java", "package p; import java.sql.Date; public class Mixed {\n"
                + " public boolean m1() { Date d = null; return d == nul; }\n"
                + " public int m2(int x) { return x + one; }\n"
                + " public Runnable m3() { return new Runnable() { public void run() { missing(); } }; }\n"
                + " public int m4(int x) { return x * two; }\n}\n",
            "p/Field.java", "package p; public class Field { int f = \"1\"; public int k() { return f; } }"));
        Path b = write("b", Map.of(
            "p/Mixed.java", "package p; import java.util.Date; public class Mixed {\n"
                + " public boolean m1() { Date d = null; return d == null; }\n"
                + " public int m2(int x) { return x + 2; }\n"
                + " public Runnable m3() { return () -> {}; }\n"
                + " public int m4(int x) { return access$000(x); }\n"
                + " static int access$000(int x) { return x * 2; }\n}\n",
            "p/Field.java", "package p; public class Field { int f = 1; public int k() { return this.f; } }"));
        var proposal = new MethodSplice().propose(a, dir.resolve("splice"), original.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), original.jar(),
            Map.of("a", a, "b", b));
        // Same bytecode either way, but `Date` would mean java.sql.Date in this file: the import is not compatible, so the
        // copied body names java.util.Date canonically, and every name then resolves as in engine b's own file.
        assertEquals(List.of(new MethodSplice.Splice("p/Mixed.java", "p/Mixed", "m1", "()Z", "b", "IDENTICAL", 2, 2, List.of("java.util.Date"))),
            proposal.splices(), proposal.toString());
        String spliced = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Mixed.java"));
        assertTrue(spliced.contains("import java.sql.Date;") && spliced.contains("{ java.util.Date d = null; return d == null; }"), spliced);
        var reasons = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        proposal.unspliced().forEach(item -> reasons.put(item.file() + " " + item.method(), item.reason()));
        assertEquals(4, reasons.size(), reasons.toString());
        assertEquals("b:round-trip-different", reasons.get("p/Mixed.java m2(I)I"), reasons.toString());
        assertEquals("b:anonymous-or-local-classes-differ", reasons.get("p/Mixed.java m3()Ljava/lang/Runnable;"), reasons.toString());
        assertEquals("b:synthetic-name:access$000", reasons.get("p/Mixed.java m4(I)I"), reasons.toString());
        // A field initializer is not a method body: the file is left whole.
        assertEquals("errors-outside-method-bodies", reasons.get("p/Field.java -"), reasons.toString());
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/PartialRoundTripTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ClassInspector;
import dev.classrevive.model.ClassInfo;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class PartialRoundTripTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;

    @Test void measuresTheFilesThatCompileAgainstTheOriginalClassesAndLeavesTheOthersOut() throws Exception {
        // Originals: Calc and its user Report. The candidate has a correct Calc, a Report that does not compile, and a
        // Helper that only compiles once Report's original stands in for the broken source.
        var originals = original(Map.of(
            "p/Calc.java", "package p; public class Calc { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; } }",
            "p/Report.java", "package p; public class Report { public static String show(int x) { return \"v\" + new Calc().twice(x); } }",
            "p/Helper.java", "package p; public class Helper { public String run() { return Report.show(3); } }"));
        Path candidate = write("candidate", Map.of(
            "p/Calc.java", "package p;\npublic class Calc {\n   public int twice(int x) {\n      return x * 2;\n   }\n}\n",
            "p/Report.java", "package p;\npublic class Report {\n   public static String show(int x) {\n      return \"v\" + new Calc().twice(missing);\n   }\n}\n",
            "p/Helper.java", "package p;\npublic class Helper {\n   public String run() {\n      return Report.show(3);\n   }\n}\n"));
        var whole = new CompilerVerifier().verify(candidate, dir.resolve("whole"), originals.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), originals.jar());
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, whole.status());

        var result = new PartialRoundTrip().measure(candidate, dir.resolve("per-file"), originals.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), originals.jar());
        assertTrue(result.compiled());
        assertEquals(3, result.files()); assertEquals(2, result.compiledFiles()); assertEquals(2, result.rounds());
        assertEquals(List.of("p/Calc", "p/Helper"), result.classes().stream().map(ClassRoundTrip::className).toList());
        // Each class has a constructor and one method, both recompiled to the original instructions.
        assertEquals(4, result.identical()); assertEquals(0, result.different());
        assertEquals("1\tp/Report.java\n", Files.readString(dir.resolve("per-file/excluded.tsv")));
    }

    @Test void leavesOutEveryFileWithAFlowErrorInOneRound() throws Exception {
        // javac normally stops flow analysis after the first class with an error; both files must leave in round 1.
        var originals = original(Map.of(
            "p/A.java", "package p; public class A { public int f(int x) { if (x > 0) return 1; return 0; } }",
            "p/B.java", "package p; public class B { public int g(int x) { if (x > 0) return 2; return 0; } }",
            "p/C.java", "package p; public class C { public int h() { return new A().f(1) + new B().g(1); } }"));
        Path candidate = write("candidate", Map.of(
            "p/A.java", "package p; public class A { public int f(int x) { if (x > 0) return 1; } }",
            "p/B.java", "package p; public class B { public int g(int x) { if (x > 0) return 2; } }",
            "p/C.java", "package p; public class C { public int h() { return new A().f(1) + new B().g(1); } }"));
        var result = new PartialRoundTrip().measure(candidate, dir.resolve("per-file"), originals.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), originals.jar());
        assertTrue(result.compiled());
        assertEquals(1, result.compiledFiles()); assertEquals(2, result.rounds());
        assertEquals("1\tp/A.java\n1\tp/B.java\n", Files.readString(dir.resolve("per-file/excluded.tsv")));
    }

    @Test void reportsNothingCompiledWhenEveryFileFails() throws Exception {
        var originals = original(Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p; public class Calc { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; } }"));
        Path candidate = write("candidate", Map.of("p/Calc.java", "package p; public class Calc { public int twice(int x) { return y * 2; } }"));
        var result = new PartialRoundTrip().measure(candidate, dir.resolve("per-file"), originals.infos(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), originals.jar());
        assertFalse(result.compiled());
        assertEquals(0, result.compiledFiles()); assertEquals(List.of(), result.classes());
    }

    record Original(Path jar, List<ClassInfo> infos) {}

    Original original(Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path sources = write("original-src", files), classes = dir.resolve("original-classes");
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        for (var name : files.keySet()) args.add(sources.resolve(name).toString());
        assertEquals(0, javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar"); var infos = new ArrayList<ClassInfo>();
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar)); var paths = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(path -> path.toString().endsWith(".class")).sorted().toList()) {
                byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(path);
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/'))); zip.write(bytes); zip.closeEntry();
                infos.add(new ClassInspector().inspect(bytes));
            }
        }
        return new Original(jar, infos);
    }

    Path write(String name, Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path root = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve(name));
        for (var file : files.entrySet()) {
            Path path = root.resolve(file.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
        }
        return root;
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/PlaceholderTypesTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase 2CL: JADX's placeholder type {@code ??}, shaped like ZKM-obfuscated classes. Sources are only compiled. */
class PlaceholderTypesTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    static final List<ClassInfo> ORIGINALS = List.of(new ClassInfo("p/G", "java/lang/Object", 52, 0, 1, List.of(), List.of(),
        List.of(new MemberInfo("<init>", "()V", 1))));
    static final String G = """
        package p;
        /* JADX WARN: Type inference failed for: r0v9, types: [java.lang.RuntimeException, java.lang.Throwable] */
        public class G {
            static boolean B() { return false; }
            static java.util.List<String> names() { return new java.util.ArrayList<>(); }
            void flag() {
                ?? B = B();
                if (B) { return; }
            }
            void reused() {
                ?? B = new int[1];
                B = new RuntimeException();
            }
            int count() {
                ?? names = names();
                ?? S = "ok";
                String text = "?? X = 1;";
                /* 0x006c: PHI (r0v41 ??) = (r0v54 ??) */
                return names.size() + S.length() + text.length();
            }
            double bits() {
                double d;
                d = 4613937818241073152;
                long l = 4613937818241073152;
                return d + l + 2147483648.5 + 0x7fffffffffffL;
            }
            int loop(java.util.List<String> list) {
                int n = 0;
                for (?? s : list) n += s.length();
                return n;
            }
        }
        """;

    @Test void placeholdersGetTheirInitializersTypeOrObjectAndOversizedLiteralsTheirTargetsForm() throws Exception {
        Path sources = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("jadx/p"));
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("G.java"), G);
        assertTrue(PlaceholderTypes.present(G));
        assertFalse(PlaceholderTypes.present("class A { String s = \"?? X = 1;\"; /* ?? y; */ }"));
        var result = new PlaceholderTypes().type(dir.resolve("jadx"), dir.resolve("work"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(7, result.sites().size(), result.toString());
        var written = new TreeMap<Long,String>();
        for (var site : result.sites()) written.put(site.line(), site.written() + " " + site.rule());
        assertEquals(Map.of(7L, "boolean initializer", 11L, "Object object", 15L, "java.util.List<java.lang.String> initializer",
            16L, "java.lang.String initializer", 23L, "3.0 double-bits", 24L, "L long-literal", 29L, "java.lang.String initializer"), written);
        String typed = Files.readString(result.files().get("p/G.java"));
        assertTrue(typed.contains("boolean /* ?? */ B = B();"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("Object /* ?? */ B = new int[1];"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("String text = \"?? X = 1;\";"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("PHI (r0v41 ??) = (r0v54 ??)"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("d = 3.0;"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("long l = 4613937818241073152L;"), typed);
        assertTrue(typed.contains("for (java.lang.String /* ?? */ s : list)"), typed);
        assertTrue(PlaceholderTypes.present("class A { double d = 4613937818241073152; }"));
        assertFalse(PlaceholderTypes.present("class A { long a = 4613937818241073152L; int b = -2147483648; double c = 1.2345678901; }"));
        // The typed file compiles under the original release (Java 8), where `var` would not.
        Files.writeString(sources.resolve("G.java"), typed);
        var verification = new CompilerVerifier().verify(dir.resolve("jadx"), dir.resolve("check"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, verification.status(), verification.toString());
    }
}
```

`modules/verification/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/verification/SourceRepairTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.verification;

import dev.classrevive.model.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Minimal decompiler-shaped generic errors, one per repair rule. Sources are only compiled, never run. */
class SourceRepairTest {
    @TempDir Path dir;
    static final List<ClassInfo> ORIGINALS = List.of(new ClassInfo("p/Box", "java/lang/Object", 52, 0, 0x401, List.of(), List.of(),
        List.of(new MemberInfo("<init>", "()V", 1))));
    static final Map<String,String> COMMON = Map.of(
        "p/Box.java", "package p; public abstract class Box<T> { public abstract T get(); }",
        "p/IntBox.java", "package p; public final class IntBox extends Box<Integer> { public Integer get() { return 1; } }",
        "p/Factory.java", "package p; public interface Factory { <T> Box<T> create(Class<T> type); }",
        "p/Holder.java", "package p; public final class Holder<E> { public Holder(Box<? extends java.util.List<E>> box) {} }");

    Path sources(String name, Map<String,String> files) throws IOException {
        Path root = Files.createDirectory(dir.resolve(name));
        var all = new TreeMap<>(COMMON); all.putAll(files);
        for (var file : all.entrySet()) {
            Path path = root.resolve(file.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(path.getParent());
            Files.writeString(path, file.getValue());
        }
        return root;
    }
    /** The candidate with the proposal's repaired files on top, as selection would assemble it. */
    Path apply(Path sources, SourceRepair.Proposal proposal) throws IOException {
        Path merged = dir.resolve(sources.getFileName() + "-merged");
        try (var paths = Files.walk(sources)) {
            for (var path : paths.filter(Files::isRegularFile).toList()) {
                String name = sources.relativize(path).toString().replace('\\', '/');
                Path target = merged.resolve(name);
                Files.createDirectories(target.getParent());
                Files.copy(proposal.files().getOrDefault(name, path), target);
            }
        }
        return merged;
    }
    VerificationResult compile(Path sources, String name) throws IOException {
        return new CompilerVerifier().verify(sources, dir.resolve(name), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60));
    }

    @Test void guardsAnInitializerThatCannotCompleteNormallyWithoutChangingItsBytecode() throws Exception {
        // All four pinned engines print javac's `static { if (true) throw ...; }` as `static { throw ...; }`.
        Path broken = sources("initializer", Map.of("p/Throwing.java",
            "package p; public class Throwing {\n  public int value() { return 42; }\n  static {\n    throw new IllegalStateException(\"never\");\n  }\n}\n"));
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of(), proposal.unrepaired());
        assertEquals(List.of("guard-initializer"), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList());
        assertEquals("compiler.err.initializer.must.be.able.to.complete.normally", proposal.edits().getFirst().code());
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Throwing.java")).contains("{ if (true) {"));
        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, compile(merged, "verify").status());

        // The repaired class compiles to the same initializer and method bodies as javac's own source form.
        Path reference = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("reference/p"));
        Files.writeString(reference.resolve("Throwing.java"),
            "package p; public class Throwing { public int value() { return 42; } static { if (true) throw new IllegalStateException(\"never\"); } }");
        Path referenceClasses = dir.resolve("reference-classes"), repairedClasses = dir.resolve("repaired-classes");
        var javac = javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler();
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", referenceClasses.toString(),
            reference.resolve("Throwing.java").toString()));
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", repairedClasses.toString(),
            merged.resolve("p/Throwing.java").toString()));
        var outcomes = MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Throwing.class")),
            Files.readAllBytes(repairedClasses.resolve("p/Throwing.class")));
        assertEquals(3, outcomes.size(), outcomes.toString());
        assertTrue(outcomes.stream().allMatch(result -> result.outcome() == MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL), outcomes.toString());
    }

    @Test void restoresTheIntSpellingOfAConstantPrintedAsABooleanLiteral() throws Exception {
        // CFR printed ASM's `readCount != 1` (iconst_1; if_icmpne) as `readCount != true`.
        String shaped = "package p; public class Counter {\n  public static int f(int n) {\n    int count = 0;\n"
            + "    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) ++count;\n    if (count != true) return -1;\n    return count;\n  }\n"
            + "  static boolean g(String s) { return s == true; }\n}\n";
        Path broken = sources("boolean-literal", Map.of("p/Counter.java", shaped));
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of("boolean-literal-as-int"), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList());
        assertEquals("true", proposal.edits().getFirst().before()); assertEquals("1", proposal.edits().getFirst().after());
        // A String compared with a boolean (javac: operator.cant.be.applied.1) is reported and never edited.
        assertTrue(proposal.unrepaired().stream().anyMatch(left -> left.line() == 8), proposal.unrepaired().toString());
        assertTrue(proposal.edits().stream().noneMatch(edit -> edit.line() == 8));

        Path fixed = sources("boolean-literal-fixed", Map.of("p/Counter.java", shaped.replace("  static boolean g(String s) { return s == true; }\n", "")));
        var single = new SourceRepair().propose(fixed, dir.resolve("repair-fixed"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        Path merged = apply(fixed, single);

    @Test void dropsOnlyUnreachableJumpStatementsAndKeepsTheBytecode() throws Exception {
        // Procyon prints a `break;` after an inner switch whose every case jumps out or throws (ASM's Frame).
        String body = "  static int f(int x, int y) {\n    outer: switch (x) {\n      case 1: {\n"
            + "        switch (y) { case 0: break outer; default: throw new AssertionError(); }\n        BREAK\n      }\n"
            + "      case 2: return 2;\n    }\n    return 0;\n  }\n";
        String shaped = "package p; public class Jumps {\n" + body.replace("BREAK", "break;")
            + "  static int g(int x) { return x;\n  }\n}\n";
        Path broken = sources("unreachable", Map.of("p/Jumps.java", shaped));
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of("drop-unreachable-jump"), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList());
        assertEquals("break;", proposal.edits().getFirst().before()); assertEquals("", proposal.edits().getFirst().after());
        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, compile(merged, "verify").status());

        Path reference = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("reference/p"));
        Files.writeString(reference.resolve("Jumps.java"), "package p; public class Jumps {\n" + body.replace("BREAK", "")
            + "  static int g(int x) { return x;\n  }\n}\n");
        Path referenceClasses = dir.resolve("reference-classes"), repairedClasses = dir.resolve("repaired-classes");
        var javac = javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler();
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", referenceClasses.toString(),
            reference.resolve("Jumps.java").toString()));
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", repairedClasses.toString(),
            merged.resolve("p/Jumps.java").toString()));
        var outcomes = MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Jumps.class")),
            Files.readAllBytes(repairedClasses.resolve("p/Jumps.class")));
        assertTrue(outcomes.stream().allMatch(result -> result.outcome() == MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL), outcomes.toString());

        // An unreachable statement with an effect is never removed.
        Path effect = sources("unreachable-effect", Map.of("p/Effect.java",
            "package p; public class Effect {\n  static int h(int x) {\n    return x;\n    x++;\n  }\n}\n"));
        var left = new SourceRepair().propose(effect, dir.resolve("repair-effect"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertTrue(left.edits().isEmpty(), left.edits().toString());
        assertTrue(left.unrepaired().stream().anyMatch(item -> item.reason().equals("not-a-jump-statement")), left.unrepaired().toString());
    }

    @Test void dropsAnUpcastToObjectThatBlocksAGenericCallButNeverABoxingCast() throws Exception {
        // CFR prints `entries.add((Object)new Entry(e))` for a List<Entry>; the original call had no cast.
        String shaped = "package p; import java.util.*; public class Entries {\n  final List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();\n"

        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);
        Path reference = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("reference/p"));
        Files.writeString(reference.resolve("Entries.java"), shaped.replace("(Object)name.trim()", "name.trim()"));

            reference.resolve("Entries.java").toString()));

        // (Object)5 boxes the int, so dropping the cast would call a different method: never edited by this rule.

    }

    @Test void castsAReceiverMethodReferenceToTheInterfaceOfItsOriginalInvokedynamic() throws Exception {
        // Ant 1.10.17's PatternSet and EchoProperties: a method reference used as a receiver, printed without its cast.
        Path reference = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("reference/p"));
        Files.writeString(reference.resolve("Refs.java"), "package p; import java.util.*; import java.util.function.*; public class Refs {"
            + " public static long nonEmpty(List<String> lines) { return lines.stream().filter(((Predicate<String>) String::isEmpty).negate()).count(); }"
            + " public static Comparator<Map.Entry<Object, Object>> byKey() {"
            + " return Comparator.comparing(((Function<Map.Entry<Object, Object>, Object>) Map.Entry::getKey).andThen(Object::toString)); } }");
        Path referenceClasses = dir.resolve("reference-classes"), repairedClasses = dir.resolve("repaired-classes");
        var javac = javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler();
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", referenceClasses.toString(),
            reference.resolve("Refs.java").toString()));
        Path jar = dir.resolve("classes.jar");
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry("p/Refs.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Refs.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        Path broken = sources("receiver", Map.of("p/Refs.java", "package p;\nimport java.util.*;\nimport java.util.function.*;\npublic class Refs {\n"
            + "  public static long nonEmpty(List<String> lines) {\n    return lines.stream().filter((String::isEmpty).negate()).count();\n  }\n"
            + "  public static Comparator<Map.Entry<Object, Object>> byKey() {\n"
            + "    return Comparator.comparing((Map.Entry::getKey).andThen(Object::toString));\n  }\n}\n"));
        // Without the original classes the interface is unknown, so nothing is proposed.
        var blind = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("blind"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of(), blind.edits(), blind.toString());
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), jar);
        assertEquals(List.of("functional-cast", "functional-cast"), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList(), proposal.toString());
        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);
        String repaired = Files.readString(merged.resolve("p/Refs.java"));
        assertTrue(repaired.contains("((java.util.function.Predicate<java.lang.String>) (String::isEmpty)).negate()"), repaired);
        assertTrue(repaired.contains("((java.util.function.Function<java.util.Map.Entry, java.lang.Object>) (Map.Entry::getKey)).andThen"), repaired);
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", repairedClasses.toString(),
            merged.resolve("p/Refs.java").toString()));
        var outcomes = MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Refs.class")),
            Files.readAllBytes(repairedClasses.resolve("p/Refs.class")));
        assertTrue(outcomes.stream().allMatch(result -> result.outcome() == MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL), outcomes.toString());
    }

    @Test void castsALambdaAndAnInvalidMethodReferenceToTheInterfacesOfTheirOriginalInvokedynamic() throws Exception {
        // Ant 1.10.17's Main (a lambda on a Map declared raw) and ProjectHelperTask (`Object::getClass` then a bound reference).
        String written = "package p; import java.util.*; import java.util.function.*; public class Props {"
            + " static void set(String key, String value) {} static void register(Class<? extends Number> type) {}"
            + " void apply(Map<String, Object> defined) { Map<String, Object> raw = new HashMap<>(defined);"
            + " raw.forEach((arg, value) -> set(arg, String.valueOf(value))); }"
            + " void each(List<Integer> numbers) { numbers.stream().map(Integer::getClass).forEach(Props::register); } }";

            reference.resolve("Props.java").toString()));

            zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry("p/Props.class")); zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Props.class"))); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        // As decompilers print them: the local declared raw, and getClass referenced through Object.
        Path broken = sources("lambda", Map.of("p/Props.java", written.replace("Map<String, Object> raw", "Map raw")
            .replace("Integer::getClass", "Object::getClass")));

        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", repairedClasses.toString(),
            merged.resolve("p/Props.java").toString()));
        var outcomes = MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/Props.class")),
            Files.readAllBytes(repairedClasses.resolve("p/Props.class")));
        assertTrue(outcomes.stream().allMatch(result -> result.outcome() == MethodRoundTrip.Outcome.IDENTICAL), outcomes.toString());
    }

    @Test void hoistsALocalClassUsedBeforeTheLoopItWasPrintedIn() throws Exception {
        // Guava 17's Types.ClassOwnership.detectJvmBehavior: Vineflower prints `class LocalClass<T> {}` inside the loop that
        // names `LocalClass.class`, after the statement that creates an anonymous subclass of it.
        String written = "package p;\npublic class Owner {\n  static Object owner(Class<?> c) { return c.getEnclosingClass(); }\n"
            + "  static int detect() {\n    class LocalClass<T> {}\n    Class<?> subclass = new LocalClass<String>() {}.getClass();\n"
            + "    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {\n      if (owner(LocalClass.class) == subclass.getGenericSuperclass()) {\n        return i;\n      }\n"
            + "    }\n    return -1;\n  }\n}\n";
        String printed = written.replace("    class LocalClass<T> {}\n", "")
            .replace("    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {\n", "    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {\n      class LocalClass<T> {}\n");
        Path reference = Files.createDirectories(dir.resolve("reference/p"));
        Files.writeString(reference.resolve("Owner.java"), written);
        Path broken = sources("local-class", Map.of("p/Owner.java", printed));
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of("hoist-local-class", "hoist-local-class"), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList(), proposal.toString());
        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);

        Path referenceClasses = dir.resolve("reference-classes"), repairedClasses = dir.resolve("repaired-classes");

            reference.resolve("Owner.java").toString()));
        assertEquals(0, javac.run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none", "-d", repairedClasses.toString(),
            merged.resolve("p/Owner.java").toString()));

            var outcomes = MethodRoundTrip.compareClass(Files.readAllBytes(referenceClasses.resolve("p/" + name + ".class")),
                Files.readAllBytes(repairedClasses.resolve("p/" + name + ".class")));

        }

    @Test void stubsTheMethodsAJdkInterfaceGainedAfterTheOriginalTargetAndMarksThem() throws Exception {
        // Guava 17's Types.TypeVariableImpl: built for Java 6, it implements TypeVariable, which Java 8 made an
        // AnnotatedElement with getAnnotatedBounds(); javac 21 cannot build below release 8.
        Path broken = sources("environment", Map.of("p/Variable.java", "package p;\nimport java.lang.reflect.*;\n"

        var blind = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("blind"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of("no-original-classes"), blind.unrepaired().stream().map(SourceRepair.Unrepaired::reason).toList(), blind.toString());
        // Built for Java 8, the original would have had to declare the methods: no stub.
        var java8 = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("java8"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            variableJar(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_8, "java8.jar"));
        assertEquals(List.of("target-release-buildable"), java8.unrepaired().stream().map(SourceRepair.Unrepaired::reason).toList(), java8.toString());
        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(),
            variableJar(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.V1_6, "java6.jar"));
        assertEquals(List.of(SourceRepair.ENVIRONMENT_STUB), proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::rule).toList(), proposal.toString());
        Path merged = apply(broken, proposal);
        String repaired = Files.readString(merged.resolve("p/Variable.java"));
        for (String stub : List.of("   public java.lang.reflect.AnnotatedType[] getAnnotatedBounds() {\n",

                "   public java.lang.annotation.Annotation[] getAnnotations() {\n", "   public java.lang.annotation.Annotation[] getDeclaredAnnotations() {\n"))
            assertTrue(repaired.contains(stub), repaired);
        assertEquals(4, repaired.split("// ClassRevive environment stub, not in the original class \\(class file version 50", -1).length - 1, repaired);
        assertTrue(repaired.endsWith("      throw new UnsupportedOperationException(\"getAnnotatedBounds: not in the original class\");\n   }\n}\n"), repaired);
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, compile(merged, "verify").status());
    }

    /** {@code p/Variable} as javac would have built it for {@code version}: no method TypeVariable gained in Java 8. */
    private Path variableJar(int version, String name) throws Exception {
        var writer = new org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter(org.objectweb.asm.ClassWriter.COMPUTE_MAXS);
        writer.visit(version, org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC | org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_FINAL | org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_SUPER, "p/Variable",
            "<D::Ljava/lang/reflect/GenericDeclaration;>Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/reflect/TypeVariable<TD;>;", "java/lang/Object",
            new String[] {"java/lang/reflect/TypeVariable"});
        for (String[] method : new String[][] {{"getBounds", "()[Ljava/lang/reflect/Type;"},
                {"getGenericDeclaration", "()Ljava/lang/reflect/GenericDeclaration;"}, {"getName", "()Ljava/lang/String;"}}) {
            var code = writer.visitMethod(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACC_PUBLIC, method[0], method[1], null, null);
            code.visitCode(); code.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ACONST_NULL); code.visitInsn(org.objectweb.asm.Opcodes.ARETURN);
            code.visitMaxs(0, 0); code.visitEnd();
        }
        writer.visitEnd();
        Path jar = dir.resolve(name);
        try (var zip = new java.util.zip.ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(jar))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new java.util.zip.ZipEntry("p/Variable.class")); zip.write(writer.toByteArray()); zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return jar;
    }

    @Test void capturesFromSeveralStatementsOfOneBlockGetDistinctCopies() throws Exception {

    @Test void eachRuleRepairsItsDiagnosticAndTheResultCompiles() throws Exception {
        Path broken = sources("broken", Map.of(
            "p/Conditional.java", "package p; public final class Conditional implements Factory {\n"
                + "  public <T> Box<T> create(Class<T> type) { return type == Integer.class ? new IntBox() : null; }\n}\n",
            "p/Returned.java", "package p; public final class Returned implements Factory {\n"
                + "  public <T> Box<T> create(Class<T> type) { return new IntBox(); }\n}\n",
            "p/Diamond.java", "package p; final class Diamond {\n  <T> Object make(Box<T> box) { Holder<T> held = new Holder<>(box); return held; }\n}\n",
            "p/Statics.java", "package p; final class Statics<E> {\n  static Object wrap(Object value) { return (Box<E>) value; }\n}\n",
            "p/Calls.java", "package p; import java.util.*; final class Calls {\n  static <T> void both(List<T> a, List<T> b) {}\n"
                + "  void call(List<?> x, List<?> y) { both(x, y); }\n}\n",
            "p/Finals.java", "package p; final class Finals {\n  Runnable task(Object a, Object b) {\n    final Object chosen = null;\n"
                + "    if (a != null) chosen = a;\n    if (chosen == null) chosen = b;\n"
                + "    return new Runnable() { public void run() { System.out.println(chosen); } };\n  }\n}\n",
            "p/Renamed.java", "package p; final class Renamed {\n  Runnable task(boolean flag) {\n"
                + "    if (flag) { final String value = \"a\"; return () -> System.out.println(value); }\n"
                + "    final String valuex = \"b\";\n    return new Runnable() { public void run() { System.out.println(value); } };\n  }\n}\n"));
        var before = compile(broken, "before");
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILE_FAILED, before.status());
        assertEquals(0, before.syntaxErrors());

        var proposal = new SourceRepair().propose(broken, dir.resolve("repair"), ORIGINALS, Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of());
        assertEquals(List.of(), proposal.unrepaired(), "every diagnostic here has a rule");
        var rules = new TreeMap<String,String>();
        proposal.edits().forEach(edit -> rules.merge(edit.file(), edit.rule(), (a, b) -> a.endsWith(b) ? a : a + "," + b));
        assertEquals(Map.of("p/Conditional.java", "raw-cast-to-target", "p/Returned.java", "raw-cast-to-target",
            "p/Diamond.java", "raw-diamond", "p/Statics.java", "raw-type-argument", "p/Calls.java", "raw-argument",
            "p/Finals.java", "drop-final-local,capture-copy", "p/Renamed.java", "renamed-local"), rules);
        assertTrue(proposal.edits().stream().allMatch(edit -> edit.code().startsWith("compiler.err.") && edit.line() > 0 && edit.column() > 0));
        assertEquals(proposal.edits().stream().map(SourceRepair.Edit::file).collect(java.util.stream.Collectors.toSet()), proposal.files().keySet());

        String conditional = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Conditional.java"));
        assertTrue(conditional.contains("? (p.Box)new IntBox() : null"), conditional);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Diamond.java")).contains("new Holder(box)"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Statics.java")).contains("return (Box) value;"));
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Calls.java")).contains("both((java.util.List)x, (java.util.List)y)"));
        String finals = Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Finals.java"));
        assertTrue(finals.contains("    Object chosen = null;"), finals);
        assertTrue(finals.contains("final Object chosenCaptured = chosen;\n    return new Runnable()"), finals);
        assertTrue(finals.contains("System.out.println(chosenCaptured)"), finals);
        assertTrue(Files.readString(proposal.files().get("p/Renamed.java")).contains("public void run() { System.out.println(valuex); }"));
        // The originals are untouched; repaired copies live in the worker's own folder.
        assertTrue(Files.readString(broken.resolve("p/Finals.java")).contains("final Object chosen = null;"));

        var after = compile(apply(broken, proposal), "after");
        assertEquals(VerificationResult.Status.COMPILED, after.status(), Files.readString(dir.resolve("after/engine.log")));
    }

    @Test void declarationsAndUnknownDiagnosticsAreLeftAloneWithAReason() throws Exception {
        Path broken = sources("unrepaired", Map.of(
            "p/Field.java", "package p; final class Field {\n  Missing field;\n}\n",

            "p/Downcast.java", "not-an-upcast"), reasons);
    }

    @Test void logFieldsRoundTripThroughEscapingAndInvalidEscapesAreRejected() throws Exception {
        String text = "a\tb\\c\nd\re";
        assertEquals(text, SourceRepair.unescape(SourceRepairWorker.escape(text)));
        assertFalse(SourceRepairWorker.escape(text).contains("\t") || SourceRepairWorker.escape(text).contains("\n"));
        for (String bad : List.of("trailing\\", "\\x")) assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> SourceRepair.unescape(bad), bad);
        for (String row : List.of("../A.java\t1\t1\tcompiler.err.x\tno-rule", "/A.java\t1\t1\tcompiler.err.x\tno-rule",
                "A.java\t1\t1\tcompiler.warn.x\tno-rule", "A.java\t1\t1\tcompiler.err.x", "A.txt\t1\t1\tcompiler.err.x\tno-rule")) {
            Path log = dir.resolve("log-" + Math.abs(row.hashCode()) + ".tsv");
            Files.writeString(log, row + "\n");
            assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> SourceRepair.rows(log, 5, 10), row);
        }
    }

    /** The source with the cast edits of {@link SourceRepairWorker#castSites} for {@code types} applied to method {@code name}. */
    static String castEdited(String source, String name, Set<String> types) {
        var warnings = new ArrayList<javax.tools.Diagnostic<? extends javax.tools.JavaFileObject>>();
        var file = new javax.tools.SimpleJavaFileObject(java.net.URI.create("string:///p/T.java"), javax.tools.JavaFileObject.Kind.SOURCE) {
            @Override public CharSequence getCharContent(boolean ignoreEncodingErrors) { return source; }
        };
        var task = (com.sun.source.util.JavacTask) javax.tools.ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().getTask(null, null, diagnostic -> {
            if (diagnostic.getKind() == javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR) fail(diagnostic.toString());
            if (diagnostic.getKind() == javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.WARNING) warnings.add(diagnostic);
        }, List.of("--release", "8", "-Xlint:cast", "-Xlint:-options", "-proc:none"), null, List.of(file));
        com.sun.source.tree.CompilationUnitTree unit;
        try { unit = task.parse().iterator().next(); task.analyze(); } catch (IOException error) { throw new java.io.UncheckedIOException(error); }
        var body = new com.sun.source.util.TreePath[1];
        new com.sun.source.util.TreePathScanner<Void,Void>() {
            @Override public Void visitMethod(com.sun.source.tree.MethodTree tree, Void unused) {
                if (tree.getName().contentEquals(name)) body[0] = new com.sun.source.util.TreePath(getCurrentPath(), tree.getBody());
                return super.visitMethod(tree, null);
            }
        }.scan(unit, null);
        var edits = SourceRepairWorker.castEdits(SourceRepairWorker.castSites(task, warnings, body[0]), types);
        var text = new StringBuilder(source);
        for (int i = edits.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) text.replace(edits.get(i).start(), edits.get(i).end(), edits.get(i).replacement());
        return text.toString();
    }

    @Test void castSitesTakeAwayOnlyTheRequestedCastsAndKeepEveryExpression() {
        String source = "package p; import java.util.*; class T {\n"
            + "  static class Pair<A, B> { static <A, B> Pair<A, B> make(A a, B b) { return null; } }\n"
            + "  Object joined(List<String> l) { return(String)l.get(0); }\n"
            + "  void nested(List<Pair<Integer, String>> out, List<String> l) { out.add(Pair.make(1, l.get(0))); }\n"
            + "  void statement(List<String> l) { Pair.make(1, l.get(0)); }\n"
            + "  void filtered(Set<String> s, Set<Integer> n, List<String> l, List<Integer> m) { s.add(l.get(0)); n.add(m.get(0)); }\n"
            + "  void creation(List<String> l) { Object b = new ArrayList<String>(Collections.singleton(l.get(0))); }\n"
            + "  List<String> varargs(List<String> l) { return Arrays.asList(l.get(0), l.get(1)); }\n"
            + "  String used(Map<String, String> m, Map.Entry<String, String> e) { return m.put(e.getKey(), e.getValue()); }\n"
            + "  boolean arrays(String[] a, String[] b) { return Arrays.equals((Object[]) a, (Object[])b); }\n"
            + "  void wild(Set<Object> s, List<? extends Number> l) { s.add((Number) l.get(0)); }\n}\n";
        var strings = Set.of("java/lang/String");
        // `return(T)x` keeps its tokens apart.
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "joined", strings).contains("Object joined(List<String> l) { return l.get(0); }"));
        // The generic method's argument is upcast and its result raw inside the outer call; the outer call needs nothing.
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "nested", strings).contains("{ out.add(((p.T.Pair) Pair.make(1, ((java.lang.Object) l.get(0))))); }"));
        // An unused result needs no raw cast (a cast is no statement).
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "statement", strings).contains("{ Pair.make(1, ((java.lang.Object) l.get(0))); }"));
        // Only the sites casting to a requested class.
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "filtered", Set.of("java/lang/Integer")).contains("{ s.add(l.get(0)); ((java.util.Set) n).add(m.get(0)); }"));
        // singleton's argument is cast for its own type variable; the creation's argument is a Set, which needs nothing.
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "creation", strings)
            .contains("new ArrayList<String>(((java.util.Set) Collections.singleton(((java.lang.Object) l.get(0)))))"));
        // Variable-arity elements are cast by both javac generations; a raw receiver would erase a value that is used.
        assertEquals(source, castEdited(source, "varargs", strings));
        assertEquals(source, castEdited(source, "used", strings));
        // Upcasts javac does not call redundant but checks: to an array type, and of a wildcard-typed value.
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "arrays", Set.of("[Ljava/lang/Object;")).contains("{ return Arrays.equals(a, b); }"));
        assertTrue(castEdited(source, "wild", Set.of("java/lang/Number")).contains("{ s.add(l.get(0)); }"));
        assertEquals(source, castEdited(source, "wild", strings));
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * A validated decompile job: what {@code classrevive decompile} options describe, for any front end.
 * {@code engineCache}: Phase 2CH output cache directory, or null; {@code stubs}: Phase 2CT inferred stubs; {@code entry}:
 * Phase 2DB nested jar to take from a bundle of jars, or null for the default rule; {@code deobfuscate}: Phase 2DD automatic
 * reversal of an obfuscator the diagnosis recognizes with HIGH confidence.
 */
public record DecompileRequest(Path input, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                               Path engineCache, boolean stubs, String entry, boolean deobfuscate) {
    public DecompileRequest(Path input, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                            Path engineCache, boolean stubs) {
        this(input, output, engines, timeout, dependencies, engineCache, stubs, null);
    }
    /** With the automatic reversal on (the default). */
    public DecompileRequest(Path input, Path output, List<DecompilerEngine> engines, Duration timeout, List<Path> dependencies,
                            Path engineCache, boolean stubs, String entry) {
        this(input, output, engines, timeout, dependencies, engineCache, stubs, entry, true);
    }
    /** The same job with the automatic reversal turned on or off. */
    public DecompileRequest withDeobfuscation(boolean enabled) {
        return new DecompileRequest(input, output, engines, timeout, dependencies, engineCache, stubs, entry, enabled);
    }

    public DecompileRequest {
        Objects.requireNonNull(input, "input");
        Objects.requireNonNull(output, "output");
        engines = List.copyOf(engines);
        if (engines.isEmpty() || engines.size() > 4) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Select one to four engines");
        timeout = RequestLimits.timeout(timeout);
        dependencies = RequestLimits.dependencies(dependencies);
        if (entry != null && entry.isBlank()) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Empty --entry name");
    }

    /** The CLI defaults: CFR and Vineflower, 120 seconds per worker, no dependencies or cache, stubs and automatic reversal on. */
    public static DecompileRequest defaults(Path input, Path output) {
        return new DecompileRequest(input, output, EngineRegistry.parse("cfr,vineflower"), Duration.ofSeconds(120), List.of(), null, true);
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/DecompileService.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase G1: one decompile job end to end, as {@code classrevive decompile} runs it, so no front end repeats the steps that
 * follow the pipeline job. Native triage stays a separate call: a front end may report between the two.
 */
public final class DecompileService {
    /** {@code output}: absolute result directory; {@code origin}: Phase 2CE note when the Java came from another file, else null. */
    public record Decompiled(Path output, DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job, String origin) {}

    /** Runs the job into the new {@code request.output()} and records where its Java came from. Interrupting the thread cancels it. */
    public Decompiled decompile(DecompileRequest request, JobListener listener) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        Path output = request.output().toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        String name = request.input().getFileName() == null ? "" : request.input().getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        boolean named = name.endsWith(".class") || name.endsWith(".jar");
        if (request.entry() != null && named)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("--entry applies only to a bundle of jars, not to a .class or .jar input");
        DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob job;
        if (!named && (request.entry() != null || InputIdentifier.identify(request.input()).verdict() == InputIdentifier.Verdict.JAVA_BUNDLE)) {
            job = bundle(request, listener, output);
        } else {
            job = job(request, listener).runVerified(request.input(), request.output(), request.engines(), request.timeout(), request.dependencies());
        }
        String origin = InputIdentifier.attach(output, output.resolve("report.txt"), output.resolve("report.json"));
        return new Decompiled(output, job, origin);
    }

    /**
     * Phase 2DB: a bundle of jars. The chosen nested jar is decompiled under its own name and the bundle's other jars with
     * classes join the --classpath JARs (most classes first, up to {@link RequestLimits#MAX_DEPENDENCIES} in all); they are
     * written to a temporary folder as data and removed afterwards. The origin is recorded even when the job fails.
     */
    private DecompilationJob.VerifiedJob bundle(DecompileRequest request, JobListener listener, Path output) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var resolved = InputIdentifier.resolve(request.input(), request.timeout(), request.entry());
        Path work = Files.createTempDirectory("classrevive-bundle");
        boolean existed = Files.exists(output, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS);
        try {
            Path main = Files.createDirectory(work.resolve("main")).resolve(fileName(resolved.entry()));
            Files.write(main, resolved.bytes(), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
            var dependencies = new ArrayList<>(request.dependencies());
            var used = new LinkedHashMap<String,byte[]>();
            int index = 0;
            for (var nested : resolved.classpath().entrySet()) {
                if (dependencies.size() >= RequestLimits.MAX_DEPENDENCIES) break;
                Path jar = Files.createDirectories(work.resolve("classpath").resolve(String.valueOf(index++))).resolve(fileName(nested.getKey()));
                Files.write(jar, nested.getValue(), StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW);
                dependencies.add(jar);
                used.put(nested.getKey(), nested.getValue());
            }
            resolved = resolved.withClasspath(used);
            return job(request, listener).runVerified(main, request.output(), request.engines(), request.timeout(), dependencies);
        } finally {
            if (!existed && Files.isDirectory(output, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && !Files.exists(output.resolve("input-origin")))
                InputIdentifier.record(output, resolved);
            try (var walk = Files.walk(work)) {
                for (Path path : walk.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).toList()) Files.deleteIfExists(path);
            } catch (IOException | UncheckedIOException ignored) {
                // A leftover temporary folder holds only copies of the bundle's jars.
            }
        }
    }

    private static DecompilationJob job(DecompileRequest request, JobListener listener) {
        return new DecompilationJob().withEngineCache(request.engineCache()).withStubs(request.stubs())
            .withDeobfuscation(request.deobfuscate()).withListener(listener);
    }

    /** A nested jar's base name as a portable file name ending in .jar. */
    static String fileName(String entry) {
        String base = entry.substring(Math.max(entry.lastIndexOf('/'), entry.lastIndexOf('\\')) + 1).replaceAll("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]", "_");
        if (base.isEmpty() || base.startsWith(".")) base = "nested" + base;
        if (base.length() > 100) base = base.substring(0, 96);
        return base.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".jar") ? base : base + ".jar";
    }

    /** Native triage of a finished job, attached to its report; null when its input is not a jar. */
    public NativeAnalysis.Result triageNative(Decompiled decompiled, NativeAnalysis.Options options) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        Path output = decompiled.output();
        if (!NativeTriage.applicable(output)) return null;
        return NativeTriage.run(output, output.resolve("report.txt"), output.resolve("report.json"), options);
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/EngineRegistry.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.cfr.CfrEngine;
import dev.classrevive.engine.DecompilerEngine;
import dev.classrevive.jadx.JadxEngine;
import dev.classrevive.procyon.ProcyonEngine;
import dev.classrevive.vineflower.VineflowerEngine;
import java.util.*;

/** The bundled decompiler engines, in their fixed order, and the {@code cfr,vineflower,...} / {@code all} selection syntax. */
public final class EngineRegistry {
    private EngineRegistry() {}

    public static List<DecompilerEngine> all() { return List.of(new CfrEngine(), new VineflowerEngine(), new ProcyonEngine(), new JadxEngine()); }

    public static List<DecompilerEngine> parse(String names) {
        if (names.equals("all")) return all();
        var result = new ArrayList<DecompilerEngine>();
        var seen = new HashSet<String>();
        for (String name : names.split(",", -1)) {
            if (!seen.add(name)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Duplicate engine: " + name);
            result.add(all().stream().filter(engine -> engine.id().equals(name)).findFirst()
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown engine: " + name + ". Use cfr,vineflower,procyon,jadx or all.")));
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.NativeAnalysis;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;

/** Phase 2CC native triage of a finished job's {@code input.jar}, attached to that job's text and JSON evidence. */
public final class NativeTriage {
    private NativeTriage() {}

    /** Only a jar input bundles native libraries; a standalone class has none. */
    public static boolean applicable(Path output) { return Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("input.jar"), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS); }

    /** Extracts the bundled libraries as data into {@code output/native} and appends the summary to {@code text} and {@code json}. */
    public static NativeAnalysis.Result run(Path output, Path text, Path json, NativeAnalysis.Options options) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var result = new NativeAnalysis().run(output.resolve("input.jar"), output.resolve("native"), options);
        NativeAnalysis.attach(text, json, result);
        return result;
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/ObfuscationCheck.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscationProfile;
import dev.classrevive.bytecode.ObfuscatorClassifier;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.ZipFile;

/**
 * Phase G5: which obfuscator a jar or class file points to, with the Phase 2BZ classifier that {@code classrevive diagnose}
 * and every decompile report already use. ASM reads the class bytes; nothing is loaded or run. A suggestion, never proof.
 */
public final class ObfuscationCheck {
    /** One hypothesis: the obfuscator, its score 0..100, {@code LOW}/{@code MEDIUM}/{@code HIGH}, and the evidence behind it. */
    public record Hypothesis(String obfuscator, int score, String confidence, List<String> reasons) {
        public Hypothesis { reasons = List.copyOf(reasons); }
    }

    /** One technique found: its label and how many classes show it. */
    public record Technique(String label, int classes) {}

    /**
     * {@code verdict}: {@code SUGGESTED}, {@code NONE} (no technique) or {@code UNKNOWN} (techniques, but no rule matched);
     * {@code summary}: the one-line text of the reports.
     */
    public record Detection(String verdict, String summary, List<Hypothesis> hypotheses, List<Technique> techniques, int classes) {
        public Detection { hypotheses = List.copyOf(hypotheses); techniques = List.copyOf(techniques); }

        /** The strongest hypothesis, or null. */
        public Hypothesis top() { return hypotheses.isEmpty() ? null : hypotheses.getFirst(); }

        /** Skidfuscator is the strongest hypothesis with at least medium confidence: the reversal is worth offering. */
        public boolean skidfuscator() {
            var top = top();
            return top != null && top.obfuscator().equals(SKIDFUSCATOR) && !top.confidence().equals("LOW");
        }
    }

    public static final String SKIDFUSCATOR = "Skidfuscator";
    static final int MAX_ENTRIES = 100_000, MAX_CLASS_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024;

    private ObfuscationCheck() {}

    /** Classifies a {@code .jar} (classes and resource names) or a single {@code .class}. */
    public static Detection analyze(Path file) throws IOException {
        var builder = new ObfuscationProfile.Builder();
        if (file.getFileName().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class")) {
            byte[] bytes = Files.readAllBytes(file);
            if (bytes.length <= MAX_CLASS_BYTES) builder.addClass(bytes);
        } else try (var zip = new ZipFile(file.toFile())) {
            var entries = zip.entries();
            for (int visited = 0; entries.hasMoreElements() && visited < MAX_ENTRIES; visited++) {
                var entry = entries.nextElement();
                if (entry.isDirectory()) continue;
                if (!entry.getName().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).endsWith(".class")) { builder.addResource(entry.getName(), entry.getSize()); continue; }
                if (entry.getSize() > MAX_CLASS_BYTES) continue;
                try (var in = zip.getInputStream(entry)) {
                    byte[] bytes = in.readNBytes(MAX_CLASS_BYTES + 1);
                    if (bytes.length <= MAX_CLASS_BYTES) builder.addClass(bytes);
                }
            }
        }
        var profile = builder.build();
        var result = ObfuscatorClassifier.classify(profile);
        var techniques = new ArrayList<Technique>();
        profile.techniques().forEach((technique, count) -> techniques.add(new Technique(technique.label(), count.classes())));
        techniques.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(Technique::classes).reversed().thenComparing(Technique::label));
        var hypotheses = result.hypotheses().stream().map(h -> new Hypothesis(h.obfuscator(), h.score(), h.confidence(), h.reasons())).toList();
        return new Detection(result.verdict(), result.summary(), hypotheses, techniques, profile.classes());
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/RequestLimits.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;

/** Limits every front end applies to a job before it starts; the messages are the CLI's. */
public final class RequestLimits {
    public static final int MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 1, MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 3600;
    /** The verifier's limit on explicit dependency JARs (Phase 3A). */
    public static final int MAX_DEPENDENCIES = 16;

    private RequestLimits() {}

    public static Duration timeoutSeconds(int seconds) { return timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(seconds)); }

    /** Per worker or compile attempt, not for the whole job. */
    public static Duration timeout(Duration timeout) {
        if (timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)) < 0 || timeout.compareTo(Duration.ofSeconds(MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)) > 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Timeout must be 1..3600 seconds");
        return timeout;
    }

    public static List<Path> dependencies(List<Path> dependencies) {
        if (dependencies.size() > MAX_DEPENDENCIES) throw new IllegalArgumentException("At most 16 dependency JARs");
        return List.copyOf(dependencies);
    }
}
```
