`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/ResultIndex.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.Json;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Phase G2: a finished decompile job read back from its output folder, for the desktop GUI. Everything comes from
 * {@code report.json} (levels from {@code class_confidence}, the rows of {@code report.html}) and the source folders the
 * job wrote; nothing is recomputed, nothing from the input is loaded or run. Folders written before Phase G2 have no
 * {@code class_confidence}: {@link #levelsAvailable()} is then false and every level is null.
 */
public final class ResultIndex {
    /** The confidence levels of {@code report.html}, strongest evidence first. */
    public enum Level { EXACT, CLOSE, PER_FILE, PARTIAL, UNVERIFIED }

    /** One class: its source file (relative, in every candidate), origin in the selected sources, and recompilation evidence. */
    public record ClassEntry(String className, String file, String origin, int matchedSymbols, int expectedSymbols, int identical,
                             int equivalent, int different, List<String> differentMethods, Level level, Map<String,Outcome> methods) {
        public ClassEntry {
            differentMethods = List.copyOf(differentMethods);
            methods = Collections.unmodifiableMap(new LinkedHashMap<>(methods));
        }
    }

    /** Phase G4: one method's round trip, keyed in {@link ClassEntry#methods()} by {@code name + descriptor}. */
    public enum Outcome { IDENTICAL, EQUIVALENT_AFTER_NORMALIZATION, DIFFERENT }

    /** Phase G4: a javac error of the selected sources; {@code file} is relative to their folder, positions 1-based or -1. */
    public record Diagnostic(String file, long line, long column, String code, String message) {}

    /** Phase 2CJ, as the report states it: the main language, javac or ecj, a javac version lower bound (0 when unknown). */
    public record Compiler(String language, String javaCompiler, int javacAtLeast, int classes) {}

    /** One engine run of the job. */
    public record EngineEntry(String id, String version, String status, long sourceFiles) {}

    /** Whole-job verification as {@code report.json} states it; behavior is always {@code NOT_VERIFIED}. */
    public record Summary(String inputSha256, String compilation, int errors, int matchedSymbols, int expectedSymbols,
                          boolean structurallyComplete, String selectedCandidate, String behavior) {}

    /** The candidate holding the selected sources. */
    public static final String SELECTION = "selection";
    /** {@code report.json} larger than this is refused, matching the strict JSON reader's own limit. */
    static final long MAX_REPORT_BYTES = 16L * 1024 * 1024;

    private final Path output;
    private final Summary summary;
    private final SortedMap<String,ClassEntry> classes;
    private final List<EngineEntry> engines;
    private final Map<String,String> originalNames;
    private final boolean levelsAvailable;
    private final Compiler compiler;
    private volatile List<Diagnostic> diagnostics;

    private ResultIndex(Path output, Summary summary, SortedMap<String,ClassEntry> classes, List<EngineEntry> engines,
                        Map<String,String> originalNames, boolean levelsAvailable, Compiler compiler) {
        this.output = output; this.summary = summary; this.classes = classes; this.engines = engines;
        this.originalNames = originalNames; this.levelsAvailable = levelsAvailable; this.compiler = compiler;
    }

    /** Reads {@code output/report.json}; fails with an {@link IOException} when it is missing, too large or not a decompile report. */
    public static ResultIndex open(Path output) throws IOException {
        output = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path report = output.resolve("report.json");
        if (!Files.isRegularFile(report, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) throw new IOException("No report.json in " + output);
        if (Files.size(report) > MAX_REPORT_BYTES) throw new IOException("report.json exceeds " + (MAX_REPORT_BYTES >> 20) + " MiB");
        Map<String,Object> root;
        try {
            root = map(Json.decode(Files.readString(report, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)), "report");
            if (!"decompilation".equals(root.get("kind"))) throw new IllegalArgumentException("kind is not decompilation");
            var verification = map(root.get("verification"), "verification");
            var summary = new Summary(string(root, "input_sha256"), string(verification, "status"), integer(verification, "errors"),
                integer(verification, "matched_symbols"), integer(verification, "expected_symbols"),
                Boolean.TRUE.equals(verification.get("structurally_complete")), string(root, "selected_candidate"), string(root, "behavior"));
            var engines = new ArrayList<EngineEntry>();
            for (Object item : list(root.get("engines"), "engines")) {
                var engine = map(item, "engine");
                engines.add(new EngineEntry(string(engine, "id"), string(engine, "version"), string(engine, "status"), integer(engine, "source_files")));
            }
            var classes = new TreeMap<String,ClassEntry>();
            boolean levels = root.get("class_confidence") != null;
            if (levels) {
                for (Object item : list(root.get("class_confidence"), "class_confidence")) {
                    var row = map(item, "class confidence");
                    var methods = new ArrayList<String>();
                    for (Object method : list(row.get("different_methods"), "different_methods")) methods.add((String) method);
                    var outcomes = new LinkedHashMap<String,Outcome>();
                    if (row.get("methods") != null) for (Object measured : list(row.get("methods"), "methods")) {
                        var method = map(measured, "method");
                        outcomes.put(string(method, "method"), Outcome.valueOf(string(method, "outcome")));
                    }
                    var entry = new ClassEntry(string(row, "class_name"), string(row, "file"), string(row, "origin"),
                        integer(row, "matched_symbols"), integer(row, "expected_symbols"), integer(row, "identical"),
                        integer(row, "equivalent_after_normalization"), integer(row, "different"), methods, Level.valueOf(string(row, "level")), outcomes);
                    classes.put(entry.className(), entry);
                }
            } else {
                // Before Phase G2: structural coverage only; the selected file follows the top-level class name.
                var provenance = root.get("provenance") == null ? Map.<String,Object>of() : map(root.get("provenance"), "provenance");
                for (Object item : list(verification.get("class_coverage"), "class_coverage")) {
                    var row = map(item, "class coverage");
                    String name = string(row, "class_name"), file = topLevel(name) + ".java";
                    classes.put(name, new ClassEntry(name, file, String.valueOf(provenance.getOrDefault(file, "none")),
                        integer(row, "matched_symbols"), integer(row, "expected_symbols"), 0, 0, 0, List.of(), null, Map.of()));
                }
            }
            var originals = new TreeMap<String,String>();
            if (root.get("portable_names") != null) {
                var renamed = map(map(root.get("portable_names"), "portable_names").get("renamed_classes"), "renamed_classes");
                renamed.forEach((original, portable) -> originals.put(String.valueOf(portable), original));
            }
            Compiler compiler = null;
            if (root.get("compiler") instanceof Map<?,?>) {
                var found = map(root.get("compiler"), "compiler");
                compiler = new Compiler(string(found, "language"), string(found, "java_compiler"),
                    found.get("javac_at_least") == null ? 0 : integer(found, "javac_at_least"), integer(found, "classes"));
            }
            return new ResultIndex(output, summary, Collections.unmodifiableSortedMap(classes), List.copyOf(engines),
                Collections.unmodifiableMap(originals), levels, compiler);
        } catch (IllegalArgumentException | ClassCastException | NullPointerException malformed) {
            throw new IOException("Not a readable ClassRevive report: " + malformed.getMessage(), malformed);
        }
    }

    public Path output() { return output; }
    /** The language and compiler found in the bytecode, or null when the report predates Phase 2CJ. */
    public Compiler compiler() { return compiler; }

    /**
     * Phase G4: the selected sources' javac errors ({@code selection/diagnostics.tsv}); empty when they compiled, for
     * folders written before G4, or when the file is not readable.
     */
    public List<Diagnostic> diagnostics() {
        var cached = diagnostics;
        if (cached != null) return cached;
        var list = new ArrayList<Diagnostic>();
        try {
            Path file = output.resolve(SELECTION).resolve(dev.classrevive.verification.SelectedDiagnostics.FILE);
            for (var diagnostic : dev.classrevive.verification.SelectedDiagnostics.read(file))
                list.add(new Diagnostic(diagnostic.file(), diagnostic.line(), diagnostic.column(), diagnostic.code(), diagnostic.message()));
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException unreadable) {
            list.clear();
        }
        cached = List.copyOf(list);
        diagnostics = cached;
        return cached;
    }

    /** The javac errors of one selected source file ({@code a/b/C.java}). */
    public List<Diagnostic> diagnostics(String file) {
        return diagnostics().stream().filter(diagnostic -> diagnostic.file().equals(file)).toList();
    }
    public Summary summary() { return summary; }
    /** Every class of the job by internal name ({@code a/b/C$D}), sorted. */
    public SortedMap<String,ClassEntry> classes() { return classes; }
    public List<EngineEntry> engines() { return engines; }
    /** Whether the levels came from the report; false for folders written before Phase G2. */
    public boolean levelsAvailable() { return levelsAvailable; }

    /** The input's own name for a class renamed to a portable name (Phase 2BV), or the name itself. */
    public String originalName(String className) { return originalNames.getOrDefault(className, className); }

    /** {@link #SELECTION} when the job wrote selected sources, then each engine with a source folder, in report order. */
    public List<String> candidates() {
        var candidates = new ArrayList<String>();
        if (Files.isDirectory(sources(SELECTION), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) candidates.add(SELECTION);
        for (var engine : engines) if (Files.isDirectory(sources(engine.id()), LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) candidates.add(engine.id());
        return List.copyOf(candidates);
    }

    /**
     * The file holding {@code className} in one candidate's sources. An engine may write a nested class as its own
     * {@code B$C.java} (when the input lost its InnerClasses attribute) or inside {@code B.java}; the first that exists wins.
     * Only regular files inside that candidate's folder are returned.
     */
    public Optional<Path> source(String className, String candidate) {
        if (!classes.containsKey(className)) return Optional.empty();
        Path root = sources(candidate).normalize();
        for (String file : List.of(className + ".java", topLevel(className) + ".java")) {
            Path path = root.resolve(file).normalize();
            if (path.startsWith(root) && Files.isRegularFile(path, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return Optional.of(path);
        }
        return Optional.empty();
    }

    /** Classes per level, every level present (zero when none). Empty when the levels are unavailable. */
    public Map<Level,Integer> levelCounts() {
        if (!levelsAvailable) return Map.of();
        var counts = new EnumMap<Level,Integer>(Level.class);
        for (var level : Level.values()) counts.put(level, 0);
        for (var entry : classes.values()) counts.merge(entry.level(), 1, Integer::sum);
        return Collections.unmodifiableMap(counts);
    }

    private Path sources(String candidate) {
        if (!candidate.equals(SELECTION) && engines.stream().noneMatch(engine -> engine.id().equals(candidate)))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown candidate: " + candidate);
        return output.resolve(candidate).resolve("sources");
    }

    static String topLevel(String internalName) {
        int slash = internalName.lastIndexOf('/'), dollar = internalName.indexOf('$', slash + 1);
        return dollar > slash + 1 ? internalName.substring(0, dollar) : internalName;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private static Map<String,Object> map(Object value, String what) {
        if (!(value instanceof Map<?,?>)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(what + " is not an object");
        return (Map<String,Object>) value;
    }
    private static List<Object> list(Object value, String what) {
        if (!(value instanceof List<?> items)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(what + " is not an array");
        return new ArrayList<>(items);
    }
    private static String string(Map<String,Object> map, String key) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof String text)) throw new IllegalArgumentException(key + " is not a string");
        return text;
    }
    private static int integer(Map<String,Object> map, String key) {
        if (!(map.get(key) instanceof Long number) || number < Integer.MIN_VALUE || number > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(key + " is not an integer");
        return number.intValue();
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/main/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/SkidReversal.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.TransformJob;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;

/**
 * Phase G5: the Skidfuscator 2.1.0 reversal (Phases 2CN–2CS) as {@code classrevive transform --passes skidfuscator} runs
 * it: a whole-jar pass in a worker JVM, then the JVM verifier links every rewritten class (never initializes it). The
 * desktop application decompiles the result only when it produced a jar and every class linked.
 */
public final class SkidReversal {
    /** {@code jar}: the reversed classes, or null when the reversal produced none; {@code report}: the pass's own summary. */
    public record Result(Path output, Path jar, boolean linked, int linkedClasses, String linkError, String report) {
        /** A jar exists and the verifier accepted every class: safe to decompile instead of the original. */
        public boolean usable() { return jar != null && linked; }
    }

    /** The pass name of {@code SkidfuscatorReverser} ({@code transform --passes skidfuscator}). */
    static final String PASS = "skidfuscator";

    private SkidReversal() {}

    /** Writes the reversal into the new folder {@code output} (its parent must exist). Interrupting the thread cancels it. */
    public static Result run(Path input, Path output, Duration timeout) throws IOException, InterruptedException {
        var result = new TransformJob().run(input, output, 10_000, RequestLimits.timeout(timeout), PASS);
        Path jar = output.resolve("worker/transformed/transformed.jar");
        if (!result.successful() || !Files.isRegularFile(jar, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS)) return new Result(output, null, false, 0, "no output", "");
        var link = result.link();
        Path passes = output.resolve("worker/transformed/jar-passes.txt");
        String report = Files.isRegularFile(passes, LinkOption.NOFOLLOW_LINKS) && Files.size(passes) < 64 * 1024 ? Files.readString(passes) : "";
        return new Result(output, jar, link != null && link.linked(), link == null ? 0 : link.classes(),
            link == null || link.linked() ? null : link.errorType() + (link.failedClass() == null ? "" : " in " + link.failedClass()), report);
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/DecompileServiceTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.engine.*;
import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class DecompileServiceTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    /** Records every callback as text, from any thread. */
    static final class Recorder implements JobListener {
        final List<String> events = Collections.synchronizedList(new ArrayList<>());
        @Override public void stage(Stage stage) { events.add(stage.name()); }
        @Override public void engineStarted(String engine) { events.add("start:" + engine); }
        @Override public void engineFinished(EngineResult result) { events.add("finish:" + result.engine() + ":" + result.status()); }
    }

    @Test void reportsStagesAndEnginesInOrderAndWritesTheSameEvidence() throws Exception {
        var input = jar("demo/Sample.java", """
            package demo;
            public class Sample { public int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; } }
            """, null);
        var recorder = new Recorder();
        var request = new DecompileRequest(input, directory.resolve("out"), EngineRegistry.parse("cfr,vineflower"), Duration.ofSeconds(60),
            List.of(), null, true);
        var decompiled = new DecompileService().decompile(request, recorder);
        var events = List.copyOf(recorder.events);
        assertTrue(decompiled.job().selection().verification().complete(), events.toString());
        assertEquals(directory.resolve("out").toAbsolutePath().normalize(), decompiled.output());
        assertNull(decompiled.origin());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(decompiled.output().resolve("report.json")));
        // Stages in order; a complete selection needs neither the per-file measurement nor the fallback.
        assertEquals(List.of("INTAKE", "ENGINES", "STUBS", "SELECTION", "REPORTS"),
            events.stream().filter(e -> !e.contains(":")).toList());
        // Each engine starts and finishes between ENGINES and STUBS, in any order between engines.
        int engines = events.indexOf("ENGINES"), stubs = events.indexOf("STUBS");
        for (String id : List.of("cfr", "vineflower")) {
            int start = events.indexOf("start:" + id), finish = events.indexOf("finish:" + id + ":OUTPUT_PRODUCED");
            assertTrue(engines < start && start < finish && finish < stubs, events.toString());
        }
        assertEquals(9, events.size(), events.toString());
        assertNull(new DecompileService().triageNative(decompiledWithoutJar(), null));
    }

    @Test void reportsTheMeasurementAndFallbackOfAPartialResult() throws Exception {
        // lib/Missing is used but not supplied, and stubs are off: the candidate cannot compile.
        var input = jar("app/Use.java", """
            package app;
            public class Use { public int call() { return lib.Missing.value(); } }
            """, "package lib; public class Missing { public static int value() { return 1; } }");
        var recorder = new Recorder();
        var request = new DecompileRequest(input, directory.resolve("partial"), EngineRegistry.parse("cfr"), Duration.ofSeconds(60),
            List.of(), null, false);
        var decompiled = new DecompileService().decompile(request, recorder);
        assertFalse(decompiled.job().selection().verification().complete());
        assertEquals(List.of("INTAKE", "ENGINES", "start:cfr", "finish:cfr:OUTPUT_PRODUCED", "SELECTION", "PER_FILE", "FALLBACK", "REPORTS"),
            recorder.events);
    }

    /** Phase G4: per-method outcomes, the selected sources' javac errors and the compiler fingerprint reach the index. */
    @Test void resultsCarryMethodOutcomesJavacErrorsAndTheCompiler() throws Exception {
        var input = jar("app/Use.java", """
            package app;
            public class Use {
                public int call() { return lib.Missing.value(); }
                public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; }
            }
            """, "package lib; public class Missing { public static int value() { return 1; } }");
        var request = new DecompileRequest(input, directory.resolve("errors"), EngineRegistry.parse("cfr"), Duration.ofSeconds(60),
            List.of(), null, false);
        var output = new DecompileService().decompile(request, JobListener.NONE).output();
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(output.resolve("selection/diagnostics.tsv")), "javac errors kept beside the selected sources");
        var index = ResultIndex.open(output);
        var errors = index.diagnostics("app/Use.java");
        assertFalse(errors.isEmpty());
        assertTrue(errors.stream().allMatch(error -> error.line() > 0 && error.code().startsWith("compiler.err.")), errors.toString());
        assertTrue(index.diagnostics("app/Other.java").isEmpty());
        assertEquals("Java", index.compiler().language());
        // Two tiny classes carry no javac-only trace (lambdas, enum switch maps), so the compiler stays undetermined.
        assertTrue(Set.of("javac", "undetermined").contains(index.compiler().javaCompiler()), index.compiler().toString());

        var good = jar("demo/Ok.java", "package demo; public class Ok { public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; } }", null);
        var compiled = ResultIndex.open(new DecompileService().decompile(new DecompileRequest(good, directory.resolve("ok"), EngineRegistry.parse("cfr"),
            Duration.ofSeconds(60), List.of(), null, true), JobListener.NONE).output());
        assertTrue(compiled.diagnostics().isEmpty(), "a compiling result has no diagnostics file");
        var methods = compiled.classes().get("demo/Ok").methods();
        assertEquals(ResultIndex.Outcome.IDENTICAL, methods.get("twice(I)I"), methods.toString());
        assertTrue(methods.containsKey("<init>()V"));
    }

    @Test void interruptingTheJobStopsItsWorkersWithoutOrphans() throws Exception {
        var input = jar("demo/Sample.java", "package demo; public class Sample {}", null);
        var sleeper = sleeper();
        var started = new CountDownLatch(1);
        var listener = new JobListener() { @Override public void engineStarted(String engine) { started.countDown(); } };
        var request = new DecompileRequest(input, directory.resolve("cancelled"), List.of(sleeper), Duration.ofSeconds(600), List.of(), null, true);
        var failure = new AtomicReference<Throwable>();
        var job = new Thread(() -> {
            try { new DecompileService().decompile(request, listener); failure.set(new AssertionError("job finished")); }
            catch (Throwable error) { failure.set(error); }
        });
        job.start();
        assertTrue(started.await(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
        // The worker writes its own pid, so the check below names that process and not another child of this JVM.
        Path pidFile = directory.resolve("sleeper.pid");
        assertTrue(waitFor(() -> Files.isRegularFile(pidFile) && pid(pidFile) > 0), "worker JVM never started");
        var worker = ProcessHandle.of(pid(pidFile)).orElseThrow();
        assertTrue(worker.isAlive());
        long before = System.nanoTime();
        job.interrupt();
        job.join(60_000);
        assertFalse(job.isAlive());
        assertInstanceOf(InterruptedException.class, failure.get());
        assertTrue(Duration.ofNanos(System.nanoTime() - before).toSeconds() < 30, "cancellation was not prompt");
        assertTrue(waitFor(() -> !worker.isAlive()), "orphan worker left running: " + describe(worker));
    }

    private static long pid(Path file) {
        try { return Long.parseLong(Files.readString(file).trim()); } catch (Exception notYet) { return -1; }
    }

    private static String describe(ProcessHandle process) {
        return process.pid() + " " + process.info().command().orElse("?") + " parent=" + process.parent().map(ProcessHandle::pid).orElse(-1L);
    }

    private DecompileService.Decompiled decompiledWithoutJar() throws Exception {
        var classOnly = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("class-only"));
        return new DecompileService.Decompiled(classOnly, null, null);
    }

    /** A worker that never ends, standing in for a slow decompiler. */
    private DecompilerEngine sleeper() throws Exception {
        var source = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("sleeper")).resolve("Sleeper.java");
        Files.writeString(source, """
            public class Sleeper {
                public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
                    java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of(a[0]), Long.toString(ProcessHandle.current().pid()));
                    Thread.sleep(600_000);
                }
            }
            """);
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "-proc:none", source.toString()));
        String java = Path.of(System.getProperty("java.home"), "bin", "java").toString();
        Path classes = source.getParent(), pidFile = directory.resolve("sleeper.pid");
        return new DecompilerEngine() {
            @Override public String id() { return "sleeper"; }
            @Override public String version() { return "test"; }
            @Override public List<String> command(Path in, Path out) { return List.of(java, "-cp", classes.toString(), "Sleeper", pidFile.toString()); }
        };
    }

    private Path jar(String path, String source, String library) throws Exception {
        var sources = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src-" + path.hashCode()));
        var classes = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("classes-" + path.hashCode()));
        Path file = Files.createDirectories(sources.resolve(path).getParent()).resolve(Path.of(path).getFileName());
        Files.writeString(file, source);
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString(), file.toString()));
        Path libraryClasses = null;
        if (library != null) {
            libraryClasses = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("lib-classes"));
            Path lib = Files.createDirectories(sources.resolve("lib")).resolve("Missing.java");
            Files.writeString(lib, library);
            assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d",
                libraryClasses.toString(), lib.toString()));
            args.addAll(0, List.of("-cp", libraryClasses.toString()));
        }
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        String entry = path.replace(".java", ".class");
        var archive = directory.resolve("input-" + path.hashCode() + ".jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(archive))) {
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(entry));
            zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(classes.resolve(entry)));
            zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return archive;
    }

    private static boolean waitFor(java.util.function.BooleanSupplier condition) throws InterruptedException {
        long deadline = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(30);
        while (System.nanoTime() < deadline) {
            if (condition.getAsBoolean()) return true;
            Thread.sleep(50);
        }
        return condition.getAsBoolean();
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class EngineRegistryTest {
    @Test void listsTheFourBundledEnginesInTheirFixedOrder() {
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower", "procyon", "jadx"), EngineRegistry.all().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower", "procyon", "jadx"), EngineRegistry.parse("all").stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of("jadx", "cfr"), EngineRegistry.parse("jadx,cfr").stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
    }

    @Test void rejectsUnknownAndDuplicateEnginesWithTheCliMessages() {
        assertEquals("Duplicate engine: cfr", assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> EngineRegistry.parse("cfr,cfr")).getMessage());
        assertEquals("Unknown engine: fernflower. Use cfr,vineflower,procyon,jadx or all.",
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> EngineRegistry.parse("fernflower")).getMessage());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> EngineRegistry.parse(""));
    }

    @Test void requestsKeepTheCliLimits() {
        Path in = Path.of("in.jar"), out = Path.of("out");
        var request = DecompileRequest.defaults(in, out);
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower"), request.engines().stream().map(e -> e.id()).toList());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofSeconds(120), request.timeout());
        assertTrue(request.stubs());
        assertNull(request.engineCache());
        assertEquals("Timeout must be 1..3600 seconds", assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
            () -> new DecompileRequest(in, out, EngineRegistry.all(), Duration.ofMillis(999), List.of(), null, true)).getMessage());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> new DecompileRequest(in, out, EngineRegistry.all(), Duration.ofSeconds(3601), List.of(), null, true));
        assertEquals("Select one to four engines", assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
            () -> new DecompileRequest(in, out, List.of(), Duration.ofSeconds(1), List.of(), null, true)).getMessage());
        var seventeen = Collections.nCopies(17, Path.of("lib.jar"));
        assertEquals("At most 16 dependency JARs", assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class,
            () -> new DecompileRequest(in, out, EngineRegistry.all(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), seventeen, null, true)).getMessage());
        assertEquals(Duration.ofSeconds(3600), RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(3600));
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> RequestLimits.timeoutSeconds(0));
        var dependencies = new ArrayList<>(List.of(Path.of("a.jar")));
        var copy = new DecompileRequest(in, out, EngineRegistry.all(), Duration.ofSeconds(60), dependencies, null, false);
        dependencies.add(Path.of("b.jar"));
        assertEquals(1, copy.dependencies().size());
    }
}
```

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

/** Phase G5: the obfuscator classification and the Skidfuscator reversal on the committed fixtures (nothing is run). */
class ObfuscationCheckTest {
    static final Path FIXTURES = Path.of("../../benchmarks/obfuscated");
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void recognizesSkidfuscatorAndNotTheCleanOrProguardJars() throws Exception {
        var skid = ObfuscationCheck.analyze(FIXTURES.resolve("skidfuscator/skid-fixture-obf.jar"));
        assertEquals("SUGGESTED", skid.verdict());
        assertEquals(ObfuscationCheck.SKIDFUSCATOR, skid.top().obfuscator(), skid.hypotheses().toString());
        assertTrue(skid.skidfuscator(), skid.top().toString());
        assertFalse(skid.top().reasons().isEmpty());
        assertFalse(skid.techniques().isEmpty());
        assertTrue(skid.classes() > 0);

        var clean = ObfuscationCheck.analyze(FIXTURES.resolve("skidfuscator/skid-fixture.jar"));
        assertFalse(clean.skidfuscator(), clean.summary());
        var proguard = ObfuscationCheck.analyze(FIXTURES.resolve("proguard8/obf8.jar"));
        assertFalse(proguard.skidfuscator(), proguard.summary());
    }

    @Test void reversesTheSkidfuscatorFixtureIntoClassesTheVerifierAccepts() throws Exception {
        var result = SkidReversal.run(FIXTURES.resolve("skidfuscator/skid-fixture-obf.jar"), directory.resolve("reversal"), Duration.ofSeconds(300));
        assertTrue(result.usable(), result.toString());
        assertTrue(Files.isRegularFile(result.jar()));
        assertTrue(result.linkedClasses() > 0);
        // The reversed jar no longer looks like Skidfuscator to the classifier.
        assertFalse(ObfuscationCheck.analyze(result.jar()).skidfuscator());
    }
}
```

`modules/workbench/src/test/java/dev/classrevive/workbench/ResultIndexTest.java`:

```java
package dev.classrevive.workbench;

import dev.classrevive.pipeline.JobListener;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
import javax.tools.ToolProvider;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.io.TempDir;
import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*;

class ResultIndexTest {
    @TempDir Path directory;

    @Test void readsAJobBackWithTheLevelsOfItsHtmlReport() throws Exception {
        var input = jar(Map.of("demo/Outer.java", """
            package demo;
            public class Outer {
                public int twice(int x) { return x * 2; }
                public static class Inner { public String name() { return "inner"; } }
            }
            """, "demo/Other.java", "package demo; public class Other { public long add(long a, long b) { return a + b; } }"));
        var request = new DecompileRequest(input, directory.resolve("out"), EngineRegistry.parse("cfr,vineflower"), Duration.ofSeconds(60),
            List.of(), null, true);
        var job = new DecompileService().decompile(request, JobListener.NONE).job();
        var index = ResultIndex.open(directory.resolve("out"));

        assertTrue(index.levelsAvailable());
        assertEquals(Set.of("demo/Outer", "demo/Outer$Inner", "demo/Other"), index.classes().keySet());
        var verification = job.selection().verification();
        var summary = index.summary();
        assertEquals(verification.status().name(), summary.compilation());
        assertEquals(verification.matchedSymbols(), summary.matchedSymbols());
        assertEquals(verification.expectedSymbols(), summary.expectedSymbols());
        assertEquals(job.selection().candidate(), summary.selectedCandidate());
        assertEquals("NOT_VERIFIED", summary.behavior());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr", "vineflower"), index.engines().stream().map(ResultIndex.EngineEntry::id).toList());
        assertEquals(List.of(ResultIndex.SELECTION, "cfr", "vineflower"), index.candidates());

        // Every class carries exactly the level the page shows for it.
        String html = Files.readString(directory.resolve("out/report.html"));
        var pageLevels = HtmlLevels.parse(html);
        assertEquals(index.classes().size(), pageLevels.size());
        index.classes().values().forEach(entry -> assertEquals(pageLevels.get(entry.className()), entry.level(), entry.className()));
        assertEquals(3, index.levelCounts().get(ResultIndex.Level.EXACT), index.levelCounts().toString());

        // A nested class lives in its top-level file in every candidate.
        var inner = index.classes().get("demo/Outer$Inner");
        assertEquals("demo/Outer.java", inner.file());
        for (String candidate : index.candidates()) {
            Path source = index.source("demo/Outer$Inner", candidate).orElseThrow(() -> new AssertionError(candidate));
            assertTrue(Files.readString(source).contains("Inner"), candidate);
            assertTrue(source.startsWith(directory.resolve("out").toAbsolutePath()));
        }
        assertTrue(index.source("demo/Missing", "cfr").isEmpty());
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException.class, () -> index.source("demo/Outer", "procyon"));
        assertEquals("demo/Outer", index.originalName("demo/Outer"));
    }

    @Test void readsAFolderWrittenBeforeLevelsExistedWithoutInventingThem() throws Exception {
        var output = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("old"));
        Files.createDirectories(output.resolve("cfr/sources/a"));
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("cfr/sources/a/B.java"), "package a; class B {}");
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("report.json"), """
            {"behavior":"NOT_VERIFIED","engines":[{"id":"cfr","version":"0.152","status":"OUTPUT_PRODUCED","source_files":1}],
             "input_sha256":"00","kind":"decompilation","provenance":{"a/B.java":"cfr"},"selected_candidate":"cfr",
             "portable_names":{"renamed_classes":{"a/b":"a/b_cr2"}},
             "verification":{"status":"COMPILED","errors":0,"matched_symbols":2,"expected_symbols":2,"structurally_complete":true,
               "class_coverage":[{"class_name":"a/B$C","matched_symbols":1,"expected_symbols":1},
                                 {"class_name":"a/b_cr2","matched_symbols":1,"expected_symbols":1}]}}
            """);
        var index = ResultIndex.open(output);
        assertFalse(index.levelsAvailable());
        assertTrue(index.levelCounts().isEmpty());
        var nested = index.classes().get("a/B$C");
        assertNull(nested.level());
        assertEquals("cfr", nested.origin());
        assertEquals(output.toAbsolutePath().normalize().resolve("cfr/sources/a/B.java"), index.source("a/B$C", "cfr").orElseThrow());
        assertEquals(List.of("cfr"), index.candidates());
        assertEquals("a/b", index.originalName("a/b_cr2"));
    }

    @Test void refusesWhatIsNotAReadableDecompileReport() throws Exception {
        var none = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("none"));
        assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> ResultIndex.open(none));
        for (String text : List.of("not json", "[]", "{\"kind\":\"benchmark\"}", "{\"kind\":\"decompilation\"}",
                "{\"kind\":\"decompilation\",\"verification\":{\"status\":7}}")) {
            var folder = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("bad-" + Math.abs(text.hashCode())));
            Files.writeString(folder.resolve("report.json"), text);
            assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> ResultIndex.open(folder), text);
        }
    }

    @Test void neverReturnsAFileOutsideTheCandidateFolder() throws Exception {
        // A tampered report naming a class that climbs out of the sources folder.
        var output = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("tampered"));
        Files.createDirectories(output.resolve("cfr/sources"));
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("cfr/evil.java"), "outside");
        Files.writeString(output.resolve("report.json"), """
            {"behavior":"NOT_VERIFIED","engines":[{"id":"cfr","version":"0.152","status":"OUTPUT_PRODUCED","source_files":1}],
             "input_sha256":"00","kind":"decompilation","selected_candidate":"cfr",
             "verification":{"status":"COMPILED","errors":0,"matched_symbols":1,"expected_symbols":1,"structurally_complete":true,
               "class_coverage":[{"class_name":"../evil","matched_symbols":1,"expected_symbols":1}]}}
            """);
        var index = ResultIndex.open(output);
        assertTrue(index.classes().containsKey("../evil"));
        assertTrue(index.source("../evil", "cfr").isEmpty());
    }

    /** Class levels as report.html renders them: package summaries, then one table row per class with its level pill. */
    static final class HtmlLevels {
        private static final Pattern PACKAGE = Pattern.compile("<summary><code>([^<]*)</code>");
        private static final Pattern ROW = Pattern.compile("<tr><td><code>([^<]*)</code>.*?<span class=\"pill ([a-z-]+)\">", Pattern.DOTALL);

        static Map<String,ResultIndex.Level> parse(String html) {
            var levels = new TreeMap<String,ResultIndex.Level>();
            var packages = PACKAGE.matcher(html);
            var starts = new ArrayList<int[]>();
            var names = new ArrayList<String>();
            while (packages.find()) { starts.add(new int[]{packages.start()}); names.add(unescape(packages.group(1))); }
            for (int i = 0; i < names.size(); i++) {
                int from = starts.get(i)[0], to = i + 1 < starts.size() ? starts.get(i + 1)[0] : html.length();
                String pkg = names.get(i).equals("(default package)") ? "" : names.get(i).replace('.', '/') + "/";
                var rows = ROW.matcher(html.substring(from, to));
                while (rows.find()) levels.put(pkg + unescape(rows.group(1)), ResultIndex.Level.valueOf(rows.group(2).toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT).replace('-', '_')));
            }
            return levels;
        }

        static String unescape(String text) {
            return text.replace("&lt;", "<").replace("&gt;", ">").replace("&quot;", "\"").replace("&#39;", "'").replace("&amp;", "&");
        }
    }

    private Path jar(Map<String,String> sources) throws Exception {
        var sourceRoot = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("src"));
        var classes = Files.createDirectories(directory.resolve("classes"));
        var args = new ArrayList<>(List.of("--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-d", classes.toString()));
        for (var source : sources.entrySet()) {
            Path file = sourceRoot.resolve(source.getKey());
            Files.createDirectories(file.getParent());
            Files.writeString(file, source.getValue());
            args.add(file.toString());
        }
        assertEquals(0, ToolProvider.getSystemJavaCompiler().run(null, null, null, args.toArray(String[]::new)));
        var archive = directory.resolve("input.jar");
        try (var zip = new ZipOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(archive)); var walk = Files.walk(classes)) {
            for (Path file : walk.filter(Files::isRegularFile).sorted().toList()) {
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(classes.relativize(file).toString().replace('\\', '/')));
                zip.write(Files.readAllBytes(file));
                zip.closeEntry();
            }
        }
        return archive;
    }
}

```

`scripts/benchmarks/skidfuscator.py`:

```py
"""Phase 2CD: reproducible Skidfuscator benchmark with an answer key.

Builds Skidfuscator from a pinned commit (it runs only as a tool; the obfuscated jars are the targets), obfuscates
jars whose source we have, decompiles each obfuscated jar with ClassRevive and scores the result against the original
jar (`classrevive compare-reference`). No target code is executed: ClassRevive only parses and decompiles, and javac only
compiles the recovered sources.

Skidfuscator draws its keys from an unseeded java.util.Random, so every run produces different bytes. The script fixes
the tool commit and configuration and records the SHA-256 of every input and obfuscated jar in summary.json; the
reversal must work for any draw, so a benchmark is a sample of draws, not one fixed file.

Usage (from the repository root, after `./gradlew :cli:installDist`):
  python scripts/benchmarks/skidfuscator.py --sets fixture,dev,holdout --output .analysis/skid-bench/<name>
      [--passes skidfuscator] [--deobfuscate auto|off] [--runs 1] [--samples gson,asm]
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile

SKIDFUSCATOR_REPO = "https://github.com/skidfuscatordev/skidfuscator-java-obfuscator"
SKIDFUSCATOR_COMMIT = "e4c0f981911703e86ac8a2b1a77d7cfd18b9d719"  # 2026-09-23, version 2.1.0, MIT
ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
FIXTURE = ROOT / "benchmarks" / "obfuscated" / "skidfuscator"
WINDOWS = os.name == "nt"


def sha256(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(path, "rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def run(command, cwd=None, log=None, timeout=3600):
    started = time.time()
    with open(log, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") if log else open(os.devnull, "w") as out:
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
    return result.returncode, round(time.time() - started, 1)


def gradlew():
    return [str(ROOT / ("gradlew.bat" if WINDOWS else "gradlew"))]


def classrevive():
    # CLASSREVIVE_HOME: an installed copy (so a long run is not disturbed by rebuilding the working tree).
    home = pathlib.Path(os.environ.get("CLASSREVIVE_HOME", ROOT / "modules" / "cli" / "build" / "install" / "classrevive"))
    return [str(home / "bin" / ("classrevive.bat" if WINDOWS else "classrevive"))]


def build_skidfuscator(work):
    source = work / "skidfuscator-src"
    if not source.is_dir():
        subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "--quiet", SKIDFUSCATOR_REPO, str(source)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(source), "checkout", "--quiet", SKIDFUSCATOR_COMMIT], check=True)
    head = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(source), "rev-parse", "HEAD"], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    if head != SKIDFUSCATOR_COMMIT:
        sys.exit(f"Skidfuscator checkout is {head}, expected {SKIDFUSCATOR_COMMIT}")
    tool = source / "dev.skidfuscator.client.standalone" / "build" / "libs" / "client-standalone-all.jar"
    if not tool.is_file():
        wrapper = source / ("gradlew.bat" if WINDOWS else "gradlew")
        code, _ = run([str(wrapper), ":client-standalone:shadowJar", "-x", "test", "--console=plain"], cwd=source, log=work / "skidfuscator-build.log")
        if code != 0 or not tool.is_file():
            sys.exit("Skidfuscator build failed; see " + str(work / "skidfuscator-build.log"))
    return tool


def fixture_jar(work):
    """Compiles the authored fixture with javac --release 8 into a jar with fixed timestamps and sorted entries."""
    classes = work / "fixture-classes"
    shutil.rmtree(classes, ignore_errors=True)
    sources = sorted(str(p) for p in (FIXTURE / "src").rglob("*.java"))
    subprocess.run(["javac", "--release", "8", "-proc:none", "-encoding", "UTF-8", "-d", str(classes)] + sources, check=True)
    jar = work / "samples" / "fixture" / "skid-fixture.jar"
    jar.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(jar, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as out:
        for path in sorted(classes.rglob("*.class")):
            info = zipfile.ZipInfo(path.relative_to(classes).as_posix(), (1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
            info.compress_type = zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED
            out.writestr(info, path.read_bytes())
    return jar


def samples(work, sets, only):
    result = []
    for name in sets:
        if name == "fixture":
            result.append(("fixture", fixture_jar(work)))
            continue
        task = ":cli:scoreboardCorpus" + name[0].upper() + name[1:]
        subprocess.run(gradlew() + [task, "-q", "--console=plain"], cwd=ROOT, check=True)
        corpus = ROOT / "build" / "scoreboard-corpus" / name
        for jar in sorted(corpus.glob("*.jar")):
            result.append((name, jar))
    if only:
        result = [(s, j) for s, j in result if any(token in j.name for token in only)]
    return result


def dependencies(jar):
    deps = jar.parent / (jar.name + ".deps")
    return sorted(deps.glob("*.jar")) if deps.is_dir() else []


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--sets", default="fixture")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--passes", default="")
    # Phase 2DD: decompile reverses a recognized obfuscator by itself; "off" measures the engines on the obfuscated classes.
    parser.add_argument("--deobfuscate", choices=["auto", "off"], default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--runs", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", default="")
    parser.add_argument("--engines", default="all")
    parser.add_argument("--reuse", default="", help="earlier output folder whose obfuscated jars are measured again (same draws)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    output = pathlib.Path(args.output).resolve()
    if output.exists():
        sys.exit("Output exists; choose a new folder")
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    work = ROOT / ".analysis"
    work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    reuse = pathlib.Path(args.reuse).resolve() if args.reuse else None
    tool = None if reuse else build_skidfuscator(work)
    configs = {"fixture": FIXTURE / "skidfuscator.hocon"}
    library_config = FIXTURE / "skidfuscator-libraries.hocon"
    rows = []
    for set_name, jar in samples(work, args.sets.split(","), [s for s in args.samples.split(",") if s]):
        deps = dependencies(jar)
        for draw in range(1, args.runs + 1):
            case = output / f"{set_name}-{jar.stem}-{draw}"
            case.mkdir()
            libs = case / "libs"
            libs.mkdir()
            for dep in deps:
                shutil.copy(dep, libs / dep.name)
            obfuscated = case / "obfuscated.jar"
            config = configs.get(set_name, library_config)
            # Skidfuscator fails on module descriptors ("Failed to compute some libraries!"): it gets the jar without
            # module-info.class and META-INF/versions/; the answer key stays the original jar.
            tool_input = case / "input.jar"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(jar) as source, zipfile.ZipFile(tool_input, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as target:
                for item in source.infolist():
                    if item.filename.endswith("module-info.class") or item.filename.startswith("META-INF/versions/"):
                        continue
                    target.writestr(item, source.read(item))
            # -notrack: Skidfuscator otherwise sends analytics. The tool runs in its own JVM; it is not a target. It writes
            # error dumps and a mappings/ cache into its working directory, so it runs inside the case folder.
            if reuse:
                earlier = reuse / case.name
                if (earlier / "obfuscated.jar").is_file():
                    shutil.copy(earlier / "obfuscated.jar", obfuscated)
                    shutil.copy(earlier / "skidfuscator.log", case / "skidfuscator.log")
                code, seconds = 0, 0.0
            else:
                code, seconds = run(["java", "-jar", str(tool), "obfuscate", "-notrack", "-cfg", str(config), "-li", str(libs),
                                     "-o", str(obfuscated), str(tool_input)], cwd=case, log=case / "skidfuscator.log")
            row = {"set": set_name, "sample": jar.name, "draw": draw, "input_sha256": sha256(jar), "obfuscate_seconds": seconds,
                   "config": config.name}
            if (case / "skidfuscator.log").is_file() and b"Exception" in (case / "skidfuscator.log").read_bytes():
                row["skidfuscator_exceptions"] = True
            if code != 0 or not obfuscated.is_file():
                row["status"] = "OBFUSCATION_FAILED"
                rows.append(row)
                continue
            # Skidfuscator 2.1.0 leaves class files older than Java 8 untouched: such a sample is no Skidfuscator sample.
            log = (case / "skidfuscator.log").read_bytes() if (case / "skidfuscator.log").is_file() else b""
            if b"Executed String Encryption [Success: 0 " in log and b"Executed Flow Condition [Success: 0 " in log:
                row["status"] = "NOT_OBFUSCATED"
                rows.append(row)
                continue
            row["obfuscated_sha256"] = sha256(obfuscated)
            target = obfuscated
            if args.passes:
                code, seconds = run(classrevive() + ["transform", str(obfuscated), "--output", str(case / "transform"),
                                                     "--passes", args.passes, "--max-changes", "10000", "--timeout-seconds", "3600"],
                                    log=case / "transform.log")
                row["transform_seconds"] = seconds
                reversed_jar = case / "transform" / "worker" / "transformed" / "transformed.jar"
                if code != 0 or not reversed_jar.is_file():
                    row["status"] = "TRANSFORM_FAILED"
                    rows.append(row)
                    continue
                target = reversed_jar
            classpath = os.pathsep.join(str(d) for d in deps)
            command = classrevive() + ["decompile", str(target), "--output", str(case / "decompile"), "--engines", args.engines,
                                       "--timeout-seconds", "1800", "--deobfuscate", args.deobfuscate]
            if deps:
                command += ["--classpath", classpath]
            _, seconds = run(command, log=case / "decompile.log")
            row["decompile_seconds"] = seconds
            command = classrevive() + ["compare-reference", str(jar), str(case / "decompile"), "--output", str(case / "reference"),
                                       "--timeout-seconds", "1800"]
            if deps:
                command += ["--classpath", classpath]
            code, _ = run(command, log=case / "reference.log")
            evidence = case / "reference" / "reference.json"
            if code != 0 or not evidence.is_file():
                row["status"] = "COMPARE_FAILED"
                rows.append(row)
                continue
            data = json.loads(evidence.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            whole = data["whole_compilation"]
            row.update({"status": "MEASURED", "compiled": whole["status"] == "COMPILED", "errors": whole["errors"],
                        "signatures": [whole["matched_symbols"], whole["expected_symbols"]],
                        "bodies": [data["bodies_recovered"], data["reference_bodies"]],
                        "literals": [data["literals_found"], data["literals"]],
                        "files_naming_foreign_classes": [data["files_naming_foreign_classes"], data["reference_source_files"]]})
            rows.append(row)
    summary = {"schema_version": 1, "behavior": "NOT_VERIFIED", "skidfuscator_commit": SKIDFUSCATOR_COMMIT,
               "skidfuscator_config_sha256": {path.name: sha256(path) for path in [configs["fixture"], library_config]},
               "passes": args.passes, "deobfuscate": args.deobfuscate, "rows": rows}
    (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    lines = ["| Sample | Draw | Compiles? | Signatures | Bodies | Literals | Files naming obfuscator classes |",
             "|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|"]

    def frac(pair):
        return f"{pair[0]}/{pair[1]} ({100.0 * pair[0] / pair[1]:.1f}%)" if pair[1] else "n/a"

    for row in rows:
        if row["status"] != "MEASURED":
            lines.append(f"| {row['sample']} | {row['draw']} | {row['status']} | | | | |")
            continue
        lines.append(f"| {row['sample']} | {row['draw']} | {'yes' if row['compiled'] else 'no, ' + str(row['errors']) + ' errors'} | "
                     f"{frac(row['signatures'])} | {frac(row['bodies'])} | {frac(row['literals'])} | {frac(row['files_naming_foreign_classes'])} |")
    measured = [r for r in rows if r["status"] == "MEASURED"]
    if measured:
        total = lambda key: [sum(r[key][0] for r in measured), sum(r[key][1] for r in measured)]
        lines.append(f"| **all** | | {sum(r['compiled'] for r in measured)}/{len(measured)} | {frac(total('signatures'))} | "
                     f"{frac(total('bodies'))} | {frac(total('literals'))} | {frac(total('files_naming_foreign_classes'))} |")
    (output / "summary.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print("\n".join(lines))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`scripts/check_benchmark.py`:

```py
"""Independently validate benchmark evidence; no target code is imported or run."""
import json
import pathlib
import sys

root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
report = json.loads((root / "benchmark.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert report["schema_version"] == 1
assert report["behavior"] == "NOT_VERIFIED"
assert report["attempted"] == len(report["rows"]) > 0
assert report["structurally_complete"] == sum(row["status"] == "STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE" for row in report["rows"])
assert (root / "benchmark.md").is_file()
hashes = {}
for row in report["rows"]:
    if row["case"] in hashes:
        assert hashes[row["case"]] == row["input_sha256"]
    hashes[row["case"]] = row["input_sha256"]
for engine in ("cfr", "vineflower", "procyon", "jadx"):
    assert (engine in report["variants"]) == (engine not in report["not_measured"])
for variant, summary in report["variants"].items():
    rows = [row for row in report["rows"] if row["variant"] == variant]
    assert len(rows) == summary["attempted"] == report["samples"]
    assert summary["recompiled"] == sum(row.get("verification", {}).get("status") == "COMPILED" for row in rows)
    assert summary["structurally_complete"] == sum(row["status"] == "STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE" for row in rows)
for row in report["rows"]:
    assert row["total_elapsed_ms"] >= 0
    if "report" in row:
        child_path = (root / row["report"]).resolve()
        assert child_path.is_relative_to(root.resolve())
        child = json.loads(child_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        assert child["input_sha256"] == row["input_sha256"]
        assert child["behavior"] == "NOT_VERIFIED"
        assert child["verification"] == row["verification"]
progress = [json.loads(line) for line in (root / "progress.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
assert progress == report["rows"]
print(f"Validated {report['attempted']} benchmark rows and linked evidence reports.")
```
